qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over topsalarissen bij de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep

An MP asked whether a presenter's reported high salary at the public broadcaster was true and what the government would do about such pay funded by taxpayers. The state secretary said the salary exceeds the WNT disclosure norm, that the exact figure cannot be verified from disclosed data, that the NPO will revise its hiring and pay policy, and that the cabinet will extend the WNT pay cap to non-top staff via the WNT-3 bill going to the Raad van State.
I have ordered the public broadcaster to inform me shortly of the concrete follow-up steps it intends to take regarding a more responsible hiring and remuneration policy.
Ik heb de publieke omroep gesommeerd mij op korte termijn te laten weten welke concrete vervolgstappen zij voornemens is te zetten op het terrein van een meer verantwoord inhuur- en beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over de brandbrief van Europese luchtvaartmaatschappijen over de ‘kwestie Gibraltar’

An MP asked the state secretary about a letter from European airlines complaining that the long-running Gibraltar dispute delays EU aviation legislation (SES2+, passenger rights, airport slots) and raises costs, and asked about Dutch EU presidency involvement and the timeline. The secretary acknowledged the delay, said the Netherlands and the Commission urge a solution as honest broker, and said a breakthrough is unlikely before the Spanish elections on 26 June.
As Chair we will continue to encourage both parties to reach a solution.
Als Voorzitter zullen we beide partijen blijven aanmoedigen om tot een oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over het bod van de NOS op de eredivisiesamenvattingen

An MP asked the State Secretary about the NOS bid for Eredivisie highlights, the confidential deal with FOX Sports, the reported EUR 75 million cost, STER-time arrangements and the timing of the Commissariaat voor de Media investigation. The State Secretary said the financial details and STER arrangements remain confidential under the agreement, that the Commissariaat has published a decision and will widen its investigation, and that transparency in future contracts is being discussed with the NPO and NOS.
Because of the confidentiality agreed between the NOS and EMM, I have so far been unable to make public any information on the financial details of the contract, and I cannot do so now.
Vanwege de geheimhouding die de NOS en EMM zijn overeengekomen heb ik tot op heden geen informatie over de financiële details van de overeenkomst openbaar kunnen maken en kan ik dat ook nu niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias inzake STER-afspraken in het NOS-contract voor de eredivisiesamenvattingen

An MP asked the State Secretary about STER advertising arrangements in the NOS contract for Eredivisie highlights, including free spots for Fox and whether these lower STER payments to the media budget. The government answered that the Commissariaat voor de Media is responsible for assessing Mediawet compliance, is investigating and has extended its inquiry to STER, and that it will await the outcome without commenting on legality itself.
The Commissariaat announced on 19 January 2015 that it is continuing and widening its investigation into the purchase of Eredivisie highlights rights to other parties, including the Ster.

Het Commissariaat heeft op 19 januari 2015 aangekondigd dat het zijn onderzoek naar de aankoop van de rechten op de Eredivisiesamenvattingen vervolgt en verbreedt naar andere partijen, waaronder de Ster.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias inzake de nieuwe ledenwervingsactie van Omroep Max

An MP asked the state secretary about Omroep Max's membership campaign offering a free book worth more than the membership fee, whether this breaches the Mediawet ban on benefits, the status of the Commissariaat's fine, and the regulator's sanction options. The state secretary agreed the offer is undesirable, confirmed the ban on monetary benefits took effect on 1 January 2015, reported a fine of 180,000 euros imposed on Omroep Max, and listed the regulator's available instruments.
The Commissariaat will shortly carry out a sample check to see whether the ban is being complied with.
Het Commissariaat zal binnenkort een steekproef houden om te zien of het verbod goed wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Elias en Straus over het functioneren van L1 als rampenzender tijdens de asbest-situatie in Roermond

Two VVD MPs asked whether regional broadcaster L1 should function as a disaster broadcaster during the Roermond asbestos fire, how quickly it reported compared with national media, and whether the government will improve regional disaster reporting. The minister replied that L1 was not formally activated as calamity broadcaster, that the safety region chose other channels, and that an evaluation with the province, safety regions and L1 will follow.
For the timeline of journalistic coverage of the incident on the various platforms of broadcaster L1 and other media, I refer you to the broadcasters concerned.
Voor de tijdlijn van de journalistieke verslaggeving van het incident op de verschillende platforms van omroep L1 en andere media, verwijs ik u naar de betreffende omroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over de regelgeving inzake onbemande luchtvaartuigen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about drone regulation: the rationale for hobbyists flying up to 25 kg without a permit while professional use requires one, support for initiatives like the Dutch Drone Academy, and a letter on the state of rules on privacy and safety. The government answered that a permit regime aligns with ICAO practice, that a framework for non-complex professional operations will be published soon, and that a WODC report and cabinet position will follow by February and summer 2015.
By February at the latest, the cabinet will send you the WODC report 'The use of drones; an exploratory study of unmanned aircraft', with a first cabinet position in outline.

Uiterlijk in februari zal het kabinet het WODC-rapport «Het gebruik van drones; Een verkennend onderzoek naar onbemande luchtvaartuigen», met een eerste kabinetsstandpunt op hoofdlijnen, aan u doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Elias over wie de baas is van 'de rode knop' op de afstandsbediening

MPs De Liefde and Elias (VVD) asked whether the government intends to resolve the dispute over who controls the 'red button' on TV remotes between broadcasters and cable/telecom providers, and how the legal rules differ between cable, IP-TV and over-the-top services. The State Secretary answered that the rules on must-carry obligations are technology-neutral since 1 January 2014, that the legislator cannot impose carriage obligations on specific techniques such as HbbTV, that the relevant rules will be reviewed and modernised later this year, and that carriage negotiations between providers and broadcasters are free commercial negotiations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over het bericht dat de NOS de samenvattingsrechten van het eredivisievoetbal voor de komende drie jaar heeft verworven

An MP asked the Education, Culture and Science State Secretary about the NOS acquiring highlights rights to Eredivisie football and whether the bidding was distorted or the amounts kept secret. The State Secretary answered that the Commissariat for the Media is investigating, that the NOS is bound by a non-disclosure agreement and the amounts remain undisclosed, that he finds this unsatisfactory and will push for transparency and tighten rules on efficiency, and offered confidential briefing to media spokespersons.
The NOS appears bound by the contractual agreements made with Eredivisie Media&Marketing (EMM) on this matter.
De NOS blijkt gehouden aan de contractuele afspraken die hierover zijn gemaakt met Eredivisie Media&Marketing (EMM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over landingsbeperkingen voor vrachtvliegtuigen op Schiphol

An MP asked whether the Dutch government refuses cargo airlines landing rights at Schiphol and whether it would consult stakeholders on easing conditions for freight flights. The state secretary answered that non-EU carriers need route permits based on bilateral agreements or case-by-case weighing, that refusals occur in a limited number of cases, that the government cannot assess other countries' decisions, and that it is willing to consult the air cargo sector on the assessment framework.
I have no insight into requests for traffic rights made in other countries, such as Belgium and Germany.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de verzoeken voor verkeersrechten die worden gedaan in andere landen, zoals België en Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over het bericht dat de luistercijfers van het publieke radiostation FunX niet openbaar zijn

An MP asked the State Secretary why FunX radio listening figures were not public, and whether a commitment to inform parliament about the Commissariaat voor de Media's view on the NPO's FunX arrangement had been kept. The State Secretary answered that the NPO and the NLO excluded FunX from the standard listening survey for representativeness reasons, that a separate survey has been commissioned and its results will be published this year, and that the commitment was met in the 2013 budget letter.
Listening figures for FunX will therefore be made public this year.
Er zullen dit jaar dus luistercijfers over FunX openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over het vergassen van ganzen

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that goose gassing (CO2) cannot be used on Schiphol throughout 2014, and whether the European exemption applies, why winter rest is maintained, and why interim measures are not taken. The government says CO2 use awaits a biocide authorisation under an ongoing EU procedure, that gassing and scaring were done under exemptions in 2012–2013, and that a multi-track approach runs with results to be reported at year-end.
Once the substance is officially placed on the EU list of permitted agents, the Ctgb can grant an authorisation for a CO2-based product in the Netherlands.

Zodra de stof in Europa officieel op de lijst is geplaatst van toegestane middelen kan door het College voor de toelating van Gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden (Ctgb) een toelating voor een middel op basis van CO 2 in Nederland worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Dijkhoff, Elias en Litjens over het artikel ‘Onderzoek naar corruptie KLM werd vroegtijdig gestaakt’

MPs from the VVD asked whether a Caribbean corruption investigation into KLM-linked bribery was stopped early after a judge-commissioner imposed a four-month time limit, and why. The minister answered that the time limit was set under the reasonable-time rules, the prosecution prioritised two of eight files, the Oil Trading Bonaire file was dropped, and a later court complaint was only partly upheld.
The Public Prosecution Service on Bonaire has informed me that neither the Oil Trading Bonaire file nor other investigation has shown any free business-class flights.
Het Openbaar Ministerie op Bonaire heeft mij bericht dat noch uit het dossier «Oil Trading Bonaire», noch uit overig onderzoek, is gebleken over gratis businessclassvluchten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Elias over het verhogen van de maximumsnelheid op de A2

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the speed limit on the entire A2 motorway could be raised to 130 km/h, its cost within existing budgets, the cost of enabling this earlier, and which sections could be done quickly. The minister answered that a large part of the A2 can eventually be raised to 130 km/h within environmental and nature conditions, with the pace set by air quality and noise ceilings, and that about 28 km could be raised in 2014 depending on the PAS nitrogen programme.
Antwoord vragen Elias over het publiceren van een videoschouw op de website van het departement van Infrastructuur en Milieu

An MP asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment to publish on the ministry's website a video inspection of unclear speed-limit signage on the A2 motorway between Vinkeveen and Abcoude, which the minister had earlier said could not be sent to parliament because it was a video. The minister agreed to make the video publicly available and gave a link to it on the Rijkswaterstaat website.
Yes, I am willing to make the video inspection concerning the speed limit signage on the A2 publicly available.
Ja, ik ben bereid de videoschouw betreffende de bebording van de maximumsnelheid op de A2 openbaar te maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Elias over de kwetsbaarheid van vangrails

An MP asks the minister about a truck that broke through a median guardrail on the A1, how this fits earlier statements that guardrails are adequate for heavier trucks (LZVs), and whether Dutch guardrails are designed for proposed 44-tonne vehicles. The minister answers that such breaches are rare and depend on circumstances, that the H2 performance class was chosen on cost-effectiveness and accident analysis, and that the current class is considered sufficient without committing to new measures.
I do not consider it necessary to assume the heaviest vehicles and the most unfavourable impact conditions.
Ik acht het niet noodzakelijk van de zwaarste voertuigen en de ongunstigste inrijdcondities uit te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Elias en Litjens over het mogelijk stellen van natuur boven mensen in Flevoland

MPs Elias and Litjens asked the state secretary whether nature protection in Flevoland is placed above residents' living conditions, given that Natura 2000 areas are overflown at higher altitudes than inhabited areas like Zeewolde, and whether the government will work with the municipality on a solution. The state secretary answered that existing national noise and nature standards apply equally, that the Alders advice ensures a minimum flight altitude over protected areas, and that the Alders table will continue working on route design and noise-reduction measures with the municipality.
At the end of last year I gave Mr Alders the assignment to draw up an implementation programme for elaborating the Alders advice on Lelystad.
Ik heb eind vorig jaar de heer Alders de opdracht gegeven om een uitvoeringsprogramma op te stellen voor de uitwerking van het Aldersadvies Lelystad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over het transitokenteken voor de doorvoer van niet-gekentekende voertuigen

An MP asked the minister whether the transit plate for non-registered vehicles is rarely used due to strict requirements and whether it disadvantages Dutch exporters compared with other countries. The minister replied that the plate protects road safety and prevents theft, that the RDW procedure is efficient, and that she is willing to explore faster procedures with the sector but will not allow administrative issuance because of fraud.
I am certainly willing to examine with the sector whether the procedures can be made faster and better, but returning to administrative issuance is not an option because of fraud.
Ik ben zeker bereid met de sector te onderzoeken of de procedures nog sneller en beter kunnen, maar teruggaan naar het verleden met administratieve verstrekking is vanwege fraude geen optie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Elias en Lucas over de dreigende sluiting Vaktechnisch Opleidingscentrum VTOC Fokker

Two VVD MPs asked the education minister about the threatened closure of the VTOC Fokker aircraft maintenance training centre, its lack of standalone funding, and whether graduates are disadvantaged. The minister confirmed awareness, said the current law offers no funding route for private training, denied that only VTOC and one other centre place graduates, and promised a review with stakeholders by year-end.
It was agreed with those involved to examine how aircraft maintenance education can be offered in an accessible, high-quality and efficient way.
Met de betrokkenen is afgesproken te bezien op welke wijze het vliegtuigonderwijs op toegankelijke, kwalitatief goede en doelmatige wijze aangeboden kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Elias en Van der Steur over misbruik door NS van gegevens van de OV -chipkaart

MPs Elias and Van der Steur asked the ministers whether NS misused OV-chipkaart travel data for marketing, as the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) found, whether this breached 2008 agreements, and what would ensure the misuse has stopped. The minister accepts the CBP's findings, notes NS has already destroyed the data and changed its practice, and states that monitoring and enforcement lie with the CBP rather than with the government.
The CBP is charged with supervising compliance with and enforcement of the Personal Data Protection Act (Wbp).
Het CBP is belast met toezicht op de naleving en handhaving van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp).
Antwoord vragen Elias en Azmani over werkloze jongeren die op reis gaan naar Schotland

MPs Elias and Azmani (VVD) asked why unemployed youths are sent on a work placement to Scotland under an EU Leonardo da Vinci subsidy, questioning its value compared with domestic options and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The state secretary defended the project as eligible under EU criteria, said municipalities are responsible for tailored reintegration, and said the EU funds cannot be reclaimed while the project is still running.
These are EU funds, managed by the National Agency Lifelong Learning and awarded under European subsidy conditions.
Het betreft EU-middelen, die door het Nationaal Agentschap Leven Lang Leren worden beheerd en op grond van Europese subsidievoorwaarden zijn toegekend.
Antwoord vragen Elias over stakingen in het onderwijs

An MP asks the education minister about school closures and teacher strikes in March 2012, including whether schools must provide care for parents, whether strikers' salaries are paid, and whether lost teaching hours must be made up. The minister answers that striking is a worker's right, schools must communicate with parents and arrange alternative care, and the Inspectorate will monitor instructional time, while declining to investigate salary payments.

m: Motie van de leden Irrgang en Ouwehand over wettelijk vastleggen van de wijze van informeren van het parlement
Asks the government to set in statute how parliament will be informed in advance about support operations by the emergency ESM fund.
to legally establish how parliament will be informed in advance about support operations by the emergency fund
om wettelijk vast te leggen op welke manier het parlement vooraf zal worden geïnformeerd over steunoperaties door het noodfonds
Motie van het lid Ouwehand c.s. over een besluit over ratificatie pas na de verkiezingen van 12 september 2012
Asks that a decision on ratifying the European Stability Mechanism be taken only after the September 2012 elections by the newly elected House.
a decision on possible ratification of the ESM can only be taken after the elections of 12 September 2012
een besluit over eventuele ratificatie van het ESM pas na de verkiezingen van 12 september 2012 kan worden genomen

Amendement van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 27 over het vermelden van het volledige economische belang (zowel 'long' als 'short') bij het verzoek tot behandeling van een
Requires shareholders requesting a shareholder-meeting agenda item to disclose their full long and short economic interests in shares and related instruments.
This concerns a new obligation for the shareholder who requests treatment of an agenda item to disclose, with the request, his full economic interest (both long and short) in shares to the company.

Het betreft een nieuwe verplichting voor de aandeelhouder die om behandeling van een agendapunt verzoekt, om bij zijn verzoek zijn volledige economische belang (zowel «long» als «short») in aandelen bekend te maken aan de vennootschap.

Amendement van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 26 over het vermelden van het volledig economisch belang (zowel 'long' als 'short') bij het verzoek tot behandeling van een a
Requires shareholders requesting a shareholder-meeting agenda item to disclose their full long and short economic interest in the company's shares and related instruments.
to disclose at the time of his request his full economic interest (both long and short) in shares to the company
om bij zijn verzoek zijn volledige economische belang (zowel «long» als «short») in aandelen bekend te maken aan de vennootschap

Amendement van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over het vermelden van het volledig economisch belang (zowel 'long' als 'short') bij het verzoek tot behandeling van een a
Amends the Wft so that shareholders requesting a shareholder meeting agenda item must disclose their full long and short economic interest.
Amendement van de leden Groot en Irrgang over de bevoegdheid van de ondernemingsraad tot het indienen van een enquêteverzoek
Adds a right for the works council to file an enterprise-enquiry request to the Enterprise Chamber, alongside trade unions.
This amendment provides that not only the trade union but also the works council may file an enquiry request.
Dit amendement regelt dat niet alleen de vakbond, maar ook de OR een enquêteverzoek kan doen.
Amendement van het lid Irrgang over het tevens horen van de Stichting Autoriteit Financiële Markten
Amends the financial supervision act so that the Authority for the Financial Markets is also heard alongside De Nederlandsche Bank on requests to suspend or dismiss a director for insider trading.
in addition to De Nederlandsche Bank N.V., the Stichting Autoriteit Financiële Markten is also given the opportunity to be heard on the request
naast De Nederlandsche Bank N.V. ook de Stichting Autoriteit Financiële Markten in de gelegenheid wordt gesteld om over het verzoek te worden gehoord
Amendement van de leden Irrgang en Groot ter vervanging van nr. 17 over het tevens horen van de Stichting Autoriteit Financiële Markten
Adds the Stichting Autoriteit Financiële Markten alongside De Nederlandsche Bank as a body to be heard on requests concerning suspension or dismissal of directors.
This amendment ensures that, alongside De Nederlandsche Bank N.V., the Stichting Autoriteit Financiële Markten is also given the opportunity to be heard on the request.
Met dit amendement wordt bewerkstelligd dat naast De Nederlandsche Bank N.V. ook de Stichting Autoriteit Financiële Markten in de gelegenheid wordt gesteld om over het verzoek te worden gehoord.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Plasterk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over een scheiding tussen audit en non-audit bij OOB's
Bars accounting firms that audit public-interest organisations from also providing non-audit services to them, with transitional rules.
For public-interest organisations (OOBs) there must be a separation between audit services and other work.
Voor organisaties van openbaar belang (OOB's) moet er een scheiding komen van controlediensten en andere werkzaamheden.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Plasterk en Irrgang ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het uitbreiden van het bonusverbod naar dagelijks beleidsbepalers
Extends the state-aid bonus ban for financial firms from board members to all daily policy-makers.
remuneration of daily policy-makers, other than board members, insofar as it concerns support granted to a financial undertaking before 7 February 2012
beloningen van dagelijks beleidsbepalers, niet zijnde bestuurders, voor zover het steun betreft die is verleend aan een financiële onderneming voor 7 februari 2012
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Plasterk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over een scheiding tussen audit en non-audit bij OOB's
Requires accounting firms that audit organisations of public interest to provide no non-audit services to those organisations.
The accounting organisation that performs statutory audits at an organisation of public interest performs no other work for that organisation besides those audits.
De accountantsorganisatie die wettelijke controles verricht bij een organisatie van openbaar belang, verricht naast die controles geen andere werkzaamheden voor die organisatie.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Braakhuis en Irrgang ter vervanging van nr. 11 over het verplicht worden van opdrachtgevers om de AFM te informeren over de accountantskeuze
Amends the Civil Code so that certain companies of public interest must inform the AFM of their chosen auditor before appointing them, with ministerial rules on the notification.
This notification takes place before the assignment referred to in the second paragraph is granted.
Deze mededeling geschiedt voordat tot de verlening van die opdracht, bedoeld in het tweede lid, is overgegaan.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Vliet c.s. ter vervangign van nr. 8 over het opheffen van de chinese walls bij de AFM en het uitbreiden van bevoegdheden van de AFM in de onderzoeksfase
Amends the financial reporting supervision law to lift the internal Chinese walls at the AFM and to widen the AFM's investigative powers toward firms.
In addition, the AFM has only limited powers in the investigation phase.
Daarnaast heeft de AFM slechts beperkte bevoegdheden in de onderzoeksfase.

Tweede nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Irrgang en Blanksma-Van den Heuvel ter vervanging van nr. 20 over een lichte voorhang met instemmingsrecht op de AMvB betreffende de overbruggingsinstell
Adds a four-week waiting period before an AMvB on the bridging institution can be submitted, during which either chamber can block it, giving parliament a light pre-consultation and consent right.
This amendment creates a light pre-consultation provision with a consent right for the chambers.
Dit amendement zorgt voor een lichte voorhangbepaling met een instemmingsrecht voor de Kamers.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Irrgang en Blanksma-Van den Heuvel ter vervanging van nr. 16 over een lichte voorhang met instemmingsrecht op de AMvB betreffende de overbruggingsinstelling
Adds a light prior-consultation procedure with a consent right for the Chambers before the general administrative order on the bridging institution is issued.
If within that period one of the chambers or at least a fifth of the constitutional number of members decides not to consent to the draft, no proposal may be made
Indien binnen die termijn een der kamers of ten minste een vijfde van het grondwettelijk aantal leden besluit niet in te stemmen met het ontwerp, kan geen voordracht worden gedaan
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Irrgang en Blanksma-Van den Heuvel ter vervanging van nr. 12 over een lichte voorhang met instemmingsrecht op de AMvB betreffende de overbruggingsinstelling

Amendment requiring a four-week pre-submission period and a parliamentary veto (either chamber or a fifth of members) before the AMvB on the bridging institution (overbruggingsinstelling) can be submitted.

The proposal for a general administrative order to be established under the second paragraph shall not be made earlier than four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het tweede lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal overgelegd.
Amendement van het lid Irrgang over uitbreiding van de reikwijdte van het wetsvoorstel
Broadens the liability exclusion for supervisors DNB and AFM to cover supervision under all financial supervision laws, not only the Wft.
This amendment therefore provides that the liability limitation also applies to laws other than the Wft.
Dit amendement regelt daarom dat de aansprakelijkheidsbeperking ook geldt voor andere wetten dan de Wet op het financieel toezicht.
Amendement van het lid Irrgang over een zware voorhamg op de AMvB betreffende de overbruggingsinstelling
Adds a pre-consultation requirement so both Houses receive the draft AMvB on the bridging institution and can request it be made statutory.
This amendment provides a pre-submission provision to ensure parliamentary involvement in the content of this general administrative order.
Dit amendement zorgt voor een voorhangbepaling om parlementaire betrokkenheid bij de inhoud van deze algemene maatregel van bestuur te verzekeren.
Amendement van het lid Irrgang over bescherming tegen ongunstigere depositostelsel voor depositohouders na overdracht
Amendment barring transfer of deposit agreements to non-EU acquirers lacking equivalent deposit guarantee protection.
Deposit agreements may not be transferred to an acquirer based in a non-member state
Deposito-overeenkomsten worden niet overgedragen aan een overnemer met zetel in een staat die geen lidstaat is
Amendement van het lid Irrgang over het laten vervallen van de bevoorrechte positie van aandeelhouders die meer dan 5% van de aandelen bezitten
Amendment removing the privileged position of shareholders holding more than 5% of shares to be heard by the court before a transfer decision.
removes the privileged position for shareholders holding more than 5% of capital to be heard by the judge
schrapt de bevoorrechte positie voor aandeelhouders die meer dan 5% van het kapitaal hebben om door de rechter gehoord te worden
Amendement van het lid Irrgang over de rechten van depositohouders bij overdracht
Gives depositholders a two-month period to withdraw or switch without penalty when a deposit transfer changes their conditions to their detriment.

The acquirer may, if conditions have been changed to the depositor's detriment, not rely for two months after the notice in the Staatscourant on clauses restricting depositors' access to their deposits.

De overnemer kan, indien voorwaarden ingevolge het derde lid ten nadele van de depositohouder zijn gewijzigd, gedurende twee maanden na de mededeling in de Staatscourant, bedoeld in artikel 3:159l, tweede lid, geen beroep doen op bedingen
Amendement van het lid Irrgang over het vaststellen van de schadevergoeding
Amendment letting the minister set expropriation compensation instead of the court, with the Ondernemingskamer reviewing only on request.
this amendment provides that the amount of compensation is set by the minister instead of by the judge
regelt dit amendement dat de hoogte van de schadeloosstelling door de minister wordt vastgesteld in plaats van door de rechter
Amendement van de leden Braakhuisen en Irrgang over het verplicht worden van opdrachtgevers om de AFM te informeren over de accountantskeuze
Requires companies of public interest to notify the AFM of their chosen auditor before the shareholder meeting appoints them.
Clients (public-interest entities in this case) must be obliged to inform the AFM about the choice of accountant
Opdrachtgevers (ondernemingen van openbaar belang, OOB’s in dit geval) moeten verplicht worden de AFM te informeren over de accountantskeuze
Amendement van het lid Plasterk c.s. over een scheiding tussen audit en non- audit bij OOB's
Prohibits accounting firms that audit organisations of public interest from also providing non-audit services to those organisations.
An accounting organisation responsible for the statutory audit ... performs no other activities for that organisation alongside those audits.
Een accountantsorganisatie die verantwoordelijk is voor de wettelijke controle ... voert naast die controles geen andere werkzaamheden uit voor die organisatie.
Amendement van het lid Van Vliet c.s. over het opheffen van de chinese walls bij de AFM en het uitbreiden van bevoegdheden van de AFM in de onderzoeksfase
Removes the Chinese walls within the AFM so information can be shared across supervision units, and extends the AFM's investigative powers in the financial reporting supervision.
Because of the so-called Chinese Walls in AFM supervision, information from other departments cannot be used
Door de zogenaamde «Chinese Walls» in het toezicht van de AFM kan de informatie van andere afdelingen niet gebruikt worden
Amendement van de leden Plasterk en Irrgang over het uitbreiden van het bonusverbod naar dagelijks beleidsbepalers
Extends the pay restrictions for bailed-out financial firms from board managers to all persons who determine daily policy.
This amendment provides that the pay restrictions on managers of supported financial firms also apply to all persons who determine daily policy.
Dit amendement regelt dat de beperkingen die aan de beloning van bestuurders van gesteunde financiële ondernemingen worden gesteld ook van toepassing zijn op alle dagelijks beleidsbepalers.
Amendement van het lid Irrgang over de overgangsbepalingen vaste salarissen
Amends a transitional provision so that bonus-related pay components of executives at financially supported firms cannot rise above their 26 October 2011 value while state support continues.
cannot increase in value as long as there is support
niet in waarde kan toenemen zolang er sprake is van steun
Motie Bashir/Irrgang over een openbare database
Asks the government to set up a public database to which charities (ANBIs) must submit annual accounts and policy plans.
requests the government to set up a public database to which ANBIs are obliged to supply data
verzoekt de regering een openbare database op te zetten waaraan anbi's verplicht worden om gegevens te leveren

Amendement van de leden Bashir en Irrgang over het niet aanmerken van een instelling als ANBI indien de bestuurder/feitelijk leidinggevende een fiscaal loon heeft dat hoger is dan de zogenoemde DG-nor
Would deny ANBI charity status to institutions whose director or de facto leader earns above the 2011 DG salary norm.
an institution cannot be designated as a public benefit institution (ANBI) if its director or de facto leader has an annual fiscal salary above the so-called DG norm in 2011.

een instelling niet als algemeen nut beogende instelling (ANBI) worden aangemerkt indien de bestuurder of feitelijk leidinggevende van die instelling op jaarbasis een fiscaal loon heeft dat hoger is dan de zogenoemde DG-norm in 2011.
Amendement van het lid Irrgang over de verplichting tot aansluiting bij een geschilleninstantie
Requires financial firms to join a government-recognised complaints body for consumer disputes where such a body exists.
Joined to an instance for handling disputes about those products or services that is recognised by the Minister.

Dit amendement dient ertoe om de loongrens bij de werkgeversheffing van 15% op de zogenaamde backservice te verlagen naar € 185 000.
Amendement van het lid Irrgang om het toetsloon bij de werkgeversheffing op excessieve vertrekvergoedingen te verlagen naar € 185 000
Lowers the wage threshold of the employer levy on excessive severance payments from 500,000 euro to 185,000 euro and makes the levy non-deductible for corporate tax.
in article 32bb, second paragraph, the phrase 500,000 euro is replaced by 185,000 euro
wordt in artikel 32bb, tweede lid, de zinsnede «€ 500 000» vervangen door: € 185 000
Amendement van het lid Irrgang dat ertoe dient om de keuze om rendement op lucratieve belangen te belasten als aanmerkelijk belang uit het wetsvoorstel te halen
Removes the option to tax returns on lucrative interests as a substantial interest, so they are taxed as other work income.
This amendment aims to remove this option from the bill.
Dit amendement dient ertoe om deze keuzemogelijkheid uit het wetsvoorstel te halen.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Irrgang over het bericht dat Griekenland de afspraken over vermindering van het aantal ambtenaren schendt

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Greece hired tens of thousands of new civil servants in 2010-2011 despite agreed reductions, and whether the Troika knew. The minister confirmed that the reduction of civil servants was slower than planned due to hiring offsetting departures, cited the MoU target of 150,000 cuts by 2015, and said the Troika will monitor progress closely.
The Troika concluded in March that the main cause was the lack of effective centralised coordination in the public sector.
De Trojka oordeelde in maart jl. dat de voornaamste oorzaak hiervoor het gebrek aan effectieve gecentraliseerde coördinatie in de publieke sector betrof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Irrgang over de mogelijkheid om banksparen ook mogelijk te maken voor het aankopen van het pensioen

MPs Lodders (VVD) and Irrgang (SP) asked whether a mandatory insurance product covering longevity risk could make bank savings usable for buying a pension annuity. Minister Kamp replied that financial effects of non-existent products cannot be calculated and that splitting the product between a bank and an insurer would be complex and error-prone, referring to earlier answers.

Furthermore, I indicated in answer to question 6 of the earlier questions on this subject that I consider splitting the pension product into a savings part held at a bank and an insurance part held at an insurer to be a complicated structure in terms of costs and administration.

Verder heb ik in antwoord op vraag 6 van de eerder gestelde vragen over dit onderwerp aangegeven dat ik het splitsen van het pensioenproduct in een spaardeel dat ondergebracht wordt bij een bank en een verzekeringsdeel dat ondergebracht wordt bij een verzekeraar kostentechnisch en administratief een ingewikkelde constructie vind.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ferrier, Van der Staaij, El Fassed, De Lange, Ouwehand, Hachchi en Irrgang over het bericht dat ruim 18 miljoen mensen in de Sahel worden bedreigd door een humanitaire ramp

MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the Sahel food crisis affecting 18 million people, its urgency, past prevention efforts, Dutch funding levels, disaster risk reduction, and support for smallholders. The State Secretary answered that the situation is very serious, outlined past Dutch development projects, reported modest extra Dutch emergency contributions and planned bilateral and multilateral efforts, but gave no specific DRR funding breakdown and declined to pledge larger increases.
At present so-called aid tracking of DRR activities, labelling the DRR dimension of development cooperation activities, is not yet possible.
Op dit moment is het zogenoemde «aid tracking» van DRR activiteiten, het labellen van de DRR-dimensie van OS activiteiten, nog niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Irrgang over de mogelijkheden in het privaatrecht bonussen terug te vorderen

An MP asked whether private law allows clawing back or refusing excessive bonuses that cause public outrage, and whether contractual freedom is absolute. The minister answered that contractual freedom is not absolute, that bonus contracts are not untouchable under Civil Code provisions on reasonableness and fairness, and pointed to a bonus-adjustment bill and other measures such as pay caps in the public and semi-public sector.
The cabinet does not consider contracts in which high bonuses have been agreed to be untouchable.
Het kabinet acht contracten, waarin hoge bonussen zijn afgesproken, niet onaantastbaar.
Antwoord vragen Irrgang over het artikel ‘Hoe Arend Jan linkse taboes slecht – in zijn eentje’

An SP MP asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers whether a former foreign minister had agreed with a VVD MP to attack a colleague minister on development aid, whether the economic affairs minister is defending the development budget at the Catshuis talks, and whether a former MP's claims about cooperation were true. The minister answered that no such arrangement existed, declined to address the Catshuis talks beyond noting a parliamentary exchange had taken place, and said the practice described is consistent with good, transparent parliamentary conduct.
No, as explained in the answer to question 3.
Nee, zoals toegelicht bij beantwoording vraag 3.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Irrgang over waterprivatisering door de Wereldbank

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs to respond to a critical NGO report on World Bank support for water privatisation, and about a parliamentary amendment cutting Dutch funding to PPIAF. The government rejects full privatisation, defends PPIAF and the Dutch public-ownership model, and says the report is one-sided and that the contract adjustment reduced funding only in 2012.
After the contractual obligation with PPIAF ends in 2013, and based on an evaluation of the programme, it will be decided whether the Netherlands continues to support PPIAF after 2013.
Na het aflopen van de contractuele verplichting met PPIAF in 2013, en op basis van een evaluatie van het programma, zal worden besloten of Nederland PPIAF na 2013 blijft ondersteunen.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Irrgang over de terugbetaling van geïnde omstreden Amerikaanse invoerheffingen aan het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven

Two SP MPs asked whether the EU-US deal ending zeroing duties, which does not require refunds of wrongly collected duties to Dutch firms, is acceptable, and what can be done about collective recovery. The minister called the refund outcome disappointing but acceptable, said the EU lacks legal means to force US refunds, and said firms themselves must decide on collective action in US courts.
The agreement reached was the highest achievable and is therefore disappointing on refunds but wholly acceptable to me.
Het bereikte akkoord was het hoogst haalbare en is voor mij dan ook op het punt van terugbetaling teleurstellend maar in zijn geheel acceptabel.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over Europese wapenleveranties aan Griekenland

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of claims that France and Germany pressed Greece to spend EU aid on arms contracts and tied aid to submarine-type purchases. The minister confirmed awareness of both claims and said they gave him no reason to revise his earlier answers.
The statement by Mr Cohen Bendit and the anonymous remarks from a former Papandreou aide give me no reason to revise these answers.
De verklaring van de heer Cohen Bendit en de anonieme uitspraken van een medewerker van voormalig premier Papandreou geven mij geen aanleiding deze antwoorden ter herzien.
Antwoord vragen Irrgang en Jasper Van Dijk over de betrokkenheid van Nederland bij mogelijke bombardementsmissies op land in Somalië

MPs Irrgang and Van Dijk asked whether the Netherlands was involved in contingency plans for beach bombardment missions against pirate and insurgent camps in Somalia, and whether this would exceed the mandate. The ministers answered that the Netherlands was not involved in any such plans, that piracy and terrorism were conflated in the press, and that Atalanta's mandate rests on UN resolutions; they promised to inform parliament once EU decisions on action with effect on land are completed.
As soon as the decision-making in EU context on action from the sea, with effect on land, is completed, your House will be informed about this.
Zodra de besluitvorming in EU-verband over optreden vanaf zee, met effect op land voltooid is, wordt uw kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Irrgang over afschaffen omstreden Amerikaanse  invoerheffingen en terugbetaling van de geïnde heffingen aan het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven

Two SP MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister about the end of US 'zeroing' anti-dumping duties and why no refund of duties already paid by Dutch exporters was agreed. The state secretary welcomed the deal, said the WTO ruling was prospective only, and noted that the EU tried but failed to secure refunds, leaving affected firms to pursue US courts.
The ruling applies to the future and has no retroactive effect.
De uitspraak geldt voor de toekomst en heeft geen terugwerkende kracht.
Antwoord vragen Irrgang en Van Bommel over wapenleveranties aan Griekenland

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Finance whether Greece will buy costly, unnecessary weapons during its bailout, whether the Dutch government issued export licences and lobbied for German arms sales, and whether Greek defence spending is excessive. The minister replied that Greek defence budgets have fallen since 2007, that the Dutch licence concerns frigate radar components for a Greek shipbuilding programme unrelated to the Die Zeit report, and that Greek procurement is a matter for Greece, declining to confirm several reported claims.
It is for the Greek government to shape its security policy and to set the priorities for its armed forces, and therefore also for its investments.
Het is aan de Griekse regering om haar veiligheidsbeleid vorm te geven, alsook de prioriteiten vast te stellen voor de strijdkrachten en daarmee ook in het doen van investeringen.
Antwoord vragen Bashir, Gesthuizen en Irrgang inzake het toezicht op goede doelen

MPs Bashir, Gesthuizen and Irrgang (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about supervision of charities after a VPRO programme found many ANBI-listed organisations did not meet the listing conditions, including missing policy plans and governance requirements. The State Secretary declined to assess the CIGD study because only an anonymised extract was provided, described the Tax Authority's supervision and revocation powers, and said legislation requiring ANBIs to publish balance sheets is being prepared for submission before summer.
If it turns out that an institution does not meet one or more conditions, the Tax Authority can ask the institution's board to remedy the omissions within a reasonable period.

Indien mocht blijken dat een instelling niet voldoet aan één of meer voorwaarden, dan kan de Belastingdienst het bestuur van een instelling verzoeken om binnen een redelijke termijn de omissies te herstellen.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de voordurende verslechtering van de mensenrechtensituatie in Burundi (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

Irrgang (SP) asks the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the deteriorating human rights situation in Burundi, including political killings with police and intelligence involvement, jailing of opponents, journalist intimidation, and whether Dutch security-sector aid amounts to financing a repressive apparatus. Knapen answers that the government is aware of these reports, has raised concerns with Burundi's vice-president and through a demarche to the interior minister, raises the issue with regional states such as South Africa, and rejects the claim that Dutch aid funds repression because it is non-budgetary and aimed at democratic control of the security sector.
The Netherlands does this and will continue to do so.
Nederland doet dit en zal dit blijven doen.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over verzekeraars en onderzoeksbureaus. (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether insurers and their in-house investigation bureaus systematically avoid paying out claims, whether independent investigation is warranted, and whether conflicts of interest and the choice of investigator should be addressed. The minister said complaints are few and unfounded according to Kifid and the Consumentenbond, so no trend is seen, promised further research and talks with the insurers' association on the codes and on informing consumers of their right to a counter-expert.
I believe that when a claim is reported, the insurer must act quickly, reliably and efficiently in the interest of the customer.
Ik vind dat er bij een schademelding, in het belang van de klant, snel, betrouwbaar en efficiënt moet worden gehandeld door de verzekeraar.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over mensenrechtenschendingen in Burundi (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

MP Irrgang asks the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about human rights violations in Burundi, including attacks, pressure on journalists and lawyers, and the lack of separation of powers in a security sector shaped by government orders. The State Secretary condemns the violence, defends the mix of dialogue, pressure and aid, describes security sector and civil oversight programmes, and says budget support will not be given bilaterally in 2012.
The Netherlands will not provide bilateral budget support to Burundi in 2012, nor a separate contribution for that country via the EU or the World Bank.
Nederland zal in 2012 geen bilaterale begrotingssteun geven aan Burundi, ook niet door een aparte bijdrage voor dat land via de EU of de Wereldbank.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de minister van Financiën over Defensie in Griekenland (ingezonden 19 september 2011).

MPs Irrgang and Van Bommel asked the Finance Minister about reported Greek defence spending despite fiscal crisis, a US offer of tanks, F-16 purchases and reserve-part contracts, and whether France and Germany use the crisis to push arms sales. The minister replied that Greek defence budgets were cut under EU/IMF terms through postponed and cancelled investment plans and salary measures, that the tank transfer did not go ahead, that F-16 numbers and reserve-part volumes were estimated, and that he could not confirm the arms-sales claim, noting the Troika monitors defence spending.
The Troika closely monitors all expenditure by Greece, including expenditure in the field of defence.
De Trojka houdt nauw toezicht op alle uitgaven door Griekenland, inclusief de uitgaven op het terrein van defensie.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de goudvoorraad (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

Irrgang (SP) asked the Finance Minister whether DNB lent out or sold its gold, how it is stored and valued, and whether sales were wise, including a claimed 30 billion euro loss. The minister answered that DNB stopped lending gold in 2008, sold 1100 tonnes since 1991 to align with peer countries, and that the claimed loss is roughly of that order but depends on later returns and fluctuating gold prices.
DNB has informed me that it stopped lending gold in 2008.
DNB heeft mij aangegeven dat zij in 2008 is gestopt met het uitlenen van goud.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over een credit event bij het doorrollen van Griekse staatsobligaties (ingezonden 28 juni 2011).

MP Irrgang asked the Finance Minister how credit events are determined for Greek sovereign bond rollovers, whether hedge funds sitting on the ISDA committee should decide CDS triggers despite having interests, and about holdings of Greek CDS. The minister explained the ISDA determinations procedure, said conflicts of interest are possible but mitigated by transparency and diverse positions, and said he lacks a full overview of CDS holders, with EMIR reporting planned from 2013.
I do not have a total overview of the writers and holders of CDS contracts on Greek sovereign debt.
Ik heb geen totaaloverzicht van de schrijvers en bezitters van CDS contracten op de Griekse staatsschuld.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de humanitaire situatie in de Ogaden en Somalië (ingezonden 24 juni 2011).

MP Irrgang asks the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about access for the ICRC, WFP, MSF and independent media to the Ogaden, the peace process with the ONLF, and Somalia food aid funding. The State Secretary answers that access remains severely limited, that Nederland funds humanitarian aid and raises the issue with Ethiopia, but that the government opposes a special rapporteur for the Ogaden and has not yet received a WFP request.
The Netherlands is not in favour of this.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht «ETF’s: het nieuwste gevaar voor de financiële markten» (ingezonden 30 mei 2011).

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister about risks of ETFs, including synthetic ETFs whose collateral does not match the tracked index, investor transparency, market concentration among few providers, and the FSB warning on financial stability. The minister answers that transparency via prospectuses and AFM guidance is key, acknowledges concentration and synthetic-collateral risks, and announces a renewed AFM study planned for the second half of 2011.
For that reason, ETFs issue a prospectus through which investors are informed.
Om die reden geven ETFs een prospectus uit waarmee beleggers geïnformeerd worden.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nationale Commissie voor Internationale Samenwerking en Duurzame Ontwikkeling (NCDO) (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

MP Irrgang (SP) asks the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about a critical article on the NCDO, its future, its role and budget, and whether its magazine IS should be unsubsidised. The state secretary rejects the characterisation of the NCDO as competitive, sets out its new advisory role and budget, and says competition is to be avoided while subsidy dependence is to be reviewed.
In the Budget for 2012 I will give clarity on the available budget for 2012 and the years after.
In de Begroting voor 2012 zal ik uitsluitsel geven over het beschikbare budget in 2012 en de jaren daarna.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de exposure van Nederlandse banken, verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen op Griekse staatsobligaties (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

Irrgang (SP) asked the Finance Minister for the latest figures on Dutch banks', insurers' and pension funds' exposure to Greek sovereign bonds and CDS, the ECB's bond purchases and collateral, and the likely impact of a Greek default. The minister answered that Dutch banks had about EUR 3.7 billion Greek exposure at end-2010, that much detail is supervision- or monetary-confidential, and that the ECB and DNB figures are partly published while CDS net exposures are not tracked.
Not all questions can be fully answered due to supervisory confidentiality and the monetary secrecy DNB is bound by.
Niet alle vragen kunnen echter volledig worden beantwoord in verband met toezichtvertrouwelijkheid en de monetaire geheimhouding waar DNB aan gebonden is.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de benoeming van de nieuwe directeur van het IMF (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister why he backs French minister Christine Lagarde for IMF Managing Director, given his earlier support for merit-based, nationality-blind selection, and how this squares with critics' views on European and non-European candidates. The minister confirmed his support, arguing her expertise and broad backing make her the most suitable candidate, that nationality is not decisive, and that the selection process is democratic and transparent.
I can confirm that I support the candidacy of French Finance Minister Christine Lagarde for the position of Managing Director (MD) at the IMF.
Ik kan bevestigen dat ik de kandidatuur van de Franse minister van Financiën Christine Lagarde steun voor de positie van Managing Director (MD) bij het IMF.
Vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Van Dijk en Irrgang (allen SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de inzet Nederlandse militairen in Sahel-landen (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

SP MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs whether Dutch participation in the Flintlock exercises in the Sahel, linked to US counter-terrorism operations, was disclosed to parliament, why no artikel 100 procedure was used, and whether the operation militarises Sahel problems. The minister answered that Flintlock is a training exercise, not an operation, that parliament is not informed of such exercises, and that the programme does not militarise the region's political problems.
Since the Dutch military deployment concerns an exercise, the House of Representatives is not informed about it.
Aangezien de Nederlandse militaire inzet betrekking heeft op een oefening wordt de Kamer daarover niet geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het Klachteninstituut Financiële Dienstverlening (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether reports that the financial complaints institute Kifid wrongly rejects complaints justify examining its governance and funding, and whether its recognition as a dispute body under the Wft should be withdrawn. The minister answered that Kifid denies systematic failure, that independent committees review complaints, that the public-law ombudsman study continues, and that there is no reason to withdraw recognition.
I see no reason to proceed to withdraw the licence.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om tot intrekking van de vergunning over te gaan.

Vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) en Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over mensen in ontwikkelingslanden

MPs Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink and Irrgang asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about weak oversight of drug trials in developing countries, outsourcing to CROs, Helsinki Declaration compliance and EU database transparency. The minister answered that the sponsor remains responsible, the CBG checks compliance retrospectively, and the government supports EU review and a public EU clinical trials register, but did not commit to new mandatory measures.
Yes, I am willing to work towards ensuring that ethical guidelines are actually embedded in the approval process where this is not yet sufficiently the case.
Ja ik ben bereid mij ervoor in te zetten dat de ethische richtlijnen daar waar dat nog niet voldoende het geval is daadwerkelijk worden verankerd in het toelatingsproces.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de omwisselkoers van de gulden (ingezonden 7 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether a Socialist Party research bureau study on guilder purchasing power at euro conversion should change the government's reliance on CPB findings that the guilder was fairly priced, and whether an independent study of the effects of undervaluation should be commissioned. The minister answered that the study does not conclusively show undervaluation, that he relies on CPB analysis, and declined to commission further research because effects were likely temporary and modest and lack current policy relevance.
I therefore see no reason to renounce these statements.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om afstand te doen van deze uitspraken.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over een Afrikaans biogas project (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP asked whether SNV and Hivos took over an African biogas project and had it funded by the Dutch government, and about the complaints of the Biogas for Better Life foundation. The state secretary answered that the ministry funded the preparatory phase, that Hivos received a EUR 30 million subsidy because the foundation was judged too small to manage the risks, that the foundation withdrew in August 2008, and that the newspaper report rested on incorrect information.
In the ministry's judgment the management risks were too great to grant this young and small foundation a subsidy of EUR 30 million.
Naar het oordeel van het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken waren de beheersmatige risico’s te groot om aan deze jonge en kleine stichting een subsidie van 30 miljoen Euro toe te kennen.
Vragen van de lid Tony van Dijck (PVV) aan de minister van Financiën over Marokkaanse banken (ingezonden 7 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Moroccan banks entering the Dutch market would be fully supervised by DNB, whether they should be excluded from the deposit guarantee scheme, and whether their Islamic banking products hinder integration. The minister replied that EEA branches fall under home-country prudential supervision and are not covered by the Dutch DGS, and referred the integration question to the Interior Minister.
This means that EEA banks can, among other things, open branches in other EEA member states without applying for a new banking licence in the host member state.
Dat betekent dat EER-banken onder andere bijkantoren kunnen openen in andere EER-lidstaten zonder in de «lidstaat van ontvangst» een nieuwe bankvergunning aan te vragen.
Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Irrgang (beiden SP) aan de minister van Financien over wanpraktijken bij het verlengen van hypotheken (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

MPs Jansen and Irrgang (SP) asked the Finance Minister about high mortgage rates on renewal, the deadline for renewal offers, and whether banks may charge existing customers more than new ones. The minister answered that the NMa is studying the mortgage market in two stages, that the first quick scan signals serious problems, that pricing is for lenders to decide, and that he is consulting parties and the AFM on possible follow-up.
The NMa is currently examining competition in the mortgage market in more depth in a second study.
Momenteel onderzoekt de NMa in een tweede onderzoek meer diepgaand de concurrentie op de hypotheekmarkt.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Veiligheid en Justitie over commissarissen (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Justice about supervisory board members' time commitments, diversity, outside appointments via personal networks, and transparency. The minister answered that the matter depends case by case, that current rules and the Corporate Governance Code suffice, and that no new regulation is planned.
I see no reason for further regulation on this point.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nadere regelgeving op dit punt.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over financiering lobby door Aegon (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

Irrgang (SP) asks the Finance Minister whether it is acceptable that Aegon, partly state-supported, funded a US Chamber of Commerce campaign against financial regulation, and whether the US Chamber functions as a lobby organisation. The minister replies that he does not intervene in daily operations of companies Aegon, that Aegon's US foundation gave $3 million to the Chamber's National Foundation, and that the Chamber opposed certain parts of the legislation, while accepting that the US Chamber functions more as a lobby organisation.
In general, even in my capacity as shareholder of the state holdings, I do not interfere in the daily operational activities of the companies concerned.
In algemene zin geldt dat ik zelfs in mijn hoedanigheid van aandeelhouder van de staatsdeelnemingen niet treedt in de dagelijkse operationele activiteiten van de betreffende deelnemingen

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Irrgang (beiden SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over kinderarbeid bij hazelnotenproductie in Turk

MPs Gesthuizen, Irrgang and Voordewind asked ministers about reports of widespread child labour and school absence in Turkish hazelnut harvesting, and whether Dutch companies and the state should act in line with ILO conventions. The government answered that the problem is complex and mainly the responsibility of Turkey, that Dutch firms should exercise due diligence and will be consulted again in early 2011, and that it will raise the issue bilaterally with Turkey without committing to new investigations of Dutch companies.
Due to the confidentiality of commercially sensitive information, these data cannot be traced back to individual companies.
Vanwege vertrouwelijkheid van bedrijfsgevoelige informatie zijn deze gegevens niet herleidbaar naar individuele bedrijven.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over topmannen van Nederlandse beursgenoteerde ondernemingen (ingezonden 12 oktober 2010).

MP Irrgang asked the Finance Minister why Dutch listed company CEOs change more often and perform worse than foreign ones, whether this shows pressure from shareholders or weak board appointment processes, and whether Dutch listed companies are the least protected in the world, with an overview of shareholder meeting powers in six countries. The government answered that CEO appointments and departures are primarily for the companies and their supervisory boards, that the Dutch corporate governance framework has adequate supervisory safeguards, that the research did not show Dutch companies under more shareholder pressure, and it gave a comparative overview of appointment and dismissal powers.

The Dutch corporate governance framework contains safeguards for efficient supervision of the board, including rules on appointment and dismissal of directors and supervisory board members, supervision by the supervisory board, the right to place items on the agenda, and the right of enquiry.

Het Nederlandse corporate governance raamwerk bevat waarborgen voor een efficiënt toezicht op het bestuur via onder meer regels inzake benoeming en ontslag van bestuurders en commissarissen, toezicht door de raad van commissarissen, het agenderingsrecht en het enquêterecht.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de minister van Financiën over toezicht van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) op reclame-uitingen (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

MPs Irrgang and Bashir (SP) asked the Finance Minister how the AFM supervises advertisements for investment products that promise high fixed returns below the 50,000 euro threshold, whether the threshold should be raised, and whether the AFM considers tax-benefit claims and undisclosed risks in such ads acceptable. The minister answered that the AFM monitors advertising and acts through informal or formal enforcement, that the threshold is being doubled to 100,000 euro, and that risks should be disclosed, while declining to discuss individual supervisory cases.
Naturally, individual supervisory cases cannot be discussed here.
Uiteraard kan hier niet ingegaan worden op individuele toezichtcasussen.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het bedrijf Future Life Insurance Broker SA (FLIB) (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010)

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister why the Luxembourg home supervisor and the Dutch AFM and DNB did not act sooner against FLIB, an unlicensed insurance broker, and why enforcement orders were published late and the directors were not targeted earlier. The minister answers that the regulators lacked sufficient information, were limited against foreign firms, pursued the matter through criminal referral and enforcement orders, and will explore consumer complaints to the Ombudsman and push for stronger host-supervisor powers in Europe.
The (legal) possibilities to tackle companies established abroad that are active on the Dutch market are limited.
De (wettelijke) mogelijkheden om ondernemingen gevestigd in het buitenland, die actief zijn op de Nederlandse markt, aan te pakken zijn beperkt.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het kantoor van de Stichting Nederlandse Vrijwilligers (SNV) in Washington (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs whether the SNV Washington office was set up with prior ministry approval, whether it is funded by Dutch subsidy, its staffing, the director's pay and allowances, and whether its fundraising role justifies its existence. The state secretary answered that no prior written approval was needed, the office is fully subsidy-funded and focuses on North American fundraising, salaries are below the DG norm, and a major evaluation of SNV including the Washington office will take place in 2012.
The SNV office in Washington was of course not set up with the aim of working on direct poverty reduction.
Het kantoor van SNV in Washington is uiteraard niet opgericht met de bedoeling aan directe armoedebestrijding te gaan werken.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over SNV (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

An SP MP asked ministers about reports of staff revolt over high director salaries at development organisation SNV, the chair of its supervisory board's claim that salaries meet the Code Wijffels, and whether salary norms cover allowances, pension contributions and variable pay. The state secretary answered that top salaries do not fit SNV, that the claim of compliance with the Code Wijffels is untenable, that the board chair's conduct is not for the minister to judge, and that the forthcoming WNT will extend norms to all components.
It is not for me to pass judgment on Mr De Waal in his role as chair of the Supervisory Board.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel uit te spreken over de heer De Waal in zijn rol als voorzitter van de Raad van Toezicht.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Irrgang (SP), Dikkers (PvdA), Van der Staaij (SGP), Ten Broeke (VVD) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over topsalarissen bij ontwikkelingsorgani

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about excessive director salaries at development organisation SNV, how the government will recover the excess against subsidies, whether other non-MFS organisations also pay above the cap, and whether a salary ceiling will be enforced. The state secretary answered that differences will be settled retroactively against the subsidy, that specific arrangements will be made with SNV, that other organisations will be referred to a separate letter, and that a salary cap will be agreed with non-MFS organisations largely funded by government.
Established differences between director salaries and the DG norm can be settled afterwards against the subsidy fixed afterwards for a given year.
Vastgestelde verschillen tussen directiesalarissen en de DG-norm kunnen achteraf worden verrekend met de eveneens achteraf vastgestelde subsidie over een bepaald jaar.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over folteringen in Senegal (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister how he reacted to reports of police torture going unpunished in Senegal, whether this should prompt reconsidering budget support, and for answers before a committee meeting. The minister replied that the government is concerned and will raise it in political dialogue, that Senegal denies impunity and says justice followed in all cases, and that the dialogue currently gives enough grounds to keep engaging rather than reconsidering budget support.
The Dutch government is concerned about this report and will raise this concern in the political dialogue with Senegal.
De Nederlandse regering is bezorgd over dit bericht en zal deze zorg in de politieke dialoog met Senegal aan de orde stellen.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de weigering door Kenia om de Soedanese president Al-Bashir op te pakken (ingezonden 31 augustus 2010).

MPs Peters and Irrgang asked why Kenya hosted Sudanese president Al-Bashir despite an ICC arrest warrant, whether the Netherlands pressed Kenya, and whether it will protest when Al-Bashir visits other ICC states. The minister says Nederland and the EU have strongly urged Kenya to comply, summoned Kenyan ambassadors, and will press for a united EU reaction to future visits, but gives no account of Kenya's own reasoning beyond what Kenya stated.
The Netherlands did this on 2 September.
Nederland heeft dit op 2 september jl. gedaan.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Irrgang (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit, van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over speculatie in landbouwgewassen (ingezonden 6 augustus 2010).

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether speculation caused the 2008 food price spike, how the World Bank report and the energy-food price link should be read, and what action will curb speculation in agricultural commodities such as cocoa. The government answered that the evidence on speculation is inconclusive, that fundamental market factors dominate, and that it will examine how to improve market functioning and price transparency with international partners.
The cabinet is examining, together with international partners, how market functioning can be improved.
Het kabinet onderzoekt, samen met de internationale partners, hoe de marktwerking kan worden verbeterd.

SP MPs asked the ministers whether hospitals recruiting operating-theatre assistants in India for cost savings was acceptable, whether it breached government policy, and what the status was of the WHO code, the sector consultation and a training fund. The minister answered that cost savings were doubtful, that recruitment from outside the EU should be a last resort, that the WHO code is non-binding and that no mandatory Dutch code will be introduced.
I see no reason to move towards drafting a binding Dutch code for recruiting care staff from developing countries outside the EU.
Ik zie geen reden om over te gaan tot het opstellen van een verplichtende Nederlandse code voor de werving van zorgpersoneel in ontwikkelingslanden buiten de EU.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Irrgang (allen SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het werven van Indiaas personeel door het Refaja ziekenhuis en het Sint

SP MPs asked why two Dutch hospitals (Refaja and Sint Jans Gasthuis) recruited Indian operating-theatre assistants, whether this conflicts with the cabinet's stance that recruiting non-EU care staff should be a last resort, and whether the WHO code can prevent such recruitment. The minister answers that the hospitals acted within the knowledge-migrant scheme after domestic and EU recruitment failed, that the recruitment was ethical and circular, and that the government will explore intensifying recruitment in other EU member states.
I will examine together with industry organisations which options for intensifying the recruitment of care staff in other EU member states are possible.
Ik zal samen met brancheorganisaties bekijken welke opties voor het intensiveren van werving van zorgpersoneel in andere EU-lidstaten mogelijk zijn.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de beloning van de directeur van het Rode Kruis (ingezonden 29 juni 2010).

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether the Red Cross director's pay (about 202,000 euro including social charges and other allowances) exceeds the DG-norm and the Wijffels code, and whether MFS II subsidy should be withheld. The minister said the salary is within the VFI norm, that the total exceeds the DG-norm and VFI norm but not the Balkenende norm, that the reporting needs clarification which he will raise with the Red Cross, and that the Red Cross has committed to meet the DG-norm from 1 January 2011, so no subsidy sanction is planned.
I share the view that the way the organisation reports allowances and costs is insufficiently transparent and needs clarification.
Ik deel de mening dat de wijze waarop de organisatie melding maakt van vergoedingen en kosten onvoldoende transparant is en verduidelijking behoeft.
Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Irrgang (beiden SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een salarisverhoging voor Keniaanse parlementsleden (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

MPs Van Bommel and Irrgang asked the Foreign Minister whether Kenyan MPs had voted a 25% salary rise, whether this was excessive given Dutch aid to Kenya, and whether Dutch aid would continue. The minister confirmed the decision is not yet implemented, referred to a planned independent salary commission in the draft constitution, and said good governance programmes address accountability and the issue has been raised in EU political dialogue.

Moreover, civil society organisations in Kenya, supported by the Netherlands and other members of the international community, have long argued that setting MPs' salaries and emoluments is best done by an independent and broadly composed commission rather than by the interested parties themselves.

Overigens hebben maatschappelijke organisaties in Kenia, hierin gesteund door Nederland en andere leden van de internationale gemeenschap, al langer bepleit dat de vaststelling van de hoogte van salarissen en emolumenten voor parlementsleden het best gedaan kan worden door een onafhankelijke en breed samengestelde commissie, en niet door de belanghebbenden zelf.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang (SP) en Ten Broeke (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse ontwikkelingsorganisatie SNV (ingezonden 21 mei 2010).
