The minister replied that a tri-partite energy collaboration exists, that board member did not take part in SNV decisions on NOTS and no SNV funding flowed, and that the Washington office's necessity cannot yet be judged, promising to press for closure if results show it is not essential.
There is no SNV financing of the board member's foundation; the board member did not take part in any SNV decision-making about NOTS.
Van financiering van de stichting van het betrokken lid van de Raad van Toezicht door SNV is geen sprake, het betrokken lid heeft niet deelgenomen aan enige besluitvorming door SNV over NOTS
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het dumpen van Zuid-Europese staatsobligaties door Ageas (ingezonden 28 mei 2010).

Irrgang (SP) asks the Finance Minister about reports that Ageas dumped about 4.8 billion euro of Southern European government bonds, whether a gentlemen's agreement against such dumping exists, and what measures could prevent it. The minister answers that Greece must implement its adjustment programme, that the IIF and Dutch banks pledged support, that banks cannot be obliged to hold Greek bonds, and that he has no insight into individual institutions' positions.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over speculatie op Griekse staatsobligaties door het ABP (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

MP Irrgang asks the Finance Minister whether the ABP's large holding of Greek government bonds (2.3 billion euro in 2009) was risky, how DNB supervised it, and whether the fund's exposure was a reason for the Greek bailout. The minister answers that pension fund investment decisions are the responsibility of the fund board, that DNB cannot discuss institution-specific matters, and gives aggregate figures showing Dutch pension funds held about 3.7 billion euro in Greece (about 0.6% of assets).
It is not permitted for DNB to answer institution-specific questions.
Het is voor DNB niet toegestaan om instellingspecifieke vragen te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mensenrechtenschendingen in Burundi (ingezonden 4 juni 2010).

Irrgang (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about the expulsion of a Human Rights Watch researcher from Burundi, election-related violence, and the withdrawal of opposition presidential candidates, and whether these would weigh on budget support. The minister regretted the expulsion, said Burundi should have engaged in dialogue rather than expelling her, and said the Netherlands raised the issue bilaterally, via the EU and in the UN Human Rights Council, with human rights respect one of the conditions for budget support decided after the elections.
At the UN Human Rights Council currently meeting in Geneva, the Netherlands will raise the matter through a national statement.
In de VN-Mensenrechtenraad die momenteel plaatsvindt in Genève, zal Nederland de onderhavige kwestie via een nationale verklaring aankaarten.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Duitse huurlingen in Somalië (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a German firm, Asgaard, signed a five-year contract with a Somali warlord, whether this worsens the civil war, and whether the minister would press Germany to act against such mercenaries. The minister said he only knew of the contract from the media, found such involvement undesirable, and pointed to Germany's statement that the firm must observe EU and German law including the Somalia arms embargo, with the decision on prosecution resting with German authorities.
The content of such a contract is not known to me.
De inhoud van een dergelijk contract is mij niet bekend.

Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financien over de rol van de Stichting van de Arbeid bij de compensatieregeling voor woekerpensioenen (ingezonden 21 april 2010

Irrgang (SP) asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Finance whether the Stichting van de Arbeid went beyond overseeing the process and shaped the content of the compensation scheme for woekerpensioenen, and questioned the cost levels and the Wabeke norm. The minister answered that the Stichting only followed a process led by the Ombudsman Financiële Dienstverlening, that it cannot judge the norm itself, and that it declines to assess the compensation level, refusing the banksparen suggestion for the second pillar.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over tussenpersonen (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

Irrgang (SP) asked the Finance Minister whether DNB was wrong to block service subscriptions for financial intermediaries and whether the law should be changed so such subscriptions avoid insurer licensing. The minister answered that DNB's stance concerns insurance-like features and licensing, that intermediaries may already be paid by subscription where there is no uncertainty element, and that the provision regime will be reviewed in the upcoming evaluation.
This point will be taken into account in the evaluation of the commission regulations.
Dit punt zal in de evaluatie van de provisieregelgeving worden meegenomen.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Rwandese beschuldigingen aan het adres van Human Rights Watch (ingezonden 7 mei 2010).

The MP asks whether Rwandan accusations of blackmail against Human Rights Watch are justified, whether refusing a work permit threatens HRW's operations, and whether the government will press Rwanda on intolerance of criticism before elections and on resuming general budget support. The minister rejects the blackmail claim, expects HRW to remain welcome, says Nederland and EU partners have raised concerns, and says a decision on budget support will follow a joint review in October 2010.
They invoke the need to prevent at all costs a repetition of the 1994 genocide; preserving stability takes precedence.

I have advised SNV to consider making the salaries of all four directors public.
Ik heb SNV in overweging gegeven de salarissen van alle vier de directeuren openbaar te maken.

Motie-Van der Veen over de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling in zorginstellingen
Asks the government for a note setting out responsibility, liability and sanction options among boards, medical staff and supervision in care institutions.
requests the government to send the House as soon as possible a note setting out the division of responsibilities, liability and sanction options
verzoekt de regering de Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk een notitie te zenden waarin de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling, de aansprakelijkheid en de sanctiemogelijkheden uiteengezet worden
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over kernwapenbeleid

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked the Dutch government about US nuclear modernisation (B61 bombs, the F-35 nuclear role, transport and accident safety) and whether the Netherlands should refuse nuclear weapons. The minister declined to give locations, numbers and transport details on alliance grounds, said the F-35 will take over the nuclear-capable role from the F-16 in line with prior policy, and pointed to a forthcoming AIV advisory report.
As the House is aware, under alliance arrangements no information can be provided on the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe.
Zoals de Kamer bekend kunnen op basis van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over Diyanet

PVV MPs asked the government whether it would end its relationship with Diyanet Nederland (ISN/HDV) and close its mosques after Diyanet reportedly approved marriage and pregnancy of 9-year-old girls, and whether it would expel the Turkish ambassador or cut diplomatic ties. The minister answered that ISN is one of many dialogue partners with no formal cooperation, that Diyanet publicly condemned child marriage, that freedom of religion and association mean closing mosques is not possible, and that diplomatic relations are needed to discuss rule-of-law issues; no Turkish ambassador is currently accredited in the Netherlands.
There is no question of formal cooperation.
Er is geen sprake van formele samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Karabulut over een nieuw rapport inzake Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeid in de EU en de betrokkenheid van Nederlandse bedrijven

MPs Ten Broeke and Karabulut asked about a report on North Korean forced labour in the EU, including Dutch firms' involvement in building ships, and the government's response on enforcement, the Polish role, and the Netherlands' legal jurisdiction. The minister answers that the situation could possibly qualify as forced labour or trafficking, outlines EU and UN measures, states that Poland has issued no new work permits since August 2017, and refers largely to company responsibility, the OECD guidelines, and the ILO process, without confirming the scale of Dutch firms' involvement.
How many companies and shipyards are involved, and over what period this occurred, cannot be established with certainty.
Om hoeveel bedrijven en werven het gaat, en in welke periode hiervan sprake was, valt niet met zekerheid vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over de opvang van Venezolaanse vluchtelingen

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Affairs and Development ministers about support for Venezuelan refugees, including UN aid to Colombia, the Netherlands' role, reception on the Caribbean islands, and Dutch citizens stranded in Venezuela. The minister answered that the government backs UN aid to Colombia, funds UN agencies through unearmarked contributions, sees no added value in raising the issue at the UN Security Council, and described reception arrangements and departure flights for stranded Dutch nationals.
The cabinet currently sees no added value in placing the reception of Venezuelan refugees on the agenda of the UN Security Council.
Het kabinet ziet op dit moment geen toegevoegde waarde in het agenderen van de opvang van Venezolaanse vluchtelingen in de VN Veiligheidsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Graus over eenzijdig Chinees optreden bij instellen van vliegroutes over de Straat van Taiwan

PVV MPs De Roon and Graus asked whether the government shares US concern over China's unilateral setting of new flight routes over the Taiwan Strait and whether this endangers Dutch flights. The minister answered that the government and the EU call for a peaceful dialogue solution, that Dutch airlines do not use these routes so there is no reason to engage, and that Nederland and the EU will keep urging both sides toward constructive dialogue.
Dutch airlines, however, do not use the routes. The cabinet therefore sees no reason to enter into consultation on this.
Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen maken echter geen gebruik van de routes. Het kabinet heeft dan ook geen aanleiding hierover in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over de donorconferentie voor Irak

PVV MPs De Roon and Van Weerdenburg asked about Dutch participation and pledges at the February 2018 Iraq donor conference in Kuwait, including whether taxpayer money should go to Iraq rather than domestic needs, and whether a full list of pledges would be shared. The minister confirmed participation, cited a EUR 12 million stabilisation contribution and conditional aid, and said no full overview of pledges had been compiled, citing a roughly USD 30 billion total from the Kuwaiti chair.
No overview has been made of all the pledges made during the conference.
Er is geen overzicht gemaakt van alle toezeggingen gedaan tijdens de conferentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over mogelijke arrestatiebevelen tegen Nederlandse Marokkanen

An MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Morocco is planning arrest warrants against Dutch-Moroccans involved in the Rif protests, whether the government shares concern about treatment of detained demonstrators, and whether extradition is ruled out given doubts about fair trials. The government replied that Morocco described the matter as summonses to testify rather than arrest warrants, that the Dutch embassy and EU partners monitor detainees and raised concerns with Moroccan ministers, and that there are no indications of an extradition request.
As indicated under 2, there are no indications that the Moroccan authorities intend to request extradition of the persons named.
Zoals onder 2 is aangegeven, zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat de Marokkaanse autoriteiten van plan zouden zijn om uitlevering te vragen van genoemde personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Kuzu over het bericht dat vier Marokkaanse Nederlanders onderwerp van een arrestatiebevel zijn van het Marokkaanse openbaar ministerie

DENK MPs asked whether four Dutch-Moroccans are subject to arrest warrants from Morocco's prosecutor over Rif protests, what contact the Netherlands had with Moroccan authorities, and how the Netherlands would refuse unjustified extradition or legal-assistance requests. The government replied that Morocco said these were witness summonses rather than arrest warrants, that it cannot say more than it knows, that each request is assessed case by case under Dutch law and the ECHR including free expression, and that it raised the treatment of detained demonstrators with Moroccan ministers.
Legal assistance and extradition requests are always assessed case by case and in compliance with Dutch law and international treaties.
Rechtshulp- en uitleveringsverzoeken worden altijd per geval en met inachtneming van de Nederlandse wet en internationale verdragen beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het bericht 'EU rift over rule of law deepens’

SP MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked the ministers about the European Commission's warnings to Romania over judicial reforms that could weaken the rule of law and shield corruption suspects, and about rule-of-law decline in several member states, EU justice cooperation, EU funds and Western Balkans accession. The minister confirmed awareness of the Commission's concerns, said the Cooperation and Verification Mechanism mainly signals problems without enforcement power, and stated that justice cooperation is based on mutual recognition with limited refusal grounds.
The Cooperation and Verification Mechanism (CVM) was designed after the accession of Bulgaria and Romania to monitor progress in judicial reform and the fight against corruption.

Het Coöperatie- en Verificatiemechanisme mechanisme (CVM) werd ontworpen na de toetreding van Bulgarije en Roemenië om voortgang te monitoren bij de hervorming van het rechtsstelsel, de bestrijding van corruptie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de politie-inval bij de Eurogroep-voorzitter

An MP asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about a police raid on Eurogroup president Centeno, how integrity was assessed in his selection, and whether he should remain in office during an investigation. The government replied that integrity is essential, that the Portuguese investigation has concluded with no finding of integrity violations, and that Centeno was never formally a suspect.
A statement from the Portuguese public prosecutors says the investigation found that Centeno did not commit any integrity violations.
In een verklaring van de Portugese openbaar aanklagers wordt gesteld dat uit het onderzoek is gebleken dat Centeno zich niet schuldig heeft gemaakt aan integriteitsschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Pedofielen delen massaal Nederlandse kinderfoto’s op openbare Russische site’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked whether the government would investigate a Russian website hosting child photos, including Dutch children, and whether Dutch police cooperate with Belgian investigators. The government answered that no joint investigation or Dutch-specific investigation is underway because no punishable images of Dutch children have been found, that the OM would open an investigation if such material is found, and that it will ask Russian authorities about action against the site.
At this moment there is no joint investigation with the Belgian authorities underway regarding the named Russian website, nor any investigation into images of Dutch children.
Op dit moment is er ten aanzien van de genoemde Russische website geen gezamenlijk onderzoek met de Belgische autoriteiten gaande of onderzoek gedaan naar afbeeldingen van Nederlandse kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse medewerking aan Amerikaanse modernisering van Saoedische tanks

An MP asked whether Dutch firms performed work after 28 February 2017 on the US contract modernising Abrams tanks for Saudi Arabia, Australia and Kuwait, and how this fits Dutch restrictive arms-export policy toward Saudi Arabia. The minister answered that no Dutch companies performed licensable work under the contract, that customs found no licensable Dutch deliveries or support since that date, and that the Netherlands applies a strict case-by-case policy to Saudi Arabia.
Inquiries with Customs show that since 28 February 2017 there have been no licensable deliveries or technical support from the Netherlands in relation to Abrams tanks.
Navraag bij de Douane wijst uit dat er sinds 28 februari 2017 geen vergunningplichtige leveringen of technische ondersteuning vanuit Nederland in relatie tot Abrams-tanks hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en De Jong over het bericht 'Europees pensioenfonds op rand van de afgrond'

PVV MPs asked the government about a reported EUR 326 million deficit in the European Parliament's voluntary supplementary pension fund, its total EU pension liabilities, and whether the Dutch taxpayer will bear the cost. The minister answered that the fund concerns voluntary pensions accrued before 2009, that the EP itself is responsible for its sustainability, and that the cabinet expects the EP leadership to address it.
It is up to the EP to find a solution to this problem.
Het is aan het EP een oplossing voor deze problematiek te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de ontvoering van Insiya naar India

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the abduction of a child to India, the content and enforceability of an Indian family court ruling, what the Dutch government is doing to speed up the child's return, and the status of the criminal case against the father. The government answered that the Indian ruling is not public and concerns parental rights rather than the abduction, that the Foreign Ministry and embassy press for return and have raised the case at high level, and that the criminal case is pending before the court so it will not comment further.
From the start of the case, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has maintained close contact with Insiya's mother about the status of the case and the possible return of Insiya to the Netherlands.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken houdt vanaf het begin van de zaak nauw contact met de moeder van Insiya over de stand van zaken en de mogelijke terugkeer van Insiya naar Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Bosman over het bericht “Deal in Nederland onder de radar”

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke and Bosman asked about reports that a Dutch administration office became shareholder in a large Venezuelan oilfield, whether this breaches Venezuelan law and EU sanctions, and what risks and oversight apply. The government declined to discuss the specific case citing tax secrecy, stated the EU sanctions do not restrict oil-sector transactions, noted firms must self-check compliance, and said the OECD guidelines research by the National Contact Point will be sent to parliament before summer 2018.
Under the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, individual taxpayers cannot, as is well known, be discussed.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan zoals bekend niet worden ingegaan op individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zijlstra en Azmani inzake ‘aanranding Almeerse door drie asielzoekers’ en ‘Kans op geweld tegen christenen is 100 procent’

MPs Zijlstra and Azmani asked the State Secretary about an assault on an 18-year-old woman in Almere by three asylum seekers and reports of violence against Christians in reception centres, asking whether asylum applications of those not respecting Dutch norms should be rejected and expelled. The State Secretary condemned such conduct, said COA house rules and police intervene, and promised to inform parliament on tightening national rules so asylum permits can be refused or withdrawn more readily after criminal convictions.

In the general consultation with your House of 30 September on, among other things, the increased inflow, I committed to your House to come with further proposals on how, within existing EU frameworks, national rules on this point can be tightened.

In het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer van 30 september jl. over onder meer de verhoogde instroom heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd met nadere voorstellen te komen hoe binnen de bestaande EU-kaders een aanscherping van de nationale regelgeving op dit punt kan worden gerealiseerd
Antwoord vragen Oosenbrug over het bericht dat de overheid gegevens van miljoenen burgers aan de Mormonen heeft verstrekt

Oosenbrug asked whether the government unlawfully gave personal record cards of millions of deceased Dutch citizens to the Mormon Genealogical Society, whether privacy law was breached, and whether the data can be reclaimed. Minister Plasterk answers that the 1973 arrangement likely conflicted with the 1967 population registry decree, that current rules are stricter, that the CBG keeps the cards, and that he will verify and secure access with a letter in early 2013.
Against this background, it is plausible that the provision must be regarded as contrary to the Population Registry Decree of 1967 then in force.
Tegen deze achtergrond is het aannemelijk dat de verstrekking gezien moet worden als in strijd met het toenmalige Besluit bevolkingsboekhouding uit 1967.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Filmlaboratorium Cineco failliet’

MPs Bergkamp and Verhoeven asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Finance about the bankruptcy of film laboratory Cineco, including its causes, consequences for the Dutch film industry, and whether a tax shelter is needed for a level playing field in Europe. The minister answered that the consequences are hard to judge yet, that the industry itself must look at preserving Cineco's expertise, and that it cannot yet be determined whether the lack of a tax shelter was decisive, while creating new fiscal facilities for specific sectors conflicts with simplifying the tax system.
It is up to the industry itself to examine whether there are possibilities to preserve Cineco's knowledge and expertise in the Netherlands.
Het is aan de bedrijfstak zelf om te bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om de kennis en kunde van Cineco in Nederland te behouden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rog en De Rouwe over het persbericht ‘Studenten onredelijk behandeld bij defecte OV-chipkaart’

Two CDA MPs asked why students cannot receive a temporary replacement for a defective OV-chipkaart as other travellers can, and whether DUO, RSR and TLS exchange enough information. The minister explains that student privacy rules (privacy by design) prevent carriers from verifying students, that no exception is planned, and that only efforts to speed up replacement will be explored.
The privacy provisions will not be changed.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Veldhoven over de kwartaalrapportage van het OV loket waarin wordt gesteld dat studenten onredelijk worden behandeld bij een defecte OV-chipkaart

Two D66 MPs asked why students get no replacement OV-chipkaart at counters while other travellers do, citing an ombudsman report calling this unequal and unnecessary. The minister answered that privacy rules prevent carriers from verifying student status, that these rules will not change, and that only faster replacement is being explored.
For students this service is not possible with any carrier, for privacy reasons.
Voor studenten is deze service om privacyredenen bij geen enkele vervoerder mogelijk.

Vragen van de leden Zijlstra en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken over de verkoop van alcoholische streekproducten (ingezonden 11 augustus 2010).

MPs Zijlstra and Ziengs (VVD) asked why the Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (VWA) tolerates sales of low-alcohol regional products at markets and tourist shops in Veere without enforcement, and how this unequal treatment can be ended. The minister explains that a 2005 directive to the VWA, prompted by a parliamentary motion, tolerates such sales at fairs for regional development reasons, denies the practice is unfair competition, and says the directive will not be withdrawn for now.
For the time being I do not intend to withdraw the directive to the VWA.
Voorlopig ben ik niet voornemens de aanwijzing aan de VWA in te trekken.

Vragen van de leden Van der Burg , Zijlstra en Van Miltenburg (allen VVD) aan de ministers voor Jeugd en Gezin en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zwangere vrouwen die een vragenlijst moeten invullen bij gemeen

VVD MPs asked whether Venray municipality's 36-question prenatal questionnaire (Samen Starten), which can lead to AMK referrals, labels future parents as risk parents and exceeds government authority. The minister replied that it is a voluntary support tool for midwives, not a suitability test, that no objective criteria for parental suitability exist or are the state's task, and that the municipality is responsible for prenatal information.
The aim of the method is not to determine whether the pregnant woman will be a good mother, but to assess whether the prospective mother needs extra help or guidance.
Het doel van de methodiek is niet om vast te stellen of de zwangere vrouw een goede moeder zal zijn, maar om te beoordelen of de aanstaande moeder extra hulp of begeleiding nodig heeft.

Vragen van het lid Zijlstra (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, van Economische Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het Top Instituut Pharma (ingezonden 10 juni 2010).

MP Zijlstra asked whether the EUR 6 million bridging finance granted to TI Pharma secures its continuity, what TI Pharma requested, and whether the government values the public-private partnership enough. The minister replied that the EUR 6 million only secures short-term continuity, leaving long-term funding to the next cabinet, and that the government is willing to consult partners.
The bridging amount of EUR 6 million is not intended to secure the long-term continuity of TI Pharma; it guarantees its continuity in the short term.
Het overbruggingsbedrag van € 6 mln. is niet bedoeld om de langetermijncontinuïteit van TI Pharma zeker te stellen; het waarborgt de continuïteit van TI Pharma op de korte termijn.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over de situatie van Nederlandse kinderen in Syrië en Irak

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked the government about the situation of Dutch children in Syria and Iraq, whether it will actively help them return, and whether consular assistance and child protection cooperation are possible. The minister answered that at least 175 minors with a Dutch link are there, that consular help is only given when families present themselves in person at a Dutch post, that Syria and crisis areas are largely beyond reach, and that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming is ready to support returnees.
The Dutch government does not provide consular assistance to Dutch travellers and families who are in unsafe areas in Syria and Iraq and wish to leave.
De Nederlandse regering verleent geen consulaire bijstand aan Nederlandse uitreizigers en families die zich in onveilige gebieden in Syrië en Irak bevinden en deze willen verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een VN-lijst met bedrijven die actief zijn in illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

An MP asked whether five Dutch companies on a UN OHCHR list linked to Israeli settlements would be disclosed and whether the government would contact them. The government said the list is unfinished, the Netherlands opposes the database and will not seek its publication, and it reiterates its policy discouraging economic ties with settlement businesses while leaving companies to decide under OECD guidelines.
In response to the OHCHR note, the Netherlands again emphasised its own position on the database.
Nederland heeft in een reactie op de nota van OHCHR het eigen standpunt ten aanzien van de database nogmaals benadrukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Ten Broeke, Karabulut en De Roon over de onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

MPs asked the minister about the expulsion of a BBC journalist from Papua, press freedom, deteriorating human rights, and Dutch police training in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the expulsion, said foreign journalists need permits, described Dutch support for press freedom and the Community Policing Programme, and said human rights including Papua are raised in bilateral and EU/UN dialogue.
Enquiries showed that the BBC journalist indeed had to leave the province.
Bij navraag is gebleken dat de BBC-journaliste inderdaad de provincie moest verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Rechten van meisjes blijven internationaal onderbelicht’

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about a Plan International report finding girls' rights rarely named in international treaties. The minister answered that girls' rights are covered by existing conventions, that the government will push for explicit mention in new negotiations and UN resolutions, and that it will press states to withdraw reservations.
Therefore the cabinet will advocate explicit mention of girls' rights when negotiations take place on new binding treaties
Daarom zal het kabinet pleiten voor een expliciete vermelding van de rechten van meisjes wanneer onderhandelingen plaatsvinden over nieuwe bindende verdragen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van Helvert over een nieuwe serie moorden onder christenen in Nigeria

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reported killings of Christians in Nigeria and whether Fulani herdsmen are responsible, why the Nigerian state fails to protect civilians, whether religion plays a role, Boko Haram's current strength, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister said the government cannot independently confirm the figures, attributed the violence mainly to economic and land-related causes rather than a religious agenda, and committed to pressing Nigerian authorities to document crimes and prosecute perpetrators.
The Netherlands will, preferably together with other partners or within the EU, press the Nigerian authorities that the perpetrators of the killings must not go unpunished
Nederland zal er, bij voorkeur ook samen met andere partners, dan wel in EU-verband, bij de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten op aandringen dat de daders van de moordpartijen niet vrijuit gaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een door Indonesië gearresteerde Papua activist

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the treason trial in Indonesia of Papuan activist Yanto Awerkion over a referendum petition, his health, and Dutch efforts on repression in Papua. The minister confirmed the trial and the charge, said reliable sources report his health is good with no family visit restrictions, and described human rights raised in bilateral and EU dialogues while declining to comment on the pending verdict.
The case is before the court and the cabinet will make no statements on it pending the verdict.
De zaak is onder de rechter en het kabinet doet in afwachting van de uitspraak hierover geen uitlatingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Ten Broeke over het betrekken van Nederlanders in het buitenland bij de verbetering van het postennetwerk en consulaire dienstverlening

MPs Sjoerdsma and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister how the government will strengthen the diplomatic network and consular services, whether it will actively involve the Dutch abroad, push digitalisation, set up a 24/7 one-stop shop, and consider an Irish-style 'Global Irish' initiative. The minister answered that a policy letter (Consulaire Canon) and a network vision will come before summer 2018, that consultations and surveys of Dutch citizens abroad are ongoing, that digitalisation aims for maximum feasible digital service by 2020, that the one-stop shop will be built stepwise over 3-4 years, and that foreign examples like Global Irish will be considered.

Before summer, the House will be further informed about the cabinet's vision on the diplomatic network and how the funds announced in the Coalition Agreement for its expansion and strengthening will be spent.

Uiterlijk voor de zomer wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de visie van het kabinet op het postennet en de wijze waarop de in het Regeerakkoord aangekondigde middelen voor de uitbreiding en versterking hiervan zullen worden besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de recente benoeming van een rechter die homo- en transgenderonvriendelijke uitspraken deed bij het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the appointment of Judge María Elósegui to the European Court of Human Rights, given her past statements questioning homosexuality as a disease and advocating psychiatric help for transgender people. The minister distanced the government from those statements, said LHBTI rights are protected by the ECHR and the Court, described the nomination process as confidential with the national government nominating and PACE deciding, and said no reason existed to doubt Spain's support for LHBTI rights.
The nomination of all judges to the ECtHR is a confidential process and not publicly transparent.
De kandidaatstelling van alle rechters voor het EHRM is een vertrouwelijk proces en niet publiek inzichtelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, De Roon en Fritsma over de schamele korting op de financiële steun van de Europese Unie (EU) aan Turkije en het vooruitzicht op visumvrij reizen van miljoenen Turken

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether a reported 100 million euro cut in EU pre-accession aid to Turkey is real, whether Dutch money should still flow to Turkey, for a detailed overview of EU funds, and whether visa-free travel for Turks can be prevented. The minister confirmed about 50% cuts to annual and about 30% to multi-year pre-accession programmes in 2017, said the Netherlands favours suspension but lacks majority support, referred to existing documentation for fund details, and stated Turkey does not yet meet all visa liberalisation benchmarks so no Dutch position is needed yet.
The Netherlands is awaiting the Commission's proposals for limiting and reallocating the funds.
Nederland wacht de voorstellen van de Commissie voor inperking en herschikking van de middelen af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een in Iran opgelegde doodstraf

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Iranian Supreme Court had definitively upheld the death sentence against Belgian-based academic Ahmadreza Djalali, whether confessions obtained under torture are a concern, and whether the minister would urgently raise the case with Iranian counterparts. The minister confirmed the ruling appears final but that the lawyer is considering further appeal, shares concern about torture-obtained confessions, and reports EU and personal representations on the death penalty, fair trial and torture.
I personally spoke with my counterpart on 21 February about human rights in broad terms and conveyed the Dutch positions on the death penalty, fair trial and excluding torture.

Zelf heb ik op 21 februari jl. met mijn counterpart in brede zin gesproken over mensenrechten en de Nederlandse standpunten overgebracht ten aanzien van de doodstraf, eerlijke rechtsgang en het uitsluiten van foltering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Onderzoekers OPCW linken Syrië aan grote sarinaanval in 2013’

Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the OPCW reports linking Syria to the 2013 sarin attack, what consequences it attaches, whether Assad has a future in Syria, and what the earlier OPCW findings have led to. Minister Kaag answered that the reports cannot yet be confirmed, that the government keeps pressing Syria in the UN and OPCW, and that no majority exists yet for direct consequences, pointing to accountability initiatives such as the IIIM and EU sanctions.
The cabinet is therefore working, both inside and outside the UN Security Council and together with like-minded countries, to stop the use of chemical weapons in Syria.
Het kabinet zet zich daarom, zowel binnen als buiten de VN-Veiligheidsraad, samen met gelijkgezinde landen in om het gebruik van chemische wapens in Syrië te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over seksuele intimidatie binnen de Verenigde Naties

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about sexual harassment within the UN, the silence of victims, whether immunity shields perpetrators, and what the UN is doing about its internal complaints system. The minister answers that the Netherlands supports the Secretary-General's zero-tolerance approach, notes the new task force and five-point plan, explains that UN officials have functional immunity that the Secretary-General can lift, and says it is too early to judge the measures' adequacy.
The Netherlands will closely monitor the implementation of these measures and, in addition, consult with like-minded countries on additional measures the UN could take.
Nederland zal de uitvoering van deze maatregelen nauwgezet volgen en daarnaast met gelijkgezinde landen in overleg treden over additionele maatregelen die de VN zou kunnen nemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'EU welcomes Silvio Berlusconi as the man to save Italy from populism'

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether it is appropriate for Commission President Juncker, EP President Tajani and others to publicly back Berlusconi, who is barred from office by the European Court of Human Rights, before the Italian elections, and whether this oversteps the EU's mandate and affects Brexit talks. The minister replies that the Commission President and other EU officials decide whom they meet and what they say, that the government has confidence in Barnier, and that Berlusconi is not currently a candidate.
It is up to Commission President Juncker and other EU high-level officials to decide whom they meet, and the statements they make are for their own account.

Het is aan de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie Juncker en andere EU-hoogwaardigheidsbekleders om te bepalen met wie zij een ontmoeting hebben en de uitspraken die zij doen zijn voor hun eigen rekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht 'Kijk die Zweden nu eens!’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Sweden's 'EU Handshake' campaign to raise public engagement with the EU and whether the Netherlands should adopt similar measures. The minister answered that the government supports engagement, lists various steps, stresses that responsibility is shared with civil society, parties and media, and says it will examine how to give shape to closer involvement while respecting national context.
The cabinet is willing to further examine how closer involvement of people, civil society organisations and businesses in the EU can be given shape.
Het kabinet is bereid om nader te bezien op welke wijze vorm kan worden gegeven aan de nadere betrokkenheid van mensen, maatschappelijke organisaties en bedrijven bij de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Roemeense leider van de sociaaldemocraten verdacht wordt van EU-fraude

The MP Leijten asked the Foreign Minister whether Romanian Social Democrat leader Dragnea, suspected of EU and national fund fraud, had received subsidies, whether EU funds were recovered, what measures were taken, whether the case affects Romania's Schengen accession, what lessons apply to candidate states, and whether the EU budget should be increased. The government answered that an investigation is ongoing in Romania, that it will not comment further on the pending case, that EU funds are subject to standard controls and recovery is required for unlawful payments, that Schengen accession requires unanimity and is not on the agenda, and that it opposes increasing the EU budget and favours reform and stronger control.
The cabinet makes no further statements pending the investigation taking place in another member state.
Het kabinet doet geen verdere uitspraken hangende het onderzoek dat in een andere lidstaat plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de levering van twee Fokker 70-toestellen die in het bezit van de luchtmacht van Myanmar zijn gekomen

Karabulut (SP) asked whether two Fokker 70 aircraft sold by KLM Cityhopper and acquired by Air KBZ had ended up with Myanmar's air force, and whether export permits were granted and the aircraft should be reclaimed under the arms embargo. The ministers answered that KLM sold the planes to a Singapore company, they were converted to VIP aircraft and are leased to Myanmar's government, no export permit was needed for civil aircraft, and that leasing civil aircraft to the air force falls outside the EU arms embargo even on a strict reading.
The Netherlands advocates strict compliance with the EU arms embargo against Myanmar.
Nederland pleit voor strikte naleving van het EU-wapenembargo ten aanzien van Myanmar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het optreden van de Iraanse autoriteiten tegen demonstranten in Iran

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about reports of deaths of detained protesters in Iran, the number of arrests and whether political prisoners' release would be advocated. The minister said the Netherlands called for independent investigation, fair trials and release of detainees, and would keep monitoring the situation without committing to specific new steps.
The Netherlands will, together with European partners, closely follow the handling of the recent protests.
Nederland zal, samen met Europese partners, de afwikkeling van de recente protesten nauwgezet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het voornemen om nieuwe sancties aan Noord-Korea op te leggen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands supports new US-considered sanctions on North Korea, how sanctions are being enforced and whether ships are used to evade them, and why China and Russia were absent from the Vancouver meeting. The minister answered that Nederland supports further pressure and autonomous measures beyond UN resolutions, stresses enforcement and ship inspections, and notes that China and Russia's role was emphasised in the meeting's summary.

The Netherlands and the other countries attending the Vancouver meeting on North Korea (15–16 January 2018) agreed to consider autonomous sanctions or diplomatic actions going beyond the UN Security Council resolutions.

Nederland en de andere landen die aan de bijeenkomst over Noord-Korea in Vancouver deelnamen (15–16 januari 2018), hebben afgesproken autonome sancties of diplomatieke acties te overwegen die verder gaan dan de VN-Veiligheidsraadsresoluties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bruins en Sneller over de rechtsgrondslag van het voorgestelde Europees Monetair Fonds (EMF)

MPs asked whether the Commission's proposal for a European Monetary Fund, based on the flexibility clause Article 352 TFEU, is legally sound, given a German Bundestag opinion that found the basis inadequate, and whether the government has legal advice. The minister acknowledged the Commission's choice and said the government finds it insufficiently clear why an EMF is needed, will request a Council legal service opinion, and favours keeping the ESM's intergovernmental character.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Helvert over de Open Doors ranglijst christenvervolging 2018

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the 2018 Open Doors persecution ranking, including religious freedom in Pakistan, North Korea, India and other countries, and whether religious freedom should be a priority in asylum policy. The minister answered that the government shares concern, describes bilateral, EU and Human Rights Fund activities, and sees no reason to make Christian asylum seekers a separate priority in asylum policy.
The government cannot independently confirm the exact number of North Korean Christians in prison camps.
Het kabinet kan het exacte aantal Noord-Koreaanse christenen in strafkampen niet eigenstandig bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat Ethiopië toch niet politieke gevangenen vrijlaat

MP Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Ethiopia would release all political prisoners, later contradicted by a spokesperson, and about Dutch efforts on human rights in Ethiopia. The minister attributed the discrepancy to a translation error, noted that 528 detainees were released in federal prisons with more releases possible, and described Dutch human rights dialogue and capacity-building efforts, without committing to further action.
Ethiopia has begun releasing jailed politicians (or 'political prisoners').
Ethiopië is begonnen met het vrijlaten van gevangen politici (of «politieke gevangenen»).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving dat resten van zeehelden op de vuilnisbelt liggen

An MP asked the Defence, Foreign Affairs and Health ministers about reports that human remains of Dutch naval war dead lie at dump sites near the Java Sea, and whether the government will recover and rebury them. The government confirmed contact with Indonesia and other flag states, offered help and requested on-site investigation, and said it will inform the families and parliament once there is clarity, though it cannot yet give a timeline.
Once there is clarity about the on-site investigation, we will inform you of this.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over het onderzoek ter plaatse, zullen wij u hierover berichten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Arissen, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers in Europa in voorbere

MPs from ten parties asked the government whether it knew of reports that assassinations of Turkish citizens in Europe were being planned, how it assessed these claims, and whether it would investigate and take extra security measures. The minister said the government is alert and monitors tensions and safety in the Turkish-Dutch community, cannot confirm the existence of such plans, and urged anyone threatened to report it.
I cannot confirm the existence of plans for assassinations of Turkish citizens.
Het bestaan van plannen voor moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers kan ik niet bevestigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over mogelijke mijnbouwactiviteiten aan de grens met België bij Zuid-Limburg voor de winning van onder andere zink en mogelijke effecten voor de Nederlandse bie

CDA MPs asked whether Belgian mining exploration for zinc near the Dutch border, and the Einstein Telescope bid in South Limburg, threaten each other. The minister answered that the Belgian authorities did not notify the Netherlands, that a transboundary environmental assessment would be required, and that the Belgian mining could affect the telescope's noise environment, but that it is too early to judge and the matter will be investigated with the province and the Belgian authorities.
I was not informed by the Belgian authorities.
Ik ben door de Belgische autoriteiten niet op de hoogte gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Komt Johan van Laarhoven in 2018 naar Nederland?’

MP Bergkamp asked whether the Thai appeal against Johan van Laarhoven's conviction allows preparation of a WOTS transfer, whether the government will press Thailand to withdraw the appeal, and what other transfer options exist. The minister answered that WOTS can only start once the judgment is final, that the government does not interfere in ongoing foreign criminal cases, and that the prosecution service decides on extradition and has no plans to request it.
Once the case is final, the WOTS request of Mr Van Laarhoven, as promised in my letter of 13 December 2017 to your House, will be processed expeditiously.
Zodra de zaak onherroepelijk is, zal het Wots-verzoek van de heer Van Laarhoven, zoals toegezegd in mijn brief van 13 december 2017 aan uw Kamer, voortvarend in behandeling worden genomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Helvert over het stemgedrag van Nederland in de Verenigde Naties

MPs Voordewind and Van Helvert asked how Dutch voting positions on UN resolutions are determined, how parliament exercises democratic control over them, and whether the government is bound by an alleged EU principle that all member states vote the same. The minister answered that positions are set by the minister after substantive review and EU coordination, that parliament controls this through regular debates, questions and motions, and that no EU principle requires identical voting, though member states must coordinate under Article 34 TEU.
There is no principle agreement within the EU that all member states vote the same.
Er is geen principe-afspraak binnen de EU dat alle lidstaten hetzelfde stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van  het lid Ten Broeke over de illegale smokkel van Russische olie naar Noord-Korea

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of Russian oil smuggled to North Korea and Russian help with missile technology, and what the Netherlands would do as chair of the UN sanctions committee. The minister said the government cannot confirm the reports, would await the UN Expert Panel report, and committed to urging member states to report violations and to outreach activities on sanctions implementation.
The Netherlands will also call on countries to raise reports of possible sanctions violations with the Expert Panel assisting the 1718 Sanctions Committee.
Nederland zal ook landen oproepen om meldingen van eventuele schendingen van sancties aan te kaarten bij het Expertpanel dat het 1718-Sanctiecomité bijstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over Nederlandse steun en internationale steun aan de Syrische oppositie

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about Dutch and international support for the Syrian opposition, including the AJACS police programme in Idlib, monitoring of aid, NLA to the SDF, the White Helmets, and arms origins. The ministers answered most questions on substance, defending the AJACS programme's resumption after investigations and declining to share detailed monitoring reports and recipient locations for security reasons.
For security reasons the cabinet does not share information showing at which locations and to which communities the AJACS programme provides support.
Het kabinet deelt om veiligheidsredenen geen informatie waaruit kan blijken op welke locaties en aan welke gemeenschappen het AJACS-programma ondersteuning verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over een zelfmoordaanslag op een kerk in Pakistan

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a suicide attack on a church in Pakistan, its victim numbers, the attackers' background, the state of radical Islamist groups and Dutch efforts on religious freedom, including the cases of death-sentenced Christians. The minister answered with casualty figures, attributed the attack to ISIS-Khorasan, described the Pakistani government's counter-terrorism plan and reported Dutch and EU engagement on religious freedom.
It cannot be determined from the figures whether the victims were of terrorist, sectarian or separatist violence.
Het is niet uit de cijfers op te maken of het hierbij gaat om slachtoffers van terroristisch, sektarisch of separatistisch geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het optreden van de Israëlische autoriteiten in de bezette Palestijnse gebieden

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli detention of a 17-year-old Palestinian girl and her mother, the killing of a wheelchair-using protester, casualty and detention figures since the US Jerusalem decision, the number of Palestinian political detainees, whether Israeli force is disproportionate, and whether the government will press Israel to investigate and prosecute killings of unarmed demonstrators. The minister confirmed the detentions and killing, gave OCHA casualty and detention figures, cited B'Tselem's detainee count, stated the Netherlands and EU urge strict compliance with safeguards on administrative detention and proportionate force, and said he raised investigation, transparency and prosecution with both parties.

At the same time, the cabinet will continue to hold Israel to its obligation to act proportionately and press for the need for investigations into its own conduct, transparency of outcomes, prosecution of any perpetrators, and measures to prevent incidents in future.

Tegelijk zal het kabinet Israël blijven aanspreken op de verplichting proportioneel te handelen en aandringen op de noodzaak van onderzoeken naar eigen optreden, op transparantie van de uitkomsten, op vervolging van eventuele daders en op maatregelen om incidenten in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het Nederlandse stemgedrag inzake VN-resoluties aangaande Israël

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands voted for a UN General Assembly resolution on Jerusalem that appears to deny Jewish ties to the holy sites, and how this squares with his motion against disproportionate UN agendas on Israel. The minister answered that the resolution follows UNSC resolution 478 and the EU position on the 1967 borders, that the EU added a statement stressing the holy sites, and listed Dutch votes on other 2017 UN resolutions concerning Israel.
The cabinet also refers to the answer to parliamentary questions of 27 July 2017 on the UNESCO decision on the Old City of Hebron.
Het kabinet verwijst tevens naar de beantwoording van Kamervragen van 27 juli 2017 over het besluit van Unesco over de Oude Stad van Hebron.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Niemand vertelt ons wat’

MPs Van Helvert and Van Dam asked how the government supports relatives of Dutch citizens who die abroad, how it supports the Malaysian police investigation into Ivana Smit's death, and why there is no dedicated contact person for such relatives. The minister replied that the ministry provides consular assistance on request, keeps contact with relatives and local authorities, and that Slachtofferhulp Nederland can offer support after return, while noting that the Netherlands cannot interfere in a foreign police investigation.
The Netherlands cannot interfere in a police investigation by foreign authorities into a case that took place abroad.
Nederland kan zich niet mengen in een politieonderzoek door buitenlandse autoriteiten naar een zaak die zich in het buitenland heeft afgespeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Groothuizen over de vrijspraak van Julio Poch

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Justice and Foreign Affairs about the acquittal of Julio Poch in Argentina, his long pre-trial detention, Dutch extradition and legal assistance, compensation, and consular support. The government answered that it sees no reason to revise earlier answers, that the duration of detention is for Argentine courts to decide, that Dutch legal assistance obligations were met, and that consular support was provided, while declining to comment on the unpublished judgment.
It is not appropriate for the government to judge the substance of foreign court rulings.
Het past de regering niet om inhoudelijk te oordelen over buitenlandse rechterlijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Oosten over vrijspraak van de heer Poch in Argentinië

MPs Ten Broeke and Van Oosten asked the ministers about the Argentine acquittal of Mr Poch, the state's role in facilitating his prosecution, an anonymous prosecutor's remark, and the adequacy of consular assistance. The government answered that legal aid was given within the existing framework, that the state does not interfere in foreign criminal cases, that consular support was provided throughout detention, and that Mr Poch returned to the Netherlands on 7 December 2017.
The State refrains from substantive involvement in criminal cases that are before the (foreign) judge.
De Staat onthoudt zich van inhoudelijke bemoeienis met strafzaken die onder de (buitenlandse) rechter zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de steun aan het Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat en de samenwerking met de Women’s Affairs Technical Committee

MPs asked why the Dutch government ended funding for the Women's Affairs Technical Committee after it refused to distance itself from a youth centre named after a convicted terrorist, and why the Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat still lists WATC and touts its advocacy against Israel. The ministers answered that donors ended the partnership after WATC refused to distance itself from glorifying violence, that the last payment was in May 2017, that the website figures were adjusted, and that support for Israeli and Palestinian human rights organisations will continue under review.
The cabinet considers glorifying violence simply unacceptable and expects all its partners to keep well away from it.
Het kabinet acht het verheerlijken van geweld simpelweg onacceptabel en verwacht van al zijn partners dat zij zich hier verre van houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse journalisten die op een dodenlijst zijn gezet door Erdogan’s AK-partij

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about a reported Turkish death list of critical journalists, paramilitary threats, safety of Turkish journalists in the Netherlands, abduction risks, and continued EU pre-accession aid to Turkey. The minister said the column cited does not show a death list, that authorities monitor such groups and urge victims to report, and that pre-accession aid reduction was pursued at EU level without sufficient support, while the rule-of-law concerns are raised regularly.
The cabinet notes that on the basis of this column and the article you refer to, it cannot be concluded that a high-ranking Turkish politician has drawn up a death list for critical journalists.

Het kabinet constateert dat op basis van deze column en het artikel waar u naar verwijst, niet kan worden geconcludeerd dat een hooggeplaatste Turkse politicus een dodenlijst voor kritische journalisten heeft opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Van der Staaij over de omstandigheden in Noord-Koreaanse politieke gevangenissen

MPs from CDA, VVD, PVV and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that North Korean political prisons resemble Nazi camps, including detention numbers, alleged crimes against humanity, UN and ICC action, and protection for Christians. The minister answered that the UN commission reports are authoritative, that Netherlands raises the issue at the UN and supports referral to the ICC though this requires Security Council agreement, and that it supports documentation projects and religious freedom.
The Netherlands, together with the EU, regularly raises the human rights situation in North Korea, including abuses in (political) prisons.
Nederland stelt de mensenrechtensituatie in Noord-Korea, inclusief misstanden in (politieke) gevangenissen, mede in EU-verband regelmatig aan de orde
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de verplaatsing van de Amerikaanse ambassade in Israël naar Jeruzalem

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the planned US move of its embassy to Jerusalem and whether the Netherlands would relocate its own embassy, and whether the government would raise its concerns with the US. The minister confirmed the government considers the move counterproductive, that the Dutch embassy stays in Tel Aviv until a comprehensive peace agreement settles Jerusalem, and that concerns were already conveyed to US authorities.
The Netherlands conveyed its concerns to the US, including at a lunch with Secretary of State Tillerson during the NATO ministerial meeting and in senior official contact with US authorities.

Nederland heeft de zorgen kenbaar gemaakt aan de VS, onder meer bij de lunch met Secretary of State Tillerson tijdens de ministeriële bijeenkomst van de NAVO en in hoogambtelijk contact met de Amerikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over extra maatregelen tegen Noord-Korea en de positie van Nederland als voorzitter van het VN-sanctiecomité Noord-Korea

The PVV MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the Dutch chairmanship of the UN North Korea sanctions committee in 2018, US calls to expand the shipping blacklist, enforcement capacity, cryptocurrency theft, tightening sanctions and attendance at the Vancouver meeting. The minister answered that the Netherlands will focus on effective implementation and outreach, that existing rules already allow ship inspections, that the expert panel supports enforcement, that no separate Dutch investigation into crypto theft is planned, and that the Netherlands supports resolution 2379 and will attend Vancouver.
Carrying out an independent Dutch investigation into the scale of North Korea's cryptocurrency trade and digital theft does not seem appropriate.
Uitvoering van een eigenstandig onderzoek door Nederland naar de schaal van de handel in cryptocurrencies door Noord-Korea en digitale diefstal daarvan ligt niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Nederland in de VN meestemt met anti-Israëlische resoluties als gevolg van EU-beleid

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch voting on anti-Israel UN resolutions is determined by EU policy and whether this conflicts with a parliamentary motion, and whether the government will change its voting. The minister answered that each proposal is assessed on its merits, that EU unity is pursued for influence, and that the motion is seen as encouragement to continue the current approach, without committing to a change in voting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de immense schaal waarop kinderen worden misbruikt op islamitische scholen in Pakistan

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about reported widespread child sexual abuse at Islamic schools (madrassas) in Pakistan, including lack of oversight, funders, and whether Sharia and Islamic ideology enable abuse, and whether the Netherlands should push for an inquiry at the UN Security Council. The minister said the situation is very worrying but cannot be verified, that unregistered madrassas have little oversight, that funders are unknown to the government, that abuse is not caused by Islam or Sharia but impunity is a problem addressed in EU-Pakistan dialogue, and that the Security Council is not the right forum.
The cabinet does not have an overview of parties that financially contribute to Pakistani madrassas.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een overzicht van partijen die financieel bijdragen aan Pakistaanse madrassa's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul en Van der Staaij over de waarschuwing van Unicef over de zorgwekkende situatie van 8,5 miljoen kinderen in Syrië en omliggende landen

Four MPs asked the ministers about UNICEF's warning on 8.5 million children in Syria and neighbouring countries, including emergency aid, action on Eastern Ghouta, the position of children in peace talks, and renewal of UN Security Council resolution 2165. The ministers answered that the Netherlands has contributed substantial humanitarian funds, pushes for humanitarian access and medical evacuations in the ISSG, and will prioritise child protection and cross-border aid during its 2018 Security Council seat.
The Netherlands raises the worrying situation weekly in the International Syria Support Group and will also work in the UN Security Council in 2018 to improve the situation.
Nederland zet zich wekelijks in de ISSG (International Syria Support Group) in om de zorgwekkende situatie aan de kaak te stellen en zal zich in 2018 ook in de VN Veiligheidsraad ervoor inzetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over recente ontwikkelingen in de strijd tegen corruptie in Oekraïne

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister about Ukraine's bills 7440 and 7441 creating an independent anti-corruption court, whether they meet Venice Commission advice, and how the Procurator-General's conflict with the NABU anti-corruption bureau and the dismissal of Ihor Soboliev should be addressed. The minister answered that the bills do not fully incorporate Venice Commission advice on judicial selection and case jurisdiction, that the Netherlands shares those concerns and will raise them bilaterally and in the EU and IMF, and that the Netherlands regrets the Soboliev dismissal and will monitor its effects.
The Netherlands will continue to stress, in bilateral contacts and international forums, the importance of a genuinely impartial and independent court and of following the Venice Commission's advice.

Nederland zal in de bilaterale contacten en internationale gremia het belang van een daadwerkelijk onpartijdig en onafhankelijk Hof, en het opvolgen van de adviezen van de Venetië Commissie blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de op Saoedi-Arabië afgevuurde raketten ‘Made in Iran’

The MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Iran supplied missiles fired by Houthi rebels at Saudi Arabia, and whether Iran violated UN Resolution 2216, and asked whether the government would raise it with Iran and allies. The minister said the UN Panel of Experts found the missile had Iranian characteristics but made no finding on who supplied it, that no evidence yet shows Iran breached the embargo, and that the EU conducts critical dialogue with Iran on its regional role and missile programme without new sanctions planned.
The Panel makes no statements in this report about when, by whom and how the missile would have been supplied to the Houthi rebels.
Het Panel doet in dit rapport geen uitspraken over wanneer, door wie en hoe de raket aan de Houthi-rebellen geleverd zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Ten Broeke over de implementatie van het vredesakkoord in Colombia

MPs Van der Staaij, Van Helvert and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the slow and uneven implementation of the Colombia peace agreement, including rising violence and rights abuses, and what the Netherlands is doing and will do about it. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described mixed progress, listed Dutch funding and diplomatic initiatives, and said the government will press Colombia on faster implementation.
The cabinet will therefore seize every opportunity to press for the most effective and swift possible implementation of the peace agreement.
Het kabinet zal dan ook elke gelegenheid aangrijpen om aan te dringen op een zo effectief en spoedig mogelijke uitvoering van het vredesakkoord
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Nederlanders die probeerden omstreden spionagesoftware te verkopen aan Ecuador

MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch honorary consul who allegedly facilitated sales of Hacking Team spyware to Ecuadorian intelligence, whether such activity should be reported, whether Dutch police or the MIVD used Hacking Team software, and about EU export-control reform. The minister condemned the sales, said honorary consuls are not required to report commercial activities, refused to disclose which spyware Dutch investigators use citing operational risks, and described the EU dual-use reform as under negotiation without committing to a new position.
The cabinet therefore cannot provide any information about this.
Het kabinet kan hierover derhalve geen informatie over verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat christenen in Noord-Irak bedreigd worden door sjiitische milities

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Shia militias in northern Iraq are preventing and persecuting Christians who fled the offensive against the Kurdish region, and about possible ethnic cleansing and Iranian influence. The minister answered that the UN cannot confirm systematic persecution or ethnic cleansing, that the government monitors the situation and raises minority rights with Iraqi and Kurdish authorities, and that the matter is discussed in EU channels.
The government closely follows the situation, in cooperation with the Iraqi government and our international partners.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie nauwgezet, in samenwerking met de Iraakse overheid en onze internationale partners.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omzigt en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘UK foreign aid money 'diverted to extremists' in Syria’

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the government was aware of BBC allegations that AJACS-funded police in Syria paid extremists and worked with courts imposing executions, and asked about Dutch funding and whether it would suspend aid. The minister confirmed awareness, stated Dutch funding of EUR 2.2 million was held pending investigation, committed to joint inquiry with the UK, and listed conditions for resuming aid.
In response to these serious allegations, the financiers involved took immediate action.
Naar aanleiding van deze ernstige aantijgingen hebben de betrokken financiers direct actie ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de geheime stemming over Europese Agentschappen

Leijten (SP) asked the Foreign Minister why the Council decided the relocation of the EMA and EBA by secret ballot, whether this fits Council transparency rules, and how the Council will become more transparent. Minister Zijlstra answered that the decision was intergovernmental and followed a published, transparent procedure, that the Netherlands sees no reason to think it damaged public trust, and that Council votes are generally public though some parts, including this relocation procedure, are not, while the government supports greater openness in EU legislation.
Since this is not an EU decision, the usual rules and practices on decision-making in the Council do not strictly speaking apply.
Aangezien het niet gaat om een EU besluit, zijn de gebruikelijke regels en praktijken rondom besluitvorming in de Raad strikt gezien ook niet van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van Tongeren over het artikel 'Nuclear accident sends 'harmless' radioactive cloud over Europe'

MPs Van Ojik and Van Tongeren asked whether the government knows who was responsible for a radioactive ruthenium-106 release over Europe, whether Russia or Kazakhstan violated early-notification duties, and what risks follow. The minister says the source is not known with certainty but likely the southern Urals, that the Netherlands raised the matter at the IAEA board, and that the national radiation monitoring network can detect such releases.
The Netherlands, together with several other European countries, asked the other IAEA member states for clarification at the recent IAEA board meeting.

Nederland heeft, tezamen met een aantal andere Europese landen, tijdens de afgelopen bestuursraad van de Internationaal Atoomenergieagentschap (IAEA) opheldering gevraagd aan de andere IAEA-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over transseksuelen en interseksuelen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports on transgender and intersex rights, funding gaps for their advocacy groups, limited health access, and support for international funds. The minister said the government funds LHBTI organisations including NNID, that intersex groups are a newer movement with limited donor attention, and that the cabinet will examine intensifying LHBTI priorities.
The cabinet is examining the possibilities for intensifying the priorities named in the coalition agreement, including equal rights for LHBTI persons.
Het kabinet bekijkt de mogelijkheden voor intensivering van de in het regeerakkoord genoemde prioriteiten, waaronder gelijke rechten voor LHBTI's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Geweld tegen Rohingya: 'Massaslachtingen met honderden doden''

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers about reports of mass killings and possible ethnic cleansing of Rohingya by the Myanmar army, including sexual violence, and about psychosocial aid and UN Security Council sanctions. The government expressed serious concern, called for cooperation with the UN Fact Finding Mission and humanitarian access, outlined funding for sexual violence support, and said thematic sanctions face substantial resistance in the Security Council.
The cabinet is seriously concerned about reports of human rights violations by the Myanmar army against Rohingya in Rakhine State.
Het kabinet maakt zich ernstige zorgen over berichten over mensenrechtenschendingen door het Myanmarese leger tegen Rohingya in Rakhine State
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Wilders over de uitspraken van de voorzitter van het Europees Parlement aangaande het budget van de Europese Unie

PVV MPs Maeijer and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the European Parliament president's call to double the EU budget and introduce an EU tax, and whether Dutch membership should be reconsidered. The minister rejected doubling the budget, stated the Dutch position favours a smaller, modernised budget, said direct taxation remains a member-state competence and the Netherlands opposes an EU tax, and rejected leaving the EU.
The cabinet does not agree with the need to double the EU's annual budget.
Het kabinet is het niet eens met de noodzaak van verdubbeling van het jaarlijkse budget van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Geheime deal: veel meer IS’ers mochten Raqqa ontvluchten’

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew hundreds of ISIS fighters had been allowed safe passage out of Raqqa, what he thought of it, where they went, and whether he would raise the evacuation decision with the anti-ISIS coalition. Minister Zijlstra said the coalition was not involved in or informed beforehand of the local deal, that the government finds it concerning that some armed fighters benefited, that tribal leaders reportedly handed most released fighters to local tribes after SDF screening, and that Nederland raised concerns with the coalition's envoy and informed the Kamer on the same day.
The Coalition was not involved in the talks that led to this agreement, nor was the Netherlands informed of it in advance.
De Coalitie was niet betrokken bij de gesprekken die tot deze afspraak hebben geleid, noch is Nederland hierover vooraf geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de ziekelijke fantasieën van een Nederlandse VN vrouwenvertegenwoordiger

MP De Roon asks whether the Minister of Foreign Affairs appoints the Dutch UN women's representative, what the requirements are, whether her appointment should be reversed over violent remarks, and why not. The minister answers that the Dutch Women's Council (NVR) selects the representative without the ministry's involvement, outlines the NVR's criteria and selection process, says the government would deem such remarks unfit if made, and declines to reverse the appointment because the NVR made it.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is not involved in this and is only informed.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is hierbij niet betrokken en wordt alleen geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een lastercampagne van pro-Israël activisten tegen de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking

Member Kuzu asked the government about a smear campaign by pro-Israel groups against Minister Kaag, including attacks on her family, a misquoted article, and reported Israeli surveillance of pro-Palestinian activists in Europe. The government condemned personal attacks, said the quoted remark was incorrect and regretted the resulting confusion, and declined to say anything publicly about foreign intelligence activity while noting the Dutch services operate under the Wiv 2002 and ECHR standards.
No public statements can be made about knowledge of or investigations into the activities of foreign intelligence services.
Over kennis van en onderzoek naar activiteiten van buitenlandse inlichtingendiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over een arrestatiebevel tegen een Turkse journalist

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked whether journalist Can Dündar had cancelled a Netherlands visit because of a Turkish Interpol arrest request, and how the Netherlands handles such requests. The minister answered that he could not confirm the cancellation, that Dündar has since visited, that no Dutch government view on the foreign conviction is given, and that foreign Interpol requests are assessed case by case before registration.

A foreign arrest request or alert that the Netherlands receives via INTERPOL channels is not automatically acted upon: each is assessed case by case before being entered in the national investigation register.

Aan een buitenlands aanhoudingsverzoek of signalering dat Nederland via INTERPOL kanalen ontvangt, wordt niet automatisch gevolg gegeven: deze worden per geval beoordeeld alvorens deze worden ingevoerd in het nationale opsporingsregister.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat NWO1) promotiestudenten financiert die voor Shell in India gaan werken

An MP asked whether NWO funding for PhD positions that largely go to Indian students who will then work for Shell is a good use of scarce research money. The government replied that Shell pays the PhD salaries, that NWO's contribution goes to open research programmes within the top-sector policy, and that no revision of NWO allocation criteria is needed.
Revising the criteria for the distribution of the NWO budget is not on the table.
Herziening van criteria voor verdeling van NWO-budget is niet aan de orde.
