Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht “doof meisje kan geen journaliste worden”

An MP asked the state secretary for Education whether a deaf student denied the ability to finish journalism training met the duty to make reasonable accommodations under equal-treatment law, and whether accreditation checked accessibility. The state secretary answered that institutions must make adequate adjustments in consultation with the student, that accessibility is now an accreditation element checked at institutional level, and that disputes can go to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
This autumn the NVAO will check at institutional level (institutional audit) whether and how Hogeschool Utrecht has introduced policy for students with a disability.
Dit najaar toetst de NVAO op instellingsniveau (instellingstoets) of en op welke wijze de Hogeschool Utrecht beleid ten aanzien van studenten met een functiebeperking heeft ingevoerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaver en Voortman over het bericht “doof meisje kan geen journaliste worden”.

MPs Klaver and Voortman asked whether a deaf applicant was wrongly denied a place in journalism studies at Hogeschool Utrecht and whether the government would act, including on ratifying the UN disability convention. The state secretary replied that the student was selected, not refused, that the Equal Treatment Act requires reasonable adjustments, that the Commission for Equal Treatment can be called in, and that ratification work and a cost-benefit study are ongoing.
The Equal Treatment Act on grounds of disability or chronic illness prohibits making a distinction on grounds of disability or chronic illness.
De Wet gelijke behandeling op grond van handicap of chronische ziekte verbiedt onderscheid te maken op grond van handicap of chronische ziekte.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber en Schouten over de subsidietoekenning 2013-2016 aan Slot Loevestein

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked the state secretary whether cutting the 2013-2016 subsidy to Slot Loevestein, which may close the castle to the public, fits his earlier praise for its cultural entrepreneurship, and why such entrepreneurship is penalised. The state secretary replied that the subsidy follows his policy priorities and the Raad voor Cultuur advice, that the lower grant is not a punishment, and that whether the monument stays open is for the castle's management to decide.
I follow the substantive advice of the Raad voor Cultuur and want to secure the preservation and management of the state collection through subsidy.
Ik volg het inhoudelijk advies van de Raad voor Cultuur en wil het behoud en beheer van de rijkscollectie zeker stellen door middel van subsidie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Kuiken over problemen bij de opleiding tot ambulancebroeder

MPs Jadnanansing and Kuiken asked why the sector requested the medical first-responder training but now cannot or will not offer enough internship places, and what will be done for students. The minister says student intake was reduced from 90 to 75, legal embedding of graduates' powers is under discussion with the sector, and the programme was added to the Stagefonds to fund internship places.
This is being discussed with the Ministry of Health, the universities of applied sciences, the hospitals and the ambulance sector, with the aim of resolving it as soon as possible.
Daarover wordt met het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, de hogescholen, de ziekenhuizen en de ambulancesector gesproken, met als doel op zo kort mogelijke termijn
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk inzake het NRC-bericht “Kritiek op bezuinigingen door het bestuur van de Vrije Universiteit”

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Education about the VU Amsterdam board's planned 33 million euro cutback, possible job losses, derivatives exposure and staff unrest. The State Secretary declined to judge the opinion piece, said the VU board is responsible for its own budget and personnel policy, pointed to a pending Inspectorate review of derivatives, and rejected reforming university governance.
I am awaiting the results of that investigation before deciding whether additional measures or amendments to the policy rule are necessary.
Ik wacht de resultaten van dat onderzoek af alvorens ik besluit of aanvullende maatregelen of aanpassingen van de beleidsregel noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord vragen Koppejan en Holtackers over de stand van zaken op het gebied van meting van actuele grondwaterstanden

MPs Koppejan and Holtackers asked the state secretaries about recent developments in measuring groundwater levels, the independence of DLO research, the reliability of piezometer data and the NHI model. The government answered that the Alterra report on groundwater measurement is attached, that it sees no societal damage from possible measurement errors, and that screening of piezometers for soil structure is not centrally available and is the responsibility of provinces and water boards.
This detailed information is not centrally registered, and collecting it across a large variety of projects is very labour-intensive.
Deze detailinformatie wordt niet centraal geregistreerd en het verzamelen daarvan bij een grote verscheidenheid aan projecten is zeer arbeidsintensief.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de effecten van de langstudeerboete op deeltijdstudenten

An MP asked the state secretary whether, after the July 2012 court ruling, part-time students who began before 1 February 2011 are exempt from the long-study fine, how study duration of part-time programmes is determined, and whether institutions will be compensated for resulting costs. The state secretary answered that these students are not exempt but subject to a transitional rule, that study duration is taken from formally fixed documents, and that institutions will be compensated for the financial effects on the state contribution but not for litigation or administrative costs.
This institution-specific information is only known to the universities and universities of applied sciences.
Deze instellingsspecifieke informatie is alleen bij de universiteiten en hogescholen bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de brief van studentenorganisatie ISO over de langstudeerboete

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about a student-organisation letter on the long-study fine, and whether part-time students are unfairly penalised and whether earlier study history can be used. The state secretary answered that the rulings clarify the rules, that part-time students are not inherently slower, and that hardship cases can be handled through institutional hardship funds, with student organisations kept informed.

To calculate the number of enrolled study years of a student, the sum of their enrolments in the Central Register of Higher Education on the reference date in any year from 1 September 1991 onward is used.

Voor de berekening van het aantal ingeschreven studiejaren van een student wordt uitgegaan van de optelling van diens inschrijvingen in het Centraal register inschrijving hoger onderwijs op de peildatum in enig jaar vanaf 1 september 1991.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het opleggen van de langstudeerboete aan studenten van de TU Delft

The MP asks the state secretary whether it is unreasonable that TU Delft students face a 3000 euro long-study fine due to how the hard cut-off was introduced, and whether they can be exempted. The state secretary rejects both, arguing the case is not merely administrative since students were enrolled in and examined for the master, and refers to a letter for withdrawing the fine.
No, as stated in the answer to question 2, this is not merely an administrative matter.
Nee, zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 2 betreft het hier niet slechts een administratieve kwestie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het opleggen van langstudeerdersboetes aan zieke studenten

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is acceptable to impose long-study fines on students who fall ill, and how the earlier commitment to spare sick students will be restored. The state secretary said the law was amended to give extra time to more sick students and that the wrongly fined case was corrected, while rejecting that the measure has more drawbacks than benefits.
In that specific case DUO indeed did not act correctly, but this has since been rectified.
In dat specifieke geval heeft DUO inderdaad niet juist geopereerd, maar dit is inmiddels rechtgezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht dat studenten die door ziekte studievertraging hebben opgelopen, een langstudeerboete krijgen opgelegd

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked whether students who fell behind due to illness are being charged the higher tuition under the long-study penalty despite a promised exemption for chronically ill students. The state secretary answered that the law was amended to extend the exemption to chronically ill and disabled students without study finance, that students can apply to the institutional hardship fund, and that any affected students have since been helped.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht "DUO gaf foute voorlichting zieke student"

MP Klaver asked the state secretary for Education about reports that DUO gave wrong information to a sick student about the long-study penalty, asking the cause, how to correct it, and whether affected students would be informed. The state secretary acknowledged the report, attributed the errors to rapid administrative changes and a late law amendment, said the website is now correct and erroneous information has been corrected, and stated that DUO will provide correct tuition indications to institutions so they can refund overpaid fees.
Where DUO has given incorrect information, this has now been corrected.
Waar DUO onjuiste informatie heeft gegeven, is dit inmiddels gecorrigeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de peildatum voor de langstudeerboete

An MP asked the state secretary why the cut-off date for the long-study fine was set at 1 November, allowing students to use up their extra year unnoticed via the 1 February scheme, and whether the rules would be changed. The state secretary replied that the cut-off date is 30 September rather than 1 November, that it is fixed by law and matches the funding date, and declined to change it.
The law chose a single reference date to limit administrative burdens for institutions and to ensure as transparent a system as possible for students.
Er is in de wet gekozen voor één peilmoment om de administratieve lasten voor de instellingen te beperken en te zorgen voor een zo transparant mogelijk systeem voor studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat ons hoger onderwijs wordt overspoeld door Zuid-Europese crisisstudenten

PVV MP Beertema asked the state secretary whether around 16,000 crisis students from Southern Europe would enrol in Dutch higher education, and whether Dutch taxpayers would bear about 8,000 euro per student in tuition and grant costs. The state secretary answered that the 16,000 figure rests on website visitor statistics that cannot be verified, that actual Nuffic numbers from Portugal, Spain, Italy and Greece are small (2,030 rising to 3,765), that EU students pay the standard fee with state funding under EU rules, and that the government sees net fiscal benefits and will not change the arrangement.
Whether and to what extent these statistics give a realistic picture of actual enrolments cannot be assessed by me on the basis of the available data.
Of en in hoeverre deze statistieken een realistisch beeld schetsen van de daadwerkelijke inschrijvingen, is voor mij op basis van de beschikbare gegevens niet te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Monasch over hypotheekverstrekking aan mensen met een studieschuld

MPs Jadnanansing and Monasch asked whether banks' practice of applying a 2% monthly norm to the total student debt, rather than actual repayments, inflates the mortgage burden and whether they will raise this with lenders. The State Secretary answered that lenders must consider student loan burdens under the Wft, that DUO loans are not consumer credit under that rule, and that banks and insurers agreed to use 0.75% of the original loan from 1 April 2013, with the government endorsing this method.
In good consultation these parties agreed that the mortgage lender will, in future, in principle base the monthly financial burden attached to the student debt on 0.75% of the original loan.

In goed overleg zijn deze partijen overeengekomen dat de hypothecair financier in de toekomst bij de berekening van de aan de studieschuld verbonden maandelijkse financiële lasten in beginsel uitgaat van 0,75% van de oorspronkelijke lening.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de langstudeerdersboete

An MP asks the state secretary for Education about the long-term student fine (langstudeerdersboete) after a court ruling upheld it, questioning its political support, the likelihood of its survival, and whether collection should be postponed. The secretary rejects postponement and calls the measure in force, while promising a general administrative order to address the court's ruling on part-time students.
I will promote that as soon as possible a general administrative order (amvb) is published that gives effect to the court's ruling.
Ik zal bevorderen dat zo spoedig mogelijk een algemene maatregel van bestuur (amvb) wordt gepubliceerd waarin gehoor wordt gegeven aan de uitspraak van de rechtbank.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klijnsma over cultuureducatie op basisscholen

An MP from the PvdA asked the state secretary about arts education in primary schools, including the Raad voor Cultuur advice, support for schools via the Cultuurkaart and Jeugdcultuurfonds, and keeping the Cultuurkaart going as requested by a motion. The state secretary promised a policy response this autumn and a letter before Prinsjesdag, while noting the existing programme Cultuureducatie met Kwaliteit.
I aim to send your House a policy response to the advice of the Education Council and the Council for Culture this autumn.
Ik streef ernaar om dit najaar een beleidsreactie op het advies van de Onderwijsraad en de Raad voor Cultuur naar uw Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Ham over de langstudeerdersboete voor olympiërs

MP Van der Ham (D66) asks whether the government will scrap or adjust the long-term student fine for top athletes, after reports that a quarter of Dutch Olympic team student-athletes face it. Secretary Zijlstra refuses, saying students already get extra years before the higher tuition applies, can borrow the fee, can appeal to institutional hardship funds, and that institutions may set their own rules.
I want to promote student freedom of choice and the diversity of institutions.
Ik wil de keuzevrijheid van de student en de diversiteit van de instellingen bevorderen.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing inzake frauderende hoogleraar Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam (EUR)

An MP asked the state secretary about a Erasmus University professor accused of research fraud, who denied it and said his department culture left him feeling not personally guilty, and whether rules or dialogue with universities should change. The state secretary said integrity rules were recently tightened, researchers bear personal responsibility, universities enforce compliance, and no further action was needed.
No, I see no reason for that.
Nee, daartoe zie ik geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de verwachte uitval van veel eerstejaars studenten

An MP asked whether the binding study advice (BSA) and expected first-year dropout are a concern, and whether matching interviews could prevent dropout. The state secretary said raising study-credit thresholds is not expected to cause mass dropout, and that study-choice activities are a useful instrument, with a bill on the statutory right to such activities expected in autumn 2012.
Yes, study-choice interviews and other study-choice activities are instruments that can contribute to reducing first-year dropout.
Ja, studiekeuzegesprekken en andere studiekeuzeactiviteiten zijn instrumenten die een bijdrage kunnen leveren aan de terugdringing van de uitval in het eerste jaar.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing en Van Dekken over de langstudeerdersboete voor topsporters

MPs Jadnanansing and Van Dekken asked whether the long-student fine deters elite athletes from combining sport with study and whether it should be replaced. Minister Zijlstra rejected this, pointing to existing extra study years, loan options, profiling-fund support and university athlete schemes, and promised few exceptions.
No, I do not share this view.
Nee, ik deel deze mening niet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Jadnanansing over de afnemende interesse voor lerarenopleidingen en pabo’s

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about the falling intake for teacher-training and pabo programmes, the effect of the public-sector pay freeze, and the projected teacher shortages. The state secretary said the June figures are provisional, attributed the drop partly to the new language and arithmetic test, gave sector-by-sector shortage estimates and listed measures such as career and alternative-entry schemes, while leaving the pay freeze for a new cabinet to decide.
It is up to a new cabinet to decide whether or not to lift the pay freeze.
Het is aan een nieuw kabinet om te beslissen over het wel of niet opheffen van de nullijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Ham over het verdwijnen van de studie Fries

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether the disappearance of the only Dutch university Frisian language and culture programme at the RuG is acceptable, and how Frisian expertise will be safeguarded. The State Secretary replied that the bachelor's programme remains a separate, registered programme and will be embedded in a new broad European languages and cultures bachelor, which he considers the best way to preserve Frisian knowledge.

I understand that the bachelor's programme in Frisian language and culture – contrary to earlier reports – will be maintained as a separate programme and will remain registered in the Central Register of Higher Education Programmes.

Ik heb begrepen dat de bacheloropleiding Friese taal en cultuur – in afwijking van eerdere berichtgeving daarover – als afzonderlijke opleiding wordt gehandhaafd en geregistreerd blijft in het Centraal Register Opleidingen Hoger Onderwijs.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over het rapen van kievitseieren op de Werelderfgoedlijst van Unesco

An MP asked whether the Chamber's April 2012 approval of the UNESCO Intangible Heritage convention changes the government's earlier answers that listing egg-collecting was not on the agenda. The state secretary replied that ratification does not change earlier answers, because the Kingdom only becomes party three months after deposit and inventorying will come first.
The fact that the House of Representatives approved ratification of the UNESCO Convention for Intangible Cultural Heritage changes nothing about the earlier answers.
Het feit dat de Tweede Kamer heeft ingestemd met de ratificatie van het UNESCO-verdrag voor Immaterieel Erfgoed verander niets aan de eerdere antwoorden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het per scriptie betalen van een begeleider aan de UvA

An MP asked whether a university lecturer being paid per supervised thesis undermines diploma quality and whether such practice should be stopped. The state secretary said quality safeguards must be in place, the Inspectorate is seeking information from the University of Amsterdam, and no separate inspection of other institutions is planned.
The inspectorate has asked the college questions about the nature and scale of the hiring and how quality is safeguarded in such cases.
De inspectie heeft het college vragen gesteld over de aard en omvang van de inhuur en op welke wijze in dergelijke gevallen de kwaliteit wordt geborgd.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over de gebrekkige werking van de Code Goed Bestuur

An MP asked the state secretary about weak compliance with the HBO governance code, its lack of attention to education quality, board conflicts of interest, and sanctions for non-compliance. The state secretary acknowledged the shortcomings, said the sector must revise the code, and promised to designate a stronger code by general administrative order with a comply-or-explain duty, while stating no direct government sanctions were planned.
I am of the view that change must come quickly here.
Ik ben van oordeel dat hier snel verandering in moet komen.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de langstudeersboete voor premasterstudenten

An MP asked the state secretary who should pay compensation for premaster students wrongly charged the long-study fine, whether disagreement between universities and the ministry will delay compensation, and whether other flaws in the long-study measure need fixing. The state secretary answered that institutions will compensate these students from the coming academic year, that there is no delay, and that the issue was already known and resolved through consultation with institutions.
The institutions will compensate premaster students who become long-term students because they enrolled in a master's programme for their premaster.
De instellingen zullen premasterstudenten compenseren die langstudeerder worden als gevolg van het feit dat zij voor hun premaster in een masteropleiding zijn ingeschreven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de 10-urennorm voor studenten van buiten de Europese Economische Ruimte

An MP asked the state secretary for Education whether the 10-hour weekly work limit for non-EEA students should be raised, comparing it with the EU-student 56-hour rule and asking about study progress and internship barriers. The state secretary declined to raise the limit, arguing study must remain the main purpose of residence, and said the rules differ because EU law applies only to Europeans, while noting no known internship obstacles.
The maximum norm of 10 hours of work per week or three months of full-time work in summer months precisely guarantees that study remains the main purpose.
De maximumnorm van 10 uur werk per week of drie maanden fulltime werk in de zomermaanden waarborgt juist dat studie het hoofddoel is.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over de geringe belangstelling voor prestatiebeloning

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education about the low school interest in performance pay experiments and whether the plan should be withdrawn. The State Secretary answered that performance pay funding was reallocated under a new budgetary situation, the scheme is being withdrawn, and compensation will be paid to schools that applied; the other questions were declared no longer relevant.
Therefore, on 11 May 2012 I decided to withdraw the Regulation on performance pay in education in its entirety and in the short term.
Daarom heb ik op 11 mei 2012 besloten de Regeling prestatiebeloning in het onderwijs in z’n geheel en op korte termijn in te trekken.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over het terugbetalen van studieschuld

An MP asked the state secretary of Education whether DUO should allow student debtors to raise their fixed monthly repayment amount and whether such extra repayment should be encouraged. The secretary said extra repayment is already possible voluntarily, that a monthly-amount increase cannot be realised quickly because DUO's systems are inadequate, and that it will be examined in the Programma Vernieuwing Studiefinanciering with a possible date of 2015.
However, DUO cannot realise an increase of the legally repayable monthly amount in the short term.
DUO kan verhoging van het wettelijk terug te betalen maandbedrag echter niet op korte termijn realiseren.
Antwoord vragen De Rouwe en Ferrier over het voornemen van verschillende universiteiten om talenstudies op te laten gaan in brede studies

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government shares concern that several universities plan to fold language degrees (e.g. Frisian, French, Portuguese) into broad bachelor programmes, and whether standalone full-time language study should be preserved for national and international interests. The State Secretary acknowledged language importance, said profiling may mean some small programmes disappear or are merged or restructured, and that broad bachelors can still offer languages, while institutions must align plans with the Implementation Plan for Humanities.
I share the view that languages are of great importance from a national cultural perspective and for the Dutch economy and exports.
Ik deel de mening dat talen van groot belang zijn vanuit nationaal cultureel belang en voor de Nederlandse economie en de export.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing en Jacobi over de toekomst van de enige academische opleiding Friese taal en cultuur

MPs Jadnanansing and Jacobi asked whether the University of Groningen's plan to fold Frisian language and culture into a broad European languages bachelor threatens the only academic Frisian programme. The state secretary replied that the Frisian bachelor stays separately registered in the CROHO register and will be offered jointly with the new programme to safeguard Frisian's sustainability.

I understand that, contrary to what the University of Groningen's website states about Frisian, the Frisian language and culture bachelor programme remains registered as a separate programme in the central register of higher education programmes.

Ik heb begrepen dat – in afwijking van hetgeen op de website van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen met betrekking tot het Fries is gesteld – de bacheloropleiding Friese taal en cultuur aan de RUG als afzonderlijke opleiding geregistreerd blijft in het Centraal Register Opleidingen Hoger Onderwijs.
Antwoord vragen Bosma naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Beatrixstraat Pretoria op de wip'

An MP asked whether plans by a Pretoria city council to rename streets named after Queen Beatrix and Queen Wilhelmina, and whether the Dutch ambassador should defend the Boer-era Dutch cultural heritage and refuse to use a renamed address. The state secretary replied that street naming in South Africa is for its democratically elected authorities and that the Dutch government trusts that democratic process.
The naming of streets on South African territory is a matter for the democratically elected South African authorities.
De benaming van straatnamen op Zuid-Afrikaans grondgebied is een zaak van de democratisch gekozen Zuid-Afrikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de taalvaardigheid van hbo-studenten

MP Jadnanansing asked the state secretary for Education about Dutch language skills of HBO students, whether this hinders success, why it occurs, and whether a language test would help. The state secretary acknowledges the concern, cites declining language levels across education sectors and new reference-level measures, says the responsibility for language mastery lies mainly with feeder education, and leaves the decision on language tests in higher education to the institutions.
As far as I am concerned, it is up to the higher education institutions themselves to assess for which programmes a language test is useful and necessary.
Wat mij betreft is het verder aan de instellingen voor hoger onderwijs zelf om de inschatting te maken voor welke opleidingen een taaltoets nuttig en noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de effecten van de langstudeerdersboete op leraren die willen doorstuderen

An MP asked the state secretary whether the long-student fine (langstudeerdersboete) deters teachers from pursuing further study and whether it should be withdrawn or adjusted for teacher training. The state secretary said he cannot say how many teachers will be deterred, that the rules allow three years at statutory tuition plus subsidy before the higher fee applies, and that he will not withdraw the measure but will offer case-by-case relief via the profileringsfonds.
I cannot say how many teachers will not (further) study because of the long-student measure.
Ik kan niet zeggen hoeveel leraren niet (verder) zullen studeren vanwege de langstudeerdersmaatregel.

Vragen van de leden Lucas (VVD), Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Jasper VanDijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel «Ondernemende universiteit in zwaar weer» (ingezonden 26 oktober 2

MPs asked the state secretary about a newspaper report on alleged irregular spending, property losses and integrity gaps at TU Delft, and whether the ministry should act on PwC's withheld audit approval in 2007 and 2008. The state secretary said the Inspectorate validated TU Delft's commitments and sent improvement points, and that no sanctions were imposed because non-compliance with European tendering rules carries no state sanction policy.
On the basis of this consultation, the Inspectorate of Education further validated TU Delft's input.
Op basis van dit overleg heeft de Inspectie van het Onderwijs de inbreng van TU Delft nader gevalideerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de reis- en onkostenvergoedingen bij de TU Delft

An MP asked the state secretary what action would follow reports of excessive expense claims by TU Delft board members and whether the expenses were necessary. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate of Education sent a letter demanding improvements and reporting, that the supervisory board promised more attention to internal rules, and that the board decides on necessity.
The Inspectorate of Education sent the Executive Board of TU Delft a letter on 6 February 2012 about a number of points for improvement at TU Delft.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs heeft het College van Bestuur van TU Delft op 6 februari 2012 een brief gestuurd over een aantal verbeterpunten bij TU Delft.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een decaan aan de TU Delft die opdracht gaf aan het bedrijf van zijn echtgenote (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about a TU Delft dean who repeatedly awarded university contracts to his wife's company, and whether the situation constitutes serious conflict of interest, whether reprimands suffice, who should have supervised, and whether funds can be recovered. The state secretary answered that conflict of interest is wrong, an accountant's investigation found appearances of conflict but the dean was mostly not directly involved, the dean resigned, a repayment arrangement was made, and that the existing supervisory system (Inspectie, Raad van Toezicht, accountant) is sufficient though the Raad van Toezicht will pay extra attention.
I see no reason to change this supervisory system.
Ik zie geen reden om dit toezichtstelsel aan te passen.
Vragen van het lid Jasper vanDijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over belangenverstrengeling bij de TU Delft (ingezonden 21 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about conflict of interest at TU Delft, where a dean awarded about €750,000 in contracts to his wife, and what sanctions, code of conduct tightening, and disclosure of professors' side jobs would follow. The state secretary replied that an independent audit was done, the university has taken measures, the dean stepped down, and no central overview of side jobs is planned beyond the university's own publication.
Following this article, the TU Delft Executive Board, in consultation with the Inspectorate of Education, had an accountant carry out an independent fact-finding investigation.
Naar aanleiding van onder meer dit artikel heeft het College van Bestuur van TU Delft in overleg met de Inspectie van het Onderwijs een accountant een onafhankelijk feitenonderzoek laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord vragen Lucas over de langstudeerregeling

An MP asked whether students who enrol in September and deregister before 1 October, while not studying the rest of the year, are wrongly counted as long-term students under the langstudeerregeling. The State Secretary agreed the situation is unfair and committed to an AMvB granting one extra year retroactively, to be claimed on request.
I will arrange for an AMvB to give this category of students entitlement to one extra year of study.
Ik zal regelen dat in een Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur (AMvB) deze categorie studenten aanspraak krijgt op één extra uitloopjaar.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de verdwijning van deeltijdstudies

An MP asked the state secretary for Education whether the disappearance of part-time degree programmes, reported after a sharp drop in applications, was the aim of policy and what would be done to prevent it. The state secretary answered that it is not the aim, that the decline has been ongoing for years, and that measures aimed at aligning part-time provision with demand will follow a broader review, referring to a parallel letter.
Following that broad review, I intend to take measures aimed at the future-proofing of the frameworks for part-time education, particularly regarding the alignment of provision with demand.
Ik ben voornemens naar aanleiding van die brede verkenning maatregelen te nemen gericht op de toekomstbestendigheid van de kaders voor deeltijdonderwijs
Antwoord vragen van Van Dekken en Jadnanansing over de langstudeerdersboete voor studerende topsporters.

MPs Van Dekken and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary about the long-study fee's effect on student top athletes, who are often abroad and may fall behind in their studies. The state secretary rejected the concerns, pointing to extra study years, a profileringsfonds for exceptional cases, and institutional top-athlete schemes, and denied that the measure threatens Dutch sporting ambitions.
I am of the view that the number of exceptions to the long-study measure must be very limited.
Ik ben van mening dat het aantal uitzonderingen op de langstudeerdersmaatregel zeer beperkt moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht “Hoge boete weerhoudt studenten van master”

MP Jadnanansing asked whether the long-study fine deterring students from a master's harms the economy, how many employers see a university bachelor's as sufficient, and whether dropping out of vwo is also a 'conscious choice'. The state secretary answered that choosing to delay a master's is a conscious decision, that survey data show only 2% of university bachelor students will forgo a master because of the fine, and that completion of all programmes is valued.
When asked, the researchers openly provided access to the underlying (aggregated) data.
Desgevraagd hebben de onderzoekers in alle openheid inzage gegeven in de onderliggende (geaggregeerde) gegevens.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over extra betalingseisen van Universiteit van Amsterdam aan studenten

An MP asked whether the University of Amsterdam may charge students extra tuition after its own administrative error, and whether the state will intervene with the university. The state secretary answered that the error was a correction of tuition billing, that students can object and appeal under the WHW, and that he will not intervene with the university.
For students there is the possibility of objection and appeal against the decision of the Central Student Administration (CSA).
Voor studenten is er de mogelijkheid van bezwaar en beroep tegen het besluit van de Centrale Studentenadministratie (CSA).
Antwoord vragen Peters en Jasper Van Dijk over de optelsom van bezuinigingen op cultuur

MPs Peters and Van Dijk asked the state secretary for an aggregate picture of cultural budget cuts across national, provincial and municipal government, including effects on supply, attendance, employment, the Geefwet and the WWIK abolition. The secretary answered that the aggregate cannot yet be given because decisions are unfinished and data are not comparable, and that effects cannot reliably be predicted, though some figures (WWIK saving of 10 million, VAT rise of 90 million, transition costs up to 138 million) were provided.

Partly because decisions on cultural subsidies for 2013–2016 at national, municipal and provincial level are not yet concluded, it is not possible to state how much is cut in culture by national, provincial and municipal government together.

Mede omdat de besluitvorming over de cultuursubsidies voor de periode 2013–2016 bij zowel Rijk, gemeenten als provincies nog niet is afgerond, is het niet mogelijk aan te geven hoeveel er door Rijk, provincies en gemeenten gezamenlijk wordt bezuinigd op cultuur.

Vragen van de leden Lucas, Van Nieuwenhuizen en Azmani (allen VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over studiefinanciering voor studenten u

MPs asked how many foreign students who also count as migrant workers receive study finance, the EU basis for the rule, other social provisions open to them, how hours worked are checked, and whether the eligibility threshold can be tightened. The state secretary reported a rising share of migrant-worker students among EU students, cited EU law and the Dutch 32-hour monthly norm checked by DUO, and announced raising the norm to 56 hours from next year.
I intend to implement this tightening with effect from next calendar year.
Ik ben voornemens deze aanscherping met ingang van volgend kalenderjaar door te voeren.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing en Monasch over hypotheekverstrekking aan mensen met een studieschuld

MPs Jadnanansing and Monasch asked whether borrowing for study is responsible and whether banks have tightened mortgage rules for people with student debt. The state secretary replied that student debt is rightly counted in mortgage assessments, that banks have not tightened norms but apply them more strictly, and that starters remain important to the housing market.
From the Dutch Banking Association (NvB) I have learned that the norms for granting a mortgage to people with student debt have not become stricter.
Van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken (NvB) heb ik vernomen, dat de normen ten aanzien van het verstrekken van een hypotheek aan mensen met een studieschuld niet strenger zijn geworden.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Van Gerven over de berichten dat de Saxion Hogeschool de niet-geaccrediteerde opleiding tot CAM-therapeut blijft aanbieden

SP MPs asked whether Saxion Next still offers a non-accredited HBO CAM therapist programme and what happens to students and graduates. The state secretary answered that existing students may finish, that their diplomas are legally valid, that no new students were enrolled after accreditation lapsed, and that the website wording has been amended.
Saxion Next has acknowledged this and has since amended the text on the website.
Saxion Next heeft dit onderkend en heeft de tekst op de website inmiddels aangepast.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de terugval in aanmeldingen voor deeltijdstudies

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about the drop in applications for part-time degree programmes and urged a prompt answer before summer, and whether fixing the long-term student rule was being disguised as technical maintenance. The state secretary promised a letter on the broad part-time review soon, linked to a pending SER advice, and said the long-term student measure would be addressed there.
I intend to inform the House shortly following the broad part-time exploration I announced.
Ik ben voornemens de Kamer op korte termijn te informeren naar aanleiding van de door mij aangekondigde brede verkenning deeltijd.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing inzake het wegjagen van Nederlandse studenten naar buitenlandse universiteiten

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about the flight of Dutch students to foreign universities, citing a newspaper article, and asked for numbers, motives, whether this is a brain drain, and whether Dutch students will stay abroad to work. The state secretary answered that about 16,000 Dutch students were enrolled abroad for a degree in 2007-2008, that motives are personal development and language, that there is no real brain-drain situation since inbound students far outnumber outbound ones, and that no representative stay-rate figures exist.
No representative figures are known on this.
Hierover zijn geen representatieve cijfers bekend.
Antwoord vragen Beertema over het bericht ‘Genade-zesjes voor studenten worden kwistig uitgedeeld’

An MP asked the state secretary about a newspaper report that university students are handing out lenient passing grades, and whether academic degree standards are under pressure and should be set at faculty level. The state secretary said the underlying student study was not published and was not scientific, that its survey offers no basis for conclusions about standards, and that recent policy measures like accreditation changes already address degree level, while deferring further discussion to a later debate.
The Inspectorate of Education has also requested the study. If the Inspectorate deems it necessary, further consultation will take place with the students concerned.
Ook de Inspectie van het Onderwijs heeft het onderzoek opgevraagd. Indien de Inspectie dat nodig acht, zal nader overleg plaatsvinden met de betreffende studenten.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over beschadiging en roof van openbare kunstwerken

An MP asked the state secretary how the government responds to theft and damage of public artworks for their bronze, and whether theft is rising and how heritage protection and expert advice are used. The government answered that thefts rose about 20% in 2011, pointed to the Actie Koperslag covenant and heritage protection programmes, and said that casts are rarely preserved but new ones can be made.
In response to the rising number of copper thefts, the minister of Security and Justice took additional measures and signed the Actie Koperslag covenant on 30 June 2011.
In reactie op het stijgende aantal koperdiefstallen heeft de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie extra maatregelen genomen en op 30 juni 2011 het convenant Actie Koperslag ondertekend.
Antwoord vragen Beertema over het bericht betreffende een compensatieregeling voor onvoldoendes op de faculteit der geesteswetenschappen van de Universiteit van Amsterdam

An MP asks the state secretary whether the University of Amsterdam's proposed compensation rule for failed courses (allowing a 5 to be offset by a 7 in the same cluster) lowers standards and causes diploma deflation, and what action will be taken. The secretary rejects the deflation claim, defends the rule as pedagogically motivated and part of a package to reduce dropout, sees no reason for special action, and states the funding system has shifted away from diploma-based financing.
I see no reason, based on the current UvA plans, to take steps to pay extra attention to the quality of education or the UvA's diplomas.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op basis van de huidige plannen van de UvA stappen te ondernemen om met extra aandacht te kijken naar de kwaliteit van het onderwijs of de diploma's van de UvA.
Antwoord vragen Ormel over een vrijwillig wetenschappelijk moratorium van 60 dagen op onderzoek naar levensgevaarlijk vogelgriepvirus

An MP from the CDA asked the government about a voluntary 60-day scientific moratorium on research into H5N1 bird flu virus, the planned international forum, publication safeguards, licensing of other potentially dangerous micro-organisms, and bioterrorism risk oversight. The minister answered that the government supports the WHO-facilitated international discussion, that transparency on licensed projects is limited for state security reasons, and that a body to review risks is under consideration, with a letter to follow.
Precisely in the interest of state security, no public overview of those projects can be given.
Juist in het belang van de staatsveiligheid kan er geen openbaar overzicht van die projecten worden gegeven.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over het ontbreken van instemming bij experimenten met prestatiebeloning in het onderwijs

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Education why pilot performance-pay experiments in schools went ahead without formal works-council consent, and whether such pilots are meaningful. The state secretary replied that the pilot schools consulted staff and works councils without formal signed consent, that the pilots were forerunners outside the formal scheme, and that experiments are needed to test whether performance pay works.

The Schools Participation Act (WMS) and the Works Councils Act (WOR) are clear on this: consent of the works council is required when adopting or changing policy on the award of salaries, allowances and gratuities to staff.

De Wet Medezeggenschap Scholen (WMS) en de Wet op de Ondernemingsraden (WOR) zijn hier duidelijk over: instemming van de MR/OR is noodzakelijk bij vaststelling of wijziging van het beleid met betrekking tot de toekenning van salarissen, toelagen en gratificaties aan het personeel.
Antwoord vragen Jadnansing over de vermindering van de uitgaven aan wetenschap

An MP asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science about a reported 10 percent cut to scientific research and the expected long-term economic damage, and why science should not follow the rule that everything has its price. The state secretary said he expects future earnings to depend on scientific knowledge, pointed to science's intrinsic value, and referred to a forthcoming letter on indirect R&D spending instead of quantifying the long-term damage.
Against the declining direct government spending on R&D stands an increase in indirect spending.
Tegenover de teruglopende directe uitgaven van het Rijk voor R&D staat een toename van de indirecte uitgaven.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing en Dijsselbloem over het teruglopende aantal aanmeldingen voor pedagogische opleidingen

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary for Education about the falling number of applicants to teacher-training and pedagogy programmes, including the impact of pay freezes, tuition rules and the long-study fine. The state secretary replied that the decline is mainly in pabo intake, that no specific intake measures are planned for the short term, and that tuition and fine rules will not be relaxed, pointing to alternative routes and career measures.
No specific measures are foreseen to increase intake into the pabo.
Voor verhoging van de instroom in de pabo zijn verder geen specifieke maatregelen voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht dat Nederland kampt met een nijpend tekort aan hoogopgeleide technici

MP Schouten asked the ministers about reports of a severe shortage of highly educated technicians, the ROA labour market forecast, and whether the social loan system for masters students deters bèta students. The minister acknowledged serious technical labour shortages, outlined joint public-private measures and a Masterplan due to be sent to cabinet, and argued the masters loan burden is limited and unlikely to deter students.
By 2 April at the latest, your House will be informed about the cabinet's ambitions.
Uiterlijk 2 april a.s. wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de ambities van het kabinet.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over de financiering van de wetenschappelijke functie van het Geld- en Bankmuseum

MP Van der Ham asked whether the Geld- en Bankmuseum is ceasing most of its scholarly work after a temporary Finance Ministry subsidy ended, and whether that work could be moved to another institution to preserve expertise. The state secretary confirmed that the temporary supplementary subsidy ended while the regular subsidy continues, and said the museum itself must decide how to handle its scholarly function, which is not among the exceptions to the subsidy cut.
I am happy to leave it to the Geld- en Bankmuseum itself to decide how the museum's scholarly function is handled.
Ik laat graag aan het Geld- en Bankmuseum zelf over hoe met de wetenschappelijke functie van het museum omgegaan wordt.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de grote vertraging van het innen van boetes door de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) en een coulanceregeling (inge

MP Van der Ham asked why about 20,000 students are only now being billed for exceeding the side-job income limit from two years ago, and whether DUO informed them adequately and should offer a hardship scheme. The state secretary answered that the delay stems from the tax-data process, the rules in force at the time apply, information was adequate per the Ombudsman, and no hardship scheme will be created.
I am of the opinion that the side-job income limit and the way the claim can be settled are lenient enough.
Ik ben van mening dat de bijverdiengrens en de wijze waarop de vordering kan worden voldaan coulant genoeg is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de dreigende sluiting van 17 musea

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether the reported possible closure of 17 museums, the impact on municipal museums and their collections, and the higher own-income requirement were acceptable given the 'spare heritage' commitment in the coalition agreement. The secretary answered that the closures cannot be predicted because subsidy procedures are still ongoing, that the heritage commitment applies to national policy, that he trusts municipalities and provinces to handle collections carefully, and that he sees no reason to revisit the own-income requirement, while consulting other governments on the museum system.
I see no reason to reconsider the measures taken.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de genomen maatregelen te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Ham over het minder zwaar maken van de eisen op de TU Delft

An MP asks the state secretary whether TU Delft's plan to reduce study load and allow compensation between exams is a lowering of academic standards, and whether ministry will consult the university. The state secretary answers that the changes are part of a quality-improvement plan funded by the ministry, that compensation is legally permitted, and that no new consultation is needed since programmes are accredited by NVAO.
I do not consider this a negative lowering of the level.
Ik vind dit geen negatieve niveaubijstelling.
Antwoord vragen Lucas en De Liefde over het gegeven dat NWO en AMOLF een tafel hebben gekocht bij een fundraising-diner van Museum Boerhaave

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary why NWO and AMOLF (FOM) bought a €2,500 table at a fundraising dinner for Museum Boerhaave, given the ministry's policy of more private funding for that museum, and whether these costs were efficient spending. The state secretary acknowledged the purchase (about €2,082.50), agreed it is not efficient use of public money, said NWO will not use its funds for such purposes again, and declined to reclaim the amount given its small size.
I do not regard the expenditure on the fundraising dinner as an efficient use of public funds.
Ik beschouw de uitgaven voor het fundraising-diner niet als doelmatige besteding van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de TU Delft de studielast vermindert zodat studenten sneller afstuderen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether TU Delft's plan to reduce study load so students graduate faster reflects a perverse incentive from the government's focus on study efficiency, and how quality will be protected. State Secretary Zijlstra answered that the revision is part of agreed quality improvements, that funding is not tied to graduation rates, that accreditation safeguards quality, and that no new talks with the TUs are needed.
There is currently no reason to enter into consultation with the TUs again.
Er is nu geen aanleiding om weer met de TU’s in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de verlichting van onderwijsprogramma's van de TU Delft om studenten sneller te laten afstuderen

The MP asked whether TU Delft's plans to lighten degree programmes to shorten study times lower academic content, undermine excellence, and create a perverse incentive from the long-term student measure. The state secretary answered that the curriculum revision aims to improve study-ability within the agreed quality plans, that technical programmes have long had low completion rates, and that the measure does not compromise programme quality.
The revision of the education programme is part of the agreements I have made with the three TUs on improving education quality, including the study-ability of the programmes.

De herziening van het onderwijsprogramma maakt deel uit van de afspraken die ik met de drie TU's heb gemaakt over verbetering van de onderwijskwaliteit, waaronder de studeerbaarheid van de programma's.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een docent aan de Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (VU) die tentamens heeft versimpeld om meer financiering binnen te

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Education whether a VU lecturer simplified exams to increase funding and how university funding creates incentives to lower standards. The state secretary answered that only four students received an extra resit in a politics programme after a curriculum change, that no deliberate exam simplification occurred, that funding does not depend on study points, and that performance agreements focus on quality, so no further investigation is planned.
I am therefore of the view that in this case there is no question of deliberately simplifying exams with the aim of getting more students to pass.
Ik ben dan ook van mening dat in dit geval geen sprake is van het opzettelijk versimpelen van tentamens met als doel meer studenten te laten slagen.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een decaan aan de TU Delft die opdracht gaf aan het bedrijf van zijn echtgenote (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

MP Jadnanansing asks the state secretary how the government views a TU Delft dean who repeatedly awarded university contracts to his wife's company, whether reprimands are adequate, who should have supervised this, and whether recovery of funds is possible. The state secretary replies that the Inspectorate of Education will check whether additional investigation is needed, and answers to the questions will follow only after its findings.

Because the inventory is related to the earlier questions from members Jadnanansing, Lucas and Jasper van Dijk, I can only answer these earlier questions after I have received the findings of the additional investigation by the Inspectorate of Education.

Omdat de inventarisatie verband houdt met de eerdere vragen van de leden Jadnanansing, Lucas en Jasper van Dijk kan ik deze eerdere vragen pas beantwoorden nadat ik de bevindingen van het aanvullende onderzoek van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs heb ontvangen.

Vragen van de leden Lucas(VVD), Jadnanansing(PvdA) en Jasper Van Dijk(SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel «Ondernemende universiteit in zwaar weer» (ingezonden 26 oktober 201

MPs Lucas, Jadnanansing and Van Dijk asked the state secretary about press reports on TU Delft's spending of public funds, including lawsuits and fines, and about unqualified audit opinions in 2007 and 2008. The state secretary replied that he will answer only after the Inspectorate of Education completes a follow-up inventory of possible additional investigation.

Vragen van de leden Lucas (VVD), Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Jasper Van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel «Ondernemende universiteit in zwaar weer» (ingezonden 26 oktober

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether TU Delft's public funding was lawfully spent, including on lawsuits against the state and fines for overpaid chairs, and why the ministry took no action after an auditor withheld approval of TU Delft's accounts in 2007 and 2008. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate of Education is examining whether further investigation is needed, and will answer the questions only after its findings are received.
Following the NRC report of 24 January 2012, the Inspectorate of Education contacted Delft University of Technology.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving in het NRC van 24 januari 2012 heeft de Inspectie van het Onderwijs contact opgenomen met de Technische Universiteit Delft.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de openbaarmaking van het aantal contacturen bij universitaire opleidingen (ingezonden 7 december 2

Two MPs asked the state secretary why universities' contact-hour data, collected via the Nationale Studenten Enquête, was not published for prospective students. The secretary said the data was collected only for the inspectorate in a confidential pilot, universities judged it unfit for publication, and he pressed for proper questions in future surveys and a working group was set up.
I have therefore taken note with approval of the board's decision.
Ik heb dan ook met instemming van het besluit van het bestuur kennis genomen.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het scharen van pre-masters onder de masterfase (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether universities placed pre-master programmes under the master phase to avoid the long-term student fine, and whether affected students could be exempted. The state secretary confirmed some universities did so, said the number of students is not known, asked universities to map the group and help them graduate, and refused a one-off exemption.
I am not aware of that.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de klacht dat DUO automatisch leningen aan studenten verstrekt (ingezonden 16 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is reasonable that DUO automatically converts student grants into loans after the grant phase, forcing students to act to stop unwanted loans, and whether DUO's communication and complaint handling should be reviewed. The secretary rejected the criticism, arguing students retain control via 'Mijn DUO', were warned by mailing, and that DUO's service and complaint procedures meet agreed standards.
DUO's working method is permanently monitored. Accountability for this is given in the annual report.
De werkwijze van DUO wordt permanent gemonitord. Daarover wordt bij het jaarverslag verantwoording afgelegd.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over problemen met DUO en Studielink (ingezonden 29 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about a poll reporting that 31% of students experienced errors by the Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) and whether service is reliable given the financial stakes for students. The state secretary rejects the poll's picture, citing satisfaction surveys (rated 7), performance indicators and complaint numbers, and sees no quality gap requiring a report to parliament.
In view of the foregoing, I see no quality shortfall at DUO that needs to be remedied and about which it is necessary to inform your House.
Gelet op het voorgaande zie ik geen kwaliteitsachterstand bij DUO die dient te worden verholpen en waarover het nodig is uw Kamer te informeren.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de informatievoorziening betreffende de langstudeerdersboete en andere studiemaatregelen (ingezonden 16 december 20

An MP asks the state secretary of Education how many students know about the long-study fine and other study measures, and whether information provision is effective rather than just a matter of effort. The secretary reports that information is given via websites, letters and meetings, that a baseline survey shows high awareness (95% WO, 83% HBO), and promises to send the final results to parliament in January with any extra information measures.
I intend to send the final results of the said research to your House in January.
Ik ben voornemens de definitieve resultaten van het genoemde onderzoek in januari aan uw Kamer te sturen.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de verschraling van profileringsfondsen van hoger onderwijsinstellingen (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

Van der Ham (D66) asked the state secretary of Education, Culture and Science how the size of universities' and colleges' profileringsfondsen (profiling funds for student grants) is developing, what this means for grants, whether spending priorities are shifting, and how claims and their total value have evolved. The secretary said he has no current data, will receive institutional figures in mid-2012, and cited a 2010 Inspectorate report showing fund sizes rising from 2004 to 2008 with no clear shift between categories.
I have ensured that from 2011 institutions will include data on the size of the profiling fund in their annual accounts.
Ik heb ervoor gezorgd dat de instellingen vanaf 2011 in hun jaarrekening gegevens over de hoogte van het profileringsfonds gaan opnemen.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het voornemen van voortgangstoetsing van drie samenwerkende hogescholen (ingezonden 16 november 201

MPs Jadnanansing and Lucas asked why a joint proposal by three universities of applied sciences to develop progress tests, submitted in September 2010 with a requested subsidy, had no decision for over a year. The State Secretary replied that the process was paused during an Inspectorate study on assessment practice, that €8 million has since been reserved for 2012-2015 to improve assessment, and that the institutions may pursue the plan independently.
Nothing prevents the institution from pursuing the plan independently, as happened in the past with five medical faculties attached to universities.
Er staat de instelling niets in de weg het plan zelfstandig op te pakken zoals dat in het verleden is gebeurd bij vijf medische faculteiten verbonden aan universiteiten.

Vragen van de leden Lucas, Van Nieuwenhuizen en Azmani (allen VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over studiefinanciering voor studenten u

MPs Lucas, Van Nieuwenhuizen and Azmani (VVD) asked the state secretary for Education and the minister of Social Affairs about student finance for foreign students who also hold migrant worker status, covering numbers, annual amounts, the EU basis of the control policy, other social provisions, hours-worked checks and possible tightening of eligibility. The government's reply only announced that interdepartmental consultation would delay answers, with a substantive response expected in January 2012.
Because interdepartmental coordination will still take some time, I am not able to answer the questions within the usual period.
Omdat de interdepartementale afstemming nog enige tijd zal vergen, ben ik niet in staat de vragen binnen de gebruikelijke termijn te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over voorlichting omtrent de studie Omgangskunde (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

An MP asked whether students of the Omgangskunde teacher training were misled about job prospects, since the subject is barely taught in secondary education and the 2006 teacher qualification law limits teachers to their own subject. The state secretary acknowledged the subject is mainly taught in vocational colleges, that many students are career-changers, and that the four colleges promised clearer information for prospective students, without any sanction.
The colleges promised me on that occasion that they would leave no doubt in their information materials about the qualification the certificate confers.
De hogescholen hebben mij bij die gelegenheid toegezegd in hun voorlichtingsuitingen geen enkele twijfel te laten bestaan over de bevoegdheid die aan het getuigschrift is verbonden

Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het vertragen van de film Mocro’s door het Filmfonds omdat deze film «vooroordelen» van Marokkanen zou bevestigen (ingezonden 1

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Film Fund delayed the film Mocro's by a year because it confirmed prejudices about Moroccans, and why the taxpayer should keep funding this group. The state secretary denied the film was delayed for that reason, explaining the maker chose to re-edit the documentary after the Fund criticised its departure from the original filmplan, with no influence exercised by the Fund.
The Film Fund did not exert any influence on this and gave its full cooperation to the committed financing for realisation.
Het Filmfonds heeft hier geen invloed op uitgeoefend en heeft de volle medewerking gegeven voor de toegezegde financiering voor realisering.

Vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk (SP) en Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de wetenschappelijke fraude van de heer Stapel (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

MPs asked the state secretary how the government views the Levelt Committee's recommendations on the Stapel research fraud, including a fraud confidant, five-year data retention, openness in research culture, pressure on researchers, the Independent Science declaration, and protection of affected researchers. The state secretary answered that the recommendations are directed at institutions, that the KNAW and VSNU are acting, that the code of conduct did not fail, and that trust cannot be replaced by bureaucracy.
The recommendations of the Levelt Committee are directed at the institutions concerned.
De aanbevelingen van de Commissie Levelt zijn gericht aan de betrokken instellingen.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over pre-masters (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the VU Amsterdam would stop offering premaster programmes, what this means for costs for HBO graduates, and whether premasters should stay at the statutory tuition fee. The state secretary denied that the VU is abolishing premasters, stated that premasters up to 30 ECTS will be available at statutory tuition fee (to be legislated), and that longer programmes may carry institutional tuition.
I have no information that universities plan to stop offering premasters.
Ik beschik niet over informatie dat universiteiten van plan zijn om te stoppen met het aanbieden van premasters.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het Tropenmuseum (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

MP Van der Ham (D66) asked how the government will keep supporting the Tropenmuseum now that its funding through the development cooperation budget is being removed, and how this fits with its pledge to spare heritage management from irresponsible cuts. State secretary Zijlstra answered that the museum must present a viable plan, possibly through closer cooperation or merger within the OCW museum system, and that the foreign affairs state secretary may consider a contribution under conditions.
The state secretary of Foreign Affairs will ask the Tropenmuseum to come up with a plan to offer a viable perspective within the OCW museum system after decoupling from the KIT.
De staatsecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken zal het Tropenmuseum vragen met een plan te komen om, na ontkoppeling van het KIT, een levensvatbaar perspectief in het museale bestel van OCW te bieden.
Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat het aantal deeltijdstudenten sterk gedaald is (ingezonden 25 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Education whether part-time student enrolment has fallen sharply and whether an exception to the long-term student rule should have been created for part-time students. The state secretary says the figures are only pre-enrolments, outlines several measures in the Strategic Agenda, and says he will monitor the effects of the long-term student rule including on part-time enrolment.
I will monitor the effects of the long-term student measure, including its effect on participation in part-time programmes.
Daarnaast ga ik de effecten van de langstudeerdersmaatregel monitoren, inclusief het effect hiervan op de deelname aan deeltijdopleidingen.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het aantrekken van getalenteerde Chinese studenten door Nederlandse universiteiten (ingezonden 26 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education how Dutch universities can attract talented Chinese students amid rising competition, and whether obstacles such as visa fees and the end of the Huygens scholarships will be addressed. The state secretary agreed that talented foreign students are valuable, pointed to the Strategic Agenda and a planned privately funded successor to the Huygens programme, and rejected the claim that the visa fee increase endangers accessibility.
Nuffic is examining whether private money can be used to continue awarding scholarships to students under the name Huygens Scholarship Programme in the future.
De Nuffic onderzoekt de mogelijkheid om met privaat geld ook in de toekomst onder de naam Huygens Scholarship Programme beurzen aan studenten te verstrekken.
Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de omzet en de rol van poppodia (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary about a report that pop venues had fewer visitors but higher revenue, and whether higher ticket prices hurt accessibility, quality and jobs. The secretary said he cannot judge accessibility from this information, that programming is the venues' own responsibility, and that job losses are not known because venues are mainly funded by municipalities.
Because pop venues in the Netherlands are generally subsidised by municipalities and not by the central government, these figures are not known to my ministry.
Omdat poppodia in Nederland over het algemeen gesubsidieerd worden door gemeenten en niet door de rijksoverheid, zijn deze cijfers niet bekend bij mijn ministerie.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de effecten van de nieuwe criteria van het Fonds Podiumkunsten op muziekensembles (ingezonden 9 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether the new Fonds Podiumkunsten criteria make the closure of music ensembles unavoidable and whether he agrees this is unacceptable. The secretary answers that closure is not unavoidable, that ensembles remain eligible for multi-year and project funding, and that 5.8 million euro is reserved for multi-year music activities.
There is no question that the new rules of the Fonds Podiumkunsten make the dissolution of the music ensembles unavoidable.
Er is geen sprake van dat door de nieuwe regels van het Fonds Podiumkunsten de opheffing van de muziekensembles onontkoombaar is.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de nieuwe systematiek voor subsidieverlening van het Fonds Podiumkunsten (ingezonden 9 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about the new subsidy system of the Performing Arts Fund, including expected cuts to cultural supply, the criteria, and effects on specific companies such as the Internationaal Danstheater and Orkater. The secretary answers that demand will exceed the budget, that the fund's criteria fit government policy, and that individual institutions must decide how to adapt, without predicting specific effects.
How much cultural supply will disappear depends on so many factors that it cannot be predicted.
Hoeveel cultureel aanbod er zal verdwijnen, hangt van zoveel factoren af, dat dit niet te voorspellen is.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een decaan aan de TU Delft die opdracht gaf aan het bedrijf van zijn echtgenote (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Education how to judge a TU Delft dean who repeatedly awarded university contracts to his wife's company, whether a reprimand is adequate, who should have supervised it, and whether public funds can be recovered. The state secretary replies that the matter is being examined through an external fact-finding inquiry and an Inspectorate review, and promises to answer the questions only after the Inspectorate's findings are known.
I aim to answer all questions as soon as possible and as coherently as possible only after I have gained insight into the findings of the Inspectorate of Education.
Ik streef ernaar alle vragen, zo spoedig mogelijk en zoveel mogelijk in onderlinge samenhang te beantwoorden eerst nadat ik inzicht heb verkregen in de bevindingen van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over belangenverstrengeling bij de TU Delft (ingezonden 21 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that a TU Delft dean awarded about 750,000 euros in contracts to his wife, asking about damage to science, sanctions, code of conduct tightening, sector-wide risk and disclosure of board positions. The state secretary's reply defers substantive answers until the Inspectorate of Education has validated an independent fact-finding report, while stating that the matter is being followed closely.
I aim to answer all questions as soon as possible and as far as possible in mutual coherence, only after I have gained insight into the findings of the Inspectorate of Education.
Ik streef ernaar alle vragen, zo spoedig mogelijk en zoveel mogelijk in onderlinge samenhang te beantwoorden eerst nadat ik inzicht heb verkregen in de bevindingen van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs.

Vragen van de leden Lucas (VVD), Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Jasper Van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel «Ondernemende universiteit in zwaar weer» (ingezonden 26 oktober

MPs from VVD, PvdA and SP asked the state secretary about press reports on TU Delft's spending of public funds, including litigation, administrative fines for a board chair, and a PwC audit refusal in 2007-2008, and whether ministry action was taken. The state secretary replied that he will answer all questions once the Inspectorate of Education has validated an independent fact-finding report, and that he discussed the matter with the university's board and supervisory board.
I aim to answer all questions as soon as possible and as far as possible in mutual coherence, only after I have gained insight into the findings of the Inspectorate of Education.
Ik streef ernaar alle vragen, zo spoedig mogelijk en zoveel mogelijk in onderlinge samenhang te beantwoorden eerst nadat ik inzicht heb verkregen in de bevindingen van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de verdiencapaciteit van musea (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether museums such as Meermanno and Boerhaave, which have raised private funds, can continue given earlier doubts, and whether a letter should clarify if that income is structural or one-off before the committee meeting. The secretary confirmed awareness of the report, declined to prejudge the funding decision, and refused to send a letter before the formal subsidy application and advisory process are completed.
No, I do not want to disrupt the careful procedure of subsidy application and assessment.
Nee, ik wil de zorgvuldige procedure van subsidieaanvraag en beoordeling niet doorkruisen.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de abominabele financiële omstandigheden van Chinese bursaalstudenten (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about TU Delft's 2010 rule supplementing scholarships for Chinese PhD students after reports they relied on the food bank, and whether other universities had followed and should commit to minimum stipends. The state secretary confirmed knowing the rules but had not heard of food bank signals elsewhere, said he was unaware of other universities following suit, and pointed to ongoing VSNU work on a shared framework based on the IND income norm rather than committing to a minimum.
What I can tell you is that the VSNU is currently working on developing a joint university framework for doctoral students.
Wat ik u wel kan melden is, dat door VSNU op dit moment wordt gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling van een gezamenlijk universitair kader voor promotiestudenten.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over maatregelen waardoor minder studenten een masteropleiding gaan volgen (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Education about an ISO study finding that about twenty percent of students would not pursue a master's if the master's basic grant is abolished, and about the effects on access, debt and the knowledge-nation ambition. The secretary replies that the basic grant is not simply being abolished but replaced by a social loan scheme that keeps access guaranteed, that savings will be reinvested in quality, and that the study will be considered when the bill is debated.
I propose to take the ISO study into account when the aforementioned bill is considered.
Voor het overige stel ik voor om het ISO-onderzoek te betrekken bij de behandeling van het bovengenoemde wetsvoorstel.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de toegang tot archieven in beheer van het Marechausseemuseum in Buren (ingezon

An MP asks whether a private museum may refuse researchers access to its archives on the ground of alleged commercial intent, whether the archive holder may judge that a topic is already sufficiently described, how requesters can tell if private archives contain public records, and whether the Erfgoedinspectie will mediate access for historians studying the Bende van Oss. The state secretary answers that the private foundation may decide who gets access, that the Erfgoedinspectie does not mediate, and that it is checking possible government records held by the museum, with the KMar investigating and the inspectorate to act depending on the outcome.
The Erfgoedinspectie is not there to mediate in disagreements between historians and independent museums.
De Erfgoedinspectie is er niet om te bemiddelen in onenigheid tussen historici en onafhankelijke musea.
