Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

Opposition MPs asked the education minister for measurable, verifiable targets for more and better teachers, including fte numbers, baselines, interim goals and quality criteria. The state secretary pointed to existing teacher-quality rules, a planned professionalisation agenda and funding, but gave no concrete fte targets or interim milestones.
The cabinet aims to reduce the teacher shortages, which mainly exist in secondary education, as much as possible.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar de tekorten aan docenten die vooral in het VO bestaan zoveel mogelijk te reduceren.

Vragen van het lid De Liefde (VVD) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de Monumentenwacht oneerlijk zou concurreren en belasting zou ontwijken (ingezonden 8 decem

An MP asks the ministers about reports that Monumentenwacht competes unfairly and avoids VAT by offering supplementary services, and about its inspection practices. The government answers that competition questions are for the NMa or European Commission, that the Belastingdienst is checking whether VAT should have been charged, and that it does not plan a strict separation rule for the private foundations.
Following the signals now received, the Tax Authority is examining further the extent to which Monumentenwacht performs work on which VAT is due but is not charged.

Naar aanleiding van de thans ontvangen signalen wordt door de Belastingdienst nader bezien in hoeverre Monumentenwacht werkzaamheden verricht waarover BTW is verschuldigd zonder dat deze in rekening wordt gebracht.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the cabinet how it will measure and achieve measurable quality targets for higher education linked to the social loan system, including criteria, benchmarks, milestones, instruments and accountability. The State Secretary answered that the money will be invested in higher education quality, that criteria and targets will be set out in the cabinet response to the Veerman commission and the Strategic Agenda, and that accountability runs through the regular departmental annual report.

For the answer to this question I refer you to the cabinet response to the Veerman commission report, which you will receive in February, and to the Strategic Agenda for Higher Education and Research (June 2011).

Ik verwijs u voor het antwoord op deze vraag naar de kabinetsreactie op het rapport van de commissie-Veerman die u in februari a.s. ontvangt en naar de Strategische Agenda voor het Hoger Onderwijs en Onderzoek (juni 2011).

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over bezuinigingen op de bedrijfsvoering van een faculteit van de UvA (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about the UvA economics faculty's reorganisation plans after an undisclosed budget deficit, how the state can hold executive boards and supervisory boards accountable, and whether dismissals to build reserves are acceptable. The state secretary said the plans were unknown to him, that business operations are the board's responsibility under the WHW, that he could sanction only in exceptional cases or intervene in the supervisory board if continuity is threatened, and that staff and quality matters are for the institution.
Decisions on the operational management of an institution fall under the responsibility of the executive board as laid down in the Higher Education and Research Act (WHW).

Beslissingen over de bedrijfsvoering van een instelling behoren tot de verantwoordelijkheid van het college van bestuur zoals is vastgelegd in de Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek (WHW).

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over massaontslagen bij universiteiten door bezuinigingen en gevolgen voor de kenniseconomie (ingezon

MPs Jadnanansing and Dijksma asked the state secretary about mass layoffs at universities caused by budget cuts and the effects on the knowledge economy, including research quality and the government's ambition to reach the global top. The state secretary acknowledged the measures are drastic but necessary, pointed to a quality boost and planned structural balance from 2015, and said it is too early to judge research effects while checks on quality remain in place.
It is still too early to speculate about the effects on the quality and positioning of research in relation to the loss of jobs.
Het is nog te vroeg om te speculeren over de gevolgen van de kwaliteit en positionering van het onderzoek in relatie tot het verlies aan arbeidsplaatsen.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over studenten die moeten betalen voor hun eigen tentamen (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Education whether students must pay to view their own exam papers and whether he will end such practices. The state secretary said charging for viewing is wrong and that institutions do not ask for a payment to view exams, though a cost-covering fee may be charged for a copy and exams are not returned to students.
I consider it wrong if students were to have to pay to view exams.
Ik acht het onjuist indien studenten zouden moeten betalen voor het inzien van tentamens.
Vragen van het lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over mogelijke versoepeling van de kwaliteit in het Hoger Onderwijs (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Erasmus University Rotterdam would loosen teaching standards, such as adding resits, in response to the new long-study rule, and what this would mean for quality and the investment agenda. The state secretary answered that the university is actually reducing resits to improve study efficiency, that there is no loosening of quality requirements, and that quality is checked by the NVAO and the Inspectorate, with the investment agenda to follow in June.
There is no loosening of the requirements at the EUR, but rather targeted policy to raise study efficiency.
Er is geen sprake van een versoepeling van de eisen aan de EUR, maar juist van gericht beleid om het studierendement te verhogen.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het grote aantal fraudegevallen met uitwonende studiebeurs (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about the high rate of fraud with the living-away-from-home student grant found in Amsterdam home visits, and what enforcement changes follow. The secretary acknowledged the problem, said the sample came from risk profiles so national extrapolation is premature, and outlined a bill with administrative fines and municipal address checks, while declining to make relatives liable for facilitating fraud because of evidentiary problems.
The bill provides for amending the definition of living-away and living-at-home students in the Student Finance Act 2000, designating a supervisor, and introducing an administrative fine.

Het wetsvoorstel voorziet in aanpassing van de definitie van uit- en thuiswonende studerenden in de Wet studiefinanciering 2000, aanwijzing van een toezichthouder en invoering van een bestuurlijke boete.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de maatschappelijke kosten en effecten van de wetgeving tegen langstudeerders (ingezonden 16

MPs Jadnanansing and Van Dekken asked the state secretary whether the costs and societal effects of penalising long-term students were overstated, and whether students and parents would be informed quickly and exceptions made for students with illness or disability. The state secretary rejected the view that societal costs are small, argued the measure fosters a more ambitious study culture, promised early information to students, and announced an extra study year for students with a functional limitation.
I consider it of great importance to inform students, parents and institutions in good time about the forthcoming legislative amendment.
Ik acht het van groot belang studenten, ouders en instellingen tijdig te informeren over de aanstaande wetswijziging.

Vragen van het lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het instellen van een numerus fixus bij de Technische Universiteit (TU) Delft (ingezonden 19 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether TU Delft's plan to introduce a numerus fixus for Bouwkunde and Industrieel Ontwerp fits the coalition promise to abolish it for medicine, and whether selection at the gate could replace it. The state secretary replied that the plan is lawful under current law, that he favours selection over lottery and will propose the Ruim baan voor talent bill again plus wider selection options in the Strategic Agenda, but sees no need to talk with TU Delft.
As a first step, the bill Ruim baan voor talent will soon be re-introduced into the legislative procedure.
Als eerste stap zal binnenkort het wetsvoorstel «Ruim baan voor talent» opnieuw in procedure worden gebracht.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel «Bezuinigingen cultuur raken vooral kinderen» (ingezonden 1 november 2010 2010).

An MP asked the minister about press reports that cultural budget cuts would threaten small theatres, music schools and libraries, and about the effects on libraries. The state secretary answered that municipal budgets are the source of the cuts, that library funding is a municipal responsibility, and that a survey found 93% of public libraries face cuts, with a broader cultural policy letter promised for December.
The announced municipal cuts to local library work are the result of municipal policy.
De aangekondigde gemeentelijke bezuinigingen op het lokale bibliotheekwerk zijn het resultaat van gemeentelijk beleid.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de bibliotheca philosofica hermetica (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the Bibliotheca Philosophica Hermetica, a collection whose state-owned part is inaccessible due to seizure amid a dispute with a bank, and about whether a former minister had promised to take over the collection. The state secretary said the state part must remain accessible and is being pursued, and denied that the former minister made any such promise.
Former minister Van der Hoeven made no promise regarding taking over the book collection.
Voormalig minister Van der Hoeven heeft geen belofte gedaan inzake het overnemen van de boekenverzameling.
Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de anti-PVV cursus aan de Erasmus Universiteit (ingezonden 26 oktober 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about a Erasmus University workshop on framing that he described as an anti-PVV course paid for by taxpayers, and whether the funding should be cut. The state secretary answered that the workshop was not against the PVV, was open to all, was organised by Studium Generale with an outside partner, and that no reduction in funding was warranted.
Enquiries have shown that the Erasmus University did not organise a meeting against the PVV.
Navraag heeft opgeleverd dat de Erasmus Universiteit geen bijeenkomst tegen de PVV heeft georganiseerd.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Salaris Dales gewoon doorbetaald» (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether the salary of the former InHolland board chair Dales would be paid until the end of his contract, and whether such severance constructions are acceptable and occur elsewhere. The state secretary said the contract ended on 1 January 2011 with a one-year severance payment, called such arrangements undesirable, and announced recovery of the excess cost from InHolland's supervisory board.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over de ruime vertrekregeling van de bestuursvoorzitter van InHolland (ingezonden 18 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the education minister to assess the generous severance package of the chair of the Hogeschool InHolland board, whether it fits the promised modest arrangement, and whether recovery should be considered as in an earlier Friesland College case. The state secretary said the package exceeds the 130% ministerial-salary norm and the court-clerk formula, that the difference will be recovered from the supervisory board, and that the inspectorate's fraud investigation must finish before judging the broader question.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over problemen bij hogeschool INHolland (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked why the outgoing board chair of InHolland, a public university of applied sciences, would keep receiving salary until the end of 2010 and receive a severance payment, and whether that is a sober dismissal settlement. The state secretary answered that the contract was ended by mutual agreement with salary paid until 1 January 2011 and a severance afterwards, that the cost exceeds what the kantonrechter formula would give, and that he will reclaim the difference via a letter to the supervisory board.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over aanwijzingen dat er toch druk op de staf van InHolland is gelegd inzake sjoemelen met diploma’s (ingezonden 2 novembe

An MP asks the state secretary for Education whether reports that InHolland teachers were pressured to award diplomas too easily, based on material held by a newspaper, are true, and whether the Inspectorate will re-examine the Leers committee's interviews. The state secretary replies that the Leers committee found no proven improper pressure, that the Inspectorate's ongoing investigation will explicitly address pressure on staff and speak with the MEM teachers, and that no grounds exist to doubt the committee's thoroughness.
In the discussions the Inspectorate is conducting with InHolland, including with the Executive Board, 'pressure on staff' is explicitly addressed.
In de gesprekken die de Inspectie hierover voert met InHolland, inclusief die met het CvB, komt «druk op personeel» expliciet aan de orde.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel in de Volkskrant van zaterdag 10 juli 2010 over diplomafraude op hogeschool InHolland (ingezonden 13 juli 20

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education about reports that InHolland issued diplomas to about 250 students who had not met the exam standard via a 'Theo-route' pilot, and whether this amounted to fraud, and demanded investigation, sanctions and revocation of diplomas. The Secretary said the Leers commission saw a laisser-faire climate rather than fraud, that the actual number was 147 students, that the Inspectorate is conducting follow-up research and will recover funding if diplomas were unlawfully issued, but that revoking diplomas is the institution's responsibility.
The inspectorate is currently conducting a follow-up investigation at InHolland.
Momenteel voert de inspectie een vervolgonderzoek uit bij InHolland.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over pilot met diploma’s bij InHolland (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about InHolland's alternative graduation pilot that awarded diplomas to about 250 students, including its quality and the Inspectorate's role. The state secretary called the situation worrying, found that 104 diplomas were issued without adequate safeguards and that the Higher Education Act was not complied with, and announced further Inspectorate investigations and possible measures.
Unacceptable risks have arisen for the value of diplomas.
Er zijn onacceptabele risico's ontstaan voor de waarde van diploma's.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over studenten van InHolland die via een truc een diploma kregen (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary about InHolland students who obtained diplomas through an alternative graduation track, including accepted substandard theses, pressure on staff, and whether the funding system creates perverse incentives. The state secretary condemns diploma fraud, cites the Leers commission and inspectorate findings, says no financial motive was found, and announces a reduced diploma component in funding from 2011 plus an inspectorate review of other institutions.
At 41 institutions the inspectorate is requesting additional information and will verify the information already available.
Bij 41 instellingen wordt door de inspectie aanvullende informatie opgevraagd en de reeds beschikbare informatie zal geverifieerd worden.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het ongeoorloofd verstrekken van diploma’s media-opleiding door hogeschool InHolland te Haarlem (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister about reports that InHolland Haarlem awarded about 250 media-management students diplomas through an irregular alternative graduation track, and how it responds to incentives tied to graduation bonuses. The state secretary condemns the practice, says the inspectorate is investigating alternative tracks across higher education, and outlines tighter accreditation and examination-committee rules and the new funding model.
If it is established that diplomas were wrongly issued, I will reclaim the funding attached to them from the institution concerned.
Als vast komt te staan dat er onterecht diploma's zijn verstrekt, dan zal ik de daaraan verbonden bekostiging terugvorderen van de instelling die het betreft.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over mogelijke trucs bij diplomaverstrekking op de Hanzehogeschool (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether alternative graduation routes for long-term students at the Hanzehogeschool (oral exams, extra-curricular competences) are of sufficient quality, and whether the inspectorate was involved. The state secretary said there is cause for concern, the inspectorate has started a sector-wide investigation with interim findings on risks, and a definitive quality judgment must await the April 2011 final report.
The inspectorate started an investigation in July into alternative graduation routes across all institutions in higher education.
De inspectie is in juli jl. een onderzoek gestart naar alternatieve afstudeertrajecten onder alle instellingen in het hoger onderwijs.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de kwaliteit van de diploma’s in het hoger onderwijs (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister how she responds to an EenVandaag broadcast alleging diploma fraud and pressure on teachers at Dutch universities of applied sciences, and whether the inspectorate will check that standards are in place before the coming academic year. The state secretary says the inspectorate will investigate, that the Leers committee found pressure on teachers not proven though possibly experienced, and that the inspectorate will report on InHolland's improvement plan by mid-January.
The inspectorate will therefore get to the bottom of these matters.
De inspectie zal deze zaken dan ook tot op de bodem uitzoeken.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een HBO-docent die studenten zonder de vereiste kwaliteiten een diploma geeft (ingezonden 8 september 2010).

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the state secretary about a HBO lecturer who awarded diplomas to students lacking the required competences, and how such students could reach final stages and whether funding incentives and national exams would help. The state secretary regretted the case, said diplomas are governed by exam committees and accreditation rules, defended the funding model, and committed to an Inspectorate investigation of InHolland with a progress report by mid-January.

The Inspectorate will therefore give the most important parts of the improvement plan the highest attention and report to me on their progress, as far as assessable at that time, by mid-January at the latest.

De inspectie zal daarom de belangrijkste onderdelen van het verbeterplan de grootst mogelijk aandacht geven en mij over de voortgang daarvan voorzover op dat moment te beoordelen uiterlijk half januari rapporteren.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over problemen bij hogeschool INHolland (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about INHolland's outgoing board chair receiving a year's salary after resigning, board pay, the pending top-income bill, diploma fraud, staff fear of speaking out, and whether the supervisory board or government could intervene. The state secretary mostly deferred to an ongoing inspection and the supervisory board, promised a letter before the debate, and said the government should have powers to intervene if governability is in doubt, with proposals in April.
I have committed to return to this in a separate letter to the House and to set out what options I see on that point.
Ik heb toegezegd daar in een aparte brief aan de Kamer op terug te komen en te laten weten welke mogelijkheden ik op dat punt zie.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de oproep van negen wethouders van de grote steden inzake de voorgenomen bezuinigingen op kunst en cultuur (ingezonde

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science to respond to a letter from nine big-city aldermen calling the planned culture cuts disproportionate, asking whether the cuts should be staggered, and whether they should be preceded by further research. The state secretary replied that the regeerakkoord framework is leading, that he is still deliberating on how to implement the culture paragraph, and that he will inform the House in a letter on 13 December.
Before the culture budget debate on 13 December I will inform you in an outline letter about how I intend to implement the culture component of the coalition agreement.
Ik informeer u voor de cultuurbegroting op 13 december in een brief op hoofdlijnen over de wijze waarop ik uitvoering wil geven aan het onderdeel cultuur van het regeerakkoord.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het mogelijk uitstellen van de bouw van het nationaal historisch museum (ingezonden 18 oktober 2010).

MP Klijnsma asked whether the National Historical Museum's building project is delayed by budget cuts, whether its director's fear of too little money for activities is justified, and whether a temporary location could help. The state secretary confirmed that culture must contribute to cuts, stopped the building subsidy in favour of a 2011 project subsidy for activities, and declined to commit to a temporary location.
I have decided no longer to subsidise the NHM for realising a building, as I informed you by letter.
Ik heb besloten het NHM niet langer te subsidiëren voor het realiseren van een gebouw, zoals ik u per brief heb laten weten.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het topsalaris van de collegevoorzitter van de TU-Delft iIngezonden 2 september 2010).

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science why the TU Delft board chair earns about 200,000 euro, above the Balkenende norm agreed with the supervisory board, and whether salary-freeze and bonus rules are being respected. The state secretary said the salary, including a bonus, exceeded the norm, reduced the 2009 state grant by 19,000 euro, and will notify the supervisory board, while leaving wage-setting for staff to social partners and promising to send a sector-wide overview of top salaries in December.
Pursuant to Article 2.9, fourth paragraph, of the WHW, I have therefore decided to reduce the 2009 state contribution to TU Delft by 19,000 euro.
Gelet op artikel 2.9, vierde lid, van de WHW heb ik daarom besloten de rijksbijdrage 2009 voor de TU Delft te verminderen met € 19 000

m: Tweede nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 17 over het waarborgen van zeggenschap bij interne collectieve waardeoverdracht
Amendment giving pension fund members an individual objection right or an approval right over internal collective value transfers, with notice, procedure and safeguard requirements.
that it is also desirable to give an individual objection right or an approval right for internal collective value transfer
dat het tevens gewenst is om een individueel bezwaarrecht dan wel een goedkeuringsrecht te geven bij interne collectieve waardeoverdracht
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het invoeren van een goedkeuringsrecht bij interne waardeoverdracht van pensioenen
Amends the pension bill so that internal collective value transfers require prior approval by members, with information duties and a 30% response threshold, and a supervisor notification.
No later than four weeks before the intended date of the internal collective value transfer, approval must be obtained and electronically reported to the supervisor

Uiterlijk vier weken voor de beoogde datum van de interne collectieve waardeoverdracht moet goedkeuring als bedoeld in lid 1a, onderdeel c, zijn verkregen en elektronisch zijn gemeld aan de toezichthouder.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het invoeren van een goedkeuringsrecht bij interne waardeoverdracht van pensioenen

Amends the pension act so that internal collective value transfers require prior member approval (majority of respondents, at least 30% response) and individual objection rights, with a supervisor notification duty.
At least four weeks before the intended date of the internal collective value transfer, approval must be obtained and electronically reported to the supervisor.

Uiterlijk vier weken voor de beoogde datum van de interne collectieve waardeoverdracht moet goedkeuring als bedoeld in lid 1a, onderdeel c, zijn verkregen en elektronisch zijn gemeld aan de toezichthouder.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over het invoeren van een goedkeuringsrecht bij interne waardeoverdracht van pensioenen

Amendment requires prior member approval (or an individual objection option) for internal collective transfers of pension capital, with information duties and a 30% response threshold, and a transitional rule.
Without this approval the internal collective value transfer cannot take place.
Zonder deze goedkeuring kan de interne collectieve waardeoverdracht niet plaatsvinden.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Patijn en Omtzigt ter vervanging van nr. 52 over handhaving mogelijk maken voor de bepalingen inzake gelijke behandeling van ter beschikking gestelde arbeidskrachten
Lets the labour inspectorate (NLA) enforce and fine breaches of equal-treatment rules for temporary agency workers, starting 1 January 2026.
However, the NLA does not have the power to itself enforce and fine when it finds violations of these articles.
De NLA heeft echter niet de bevoegdheid om zelf te handhaven en beboeten wanneer zij overtredingen van deze wetsartikelen constateert.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Patijn en Omtzigt ter vervanging van nr. 50 over de mogelijkheid van een verbod op terbeschikkingstelling van arbeidskrachten expliciteren

Amends the Waadi to make explicit that the minister may ban temporary agency work for sectors or labour-market segments by general administrative order, with a justification required in any such decision.
This amendment creates a power for the Minister to restrict temporary agency work.
Dit amendement creëert een bevoegdheid voor de Minister om tba in te perken

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over het voor de Europese blauwe kaart vereisen van een minimumsalaris van 1,3 keer het gemiddelde bruto jaarinkomen in Nederlan
Sets a statutory minimum salary of 1.3 times average gross income as a condition for EU Blue Card residence permits, narrowing executive discretion over admission.
shall be refused if the foreign national will work for a salary lower than a salary of at least 1.3 times average gross income, to be set by general administrative order
wordt afgewezen indien de vreemdeling arbeid zal gaan verrichten voor een lager salaris dan een bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur te bepalen salaris van ten minste 1,3 maal

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het beperken van de uitgifte van de Europese blauwe kaart tot bij of krachtens amvb aan te wijzen functies waarvoor een aant

Limits Blue Card residence permits to occupations designated by AMvB in shortage sectors, excludes agency work, and requires the draft AMvB to be laid before parliament with a four-week window for a request to regulate by law.
The draft general administrative order to be adopted under the first paragraph shall be submitted to both Houses of the States General.

I cannot make statements about confidential conversations.
Ik kan geen mededelingen doen over vertrouwelijke gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Omtzigt, Mooiman en Wilders over het bericht ‘Maximale huurverhoging vanaf 1 januari 2025: 4,1% voor vrije sector en 7,7% voor middenhuur’

MPs asked the Minister of Housing whether the 7.7% maximum rent increase for mid-segment rentals in 2025 is acceptable for households, and whether additional measures, a transitional arrangement, or a structural change to the mid-rent increase system are planned. The minister answered that the increase follows from the Wet betaalbare huur tied to collective wage growth, that the actual increase will often be lower, and that no legislative change is planned before the 2027 evaluation, while declining to calculate household income effects.
I therefore cannot make a calculation of the effects on the purchasing power figures.
Ik kan dan ook geen doorrekening maken van de effecten in de koopkrachtplaatjes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Omtzigt over de situatie van Aramese christenen in Maaloula (Syrië)

Two MPs asked the government about reports of threats, forced expulsion and property seizures against Aramean Christians in Maaloula, Syria, by HTS-linked groups, and about Dutch efforts to protect minorities and HTS's status. The minister says the government has no information confirming sectarian incidents against Aramean Christians there, lists existing accountability and diplomatic efforts, and reviews HTS's terrorist listing and citizenship revocation rules without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet has no information confirming that sectarian incidents against Aramean Christians in Maaloula have taken place since the fall of the Assad regime.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die de berichten bevestigt dat er sinds de val van het Assad-regime sektarische incidenten hebben plaatsgevonden tegen Aramese christenen in Maaloula.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Idsinga over de ramingen van het Centraal planbureau en de grote ramingsfouten die daarin zijn gemaakt de afgelopen jaren

MPs Omtzigt and Idsinga asked the Finance Minister about large forecasting errors in government and CPB deficit and tax-revenue projections, and about whether the new expert group on forecasting would receive their initiative note and report by March 2025. The Minister answered that the note will be forwarded, the expert group's findings await, and forecast errors are attributed to volatile conditions, while declining to commit to legal anchoring of forecast accuracy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Vroonhoven over de inkomstenramingen bij de Najaarsnota.

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Van Vroonhoven) asked the Finance Ministry to reconstruct how revenue forecasts in the Najaarsnota 2024 were made, why revenue forecasts have consistently underestimated outturns, and whether an internal evaluation exists. Minister Heinen answered that forecasts follow a model recalibrated with cash data, attributes past underestimates to economic volatility, tax-specific factors and corporate tax timing, and says an expert group on forecasting is still analysing the gaps.
The expert group on forecasts is currently analysing the forecast differences on both the revenue and expenditure side of the budget.
Momenteel werkt de expertgroep ramingen aan een analyse van de ramingsverschillen aan zowel inkomsten- en uitgavenkant van de begroting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over "staatscommissie demografie"

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about the government's position on the State Commission's demography report, including which scenario policy follows and whether the programmatic governance approach and a four-yearly demography report will be adopted. The minister answers that the cabinet endorses steering toward moderate population growth, plans an annual monitor and knowledge infrastructure, and will report on the governance exploration in spring 2025, but declines to answer the questions in time for the debate.

Following the caretaker cabinet's commitment in its letter of 24 May 2024, in November 2024 an assignment was given to ABDTOPConsult for an exploration of how to achieve a cross-domain, multi-year programmatic approach within the central government.
Naar aanleiding van de toezegging van het demissionaire kabinet in de Kamerbrief van 24 mei 2024 is in november 2024 een opdracht verstrekt aan ABDTOPConsult voor een verkenning
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman, Omtzigt, Ceder over de opmars van de HTS in Syrië

MPs Kahraman, Omtzigt and Ceder asked the ministers about HTS's rise in Syria, including foreign support, its terrorist listing, contacts, minority rights, sanctions, humanitarian aid and paths to peace. The minister answered that the government lacks information on who backs HTS, HTS is treated as terrorist via the UN/EU listing, no contacts exist, and many questions are deferred to the upcoming debate or ongoing EU reviews.
The cabinet does not have independent information with which these reports can be confirmed or denied.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie waarmee deze berichten bevestigd of ontkend kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Omtzigt over de lobby van grote familiebedrijven om de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling (BOR) te verruimen

MPs Idsinga and Omtzigt asked why the requested lobby letters from large family firms seeking to widen the business succession scheme (BOR) had not yet been sent to Parliament, and asked for their timely delivery along with all related correspondence. The State Secretary answered that the request could not be met in the short term, supplied a search of correspondence from the Finance, Economic Affairs and General Affairs ministries as an annex, and said the letters would be attached to the tax bill Wet aanpassing fiscale bedrijfsopvolgingsfaciliteiten 2025.
A copy of the lobby letters has been included as an annex to that bill.
Een afschrift van de lobbybrieven is opgenomen als bijlage bij dat wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Van Vroonhoven en Omtzigt over een plan om het verhuren van een kamer aan studenten veel gemakkelijker te maken

MPs Welzijn, Van Vroonhoven and Omtzigt asked the government about making it easier to rent rooms to students through hospita arrangements, covering housing shortages, mortgage and bank consent, the WWSO rent rules, the kostendelersnorm, huurtoeslag and the income-dependent rent increase. The minister answered that the rent-rule and hospita exception is already in place, that a bill to end hospita contracts on sale is being prepared, that banks' consent is being pursued, and that several questions (MKBA, huurtoeslag, exemption thresholds) are under study or not feasible now.
At present I am preparing a legislative amendment that should allow the rental contract to be terminated upon sale, only in the case of hospita rental.
Op dit moment bereid ik een wetswijziging voor die er toe moet leiden dat het huurcontract – alleen in het geval van hospitaverhuur – bij verkoop kan worden beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Omtzigt en Palmen over het artikel ‘Landsadvocaat krijgt waarschuwing voor rol in fraudezaak’

MPs Omtzigt and Palmen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a disciplinary warning given to the state's chief lawyer (landsadvocaat) from Pels Rijcken over handling privileged emails in the fraud case, and about integrity safeguards in the state's contract with the firm. The Minister answered that the warning was the lightest sanction, that he did not believe the lawyer acted contrary to his duties, that the emails should have been removed promptly, and that the issue would be raised in administrative consultations with the firm.
I regret that these emails were not removed from the file directly when it became clear that they concerned information covered by legal privilege.
Ik vind het te betreuren dat deze e-mails niet direct uit het dossier zijn verwijderd toen duidelijk werd dat het verschoningsgerechtigde informatie betrof.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris, Omtzigt en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Crisis bij UWV: tienduizenden uitkeringen na jaren aangepast wegens fouten' en brief van minister SZW d.d. 4 september 2024 naar aanleidin

MPs Saris, Omtzigt and Inge van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV errors in WIA benefit calculations, whether benefits decided long ago can be adjusted against recipients, the legal basis and protection, known problems, audit reports, and the timing and scope of the government's knowledge and remedies. The minister answered at length: errors are being identified, UWV expects a complete picture by December, recovery depends on individual case review with attention to the human scale, and the government plans WIA reforms and an independent inquiry.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Omtzigt over de problemen met de WIA-keuringen en de vaststelling van de hoogte van de uitkeringen, die niet terug te vinden zijn in de vele verslagen, Kamerbrieven en andere zake

MPs Saris and Omtzigt asked about discrepancies in UWV's error and uncertainty figures for WIA benefits and why problems in WIA assessments and benefit calculations were absent from UWV reports and the Minister's letters. The Minister defended the provisional figures, acknowledged UWV failed to report internal findings, and said a legislative proposal on benefit recovery and the 'reasonably clear' criterion is being considered.
UWV has so far not reported on the inaccuracies found in internal samples in calculating and determining WIA benefits.
UWV heeft tot dusverre niet gerapporteerd over de bij interne steekproeven geconstateerde onjuistheden bij het berekenen en vaststellen van de WIA-uitkeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Vroonhoven over de Belastingdruk op middenhuurwoningen

MPs Omtzigt and Van Vroonhoven asked the government to calculate the costs and returns of a private landlord's rental home in box 3 for 2016 to 2025, including the effects of tax and rent regulation measures, and whether mid-rent housing is in shortage and how box 3 burdens could be eased. The government answered that the example is illustrative only, showed the 2023 and 2024 figures, explained the box 3 tax rate rise to 36%, the updated leegwaarderatio and the Wet betaalbare huur, and said the Supreme Court's June 2024 rulings will lead to a counter-evidence scheme for actual returns.
No figures are kept on the number of homes rented out in box 3.
Er worden geen cijfers bijgehouden van het aantal woningen dat in box 3 wordt verhuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boomsma en Omtzigt over het innen van een eigen bijdrage van werkende Oekraïense ontheemden die opgevangen worden door gemeentes

MPs Boomsma and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about municipalities charging a contribution from working Ukrainian displaced persons in municipal shelter, the feasibility of this for municipalities, Suwinet data access, and related costs. The minister confirmed that municipalities must collect the contribution from all displaced persons with income after six months, noted that Suwinet access for income verification is still being examined, and gave cost and contribution figures.

However, the implementation assessment by UWV and consultation with the VNG concluded that the ground in the Temporary Act does not make all data available to municipalities that are needed to fully verify net income.

Uit de uitvoeringstoets van het UWV en in afstemming met de VNG is evenwel geconcludeerd dat met de grond in de Tijdelijke Wet niet alle gegevens beschikbaar komen voor gemeenten die gewenst zijn om het netto inkomen volledig te kunnen verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Vroonhoven over het Rechtsstaatrapport van de Europese Commissie, uitgekomen op 24 juli 2024

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the government will respond to the European Commission's Rule of Law Report concerns on journalism: the Press Council's capacity, media ownership transparency and pluralism, public broadcaster governance and EMFA compliance, state advertising, journalist safety and anti-SLAPP. The minister answered that the Press Council is independent and self-regulating and will not be subsidised, that the government will discuss issues with it and reform public broadcasting, and that EMFA compliance and the anti-SLAPP bill are being prepared.
The Press Council is an independent, self-regulating body entirely supported by the sector.
De Raad voor de Journalistiek is een onafhankelijk, zelfregulerend orgaan dat geheel gedragen wordt door de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Kahraman over Nord Stream 2

MPs Kahraman and Omtzigt asked the government about the Nord Stream sabotage, prior consultations with Ukraine and Russia, MIVD warnings, Gasunie write-offs, and internal memos. The ministers answered that they await the German investigation, that no Dutch-Ukrainian consultations on Nord Stream are known for 2020-2021, that no specific government-level Nord Stream talks with Russia took place, and declined to comment on intelligence matters while promising an inventory of documents by end of September 2024.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on the knowledge level, working methods or sources of our services.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van onze diensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Omtzigt over uitingen van de AFM over verkeerde pensioenverwachtingen als gevolg van een ‘rentedip’ in de modelberekeningen

MPs Joseph and Omtzigt asked the minister about the AFM warning that a 'rate dip' in the scenario sets can misstate pension expectations for people about to retire, by up to about 8%. The minister acknowledged the concern, said DNB is studying adjustments to the scenario sets, and that pension funds bear responsibility for communicating with context.
DNB has indicated that it is researching possible adjustments to limit the impact of the interest rate jumps.
DNB heeft aangegeven onderzoek te doen naar mogelijke aanpassingen om de impact van de rentesprongen te beperken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Kahraman over de implementatie van de sanctiepakketten tegen Rusland

MPs Omtzigt and Kahraman asked the ministers about the implementation of the EU sanctions packages against Russia, including whether the Coast Guard enforces them, and whether any sanctions go unenforced or incompletely implemented. The minister answered at length that all sanctions are nationally implemented via the Sanctieregeling, that the government aims for strict compliance, that the Coast Guard was agreed to prioritise packages 1 to 10 given limited capacity with alternatives found for later packages, and that implementation is a national matter with no formal notice from the Commission.
The cabinet's starting point is strict compliance with all sanctions, and the cabinet therefore does not share the view that there are measures that are not enforced.
Uitgangspunt van het kabinet is het strikt naleven van alle sancties, en het kabinet deelt dus ook niet het beeld dat er maatregelen zijn die niet gehandhaafd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Wilders over het feit dat de MIVD de wettelijk verplichte notificatieplicht bij afluisteren, aftappen en andere bijzondere bevoegdheden niet nakomt

MPs Omtzigt and Wilders asked why the MIVD has not fulfilled its statutory duty to notify people subjected to special powers, and about the status of its notification backlog since the CTIVD's 2017 report. The minister acknowledged a backlog from 2019 to November 2023, said measures are underway with full repair targeted by 1 April 2025, but declined to give figures on targets, politicians, lawyers or journalists and did not disclose compliance incidents to Parliament.
The aim is for the MIVD to have fully cleared the backlog by 1 April 2025.
Het streven is dat de MIVD de achterstand voor 1 april 2025 volledig heeft hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de benoeming tot Secretaris-Generaal van de NAVO

An MP asked the Prime Minister why he had denied in 2022 being a candidate for NATO Secretary-General, when he later confirmed availability in October 2023, and when he began discussing the post. The Prime Minister confirmed the 2021 trip, said he had earlier declined such approaches, and that he became available via diplomatic contact in September 2023 and publicly confirmed it in October 2023.
The answer to the questions in April 2022 was: "I am not leaving and am therefore not a candidate for the post of SG of NATO."
Het antwoord op de vragen in april 2022 luidde: «Ik ga niet weg en ben dus geen kandidaat voor de functie van SG van de NAVO.»

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Olger van Dijk, Tuinman, De Roon en Stoffer over meldingen in het veiligheidssysteem ECCAIRS over het luchtruim boven Oekraïne voor 17 juli 2014, de datum waarop vlucht MH17/KL410

MPs asked the minister for details of three Eccairs safety reports on Ukrainian airspace filed in 2014 before MH17 was shot down, and for the reports to be shared with parliament. The minister declined, citing a pending Council of State case and EU Regulation 376/2014 confidentiality rules, and promised to inform parliament after the ruling expected in Q3 2024.
Because this procedure is still ongoing, no further information can be provided.
Omdat deze procedure nog loopt, kan verder geen informatie worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Palmen  over antisemitisme

MPs Omtzigt and Palmen asked the Justice Minister for a list of all antisemitic incidents over four weeks, the concrete actions taken and the number of people fined, arrested or prosecuted, and for answers within a week. The minister gave partial counts from anti-discrimination bodies and the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, said a full case-level overview would be disproportionate to produce now, and referred the request for incident overviews to CIDI.
The full overview requested, with the manner of follow-up, requires case-level research.
Het door u gevraagde volledige overzicht met de wijze van opvolging vergt onderzoek op zaaksniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans, Wilders, Omtzigt en Van der Plas over het bericht 'Ingrijpend miljardenpakket voor opkoop boeren moet koude sanering veestapel voorkomen'

MPs Hermans, Wilders, Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the agriculture minister about press reports of a multi-billion buyout package to prevent a cold clearance of livestock, and whether the government would refrain from announcing buyout schemes during the formation period. The minister says a broad action plan responding to the Van Campen motion is being prepared, that a buyout scheme is only one component, that the European Commission has ruled out a new derogation, and asks the Chamber to debate the plan urgently.
This cabinet considers the situation very urgent and intends to send an action plan to the House at short notice after final decision-making.
Dit kabinet vindt de situatie zeer urgent en is voornemens om, na definitieve besluitvorming, op korte termijn een plan van aanpak aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de invloed van Russisch geld op de Nederlandse politiek

MP Omtzigt asked whether the government requested declassification of Czech intelligence on Russian financing of Dutch politicians, how the information could be made public, whether prosecution is possible, and for an overview of signals of Russian financing of Dutch politicians or parties. The minister answered that the Czech government decides on publication, that the AIVD cannot disclose specific cases for national security and prosecution reasons, that prosecution can follow an AIVD report to the OM, that since 2023 foreign donations to parties are banned and no direct Russian gifts appear in party disclosures, and that the AIVD cannot give an overview of its signals.
Regarding the intelligence domain, I cannot give you an overview of signals and evidence within that domain.
Waar het gaat over het inlichtingendomein, kan ik u geen overzicht geven van signalen en bewijzen die zich binnen dat domein bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga, Palmen-Schlangen en Omtzigt over een advies van de landsadvocaat

MPs Idsinga, Palmen-Schlangen and Omtzigt asked why the landsadvocaat's advice on the childcare benefits affair was released late, what changed between two versions of the letter, and how the 'Heidi' logging system worked, when it breached GDPR and how it linked to the Fraud Signalling Facility. The State Secretaries answered that the version was not final, explained Heidi's purpose and its suspension in 2017 and December 2023, and promised a further letter within three weeks on wider Tax Authority use of Heidi.
Your House will be informed within 3 weeks at the latest about how other parts of the Tax and Customs Administration used Heidi, for what purposes and which data were processed.
Uw Kamer wordt uiterlijk over 3 weken geïnformeerd over hoe andere onderdelen van de Belastingdienst gebruik hebben gemaakt van Heidi, voor welke doeleinde en welke gegevens hierbij verwerkt werden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt over “de chatberichten van bewindspersonen en topambtenaren die niet zijn opgenomen in de hotspot archief”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Finance why chat messages of ministers and senior officials were not included in the COVID-19 hotspot archive, and whether they are preserved and available for the parliamentary inquiry. The minister answered that chats are now secured for current ministers and senior officials, that some former officials' messages were not secured and contact is being sought, and that selection and archiving will follow once national archiving guidelines are ready, with delays acknowledged.
The aim was to answer within the usual three-week period, but interdepartmental coordination meant it took longer.
Het streven is geweest te antwoorden binnen de gebruikelijke termijn van 3 weken, wegens interdepartementale afstemming heeft dit langer geduurd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Vroonhoven en Dassen over minister Van Nieuwenhuizen die zich met energiebedrijven en honderden miljoenen subsidies bemoeide, nadat ze wist dat ze voorzitter van Energie Neder

MPs Omtzigt, Van Vroonhoven and Dassen asked the Prime Minister how former minister Van Nieuwenhuizen could take part in decisions on subsidies and compensation for energy companies after she knew she would head Energie Nederland, and why the related FOIA request and ministerial information took so long. The government answered that no integrity issue arose, that she left the post after a political weighing, that the FOIA delay was regretted but not politically motivated, and that the requested cabinet and committee documents would not be published.

It is not appropriate to make public documents that were on the agenda of a ministerial committee or the Council of Ministers, because publication could jeopardise the proper functioning of the Council of Ministers.

Het ligt niet in de rede om stukken die geagendeerd zijn geweest in een ministeriële commissie of in de ministerraad openbaar te maken, omdat door openbaarmaking het goed functioneren van de ministerraad in het gedrang kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Omtzigt over "de invaaradviezen"

MPs Joseph and Omtzigt asked the minister why legal advice on pension-transition (invaren) would only be available confidentially, whether counsel and the public could see it, and asked for the advice and internal correspondence to be published. The minister refused to publish the advice because it concerns the state's litigation position, offered confidential inspection to MPs, declined to release counsel correspondence, and agreed only to inventory internal correspondence on invaren advice from 2020 with an update expected by end of March.
Advice concerning the state's litigation position is not suitable for publication.
Adviezen die betrekking hebben op de procespositie lenen zich niet voor openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aanstelling van de regeringscommissaris voor de pensioentransitie

An MP asks the minister to explain the role, mandate, recruitment and independence of the government commissioner for the pensions transition, including concerns about board positions and past advisory roles. The minister answers that the commissioner advises on process only, describes the appointment safeguards and declared side roles, and dismisses concerns about parameter sets and IT risks.
Given the confidentiality of the procedure, it is not appropriate to provide detailed information.
Het is gelet op de vertrouwelijkheid van de procedure niet opportuun om gedetailleerde informatie te verstrekken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Hoop, Hagen, Peters, Richardson, Drost, Beertema, Pouw-Verweij, Bisschop, Van Baarle, Sylvana Simons, Omtzigt en Wassenberg over de examenuitslag voor vso-scholieren

MPs asked the minister whether vso (special secondary education) pupils could receive their exam results on the same day as mainstream pupils, and whether an earlier-announcement arrangement from 2024 was progressing. The minister agreed this would be desirable, explained that a structural fix requires rescheduling the state exams and will not be ready until late 2024, and said an interim measure is unlikely to be feasible in 2025.

I will inform your House about these possibilities and the extent to which the group of candidates for whom it becomes possible increases compared with a possible interim solution in 2024, so that your House can weigh the desirability of the interim solution in 2025.

Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over deze mogelijkheden en in welke mate het de groep kandidaten voor wie het mogelijk wordt gemaakt ten opzichte van een eventuele tussenoplossing in 2024 wordt vergroot zodat uw Kamer de wenselijkheid van de tussenoplossing in 2025 kan wegen.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de voortgang van de onderhandelingen over de Europese Natuurherstelverordening en het voornemen van de regering om daarmee in te stemmen

MP Omtzigt asked about the progress of EU Nature Restoration Regulation negotiations, how the government's concerns were addressed, risks to housing, infrastructure and energy, the feasibility of targets, and whether an impact assessment should precede a Dutch vote. The minister replies that the provisional agreement softened the non-deterioration obligation and other priorities, that feasibility assessments are still in progress, and that the Netherlands will inform parliament before adoption.
I will inform the House of Representatives when the Presidency schedules the Nature Restoration Regulation for adoption in a Council.
Wel zal ik de Tweede Kamer informeren wanneer het Voorzitterschap de Natuurherstelverordening voor adoptie agendeert in een Raad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht 'Roemeense NGO licht DUO op. Betaald voor niet-bestaand werk.'

Member Omtzigt asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that a Romanian NGO, the Global Confederation of Romanian Students, helped students claim Dutch study finance for non-existent work, asking when DUO knew of it, what was done, how many students benefited, and whether such abuse is common. The minister answered that DUO received first signals in 2018 and passed them to the labour inspectorate and tax authority, that about 260 people received study finance linked to the NGO, that DUO lacks authority to investigate the organisation itself, and that the ministry will examine further measures.
DUO is therefore not authorised to independently investigate the activities of a particular organisation.
DUO is dus niet bevoegd zelfstandig onderzoek in te stellen naar de werkzaamheden van een bepaalde organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een aanvullende randvoorwaarde over het invaren van pensioenen in het coronaherstelfonds

Omtzigt asks the Finance and Pensions ministers about an added condition in the Dutch recovery plan requiring that 66% of participants' pensions be transferred (invaren) to the new pension system by 2026, and why this was not communicated to parliament earlier. Minister Schouten answers that the condition is an operationalisation of existing recovery-plan commitments needed because the pension transition was extended to 2028, that the decision on invaren remains with social partners and fund boards, and that a list of legal advice on invaren will be shared in November.
On 4 July there was not yet an agreed proposal that could be shared with the Chamber.
Op 4 juli lag er nog geen afgesproken voorstel dat gedeeld kon worden met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Inge van Dijk, Temmink, Van der Plas en Dekker-Abdulaziz over de RAM database bij de Belastingdienst

Five MPs asked the government about the RAM database at the Belastingdienst, including whether privacy impact assessments were done, whether parliament was misinformed, and why an external investigation is needed. The State Secretary answered that an external investigation and an investigation by the Dutch Data Protection Authority are pending, so definitive answers and the legality question cannot yet be given, and that memos and documents will be sent later.
I wish to emphasise that definitive answers can only be given after the external investigation and the investigation by the AP.
Ik wil daarbij benadrukken dat pas na het externe onderzoek en het onderzoek door de AP definitieve antwoorden gegeven kunnen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het vernietigende rapport van het Adviescollege Openbaarheid en Informatiehuishouding (ACOI) over een Woo-verzoek van Nieuwsuur over de speech over groepsimmuniteit van premier

Omtzigt asked the Prime Minister about an ACOI advisory opinion criticising the government's handling of a Woo request on the group-immunity strategy behind the early COVID-19 speech, including how the hotspot archive is structured and whether a listing of its roughly 13,000 documents can be provided. Rutte answered that the ministry archived COVID-related material in a hotspot folder, that a full overview is not reasonably possible, that the requested group-immunity documents are not held by the ministry after a search of about 500 hits, and that the speech drafting timeline is covered by an earlier Woo decision.
A complete overview of COVID-19-related documents in the document management system of the Ministry of General Affairs cannot reasonably be provided.
Een volledig overzicht van COVID-19-gerelateerde documenten in het DMS van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken is redelijkerwijs niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Omtzigt over feitenonderzoek in de jeugdbescherming

MPs Kwint and Omtzigt asked why the action plan to improve fact-finding in youth protection (feitenonderzoek jeugdbescherming) produced few real improvements, what the government will do, and whether children were wrongly placed out of the home. The Minister replied that the evaluation found many actions were taken but only partly implemented, that further improvements are planned, and that no evidence of wrongful out-of-home placements due to poor fact-finding has been found.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de verwachte grenseffecten van de stijgingen van de accijnzen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the expected cross-border effects of excise increases on petrol and diesel, including how much revenue is lost and what the acceptable excise gap with neighbouring countries is. The government answered that a study estimates lower excise revenue of roughly EUR 122-207 million per year for petrol and EUR 32-136 million for diesel, but declined to give a reasonable maximum excise gap or to answer the hypothetical half-increase scenario, pointing to forthcoming study updates.
On the basis of the current cross-border effects study, that is not possible.
Op basis van het huidige grenseffectenonderzoek is dat niet mogelijk.

Antwoord op van het lid Omtzigt over "10.000 gezinnen (vaak met een parttime werkende en/of gedeeltelijk arbeidsongeschikte) die onder het bijstandsniveau leven, omdat de fiscale en sociale regels ernstig in hun nadeel w

Omtzigt asked the ministers why about 10,000 households, often with a part-time or partly disabled earner, fall below the social assistance level because of tax and benefit rules, and why they are not being proactively contacted for a top-up, citing the 2022 Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling and earlier warnings from the National Ombudsman. The ministers answered that a new approach is being prepared, about 6,400 households are affected in 2023, some municipalities have started active outreach, and no national overview of contacts exists, with broader communication postponed to avoid overloading municipalities.
There is no national picture of the number of households that have been contacted or have already been helped.
Er is geen landelijk beeld van het aantal huishoudens waarmee inmiddels contact is of dat inmiddels geholpen is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Omtzigt over het feit dat werkstudenten uit EER-landen, die 8 uur per week werken, aanspraak kunnen maken op een Nederlandse basisbeurs (€ 439,- per maand) en een Nederlan

MPs Van der Woude and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Education whether EEA students working 8 hours a week can claim Dutch basic and supplementary grants, and what this means for Dutch universities. The Minister answered that migrant-worker status is assessed on a 32-hour monthly benchmark per the Centrale Raad van Beroep, that a 24-hour, six-month rule applies, that the supplementary grant cannot be means-tested against foreign price levels under EU law, and that legislation on internationalisation is being prepared.
In view of the CRvB ruling, I consider a working-hours norm higher than 32 hours legally untenable.
Gelet op de uitspraak van de CRvB acht ik een urennorm hoger dan 32 uur juridisch niet houdbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het (on)vermogen van minderjarigen om de gevolgen van genderbehandelingen onder ogen te zien en de noodzaak om als overheid in actie te komen

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked the minister whether medical treatment of gender incongruence in minors meets the definition of regular medical care, whether the state should take responsibility for a broader societal debate, and how other countries have changed their approach. The minister replied that care is governed by professional and quality standards set by the field, that treatment of minors requires careful evaluation and informed consent, that the government does not intervene in clinical matters, and that a broad societal approach and an ongoing evaluation of the quality standard are underway.
The government does not interfere in how care providers deliver care, insofar as it concerns medical-substantive considerations.
De overheid bemoeit zich niet met de manier waarop zorgverleners zorg verlenen, voor zover het medisch-inhoudelijke overwegingen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over "een juridisch advies van de landsadvocaat over het invaren van pensioenen in de pensioenwet”

MP Omtzigt asked the minister to publish a 2011 landsadvocaat advice on invaren of pensions, and to list and disclose internal and external legal advice on invaren since 2010, and to describe the legal risks. The minister refused to publish the 2011 concept advice (pre-dating the July 2021 disclosure policy and possibly relevant to state litigation), promised a list of advice by November, and argued the legal risks were addressed in the explanatory memorandum and Council of State advice.
I will not make the requested draft advice public.
Het gevraagde concept-advies maak ik niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het advies van de landsadvocaat over invaren in het nieuwe pensioencontract

Deputy Omtzigt asked why a 2011 concept advice from the State Advocate on invaren (transferring accrued pension rights into the new contract) was shown to union and employer leaders but not to parliament, and asked for all advice on invaren to be listed and sent. The minister answered that the two individuals viewed the concept once under supervision, that the advice's content was incorporated into public documents, that advice given before July 2021 is not published, and that an inventory of written advice would be shared in November.
The concept advice, in light of ongoing or possible proceedings, is not made public, because the interest of the State, as stated in Article 68 of the Constitution, stands in the way.

Dat neemt niet weg dat het concept-advies in het licht van lopende of mogelijke procedures niet openbaar wordt gemaakt, omdat het belang van de Staat, zoals genoemd in artikel 68 van de Grondwet, daaraan in de weg staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over arbeidsmigratie

Omtzigt asked how many labour migrants entered the Netherlands in 2021 and 2022, whether a leaked migration letter is authentic, and when each measure will be elaborated and submitted to parliament. The minister gave partial figures (EU data delayed until November 2023; non-EU permits for 2021 and 2022), declined to confirm the letter's authenticity citing confidentiality of inter-party negotiations, and said the cabinet had not agreed on the measures.
In line with the established practice between parliament and cabinet and the legal framework, it is not appropriate for the cabinet to provide the political input and documents.
Conform de vaste lijn in het verkeer tussen Kamer en kabinet en het wettelijk kader is het niet aangewezen om vanuit het kabinet de politieke inbreng en stukken te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel 'Universiteit van Amsterdam geeft Netflix belastingadvies vermomd als wetenschappelijk onderzoek’ op onderzoeksplatform Follow the Money

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a Follow the Money report that the University of Amsterdam gave Netflix tax advice disguised as research, including a memo of promised benefits beyond the contract, and asked about integrity, funding, transparency and a professorship. The Minister answered that the memo's benefits are not part of the signed contract and were not granted, while acknowledging that the memo creates an appearance of dependence and conflict of interest, and that the university will evaluate the project.
In my view, the existence of the memo alongside the contract creates the appearance of dependence and conflict of interest.
Naar mijn mening wekt het bestaan van het memo naast de overeenkomst de schijn van afhankelijkheid en belangenverstrengeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Omtzigt over over tenminste 259 PAS melders die niet worden gelegaliseerd

MPs Van der Plas and Omtzigt asked why at least 259 PAS-notifying farms are not being legalised and receive no state help, and questioned the government's handling and information provision. The minister answers that these 259 failed verification under the legalisation criteria, that not all have a problem since some may hold other permits, and that provinces will send rejection letters and look for solutions, while asserting the Kamer was fully informed.
I will ask the province to provide that clarity urgently, so that the PAS notifiers know where they stand.
Ik zal de provincie verzoeken die duidelijkheid met spoed te geven, zodat de PAS-melders weten waar ze aan toe zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Plas, Eppink en Bisschop over de stikstofuitstoot van Schiphol

Four MPs asked the environment and nitrogen minister why Schiphol is absent from the RIVM list of large nitrogen emitters and whether aviation emissions escape the Aerius model, and asked about the status of Schiphol's permit applications and the promised disclosure of nitrogen space purchases. The minister replied that Schiphol falls outside the industry and energy sectors covered by the report, that aviation emissions are calibrated into RIVM's national deposition figures, that the requested purchase data will be included in an ongoing evaluation, and that the Schiphol nature permit decision is still pending.
Following commitments made to Mr Omtzigt and Mr Boswijk, I have requested part of the information on an accelerated basis.
Naar aanleiding van toezeggingen aan de heer Omtzigt 13 en de heer Boswijk 14 heb ik een deel van de informatie versneld uitgevraagd.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Baarle, Eerdmans en Omtzigt over de voordracht van Wopke Hoekstra als Eurocommissaris

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister how Wopke Hoekstra was nominated as Dutch European Commissioner, including the procedure, any candidate profile, whether parliament was informed, and whether his departure leaves the Foreign Ministry without political direction. The government replied that the nomination followed the standard Article 246 TFEU procedure after consultation within cabinet and with the Commission President, that no candidate profile was drawn up, that parliament was not informed beyond the standard procedure, and that ministerial responsibility for the Foreign Ministry is secured.
No. The procedure was followed in line with standing policy on earlier appointments, see the answers to questions 1 and 2.
Nee. De procedure is conform staand beleid van eerdere benoemingen gevolgd, zie de antwoorden op vraag 1 en 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de accijnzen per 1 januari 2024

MP Omtzigt asked about the scheduled 2024 excise duty increases on petrol and diesel, indexation, EU comparisons, cross-border price differences, and the tax-free mileage allowance. The state secretary confirmed the scheduled increases under unchanged policy, noted the government would not anticipate the August budget decision, and said a higher allowance would be considered in that decision.
During the treatment of the Tax Plan 2023 I promised to consider raising the tax-free mileage allowance from 2024 to €0.23 per kilometre.
Tijdens de behandeling van het Belastingplan 2023 heb ik toegezegd om een verhoging van de onbelaste reiskostenvergoeding per 2024 naar € 0,23 per kilometer te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het migratiepakket

An MP asks the state secretary of Justice and Security for a list of migration measures considered during failed coalition talks, of measures the four parties could agree on, and of measures the demissionary cabinet plans to implement, and whether a package can still be agreed. The government answers that no list of agreed measures exists, that the demissionary cabinet is exercising restraint so no list can be given, and that agreement on a package is not expected, while pointing to earlier letters containing internal documents.
Anticipating that, it is not possible to provide a list of measures or to give a precise date.
Vooruitlopend daarop is het niet mogelijk een lijst van maatregelen te bieden of een precieze datum aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de oorzaken van Inflatie en het feit dat volgens een recente IMF studie stijgende bedrijfswinsten de grootste oorzaak zijn

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether an IMF study finding that rising profits drove about half of euro area inflation applies to the Netherlands, and what policy lessons and measures follow. The minister says the Dutch contribution of profits to inflation cannot yet be established, that the study may not be representative of the Netherlands, and that price-intervention measures used abroad carry serious costs, while promising to address income distribution and purchasing power in the August decision-making.
The cabinet shares the conclusion that part of the inflation is caused by higher profits, as also previously stated in answers to parliamentary questions.
Het kabinet deelt de conclusie dat een gedeelte van de inflatie wordt veroorzaakt door hogere winsten, zoals ook eerder aangegeven in de beantwoording van Kamervragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, De Roon, Klink, Eppink en Omtzigt over de bescherming van mensen die met de dood bedreigd worden door wetten tegen geloofsafvalligheid en godslastering

MPs asked the Foreign Minister what the Netherlands is doing to press states that retain the death penalty for apostasy and blasphemy, including via UN resolutions, UPR reviews, and an international campaign, and how it protects people threatened in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and in UN fora, made statements and visits, supports a moratorium in principle, and cited Dutch criminal law and support for ex-believers, but gave no concrete new commitments.
The Netherlands is against the death penalty in all cases and under all circumstances and therefore gives extensive attention to these resolutions and parliamentary motions.
Nederland is tegen de doodstraf in alle gevallen en onder alle omstandigheden en geeft daarom uitgebreid aandacht aan deze resoluties en Kamermoties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pouw-Verweij over de A-status van COVID-19

MPs Omtzigt and Pouw-Verweij asked why the minister opposes their amendment moving COVID-19 from list A to B2 of the Public Health Act, when a separate bill to drop A-status is planned. The minister answers that the amendment is opposed because RIVM advice shows no epidemiological need for listing, that the bill will go to parliament before summer recess, and that the reporting duty will be relaxed by ministerial regulation from 1 July.
I hope to submit the bill to your House before the summer recess.
Ik hoop het wetsvoorstel voor het zomerreces in te dienen bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verwenij en Omtzigt over de bestrijding van desinformatie door de denktank Desinformatie

MPs Pouw-Verwenij and Omtzigt asked the health and interior ministers about the government's role in countering vaccine disinformation through the Denktank Desinformatie, including access to platform reporting portals, membership, mandate, definitions, interventions and legal basis. The state secretary answered that the think tank had no special platform status or decision-making power, that no complete overview of government contacts with platforms exists, and that participants acted on personal title, while documents were attached.
There is no overview of the deployment of the Ministry of VWS and the bodies falling under it in the area of disinformation.
Er is geen overzicht van de inzet van het Ministerie van VWS en de daaronder vallende gremia op het gebied van desinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het recht op de arbeidskorting van mensen met een arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering

An MP asks whether the government will follow a court ruling that the labour tax credit (arbeidskorting) should apply to disability benefits paid via employers, questions the size and justification of the difference, and asks for worked examples and historical figures.
