The Secretary of State answers that the government has appealed the ruling to the Supreme Court, provides calculations showing the net income gap, defends the policy aims in general terms, and says a cabinet response will follow in summer.
I have appealed against this ruling to the Supreme Court.
Tegen deze uitspraak ben ik in cassatie gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pouw-Verweij over de A-status van corona en het RIVM-advies over een mogelijke wijziging van die status

MPs Omtzigt and Pouw-Verweij asked the health minister when RIVM was asked to advise on the A-status of COVID-19, for the advice, the handling perspective, possible changes to the status, and a faster advice timeline. The minister answered that RIVM was asked on 31 May, the advice was shared with parliament on 12 June, and the minister decided to follow it so COVID-19 no longer carries the A-status or any other listed group status.
I received the advice from RIVM on 12 June and shared it with your House the same day.
Ik heb het advies van het RIVM op 12 juni jl. ontvangen en diezelfde dag met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Woude en Peters over het recht op studiebeurzen voor EU-studenten in Nederland na herinvoering van de basisbeurs

MPs Omtzigt, Van der Woude and Peters asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the entitlement of EU/EEA students to Dutch student finance after the reinstated basic grant, including worked examples, cumulation with foreign aid, verification of parental income, and European cooperation. The minister answered that a full legal analysis on portable student finance will follow before summer, that cumulation with foreign student finance is not allowed but enforcement is hard without international agreements, and that the questions and related motions are being worked on.
I will include this part in a letter that your House will receive before the summer.
Dit deel zal ik opnemen in een brief die uw Kamer voor de zomer ontvangt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de miljarden aan kosten voor de pensioenen van militairen en politieke ambtsdragers waarvoor geen voorziening is getroffen is en waardoor er geld bijgestort zal moeten worden

MP Omtzigt asked about billions in unfunded pensions for military personnel and political office holders, including whether reserves were set aside, the cost of pre-funding the APPA pensions, and why the Wet toekomst pensioenen memorandum lacked estimates. The minister answered that military pensions are budgeted via a reserve, APPA pensions are not yet reserved pending a separate legislative process, municipalities and provinces are urged to build adequate provisions, and the facts study will be repeated.
During this year I will, together with the subnational governments, repeat the factual study into the provisions already made in the budgets.
In de loop van dit jaar zal ik samen met de medeoverheden het feitenonderzoek herhalen naar de al getroffen voorzieningen op de begrotingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de wijze van verstrekken van informatie uit Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV) door de Belastingdienst aan gemeenten en andere samenwerkende instanties

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance how the Belastingdienst shares FSV fraud-signalling information with municipalities and cooperating bodies, including data deletion, legal bases, LSI intervention-team practices and the IVT system. The government answers that organisations were asked to delete FSV-related data, that many questions cannot be reconstructed or will be answered later, and that it will inform parliament in a progress letter before the next debate.
I cannot answer the question on sharing of incidental data within the set deadline. I will inform the House further through the progress letter sent before the next Belastingdienst committee debate.
Voor de deling van incidentele gegevens kan ik binnen de gestelde termijn de vraag niet beantwoorden. Ik zal uw Kamer nader informeren via de stand van zaken brief

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat Japan weigert verantwoordelijk te nemen voor de onmenselijke behandeling van 'troostmeisjes' – die gedwongen werden tot prostitutie – gedurende de Tweede Wereld

An MP asked the government about Japan's refusal to acknowledge responsibility for forced prostitution of 'comfort women' in WWII, and whether Dutch state and royal family profited from the liquidation of Japanese wartime bank funds that held their earnings. The government answered that archives (Foreign Affairs, Finance, NEFIS, National Archives) do not allow verification of such profit, sees no reason for further research, and cited archival access restrictions and the Archives Act.
At this moment the Dutch State sees no reason to conduct further investigation into the money flows, beyond the archival research already carried out.
Op dit moment ziet de Nederlandse Staat geen aanleiding om, naast het verrichte archiefonderzoek, nader onderzoek te doen naar de geldstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Cora van Nieuwenhuizen heeft een lobbyverbod maar bemoeit zich met het werk van klimaatminister Jetten’

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked the Minister of the Interior whether former minister Van Nieuwenhuizen breached the post-ministerial lobbying ban through contacts with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, and how enforcement will be ensured. The government answers that the ban was triggered by her brief five-day interim ministerial role, that her later letters were treated as Energie-Nederland positions, and that a statutory ban and register will follow in a forthcoming bill.
The lobbying ban makes no distinction based on the nature and duration of the ministerial office.
Het lobbyverbod kent geen onderscheid naar de aard en duur van het ministerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een Wob/Woo-verzoek uit januari 2021 naar de reactie op het rapport ‘Ongekend Onrecht’

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked for a detailed timeline of how the government handled a Wob/Woo request from January 2021 for drafts and related documents on the response to the 'Ongekend Onrecht' report, including court rulings, why it was omitted from an earlier list, and disclosure of the inventory and drafts. The Minister answered most questions substantively, providing timelines, the court ruling and decisions, but refused to release draft letters, citing the need for internal confidentiality, and deferred assessment of the handling to the court.

Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitspraak op 14 april 2023 van de Rechtbank Midden-Nederland waarin een nadere beslistermijn voor alle zaken bij de Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen (UHT) tot juli

An MP asks the State Secretary for Finance and the Minister for Legal Protection whether a court ruling postponing UHT's decision deadline to July 2024 undermines access to justice and rule of law under the Constitution and ECHR, and about the state's appeal, dossier delays and court–government consultation. The government replies that legal protection remains available, that the ruling does not block access to court, that it has appealed the ruling, and that a delayed UHT decision is not a constitutional violation; it declines to give some detail on dossiers and says it will share consultation minutes.
Parents retain unchanged the right to file an appeal for failure to decide in time.
Ouders hebben onveranderd het recht een beroep niet-tijdig beslissen in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de beloftes van het kabinet na het aftreden vanwege het kinderopvangtoeslagschandaal

An MP asks the cabinet to report on progress on all promises made after the childcare benefits scandal, including a timeline for redress for parents and children, and a full list of commitments with status, spending and responsibility. The government answers that it refers to its earlier progress letters and departmental contributions on the recovery operation, transparency, the legality principle and hardship clauses, but does not provide a single consolidated status overview of every promise.
In this letter the cabinet proposed to inform the House further in future about progress on the actions from the cabinet response in the relevant separate tracks.
In deze brief heeft het kabinet het voorstel gedaan om de Kamer voortaan verder te informeren over de voortgang van de acties uit de kabinetsreactie in de relevante afzonderlijke trajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over uitspraken van de rechter over de hersteloperatie en het feit dat de rechter vastgesteld heeft dat de staat onrechtmatig gehandeld heeft

MP Omtzigt asks why the cabinet has not acted on the 2019 motion recognising unlawful conduct in the childcare benefits affair, and how court rulings finding the state liable affect compensation. The State secretary says compensation does not require establishing unlawfulness, the State will not contest individual liability in these cases, and it will pursue fuller compensation while appeals on deadlines continue.
It has always been the intention to compensate these and other affected parents.
Het is altijd de intentie geweest om deze en ook andere gedupeerde ouders schadeloos te stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over 'de plannen die de provincies moeten maken voor stikstofdoelen in 2030, terwijl de wet 2035 voorschrijft en over de juridische onhaalbaarheid van onteigenen op basis van het Ae

MP Omtzigt asked the minister why provinces must submit nitrogen plans targeting 2030 when the law still sets 2035, how such plans can be enforced without a legal basis, and about the legal feasibility of expropriation based on Aerius model deposition values. The minister answered that the 2030 acceleration follows the coalition agreement and Remkes' advice, that provinces are already bound by existing duties and the government has instructive and supervisory tools, and that the legal framework on the Aerius question will be shared by summer, though the one-week deadline was missed.
I aim to share this elaboration with the House of Representatives before the summer of this year.
Ik streef ernaar om deze uitwerking voor de zomer van dit jaar met de Tweede Kamer te delen.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over onderzoek naar oversterfte

An MP asked the Health Minister whether excess-mortality research data (CBS, RIVM vaccination, Vektis) can be made available free or cheaply and quickly, and what is being done on vaccination-mortality research. The Minister said researchers can request data from holders at cost or market rates, that ZonMw raised its subsidy cap to 100,000 euros, and that vaccination and test data were made available, while noting some datasets remain at the CBS only on request.
I consider it important that researchers are enabled to carry out research into the causes of excess mortality.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat onderzoekers in staat worden gesteld om onderzoek te doen naar de oorzaken van de oversterfte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de brief van Eurocommissaris Sinkevicius van 28 maart 2023 inzake de voortgang van de integrale aanpak

Member Omtzigt asked whether the Minister met Commissioner Sinkevičius on 28 March 2023, requested the minutes and the 14 February letter, and asked how and when the Commissioner's letter was received and what the Dutch government's role in its drafting was. The Minister denied any meeting, said both letters had been sent to the House, explained the letter reached the Permanent Representation and then the ministry, and stated the Dutch government had no substantive involvement in drafting it.
On 3 April I sent your House both my letter of 14 February 2023 to Commissioner Sinkevičius and the Commissioner's reply letter of 28 March 2023.
Ik heb op 3 april uw Kamer zowel mijn brief van 14 februari 2023 aan Eurocommissaris Sinkevičius toegezonden als de antwoordbrief van de Eurocommissaris van 28 maart 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken, Ellemeet en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Poliklinieken moeten patiënten met postcovid weigeren, de zorg is niet meer te betalen’

MPs asked the Minister of Health about news that two academic post-COVID clinics would stop accepting patients because standard reimbursements do not cover costs, and about research funding. The Minister said reimbursement is a matter between hospitals and insurers, that no proven effective treatment yet exists, that over 14 million euros has been allocated to research, a knowledge agenda is due in 2023, and extra budget for multi-year research and an expertise centre is planned.
I expect to be able to give definitive clarity on this in May and will then inform your House.
Ik verwacht daarover in mei definitief uitstelsel te kunnen geven en zal uw Kamer daarover dan informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.

Antwoord op vragenvan het lid Omtzigt over de LSI-verslagen, de uitspraak van het Europese Hof d.d. 12 januari 2023 over informatie over het verstrekken van data over persoonsgegevens, alsmede de uitspraak van de Raad va

An MP asks the government about GDPR access rights to recipients of personal data (CJEU ruling), whether a 'code 88' fraud-list marking is personal data, and whether individuals may access the reasons for fraud investigations (Council of State ruling), plus questions on LSI intervention-team records, risk lists, home-entry consent and related documents. The government largely answers that access rights are subject to limits and that code 88 becomes personal data only within a dataset, gives limited information where records no longer exist, and commits to a FSV letter and an LSI evaluation.
For that reason, the information provided to the data subject must be as precise as possible.
Daarom dient de verstrekte informatie aan de betrokkene zo nauwkeurig mogelijk te zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de koppeling van persoonsgegevens van uithuisgeplaatste kinderen en onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsingen en het kinderopvangtoeslagschandaal, waar de Kamer al in 202

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister for Legal Protection and state secretaries about linking personal data of children placed out of home, independent research into out-of-home placements and the childcare benefits scandal, and why the bill on temporary data exchange did not include an independent-research objective as the 2021 motion requested. The government answered that independent research now exists via a Hamer commission, a CBS study found no group-level link to child protection measures, and the Inspectorate's second study is ongoing, while several answers note data handling and procedural constraints.
I sent the House a memorandum of amendment to the bill Temporary Law on Exchange of Personal Data UHP KOT on 16 March 2023.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 16 maart 2023 een nota van wijziging op het wetsvoorstel Tijdelijke wet uitwisseling persoonsgegevens UHP KOT toegezonden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Staaij, Ceder, Piri, Van der Lee, Koekkoek, Teunissen, Eppink en Van der Plas over de uitspraak van het Internationaal

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will ensure Azerbaijan complies with the ICJ provisional measures order to reopen the Lachin corridor, and whether it has raised this with Azerbaijan. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Azerbaijan to comply through bilateral talks, the ambassador, and EU and multilateral channels, but gives no new concrete commitment beyond continued advocacy.
Following this ruling, the Netherlands called on the Azerbaijani authorities to comply with the ruling.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak de Azerbeidzjaanse autoriteiten opgeroepen om de uitspraak na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over de Corruption Perceptions Index 2022

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked the minister about the Netherlands' 2022 Corruption Perceptions Index drop to eighth place, Transparency International's criticism of political integrity rules, party financing and lobbying oversight, and planned measures. The minister acknowledged the drop as a signal to take seriously, pointed to recent integrity measures and pending legislation, and said the government will act on the lobbying study and integrity follow-up.
The cabinet considers that this insufficiently does justice to the efforts made here over the past year.
Het kabinet vindt dat dit onvoldoende recht doet aan de inspanningen die hier het afgelopen jaar op zijn gepleegd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de motie-Omtzigt c.s. die oproept tot het ontwikkelen van heldere normen voor de artikelen 1.3, lid 5 en 7.2 WHW en te bevorderen dat de Inspectie van het Onderwijs deze normen

An MP asks the Minister of Education why the motion requiring clear norms for Dutch as the default language in higher education (WHW articles 1.3(5) and 7.2) and their enforcement by the Inspectorate has not yet been implemented, and questions the reading of the exceptions in article 7.2. The Minister acknowledges the 1992 legislative intent and the Inspectorate's findings that the provisions are hard to enforce, promises a policy letter addressing the motion, and provides student mobility figures.
I agree. The current law requires institutions to justify in a code of conduct when the necessity criterion applies.
Ik ben het hiermee eens. De huidige wet vereist dat instellingen in een gedragscode moeten onderbouwen wanneer er sprake is van het noodzaakcriterium.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Agema, Kuiken, Westerveld, Koekkoek, Stoffer, Azarkan, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Van Esch en Van der Plas over longcovid onderzoek

MPs from many parties asked the health minister about the future of Long COVID research, the 2022 motion calling for more structural biomedical research, earlier incorrect answers on biomedical studies, the funding available and its duration, and whether structural money will be provided. The minister answered that about 14 million euro is currently spent on around twenty studies, thirteen with a biomedical component, that a knowledge agenda is being commissioned from ZonMw, and that extra multi-year funding and an expertise centre are being considered, to be decided in May.
In addition, I intend to make extra budget available for multi-year research and an expertise centre for post-COVID.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens om extra budget beschikbaar te maken voor meerjarig onderzoek en een expertisecentrum post-COVID.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het Italiaanse tekort en de subsidieregeling voor het isoleren van woningen die meer dan 100 miljard lijkt te gaan kosten

Omtzigt asks the Finance Minister whether Italy's superbonus and related housing subsidies, worth over 100 billion euro, were kept outside the deficit, and why the Eurogroup and Eurostat did not prevent this. Minister Kaag answers that Eurostat's methodology clarification forces full upfront recording of these tax credits, raising Italy's 2020-2021 deficits without changing total costs, and that the Eurogroup did not discuss it.
The revision of Italy's budget deficit results from a clarification of the methodology by Eurostat, following questions from Istat in 2021.
De bijstelling van het Italiaanse begrotingstekort komt voort uit een verduidelijking van de methodologie door Eurostat, naar aanleiding van de vragen hierover van Istat in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het voorgestelde keuze- en shoprecht voor gepensioneerden na invaren vanuit een uitkeringsovereenkomst naar een flexibele premieovereenkomst

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about the choice and shop right for retirees moved from a defined-benefit scheme into a flexible premium scheme, including whether insurers will offer such products and whether a carve-out or AFM advice is warranted. The Minister confirmed the one-time choice and shop right, said insurance market availability depends on pension capital, declined to seek AFM advice now, and promised to monitor the need for a carve-out during transition.
In my view, the current legal framework provides sufficient means to ensure that participants and retirees can make a well-considered choice between a fixed or variable benefit form.

Naar mijn mening biedt het huidige wettelijke kader voldoende mogelijkheden om ervoor te zorgen dat deelnemers/gepensioneerden een weloverwogen keuze kunnen maken voor een vaste of variabele uitkeringsvorm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ‘De latente stikstofruimte en extern salderen’

An MP (Omtzigt) asked the ministers about buy-outs of farms for nitrogen permit space, unregistered latent permit capacity, the unrecorded 30% deduction in external netting, and the AERIUS model update, requesting lists and data. The minister answered that the external netting evaluation is ongoing with results expected mid-2023, that stricter external netting rules and registration of freed space are being pursued, and that a complete picture of latent space cannot be obtained.
I expect to be able to share the results of the evaluation with the House around mid-2023.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van de evaluatie medio 2023 met de Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de stand van zaken rondom het toeslagenschandaal, de hersteloperatie en de uithuis geplaatste kinderen

Mr. Omtzigt asked the government about the state of the childcare benefits scandal recovery operation, reports of administrative chaos and staff pressure, the return of children placed in care, whether the cabinet is in control, and whistleblower protection. The State Secretary answered that a prognosis projects most affected parents compensated by 2025 with objections closed in 2026, that staff numbers grew over 13%, that signals of workload are recognised, and that staff can report concerns internally or anonymously, while many answers restate existing policy and give no specific new commitments.
At the same time there is no single golden solution that ensures all affected parents can complete their recovery in the short term.
Tegelijk is er niet één gouden oplossing die ervoor zorgt dat álle gedupeerde ouders op korte termijn hun herstel kunnen afronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de mogelijkheid dat de Nederlandse overheid toegang heeft of had tot portals voor het aangeven van desinformatie bij sociale media

Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch government, including ministries, intelligence services, police, regulators and other bodies, has or had access to platform portals for reporting disinformation or other content on social media, and what that access was used for. The government answered that the ministry of BZK holds trusted flagger status at several platforms, used only sparingly around elections, along with several regulators and the police for illegal or harmful content, and that intelligence services will not comment; it could not answer all questions within the deadline and withheld some operational guidance.
Through these channels the Ministry of BZK has no power to compel these companies to remove certain content or take other actions.
Het Ministerie van BZK heeft via deze kanalen geen bevoegdheid deze bedrijven te dwingen bepaalde content te laten verwijderen of andere acties te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Alkaya en Omtzigt over de marktconsultatie voor de schaderegeling voor ex-partners

MPs Leijten, Alkaya and Omtzigt asked why the government ran a market consultation on outsourcing the ex-partner compensation scheme to a commercial party, when it was decided and whether the UHT agency's own view was tested. The State Secretary answered that UHT and CWS lack capacity, the consultation tests market interest and feasibility before a tender, the Ministry of Finance would be the client, and the government regrets the delay but considers the consultation essential.
The market consultation is used to sound out whether market parties are interested in and able to carry out the compensation scheme.
Met de marktconsultatie wordt gepolst of marktpartijen geïnteresseerd en in staat zijn om de schaderegeling uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over een klokkenluiderszaak bij de Centrale Organisatie Integriteit Defensie

MPs Omtzigt and Jasper van Dijk asked about the status, composition and method of the investigation into alleged misconduct at the defence integrity office COID, the earlier inventory study, and the treatment of two whistleblowers. The State Secretary answered that the probe restarted in February 2023 with a revised scope, names its members, declines to disclose the mandate or details about the whistleblowers for privacy reasons, and promises to report the results once completed.
Once the Commission has completed the investigation, I will inform your House of the results of this investigation.
Nadat de Commissie het onderzoek heeft voltooid, zal ik uw Kamer berichten over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over de rechtsstaat en beloofde verbeteringen na het toeslagenschandaal

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked the government about progress on promises made after the childcare benefits scandal, including the eleven 'buikpijn' cases, the implementation of softer legal discretion, the role of inspectorates and ombudsman signals, the Landsadvocaat, and the Ministerial Commission on the childcare benefits recovery. The minister answered that the cases are being pursued by the relevant departments, gave progress updates across the reaction to the 'Ongekend onrecht' report, and said the Landsadvocaat and commission data are not available as overviews, while promising ongoing reporting to parliament.
No overviews are available of that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek naar Uber, waarbij de Belastingdienst zelf de eigen vragen formuleerde

Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Authority investigated its own handling of Uber without external independence, whether the internal report could be published, whether confidentiality and interstate secrecy rules were breached, and how the external validation was scoped. The State Secretary answered that the internal report cannot be published under the tax secrecy rule but was placed confidentially before Parliament, that external experts validated it and found no breach of secrecy, and that a technical briefing would follow on 18 January 2023.
Given the purpose and design of these articles, the investigation report cannot be made public because of the secrecy obligation.
Gegeven de doelstelling en de vormgeving van deze artikelen, kan het onderzoeksrapport vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht niet openbaar gemaakt worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pouw-Verweij, Den Haan, Van Kent, Léon de Jong en Ephraim over onbegrijpelijke en op het eerste oog onjuiste scenario’s die DNB gemaakt heeft op basis van de adviezen van de commi

MPs from several parties asked the Minister for Pensions why the 2022 Parameter Committee lowered the expected stock return while DNB's scenario charts appeared to show higher returns, and about standard deviation, validation and the release of draft DNB calculations. The minister answered that the scenarios follow the committee's advice, that the charts are consistent with it, and declined to share draft DNB reports, citing the value of confidential expert exchange, while committing to answer by a set date.
I do not consider it appropriate to share draft reports with your House.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om conceptrapportages met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het vervolgonderzoek naar oversterfte in Nederland in de periode 2020-2022

An MP asks the Minister of Health about data access and follow-up research on excess mortality in 2020-2022, including the pending privacy impact assessment, comorbidity and vaccination data, and access rules for researchers. The Minister answers that a DPIA is nearly complete, that key data will be shared with the CBS by year end, that some sources remain unavailable, and that he will explore clarifying the legal basis for health data sharing and Institutional Review Boards.
I am willing to share the DPIA with your House once it is fully completed (expected mid-December).
Ik ben bereid de DPIA met uw Kamer te delen zodra deze volledig afgerond is (naar verwachting medio december).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Brekelmans, Piri en Omtzigt over de podcast uitzending ‘Kim Lane Scheppele on Viktor Orbán’s Hungary’

Four MPs (Van Wijngaarden, Brekelmans, Piri, Omtzigt) asked the Foreign Minister about a podcast on Hungary's democratic decline, covering rule of law, EU sanctions, Russian diplomats, the IIB bank, Ukrainian refugees, EU funds, the state of emergency, EPPO membership and the EU's rule-of-law toolkit. The Minister answered that Hungary is not currently a fully democratic rule-of-law state, that the Commission should use all EU instruments, and that the Netherlands has consistently raised concerns and urged EPPO accession, while noting several questions fall to member states or the Commission.
Hungary violates fundamental values set out in Article 2 of the EU Treaty.
Hongarije schendt fundamentele waarden genoemd onder artikel 2 van het EU Verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de voorbereiding van het prijsplafond voor consumenten

An MP asked the Minister about contacts with the European Commission on the consumer energy price cap, the margin test, the constitutional equality of households, the sharing of memos, and firms with negative equity. The Minister answered that Commission correspondence is confidential, that the relevant internal notes and the draft regulation were shared with parliament, and that a brutomargetoets and bankruptcy clauses are included, while several questions were answered with commitments to follow up.
Official-level conversations with the Commission in the context of ongoing state aid procedures are confidential.
Gesprekken op ambtelijk niveau met de Commissie in het kader van lopende staatsteunprocedures zijn vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de regeling van het prijsplafond

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the timing, cost basis, notification to the European Commission, and profit cap of the energy price ceiling scheme ahead of a budget debate. The minister confirmed the scheme was shared on time with a detailed explanation, gave general cost-dependence answers, referred to the supplementary budget answers for cost estimates, and declined to answer some questions within the requested deadline.
For brevity, I refer to the extensive written answers to the Chamber's questions on the 10th supplementary budget, which also go further into how the relevant estimates were made.

Kortheidshalve verwijs ik naar de uitgebreide schriftelijke beantwoording van de vragen die de Kamer gesteld heeft over de 10 e suppletoire begroting, die ook nader ingaan op de totstandkoming van de relevante ramingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de LSI (Landelijke Stuurgroep Interventieteams) en vele tot nu toe onuitgevoerde toezeggingen over privacy, risicoscores van heel veel burgers, onuitgevoerd onderzoek, niet opg

MP Omtzigt asks about the LSI joint intervention-team data sharing, including DPIAs, promised but unpublished documents, a planned external review of risk scores, an advisory analytics committee that is still not set up, and possible GDPR violations. The government answers that DPIAs and a privacy protocol are being prepared, that LSI risk scores were stopped in July 2020, that the advisory committee is still being recruited, and that the requested documents are attached or promised later.
Once the DPIA of the LSI cooperation has been completed, it will be sent to the House.
Zodra de DPIA van de LSI-samenwerking is opgeleverd zal deze aan de Kamer worden toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het prudent persons principle en het beleggen met geleend geld in de Wet toekomst pensioenen

MP Omtzigt asks the minister whether lifting the borrowing restriction in the Wet toekomst pensioenen, combined with individual allocation of returns, is compatible with the prudent person principle, and questions the 150% equity exposure for young members, the history of the 150% cap, and whether flexible contracts are covered. The minister answers that the prudent person principle is an open norm that funds must substantiate themselves, that a 150% statutory cap on equity exposure is now being added via an amendment, and that the earlier draft and the flexible-contract position were stated in a way the minister considers consistent with the bill.
I have previously stated to your House that my exchange of views with your House on this subject has convinced me that capping the borrowing restriction is a desirable addition to the bill.

Ik heb eerder in uw Kamer uitgesproken dat mijn gedachtewisseling met uw Kamer over dit onderwerp mij ervan heeft overtuigd dat een maximering van de leenrestrictie een wenselijke toevoeging aan het wetsvoorstel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de motie-Omtzigt inzake vergoedingen voor energiebedrijven (Kamerstuk 36200, nr. 118)

MP Omtzigt asks the government how it implements two motions on the energy price cap: margin-based compensation for energy suppliers and handling of shared connections (blokaansluitingen), plus questions on tax changes and the timing of the cap. The minister answers that talks on margin testing are ongoing, a solution for shared connections has top priority under coordination by the Tax Authority, the 2023 cap is intended to start on 1 January 2023, and no further change to energy tax rates is currently planned.
Talks are currently being held with energy suppliers on how to arrive at some form of margin testing in implementing the 2023 price cap scheme.
Op dit moment worden gesprekken gevoerd met de energieleveranciers over hoe te komen tot een vorm van margetoetsing bij de uitvoering van de prijsplafondregeling voor 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de overname van contracten van failliete energiebedrijven zoals Welkom energie

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about the takeover of customer contracts after the bankruptcy of Welkom Energie, including the ACM's role and whether Eneco was bound by the contracts. The minister answered that the courts, not the government, judge the specific case, that the ACM applies the rules independently, and that the Energy Act procedure for customer takeover at bankruptcy will be clarified, while refusing to revise earlier answers or assess the email, and postponing answers.
It is for the court to judge the specific circumstances of a given case.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen over de specifieke omstandigheden in een bepaald geval.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de 190 euro regeling voor huishoudens in november en december 2022

MP Omtzigt asked about the 190 euro per month energy allowance for small-scale consumers in November and December 2022, including its budget authorisation, cost estimates, households without small-consumer connections, and legal protection for individuals. Minister Jetten answered that the budget was raised to 3.15 billion euro after a VAT correction, that the government relied on an urgency provision (art. 2.27(2) Comptabiliteitswet) to bypass prior parliamentary approval, and that consumers have a right via their supplier, though some households in shared connections may not be reached.
For authorisation, the cover letter to the Ninth supplementary budget invoked the second paragraph of article 2.27 of the Comptabiliteitswet because of the high urgency of the expenditure.

Ter autorisatie is in de aanbiedingsbrief bij de Negende incidentele begroting (Kamerstuk 36 220 ) een beroep is gedaan op het tweede lid van artikel 2.27 van de Comptabiliteitswet vanwege de hoge urgentie van de uitgaven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het energieplafond en blokverwarming

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about how the energy price cap and the 190-euro allowance apply to households on shared heating (blokverwarming) and shared connections, plus transparency on their energy costs. The minister answers that tenants can request cost information under the Civil Code, that a specific scheme for block connections is being developed, that the 190-euro subsidy is per connection and may need to be shared, and that the regulations were issued urgently without prior parliamentary review.
For 2023 the cabinet aims for a specific allowance for households with block connections (heat and electricity).
Voor 2023 streeft het kabinet naar een specifieke tegemoetkoming voor huishoudens met blokaansluitingen (warmte en elektriciteit).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de voorgestelde wijzigingen inzake het nabestaandenpensioen en over berekeningen hoe het nieuwe stelsel dit jaar gewerkt zou hebben

MP Omtzigt asked the minister about survivors' pension rules under the Wet toekomst pensioenen, including the cost of voluntary continuation, the effects of a pre-retirement death, the transition and the 2022 Confident calculations. The minister largely confirmed the cited figures, said the scheme is an improvement and that details are left to social partners, and declined to give a half-year performance estimate, arguing that such a short horizon is inadequate.
A calculation period of half a year is in my view too short to properly compare contract performance and to make a well-considered choice about introducing the new system.

Een berekeningsperiode van een half jaar acht ik te kort om de prestaties van contracten goed met elkaar te kunnen vergelijken en om een weloverwogen keuze te kunnen maken over de invoering van het nieuwe stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Omtzigt over een laag tarief op verse groente en fruit, dat al in een aantal EU-lidstaten wordt toegepast en dus ook in Nederland mogelijk zou moeten zijn.

MPs Van Esch and Omtzigt asked why the Netherlands cannot apply a reduced VAT rate on fresh fruit and vegetables as Italy, Latvia and Spain do. The government answered that it is studying the legal and practical delimitation with SEO, expects results in early 2023, and that a zero rate could take effect on 1 January 2024 at the earliest.
The cabinet emphasises that it is wise to await the conclusions of this study before proceeding to any introduction of a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables.
Het kabinet benadrukt dat het verstandig is om de conclusies van dit onderzoek af te wachten voordat tot eventuele invoering van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit wordt overgegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over huidige verlagingen van variabele pensioenuitkeringen met wel 10%, de brief van de Commissie Parameters en de tussenliggende periode tot mogelijke ingangsdatum van de Wet toeko

Omtzigt asks the Minister whether variable pension payouts in the new system could fall by around 10% during high inflation, whether the solidarity contract and parameter commission timing leave people and employers unclear, and whether the Minister will extend the temporary indexation and vrijstelling rules. The Minister argues variable payouts can be stabilised by solidarity reserves and spreading, that the 10% drop is unlikely, and that the Wet toekomst pensioenen start date will be postponed to 1 July, while indicating no extension of the indexation rules is planned for now.
The bill offers earlier prospects for a more purchasing-power-proof pension, and pension accrual also becomes more personal and transparent.
Het wetsvoorstel biedt namelijk eerder perspectief op een koopkrachtiger pensioen, en ook de pensioenopbouw wordt persoonlijker en transparanter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het verhogen van de tarieven door energiemaatschappijen

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers whether energy suppliers raising tariffs from 1 October on only 10 days' notice break the 30-day notice rule, whether consumers must pay higher direct-debit amounts, and how consumers can enforce their rights. Minister Jetten answered that the ACM was asked to enforce the rules, that most large suppliers reversed their increases, that consumers can complain or go to the Geschillencommissie or court, and that the ACM cannot order refunds.
They can also report to the ACM that the supplier is not complying with the rules.
Ze kunnen ook bij de ACM melding maken dat de leverancier zich niet aan de regels houdt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het prijsplafond energie en de toegezegde voorbeelden tijdens de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about how the energy price cap would work for various household types, including large families, the chronically ill, heat network users, residents of apartment blocks with central heating, heat pump users, monument residents and holiday parks, and about the compensation paid to suppliers. The minister answered with estimated bills with and without the cap, said suppliers would receive at most the gap between their advertised price and the cap, and listed existing support measures while admitting some cases (heat networks, shared connections) remain difficult to resolve.
The cabinet will ensure in the design of the scheme that any excessively paid compensation can be recovered if the planned audit gives cause for it.
Het kabinet zal in de vormgeving van de regeling waarborgen dat eventueel te veel vergoede middelen terug kunnen worden gehaald indien de beoogde accountantscontrole hier aanleiding toe geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aangekondigde aanwijzing van een locatie in Albergen als asielzoekerscentrum

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about communication with Tubbergen municipality, the procedure for siting an asylum centre in Albergen via the national-interest route, and the consultation and objection rights of residents and the council. The government answered in detail on the procedure, the absence of required council consent, and the ex-post objection route, but declined to deliver the requested full documents now (pending a Woo request) and said it could not answer within two weeks.
There is no legally prescribed prior consultation round.
Er is geen wettelijk voorgeschreven voorafgaande inspraakronde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de energieprijzen, over de plannen voor leveringszakerheid en betaalbaarheid van energie, over het afsluitbeleid van kleinverbruikers

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about the energy security and affordability strategy, the risk of blackouts, the cost pressure on low-income households, disconnection rules for small consumers, and LNG imports from Russia. The minister points to earlier letters and debates, existing crisis plans and cross-border arrangements, and describes the existing disconnection safeguards and support measures, without providing a single published strategy document.
I refer you to the transcript of the committee debate of 9 June 2022 on energy supply and security of supply, which contains a list of these letters.
Ik verwijs u graag naar het verslag van het Commissiedebat d.d. 9 juni 2022 over voorzienings-en leveringszekerheid energie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Marijnissen over de prijscap op energie

MPs Omtzigt and Marijnissen asked the government about the planned energy price cap, its costs, who it covers, safeguards against excess profits by energy companies, and related consultations. Minister Jetten answered that a price cap from 1 January 2023 is planned with volume limits and maximum tariffs, costs are not yet exact and will be funded partly from energy tax cuts, and the government intends to bar disconnections this winter, while many answers refer to a separate letter and some consultation details are not shared.
Given the short deadline for answering, for further explanation of this answer I refer briefly to my letter of 20 September 2022.
Gegeven de korte termijn die is gesteld voor beantwoording, verwijs ik voor verdere uitleg van dit antwoord kortheidshalve naar mijn brief van 20 september 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over gaswinning in Nederland

An MP asked why GasTerra, 50% state-owned, sold almost all Dutch gas to foreign buyers under long-term contracts, and asked for the contracts and prices to be made public. The minister answered that the contracts are private, commercially sensitive, and cannot be shared with MPs, while explaining the legal constraints, market pricing and the government's energy-bill support measures.
No. These are contracts between private parties containing commercially sensitive information.
Nee. Het betreft hier contracten tussen privaatrechtelijke partijen met commercieel gevoelige informatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paulusma, Van den Berg, Agema, Hijink, Bikker, Stoffer, Van Esch, Azarkan, Westerveld, Kuiken, Koekkoek, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Gündoğan en Sylvana Simons over de aangenomen moti

MPs asked the health minister about the adopted motion on Long COVID research, citing US and Dutch figures on prevalence and work incapacity, and asked for an estimate of its size in the Netherlands and a letter on implementation. The minister answered that around one in eight people report lasting symptoms, that 18 ZonMw studies and a RIVM LongCOVID study are under way, and that a joint knowledge agenda and an expert centre are being prepared, without a fixed timeline for the letter.
I refer to the annex 'Preparation and protection – other relevant topics related to the long-term approach to the coronavirus' attached to the letter on the long-term COVID-19 approach.

Antwoord 5 Ik verwijs hiervoor naar de bijlage «Voorbereiding en bescherming – andere relevante onderwerpen die verband houden met de langetermijnaanpak van het coronavirus» 6 bij de Kamerbrief langetermijnaanpak COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bewust vertragen van Wob-verzoeken en het betalen van dwangsommen door de regering

MP Omtzigt asked whether Wob freedom-of-information requests are deliberately delayed by ministries, whether courts have imposed penalty payments (dwangsommen) on ministries for missed deadlines, and for the list of cases and the interdepartmental Wob/Woo meeting minutes. The minister admits many statutory deadlines are missed and that over two million euros in penalties were incurred in 2019-2021, cites complexity and backlog as causes, acknowledges one request (datacenter Zeewolde) was deliberately postponed at third-party request, promises improvement measures and minutes, but answers were late and some details were withheld.
I also see that in many cases the statutory deadlines are not met and that the ministries, including my own, are not complying with the law.
Ook ik zie dat in veel gevallen de wettelijke termijnen niet worden gehaald en dat de Ministeries, waaronder mijn eigen Ministerie, zich daarmee niet aan de wet houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel Onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsing kinderen toeslagenouders tegengehouden

MP Omtzigt asked the government why it did not inform parliament earlier about an independent RUG study into child removals in the childcare benefits affair, and whether the study should be commissioned. The Minister answered that the government had no involvement, that the judiciary decided not to cooperate, that CBS data rules do not allow the requested linkage, and that no new study is currently planned because an inspection and an independent commission are underway.
I have always informed your House about how independent research would take place, namely by the Inspectorate of Justice and Security (IJenV) and additionally by an investigative commission.

Ik heb uw Kamer steeds geïnformeerd over de manier waarop onafhankelijk onderzoek zou plaatsvinden, namelijk door de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid (IJenV) en aanvullend door een onderzoekscommissie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Marijnissen over kinderen die uit huis geplaatst zijn, het toeslagenschandaal en de schadevergoeding die zij krijgen uitgekeerd, terwijl ze nog uit huis geplaatst zijn

MPs Omtzigt and Marijnissen asked the government about children placed out of home in the childcare benefits scandal, compensation payments to those children, who controls the money, and whether expert analyses and rights protections are available. The minister answered that a support team has worked with 202 parents and 429 children, that a child compensation scheme exists with parents or guardians controlling minors' money under the civil code, and that contra-analyses and family-analysis instruments face waiting lists and are being piloted.
The investigation by the Inspectorate of Justice and Security and the independent inquiry committee should provide more insight into this.
Het onderzoek van de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid en van de onafhankelijke onderzoekscommissie moet hier meer inzicht in bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de gelekte maatregelen naar aanleiding van het bereikte begrotingsakkoord in aanloop naar Prinsjesdag

MP Omtzigt asks the Prime Minister and Finance ministers whether leaked pre-Budget Day measures (air ticket tax, corporate tax, box 3, student grants and others) are accurate, who leaked them, and why a leak by an opposition MP was punished while government leaks are not. The Prime Minister declines to confirm or deny specific leaked measures because the Prinsjesdag proposals are still under Council of State advice and CPB calculation, confirms the coalition agreement's rise in air passenger tax, says he regrets the breach of the confidentiality rule, but does not say who leaked or what the ministerial discussion concluded.
The decision-making process on the Prinsjesdag documents has not yet been completed.
Het besluitvormingsproces over de Prinsjesdagstukken is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Omtzigt over het eerdere totaal ontwijkende antwoord op de vraag hoeveel olie en andere brandstoffen Nederland uit Rusland importeert en het bericht 'Who’s Still Buying Fossil Fuel

MPs Piri and Omtzigt asked why the government earlier gave an evasive answer on Russian oil and fuel imports, and about reports that the Netherlands is a leading importer of Russian gas and that Russian-origin oil reaches Europe via Indian diesel. The minister answers that the CREA figures are modelled rather than official customs data, that monthly customs data is only available up to April 2022 and some data is withheld for competitive reasons, and that the government is pursuing phase-out and EU sanctions while acknowledging Indian diesel of Indian origin falls outside the sanctions.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, the information for the Visual Capitalist image was produced by the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA).
Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 2 is de betreffende informatie voor de afbeelding van Visual Capitalist geproduceerd door het Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Dassen, Azarkan en van der Plas over de stukken van de aandeelhoudersvergadering van 2022 van Schiphol

MPs Omtzigt, Dassen, Azarkan and Van der Plas asked why the government refused to share the minutes and documents of Schiphol's 2022 shareholders' meeting, and how parliament can scrutinise the state's shareholder role. Minister Kaag answered that the minutes are confidential business information, provided a summary of operational challenges, promised confidential inspection of the draft minutes, and said parliament has no power to review individual shareholder meetings.
The report of the General Meeting of Shareholders (including the relevant documents) is classified as commercially confidential information and therefore cannot be shared with your House.
Het verslag van de Algemene Vergadering van Aandeelhouders (inclusief de relevante stukken) wordt aangemerkt als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan daarom niet worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de nieuwe scenarioset in de pensioenwet, waarop zeer veel besluiten gebaseerd zijn, maar die nog steeds niet gepubliceerd is

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions why the new scenario set for the pension law, on which many decisions rest, has still not been published, and sought the effects of parameter changes on pension outcomes and transition distributions. The Minister answered that the Parameters committee has an extended mandate to 30 November 2022, that scenario changes do not alter the statutory framework, and that transition outcomes depend on fund-level decisions, while committing to share the committee's advice and DNB sensitivity analyses with the Chamber.
In that context I have already extended the mandate until 30 November 2022.
Ik heb in dat kader het mandaat reeds verlengd tot 30 november 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ’het gebruik van Energie en de plek waar de miljardenwinsten terecht komen, terwijl de Nederlandse huishoudens in Energie-armoede vervallen’

Omtzigt asked the ministers how much gas is extracted in the Netherlands in 2022, where it goes, what long-term contracts and prices the state and its companies have, how much the state earns from gas, and whether consumers are overcharged, including whether electricity producers' profits and subsidies are fair. The government answered that the gas cannot be traced to a final destination, that contract terms are confidential, that the state earns gas revenue through specified channels, and that it is examining targeted relief for vulnerable households.
The content of these contracts is confidential, and this confidentiality is also agreed in the contracts themselves.
De inhoud van deze contracten is vertrouwelijk en deze vertrouwelijkheid is ook in de contracten zelf afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Nijboer, Grinwis, Maatoug, Stoffer, Dassen en Inge van Dijk over de Uber-files en aanverwante zaken

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Uber Files, including Tax Authority conduct toward Uber, exchange-of-information handling, multilateral audits, the NFIA and APBI roles and the withheld Unilever bidbook. The Secretary answered largely by citing tax secrecy, promising an internal investigation with results expected in September, offering a confidential briefing, and declining to change rules or reveal individual cases.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), I have not been able to answer all questions and cannot make the results of the investigation public.

Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) heb ik niet alle vragen kunnen beantwoorden en kan ik ook de resultaten van het onderzoek niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over stikstof

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the government about internal Finance Ministry calculations showing that a 39-kton ammonia reduction target for the national rural area programme exceeds what is needed, and about the number of farms affected, withheld or unpublished modelling, and whether the targets could change. The minister answered that the calculations are unvalidated internal advice not equal to government policy, promised to share them with RIVM and to inform parliament on final figures, but declined to publish the figures now.
These are internal calculations by the Ministry of Finance with an indicative character that have not yet been scientifically validated.
Het betreffen ambtelijke berekeningen van het Ministerie van Financiën met een indicatief karakter en die nog niet wetenschappelijk zijn gevalideerd.
Antwoord op van de vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over stikstof

MPs Van der Plas and Omtzigt asked the minister about nitrogen deposition in Natura 2000 areas, the farm closures needed to meet critical deposition values, monitoring data on nature recovery, and the causal link between buy-outs and nature improvement. The minister answered that many outcomes depend on provincial area processes, that monitoring does not yet isolate nitrogen effects, and that scientific consensus supports nitrogen reduction, while declining to quantify farm closures or give guarantees.
No, I cannot indicate this in advance.
Nee, dit kan ik niet op voorhand aangeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt inzake Centric en de mogelijkheid en wenselijkheid een enquête te houden

Omtzigt asked whether the government is aware of the resignation of Centric's board after a conflict with its owner, the planned Ondernemingskamer action over mismanagement, and DNB's departure from Centric, and whether there are public-interest grounds for an enquiry (enquête) that the Advocate-General could order. The minister confirms awareness, notes DNB is re-tendering and temporarily continues using Centric, and says the OM has started a preliminary investigation into whether to request an enquiry, without pre-empting its outcome.
The OM was already aware of signals of ongoing unrest within the company and has started a preliminary investigation to assess whether a request will be made to the Enterprise Chamber.

Het OM was al bekend met de signalen over aanhoudende onrust binnen de onderneming en is een verkennend onderzoek gestart teneinde te beoordelen of een verzoek bij de Ondernemingskamer zal worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de positie die de belastingdienst inneemt in rechtszaken over vrijwillige verbetering van de aanslag

Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority's position in court cases on voluntary correction of tax assessments, including a Hague District Court ruling and whether the Tax Authority's stance was 'fiscale grensverkenning' and properly published. The State Secretary defends the Tax Authority's position as a legal disagreement over the reallocation of joint tax items, notes that the cited memo quote matches the explanatory memorandum in substance, declines to publish judicial rulings or a separate standpoint, and promises a late reply.
It is not customary for me to publish judicial rulings.
Het is niet gebruikelijk dat ik gerechtelijke oordelen publiceer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Boswijk en Van Campen over ‘werkbezoeken aan de grensregio in het kader van stikstof en de aangenomen motie over verschillen aan de grens’

Omtzigt, Boswijk and Van Campen ask about nitrogen-related management and differing rules at the German border, including Natura 2000 areas, cross-border cooperation, monitoring, and planned visits to border farms. The minister answers that cooperation with Germany works well, that the KDW is exceeded in some habitats due to foreign deposition, that cross-border management is being coordinated, and that she will visit three border locations on 22 August while withholding exact locations for security reasons.
In light of all the unrest, during the preparation of working visits, on the advice of the security services (police and the ministry's security service), we do not make the exact locations public.

In het licht van alle onrust maken we tijdens de voorbereiding van werkbezoeken, op advies van de veiligheidsdiensten (politie en beveiligingsdienst binnen het ministerie), de exacte locaties niet openbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over berekeningen over stikstof van het Ministerie van Financiën, die een totaal ander beeld op de stikstofproblematiek werpen en over de bemiddelingspoging van dhr

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the government about unpublished Ministry of Finance nitrogen calculations showing smaller agricultural reductions needed if climate targets are met, and why these were not shared with parliament, plus the role of mediator Remkes and the basis of the NPLG targets. The government answered that the calculations are unvalidated, indicative internal advice, that they were shared with LNV and interdepartmentally and later published, and that targets will be adjusted as new projections (KEV 2022) come in.
The cabinet considers publishing unvalidated calculations that are still part of policy preparation not in the interest of good and democratic governance.
Het kabinet acht het openbaar maken van niet-gevalideerde berekeningen die nog onderdeel zijn van de beleidsvoorbereiding niet in het belang van goede en democratische bestuursvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het nieuwsbericht 'Faillissement door verkoopverbod tabak? Lobby klopte cijfers op'

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked about a news report that a tobacco-sales-ban impact study commissioned by the government, by SEO Economisch Onderzoek, overstated bankruptcy risk under lobby pressure, and asked how commissioned research is checked for representativeness, objectivity, lobbying influence and Framework Convention compliance. The State Secretary answers that existing codes (ARVODI, ALLEA, GIR) provide sufficient safeguards, that the research design was approved by VWS and adjusted after supermarkets refused cooperation, that the government does not deem Article 5.3 FCTC breached, and that a lobby register and a new ministers' code will be pursued.
The cabinet will ask a professor with expertise in interest representation and political decision-making for advice on a lobby register, and report on it in autumn 2022.
Het kabinet zal een hoogleraar met expertise op het gebied van belangenbehartiging en politieke besluitvorming vragen om advies over een lobbyregister, en hierover najaar 2022 nader berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek naar oversterfte en de beschikbaarheid van data

An MP asked the health minister why key linked datasets (vaccination, comorbidity, infection, VECTIS insurance data) were unavailable for the excess-mortality study, and what this means for its conclusions. The minister explained that CBS and RIVM lacked access to several sources, that some sub-questions were deferred to a third research phase, and that access will follow via ZonMw-selected researchers and CBS procedures.
CBS had no access to GGD data on people who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 or to vaccination data for this study.
Het CBS had bij dit onderzoek geen toegang tot (GGD-)data over SARS-CoV-2 positief geteste personen en tot vaccinatiegegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het artikel ‘Kabinet mist kans echt transparant te zijn bij het ultieme lobby-evenement’

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked why not all ministers' agendas from the World Economic Forum were made public and requested full disclosure of meetings with persons and organisations. The government replied that the programmes of the ministers attending the 2022 annual meeting are now public and are attached to the answers.
The programmes of the ministers during the 2022 annual meeting are now public.
De programma’s van de bewindspersonen tijdens de jaarvergadering van 2022 zijn inmiddels openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Belastingdienst, die leerstoelen en hoogleraren financiert

MP Omtzigt asks the Finance and Education ministers about Tax Authority funding of university chairs, including whether the Leiden sponsorship was disclosed, which chairs are funded, the transparency of related publications, and whether funding should go through the education budget. The minister answers that seven chairs are financed by the Finance ministry, declines to provide individual publication or PhD overviews, promises to ask UNL and the code authors for an evaluation of the integrity code, and says a full overview of other funded chairs will follow later.
No statements are made about individual employees.
Er worden over individuele medewerkers geen mededelingen gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het tijdelijke gedoogbesluit over gebruik van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen van het RIVM gedurende de coronacrisis in het voorjaar van 2020 toen duizenden mensen in verplee

An MP asked the Ministers of VWS and SZW about the temporary tolerance decision under which the Labour Inspectorate applied RIVM protective-equipment rules instead of the Working Conditions Act during the spring 2020 care crisis, and about related OMT advice and enforcement. The ministers answered that the tolerance was a deliberate, documented decision based on exceptional shortages, that the inspectorate periodically re-evaluated it, but declined or deferred several answers and postponed the full response.
The tolerance decision was made known to the House by letter of 15 April 2020.
Het gedoogbesluit is kenbaar gemaakt aan de Kamer bij brief van 15 april 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Ard B. die vastzit in een Franse cel

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a Dutch detainee in a French prison, reportedly ill, would serve only four months there before transfer to the Netherlands, and whether humanitarian grounds would be used to speed up his transfer. The minister replied that a return guarantee was given, no commitment to four months is known, IOS actively pursued the transfer, and the transfer was approved on 28 June with the case handled urgently, though humanitarian conditions do not formally factor into the transfer criteria.
On 28 June I approved the transfer of the person concerned under the Act on mutual recognition and enforcement of custodial and conditional sanctions (WETS).
Op 28 juni jl. heb ik ingestemd met de overbrenging van betrokkene op grond van de Wet wederzijdse erkenning en tenuitvoerlegging vrijheidsbenemende en voorwaardelijke sancties (WETS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de bemiddelaar in het stikstofdossier en de juridische status van de stikstofplannen

Omtzigt asked the government about the nitrogen (stikstof) targets, whether the 74% reduction by 2030 in the coalition agreement is in law (current law sets 50% by 2030), the legal status of provincial measures, and whether the mediator Remkes is independent, asking for advice and consultation before the process starts. Minister Staghouwer replied that the 50% legal target stands until a bill to move the 74% target to 2030 passes, that provinces have discretion but the national target is a result obligation, and that the planned bill will go through the standard consultation, Council of State advice and financial checks.
The bill is expected to be submitted to the House of Representatives in the first half of 2023.
Het benodigde wetsvoorstel zal naar verwachting in de eerste helft van 2023 bij de Tweede Kamer worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over een klokkenluidersmelding bij de publieke omroep

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked about the handling of a whistleblower report at the public broadcaster and the applicable procedures, including whether the report was treated as a whistleblower report and what rights the whistleblower has. The State Secretary answered that the Auditdienst Rijk is investigating the facts and declined to pre-empt the outcome, while describing the applicable procedures and complaint routes (ombudsman, Huis voor klokkenluiders) and refusing to give a timeline or the number of reports.
The factual course of events surrounding this report is being investigated by the ADR, as stated in my answer to question 3.
Naar de feitelijke gang van zaken rond deze melding wordt door de ADR onderzoek gedaan, zoals gemeld in mijn antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Alkaya, Azarkan, Dassen, Van der Plas en Eerdmans over de situatie op Schiphol

MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Schiphol's management had lost control of operations, whether shareholders could face claims and dividend losses, and whether shareholders should call an extraordinary meeting, a letter of objection, or an Enterprise Chamber inquiry. The minister attributed the problems to staff shortages and rising demand, pointed to Schiphol's summer action plan and a passenger cap, said operational responsibility lies with the board, and declined to share the confidential AGM documents while rejecting an extraordinary meeting or formal written objection for now.
The minutes of the General Meeting of Shareholders (including the relevant documents) are classified as commercially confidential and therefore cannot be shared with your House.
Het verslag van de Algemene Vergadering van Aandeelhouders (inclusief de relevante stukken) wordt aangemerkt als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan daarom niet worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de juridische status van het Nationaal Programma Landelijk Gebied (NPLG), het feit dat de reductiedoelen daarin nu hoger zijn dan de reductiedoelen in de wetgeving en de juridi

Mr. Omtzigt asked the ministers whether the NPLG nitrogen reduction targets are binding, why they exceed the Wet natuurbescherming target of 50% by 2030, and whether a 74% target by 2030 has a legal basis. The minister replied that the regional targets are indicative until the area programmes are set on 1 July 2023, that the Wsn-based outcome obligation is being accelerated from 2035 to 2030 via a bill expected in the first half of 2023, and that Parliament will assess feasibility through that bill.
It is for the House of Representatives and the Senate to assess whether the acceleration of the reduction targets must be laid down in law.
Het is aan de Tweede en Eerste Kamer om te beoordelen of de versnelling van de reductiedoelen bij wet moet worden vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Omtzigt over de olietanker Sunny Liger

MPs Piri and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the tanker Sunny Liger carrying Russian oil, including contacts with buyers, options to block docking, shipment lists, and monthly import figures. The minister answered that the government had no contact with the owners, the ship had left Dutch waters, no shipment list was available, and some import data was withheld on competition grounds.
Some of this information cannot be made available by Statistics Netherlands due to competitive interests.
Een deel van deze informatie kan door het CBS niet beschikbaar worden gesteld vanwege concurrentiebelangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over het gebruik van hacksoftware, zoals Pegasus, in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt and Van Dijk asked about Dutch use of hacking software such as Pegasus, including purchases, users, offences, targets, supplier screening, statistics, and the Wet CCIII evaluation. The government answered that police buy commercial intrusion software under judicial authorization, that operational details and expenditures cannot be disclosed for protection of methods, and that the Wet CCIII evaluation is delayed and expected after summer 2022.

Providing third parties with information on which specific software the police hold and use for this special investigative power entails unacceptable risks for the usability of those means and thereby for the investigative interest.

Het verstrekken van informatie aan derden over welke specifieke software de politie beschikt en gebruikt bij de inzet van deze bijzondere opsporingsbevoegdheid, brengt onaanvaardbare risico’s met zich mee voor de inzetbaarheid van die middelen en daarmee het opsporingsbelang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Azarkan en Omtzigt over recente nihilstellingen in de kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Leijten, Azarkan and Omtzigt asked about recent nihilstellingen (zeroing-out of childcare allowance) for 2020/2021, including how the process, notification, reasons, objection and repayment are handled after the Ongekend Onrecht report. The State Secretary answered that about 4,500 2020 cases were zeroed out, described new procedural safeguards, admitted decisions do not yet state reasons in the formal beschikking, and promised improvements without firm dates.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over het verweer van de Staat in de artikel 12-procedure omtrent de vervolging van de Belastingdienst

MPs Leijten and Omtzigt asked why the State's written defence in the Article 12 complaint procedure about prosecution of the Tax Authority omitted the Tax Authority's repeated breaches of law, and about the handling of the Biemond advice, the notice of complaint, and the information shared with the Public Prosecution Service. The State secretaries answered that breaches occurred for varied reasons, that the Chamber will continue to be informed of new cases, and that the Ministry deliberately withheld documents from the Public Prosecution Service to protect its independence.
Not acting in accordance with the law can have various reasons, with different underlying causes.
Het niet handelen in overeenstemming met de wet kan diverse redenen hebben, met verschillende grondoorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het artikel ‘Lobbyist Jack de Vries heeft toegangspas tot het ministerie van Defensie’

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked about lobbyist Jack de Vries holding a Defence Ministry access pass, the status of a motion for a mandatory lobbying register, and rules on lobbying while employed by a department. The government replied that lobbyists have no free access to ministries, that a code of conduct for ministers is due mid-2022 with the motion taken into account, and that no overview of department staff with lobbying side jobs exists.
Lobbyists as such do not have free access to a ministry, and therefore also not to the Ministry of Defence.
Lobbyisten hebben als zodanig geen vrije toegang tot een ministerie, en dus ook niet tot het Ministerie van Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Westerveld, Van Esch, Agema, Sylvana Simons, Koekkoek, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Eerdmans en Den Haan over de gewiste opnames van de OMT-vergaderingen

MPs asked whether recordings of OMT (Outbreak Management Team) meetings fall under the Archiefwet, whether the 14 April 2020 recording was destroyed and by whom, and about COVID-19 hotspot archiving lists. The minister answered that audio recordings are used only to draft minutes, that the minutes are archived while recordings are deleted as standard practice, and that some answers (selection lists, hotspot lists) would follow later.
An audio recording of an OMT meeting is deleted by the secretariat after the minutes are finalised. There is no registration of this.
Een geluidsopname van een OMT-vergadering wordt door het secretariaat verwijderd na het definitief vaststellen van het verslag. Hier is geen registratie van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over geldende richtlijnen inzake persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen (PBM) aan het begin van de coronacrisis en het onderzoek naar Long COVID

An MP asks the Health Minister about RIVM guidance on personal protective equipment at the start of the Covid crisis, the Outbreak Management Team advice, Long Covid care and research, and support for health workers affected. The minister answers that the guidance was an independent RIVM/expert product, that ministry input was only for clarification, lists ongoing Long Covid research, and refers to a planned subsidy scheme and a pending decision on a Long Covid fund.
The RIVM drew up these guidelines from its independent position and on the basis of experts and substantive specialists.
Het RIVM heeft deze uitgangspunten opgesteld vanuit zijn onafhankelijke positie en op basis van de van experts en inhoudelijk deskundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over zeer forse onregelmatigheden bij de uitkering van de zorgbonus in 2020 en 2021

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister of Long-term Care and Sport and the State Secretary of Finance about serious irregularities in the 2020 and 2021 care bonus, including whether bonuses were paid net as promised and whether a sample finding of tax errors in 35% of cases showed fraud or a subsidy windfall. The minister answered that the errors mainly concern incorrect reporting of tax paid rather than deliberate fraud, that overpaid subsidy will be recovered, that a sample was kept rather than extended to full checks, and that four fraud reports have been filed.
Audited subsidies that contain errors will be set at a lower amount. The excess subsidy paid out will be recovered within the applicable laws and regulations.
Gecontroleerde subsidies die fouten bevatten worden lager vastgesteld. Het teveel uitgekeerde subsidiebedrag wordt binnen de hiervoor geldende wet- en regelgeving teruggevorderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat het ministerie het OMT-advies over medische mondneusmaskers heeft beïnvloed en de begeleidingscommissie digitale ondersteuning COVID-19

Omtzigt asked the Minister of VWS, through a series of written questions, whether employers were liable under Dutch law for failing to supply face masks and PPE to care workers in early 2020, whether the government's PPE allocation and RIVM guidance were adequate, and whether legal advice on liability existed.
