The Minister declined to answer on liability and the legal basis for the tolerance decision, pointed to the employer's primary responsibility and to a temporary tolerance decision by the Inspectorate, and said legal advice concerned only procurement frameworks, not liability.
I therefore cannot make any statements about possible liability.
Ik kan dan ook geen uitspraken doen over eventuele aansprakelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de geluidsopnames van de OMT-vergaderingen, die toch blijken te bestaan

MP Omtzigt asked the Health Minister about audio recordings of OMT meetings, which the government had earlier said did not exist, and about whether minutes and drafts of the 14 April 2020 meeting can be made available to parliament. The minister confirmed recordings are made as a secretarial aid and deleted after the minutes are final, and refused to release minutes or recordings, citing the confidential status of OMT reports.
As indicated in earlier answers, OMT reports are confidential. They are not provided, outside the participants of the meeting.
Zoals in eerdere antwoorden aangegeven zijn verslagen van het OMT vertrouwelijk. Deze worden niet verstrekt, buiten de deelnemers van het overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uithuisgeplaatste kinderen in het toeslagenschandaal

Omtzigt asks the government, after the unanimously adopted motion on children placed out of home in the childcare benefits scandal, why the independent investigation has not started, how many such placements persist and how many were reviewed, what is being done about abuse and forced removals, and what has been done to prevent a repeat. The minister answers that an Inspectorate investigation is underway, the Ondersteuningsteam is supporting families, reviews are part of regular youth protection work, and the government cannot give figures on reviews or abuse, while proposing talks with parliament on a possible commission.
I have no insight into the number of reassessments or requests that have taken place in this context.
Ik heb geen zicht op het aantal herbeoordelingen of verzoeken dat in dit kader heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Van der Lee en Omtzigt over de stroperige implementatie van sancties in Nederland

MPs Klaver, Van der Lee and Omtzigt asked why sanctions implementation in the Netherlands is slow and fragmented, covering ministerial responsibility, the tax secrecy exemption, APA/ATR rulings linked to sanctioned persons, frozen assets held by trust offices, and supervision gaps for non-financial assets. The government answered that sanctions coordination and enforcement are split across ministries and the OM, that the Belastingdienst obtained an exemption from tax secrecy and is reviewing rulings, and that a national coordinator's report with recommendations will follow in May.
The national coordinator is preparing a report with recommendations, to be submitted in mid-May and shared with your House.
De nationaal coördinator is bezig met een rapport met aanbevelingen dat medio mei zal worden aangeboden en met uw Kamer zal worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Nispen over de landsadvocaat en fraude-onderzoeken

MPs Omtzigt and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about Pels Rijcken, the State's counsel firm, refusing to share an internal fraud investigation with the public prosecutor and about related fraud, claims and governance questions. The minister answered that the prosecutor and firm are following the statutory procedure for confidential information, that the investigation results were made available to Parliament for confidential inspection, and that many questions cannot be answered because of ongoing criminal investigations.
The prosecution service and Pels Rijcken are currently following the appropriate statutory procedure for disclosing data subject to a duty of confidentiality.
Het OM en Pels Rijcken doorlopen momenteel de geëigende wettelijke procedure die bestaat voor verstrekking van gegevens waarop een geheimhoudingsplicht rust.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over juridische adviezen over box 3

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary for Finance for a full list of legal advice on box 3 since 2010, including internal notes and advice from the Landsadvocaat, and questioned why no advice appears for 2015-2017 despite the Belastingplan 2016. The State Secretary confirmed the earlier list covered only 2015 onward and EVRM-related advice, said the 2015-2017 search scope explains the gap, and promised to send the notes on the Belastingplan 2016 before the summer recess, while stating that a full list of all advice could not be provided before the debate.
The notes prepared for the change to box 3 in the Belastingplan 2016 I will send to you before the summer recess.
De notities die zijn gemaakt ter voorbereiding op de wijziging in box 3 in het Belastingplan 2016 zal ik u voor het zomerreces toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Omtzigt over het niet openbaren van het onderzoeksrapport over de aanleiding voor de zelfdoding van een politieagent

MPs Simons and Omtzigt asked why the report on the causes of a police officer's suicide was not made public, who decided this, and whether it would be shared with the House, and asked about a whistleblower scheme for national security information. The minister said the report was given to relatives under a confidentiality condition, the police chief decided with all parties, and the report is now being sent to the House with privacy protections, while describing existing whistleblower channels and an announced extra police reporting point.
I am sending your House today the report of the Brouwer Commission.
Ik zend uw Kamer vandaag het rapport van de Commissie Brouwer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over investeringen bij Tata naar aanleiding van het plan Groen Staal van FNV en andere plannen voor waterstof

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about meetings with Tata Steel executives, plans discussed for decarbonisation (including hydrogen), subsidies, and the conditions attached to any public support for the IJmuiden steelworks. The minister answered in detail: no specific subsidy commitments were made, support is under study with binding conditions on health, environment and climate, but no amount has been allocated yet, and the answers to individual questions were delivered late.
Over the coming period this will be discussed confidentially with TSN by RVO and EZK.
Hierover zal de komende periode bedrijfsvertrouwelijk gesproken worden met TSN door RVO en EZK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over inflatie en de Wet toekomst pensioenen

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions how the extremely high 2022 inflation affects the Wet toekomst pensioenen, which was calibrated on stable inflation of about 2%, and requested scenario sets, calculations and transition effects. Minister Schouten answered that the new contract offers more inflation protection via the solidarity reserve, that transition effects are not expected to shift hundreds of billions, and that a commission of experts is developing new scenario sets, while deferring answers on the bill itself.
Given the complexity and technical nature of the questions, I informed your House on 30 March that I could not answer the questions before the Toekomst Pensioenen bill is submitted.
Gegeven de complexiteit en technische aard van de vragen heb ik uw Kamer 30 maart jl. laten weten de vragen niet voor indiening van het wetsvoorstel Toekomst Pensioenen te kunnen beantwoorden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Long Covid, het bericht dat het ministerie het OMT-advies over medische mondneusmaskers heeft beïnvloed en de begeleidingscommissie digitale ondersteuning COVID-19

Omtzigt and others asked the minister about Long COVID among healthcare workers, the use and rationing of face masks and PBM in care settings in 2020, OMT advice drafting and possible ministry influence, and the ending of an advisory committee on digital COVID support. The minister answered that PBM guidance was based on RIVM and OMT advice, that OMT records are confidential and not audio-recorded, that drafts of OMT advice will be sent to parliament later, and that questions on the advisory committee were answered separately.
At the request of MP Hijink during the corona debate of 16 February, I committed to sending your House all draft OMT advice and the clarifying questions the ministry put to the OMT.

Op verzoek van het lid Hijink tijdens het coronadebat van 16 februari jl. heb ik toegezegd uw Kamer alle conceptadviezen van het OMT en de vragen ter verduidelijking die het ministerie gesteld heeft aan het OMT te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Omtzigt en Klaver over het gebruik van privé berichtenservices en privé mailboxen door bewindspersonen voor hun werk

MPs asked whether ministers' use of private email and messaging apps for government work is covered by the Wob and parliamentary inquiries, and about the Kamp Gmail and Snel phone cases. The government answered that work-related messages on private accounts fall under the Wob and parliamentary inquiry powers, that a ministry review of the VWS/BZK private accounts found no security or archiving risk, and it promised to supply usage overviews for the current and previous cabinets later.

Under Article 6(1) of the Parliamentary Inquiry Act, a parliamentary inquiry committee can demand copies of, access to, or knowledge of work-related documents, regardless of the form of communication used.

Op grond van artikel 6, eerste lid, van de Wet op de Parlementaire enquête kan er door een ingestelde parlementaire commissie een afschrift van, inzage in of kennisneming van werkgerelateerde documenten gevorderd worden, ongeacht de gehanteerde vorm van communicatie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat energiemaatschappij Vattenfall tussentijds de prijzen voor gas en elektra verhoogt en daarmee de verlaging van de btw in haar eigen zak probeert te steken

MP Omtzigt asked the minister whether Vattenfall's mid-contract price increase on 1 April 2022 for variable-contract customers, which coincides with the planned VAT cut on energy, is acceptable and what steps the government will take. The minister replied that the compensation is meant for households not suppliers, called the timing and communication unfortunate, said the government is talking with suppliers and that the ACM supervises tariffs, but did not commit to blocking such increases.
It has not proven possible to answer these questions within the requested time limit.
Het is niet mogelijk gebleken om binnen de gevraagde termijn deze vragen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Omtzigt over het bericht dat het onderzoek naar fraude bij de landsadvocaat onvolledig en niet onafhankelijk genoeg was

MPs Van Nispen and Omtzigt asked the Justice Minister about reports that the deken's investigation into fraud at Pels Rijcken was incomplete and insufficiently independent, and about the effectiveness of oversight of law firms. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, pointed to planned reforms creating a single national supervisor for advocates, and said talks with the NOvA are ongoing, with no firm commitment on the specific demands.
Given the independence of the legal profession and its supervision, I am reluctant to respond to an individual case, and this is no exception.
Gelet op de onafhankelijkheid van de advocatuur en het toezicht daarop ben ik terughoudend met het reageren op een individuele casus, zo ook deze.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aangenomen motie om binnen 48 uur de fiscale gegevens van de personen op de sanctielijst te beschikking te stellen aan de autoriteiten die de sancties moeten opleggen

MP Omtzigt asked the government about the adopted motion requiring tax data, including APA and ATR rulings, of persons on the sanctions list to be shared within 48 hours with sanctions enforcement authorities, and about the Tax Authority's data sharing, asset freezing and contacts with listed persons. The State Secretary answered that a tax secrecy exemption was granted and a legal basis is being pursued, that the ruling inventory of 3,400 requests is ongoing, and that contacts with listed persons are not tracked.
No overview is kept of contacts that ministers and officials have with persons on sanctions lists.
Er wordt geen overzicht bijgehouden van contacten die bewindspersonen en ambtenaren hebben met personen die op sanctielijsten staan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Dassen over de openbaarmaking van de brief die Cora van Nieuwenhuis tekende voor de informateur, voordat zij minister werd en waarin zij beloofde om geen afspraken te maken over

MPs Omtzigt and Dassen asked the Prime Minister to publish the letter former minister Cora van Nieuwenhuizen signed before taking office, pledging no post-office arrangements, and whether her conduct and oversight of those pledges were adequate. The Prime Minister said the standard letter's text is fully public without signature and personal data, that there is no reason to think she breached her pledges, and that the cabinet plans no separate oversight of former ministers beyond new integrity measures requiring legislation.
The cabinet has no intention of establishing any form of oversight of (former) office holders.
Het kabinet heeft geen voornemens om een vorm van toezicht op (gewezen) bewindspersonen in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over uithuisgeplaatste kinderen en het toeslagenschandaal

An MP asked the government about children placed out of home in the childcare benefits scandal, including reunification prospects, complaint procedures at the youth care inspectorate and certified institutions, the scope of the inspectorates' investigation, and legal protection for parents and children. The minister answered at length, often stating that the inspectorates lack competence to handle individual complaints, declined to name the investigators, and said the requested two-week deadline could not be met.
I am not willing to give you the names of the staff (officials) of the inspectorates who carry out the investigation.
Ik ben niet bereid u de namen te geven van de medewerkers (ambtenaren) van de inspecties die het onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Grinwis en Ceder over het gebruik van eHerkenning

MPs Omtzigt, Grinwis and Ceder asked why the government keeps requiring eHerkenning for tax filing despite a Gelderland court ruling questioning its legal basis, and about refunds, penalties and a free public alternative. The State Secretary defends the legal basis, says the ruling does not affect other tax assessments, offers a limited compensation scheme, and refuses to provide a free public login or restore paper filing for now.
To clarify this, I will have an addendum published on the Tax Administration's website.
Om dit toe te lichten zal ik een naschrift laten publiceren op de website van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het WHO-verdrag voor pandemische preventie

Two MPs asked the Health Minister and the Prime Minister about preparations for a WHO pandemic prevention treaty, including draft texts, negotiation mandate, timeline, EU competence, the 2021 op-ed signed by Rutte, and whether the structural 300 million euro pandemic preparedness budget relates to the treaty. The minister described the INB process, said drafts will be shared when available and parliament informed before the second INB session, and denied a link between the budget and the treaty.
Once the contours of the pandemic treaty are clearer, parliament will be informed.
Zodra de contouren van het pandemieverdrag duidelijker zijn, zal het parlement worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het beëindigen van de Begeleidingscommissie Digitale Ondersteuning Bestrijding COVID-19

MPs Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked why the minister is ending the advisory Begeleidingscommissie DOBC for COVID-19 digital tools while requesting nearly 30 million euro for their further development, and whether the advisory body opposed the decision. The minister defends the termination, says other advisory bodies remain available, and agrees to share correspondence with the commission while refusing to reverse the decision.
In this phase I no longer consider the Begeleidingscommissie DOBC necessary for combating COVID-19.
In deze fase acht ik de Begeleidingscommissie DOBC niet meer noodzakelijk voor de bestrijding van COVID-19.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Hijink, Omtzigt, Van der Plas en Pouw-Verweij over de positie van zorgverleners die als gevolg van long covid lange tijd thuis zitten

Four MPs asked the health minister about healthcare workers off work for long periods with long COVID, including compensation, income loss and whether those costs are covered. The minister replied that no special social security regime exists for long COVID, that a temporary subsidy for employers retaining such workers was introduced, and that causation from workplace infection cannot be established in many cases.
No registration is kept of the number of healthcare workers who are partly or fully off work after a coronavirus infection.
Er wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van het aantal zorgverleners dat na een coronabesmetting deels of volledig thuiszit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een voor de belastingdienst beschamende uitspraak bij het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden over o.a. zwarte lijsten

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling criticising the Tax Authority over blacklist (FSV) registration, dossier access, appeal conduct and trust in the tax service. The State Secretary answered most questions on substance, but declined to discuss individual cases citing tax secrecy, and committed to further investigations, an external review of CAF, and a compensation regime.
Based on the tax secrecy obligation in Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot address the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht uit artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het artikel ‘Van Nieuwenhuizen wilde aanblijven als minister toen ze baan aannam in de lobbysector, Rutte was akkoord’

Two MPs asked the government about former minister Van Nieuwenhuizen taking a lobbying job for the energy sector while still in office and attending cabinet budget meetings, and about whether Prime Minister Rutte's approval and existing integrity rules were adequate. The government answered that the former minister bears primary responsibility for integrity, that she left office in August 2021 after the Prime Minister's political assessment, and that a revolving-door ban, cooling-off period and independent advisory commission are planned via future legislation.
In the letter of 29 November 2021 from the then Minister of the Interior, three new measures were announced regarding the integrity policy for former office holders.

In de brief van 29 november 2021 van de toenmalig Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zijn drie nieuwe maatregelen aangekondigd ten aanzien van het integriteitsbeleid voor gewezen bewindspersonen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het contact met de regio (Achterhoek en Twente) over de noordtak van de Betuwelijn en een verzoek om ter plaatste het traject te zien en het gesprek aan te gaan

An MP asked the minister about regional opposition to a northern branch of the Betuwe freight line, consultation with the Achterhoek and Twente, costs, and a request to visit and talk with residents. The state secretary replied that no decision has been taken, that consultation has been broad but without specific talks on the branch, and that a visit to the region is planned.
I cannot go into the possible consequences for Doetinchem, Haaksbergen, Hengelo/Oldenzaal.
Ik kan niet in gaan op de eventuele gevolgen voor Doetinchem, Haaksbergen, Hengelo/ Oldenzaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, Eppink en Omtzigt over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2022 van Open Doors

MPs Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, Eppink and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2022 Christian persecution ranking, covering Afghanistan, Nigeria, China, India, Algeria, digital surveillance exports, and religious freedom diplomacy. The minister answered that the trends are worrying, outlined existing diplomatic, UN, EU and export-control measures, and promised no new concrete action beyond continued engagement and a future subsidy policy framework.
The Netherlands, together with like-minded countries, raises publicly and behind the scenes at every suitable opportunity the importance of protecting human rights for everyone.

Nederland vraagt, samen met gelijkgezinde landen, zowel publiek als achter de schermen bij iedere gelegenheid die zich daarvoor leent aandacht voor het belang van het beschermen van mensenrechten voor iedereen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Kröger over de uitzending van het programma Hofbar op 2 februari 2022

MPs Omtzigt and Kröger asked why the state secretary took part in a TV broadcast on wastewater injection in Twente while questions on the same issue were still pending, and why the ministry published a 'milieuneutral' permit change that loosened toluene limits. The state secretary answered that the broadcast reflected transparency toward media, that the injection was halted by the regulator and operator, that the permit application was withdrawn, and that the motion would be implemented via a separate letter.
The manner in which the motion by Member Mulder et al. will be implemented will be communicated to the House today by letter.
Over de wijze waarop de motie van lid Mulder c.s. wordt uitgevoerd wordt uw Kamer heden via een brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Gündoğan, Simons en Omtzigt over het behoud van personeel bij de GGD’en

MPs asked the health minister about GGD staffing shortages, the medium-term outlook for testing and contact tracing, and whether temporary staff can be retained given rising demand. The minister replied that GGDs are responsible for their own personnel policy, that enough staff exist for the booster campaign, and that cost compensation and permanent contracts for essential staff provide assurance, though long-term plans are still under review.
Each GGD is responsible for its own personnel policy, and the way its staff is organised can vary considerably.
Elke GGD is verantwoordelijk voor zijn eigen personeelsbeleid, waarbij de manier waarop het personeelsbestand is vormgegeven sterk kan variëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de afvalwaterinjectie in Twente

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the Twente wastewater injection, including the adopted motion to suspend it, toluene exceedances, and inspection records since 2011. The State Secretary replied that NAM must submit a re-evaluation by 1 July and a decision will follow, that the operator shut injection temporarily over toluene and CO2 exceedances, that the permits were sent to Parliament in 2016, and that operator violation reporting is largely left to NAM, while SodM supplied an inspection overview.
I am implementing the motion by setting NAM a shorter deadline to deliver the re-evaluation and then taking a decision myself as quickly as possible.
Ik geeft uitvoering aan de motie door NAM een kortere termijn te stellen voor het opleveren van de herevaluatie en zelf daarna zo snel mogelijk een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Alkaya, Grinwis en Van der Plas over de mogelijkheid dat de nachttrein Brussel/Amsterdam-Berlijn/Dresden/Praag ook in Hengelo stopt

MPs asked why the new European Sleeper night train from Brussels/Amsterdam to Berlin/Dresden/Prague does not stop in Hengelo despite earlier investment in the Hengelo-Bad Bentheim link and overnight travel gaps. The State Secretary explained that the stop is commercially and timetable-constrained for European Sleeper, that a stop in 2022 is unlikely, and that the government will explore whether a 2023 stop is feasible and talk with the operator.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderhoud aan vuurtoren in Den Helder, die op instorten staat en de staat van onderhoud van andere (rijks)monumenten bij Rijkswaterstaat

Omtzigt asked the minister about cracks in the Lange Jaap lighthouse in Den Helder, earlier knowledge of those cracks in an internal memo, contacts with the municipality and heritage bodies, Rijkswaterstaat's maintenance policy for monuments and whether other state monuments are neglected. The minister partly answered: cracks in floors and flanges were known earlier, Rijkswaterstaat did not meet its own monument-maintenance framework, but documents, the full list of monuments and other details will follow only in spring.
No, the framework mentioned in the answer to question 7 was insufficiently followed in the maintenance of this monument.
Nee, het kader genoemd bij de beantwoording van vraag 7 is onvoldoende gevolgd bij het onderhoud van dit monument.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het arrest van de Hoge Raad op 24 december 2021 over Box 3

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance how the government will respond to the Supreme Court's December 2021 ruling that the Box 3 wealth tax violates property rights and non-discrimination, including whether it will provide restitution, share prior advice, and estimate costs. The State Secretary says restitution is being prepared, a list of advice will follow within two months, and no restitution will be given for 2013-2016 before the European Court of Human Rights rules.
I therefore assume that Mr Omtzigt also means internal notes that were submitted as advice to the political office holders.
Ik ga er daarom vanuit dat de heer Omtzigt ook interne notities bedoelt die als advies aan de bewindspersonen zijn gegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over de mogelijke uitbreiding van het coronatoegangsbewijs (ctb), dat als bijlage was verstopt in een reactie van 21 december 2021 van de minister op de motie-Den H

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked why the government did not send the critical advice of the Begeleidingscommissie on expanding the corona access pass (ctb) to Parliament before deliberating on the related bills, and why it was attached as an annex to another letter. The minister answers that the advice concerns technical app matters outside the bills' scope, that it was addressed in the reply to the Den Haan motion, and that he sees no consequences, while largely restating existing policy.

It is not obvious that the Begeleidingscommissie should advise on the bills, because both the expansion of the ctb and the introduction of 2G are policy choices outside the scope of the commission's mandate.

Het ligt niet voor de hand dat de Begeleidingscommissie adviseert over de genoemde wetsvoorstellen, omdat zowel de uitbreiding van het ctb, alsook de invoering van 2G, beleidskeuzes zijn die buiten de reikwijdte van de opdracht van de Begeleidingscommissie liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paternotte en Van der Laan over sporters van teamNL, die met corona besmet zijn geraakt

MPs Omtzigt, Paternotte and Van der Laan asked whether lessons were drawn after TeamNL athletes caught COVID-19 on the Tokyo flight, what measures China imposes, and whether flying on a single pre-departure test is safe. The minister replied that NOC*NSF evaluated the trip and adopted adjusted travel measures for Beijing, that no approach can reach zero risk, and that the cabinet considers a single test sufficiently safe while leaving the operational responsibility with NOC*NSF.
It is up to NOC*NSF to ensure that the TeamNL delegation can be sent to the Games in a safe manner.
Het is aan NOC*NSF om ervoor te zorgen dat de TeamNL-delegatie op een veilige manier kan worden uitgezonden naar de Spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Omtzigt over het bericht dat de compensatie van toeslagenschandaal soms verkeerd terecht komt

MPs Leijten and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance why compensation for the childcare benefits scandal sometimes reaches people not entitled to it, how long internal warnings were known, and why the reimbursement rules and the Catshuis scheme were adopted without a statutory basis. The State Secretary answered that a deliberate trade-off between generosity, speed and legality means some undeserved payments are unavoidable, that internal signals are taken seriously but the list of internal reports will not be shared to protect staff, and that the Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen is delayed after a critical Council of State advice.
They are part of the regular assessment process.
Zij lopen mee in het reguliere beoordelingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek naar oversterfte tijdens de coronapandemie

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about the academic study into excess mortality during the pandemic that parliament had ordered by motion, including the timeline, independence of RIVM and CBS, data access, and whether a commission and standards for independent research would be set up. The minister replied that two parallel tracks would deliver results (first around mid-February, the broader one around end of June), that RIVM and CBS are independent by law and will not design the research question alone, and that existing codes suffice, but he declined to set up a commission or ask KNAW/WRR for new standards and gave only partial data access.
I consider independent research very important. Of course RIVM and CBS are fully independent; this is regulated by law.
Ik vind onafhankelijk onderzoek erg belangrijk. Uiteraard zijn RIVM en CBS volledig onafhankelijk, dit is bij wet geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over het feit dat de regering brieven met aanwijzingen aan gemeentes stuurde zonder wettelijke grondslag

MPs Omtzigt and Van Dijk asked whether letters the government sent to municipalities instructing them to create emergency asylum reception places, called 'aanwijzingen', had any legal basis, and whether they amounted to mere requests. The government answered that the letters had no basis in Dutch law, were not legally binding, were intended as urgent requests, and that it will no longer use the term 'aanwijzing' in this way, while refusing to share some correspondence yet and not answering the criminal-law questions.
The cabinet regrets this. Therefore the cabinet no longer wishes to use the term 'aanwijzing' in a situation like this in this way.
Het kabinet betreurt dat. Daarom wil het kabinet de term «aanwijzing» in een situatie zoals deze niet meer op deze wijze gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord.

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen, 17 questions on the 2021 coalition agreement covering nitrogen targets, the transition fund, carbon credits, sustainable food, buyouts, legalisation of PAS cases and a possible consumer levy. The ministers largely answered by pointing to forthcoming analyses, planned provincial area plans and later decisions, with several answers promising to inform the House soon.
To determine the precise target achievement, an additional calculation is necessary, after further elaboration of the plans.
Om het precieze doelbereik te bepalen is een aanvullende doorrekening noodzakelijk, na verdere uitwerking van de plannen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pouw-Verweij en Gündugan over opschalingsplannen voor de IC en de tekorten aan Coronamedicijnen, terwijl een week geleden gemeld werd dat er een voorraad van drie maanden was

MPs Omtzigt, Pouw-Verweij and Gündugan asked the health minister about ICU expansion plans (LNAZ, the 350-bed figure, outsourcing and concentration of ICU care) and about shortages of COVID medicines despite a reported three-month stockpile. The minister answered by describing the timing of the LNAZ reports, the scenarios in the Aanpak Najaar, the Corona Crisis Voorraad composition, and declined to answer question 9 about splitting the answers for the supplementary budgets.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs from across the opposition and coalition asked the Minister of Justice and Security 25 factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering asylum and migration, police staffing, financing, cybersecurity, organized crime and the bar. The government answered many questions only partially, deferring details to later elaboration or a decision by the cabinet, and gave specific answers on police numbers, withdrawn bills, asylum spending and the reasons for expected higher asylum inflow.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering short-haul flight discouragement, flight numbers, investment splits, air quality, aviation tax revenue, road safety budgets and infrastructure maintenance. The minister answered most questions in general terms, deferring several figures and allocations to later cabinet decisions or reports.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the government dozens of factual questions about the 2021 coalition agreement's climate, energy, and biomass plans, including Ternaard gas drilling, CCS, nuclear, and the Westerschelde tunnel toll. The minister answered only a handful on substance and deferred most questions to later cabinet decisions.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering minimum wage, childcare subsidy, rent allowance, the AOW gap, child poverty targets, institutional racism and the Rainbow Accord. The government answered most questions substantively but deferred many details (funding, targets, the Rainbow Accord) to later elaboration by the cabinet.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a cabinet decision. You will be informed about this during the further elaboration.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister, in written questions, about the coalition agreement, covering EU budget and enlargement, ODA targets, asylum spending, migration partnerships, Middle East resolutions, and transparency. The ministers answered most questions in substance, pointing to existing reports and promising further studies and letters, with few concrete commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this in more detail with a BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hierover met een BNC-fiche nader informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pouw-Verweij over het vernietigende advies van de Raad voor de rechtspraak over de wetsvoorstellen 2G en 3G op de werkvloer, dat vlak voor kerst, met vijf weken vertraging, aan

MPs Omtzigt and Pouw-Verweij asked why the Council for the Judiciary's critical advice on the 2G/3G workplace bills was sent to parliament late, why its criticisms (necessity, proportionality, dismissal risk, privacy) were not summarised in the explanatory memorandum, and why ministers may not have seen it. The minister answers that the advice was omitted by error and sent later, that the bills were substantially amended in response, and that the government considered the advice fully.
The advice was mistakenly not sent to the House of Representatives together with the other advice issued on the two bills.
Het advies is abusievelijk niet tezamen met de andere over de twee genoemde wetsvoorstellen uitgebrachte adviezen naar de Tweede Kamer gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs asked the Finance Minister about the coalition agreement, covering the budget, tax burden, fiscal rules, the RRF recovery plan, and wealth inequality. The minister answered most questions in detail, citing indicative figures, and deferred several items (inflation effects, purchasing-power tables, the sugar tax, asset-tax reform) to the Spring Memorandum and later analyses.
The cabinet is examining the options for eventually lowering VAT on fruit and vegetables to 0% and introducing a sugar tax.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden voor het op termijn verlagen van de btw op groente en fruit naar 0% en het invoeren van een suikerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parliamentary groups asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the coalition agreement, covering student grants, research funding, teacher pay, press funding, special education, childcare and digitalisation. The government answered most questions with references to further elaboration and future decisions, providing concrete figures only in a few places.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this further.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Health Minister about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering youth care savings, health inequality, healthcare wages, the chief medical officer, ICU capacity, the health deductible and premium effects. The minister answered most questions in substance, deferred several to later decision-making, and pointed to other documents for details.
For a number of questions, further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet is still required.
Voor een aantal vragen geldt dat deze nog nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming vragen door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Defence Minister, in a set of factual questions before the government declaration debate, about the defence budget increases in the coalition agreement, how the funds are allocated, European defence cooperation, specialisation and strategic autonomy, and the NATO spending norm. The minister answered that the money is additional, broken down into intensification and maintenance items, will be detailed in a forthcoming Defence Note, and brings spending to the European NATO average of 1.85% of GDP.
How the coalition agreement funds will exactly be spent requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet.
Hoe de middelen uit het coalitieakkoord precies worden uitgegeven, vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de juridische basis waarmee gemeentes gedwongen worden asielzoekers op te vangen

MP Omtzigt asked whether the Secretary of State's December 2021 letters 'designating' emergency asylum reception sites for Enschede, Gorinchem and the Rotterdam region have any legal basis, and whether this amounts to an unlawful directive to municipalities. The government replied that the letters are not legal directions, have no grounding in Dutch law and no public-law effect, were a request driven by an acute shortage of about 2,000 places, and that it would not be repeated lightly; it also declined to release a decision memo, saying none was written.
The directions have no basis in Dutch statute or regulation, as I stated during the Justice and Security budget debate in the Senate on 21 December.
De aanwijzingen hebben geen grondslag in Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving, zoals ik gemeld heb bij de begrotingsbehandeling JenV in de Eerste Kamer op 21 december jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over COVID-19 virusvariant B.1.1.529 en medicijnen tegen COVID-19

MP Omtzigt asked the Health Minister about the B.1.1.529 (omicron) variant: its detection in the Netherlands, surveillance capacity, scenarios, travel rules, antiviral procurement, vaccine contracts and Court of Audit access to those contracts. The minister answered that surveillance meets ECDC norms, that the government has prepared scenarios and travel measures, that vaccine contracts are confidential, and that the Court of Audit has insight into them.
The concluded contracts stipulate that confidentiality applies to these contracts.
In de afgesloten contracten is afgesproken dat op deze contracten de vertrouwelijkheid van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het integriteitsbeleid bewindspersonen

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Interior how the secretary-general would grant exemptions from the broadened post-office lobbying ban, who sits on the independent advisory committee, how GRECO recommendations are met, and whether the government wrongly informed GRECO that the lobbying ban had lapsed. The minister replied that exemptions weigh factors like duration of office and proximity of policy field, that the advisory committee role will be assigned to an existing college via future legislation, that responsibility for compliance lies primarily with former ministers, and that no organisations were misinformed because the ban was never withdrawn.
The lobbying ban applied and still applies in full.
Het lobbyverbod gold en geldt onverkort.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de gesprekken die de Nederlandse gezant voor Afghanistan voert met de top van het Taliban regime in Afghanistan over financiering van zorg- en onderwijssalarissen

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Development Cooperation and Finance about talks the Dutch envoy held with Taliban leaders on financing health and education salaries, including mandate, sanctioned persons, budget articles and sanctions compliance. The government answered all 14 questions in substance, confirming contacts with sanctioned Taliban figures under a no-direct-funding approach while noting salary payments might be channelled via NGOs and international organisations.
The cabinet does not provide financial support to the Taliban, as also requested in the De Roon motion.
Het kabinet verleent geen financiële steun aan de Taliban, zoals tevens is verzocht in de motie-De Roon.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu, Teunissen, Simons, Van der Plas en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken weigert Afghaanse bewakers ambassade Kabul te evacueren’

MPs asked why Dutch embassy security guards employed via a subcontractor in Kabul were not evacuated while Hungarian guards were, and whether a new direct-employment criterion was introduced without informing parliament. The government answered that the criteria for evacuation (Belhaj motion) were unchanged, that embassy guards fall under host-state responsibility and their employer is responsible, and gave figures on remaining interpreters and Afghans awaiting transfer.
There is no question of a new criterion.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuw criterium.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de gang van zaken rond het faillissement van Welkom Energie, de grote gevolgen voor klanten en de rol van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt bij de afwikkeling

Omtzigt asks the minister about the Welkom Energie bankruptcy, the high costs and forced move to Eneco for customers, the ACM's role in supervision and the takeover, and whether customers can recover credit. The state secretary answers that the bankruptcy follows standard insolvency law, that compensation is generic rather than individual, that ACM's supervision was adequate and not involved in the takeover beyond merger review, and that a study on financial requirements for suppliers and consumer protection in bankruptcy will be commissioned.
Following market developments, I am in discussion with ACM and suppliers to examine whether the legal framework for ACM supervision is robust enough.
Naar aanleiding van de ontwikkelingen op de markt ben ik in gesprek met ACM en leveranciers om te kijken of het wettelijk kader voor toezicht van ACM robuust genoeg is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Bikker, Kuzu, Pouw-Verweij en Van der Plas over eiwit-vaccins

MPs asked the health minister about people who want a protein-based COVID-19 vaccine, the cancellation or reduction of Sanofi and Novavax orders, and vaccine efficacy data. The minister said the government has no data on the size of this group, chose Novavax over Sanofi and bought fewer Novavax doses because mRNA vaccines were already sufficient, and gave efficacy figures while noting approval and procurement decisions rest with EMA and the Gezondheidsraad.
I therefore see no need to investigate this in further detail, but will ask the RIVM to keep paying attention to this in its monitoring.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak om dit in verder detail uit te zoeken, maar zal het RIVM vragen ook hier in de monitoring aandacht voor te blijven houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) naar de vliegramp in Faro, waarbij 56 mensen omkwamen en 106 mensen zwaargewond raakten

Mr. Omtzigt asked the minister about the OVV's investigation into the 1992 Faro air crash, including the 2021 court ruling on state liability, the scope of the OVV's renewed investigation, and what documents the state supplied. The minister answered that the OVV is independent, that the state made documents available and had no interest in the outcome, that no documents were classified as state secret, and that the OVV's limited investigation was published on 18 November 2021.
Pursuant to Annex 13 to the Chicago Convention and the Dutch Act on the Safety Board, the above-mentioned documents cannot be made public.
Ingevolge Bijlage 13 bij het Verdrag van Chicago en de Rijkswet Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid, kunnen de bovengenoemde stukken niet openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de opgelopen inflatie en de gevolgen voor de koopkracht in 2022

Omtzigt asked the Social Affairs state secretary about the rise in inflation to 3.4% (CPI) and 3.7% (HICP) in October 2021, the lower tax indexation factor, and the implications for purchasing power in 2021 and 2022. Wiersma confirmed the figures, noted that annual inflation is likely higher than the 1.9% forecast, said purchasing-power figures will be updated only after the CPB's March 2022 forecast, and listed a set of measures already adopted.
I will continue to closely monitor inflation developments.
Ik blijf de inflatieontwikkelingen goed monitoren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de nagekomen bekentenis van de PwC onderzoek dat ze bij de hoorzitting in de Tweede Kamer niet de waarheid verklaard hebben over het cruciale punt dat de centrale term in de me

MP Omtzigt asked whether PwC's report on the 'memo-Palmen' (the 2017 legal advice on the CAF-11 childcare allowance case) was accurate, given a later claim that the term 'laakbaar' was used in a June 2019 meeting, and sought clarification and further investigation. The State Secretary answered that PwC could not reconstruct with certainty that 'laakbaar' was used at the 4 June 2019 meeting, that the government will not break confidentiality promises to interviewees, and that no further investigation is needed.
The ministry does not have and does not receive copies of these statements.
Het ministerie heeft en krijgt hier geen afschrift van deze verklaringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het OVV onderzoek naar de moord op Peter R. de Vries

Omtzigt asks the Justice Minister whether the OVV investigation into the murder of Peter R. de Vries satisfies the state's procedural duty under ECHR Article 2, and how each effectiveness criterion applies. Minister Grapperhaus answers that the criminal investigation plus the supplementary OVV inquiry meet Article 2 requirements, citing the OVV's investigative powers, independence and family involvement, without committing to a further inquiry.

I am of the view that the criminal investigation instituted by the Public Prosecution Service and the investigation instituted by the OVV together satisfy the state's procedural obligations under Article 2 ECHR to investigate.

Ik ben van oordeel dat met het door het Openbaar Ministerie ingestelde strafrechtelijk onderzoek en het door de OVV ingestelde onderzoek wordt voldaan aan de procedurele verplichtingen van de Staat onder artikel 2 van het EVRM om onderzoek te doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Grondwet, het coronatoegangsbewijs – en de wetenschappelijke onderbouwing daarvan – en lessen die Nederland kan trekken uit van de aanpak in Corona in Noorwegen, Zweden en D

An MP asked the ministers about constitutional review of COVID measures, the scientific basis for the corona access certificate, and lessons from Norway, Sweden and Denmark. The government replied that constitutional review is applied to new laws and measures, that the certificate is justified by vaccine effectiveness, that little scientific study exists yet and a research question has been set out, and that the OVV has sent no interim report.
It is not the cabinet's task to request an interim report from the OVV. It concerns independent research.
Het is niet de taak van het kabinet om een tussenrapportage bij de OVV op te vragen. Het gaat om onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij , Omtzigt, Den Haan, Gündoğan, Hijink en Westerveld over het tijdspad van boostervaccinaties

MPs asked the Dutch health minister why the Netherlands had not yet started voluntary COVID-19 booster vaccinations for over-65s and care residents, citing declining vaccine effectiveness, rollouts in Denmark, Sweden and the UK, and vaccine stock. The minister answered that vaccine effectiveness remained high, that the Health Council had advised boosters for the oldest groups and institutional residents, that a start date of 19 November was set, and that preparation (staffing, invitations, GGD capacity) required time.
From 19 November, booster vaccination will start.
Met ingang van 19 november start het vaccineren met de booster.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over de escalatie van het conflict in Ethiopië

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the escalation of the Ethiopia conflict, including travel advice, consular preparedness and the security of the Dutch embassy. The minister answered that the travel advice was raised to red (except Addis Ababa, orange), Dutch nationals were urged to leave via commercial flights, and the situation is continuously monitored.

The Foreign Affairs travel advice was adjusted on 4 November in connection with the security situation and has since had a red classification, except for the capital Addis Ababa, which has an orange classification.

Het reisadvies van Buitenlandse Zaken is op 4 november jl. in verband met de veiligheidssituatie aangepast en heeft sindsdien een rode classificatie, behalve voor de hoofdstad Addis Abeba, dat een oranje classificatie heeft.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Kathmann, Kuik, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij, Ellemeet, Gündoğan, Omtzigt en Van Esch over de daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand en het be

MPs from several parties asked the government about protecting minors and vulnerable groups from online gambling advertising, the 30% youth-audience interpretation in the industry gambling advertising code, enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit, and the implementation of the Vos motion and amendment on warnings. The minister answered that the ban on targeting youth is absolute, enforcement lies with the Ksa, a time-slot restriction is currently not feasible, and a new warning text is being developed via Trimbos.
The Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) supervises compliance with advertising restriction measures laid down in laws and regulations.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) houdt toezicht op de naleving van reclamebeperkende maatregelen die zijn neergelegd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het journalistieke televisieprogramma Propaganda over de besluitvorming rond ‘Dansen voor Janssen’

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked the Health Minister about the decision-making behind the 'Dansen met Janssen' campaign after a TV programme alleged misleading information and a changed advice on the Janssen vaccine for young people. The minister answered that the age limit was not changed, that the Health Council advice was followed, and that the information given was objective, while rejecting claims of misleading communication.
I have not provided misleading information.
Ik heb geen misleidende informatie verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de toezegging die is gedaan tijdens de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen om een aantal noties over het woonbeleid op een rij te zetten

MP Omtzigt asked the government to deliver promised housing policy notes, including a concrete multi-year plan on housing construction, rent allowance, the cost-sharing norm, sale of social housing and sustainable urban development targets. Minister Ollongren answered that the notes were sent on 5 October 2021 and outlined building pathways, but declined to commit to a full plan, leaving further measures to a new cabinet and promising only a later letter on additional funding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Omtzigt, Azarkan, Inge van Dijk, Arib en Ceder over het bericht ‘Uithuisplaatsingen onder gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire’

MPs asked the government about reports that over 1,100 children of parents harmed by the childcare benefits scandal were placed out of home, requesting the grounds, the CBS data scope, plans to return children and a dedicated helpline. The minister answered that a causal link is hard to establish, that CBS data cover 2015–2020, that no central record of placement grounds exists, and that a plan for affected families will be sent to parliament as soon as possible.
No, this specific information is not available. There is no central registration of the grounds on which an out-of-home placement is ordered.
Nee, deze specifieke informatie is niet beschikbaar. Er is geen centrale registratie van de gronden op basis waarvan een uithuisplaatsing wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ‘het niet-indexeren van de kinderbijslag en het feit dat dat honderden miljoenen meer gaat opleveren voor het rijk door de toegenomen inflatie’

MP Omtzigt asks whether non-indexation of child benefit under bill 35 845, which was meant to raise about 100 million euro for ICT costs, would yield far more if inflation is higher, and asks the government to amend the bill and cap the structural yield. State Secretary Wiersma answers that the bill's cumulative and structural cover depends on inflation forecasts, that the government sees no need for an amendment now, and that it will send answers before the plenary debate.
I acknowledge the possibility of rising inflation, which means non-indexation of child benefit could ultimately generate more revenue than estimated when the bill was drafted.

Ik onderschrijf de mogelijkheid van een stijgende inflatie waardoor het kan zijn dat de niet-indexering van de kinderbijslag uiteindelijk meer opbrengsten genereert dan geraamd tijdens het opstellen van het wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Omtzigt over het aantal evacuaties vanuit de ambassade in Kaboel

MPs Van Dijk and Omtzigt asked whether the 'three' figure for evacuation exceptions from Kabul was used in government deliberations, and why the minutes of the inter-ministerial meetings are withheld. The minister says the figure was only an order-of-magnitude illustration relayed by phone, that cabinet minutes are confidential to protect the unity of cabinet policy, and that questions cannot be answered within 72 hours.

For this reason, information about the views within the cabinet is not made public, such as minutes of the (Council of) Ministers and preparation for sub-councils, other consultations of ministers and preliminary official deliberations.

Om deze reden wordt informatie over de opvattingen binnen het kabinet niet openbaar, zoals bijvoorbeeld verslagen van de (Rijks)ministerraad en voorbereiding voor onderraden, andere overleggen van bewindslieden en ambtelijke voorportalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Piri over de evacuatie uit Afghanistan

MPs Omtzigt and Piri asked the government about the Afghanistan evacuation, including embassy correspondence, meeting records, military protection, Council of Ministers decisions, EUPOL interpreters and a promised independent inquiry. The ministers answered most questions substantively, provided some documents with redactions, declined to provide phone-call records because none exist, and committed to establishing an independent inquiry commission.
The cabinet will establish an independent external temporary commission to investigate the crisis approach, including the evacuations of the recent period.
Antwoord 17 Een onafhankelijke externe commissie van tijdelijke aard om onderzoek toe doen naar de crisisaanpak inclusief de evacuaties van de afgelopen periode zal door het kabinet worden ingesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het feit dat alle ministers en staatssecretarissen die tevens Kamerlid zijn, afwezig waren bij de hoofdelijke stemmingen over de QR-code en hoe zich dit verhoudt tot het grondw

MP Omtzigt asked the Prime Minister whether ministers and state secretaries who are also MPs were absent from the 16 September 2021 roll-call vote on the QR code, how that squares with the free-mandate rule of Article 67, and who decided to dismiss State Secretary Keijzer and whether cabinet rules were followed. Rutte answered that cabinet agreements on dual-role ministers are internal, that the dismissal was proposed with the agreement of the responsible minister and three deputy prime ministers rather than through a cabinet meeting, and that the answers were sent within the three-week deadline though not every question was answered individually.

In this case the Prime Minister, with the agreement of the Minister of EZK as responsible minister and the three Deputy Prime Ministers, proposed the said State Secretary for dismissal with immediate effect.

In dit geval heeft de Minister-President met instemming van de Minister van EZK, als verantwoordelijke Minister, en de drie Vice-Minister-Presidenten de genoemde Staatssecretaris voorgedragen voor ontslag met onmiddellijke ingang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over radicale ideeën voor een nieuwe bestuurscultuur

Omtzigt asked Prime Minister Rutte about his promised radical ideas for a new administrative culture, the status of motions on hardship effects, a regulatory commissioner for information management, the constitutional review ban (article 120) and a framework act for supervisors, and a state commission on the rule of law. The government answered that consultations and studies are underway, timelines have slipped, the drafting of the article 120 and supervisor-law bills is left to the next cabinet, and a state commission is being prepared with a draft mandate expected in November.
A draft mandate will be submitted to the House of Representatives and the Senate. The aim is to do so in November.
Een conceptopdracht zal worden voorgelegd aan de Tweede Kamer en de Eerste Kamer. Het streven is om dat te doen in november.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de leenbijstand

An MP (Omtzigt) asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Social Affairs why the 2014 to 2016 compensation for entrepreneurs hit by the leenbijstand problem was not reported on, why the problem took so long to resolve, and what will be done for those excluded or in debt restructuring. The government admits the long delay, promises to report on compensation use and to examine extending compensation to pre-2014 cases, but declines to hand over the requested memos for now.
Unfortunately it has not yet been possible to report in line with the commitment made.
Het is helaas nog niet gelukt om te rapporteren conform de gedane toezegging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over het te veel uitkeren van kindgebonden budget aan arbeidsmigranten

Two CDA MPs asked why the Tax Administration pays the single-parent supplement of the child budget to migrant workers whose partners live abroad, and why the problem has persisted despite earlier warnings. The government acknowledges structural data gaps for non-resident partners, describes partial fixes and ongoing work, admits it cannot count affected migrant workers, and postpones the answers.
It is known that a total of about 5,000 single parents whose child does not live in the Netherlands were granted the child budget.
Wel is bekend dat in totaal aan circa 5.000 alleenstaande ouders waarvan het kind niet in Nederland woont kgb is toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt hebben gesteld over de witwaspraktijken bij ING

MPs Slootweg and Omtzigt asked the Finance and Justice ministers about money-laundering practices at ING, including whether DNB re-tested the top leadership's fitness after the settlement, what conditions attached to the state capital injection, what DNB, ECB or prosecutors told ING's board, and whether ING's compliance department was cut. The minister declined to comment on individual prosecution and supervisory matters, citing supervisory confidentiality, and said the archive shows no such letters to the ministry, while promising to check officials' mailboxes and report back.

Under the legally anchored supervisory confidentiality, the competent supervisor cannot and may not make statements, not even to me, on whether re-testing in individual cases was considered, takes place or has taken place.

Op grond van de wettelijk verankerde toezichtsvertrouwelijkheid kan en mag de bevoegde toezichthouder geen uitspraken doen, ook niet naar mij, over de vraag of hertoetsing in individuele gevallen is overwogen.
Antwoord op van het lid Omtzigt over de betaalde belasting over uitkeringen aan mensen die in Nederland wonen en in de Tweede Wereldoorlog in Duitse krijgsdienst getreden zijn (zoals bij de SS)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how much German war pension income was declared by Dutch residents who served in German forces in WWII, whether back taxes can be levied, and whether convicted war criminals are among recipients. The State Secretary answered that about 20% of recipients declared the payments, that additional assessments and invitations to file are being issued and back-assessment is possible up to five years, but could not confirm whether any recipients are convicted war criminals as this is not held by the tax authority.
I am not aware whether there are convicted war criminals among the benefit recipients.
Het is mij niet bekend of zich onder de uitkeringsgerechtigden veroordeelde oorlogsmisdadigers bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een overzicht van alle wetten waar de Belastingdienst zich de afgelopen zeven jaar niet aan gehouden heeft

Omtzigt asked the government to provide, as required by a unanimously adopted motion, an overview of all laws the Tax Administration has not complied with over the past seven years, and questioned the government's compensation and resignation. The government answered that a single unambiguous overview is not possible, referred to examples in an accompanying letter, and said compensation in the childcare benefits case is not solely linked to breaking laws.
As set out in the accompanying letter, it is not possible to make an unambiguous overview.
Zoals volgt uit de begeleidende brief is het maken van een eenduidig overzicht niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een overzicht van delen van wetten die wel door het parlement zijn aangenomen maar nooit in de werking zijn getreden

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked why many tax and benefit provisions adopted by parliament never entered into force, and requested a full overview with reasons and information given to the Chamber. The State Secretary provided an annex listing unimplemented tax and benefit provisions over ten years, with stated reasons for delay, and acknowledged the ministry kept no central overview, promising to include the topic in annual reports.
The Ministry of Finance does not keep a central overview of whether tax or benefit legislation has entered into force; of course this is known within the responsible departments.
Het Ministerie van Financiën houdt niet centraal een overzicht bij of fiscale of toeslagen wet- en regelgeving in werking is getreden; uiteraard is dat wel bij de behandelende afdelingen bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over Conservatrix

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked the Finance Minister about the 2017 transfer of insurer Conservatrix to Trier Holding for 1 euro, the promised capital injection, and why funds ended up with a Barbados reinsurer. The minister confirmed the promised recapitalisation was legally binding, described the injections and later deterioration, withheld the transfer plan and related documents from public disclosure (available confidentially), declined responsibility for the supervised firm, and committed to an independent evaluation of DNB and ministry conduct from 2017 onward, with the scope and evaluators to be reported to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Slootweg en Amhaouch over het gedrag van Centric-topman Gerard Sanderink

CDA MPs asked ministers about Centric executive Gerard Sanderink's alleged threats to an inspector, destruction of evidence, ignored court rulings, and DNB's reliance on Centric software. The government answered that it would not publish his correspondence absent a request from investigators, that DNB as a contract partner monitors Centric, and that it cannot judge a private firm, while describing supervisory board powers in general terms.
At this moment I see no reason to make the correspondence in question public without a request from the bodies you mention.
Ik zie op dit moment geen redenen om bedoelde correspondentie openbaar te maken zonder dat daar een verzoek ligt van door u genoemde instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Peters en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Arbeidsinspectie gaf werkgevers jarenlang onterechte en te hoge boetes'

Three CDA MPs asked the minister about press reports that the labour inspectorate imposed wrongful and excessive fines, and about its appeal practice, matching of fines, and remedies for affected employers. The minister denied systematic misinformation, said appeals are decided case by case, and committed to a review of the graduated approach to minor workplace accidents.
No, there is no automatic or maximal pursuit of appeals. It is always a case-by-case weighing.
Nee, er wordt niet automatisch of zoveel mogelijk doorgeprocedeerd. Het betreft steeds een weging per geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Slootweg en Omtzigt over de terugvordering van bijstand

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a case where a benefit recipient was ordered to repay about 7,000 euro for donated food and the hardship of recovery rules, the discretion of municipalities, and the treatment of food-bank parcels. The State Secretary acknowledged concerns about hardness in the Participatiewet, pointed to municipal discretion and hardship exceptions, announced working groups and a review of harsh rules, but declined to judge individual cases and promised results in the second quarter of 2021.
From my systemic responsibility, it is not appropriate for me to judge individual cases.
Vanuit mijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid past het niet dat ik oordeel over individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de uitvoering van de motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het organiseren van een wereldconferentie van democratieën in Den Haag

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister how the motion to host a world conference of democracies in The Hague is being implemented, including whether contact has been made with the incoming Biden administration. The minister supports the planned Summit for Democracy, agrees The Hague is a suitable location, and says no policy contact was possible before the inauguration but contact will be sought afterwards.
After the inauguration, contact will be sought with the administration, including via the Dutch embassy, to learn more about this initiative.
Na de inauguratie zal er contact gezocht worden met de administratie, o.a. via de Nederlandse ambassade, om meer te weten te komen over dit initiatief.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de cruciale memo-Palmen – het officiële juridische advies over de CAF 11-zaak aan het managementteam van de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen, die 2,5 jaar voor bijna iedereen is achte

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance why the 2017 legal memo on the CAF 11 case (memo-Palmen) was absent from the timeline sent to Parliament, who received and discussed it, and what happened in June 2019. The State Secretary acknowledges the timeline omission and that acting on the memo could have spared harm, but declines detailed reconstruction of internal meetings, pointing to the parliamentary inquiry, and says answers could not be given by 7 January 2021.
In questions 8 through 25 you ask me to go into great detail about internal meetings, the conduct and statements of employees, and specific civil servants.
In de vragen 8 tot en met 25 vraagt u mij zeer gedetailleerd in te gaan op interne overleggen, op gedragingen en uitspraken van medewerkers en op specifieke ambtelijke functionarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over documenten in het toeslagenschandaal

An MP asks the State Secretary about a Landsadvocaat advice on document disclosure in childcare-benefit appeal cases, who received it, the 2018 CAF-11 directive, and related documents; the government confirms the advice exists, provides several documents, and states it could not answer all questions by the requested deadline. Most questions are answered with documents, though some items (full case files, names) are withheld.
This concerns the memo Assignment Strengthening quality assurance at the Tax Administration/Benefits, from the FJZ and UHB directorates to the Director-General of the Tax Administration.
Het betreft hier het memo Opdracht Versterking kwaliteitsborging bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen van de directie FJZ en UHB aan de directeur-generaal van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en het informeren van de Kamer

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked about delayed Wob freedom-of-information requests, the government's answers on the childcare benefit scandal, and the adequacy of earlier answers to parliament. The government denies deliberate delay for political reasons, says it knows of no such cases, admits some earlier answers were incomplete and promises to keep providing relevant information.
I will ask my colleagues to be more transparent going forward about the handling of a Wob request when handling it has taken a long time.
Ik zal mijn collega’s verzoeken in het vervolg transparanter te zijn over de afhandeling van een Wob-verzoek wanneer met de afhandeling van een Wob-verzoek veel tijd gemoeid is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over Ahrar-al-Sham

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister whether Ahrar al-Sham is a terrorist organisation, whether it benefited from Dutch non-lethal assistance, and whether it poses a threat in the Netherlands, among related questions. The minister answered that intelligence services do not see the group as a direct national security threat, that no non-lethal assistance reached it, and that it does not meet the conditions for national listing, while declining to comment publicly on other armed groups.
The cabinet does not make public statements about moderate armed groups that have or have not received NLA.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over gematigde gewapende groepen die al-dan-niet NLA hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Bosman, Bouali, Leijten, Asscher en Van Ojik over het juridische advies van de commissie over de Brexit-deal.

Six MPs and a Green MP asked the ministers whether the Council's Legal Service had put its advice on the Brexit deal in writing, and requested all internal and external legal advice on the deal, plus options for a smooth transition if the deal is mixed. The minister replied that the Legal Service confirmed its view only orally, that the conclusions will be written into the Council decision and a Commission statement, that the EU-only route is a political choice not binding on future deals, and that interim application of mixed parts is not possible, while the legal analysis and a confidential annex were shared with the Chamber.
There are no written opinions from the Council's Legal Service (JDR) on these questions; the JDR confirmed both points orally.
Er zijn over deze vraagstukken geen schriftelijke adviezen van de Juridische Dienst van de Raad (JDR) verschenen; de JDR heeft beide punten mondeling bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de onderhandelingen over het toekomstig partnerschap tussen de Europese Unie en het Verenigd Koninkrijk

An MP asks the government about the state of the Brexit trade deal, whether it is mixed competence requiring national ratification, and how much time parliament and businesses have to study it. The minister answers that the deal was reached on 24 December 2020 and published, refers to letters for substantive assessment, says the deal is an EU-only competence with no legal need for a mixed agreement, and states the government prefers the deal over no-deal despite the short timeline.
For a substantive assessment, the cabinet refers to the letter sent to your House simultaneously with the answers to these questions.
Voor een inhoudelijke appreciatie verwijst het kabinet naar de brief die gelijktijdig met de beantwoording op deze vragen naar uw Kamer is verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Dam over de verkoop van paspoorten

Two MPs from the CDA asked the government about golden passport schemes, including whether Curaçao's investor residence scheme meets European Commission requirements, how many people used it, an overview of such schemes in the Kingdom, and how many people in the Netherlands hold passports bought via Malta, Cyprus or Bulgaria.
