The government answered that Curaçao's scheme falls outside the Commission's requirements, that citizenship is a Kingdom matter, that Curaçao must account for participant numbers itself, and that the Netherlands has no investment-based citizenship scheme, while noting it does not know how EU citizens resident in the Netherlands obtained their nationality.
It is up to the Curaçao government to account for that.
Het is aan de Curaçaose regering om daarover verantwoording af te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vaststelling van de rendementen in box 3

The MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance how the box 3 return percentages were set, including the statutory formula, the MSCI index used, and past calculation errors. The State Secretary answered that the correct indices and percentages were applied, pointed to the earlier calculation letter for the 2019 derivation, and acknowledged in March 2020 a correction of small errors in the 2019 and 2020 forfaitaire returns that was made retroactively.
I would like to refer you for this to the fiscal motions and commitments letter of 18 September 2018.
Ik verwijs hiervoor graag naar de fiscale moties- en toezeggingenbrief van 18 september 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de hersteloperatie

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the childcare benefit recovery operation: whether parents can access their full files before being offered a settlement, the timing of payments, compliance with procedural principles, FSV blacklist effects, and archiving. The State Secretary answers that parents can access files at various stages on request, that no separate guidance exists on access sequencing, that procedural principles are considered respected, and that a memo and further documents are provided or explained.
The parent then receives the case-related documents compiled at that moment and the summary included in the form.
De ouder krijgt dan de op dat moment samengestelde op de zaak betrekking hebbende stukken en de samenvatting die in het formulier is opgenomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Geluk-Poortvliet en Van Helvert over de Hagia Sophia, die door Turkije tegen de regels van de Organisatie der Verenigde Naties voor Onderwijs, Wetenschap en Cultuur (UNESCO) in, i

Three CDA MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's conversion of the Hagia Sophia and Chora Museum into mosques, both UNESCO World Heritage sites, breaches UNESCO rules and whether the Netherlands will raise it at the Executive Board. The minister confirmed awareness of the conversions and covered frescoes, said the matter is for the World Heritage Committee to judge under the Outstanding Universal Value standard, and noted the Executive Board meeting was postponed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Dam en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Poland’s National Public Prosecutor is going to war with the Netherlands’

MPs Van Dam and Omtzigt asked the government about a Polish National Prosecutor instruction to find grounds to refuse Dutch European arrest warrants, its link to the Amsterdam court's suspension of Polish surrenders, and possible responses. The minister said the instruction is worrying and conflicts with mutual trust, that the Netherlands is not violating EU law, that the Dutch judiciary's independence is not in doubt, and that the government will raise the matter with the Commission and in bilateral and EU channels.
It is a worrying signal that the Polish National Prosecutor instructs Polish prosecutors to search for grounds to refuse Dutch surrender requests.

Het is een verontrustend signaal dat de Poolse nationale aanklager aan Poolse officieren van justitie een opdracht geeft om op zoek te gaan naar gronden om Nederlandse overleveringsverzoeken te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de CAF 11-zaak

Omtzigt (CDA) asks the State Secretary of Finance who commissioned and received the March 2017 technical memo on the CAF 11 case, why it was omitted from earlier answers on compensation, and whether other memos and withheld WOB documents exist. The State Secretary answers that the memo was written by the technical coordinator at MT request, that it was discussed in the MT in March 2017 but not passed up to the Director-General or State Secretary, that the WOB omission was an error being corrected, and that further internal investigations are underway with a plan to be shared.
Unfortunately this memo was not taken into consideration in that context.
Helaas is daarbij dit memo niet in ogenschouw genomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Kuiken, Van Ojik, De Roon, Karabulut en Voordewind over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, dat ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneem

Six MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice why the Dutch child Insiya, abducted to India by her father, has not been returned, what steps have been taken, and whether ministers will personally intervene. The government answered that Dutch court rulings are not automatically binding in India, that it keeps raising the case bilaterally and at high level, and that it has contact persons for the mother, but that return depends on Indian legal procedures and it will not detail enforcement steps against the father.
The Netherlands will keep drawing India's attention to the rulings of the Dutch court and will closely follow the proceedings in India.
Nederland zal de uitspraken van de Nederlandse rechter bij India onder de aandacht blijven brengen en zal uitspraak in de procedures in India nauwlettend volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over “de hoge marginale druk over een pensioenuitkering ineens en het feit dat het van je geboortedatum afhangt of je soms 20% extra belasting moet betalen over een uitkering ineens

MP Omtzigt asked whether the marginal tax burden on a lump-sum pension payment depends on the recipient's birth month, with rates up to 55% for those reaching AOW age in December versus 19-28% for January, and whether this is justified and legally sound under age-discrimination rules. The minister confirmed the mechanism, defended it as inherent to the tax system and as a voluntary option, and acknowledged the burden varies but declined to see it as unjust.
It is important to emphasise that the lump-sum amount is an optional choice.
Het is belangrijk hierbij te benadrukken dat het bedrag ineens een keuzemogelijkheid is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over het recht op partnerpensioen op risicobasis na beëindiging dienstverband

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked the Social Affairs minister about survivors' pension rights after a switch from capital-based to risk-based partner pension, the requirement of informed consent, and limitation periods. The minister answered that compensation depends on the case, that a dynamic incorporation clause requires good information, and that no standardised claims procedure is needed because hardship clauses in pension schemes provide a route.

In my view, this ruling does not mean that in all cases where there was no conscious consent to the switch from a survivors' pension on accrual basis to one on risk basis, the survivor is entitled to compensation.

Mijns inziens betekent deze uitspraak niet dat in alle gevallen waarin geen welbewuste instemming is geweest met de overgang van een nabestaandenpensioen op opbouwbasis naar een nabestaandenpensioen op risicobasis, recht bestaat op een schadevergoeding voor de nabestaande.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de geheime Europese Uniemissie (EU) naar Venezuela en het bericht dat de EU Ambassadeur in Venezuela een propagandarapport in ontvangst heeft genomen uit handen

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about an EU delegation's late-September 2020 visit to Venezuela and the EU ambassador's receipt of a pro-government propaganda report from Tarek William Saab, a sanctioned official. The minister answered all 18 questions, denying that the mission or the report legitimised the Maduro government, stating that a mission cannot be held to conditions it has not set, and promising to keep the dialogue and human rights pressure going.
No. Both during and after the EU mission it was conveyed that Venezuela does not meet the conditions for holding free and fair elections.
Nee. Zowel tijdens als na de EU-missie is uitgedragen dat Venezuela niet voldoet aan de voorwaarden voor het houden van vrije en eerlijke verkiezingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de inzet van Syrische rebellen door Turkije in de oorlog om Nagorno-Karabach

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey deployed Syrian rebel fighters to support Azerbaijan in the Nagorno-Karabakh war, whether Dutch-supplied non-lethal assistance reached such groups, and what the government would do about it. The minister confirmed Turkish military involvement and condemned external interference, called for an OSCE investigation and EU statements, but declined to say whether Dutch-supported groups were involved, citing traceability, and said recovery of supplied equipment was no longer possible after monitoring ended.
Because of the traceability to the moderate armed groups supported by the Netherlands, publicly it cannot be addressed whether previously Dutch-supported moderate armed groups were involved.

In verband met herleidbaarheid naar de door Nederland gesteunde gematigde gewapende groepen, kan er in het openbaar niet worden ingegaan op eventuele betrokkenheid van voorheen door Nederland gesteunde gematigde gewapende groepen.
Antwoord op het lid Omtzigt over de parallelimport van auto's

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the volume of parallel-imported cars, the BPM and VAT collected on them, the share that were damaged or used, and the ten-year trend. The State Secretary provided tables on imports, BPM revenue, VAT reasoning and multi-year figures, while noting that data was compiled from several applications because the Databank Auto analysis environment was out of use.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra  en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Subsidiepot stroomauto’s nu al op’

MPs Lodders, Remco Dijkstra and Omtzigt asked whether the EV subsidy budget running out within eight days, the cost per avoided tonne of CO2, the limited climate gain and the Court of Audit's criticism of car taxes justify the scheme. The state secretary answered that the costs per avoided tonne fall to about 450 euro by 2025, that the scheme stays within budget and the Klimaatakkoord commitments, and that the carry-over rule for unused budget will be stopped, but gave no definitive per-tonne benchmark.
All calculations that have been carried out have already been sent to you on 3 July 2019.
Alle berekeningen die zijn uitgevoerd, heeft u reeds ontvangen op 3 juli 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Postma en Omtzigt over de toepassing van het tonnageregime voor de offshoresector

MPs Mulder, Postma and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch tonnage tax regime is stricter than in other EU countries, whether it covers vessels used to build offshore wind farms, and what this means for cost and competitiveness. The government answered that the Dutch regime is stricter on some points (e.g. Denmark allows construction-vessel profits), that wind-farm operation profits are excluded, that transport vessels to offshore parks can qualify, and that it will await an evaluation due in early 2021 before deciding on any change.
The cabinet wants to await the aforementioned evaluation before making statements on the desirability and design of any possible adjustment to the tonnage regime.
Het kabinet wil de hiervoor genoemde evaluatie afwachten, alvorens uitspraken te doen over de wenselijkheid en vormgeving van een eventuele aanpassing van de tonnageregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een aantal specifieke documenten inzake de kinderopvangtoeslagaffaire

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about article 68 of the Constitution, a February 2020 motion on individual MPs receiving specific documents, and the refusal of certain documents in the childcare benefits affair, including unredacted WOB documents and a June 2019 briefing note, and asked for their delivery by a deadline. The government answered that it will honour targeted requests for specific documents from individual MPs, but did not directly address the refused documents and only referred to a separate letter for the rest.
Against that background, the cabinet wants to honour targeted requests for specific documents from an MP.
Tegen die achtergrond wil het kabinet gerichte verzoeken om specifieke documenten van een Kamerlid honoreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de mogelijke rechtsbasis van sancties tegen Wit-Rusland

Omtzigt asked whether the Sanctiewet 1977 allows sanctions against Belarus via an intergovernmental agreement among EU states, and how broadly 'internationale afspraken' is defined. Minister Blok confirmed the statutory text, said such an agreement could provide the basis but would take considerable time and conflict with ongoing EU Council negotiations, and described 'internationale afspraken' as a broad concept.
An intergovernmental agreement could be a sufficient legal basis to adopt a general administrative order with sanctions against Belarus or individuals from Belarus.
Een intergouvernementele afspraak zou voldoende rechtsbasis kunnen zijn om een algemene maatregel van bestuur vast te stellen met sancties tegen Wit-Rusland of individuen uit Wit-Rusland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de illegale vernietiging van archieven bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen, mogelijke strafbaarheid daarvan en een stop op elke vernietiging van archieven van de Belastingdienst/T

An MP asked whether the destruction of around 9,000 Toeslagen appeal files under a Belastingdienst selection list was unlawful, whether it could amount to a criminal offence, and whether all destruction of Toeslagen archives should be halted. The State Secretary regretted the destruction, admitted the wrong selection list was applied due to mixing of files, stopped further destruction of Toeslagen files and management records, and declined to qualify the conduct as an intentional criminal offence while providing destruction declarations and promising to consult parliament before lifting the moratorium.
As long as it is not known whether the process has been fully completed or the allowance has ended, under the 2015 Toeslagen selection list destruction may not proceed.
Zolang niet bekend is of het proces volledig is afgehandeld, dan wel de toeslag is beëindigd mag conform de selectielijst Toeslagen van 2015 niet tot vernietiging worden overgegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya Hemani, dat ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneemt om haar terug te krijgen in Nederland

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the government about the 2016 abduction of Dutch toddler Insiya Hemani to India, the enforcement of Dutch court rulings on her return, and what is being done to bring her back. The ministers confirmed awareness of the case and court rulings, said the Indian authorities are being pressed via diplomatic notes but that enforcement in India cannot be compelled by the Netherlands and that India's child-custody and immigration matters are for Indian law.
In this case, Dutch court rulings are being presented to the Indian authorities through diplomatic channels so that they can take note of them.
Nederlandse gerechtelijke uitspraken worden in deze zaak langs diplomatieke weg aangeboden aan de Indiase autoriteiten om daar kennis van te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het incomplete AVG-verwerkingsregister en over onbeantwoorde belangrijke vragen over de kinderopvangtoeslagaffaire

MP Omtzigt asked whether the Tax Authority knew of other blacklists beyond FSV, why KPMG's June 2020 draft findings were not reported to parliament, what project 1043 is, and when the Tax Authority will have a complete, up-to-date processing register under the GDPR. The state secretaries answered that KPMG's drafts only pointed to possibly comparable systems, that project 1043 is a risk-detection project code, that a complete register is at least three years away, and that questions on the childcare benefit scandal would be answered later.
On 10 July the final report was adopted and sent to your House that same day.
Op 10 juli jl. is het definitieve rapport vastgesteld en dat is die dag nog aan uw Kamer toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Omtzigt over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer ‘Autobelastingen als instrument’

MPs Lodders, Remco Dijkstra and Omtzigt asked the state secretaries of Finance and Infrastructure about the Court of Audit report on car taxes, questioning the cost per avoided tonne of CO2, the climate gain, the clarity of policy goals and whether the 'hand aan de kraan' monitoring system prevents overstimulation. The government rejected the report's conclusions, arguing the costs are overstated, promising to send the first hand-aan-de-kraan analysis results to Parliament shortly.
The cabinet will send the outcomes to your House in the short term.
Het kabinet zal de uitkomsten op korte termijn uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Omtzigt, van Weyenberg en Bruins over het bericht ‘Storing Belastingdienst: ondernemers krijgen week extra voor btw-aangifte’

MPs asked whether the Tax Authority's portal outage on 31 July 2020 justified a general extension and no fines for late VAT returns and payments. The state secretary confirmed the outage and the extension to 7 August, with fines waived under existing policy and the Covid emergency measures.
That is correct; between 30 July 23:35 and 31 July 14:15 it was not possible to submit VAT returns online because the MijnBelastingdienst/Zakelijk portal was unavailable.
Dat klopt, tussen 30 juli 23:35 uur en 31 juli 14:15 uur was het niet mogelijk btw-aangiften in te dienen via internet omdat het betreffende portaal MijnBelastingdienst/Zakelijk onbereikbaar was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Nispen en Sjoerdsma inzake het bericht over de zaak van de heer Singh

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Nispen and Sjoerdsma asked the Minister of Legal Protection what steps had been taken after a motion to bring Jaitsen Singh, detained in a US prison for 36 years, to the Netherlands, including whether a transfer request existed, whether the discretionary power should be used to start a transfer procedure, and whether diplomatic pressure for clemency would be pursued. The minister replied that no formal transfer request exists, that the US review is ongoing, that no transfer procedure will be initiated by the Netherlands, and that diplomatic support for a clemency request by Singh himself will be provided if no societal risks are involved.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het project 26Lemont, Encrochat en de douane

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance how far official corruption within Customs has been found in the Encrochat police investigation, and asked for a reply before the Customs committee debate. The State Secretary replied that Customs does not investigate corruption signals itself, that such signals are handled by the Rijksrecherche and FIOD under the Public Prosecution Service (Justice ministry), and that the government does not comment on ongoing investigations, while promising to keep reviewing integrity risks with the police and FIOD.
In general, the Cabinet makes no statements about ongoing investigations.
In zijn algemeenheid doet het Kabinet geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over vele ouders die in deze zomervakantie een brief kregen om binnen de veel te korte termijn van twee weken bewijsstukken over de kinderopvangtoeslag 2019 op te sturen

An MP asked why tens of thousands of parents received requests in the summer holiday to submit childcare allowance evidence within two weeks, and whether this was a repeat of earlier unlawful stop-and-reminder practices. The State Secretary answered that about 126,000 letters were sent, that the reminder term was extended to three weeks, that the earlier unlawful practice is acknowledged, and that a proposal on reaction and reminder deadlines will follow.
Given the unfortunate summer dispatch, a reminder period of three weeks will be applied in the situation.
Vanwege de ongelukkige verzending in de zomer zal gezien de situatie een rappeltermijn van drie weken worden gehanteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Rog en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Haast geboden met ventilatie op scholen’

Three CDA MPs asked ministers whether ventilation rules for schools were known before the school year, how many schools meet current Bouwbesluit ventilation standards, and what measures RIVM, the Belastingdienst and ministries took. The government answered that existing building code rules apply, that school boards are responsible and no data on school ventilation is collected, and that the answers to the questions were delayed.
No data are collected or kept on the ventilation of school buildings.
Er worden geen gegevens verzameld of bijgehouden over de ventilatie van schoolgebouwen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over mensen die van tafel en bed gescheiden zijn, dezelfde mantelzorgregels van toepassing voor de Algemene Ouderdomswet (AOW) als op mensen die niet getrouwd zijn

CDA MPs Slootweg and Omtzigt asked whether separated-from-bed-and-board spouses face the same AOW pension cohabitation rules as unmarried people, including the two-dwelling rule, and why website information on this is lacking. Minister Koolmees answered that married persons who live separately are assessed like married couples on whether they live durably apart, that the two-dwelling rule applies only to unmarried people, and that the ministry will explore simplifying the cohabitation rules and has updated the SVB website, but gave no evaluation of the checks.
No evaluation of the approach to checking durable separate living is available.
Er is geen evaluatie van de aanpak van controle van duurzaam gescheiden leven beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de betrokkenheid van door Nederland betaalde UAWC-medewerkers bij de terreurorganisatie PFLP en het feit dat zij verdacht worden van een terreuraanslag, waarbij

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the foreign and development ministers what the government knew about Dutch-funded UAWC staff allegedly linked to the PFLP and a 2019 bombing, and about the funding involved. The ministers answered that the staff were paid partly from Dutch project funds, that payments were suspended, that audits were not yet shared due to data protection, and that an external investigation has been commissioned.
Our intention is to share these documents with you as soon as possible.
Onze intentie is om deze documenten zo spoedig mogelijk met u te delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de financiering van UAWC met Nederlands belastinggeld en de overeenkomst tussen Nederland en de UAWC nadat bekend geworden was dat twee hooggeplaatste medewerke

Two CDA MPs asked why Dutch funding to UAWC continued after two former staff were suspected of a terrorist bombing, and about the subsidy agreement's reporting and sanction clauses. The ministers answered that funding was suspended, that no irregularities were formally reported under article 6, that UAWC is not listed as terrorist by the EU, UN or Netherlands, and that an external investigation will be commissioned.
The cabinet nonetheless considers it necessary to commission further external research into UAWC in light of the recent developments.
Het kabinet acht het niettemin noodzakelijk nader extern onderzoek naar UAWC te laten doen op grond van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over de noodremprocedure

Two CDA MPs asked the Prime Minister whether the Commission can pay out recovery funds after three months if the Council does not agree on a Dutch-raised emergency brake concern, and how the procedure works. The government confirmed the procedure, explained that the Council must reach unanimity, that the Commission can fall back on the EFC route, and that the procedure was agreed with Commission and Council presidency involvement.
The starting point is that the procedure from the moment of consultation of the EFC generally lasts no longer than three months.
Het uitgangspunt is dat de procedure vanaf het moment van raadpleging van het EFC in de regel niet langer dan drie maanden duurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over 9000 dossiers die onterecht vernietigd zijn

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about roughly 9,000 childcare-allowance appeal files that were destroyed early, and about withdrawn appeals suggesting the tax authority may have reversed decisions before hearings to avoid adverse case law. The State Secretary answered that the authority reviews cases before hearings to grant rights quickly, that about 7,087 files were destroyed in 2020 and others earlier, and that the Inspectorate for Government Information and Heritage will examine the early destruction.

The Inspectorate for Government Information and Heritage has meanwhile indicated that it will include the premature destruction of files in its investigation into information and archive management at the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances.

De Inspectie Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed heeft inmiddels laten weten dat ze de vroegtijdige vernietiging van dossiers in haar onderzoek naar het informatie- en archiefbeheer bij Belastingdienst/Toeslagen zal meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het keihard liegen door de Belastingdienst/toeslagen

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary whether the Belastingdienst knowingly misled the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, withheld documents from parents and courts, and what sanctions apply to lying to the tax authority. The State Secretary acknowledged the 2017 information to the AP was incorrect and regrettable but found no concrete evidence of intent, described remedial steps such as more generous document disclosure and apologies, and gave a partial answer on sanctions.
From the above it appears that in 2017 there was indeed an incorrect presentation of facts, but it cannot be concluded that this happened knowingly and deliberately.
Uit het vorenstaande komt naar voren dat in 2017 weliswaar sprake was van een onjuiste voorstelling van zaken, maar dat niet valt te concluderen dat dit willens en wetens gebeurde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Dam en Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht ‘Erdogan wil weer bidden in de Hagia Sophia’

CDA MPs asked whether the government finds it unacceptable that Turkey may convert the Hagia Sophia from museum to mosque, what steps it would take, and whether it will lobby UNESCO. The government replied that the building's function is an internal Turkish matter, that the Netherlands with EU partners has urged respect for its symbolic role and free access, and that UNESCO's assessment focuses on preserving universal value rather than the building's function.
The precise function of the Hagia Sophia is an internal matter for Turkey.
De precieze functie van de Hagia Sophia is een interne aangelegenheid van Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de «Fraude Signalering Voorziening» (FSV) en de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance how the Tax Authority's Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV) and its data protection impact assessment related to GDPR duties to consult the data protection officer and the Dutch DPA. The answers explain the timeline, that FSV was switched off after a critical assessment, that the DPA was informed on 2 March 2020 and is investigating, and commit to further information, redesign of processes and a letter on the matter.
The Tax Authority informed the Dutch DPA on 2 March 2020 about FSV because an application was in use for which the mitigating measures were insufficiently implemented.
De Belastingdienst heeft op 2 maart 2020 de AP geïnformeerd over FSV omdat er een applicatie in gebruik was waarbij de mitigerende maatregelen onvoldoende geïmplementeerd waren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de wijze waarop de Commissie van wijzen geoordeeld heeft dat bepaalde CAF-zaken wel vergelijkbaar zijn met CAF-11, waardoor de hele groep ouders in principe in aanmerking komt

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about how the Commission of Wise Persons judged which childcare benefit (CAF) cases were comparable to CAF-11, and why the Commission lacked full document access, among 21 questions. The State Secretary admitted that some information given to the Commission was incorrect, promised re-assessment of eight cases and a review of procedures, but declined to answer several questions in full and pointed to a separate letter.
To correct the errors, the eight previously rejected CAF cases will be reassessed and I am taking the following measures.
Om de fouten te herstellen, zullen de eerder afgewezen acht CAF-zaken herbeoordeeld worden en tref ik daarbij de volgende maatregelen.

Antwoord op van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Leijten, Verhoeven en Kuiken over het onderzoek naar de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen (RUG) en zijn rol in de promotie van de ver

MPs asked about the RUG-commissioned investigation into professor Kochenov's secondary activities and his role in promoting the sale of passports on Malta, and whether he continued such advisory work. The minister reported that the report was released, that no passport-related advisory activities were found after September 2019 apart from attending a Henley & Partners congress, and that she cannot guarantee such cases will not recur.
The research report has today been made public by the RUG, and as promised I have sent you a copy of this report.
Het onderzoeksrapport is heden openbaar gemaakt door de RUG, een afschrift van dit rapport heb ik u – conform mijn toezegging – doen toekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over inzage in de dossiers door de ouders die getroffen zijn door de kinderopvangtoeslagaffaire (en daar al negen maanden op wachten terwijl de wettelijke deadline toch echt een of

Omtzigt asks why the tax authority has not issued decisions within the three-month GDPR deadline on parents' requests for their childcare-benefit files, whether it will notify them so they can claim penalty payments, and when all files will be delivered. The state secretary argues full-file requests are not GDPR access requests, so no statutory deadline applies, says 620 of 661 requests remain pending, and gives no firm date for delivery or for payment arrangements for those with fraud-type findings.
Parents who requested personal data, whether or not invoking Article 15 GDPR, must receive it with a decision from the Tax Authority within three months.
Ouders die, al dan niet met een beroep op artikel 15 van de AVG, persoonsgegevens hebben opgevraagd, moeten dit met een besluit van de Belastingdienst binnen drie maanden ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Omtzigt over het verstrekken van volledige dossiers aan gedupeerde ouders in de toeslagenaffaire

MPs Leijten and Omtzigt asked why the Tax Administration postponed sending full case files to affected childcare-benefit parents and how they can obtain their files and the grounds for decisions. The State Secretary answered that file compilation is very labour-intensive, that staff will call parents to establish their actual information needs, that no formal decisions were issued because the file requests fall outside Article 15 GDPR, and that a date for sending files will be communicated next month.
I will inform your House about this next month.
Hierover informeer ik uw kamer volgende maand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van den Berg over importheffingen en btw op mondkapjes en andere persoonlijke beschermingsmaterialen, die gebruikt worden in de strijd tegen het coronavirus

MPs Omtzigt and Van den Berg asked the State Secretaries of Finance about import duties and VAT on face masks and protective equipment during the coronavirus crisis, including whether healthcare institutions could be exempted and whether VAT could be lowered and competition rules clarified. The government answered that exemptions are available via EU rules and a Customs permit procedure, that the Netherlands applied for and obtained EU authorisation, that VAT on consumer masks was cut to 0% from 25 May 2020, and that the ACM provides guidance on cooperative purchasing.
The cabinet has decided to temporarily reduce the VAT on domestic sales of face masks to 0%.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om tijdelijk de btw op de binnenlandse verkoop van mondkapjes te verlagen naar 0%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over de planning van het onderzoek budgetneutrale overstap WLTP

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked why the results of the study on budget-neutral WLTP transition would only be shared in July 2020, who would conduct it, and how independence is guaranteed, following a motion requesting an independent review by early summer. The state secretary answers that the timing was an estimate of the time needed, names Prof. C. Koopmans (SEO, VU) as independent second-opinion reviewer, and sets out the research questions, including macro and top-ten-car budget neutrality, with a request to complete it before 1 June 2020.
Prof. dr. C. Koopmans will carry out an independent review, in the form of a second opinion, of the budget-neutral conversion of the bpm table to CO2 emissions under the WLTP test method.
Prof. dr. C. Koopmans zal in de vorm van een second opinion een onafhankelijke toets uitvoeren op de budgettair neutrale omzetting van de bpm-tabel naar de CO 2 -uitstoot volgens de WLTP-testmethode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over over tienduizenden appartementeigenaren die een te hoge WOZ-beschikking ontvangen

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked whether municipalities wrongly include the owner's share of the VvE reserve in WOZ valuations of apartments, contrary to a court ruling, and how this interacts with box 1 and box 3 taxation. The State Secretary answered that the reserve share is excluded from the WOZ value, that municipalities only adjust for significant reserves when analysing comparable sales, and that no change to box 3 treatment is needed.
For all municipalities, the (possible) share in the Owners' Association (VvE) reserve does not count in the valuation of the apartment under the WOZ Act.

Voor alle gemeenten geldt dat het (eventuele) aandeel in de reserve van de Vereniging van Eigenaren (hierna: VvE-reserve) niet meetelt bij de waardebepaling van het betreffende appartement in het kader van de Wet WOZ.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een uitspraak van de Raad van State waardoor waarschijnlijk miljoenen beschikkingen van de belastingdienst/toeslagen over terugvordering of herzieningen van voorschotten op toe

MP Omtzigt asked whether a Council of State ruling showed that millions of Tax Administration/Toeslagen decisions on childcare and other benefit advances, including reductions and reclaims, were not legally in force because they were sent only electronically, and what the consequences were. The State Secretary acknowledged the ruling, admitted about 20 million revised advance decisions since 2015 were sent only digitally, and announced a regulatory amendment from 1 July 2020 to continue the practice, with a limited group of objectors given a path to contest.
Due to the Council of State ruling, part of the first step has proven not legally valid.
Door de uitspraak van de Raad van State is een deel van de eerste stap niet rechtsgeldig gebleken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert en Van den Berg over het Coronafonds van de Europese Commissie en over het Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI)-initiatief van de G20

Three CDA MPs asked the government about the EU coronavirus investment initiative (CRII) allocations per member state, why Poland and Hungary receive large sums while the Netherlands receives very little, and about EU vaccine production and CEPI participation. The ministers answered that the CRII redistributes remaining cohesion funds based mainly on economic prosperity and implementation progress, not on COVID-19 impact, and that the government views CEPI positively and will consider a contribution, with information to follow in the weekly Corona letter.
The size of the available CRII budget per member state is therefore independent of the scale of the COVID-19 crisis in that member state.
De omvang van het beschikbare CRII-budget per lidstaat staat dus los van de omvang van de COVID-19-crisis in de betreffende lidstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palland, Amhaouch, Wiersma, Verhoeven, Bruins, Gijs van Dijk, Van Kent en Stoffer over het aangekondigde massaontslag bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs asked the government about the announced loss of 750 jobs at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, a new Hungarian plant that received subsidies, and whether EU state aid rules were breached, and whether the government would press the Commission or the company. The minister replied that the Commission judged the Hungarian aid compatible with the internal market, saw no reason to contact the Commission or Hungary, said there were no prior warnings of reorganisation in contacts with the owner and the Enschede management, and left the social plan to the company while pointing to a regional deal.
Should further study of the case give cause for it, I will bring this to the attention of the Commission and my colleagues involved.
Mocht er na verdere bestudering van de casus aanleiding toe zijn dan zal ik dat bij de Commissie en mijn collega's die hierbij zijn betrokken onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over “de toestemming van DNB voor de fusie tussen Optas en Aegon”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about DNB's approval of the Optas-Aegon merger, including whether policyholders were harmed by the loss of a tax benefit and whether they could have objected. The minister answered most questions, explaining DNB's position that policyholders are not parties to the decision, the publication steps taken, and that court proceedings are pending, while declining to rule on matters before the court or to have DNB verify objection counts.
In this case it is not for me to pass judgment on DNB's conduct.
Het is in onderhavig geval niet aan mij om een oordeel uit te spreken over de handelwijze van DNB.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Weyenberg en Lodders over banken die op grond van de FATCA-wetgeving financiële dienstverlening weigeren aan Nederlanders met (ook) de Amerikaanse nationaliteit

Three MPs asked whether banks may block or close accounts of Dutch citizens who also hold US nationality (Accidental Americans) for lacking a US TIN under FATCA, and what the government will do. The Secretary of State answers that closure is not required by FATCA or the IGA, that supervisors DNB and AFM apply case-by-case rules, that no closures had yet occurred, and that the government keeps pressing the US for solutions while declining to restrict data exchange unilaterally.
I am aware of what my predecessor wrote to the House.
Ik ben bekend met hetgeen mijn ambtsvoorganger aan uw Kamer heeft geschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over verworven rechten in de huurtoeslag

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Ronnes, CDA) asked about the Supreme Court-era ruling that lost acquired rights to rent allowance (huurtoeslag) can revive, and why the Tax Administration did not disclose that an automation error had applied a different practice from 2012 to 2017 affecting about 185 households in 2017 and an unknown number elsewhere. The State Secretary answered that the error was discovered and corrected only for 2017, that the figures were not fully known, that communication was late, and that the government will examine how the Council of State ruling can apply retroactively to the remaining households, reporting back by May.
Due to the duty of confidentiality, I cannot address individual cases.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting kan ik niet op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een toeslag vanwege samenvallende diensttijd voor gepensioneerden bij het ABP

Omtzigt asked the Minister about the ABP supplement for overlapping service years (samenvallende diensttijd), covering eligibility, how pensioners were informed and reminded, amounts, transfers to other funds, widows' rights, the PTT privatisation, and the number of recipients and unpaid entitlements. The Minister answered that ABP has now informed pensioners more clearly, that about 6,600 entitled pensioners were not yet paid and will receive back payments before 1 July 2020, and that ABP is checking roughly 3,500 more cases.
ABP will grant and pay the supplements to this group in the coming months and no later than 1 July 2020, with retroactive effect.
ABP zal de aanvullingen voor deze groep in de komende maanden en uiterlijk voor 1 juli 2020 met terugwerkende kracht toekennen en uitbetalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ronnes en Amhaouch over de problemen bij Centric en Oranjewoud

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about governance problems at Centric, Oranjewoud and Strukton, including an unlicensed investigator, the departure of Centric's top management, and board supervision. The government answered that Centric's services to DNB and BNG are unaffected for now, that no investigator licence exists, that FIOD received and declined to treat a complaint due to criminal proceedings, and explained the legal duties of supervisory boards, while noting the answers were delayed.
Due to overlap with investigation and prosecution under article 9:8(1)(f) of the General Administrative Law Act, this complaint, in consultation with the Public Prosecution Service, was not handled.
Wegens samenloop met opsporing en vervolging conform art. 9:8 lid 1 onderdeel f Awb is deze klacht, in afstemming met het Openbaar Ministerie, niet in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert, Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Gangelt is vastgesteld, direct grenzend aan Limburg

MPs of the CDA asked the ministers about COVID-19 cases in Gangelt near the Dutch border, cross-border coordination, quarantine and airport controls, hospital bed capacity, and travel advice. The minister answered that the GGD Zuid-Limburg coordinates with Germany, that airport controls are not considered appropriate, that at least 250 isolation ICU beds exist, and that travel advice follows RIVM risk assessments.
I will answer these questions as soon as possible.
Ik beantwoord deze vragen zo spoedig mogelijk.
Antwoord op van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de uitbraak van het coronavirus.

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about the coronavirus outbreak, including its infectiousness during incubation, passenger tracing from the Westerdam, EU coordination, travel restrictions and travel advice. The minister answered that transmission during incubation plays a very limited role per RIVM, that EU coordination runs through ECDC and the HSC, and that WHO and ECDC advise against trade or travel restrictions.
Based on the scientific knowledge of the RIVM, we assume that the new coronavirus is transmitted through coughing and sneezing.
Op basis van de wetenschappelijke kennis van het RIVM nemen wij aan dat het nieuwe coronavirus wordt overgedragen door hoesten en niezen.
Antwoord op de eerste drie vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Kuik en Van Helvert over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Noordrijn-Westfalen is vastgesteld, vlakbij Limburg

CDA MPs asked ministers for an update on new COVID-19 infections near the Dutch border, whether German schools had closed, and what advice applies to Dutch schools, firms and travellers. The Minister of Medical Care answered that contact tracing is ongoing in Germany with no need for extra Dutch measures, that German schools closing is noted, and that Dutch schools and workplaces can stay open.
The situation is being closely monitored and measures will follow if necessary.
De situatie wordt op de voet gevolgd en indien nodig volgen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de passagiers op het schip Westerdam

MPs Kuik, Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked about passengers stranded on the cruise ship Westerdam in Cambodia, their information, repatriation, passenger lists, and the RIVM's earlier claim that people are only contagious once symptomatic. The minister answered that most questions were addressed in an earlier letter, that about 30 Dutch nationals have returned, that returnees are monitored by the GGD, and that current RIVM knowledge supports the incubation and transmission figures, while acknowledging the contagiousness statement as based on current evidence.
Answer 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 These questions I have already answered in the letter to the House of 17 February.
Antwoord 2, 3, 4, 5 en 7 Deze vragen heb ik reeds beantwoord in de Kamerbrief van 17 februari jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins, Sienot en Lodders over het bericht dat de prijs van elektriciteit van snelladers wordt verhoogd naar 79 cent/kWH voor passanten

MPs asked whether the government will investigate market power and cartel formation among fast-charger operators after Ionity raised guest charging prices to 79 cent/kWh, and whether a maximum price should be set. The government answered that ACM is independent and has heightened attention for the sector, that the market is open and competitive, and that a maximum price is not currently under consideration.
The Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is an independent regulator.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Omtzigt over eHerkenning

Two MPs (Bruins and Omtzigt) asked the government about eHerkenning, the electronic login required for tax filing by legal entities, including whether foreign organisations, churches and small entities are excluded and whether the rollout is legally and availability-wise sound. The State Secretary answered at length, largely defending the scheme, outlining workarounds for excluded groups and promising a study on availability and interim reports before summer, while not answering all questions one by one.
Due to the care required in answering, and the need for further coordination with the Minister of BZK, it proved not feasible to answer these questions one by one and by 31 January 2020.

In verband met de zorgvuldigheid van de beantwoording, waarvoor ook nadere afstemming met de Minister van BZK noodzakelijk was, is het niet haalbaar gebleken om deze vragen één voor één en voor 31 januari 2020 te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het verplichte gebruik van eHerkenning bij de Belastingdienst

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the Tax Administration makes eHerkenning (level 3, a private authentication means) mandatory for payroll and corporation tax returns from 1 January 2020, questioning its legal basis, communication, EU comparisons, liability, impact assessment and the relation to the Digital Government Act. The state secretary answered that article 2:15 Awb and the AWR/Regeling EBV provide the basis, that the requirement follows from GDPR security duties, and that notice was given by letter and website, while acknowledging the regulation's annex needed correcting and that no formal impact assessment was made.
This will be corrected in the short term by means of a ministerial regulation with retroactive effect to 1 January 2020.
Dit zal op korte termijn door middel van een ministeriële regeling met terugwerkende kracht tot 1 januari 2020 rechtgezet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het feit dat Italië alle vluchten tussen Italië en China heeft opgeschort

Four CDA MPs asked ministers about Italy suspending China flights, Chinese tourists with coronavirus in Italy, KLM suspending China flights, travel advice, EU coordination, quarantine of returnees, and international support for vulnerable countries. The government answered that Dutch procedures match Italy's, that EU health measures remain with member states, that it follows WHO advice against disproportionate restrictions, and that no additional Dutch funding seems necessary now.
Measures regarding health are reserved to the member states.
Maatregelen ten aanzien van de gezondheid zijn voorbehouden aan de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Omtzigt en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Vanaf 1 januari wordt op de Universiteit Twente alleen Engels gesproken’

MPs Van der Molen, Omtzigt and Wiersma asked the Minister of Education whether the University of Twente's decision to use only English as its official language conflicts with ECHR article 14 and Awb article 2:6, and what the government will do. The Minister answered that the decision was taken in 2015, that no discrimination or legal violation has been identified, that language choice is for the institution with its works council, and that she will not intervene but expects the universities to consider accessibility effects.
If it were to turn out that the ECHR is not complied with because an employee or student is discriminated against, the usual legal protection is of course open to that student or employee.

Als zou blijken dat niet aan het EVRM wordt voldaan omdat een medewerker of student wordt gediscrimineerd, dan staat hiertegen uiteraard de gebruikelijke rechtsbescherming open voor de betreffende student of medewerker.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over het feit dat Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen tot 8 januari over Irak en Iran bleven vliegen en over de opvolging van aanbe

MPs asked why Dutch airlines kept flying over Iran and Iraq until 8 January 2020, what information was shared, and how the OVV's MH17 conflict-zone recommendations have been implemented. The minister answered that KLM stopped flying there about 1.5 hours after the US FAA ban, that EASA and ICAO advisories were issued and the status of each OVV recommendation was described, while stating that airspace sovereignty and closure duties lie with states and promising further international and national follow-up.
Following the attack on the Iranian general on 2 January, the situation was actively monitored by the Netherlands (Expert Group of the Convenant on sharing threat information for civil aviation).
Naar aanleiding van de aanslag op de Iraanse generaal op 2 jan jl. is de situatie door Nederland (Expertgroep van het Convenant deling dreigingsinformatie burgerluchtvaart) actief gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Omtzigt, Kuiken en Verhoeven over de paspoorthandel van Malta en de betrokkenheid van een professor van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs asked the government about Malta's citizenship-by-investment scheme, the listed buyers of Maltese passports, the AIVD warning, the Rule of Law situation in Malta, and a Groningen professor's links to a passport firm. The minister answered that the Maltese list covers all naturalisations, that the Commission is monitoring such schemes and the government will seek dialogue, that the Prime Minister raised rule-of-law concerns with his Maltese counterpart, and that the university is examining the professor's activities.
The cabinet considers the sale of passports to non-EU citizens who are suspected of crimes to be undesirable.
Het kabinet acht de verkoop van paspoorten aan niet-EU burgers, die onder verdenking staan van misdrijven, ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over het onderzoek naar de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked about the investigation into Professor Kochenov's outside positions, including advisory work for Malta and links to Henley & Partners and the Investment Migration Council, and the Paradise Papers. The minister answered that an external investigation by the University of Groningen is underway, that the Inspectorate has not yet received results, that the report is expected in Q1 2020, and that the university is responsible for publishing it, with a commitment to forward a published version to parliament.
The dissemination and degree of publicity is the responsibility of the RUG.
De verspreiding en mate van openbaarheid is de verantwoordelijkheid van de RUG.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aankondiging van de premier van Albanië, Edi Rama, dat hij paspoorten gaat verkopen aan rijke mensen van buiten de Europese Unie (die nu recht geven op reizen in het Schenge

Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister about Albanian PM Rama's announced sale of passports to non-EU wealthy buyers, including tax concessions, and whether visa-free travel for Albanians should be suspended via the emergency brake. Minister Blok answered that the proposal was halted after Commission criticism, that Albania is sovereign over its tax and citizenship rules, that the Commission is monitoring such schemes, and that he sees no grounds to renew the emergency-brake request.
What he literally said in London is not known to the Cabinet.
Wat hij letterlijk in Londen heeft gezegd is het Kabinet niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de OPCW Douma-documenten op Wikileaks

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister whether leaked OPCW Douma documents were authentic, whether the final Douma report was sound, and whether an inquiry into its preparation was warranted. The minister replied that the OPCW has launched an independent investigation into the leaks, that he sees no reason to doubt the report's process or conclusions, and that no separate inquiry is needed.
No. As I indicated above, I find the OPCW's explanation convincing and appreciate the organisation's own handling of this matter.
Nee. Zoals ik hierboven heb aangegeven, vind ik de uitleg van de OPCW overtuigend en apprecieer ik de aanpak van deze kwestie door de organisatie zelf.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over het feit dat de Belastingdienst het recht op huurtoeslag heeft afgewezen, terwijl een burger het wel had doordat er sprake was van verworven rechten

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked why the tax authority refused housing benefit that a citizen received under acquired rights, and how the Council of State ruling of July 2019 is being applied. The government says the authority changed its practice from 24 July 2019, lapsed acquired rights can be revived until 1 September 2020, and past final decisions will not be reopened.
Decisions that are final will not be reopened with retroactive effect.
Besluiten die wel onherroepelijk vaststaan, worden niet met terugwerkende kracht heropend.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Omtzigt over eHerkenning

An MP asked whether businesses must use the commercial eHerkenning login to file payroll and corporate tax returns with the Tax Authority from 1 January 2020, its legal basis, and how the transition will be managed. The minister confirmed the requirement for payroll and corporate tax returns, cited the general AWB and GDPR security duties as the basis, and promised extensions on request and a separate letter on groups without a Chamber of Commerce number by 1 March 2020.
There is a legal basis, as explained in answer to question 2.
Er is een wettelijke grondslag, zoals bij vraag 2 toegelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over berichten dat ziekenhuizen en verpleeghuizen zo vol zijn dat ouderen verzorgd worden in een hospice

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about reports that hospices in Twente are full and that elderly people on waiting lists for nursing homes end up in hospices. The Minister answered that no recent figures exist for Twente, that such placements are not intended, that regional agreements are being made, and that extra budget is available to tackle nursing home waiting lists.
No recent figures are available on the number of people who could not be admitted to a hospice in Twente.
Er zijn geen recente cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat niet kon worden opgenomen in een hospice in Twente.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg over de Nederlander die in Roemenië verdacht wordt van het misbruiken en vermoorden van een meisje en mogelijk andere vergelijkbare misdrijven

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked how Dutch authorities assisted Romania's investigation into a Dutch suspect in the abuse and killing of a girl, whether he had other offences, and why Romania lacked official confirmation of his death and was not alerted through European systems. The ministers answered that Dutch legal assistance was provided, that the suspect's death was officially communicated, that he was not registered in SIS II, SIENA or ECRIS, and that he had served his earlier sentences, though they declined to give details of his past convictions and did not answer the questions within three weeks.
I will not go into the exact convictions or sentences that Johannes V. received earlier.
Ik ga niet in op de exacte veroordelingen dan wel straffen die Johannes V. eerder heeft gekregen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de zaak van klokkenluider Victor van Wulfen en een arts van Defensie die een consult en ziektebeeld verzon, opschreef in zijn medische dossier en daarvoor beris

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked why a Defence doctor who recorded a non-existent consultation and diagnosis in a whistleblower's file was only publicly reprimanded, and whether the Inspectorate's findings and document access were adequate. The State Secretary answered that the disciplinary ruling is noted, declined to comment further while appeal was possible, rejected independent re-investigation and found no evidence of fraud, but gave limited reasons for withholding some documents from the complainant.
I do not consider it opportune to go further into the ruling of the Regional Disciplinary Board, partly because the period for appeal is still running.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om nader in te gaan op uitspraak van het Regionaal Tuchtcollege, mede omdat de termijn om daartegen beroep in te stellen nog loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de evaluaties van 15 CAF projecten (uitgevoerd in 2015), waarom de Kamer meerdere keren gevraagd heeft

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the government had not shared evaluations of 15 CAF projects from 2015 despite repeated parliamentary questions, and when the minister and predecessor knew of them. The State Secretary answered that the evaluations were now attached, that the EDP auditors focused only on CAF 11, that the minister had only recently seen them, and that certain internal deliberation documents would not be shared with parliament.
As I indicated in my letter of 22 November, I consider it of great importance that officials must be able to exchange views freely with me and with each other.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 22 november jl. heb aangegeven acht ik het van groot belang dat ambtenaren met mij en onderling vrij van gedachten moeten kunnen wisselen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over het intrekken van paspoorten Syriëgangers en beleid Buitenlandse Zaken inzake ‘gematigde’ rebellen

Three CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about passport and citizenship revocations for Syria fighters and the government's stance on 'moderate' rebel groups supported under the Dutch Non-Lethal Assistance programme, including why Ahrar al-Sham is not on Dutch terrorism lists. The ministers answered largely by referring to legal frameworks, declining to comment on individual cases, and explaining that the listing criteria for the national-security list and the national sanctions list were not met.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual cases.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over de uitspraken van mevrouw Lagarde, toekomstig president van de Europese Centrale Bank (ECB), en de noodzaak voor een review van het ECB beleid

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked the government about Christine Lagarde's remarks favouring jobs and growth over savers, and whether the ECB's monetary policy should be reviewed as parliament had requested. The minister answered that the ECB's independence limits government comment, that the government supports periodic reviews in general, and that the minister-president would convey parliament's view when the opportunity arises.
Given the independence of the ECB, the cabinet does not express a view on the necessity or desirability of a review.
Gezien de onafhankelijkheid van de ECB spreekt het kabinet zich niet uit over de noodzaak of wenselijkheid van een review.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over "de uitkomsten van het nieuwe pensioencontract bij een blijvend lage rente"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the pension outcomes under the new pension contract at a persistently low interest rate, including the yield curve, accrual rates, replacement rates and whether pensions remain inflation-proof. The minister answered that the yield curve is published by DNB, that CPB modelling is underway, and that a concrete outcome depends on premiums and returns, promising to answer further after the modelling is completed.
At the request of the steering group, the CPB will make further calculations of the contracts agreed in the accord, also examining pension outcomes under a prolonged low interest rate.

Op verzoek van de stuurgroep zal het CPB nadere doorrekeningen maken van de contracten die zijn afgesproken in het akkoord, waarbij ook zal worden gekeken naar de pensioenresultaten bij een langdurige lage rente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de houdbaarheid van box 3 en het EVRM

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the 2020 box 3 wealth-tax rates would breach the first protocol of the ECHR, whether legal advice was sought, and for a list of past advice and information on legal risks. The State Secretary answers that the 2017 system is unchanged, that the government takes the position it is not in breach at system level and leaves it to the courts, and that no list exists, while promising advice only on the pre-2017 system.
In these proceedings I take the position that the box 3 levy applicable from 2017 is, at system level, not in conflict with Article 1 of the First Protocol to the ECHR.
In deze procedures neem ik het standpunt in dat de box 3-heffing die geldt vanaf 2017 op stelselniveau niet strijdig is met artikel 1 EP EVRM.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het tarief in box 3 in 2020 en mogelijke schending van het eerste protocol van het Europees Verdrag tot bescherming van de rechten van de mens en de fundamentele vrijheden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the 2020 box 3 wealth tax rates (0.54% and 1.27% effective) could breach Article 1 of the First Protocol to the ECHR, referring to Supreme Court rulings and a parliamentary advocate's advice. The State Secretary answered that the rulings concerned 2013-2014, that the 2017-onward system better matches average real returns, that the government is examining the 2013-2014 issue and will seek its own advice, and that it will not give the requested definitive legal assessment before the deadline, with the letter on box 3 sent separately.
The cabinet is examining whether such a violation of Article 1 of the First Protocol by the box 3 system as it applied until 2017 occurs and will obtain its own advice on this.
Het kabinet onderzoekt of een dergelijke schending van artikel 1 EP EVRM door het box 3-stelsel zoals dat gold tot 2017 zich voordoet en zal hierover een eigen advies inwinnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Toorenburg en Van der Molen over de verkoop van paspoorten op Malta en de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

Three CDA MPs asked about Malta's passport-sale programme, its national security risks, and the undisclosed outside roles of a Groningen professor in the investment-migration industry. The minister said the programme is a security concern, that the university must investigate the professor's disclosure and conflicts of interest, and that the Inspectorate will advise on the findings.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to subsequently assess the findings of the investigation regarding the secondary activities and possible conflicts of interest and to advise me on them.

Ik heb de Inspectie van het onderwijs gevraagd om vervolgens de bevindingen van het onderzoek ten aanzien van de nevenwerkzaamheden en eventuele belangenverstrengeling te beoordelen en mij daarover te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het uitvoeren van de motie Van Helvert c.s. inzake het bijeen roepen van de NAVO-raad

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign Minister why he would not convene the NATO Council under Article 4 over the release of ISIS detainees in northeast Syria after the Turkish invasion, and what the Netherlands was doing to contain the threat. The minister answered that Article 4 is only appropriate if a NATO member is directly threatened, that the issue would be raised at the NATO North Atlantic Council on 15 October and in the anti-ISIS coalition, and that the Netherlands would condemn the Turkish operation and call for its halt.
Invoking Article 4 of the NATO treaty is only opportune if the territorial integrity, political independence or security of one of the NATO member states is directly threatened.
Inroeping van artikel 4 van het NAVO-verdrag is pas opportuun indien de territoriale integriteit, politieke onafhankelijkheid of de veiligheid van een van de NAVO-lidstaten direct wordt bedreigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Omtzigt over de sluiting die dreigt voor de spoedpost van de huisartsendienst Twente-Oost

MPs Van den Berg and Omtzigt asked whether the Medisch Spectrum Twente hospital's rent increase, withdrawal of nurses and cooperation changes effectively force closure of the Oldenzaal out-of-hours GP post, and asked about catchment data, regional needs and stakeholder consultation. The minister answered that the post is not financially viable, that partial or full closure is under discussion with a final decision pending, that the RIVM accessibility norm remains met, and that SHT has been asked to hold an information meeting for residents before deciding.
In my view, SHT should organise an information meeting for residents so they can voice their concerns and suggestions before a final decision is taken.

Naar mijn mening zal de SHT een informatiebijeenkomst voor inwoners moeten organiseren om de inwoners de gelegenheid te geven hun zorgen en suggesties te uiten, voordat er een definitief besluit genomen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de kinderopvangtoeslag-affaire en alle aspecten daarvan

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about the childcare benefit scandal, including the unlawful stopping of payments in the CAF-11 case, the duration of misconduct, withheld documents, accountability and possible criminal or disciplinary consequences. The State Secretary answers that the Council of State ruled the stopping unlawful, that the Adviescommissie and ADR are investigating, and that documents will be released only after those investigations and Wob procedures conclude.
I have asked the Advisory Committee and the ADR to investigate the conduct of Toeslagen.
Ik heb de Adviescommissie en de ADR gevraagd het handelen van Toeslagen te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over de informatie die de regering gaf over de CAF-11 zaak aan de Nationale ombudsman

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked whether the government told the National Ombudsman that all 235 parents affected by the CAF-11 childcare benefit case were clients of the childcare agency Dadim in 2014, and whether this misled the Ombudsman into closing his inquiry. The State Secretary confirmed the 235 figure was communicated, said only about 200 were linked to Dadim, and maintained the Ombudsman said the exact number did not affect his conclusions.
Toeslagen informed me upon request that approximately 200 of these 235 parents were affiliated with the childcare agency concerned.
Toeslagen heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten dat circa 200 van deze 235 vraagouders waren aangesloten bij het betrokken gastouderbureau.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een ambtenaar die een stuk van het onderzoek van de EDP-auditors uit het concept-verslag van onafhankelijke onderzoekers verwijderde met het oog op het eventueel mo

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance why a civil servant removed the authorisation part of the EDP auditors' draft report on the CAF 11 childcare benefits affair, and whether this was consistent with independent investigation and prior commitments to parliament. The State Secretary answered that the authorisation investigation was dropped from the assignment in agreement with the auditors because it would add little value, that no content was removed from the draft report itself, and that the relevant Wob documents have been released.
So nothing was removed from the draft investigation.
Er is dus niets weggehaald uit het concept-onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over het artikel in de Volkskrant ‘Vijf jaarsalarissen als nabestaandenpensioen’

Two MPs asked the Social Affairs minister about a Volkskrant report that social partners are developing a survivor's pension of five annual salaries, and about related data. The minister said the Stichting van de Arbeid advice is not yet ready, that the requested statistics are not available to the ministry or to DNB, the Pensioenfederatie or the Verbond van Verzekeraars, and that the cabinet will respond after the advice in early autumn.
I have made inquiries with DNB, the Pensioenfederatie and the Verbond van Verzekeraars. The parties concerned have indicated that they likewise do not have this data.
Ik heb navraag gedaan bij DNB, de Pensioenfederatie en het Verbond van Verzekeraars. De betreffende partijen hebben aangegeven eveneens niet over deze gegevens te beschikken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Peters over ‘meer dan 100.000 ouders die de komende maanden meer dan 1.000 euro kindgebonden budget krijgen nabetaald en mogelijk geen enkele band meer hebben met hun kind(eren)

MPs Omtzigt and Peters asked about over 100,000 parents receiving retroactive kindgebonden budget payments of over 1,000 euro, including cases where a parent has lost parental authority or been convicted of offences against a child, the position of separated parents, deceased parents, parents abroad, anti-cumulation rules, and seizure. The government answered that only the parent entitled to child benefit receives the payment, that entitled parents may still receive it after losing parental authority or being convicted, that the payment is protected from seizure, and that cross-border anti-cumulation arrangements are still being worked out.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg en Geurts over de Nederlandse voorbereiding op een harde Brexit

CDA MPs asked the government about the Dutch preparations for a hard Brexit on 31 October 2019, covering customs staffing and enforcement choices, medicine and medical device shortages, live animal inspection posts and NVWA capacity. The government answered that staffing targets were met, customs and NVWA preparations continue, and that shortages and disruptions cannot be fully ruled out.
The Tweede Kamer was informed about these choices in the cabinet letter dated 18 January 2019.
Over deze keuzes is de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd in de brief van het kabinet d.d. 18 januari 2019
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Schonis en Remco Dijkstra over de grote problemen bij het CBR

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about data leaks at the CBR, where medical documents of one client were viewable in another's file, including how many cases there were, when they were reported, and whether affected people were informed. The minister reported 71 cases in January to June 2019 and 5 in 2018, said procedures and GDPR obligations were followed, and agreed to share monthly progress reports with the Chamber.
Yes, I am willing to share with the Chamber the monthly report that the CBR sends me within the framework of enhanced oversight.
Ja, ik ben bereid om de rapportage die het CBR maandelijks aan mij doet toekomen in het kader van het aangescherpt toezicht te delen met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de "gevolgen van een langdurig lage en/of negatieve rente voor Nederlandse pensioenfondsen"

An MP asked the ministers about the effects of prolonged low and negative interest rates on Dutch pension funds, including the cost of pension payouts, the role of ECB policy, and whether scenario studies exist. The ministers answered that low rates are largely structural, that ECB policy contributes but its impact is hard to quantify, and that scenario analysis and further study will be addressed in a later letter on the pension accord roadmap.
I am willing to comply with that request.
Ik ben bereid om aan dat verzoek te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over berichten dat de Europese Commissie voorstellen zal doen om het Stabiliteits-en Groeipact (SGP) aan te passen

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked whether the government had seen Commission plans to loosen the Stability and Growth Pact, whether any loosening had been proposed, and what position the Netherlands takes. Minister Hoekstra answered that no proposal had been made, that the Netherlands wants the pact reformed for stricter enforcement and less flexibility, and that it opposes loosening.
No. No proposal has been made to amend the European budget rules.
Nee. Er is geen voorstel gedaan om de Europese begrotingsregels aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de ruling van Uber in Nederland

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about Uber's reported transfer of intellectual property from Bermuda to the Netherlands, the resulting tax step-up, contacts with Uber, the arm's-length research, and whether the new ruling policy allowed such a ruling. The State Secretary declined to discuss Uber's individual tax position under the confidentiality rules of the General Tax Act, described the arm's-length principle and the ongoing research due in early 2020, and explained the July 2019 ruling policy change.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 AWR kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de import van tweedehands elektrische auto’s voor een lagere bijtelling

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether young second-hand electric cars imported to take advantage of a lower company-car tax rate could be curbed, for example by tying the rate to first Dutch registration. The State Secretary answered that the rate depends on first-registration date wherever in the world, that such imports are expected to remain small, and that tying the rate to Dutch registration would breach EU free movement rules.
I see no possibilities to make the company-car tax rate for an imported zero-emission car depend on the moment it is registered on a Dutch license plate.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om bij import van een emissievrije auto het bijtellingspercentage afhankelijk te stellen van het moment dat ze in Nederland op kenteken worden gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de kosten van pensioenen en de mogelijkheden van het in rekening brengen van te hoge kosten bij individuele rekeningen

MP Omtzigt asked the minister about Australian pension fee scandals, whether an independent advisory review should be commissioned to prevent similar abuses in Dutch defined-contribution schemes, and the AFM's findings on variable pension payouts. The minister answered that fee research will be commissioned with results by end of year, that DNB and AFM already supervise costs, and that the AFM's concerns about variable payouts will be addressed by industry improvements and possible legislative measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Omtzigt over het bericht dat er geen deal is tussen Belastingdienst en Uber over een aftrekpost

MPs Bruins and Omtzigt asked whether the Tax Authority had communicated with the press about whether a ruling on a deduction exists with Uber, and asked for a reply within a week. The State Secretary declined to confirm or deny the existence of any ruling, citing the tax confidentiality duty in article 67 AWR, and said he had no reason to think that duty was breached.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act, it is not permitted to disclose information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op basis van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake Rijksbelastingen is het niet toegestaan informatie over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Stoffer, Voordewind, Koopmans, De Roon en Baudet over de uitvoering van de motie-Van der Staaij c.s. over eenzijdige resoluties bij de VN

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands voted for a UN ECOSOC resolution on Palestinian women, how often Israel is condemned in UN bodies compared to other countries, and how the government implemented the Van der Staaij motion against disproportionate UN resolutions targeting Israel. The minister confirmed the Dutch vote, said Israel is condemned far more often than states like Saudi Arabia, and explained that the vote was taken to secure a more balanced text while committing to continue reducing disproportionate attention.
The Netherlands will continue to actively work against disproportionate attention in the UN and for reducing the number of resolutions on Israel and the occupied territories.
Nederland zal zich daarom actief blijven inzetten om disproportionele aandacht tegen te gaan in de VN en voor het verminderen van het aantal resoluties over Israël en de bezette gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma en Van Nispen over gedetineerdenbegeleiding in het buitenland
