MPs from CDA, D66 and SP asked whether Dutch detainees abroad can receive legal aid from the Netherlands, how subsidies for detainee support were distributed, and whether DutchAdvocates refuses or redirects cases and pressures former PrisonLAW clients. The minister replied that legal aid is primarily the detainee's own responsibility with local lawyers, that subsidy was transferred to DutchAdvocates from 2019 with PrisonLAW's agreement, that clients are free to choose their lawyer, and that no misconduct exists.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over onbeantwoorde vragen over artikel 68 van de grondwet, de inlichtingenplicht van de regering

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked the government about delayed answers to parliamentary questions on the duty to provide information (article 68 of the Constitution), including state secrecy, deliberately delayed FOI requests and withheld information. The minister answered that questions were grouped for clarity, that the government does not track the requested statistics, that state-interest refusals are rare and pre-tested in cabinet, and that Parliament's information right is broader than the FOI law.
Parliament's right to information is in several respects also broader than the right to public access under the FOI law.
Het recht op inlichtingen van de Kamer is in een aantal opzichten ook breder dan het recht op openbaarheid onder de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de oprichting van een tribunaal om IS-strijders te vervolgen

MPs asked whether the government had discussed an international tribunal for IS fighters with Sweden, whether it will pursue genocide prosecutions and join a Swedish-invited conference, and whether a prosecutor is assigned. The government confirmed talks with Sweden and UN partners, said it is seeking expert advice on an international tribunal due 8 July 2019, and said the Public Prosecution Service will report on a dedicated prosecutor before the recess.
The Public Prosecution Service is expected to inform the cabinet before the recess whether a special prosecutor specifically for prosecuting ISIS fighters for genocide would add value.

Het OM zal het kabinet naar verwachting voor het reces nog informeren of daarnaast een speciale officier van justitie specifiek voor de vervolging van ISIS-strijders voor genocide van toegevoegde waarde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Omtzigt over de teveel betaalde belasting en ZVW-premie door oud-gevangenispersoneel dat met SBF-verlof is gegaan

MPs Van Nispen and Omtzigt asked whether former prison staff on SBF leave were wrongly charged income tax and health premiums after a 2013 law change, and why some were not compensated. The State Secretary answered that the 104-week limit runs from the start of SBF leave, that the Tax Authority and DJI reached a settlement in late 2018, and that 151 people were not refunded because no excess tax was paid for them.
This establishes that the white table applies to the remaining part of the 104-week period as of 1 January 2013.
Daarmee is vastgelegd dat op het per 1 januari 2013 resterende deel van het tijdvak van 104 weken de witte tabel wordt toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de btw-plicht voor toezichthouders in het licht van een recente uitspraak van het Europees Hof

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about VAT liability of supervisory board members after a 2019 CJEU ruling that such a member, paid a fixed fee and bearing no business risk, is not an independent economic operator. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling, said assessment is case-by-case by the inspector, declined a general policy decree for now pending a Supreme Court case, and explained that prior VAT declarations are final and no ex officio refund follows, while also withholding the legal advice and Commission correspondence for now.

Asked for the legal advice and correspondence with the European Commission, I inform you that I am still examining the extent to which these documents may be provided, since they concern communication with or from third parties.

Gevraagd naar de juridische adviezen en correspondentie met de Europese Commissie deel ik u mee dat ik nog onderzoek in hoeverre deze stukken mogen worden verstrekt nu het communicatie van/aan derden betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Omtzigt over  het  bericht 'Nederland stuurt Yezidi’s terug naar de tentenkampen en dat is tegen eigen regels zeggen advocaten'

CDA MPs Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether the Netherlands is returning Yazidis to camps in northern Iraq, whether the policy changed, and how many genocide victims received protection and perpetrators are prosecuted. The State Secretary answered that individual asylum assessments apply, that Yazidis who lived in the Kurdistan Region after fleeing other parts of Iraq are no longer treated as having a normal residence there, and that the Netherlands prosecutes international crimes while leading international evidence mechanisms, though the government does not register asylum grounds by group and gave no case figures.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to pay extra attention to the Yazidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad over de vermogensrendementsheffing

Two MPs (Lodders, Omtzigt) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Supreme Court ruling that the assumed 4% box 3 return was unrealistic for 2013 and 2014, and what it means for the wealth tax, future reform and pending objections. The State Secretary answered that the ruling leaves the assessments intact, that massive objections for 2013-2016 will be rejected by collective decision, that a real-return system is being studied with spaargeld results promised before Prinsjesdag, and that the questions would be answered within three weeks.
The Supreme Court attaches no consequences to a possible violation at system level in its ruling and leaves the assessments in place.
De Hoge Raad verbindt in het arrest geen gevolgen aan een mogelijke schending op stelselniveau en laat de aanslagen in stand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de CAF 11-zaak

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary of Finance, in around 25 questions, about the CAF 11 childcare-allowance case: the basis for suspending benefits, the 2011 and 2013 signals, the withheld internal documents and the lack of accountability within the Tax Administration. The State Secretary answers that the internal review found a tunnel focus on fraud, rigid rules and poor care, commits to an external culture study and advisory committee advice, but declines to release several internal documents and says no individual officials have been disciplined.
It is established cabinet policy not to make documents drafted for internal deliberation a subject of political debate.
Het is staand beleid van het kabinet om documenten die zijn opgesteld ten behoeve van intern beraad geen onderwerp van politiek debat te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins en Lodders over de doorrekeningen van de subsidie op elektrische auto’s

MPs Omtzigt, Bruins and Lodders asked why PBL's expert reviewers of the Klimaatakkoord analysis could not see the mobility and electricity background documents, why the Revnext calculations were not shared sooner, and how national costs per tonne of CO2 saved differ from the government-perspective costs used by the Algemene Rekenkamer. The state secretary answered that PBL published all background documents after the reviews, that the government will send Revnext calculations and later its own positioning analyses once the Klimaatakkoord is final, and that national costs for electric driving are roughly zero by 2030 while transfers like subsidies are excluded.
It is desirable that background documents become available as soon as possible.
Het is wenselijk dat achtergronddocumenten zo snel mogelijk beschikbaar komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Snels over ouders die met de staatssecretaris in gesprek gaan over de problemen in het kader van CAF-11 (Combiteam Aanpak Facilitators 11), waarover de Belastingdienst

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Snels asked the State Secretary of Finance, in written questions, about the childcare benefit (CAF-11) problems, the individual talks with affected parents, whether parents can bring an advisor, whether talk reports will be shared, and safeguards such as full file access, representation and time to consider offers. The State Secretary answered that parents may bring someone, that talk notes will not be shared given their personal nature but a summary will be provided, and that parents get file access and may be represented, while the advisory commission was asked to advise on time to consider offers and confidentiality clauses.
Given the personal nature of the conversations, I do not consider it appropriate to share the verbatim notes with your House.
Gezien het persoonlijke karakter van de gesprekken vind ik het niet gepast om de woordelijke notities met uw Kamer te delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een Brits rapport inzake geloofsvervolging waarin grote zorgen worden geuit over de wereldwijde christenvervolging

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about a British interim report on Christian persecution that said persecution in some regions approaches the UN definition of genocide, and asked what Dutch action would follow. The minister responded that the Netherlands shares concern, cites its existing human rights commitments, the planned Special Envoy and an international conference in November 2019, and that sanctions and genocide-prevention obligations are available instruments without committing to new specific measures.
The cabinet is committed, and will remain committed, to upholding the Universal Declaration, including article 18.
Nederland zet zich in, en zal zich blijven inzetten, voor naleving van de Universele Verklaring, met inbegrip van artikel 18.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een ouder die tot de Raad van State moest doorprocederen om de kinderopvangtoeslag van 2013 en 2014 te krijgen, en nog lopende zaken van ouders

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a parent who had to litigate up to the Council of State to obtain childcare allowance for 2013 and 2014 in the CAF 11 case, and about other pending parental cases, including why the tax authority did not re-check bank statements and whether the Ombudsman's recommendations were implemented. The State Secretary answered that the tax authority followed the then-current case law, detailed the Ombudsman's four recommendations and their implementation, gave litigation counts and costs, and said further action is set out in a separate letter and a meeting with parents has taken place.
I am very well aware of what the Ombudsman means in his report.
Ik ben mij heel bewust wat de Ombudsman bedoelt in zijn rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de samenwerking met Armenië

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister about cooperation with Armenia, including whether an embassy in Yerevan would be opened and when the EU-Armenia partnership agreement bill would reach parliament. The minister answered that opening an embassy is not currently on the agenda due to limited postal network funds, that the bill's explanatory memorandum will go to the Council of State in the first half of the year, and that Armenia is covered by the Georgia embassy.
The explanatory memorandum will be submitted to the Council of State in the first half of this year.
De MvT zal in de eerste helft van dit jaar aan de Raad van State worden voorgelegd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Ronnes en Omtzigt over de opvatting van het financieel stabiliteitscomité over het Klimaatakkoord en over de niet gepubliceerde achtergronddocumenten van het Klimaatakkoord

CDA MPs asked the ministers whether the Financial Stability Committee's warnings about mortgage lending norms and green building-linked finance conflict with the draft Climate Agreement, and why the PBL analysis's background documents and reviewer access were incomplete. The ministers replied that AFM and DNB concerns are being taken into account in designing new financing options, that the PBL published three of five background documents, and that the government holds no unpublished background documents.
It is up to the PBL to make the background documents public.
Het is aan PBL om de achtergronddocumenten openbaar te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over rijnvarenden, die grote persoonlijke naheffingen ontvingen van de Nederlandse belastingdienst voor sociale premies, die zij ook al in Luxemburg betaald hebben

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked why Rhine boatmen face large Dutch social premium back-assessments already paid in Luxembourg, and what steps the authorities took to recover the debt from former employers and ensure only one country collects premiums. The government answered that the tax authority cannot pursue employers for individual income-tax debts, that refund claims lie with Luxembourg authorities under its law, that it will raise the issue with Luxembourg, and that payment arrangements are available, but gave no clear timeline for resolving the double premium problem.

Although the Netherlands is not a party to these requests, I will, together with the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, actively and promptly raise the signals with the Luxembourg authorities.

Hoewel Nederland geen partij is bij deze verzoeken, zal ik met de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, die verantwoordelijk is voor de vaststelling van de verzekeringsplicht, de signalen hierover actief en op korte termijn bij de Luxemburgse autoriteiten onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Omtzigt, Bisschop en Stoffer over extra belastingdruk voor scholen die het lerarentekort proberen op te vangen middels een RTC

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education whether Dutch VAT rules penalise school boards that match teachers through regional transfer centres (RTCs) and whether the cooperation exemption applies. The government answered that matching is a different service from supplying staff, that the Tax Authority considers RTC matching outside the cooperation exemption, and that it will consult the PO-raad and RTC network on ways to avoid additional VAT burdens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Ronnes en Omtzigt over de doorrekening van het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL)

MPs Mulder, Ronnes and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the ministers about the PBL cost calculation of the draft Climate Agreement's building-sector measures, including the costs per tonne of CO2 and transparency of assumptions. The minister answered that the calculations use standard insulation assumptions, that PBL has explained its models, and that the Climate and Energy Outlook may incorporate new insights.
PBL strives for full transparency about its calculations.
PBL streeft naar volledige transparantie over zijn berekeningen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over "de rol van in Nederland werkzame vermogensbeheerders en beleggingsinstellingen bij grote financiële schandalen en het feit dat Nederlandse pensioenfondsen geheime overeenkomst

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about asset managers' role in financial scandals and whether pension funds sign secret agreements that effectively shield managers from liability for losses. The minister answers that he lacks data on DUFAS members' share of pension assets, is not familiar with the foreign investigations behind the media reports, says contractual liability limits for gross negligence are not valid under Dutch law, and leaves enforcement and supervision to DNB and the AFM.
It is up to the supervisory authority to supervise and, if necessary, take follow-up steps.
Het is aan de toezichthouder om toezicht te houden en indien nodig vervolgstappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over betere richtlijnen voor een lager maatschappelijk OZB-tarief voor bij voorbeeld sportverenigingen en buurthuizen

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked whether the government will help municipalities set a lower property tax (OZB) rate for sports clubs, community centres and similar non-profit organisations, and whether they agree such organisations should be taxed differently from businesses. The minister answered that talks with the VNG are ongoing, that OZB taxation follows the property rather than the owner so a lower rate for organisations does not fit its objective character, and that the government will consider the problems the VNG identifies.
Introducing the lower OZB rate for sports clubs and similar organisations does not fit the objective nature of this levy.
De invoering van het lagere ozb-tarief voor sportverenigingen e.a. sluit niet aan bij het objectieve karakter van deze heffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Ziengs en Omtzigt over het verkopen van bespaarde CO2-rechten door autofabrikant Tesla aan Fiat-Chrysler

MPs Lodders, Ziengs and Omtzigt asked whether the EU-permitted pooling of CO2 emission credits between Tesla and Fiat-Chrysler, which may help Fiat-Chrysler avoid EU fines, is acceptable and whether it will persist under the 95 g/km rules, and how much the national EV stimulus would actually reduce EU-wide emissions given possible waterbed effects. The State Secretary answered that pooling has been allowed since 2007, that the pool average must still meet the EU norm, that the government prefers each manufacturer to meet the norm alone, and that the national EV measures yield about 2.4 Mton additional reduction, with the waterbed effect considered small given Netherlands' roughly 3% share of the EU fleet.
The cabinet is not aware of the exact amount involved between certain manufacturers in this arrangement.
Het kabinet is niet op de hoogte van het exacte bedrag dat tussen bepaalde fabrikanten hiermee is gemoeid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het Revnext-model voor de stimulering van elektrische auto's, de merkwaardige aanbesteding, de uitkomsten van dit model en het feit dat TNO de staatssecretaris weer

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked about the Revnext CARbonTAX model used to project electric car uptake, its scientific validation, the non-competitive award of contracts, and TNO's disagreement with the government. The state secretary answered that the PBL tested the model as suitable, that Revnext holds unclear intellectual property rights, that the 2018 contract was awarded via a single-tender procedure because no other model was available, and that the government will consider options for greater transparency.
The cabinet is currently discussing all options to realise this as soon as possible.
Het kabinet bespreekt op dit moment concreet alle opties dit zo spoedig mogelijk te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Snels over de totstandkoming van de bizar lage raming van de kosten voor verlaagde bijtelling in het ontwerp-Klimaatakkoord

MPs Omtzigt and Snels asked whether the Finance Ministry checked the low cost estimate for the reduced company car tax addition (bijtelling) for electric cars in the draft Climate Agreement, and how a realistic estimate could be made. The state secretary answered that the figures come from the CARbonTAX model and are plausible, that behavioural effects explain the low 2030 cost, and that annual monitoring and a 2023 evaluation of car taxation are planned.

The cabinet considers it essential to monitor annually so that timely adjustments can be made if signals of overstimulation, unbalanced distribution of burdens, or too limited room for manoeuvre for the Dutch motorist appear.

Het kabinet acht het van essentieel belang om jaarlijks te monitoren zodat tijdig kan worden bijgestuurd bij signalen van overstimulering, onevenwichtige lastenverdeling en een te beperkt handelingsperspectief voor de Nederlandse automobilist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Aruba op zwarte lijst EU belastingontwijking’

MPs Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether Aruba was placed on the EU blacklist of non-cooperative tax jurisdictions, why it was moved from the grey list, what measures Aruba must take, and whether the Netherlands supported Aruba. The State Secretary confirmed the listing, said Aruba committed to repeal its transparency regime and is expected to be delisted at the 16 May Ecofin, and stated no figures are available on Dutch persons using Aruban tax arrangements and that Aruba bears responsibility for its own tax rules.
No figures are known about this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het feit dat het ABP jarenlang uitbetaalde partnerpensioenen terugvordert

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about ABP's recovery of years of overpaid partner pensions, including whether affected pensioners could have known of the errors, whether disclaimers were missing, and what safeguards apply to recovery. The minister explained that SVB data errors caused the miscalculations, that recovery is mandatory under the pension rules, and that pension funds bear responsibility for fair recovery procedures and remedies.
Pension providers may not, however, adjust pension payments on their own initiative.
Pensioenuitvoerders mogen echter niet eigenstandig pensioenuitkeringen aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over Brexit, veterinaire keurpunten en levende dieren

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked the government about Brexit no-deal preparedness, the lack of veterinary inspection posts on the north bank of the Nieuwe Waterweg, and the handling of live animals and products. Minister Schouten answered that NVWA preparations are on track but disruptions are not excluded, that inspection post applications are pending with the European Commission, and that temporary alternatives such as transport to southern inspection posts are being explored.
I am awaiting the definitive response of the European Commission.
Ik ben in afwachting van de definitieve reactie van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de belemmerde vervolging van Syriëgangers

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked whether Dutch jihadist fighters in Syria could cite Dutch non-lethal assistance (NLA) to armed groups in their defence, and whether the Public Prosecution Service had been informed about which groups received NLA. The minister replied that such use is not known, that information on two specific groups was shared with the prosecutor only for a pending case, and that prosecution decisions are independent of NLA support.
The Public Prosecution Service makes no general statements about fighting groups.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen algemene uitspraken over strijdende groeperingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het CAF-11 project en andere CAF-projecten waarbij ouders jarenlang geen kinderopvangtoeslag kregen toegewezen omdat ze door de belastingdienst aan het lijntje gehouden werden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Belastingdienst's CAF-11 and other CAF projects, in which parents lost childcare allowance for years, and asked for an overview of cases, evaluations and legal costs. The State Secretary accepted the Ombudsman's criticism of CAF-11, announced improvement measures, but refused to disclose an overview of other CAF cases and the legal costs of ongoing proceedings, citing investigative confidentiality and procedural strategy.
I do not wish to comply with your House's request to also provide supervision-confidential information in other CAF cases.
Ik wil niet aan het verzoek van uw Kamer tegemoetkomen om ook toezichtsvertrouwelijke informatie in andere CAF-zaken te verstrekken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de belastingsubsidies op elektrische auto’s, de modellen die aangepast lijken te zijn (en geen rekening meer houden met de CO2-uitstoot die gepaard gaat met he

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked about tax subsidies for electric cars, the CARbonTAX model used for forecasts, its validation and emissions accounting, and cost-effectiveness compared with other CO2 measures and foreign countries. The State Secretary answered at length, defending the model and tank-to-wheel accounting while conceding that fiscal stimulation of electric cars is relatively costly per tonne of CO2 avoided, and offered a technical briefing on the model without providing validation evidence.
The model is the intellectual property of research bureau Revnext. The model is not 'secret' but it is not up to the central government to make this model public.
Het model is intellectueel eigendom van onderzoeksbureau Revnext. Het model is niet «geheim» maar het is niet aan de rijksoverheid om dit model openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het bericht ‘Reactie PBL op gebruik NEV-cijfers en modellen’

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether ministries and the PBL can inspect and run the private Carbontax model, whether it has been externally validated, and what the government has spent on it. The government answered that ministries and PBL have only general knowledge of the model, that it is owned by Revnext and cannot be made public, that it is the only suitable model for the analysis, and it offered a technical briefing while listing the commissioned studies and costs.
The CARbontax model is not owned by the state but is intellectual property of Revnext, therefore it is not for the state to make it public.
Het CARbontax-model is geen eigendom van het Rijk maar is intellectueel eigendom van Revnext, daarom is het niet aan het Rijk om het openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de kinderopvangtoeslag, die bij veel gezinnen is stopgezet, het CAF 11-project en de brieven van de Kinderombudsman

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about childcare benefit cutoffs, the CAF 11 project, and letters from the Children's Ombudsman, covering 14 questions on compliance, timelines, affected parents and conduct. The State Secretary answers substantively on several points, admits delays and deficient information to parents, but withholds case costs, the full number of affected parents and an overview of other CAF cases, citing confidentiality and lack of data.
It is established policy that the costs of ongoing procedures are not made public.
Het is staand beleid dat de kosten van lopende procedures niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Omtzigt over de coreper-vergaderingen

Two CDA MPs asked the Interior Minister whether the Netherlands consistently argued in EU negotiations on the whistleblower directive that whistleblowers may always use the external channel directly, and for an overview of meetings and votes. The minister answered that Dutch practice allows direct external reporting where internal reporting cannot reasonably be expected, that the Netherlands actively promoted this flexible system at EU level, and that it acted consistently in all negotiating meetings.
During the negotiations the Netherlands actively and prominently worked to introduce this flexible system at European level as well.
Gedurende de onderhandelingen heeft Nederland zich actief en prominent ingezet om dit flexibele systeem ook op Europees niveau te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over uitstaande belastingschuld

Two MPs (Omtzigt, Lodders) asked how much tax debt in arrears the Belastingdienst held from 2016 onward, split by collection segment, and asked for answers before a debate. The State Secretary provided the arrears figures, explained that growth partly reflects dynamic monitoring of hard-to-collect claims and a lower write-off rate, and noted that the figures differ from earlier reports due to a new information system.
I have answered these questions as far as possible in my letter of 20 February.
Ik heb deze vragen voor zover mogelijk beantwoord in mijn brief van 20 februari jongstleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de schriftelijke toelichting van de Europese Commissie op het SGP-besluit Italië van december 2018

MP Omtzigt asked the Prime Minister whether the government would press the European Commission to publish its explanatory note on the Italian budget and to put SGP non-compliance on the European Council agenda, and asked about banking union and pension risks. Minister Hoekstra answered that the government shares the view that Italy does not comply with the SGP, that it has repeatedly raised the issue with the Commission and the Eurogroup, and that the Commission has not yet published the note, which was made available to the Chamber confidentially.
The European Commission has so far not proceeded to publish the note.
De Europese Commissie is tot nu toe niet overgegaan tot publicatie van de nota.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Omtzigt over de teveel betaalde belasting over de SBF-verlofuitkering door oud-gevangenispersoneel

MPs Van Nispen and Omtzigt asked about excess payroll tax and health insurance premiums withheld from former prison staff receiving SBF leave benefits, and why refunds were limited to 104 weeks and to post-2013 cases. The state secretary answered that the 2013 statutory change has no retroactive effect, refunds were paid in December 2018 for the 104-week period, and the Tax Administration cannot deviate from this.
The statutory amendment has no retroactive effect for the first cohorts.
De wetswijziging kent geen terugwerkende kracht voor de eerste lichtingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Omtzigt, Lodders, Bisschop en Van Rooijen over een keurpunt voor levend vee voor de Brexit en de extra capaciteit bij de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

MPs asked whether the minister had led a public-private effort to set up live-animal inspection posts at Dutch seaports before a no-deal Brexit, and about NVWA staffing and preparedness. The minister replied that applications were sent to the European Commission before the 15 February deadline, that exact locations are confidential, that the NVWA has hired 100 of 143 needed staff, and that service levels may have to be adjusted for about a year.
I cannot go into the precise numbers and locations because of the confidentiality of this information.
Op de precieze aantallen en locaties kan ik niet in gaan in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de overschrijdingen van begroting voor de kosten van elektrische voertuigen

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether the 141 million euro estimate for the EV bijtelling discount in Miljoenennota 2019 and the Startnota benchmark rule were breached, and what the substantial endogenous development rule implies. The Staatssecretaris acknowledges EV sales exceeded expectations, puts the 2018 cost near 200 million (about 40% above the estimate), states the 2017 benchmark is 86 million, says no specific trigger moment is fixed, and commits only to monitoring and a new estimate in Miljoenennota 2020.
For now the cabinet sees no need to adjust further in the short term, but considers it important to keep a close watch to detect signals of overstimulation in time.
Het kabinet ziet vooralsnog geen noodzaak om op korte termijn verder bij te sturen, maar acht het wel van belang om een vinger aan de pols te houden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de minderjarige Nederlandse jongen Charly die in Spanje gedetineerd is en prisonlaw

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister why Dutch detainees are not actively told about PrisonLAW, whether a minor is held unsafely in Spain, and why Kaderbesluit 829 was raised late, and about the pressure on PrisonLAW and the ministry's contacts with it. The minister answered that PrisonLAW is mentioned in a brochure but not actively offered, that the Spanish facility is judged safe, that KB 829 was raised from September 2018 and formally in December, and declined to give case details or precise contact counts citing privacy and ongoing proceedings.
For reasons of personal data protection and because the legal proceedings are still ongoing, I cannot provide the House with further judicial details about this individual case in this public letter.
Omwille van persoonsgegevensbescherming en omdat de rechtsgang nog loopt, kan ik uw Kamer via deze openbare brief geen nadere justitiële gegevens over deze individuele zaak verschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse jongen die in Spanje gedetineerd is

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Dutch youth Charly T. in Spain, including whether consular procedures were followed, why no trust lawyer was appointed, and whether the ministry pressed Spanish authorities. The minister answered that the ministry uses consular and subsidised legal-advice instruments, is actively following the case without ordering a trust-lawyer review yet, did not steer the family to another legal aid provider, and will continue its efforts.

Because the legal proceedings are still in the initial phase and the public prosecutor, the defence and the judge still have to play their roles to a significant extent, there is currently no reason or scope to use the instrument of examining the proceedings through a trust lawyer.

Omdat de rechtsgang zich nog in de initiële fase bevindt en de Officier van Justitie, de verdediging en de rechter hun rollen in de rechtsgang nog in belangrijke mate moeten vervullen, is er thans geen aanleiding en ruimte voor het inzetten van het instrument van onderzoek naar de gevolgde rechtsgang door een vertrouwensadvocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Von Martels en Omtzigt over de brand bij een Duitse kerncentrale vlakbij de Nederlandse grens

MPs from the CDA asked why the Dutch government and safety regions were not informed about a fire at a nuclear fuel plant in Lingen, Germany, and how the incident was classified and would be evaluated. The state secretary answered that the fire was not at the Emsland plant, no radioactive release occurred, it was provisionally classed INES-0, and the Veiligheidsregio Twente will evaluate it and share the findings with parliament.
The Veiligheidsregio Twente has indicated that it will evaluate this incident and involve the ANVS, the DCC IenW and the NCC (JenV).
De Veiligheidsregio Twente heeft aangegeven dit incident te gaan evalueren en daarbij de ANVS, het DCC IenW en het NCC (JenV) te zullen betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Topambtenaar kreeg ruim 40.000 euro voor achttien dagen Curaçao’

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary and Minister of Internal Affairs about a press report that a senior civil servant received over 40,000 euro in allowances for eighteen days on Curaçao, asking about the contracts, legality, tax treatment, and whether the Auditdienst Rijk should investigate. The government answered that all questions were addressed in a separate letter (Kamerstuk 35 000 VII and 35 000 IV, nr. 89), so this document itself gives no substantive answers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitspraak van de premier dat de Europese Commissie niet voldoende optreedt tegen Italië

Rep. Omtzigt asked the Prime Minister to explain his Davos criticism that the European Commission was too lax toward Italy's budget and banking practices, and asked about Italian bank rescues, a pre-retirement scheme and compliance with EU fiscal rules. Minister Hoekstra answered that the Netherlands repeatedly raised concerns in the Eurogroup and Ecofin, that Italy's budget does not meet the SGP in the government's view, and that the Commission must assess state aid and compliance, while declining to give a separate judgment on individual national measures.
The cabinet has no indications that Italy did not comply with the rules in the aforementioned cases.
Het kabinet heeft geen aanwijzingen dat Italië zich in de voornoemde casuïstiek niet aan de regels heeft gehouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Linde, Bruins, Stoffer, Tony van Dijck, Leijten, Baudet en Van Rooijen over de brief van de Minister van Financiën d.d. 5 februari 2019 over het op handen zijnde akkoord b

MPs asked the Finance Minister when the PEPP pension regulation would be finalised, what delegated acts it contains, whether Dutch pension rules could be affected without Dutch influence, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister said the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text because of the number of delegated-act powers and the EIOPA role, though the second-pillar pension system and tax rules are unaffected, and that the Chamber's view will be weighed in the vote.

As I announced in my letter of 5 February, I informed the Romanian presidency yesterday that the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text of the PEPP regulation at Coreper this coming Wednesday.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 5 februari jl. heb aangekondigd, heb ik gisteren aan het Roemeense voorzitterschap kenbaar gemaakt dat Nederland op Coreper aanstaande woensdag niet kan instemmen met het onderhandelaarsakkoord inzake de PEPP-verordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het rendement in box 3

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority's position in Box 3 litigation that AEX main shares and real estate are stable low-risk investments, the AFM's risk classification, a return-based Box 3 system, and EU comparisons of savings taxation. The State Secretary defended the Tax Authority's argument as conditional, said no AFM fund fits the low-risk description, admitted the promised spring 2018 letter on actual-return taxation is delayed, and provided OECD-based comparative tables, answering each question separately but late.
A system of wealth return tax based on actual return has far-reaching consequences for, among other things, citizens' administrative burden, the risk of tax avoidance and feasibility.

Een stelsel van vermogensrendementsheffing op basis van werkelijk rendement heeft verregaande consequenties voor onder andere de administratieve lasten van burgers, risico's op belastingontwijking en de uitvoerbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Albanië, dat zijn verplichtingen met de EU onder de Stabilisatie- en Associatieovereenkomst (SAA) niet nakomt

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether Albania violated its EU Stabilisation and Association Agreement in awarding the Vlorë airport and Air Albania contracts without open tender, and what the Commission has done about it. The minister answers that the Commission will examine any possible breach within a broader assessment of Albania's public procurement and competition framework, that no breach has been confirmed, and that the case is not on the SAA Council agenda.
The cabinet is not involved in assessing the application of existing rules in individual cases and is therefore not in a position to offer such an example.
Het kabinet is niet betrokken bij de beoordeling van de toepassing van bestaande regels in individuele zaken en is daarom niet in de positie om een dergelijk voorbeeld aan te dragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het model CARbonTAX dat gebruikt is om de verkopen van elektrische auto’s te voorspellen en welke er in 2018 meer dan 100% naast zat bij de schatting van de verkoop

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the CARbonTAX model underpredicted electric car sales in 2018 by more than 100%, and whether the model is validated and still used. The State Secretary answered that the model was built for Autobrief II, that EV sales were underestimated due to market dynamics and the early scrapping of the PHEV bijtelling discount, that the model is not public, and that its parameters were recently revalidated by PBL and TNO.
Because the Carbontax model is not public, it is not possible to send the model to your House.
Omdat het Carbontax-model niet openbaar is, is het niet mogelijk om het model aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het gebruik van pepperspray in het Turkse consulaat in Rotterdam en het feit dat niemand daarvoor vervolgd wordt

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked why no one was prosecuted after a Turkish consulate staff member used pepperspray in Rotterdam, and about the immunity and diplomatic-prosecution arrangements involved. The minister answered that the person had functional immunity, that Turkey withdrew him, that no prosecution of others was possible because no other offences were known, and described the prosecution working arrangements and the planned notification system.

When requesting a lifting of immunity, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs immediately makes clear to the country concerned that no answer or a refusal to lift immunity will very likely lead to a request for the person's withdrawal.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken maakt bij een eventueel verzoek om opheffing van immuniteit meteen duidelijk aan het land in kwestie dat geen antwoord of een weigering om de immuniteit op te heffen zeer waarschijnlijk zal leiden tot een verzoek om terugtrekking van de betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Omtzigt over de vertraging van de invoering van de wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet

MPs Peters and Omtzigt (CDA) asked why implementation of the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet was delayed by at least two years, why the Belastingdienst and UWV implementation assessments were not published earlier, and what interim measures will protect debtors. The state secretaries explain that the delay stems from ICT and process redesign, that the revised assessments will be published before the 14 February 2019 debate, and that interim measures are being sought, but give no firm dates or concrete commitments yet.
We aim to publish the Besluit beslagvrije voet before the committee debate on poverty and debt policy scheduled for 14 February 2019, so that you can review the implementation assessments.
Wij streven ernaar het Besluit beslagvrije voet vóór het voor 14 februari 2019 geplande AO Armoede- en schuldenbeleid te publiceren, zodat u van de uitvoeringstoetsen kennis kunt nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kosten van stimulering van elektrische auto’s en de totaal onderschatte vooruitgang in batterij technologie

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder ask whether EV tax subsidies (company car supplement, BPM, MRB, MIA) are cost-effective, how much they cost over five years, and how battery price assumptions in the CarbonTax model compare with forecasts. The government answers in detail, defending EV incentives as necessary for the transition, admitting past forecasting errors, and giving battery price figures while promising monitoring and an evaluation in 2023.
The cabinet is currently awaiting the costing of these proposals.
Het kabinet is op dit moment in afwachting van de doorrekening van deze voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Voordewind over mogelijke staatsgeheimen die gepubliceerd zijn in WOB-stukken over Non Lethal Assistance aan Syrische ‘rebellen’

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked whether state secrets were published in FOIA documents on Non Lethal Assistance to Syrian rebel groups, and what the penalties and actions are. The minister admits some names were wrongly left unredacted, says the government will not publicly name supported groups for security and alliance reasons, reports a data-leak investigation, and offers Parliament renewed confidential access to the documents.
The cabinet nevertheless maintains the principle that no public statements are made about groups that received support under the Non Lethal Assistance (NLA) programme.
Het kabinet blijft evenwel bij het uitgangspunt dat er geen openbare uitspraken gedaan worden over groepen die steun ontvingen in het kader van het Non Lethal Assistance (NLA)-programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over het op tijd inrichten van een keurpunt voor levende dieren voor export naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk in verband met een eventuele harde Brexit

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked whether a border inspection post for live animals imported from the UK is needed in a no-deal Brexit, whether one will be ready by 29 March 2019, and whether the government will work with business to set one up. The minister answered that no approved sea-port inspection post exists in the Netherlands or along the West European coast, that business is responsible for building one and has not yet applied, and that the government will support a solution if business takes the lead.
I am willing to work with the NVWA to facilitate business in realising a solution, if business takes the initiative to do so.
Ik ben bereid om samen met de NVWA het bedrijfsleven te faciliteren bij het realiseren van een oplossing, als het bedrijfsleven daar het initiatief daarvoor neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de 17-jarige Charly T. die al meer dan 4 maanden in voorarrest in Spanje zit

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about a 17-year-old Dutch national held on remand in Spain for over four months, including consular visits, support, and possible transfer to the Netherlands. The minister answered that the embassy has visited and supports him, has contacted Spanish authorities about alternative measures, and that the Dutch prosecutor is willing to cooperate.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de pensioenwet en de wet op de beroepspensioenfondsen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about outsourcing limits for pension funds under the amended pension law, including DUFAS model contract clauses on fiduciary managers, alleged fraud by DUFAS members, and whether supervision should be tightened. The minister acknowledged the outdated model contract was removed, stated pension fund boards remain responsible for investment policy, declined to give information on individual DUFAS members or compensation, and saw no need for additional supervisory action.
The pension fund board is at all times responsible for the investment policy and for supervising it.
Het pensioenfondsbestuur is te allen tijde verantwoordelijk voor het beleggingsbeleid en het toezien daarop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Omtzigt en Van den Berg over voorbereidingen om mogelijke medicijntekorten te voorkomen door een harde Brexit

MPs Slootweg, Omtzigt and Van den Berg asked how medicine shortages from a hard Brexit would be prevented, including supply continuity, registration, stockpiling, patient coverage and Dutch doctors' diploma recognition. The minister answered that the CBG is mapping critical medicines dependent on the UK, IGJ exemptions and alternatives are planned, and the rules for approval and healthcare coverage would be adjusted in a no-deal scenario.
To secure the supply reliability of the critical medicines on the list, several steps will be taken.
Om de leveringszekerheid van de kritieke geneesmiddelen op de lijst te borgen, zullen verschillende stappen worden doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over het bericht “ING top niet getoetst op witwaszaak”

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING's top management was not re-vetted after the money-laundering settlement of EUR 775 million, and whether supervisors should conduct the assessment themselves. The minister answered that re-vetting is solely for the independent supervisor (the ECB for ING board members), that supervisory confidentiality prevents comment on whether re-vetting was considered, and that he has no power to direct the ECB.
It is solely for the independent supervisor to proceed to re-vetting when the facts and circumstances give cause for it.
Het is uitsluitend aan de onafhankelijke toezichthouder om tot hertoetsing over te gaan, wanneer de feiten en omstandigheden daartoe aanleiding geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de merkwaardige bewering van de Belastingdienst bij de Hoge Raad dat hoofdfondsen en onroerende zaken een stabiele beleggingsvorm vormen met weinig risico’s

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the tax authority told the Supreme Court that main-share funds and real estate are stable, low-risk investments, and whether that matches AFM supervision and government policy. The State Secretary answered that the remark was incidental, that the 4% return test does not depend on the risk level of assets, that the AFM does not treat such investments as risk-free, and that a real-return box 3 system is being examined alongside other tax reform work.
It is now up to the Advocate-General to give her opinion in a conclusion on the question put before the Supreme Court.
Het is nu aan de Advocaat-Generaal om in een conclusie haar mening te geven over de kwestie die aan de Hoge Raad is voorgelegd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven, Van der Graaf, Leijten, Van Ojik, Maeijer, Asscher, Van Rooijen, Van Raan, Bisschop, Azarkan en Baudet over de rechtsstatelijke aspecten van de machtigingsbepaling van

MPs from many parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers whether article X of the Brexit omnibus bill, which lets ministers issue temporary general rules that can depart from existing law, undermines legislative primacy and rule-of-law safeguards, and whether they would add safeguards by amendment. The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.
Wij zullen op basis van de zienswijze van de Kamer en verdere reacties uit de samenleving welwillend bezien of een nota van wijziging aangewezen is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat de belastinginspecteur besloten heeft om de RVU-boete voor de gouden handdrukken van bijna 200 miljoen aan de belastingdienst kwijt te schelden

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary about reports that the Tax Authority was waived an RVU penalty of nearly 200 million euros on golden handshakes, and about how the Supreme Court ruling of June 2018 is applied, the consequences for the state, and rights of other employers. The government answered that the inspector applied the Supreme Court criteria, that about 95 million euros is expected to be refunded in 2019, that old policy decrees will be withdrawn, and that the Ministry of Defence will object to its own RVU levy, though it answered late and did not meet the one-week deadline.
Why did you not clearly inform the House about the major consequences for the RVU scheme paid by the state?
Vraag 6 Waarom heeft u de Kamer niet duidelijk geïnformeerd over de grote gevolgen voor de door de staat betaalde RVU-regeling?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over kansen voor Nederlandse batterij-industrie

MPs from the CDA asked the government whether a German one-billion-euro battery investment, possible Dutch battery opportunities, EU state aid rules and related Dutch initiatives could be supported. The State Secretary answered that Germany's plan is national but aligned with the EU initiative, that the Netherlands is exploring battery opportunities via RVO.nl, and that talks with the Commission and a Twente R&D initiative are ongoing, without firm commitments yet.
The German initiative is not yet sufficiently developed to establish whether, and if so how, it will use European funds, and whether it will conflict with European competition rules.

Het Duitse initiatief is nog onvoldoende uitgewerkt om te kunnen vaststellen of, en zo ja, hoe het gebruik zal maken van Europese middelen, en of het ook tegen Europese mededingingsregels zal aanlopen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over ING, dat de balans met 180 miljard euro bijstelde, de accountant die niet weet wat onder die post valt, de bank die zo bankenbelasting bespaarde en vervroegd staatss

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about ING's 180 billion euro balance sheet restatement, the auditor's knowledge of its components, leverage ratio compliance, early repayment of state aid and resulting bonuses. The Minister answered that netting of cash pooling is permitted under international standards, that the components are not further known to him beyond public reporting, and that the matters are for the bank, auditor, AFM and DNB rather than the ministry.
It is up to the auditor to check the annual accounts against the standards.
Het is aan de accountant om de jaarrekening te controleren op basis van de standaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘bij crisis helpt Italië banken’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about Italian Finance Minister Tria's remark that government intervention in troubled banks is not strange, and whether this undermines the banking union rules and future risk-sharing. The minister replied that no Italian state aid to banks is currently at issue, that EU rules remain in force, that the Commission assesses state aid, and that Dutch negotiating positions are unchanged, but declined to answer the last question by the deadline.
It is for the European Commission to assess whether any measures for the banking sector involve state aid and, if so, whether it is permissible aid.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie om te beoordelen of er bij eventuele maatregelen voor de bankensector sprake is van staatssteun en zo ja of het geoorloofde steun is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kosten van het rijden van een auto, lease of in eigendom, elektrisch of benzine

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder asked the State Secretary of Finance for catalogue values and net monthly lease costs for several cars under 2018 and 2019 company-car tax rules, plus the cost of running a five-year-old Tesla or Mitsubishi Outlander. The State Secretary answered with tables of catalogue prices, monthly additions to income and the tax due, using substitute models where the Tesla Model 70 was unavailable.
The table below sets out, for the requested car types for 2018, the catalogue price, the monthly addition to income and the tax due on it.
In de hierna opgenomen tabel zijn van de gevraagde (typen) auto’s voor het jaar 2018 de catalogusprijs, de bijtelling per maand en de belasting die daarover verschuldigd is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Italië en de Euro

An MP asked the government about Italy's rising bond yields, its stress scenario in the MEV 2019, a pension plan, and banking union risk reduction. The government answered that the scenario is not overly optimistic, reported its talks with Italy's prime minister on the budget, and said it would send a new letter on banking risk before April 2019.
The intention is to send your House a new letter on risk reduction in the European banking sector before April 2019.
Het voornemen is om uw Kamer vóór april 2019 een nieuwe brief te sturen inzake risicoreductie in de Europese bankensector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Fiscus blijft falen'

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked about Belastingtelefoon (tax helpline) call-answering failures, unit call numbers, staffing and whether a Q&A or email channel could help. The State Secretary gave detailed monthly figures showing 6-19% of callers not reached within five working days, said callers are not dropped from queues, and outlined 210 FTE extra capacity, but did not give a firm date for restored accessibility and declined email questions for security reasons.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over ING dat haar balans over 2014 en 2015 aanpaste met meer dan 180 miljard euro

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister why ING restated its 2014 and 2015 customer loans by over 180 billion euros, and whether supervision, accounting standards and the ECB were involved. The minister answered that the change reflects a shift from net to gross presentation of cash pooling in ING's accounts, that the accounting rules allow netting, and that the prudential supervisor, not the ministry, oversees such matters and does not comment on individual banks.
The ministry is not responsible for the content of the annual publication of individual banks' financial statements.
Het ministerie is niet verantwoordelijk voor de inhoud van de jaarlijkse publicatie van de jaarrekening van individuele banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Fiscus blijft informatie achterhouden in rechtszaken om kinderopvangtoeslag’

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the tax authority withheld case-relevant notes in court cases over childcare benefit (CAF 11), and why, plus related questions on accountability, remedies and redress. The State Secretary acknowledges that some telephone notes and reports were not submitted, commits to a generous disclosure approach, has the Landsadvocaat review pending cases, and refers to the Ombudsman's findings and further steps.
I have asked the Landsadvocaat to take over the handling of the case files still before the court and to assess whether Toeslagen has submitted all documents relating to the case.

Ik heb de Landsadvocaat gevraagd om de behandeling van de dossiers, die op dit moment nog onder de rechter zijn, over te nemen en in dat kader te beoordelen of Toeslagen alle op de zaak betrekking hebbende stukken heeft overgelegd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet, Omtzigt en Bisschop over de uitvoering van de motie Geluk-Poortvliet en het behoud van het budget voor de instandhoudingssubsidie woonhuis-rijksmonumenten

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet, Omtzigt and Bisschop asked whether the new subsidy scheme for owner-occupied and rented listed homes, and the transfer of budget from the tax deduction, is consistent with a parliamentary motion and whether budgets will suffice. The minister replied that the scheme is open to natural persons only, the full budget remains available to owners, the budget will be evaluated in 2020, and the 100% loan cannot be combined with the subsidy.
As I indicated in my policy letter Erfgoed Telt, budgetary room arises by subsidising only those costs that contribute to maintaining the monumental parts of the monument.

Zoals ik in mijn beleidsbrief Erfgoed Telt heb aangegeven, ontstaat budgettaire ruimte door alleen de kosten te subsidiëren die bijdragen aan de instandhouding van de monumentale onderdelen van het monument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de sluiting van Aramese scholen door de Koerdische YPG in Noordoost-Syrië

MPs Omtzigt, Van Helvert and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware that the YPG had closed Christian schools in north-east Syria, how he assessed this, what contacts the government has with the YPG, and what steps it would take on the risk of ethnic cleansing and a ceasefire. Minister Blok answered that the government finds the reports worrying, will raise them informally with the Benelux representation of the PYD/YPG, and that contacts are sporadic; on ceasefire efforts he described support for initiatives in Idlib without committing to new concrete steps.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts en Slootweg over de voorbereiding van Nederland op een keiharde Brexit

MPs Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts and Slootweg asked the government how prepared the Netherlands is for a no-deal Brexit, including whether the added customs, NVWA and justice capacity will be operational by 29 March 2019 and what risks remain. The government answered that NVWA and customs will only partly be staffed by that date, with temporary service reductions expected, and that departments are taking mitigating measures with the Foreign Affairs minister coordinating.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over pensioenvlucht naar België

MP Omtzigt asked the minister whether he was aware of a Belgian report showing a 50%+ rise in cross-border pension fund assets in 2017, and how much pension capital had moved abroad via cross-border transfers in 2016-2018 and how many DNB approvals were given. The minister confirmed awareness, reported that DNB assessed five cross-border collective transfers (four to Belgium, one to Luxembourg) totalling about 4.3 billion euro, with no grounds to prohibit any, and promised to answer by 8 October.
Between 1 January 2016 and 4 October 2018, DNB assessed 5 cross-border collective value transfers, four to Belgium and one to Luxembourg.
Tussen 1 januari 2016 en 4 oktober 2018 heeft DNB 5 grensoverschrijdende collectieve waardeoverdrachten beoordeeld, vier naar België en één naar Luxemburg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Griekenland wil af van pensioenafspraken met Europa’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about Greece's reported wish to revise pension cuts agreed with Europe, including what the measures are, Greece's fiscal room, the post-programme surveillance procedure and the timing of the next review. The minister confirmed the 2019 pension recalibration and inflation-indexation suspension, said Greece has made no formal request to revise commitments, and described enhanced surveillance with quarterly reporting by the Commission.
At this moment Greece has not made any formal proposal to amend any agreement as agreed for the post-programme period.
Op dit moment heeft Griekenland geen formeel voorstel gedaan tot aanpassing van enige afspraak zoals overeengekomen voor de post-programma periode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over militair optreden in Syrië

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister whether he remembers partially publishing internal international-law advice on possible military action in Syria after a Wob request, to list the internal legal advice given on Syria since late 2014, and to publish it or explain why not. The minister confirmed a summary part was released, said advice covered the NLA programme, the mandate for operations over Syria and the response to chemical weapons use, and declined to publish it, citing the need for candid internal advice, though it gave confidential access to decision memoranda on the NLA programme.
The cabinet attaches great importance to civil servants being able to advise impartially and in confidence, and therefore as a rule does not provide internal advice.
Het kabinet hecht er zeer aan dat ambtenaren onbevangen en in vertrouwen kunnen adviseren en verstrekt interne adviezen dan ook in de regel niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over de voortgangsrapportage rentederivaten, waaruit blijkt dat twee banken alle deadlines missen

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes (CDA) asked the Finance Minister why ABN AMRO and Rabobank are missing the deadline for the interest rate derivatives redress framework for SMEs, and about related issues such as advance payments, limitation periods, the mandate of the complaints committee, the withdrawn AFM fine on ABN AMRO and whether banks should pay higher interest. The Minister answered that the framework's timelines are being monitored with the AFM, that banks are contacted and committed to finishing by end 2018, and that he sees no grounds for further mandates, investigations or a higher interest rate.
I currently see insufficient reason to conduct further research into this.
Ik zie op dit moment onvoldoende aanleiding om hier verder onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse steun aan de Syrische rebellen en de vele geheime onderzoeken die daarnaar gedaan worden

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign and Prime Minister about Dutch support to Syrian rebels, the ending of the NLA programme, and the secrecy and multiple reviews surrounding it. Minister Blok answers that the programme ended, that delivery documents are classified for security reasons, that reports will be shared confidentially before the debate, and that some detailed information cannot be disclosed.
Prior to the debate on the NLA programme, the cabinet will send the full research report to the House on a confidential basis.
Voorafgaand aan het debat over het NLA-programma zal kabinet het volledige onderzoeksrapport op vertrouwelijk basis aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over intern volkenrechtelijk advies over de steun aan de rebellen in Syrië

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether internal international-law advice on arms-type aid to Syrian rebels is public, whether the government deliberately avoided external advice, and asked for all such advice to be sent to parliament before a debate. The minister said internal advice is not state secret but falls under personal policy views and is not released by default, and offered confidential inspection of the decision memoranda for the NLA programme.
In this exceptional case, the cabinet is prepared, exceptionally, to give the House confidential access to the decision memoranda on the NLA programme if desired.
In dit bijzondere geval is het kabinet bij uitzondering bereid de Kamer desgewenst vertrouwelijk inzage te geven in de besluitvormingsmemoranda over het NLA-programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de berichtgeving dat hulpgelden niet terechtkomen bij yezidi’s en christenen

MPs Kuik, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the minister whether EU and Dutch aid reaches Yazidis and Christians in northern Iraq, how EU funds are controlled, and what is being done to free abducted Yazidi women and children. The minister disputed the reports, described Dutch and EU humanitarian funding and partner-vetting mechanisms, and gave overviews of projects, while pointing to the Iraqi government for inclusive governance and promising a country strategy and an annual letter on EU external financing.
Based on the GNI distribution key, the Dutch share of this contribution is approximately 4.7%.
Op basis van de BNI-verdeelsleutel is het Nederlandse aandeel in deze bijdrage circa 4,7%.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over het bericht dat de Oostenrijkse bankentoezichthouder zijn toezicht op Turkse banken verscherpt en over het toezicht op Turkse banken in Nederland, waarvan tegoeden o

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch supervisors are monitoring Turkish-owned banks in the Netherlands, how much of their deposits are covered by the Dutch deposit guarantee scheme, and whether limits apply to their deposit-taking and lending. The minister answered that the five Dutch-licensed banks with Turkish ownership are fully subject to Dutch supervision and EU rules, that DNB does not publish bank-specific splits, and that a cap on foreign exposures relative to guaranteed deposits applies, while no absolute deposit cap exists.
DNB publishes financial data of individual banks on its website.
DNB publiceert financiële gegevens van individuele banken op haar website.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de onvolledige antwoorden op de vragen over de erf-en schenkbelasting en de herhaalde weigering om gevraagde stukken aan de Kamer te sturen

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance why answers on the inheritance and gift tax problems have been incomplete and why he keeps refusing to send internal memos and ICT analyses to parliament. The State Secretary replies that he has informed parliament sufficiently, that internal deliberation documents are kept confidential under cabinet policy, that the ICT analysis documents cannot be published for security reasons, and that management information was inadequate in April–June 2018.
I do not refuse any information.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over de verhuizing van een pensioenfonds van AON naar België en het feit dat de dekkingsgraad enkel door de verhuizing met 11% stijgt vanwege het verschil in toezicht

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked whether a Dutch pension fund moving to Belgium gains about 11 points of funding ratio from looser supervision, whether DNB may block such transfers, and how a 3.5% discount rate can be prudent. The minister answered that Belgian principle-based supervision differs, that DNB must approve cross-border transfers under IORP rules, and that the government considers avoidance-driven transfers undesirable but has no evidence of it.
For completeness, it should be noted that there is no relocation, i.e. transfer of seat, of a Dutch pension fund.
Voor de volledigheid wordt nog opgemerkt dat er geen sprake is van een verhuizing, oftewel zetelverplaatsing, van een Nederlands pensioenfonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het stopzetten van de kinderopvangtoeslag en de gevolgen daarvan en het inzagerecht van de burger in gegevens en telefoonnotities bij de BelastingTelefoon

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the termination of childcare allowance, compensation for affected families, the Belastingdienst's CAF 11 investigation documents, and citizens' right to access BelastingTelefoon call notes under the GDPR. The State Secretary answered that compensation is generally limited to statutory interest, that 109 parents received interest payments and three damage claims were rejected, that the CAF 11 report and documents will be shared confidentially, and that access rights cover only personal data, not whole documents.
So that your House can nonetheless form a good picture of the investigation and the underlying documentation, I am prepared to make the documents available for confidential inspection by your House.
Om uw Kamer toch in staat te stellen een goed beeld te krijgen van het onderzoek en de onderliggende documentatie, wil ik de stukken ter vertrouwelijke inzage aan uw Kamer verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pieter Heerma over het lage-inkomensvoordeel

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the effectiveness and transparency of the low-income benefit (LIV) paid to employers, including its use by staffing agencies, whether beschikkingen are public, and the sector breakdown. The minister argued the LIV lowers labour costs and raises employment per CPB, said no hard employment data exists yet, refused to publish firm-level figures on confidentiality grounds, and committed to a UWV baseline measurement and a report on the samenloop with the ET-regeling by year end.
A more detailed overview at employer level is not desirable because it would disclose confidential company data.
Een gedetailleerder overzicht op werkgeversniveau is niet wenselijk omdat het vertrouwelijke bedrijfsgegevens openbaar maakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de toekenning van de speciale editie van de mensenrechtentulp aan de Hoge Commissaris voor de Mensenrechten Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein en de rol van de commissaris i

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked how the special Human Rights Tulip was awarded to outgoing UN High Commissioner Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein, given his role in the treatment of whistleblower Anders Kompass, and whether he should apologise and help child victims of abuse by peacekeepers. The minister explains the award procedure and the decision by the minister, says the independent panel found no abuse of power by the High Commissioner, notes that a UN tribunal case is pending, and declines to request an apology, while pointing to UN and UNICEF measures for victims and whistleblower protection.
The cabinet will strive to answer your questions before the Human Rights Tulip ceremony.
Het kabinet zal streven naar beantwoording van uw vragen voor de uitreiking van de Mensenrechtentulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de toekenning van de mensenrechtentulp aan Zeid Ra’ad Al Hussein

MPs Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked why the Dutch human rights award was given to outgoing UN High Commissioner Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein despite whistleblower allegations of cover-ups, and whether he would apologise to whistleblowers Reilly and Kompass. The minister answered that the one-off award honoured his record defending human rights defenders, that no independent committee was involved, that the whistleblower cases were handled by UN bodies with proceedings still pending, and that the government will not ask him to apologise.
No independent committee was involved in the decision-making on the award.
Bij de besluitvorming rond de toekenning was geen onafhankelijke commissie betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Belastingtelefoon slecht bereikbaar’

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Phone (BelastingTelefoon) was hard to reach, including ombudsman complaints, rejected calls, staffing cuts and forecasting. The State Secretary admits reachability is worse than he would like, reports 141 complaints and 1 June-31 July, cites added capacity and recruitment, and explains the call-planning model and the still-incomplete digital status portal.
Yes, reachability is worse than normal and worse than I would like.
Ja, de bereikbaarheid is slechter dan normaal en slechter dan ik zou willen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Geen reactie op uitstelverzoek door storing bij fiscus’

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked about a technical fault at the Tax Authority that left extension-request replies unsent from April to July 2018, and about redirecting callers to the BelastingTelefoon and waiting times for advisers. The Secretary of State confirmed the fault, gave the number of affected requests (29,203, of which 380 rejections), said the wait times were short and that the claim that a quarter of advisers dropped off was wrong due to incorrect open data.
A solution to this problem was implemented in the ICT environment on 20 July.
Voor dit probleem is op 20 juli een oplossing gerealiseerd in de ICT-omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de belastingtelefoon en alternatieve manieren van communiceren met de Belastingdienst

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the Tax Administration stopped publishing belastingtelefoon performance figures in its half-yearly reports, asked for call-waiting, staffing and sick-leave data, and asked about electronic communication and procedures for written questions and rulings. The State Secretary answered that the indicators were replaced by client-satisfaction and technical-accessibility measures, gave the requested data and queue-management details, said formal electronic communication is not yet open, and committed to restoring accessibility to early-2017 levels by early 2019.
The accessibility indicator, for example, only provides insight into the accessibility of telephone service, whereas the Tax Administration provides services through multiple channels.
De bereikbaarheidsindicator biedt bijvoorbeeld enkel inzicht in de bereikbaarheid van de telefonische dienstverlening, terwijl de Belastingdienst via meerdere kanalen diensten verleent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de klokkenluidersbrief van Roelie Post.

Rep. Omtzigt asked the Foreign and Prime Minister about whistleblower Roelie Post, who sent a letter to the European Parliament president copied to the Dutch Prime Minister during the Dutch EU presidency, and about her dismissal by the European Commission. The government replied that EU whistleblowing guidelines allow external channels as a last resort, that the copy was noted rather than read, and that the dispute is for the Commission and the EU General Court to resolve, so the government takes no mediating role.
The copy of this letter was therefore officially received for information and was not read by the Prime Minister.
Het afschrift van deze brief is daarom ambtelijk aangenomen ter kennisgeving en niet door de Minister-President gelezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over omkoping van parlementariërs vanuit Azerbeidzjan

An MP asks the foreign minister and prime minister about alleged bribery of parliamentarians by Azerbaijan, including the 'Azerbaijan Laundromat' and the Council of Europe PACE corruption investigation, and asks why the Committee of Ministers and GRECO are not pursuing an independent inquiry. The minister answers that the government is aware of the reports, supports GRECO follow-up, and will monitor developments, but does not commit to pushing for a new independent investigation.
The cabinet welcomes the steps taken so far.
Het kabinet verwelkomt de tot op heden genomen stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Anne Mulder en Asscher over de gevolgen van het no deal-scenario voor Nederlandse en EU-burgers in het Verenigd Koninkrijk

MPs Omtzigt, Mulder and Asscher asked the government about the consequences of a no-deal Brexit for Dutch and EU citizens in the UK, including settled status, the need for a helpdesk, and timely information. The government answered that the UK's Settlement Scheme offers no hard guarantees, that a no-deal scenario is being prepared for, that information is provided via IND and the embassy, and that the Chamber will be briefed in September and a closed technical briefing in October.
However, this Statement of Intent offers no hard guarantees.
Dit Statement of Intent biedt echter geen harde garanties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Voordewind en Özdil over de hogeschool Saxion, die een stuk over de Aramese genocide niet plaatst omdat er ophef en discussie over is in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Voordewind and Özdil asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Saxion's decision not to publish a student interview on the Aramean genocide due to public controversy, questioning whether such concerns justify withholding publication and whether the institution should be told so. The Minister replied that controversy alone should not be a reason to withhold publication, that the editorial decision was made independently for safety reasons, that the article was later published internally and on Saxion's website, and that she sees no need for further action or a joint statement.
I am of the view that controversy and debate should not be reasons to avoid speaking or writing about a subject.
Ik ben van mening dat ophef en discussie geen redenen mogen zijn om over een onderwerp niet te spreken of te schrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Belastingtelefoon slecht bereikbaar’
