Two MPs (Lodders, Omtzigt) asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Helpline was poorly reachable, whether quality indicators were valid, and what steps would fix it. The State Secretary attributed the problems to tight capacity planning, staff absence, a supplier change and a shrinking labour market, cited reachability figures, and announced extra staff and new quality controls from November 2018.
I agree with you that the reachability of the Tax Helpline must return to the level of the first half of 2017, and that the answers given must be of sufficient quality.

Ik ben met u van mening dat de bereikbaarheid van de Belastingtelefoon weer terug moet bewegen naar het niveau van de eerste helft 2017 en dat daarbij de gegeven antwoorden van een voldoende kwaliteit moeten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over de netto opbrengst van pachtgronden

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance how lease returns on farmland compare with the box 3 wealth tax assumed yield of 5.39%, whether the regulated rent norms can leave net lease income below the tax, and whether the government will change the box 3 system. The government answered that regulated lease prices cap only direct rental income, that box 3 is a forfaitary system averaging returns across wealth levels, that some individual landlords may face a higher tax burden than their lease income, and that a letter on actual-return box 3 is in preparation, while declining to give a regional breakdown of average net returns and of lease-type-specific yields.

Because the returns on savings and investments are adjusted annually on the basis of the most recent available data, the wealth yield tax system from 2017 onward better matches the average actual return.

Doordat de rendementen op spaargeld en beleggingen jaarlijks worden aangepast aan de hand van de meest actueel beschikbare gegevens sluit het stelsel van de vermogensrendementsheffing vanaf 2017 beter aan bij het gemiddelde werkelijke rendement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de steun van de Nederlandse regering aan de rebellen in Zuid-Syrië

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch non-lethal assistance to Syrian rebels in the south, including reports of US withdrawal, other donors, results, and whether support continues. Minister Blok answered that the NLA programme in the south has ended, the north programme was also stopped, and that the government's objectives were stability on the Jordanian and Israeli borders and a foothold for the opposition.
Besides the Netherlands, the US also publicly states that it supported the moderate armed opposition in southern Syria in 2018.
Naast Nederland stelt ook de VS publiekelijk dat het de gematigde gewapende oppositie in Zuid-Syrië in 2018 heeft gesteund.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het steunprogramma aan de Syrische gewapende oppositie

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the Dutch support programme for the Syrian armed opposition, including the external evaluation, the number of groups supported, vehicle deliveries, end-use and goal achievement. The minister answered most questions with confidentiality and security reasons, declined to share the evaluation or transfer documents, and pointed to an IOB review and an Auditdienst Rijk audit still underway.
Information about this project, as stated in the external evaluation, is state secret.
Informatie over dit project, zoals vermeld in de externe evaluatie zijn staatsgeheim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer, Snels, Van Weyenberg, Omtzigt, Lodders en Leijten over een nieuw datalek bij Mossack Fonseca

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a new Mossack Fonseca data leak, how the Tax Authority will use the data, the yield and cost of Panama Papers work, the promised business case on strengthening its information position, and staffing outflow. The State Secretary confirmed awareness, said analysis will start once the data is public, and stated that costs and yields cannot be separately tracked or directly linked, promising a broader assessment and information to parliament on Prinsjesdag 2018.

I will inform the House on Prinsjesdag 2018 to what extent additional investment in strengthening the Tax Authority's information position and enforcement capacity could benefit tax revenues and its enforcement strategy.

Ik informeer uw Kamer op Prinsjesdag 2018 in hoeverre een extra investering op het terrein van de versterking van de informatiepositie en de opsporingscapaciteit van de Belastingdienst de belastingopbrengsten en ook de handhavingstrategie van de Belastingdienst ten goede kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins, Van Weyenberg en Lodders over rulings over de dividendbelasting

MPs Omtzigt, Bruins, Van Weyenberg and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the full dividend-tax ruling policy of the past fifteen years, whether companies can pay dividends to zero-dividend-tax jurisdictions, how many dividend-tax rulings exist, whether they comply with law, and whether the commission examined pre-2015 rulings. The State Secretary answered that no separate ruling policy exists beyond the Verzamelbesluit, that counts of rulings were not systematically kept, that rulings are checked on procedure, and that the independent commission examined a random sample of 2017 APA/ATR rulings including some dividend-tax ones.
The number of cases in which advance certainty was given on the application of the Dividend Tax Act 1965 has not been systematically recorded over the past 15 years.
Het aantal gevallen waarin zekerheid vooraf is gegeven over de toepassing van de Wet op de dividendbelasting 1965 is niet systematisch bijgehouden in de afgelopen 15 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de problemen bij de schenk- en erfbelasting die al lang bekend waren bij de Belastingdienst, maar pas in november 2017 aan de Kamer werden meegedeeld

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance why problems with the new inheritance and gift tax systems, known to the Tax Administration well before November 2017, were only reported to parliament then, and asks for the internal memos and whether withholding them is justified. The State Secretary answers that the delay only became clear in autumn 2017, that internal memos stay confidential as intern beraad, that all relevant information has been shared, and that he will not map who knew what when.
I do not provide the requested internal documents, referring briefly to the letter of 25 April 2016 from the Minister of the Interior.
De gevraagde interne documenten verstrek ik niet, waarbij ik kortheidshalve verwijs naar de Kamerbrief van 25 april 2016
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pieter Heerma en Slootweg over het lage-inkomensvoordeel

CDA MPs asked about cost increases, implementation status, employer error handling, EU worker eligibility, and the evaluation of the low-income benefit (LIV) and youth LIV. The minister answered that ICT implementation is on schedule, that targeted evaluations will follow, but that employment effects cannot yet be assessed since payments have not yet started.
The first LIV payment will be made by mid-September 2018 at the latest, and the youth LIV a year later.
De eerste betaling van het LIV zal uiterlijk medio september 2018 zijn en voor het jeugd-LIV een jaar later.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Van Rooijen over het feit dat de Raad van de Europese Unie geen enkel antwoord geeft op de aanbevelingen van de Europees Ombudsman over transparantie en geheimhouding e

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Van Rooijen asked why the EU Council has not responded to the European Ombudsman's February 2018 recommendations on transparency and secrecy in its working documents, which they argued breaches the EU treaty. The Minister replied that no formal treaty deadline binds the Council, that the Netherlands pressed for a timely reply, and that a substantive Council response is expected in early July 2018.
Formally, no obligation arises from Article 228 TFEU for the Council to send its position to the European Ombudsman within three months.
Antwoord 3 Formeel vloeit er geen verplichting voor de Raad voort uit artikel 228 VWEU om binnen drie maanden een antwoord om de Europese Ombudsman zijn standpunt mede te delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Omtzigt over een gezin waarvan de vrouw werkt, de man permanent in een WLZ-instelling verblijft en de kinderen dus geen recht hebben op kinderopvangtoeslag omdat de man niet werk

MPs Peters and Omtzigt asked why a family where the father is permanently in a WLZ care facility and the mother works cannot get childcare allowance, and why statutory articles on social-medical indicators have never entered into force. The Secretary of State acknowledges the rule can be harsh, says she will examine a statutory exception and report this autumn, but declines to comment on individual cases and points to municipalities for SMI.
Unfortunately I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan helaas niet op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geluk-Poortvliet over de gang van zaken rondom het vervallen van de ANW-compensatieregeling bij het ABP

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Geluk-Poortvliet, CDA) asked why the government and ABP accepted that the ANW-compensation scheme's abolition was poorly communicated, with no consequences, and whether supervisors, the ABP board and pension rules were adequate. The minister answered that supervision lies with independent regulators (DNB and AFM), that the ABP board knows its scheme, that no fine was imposed and no supervisor contacted, and that a 5-year coulance scheme and a 2019 evaluation will follow, with some commitments to evaluate.
The ABP board is currently carrying out an evaluation, in which the social partners are also involved.
Het ABP-bestuur is momenteel bezig met een evaluatie, waarbij ook de sociale partners worden betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) en de Belastingdienst

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Administration's compliance with the GDPR, including its register of processing, impact assessments, rights handling, data breaches and Data Protection Authority investigations. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging shortcomings and promising measures and a one-year timeline for full compliance, while declining to predict AP enforcement and withholding some detail.
In the GDPR implementation process the Tax Administration has identified a number of shortcomings in compliance.
Antwoord 2 De Belastingdienst heeft in het traject voor implementatie van de AVG een aantal »tekortkomingen in de naleving geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de mogelijke strafbaarheid van het vechten voor Turkije in Syrië

Two MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether Turkish dual nationals could be mobilised for the Afrin offensive, whether Dutch citizens fighting for the Free Syrian Army or serving in Turkish forces are criminally liable, and whether the Turkish offensive is lawful. The ministers answered that no general mobilisation orders are known, that fighting in Syria is in principle punishable for Dutch nationals except for state-authorised action against IS, that serving in foreign armed forces is not in itself criminal, and that the government takes no active role in advising those called up; several questions were answered by reference to earlier letters or deferred.
Active participation other than on government orders in the fight against IS in Iraq and Syria is in principle punishable.
Actieve deelname anders dan in opdracht van de overheid aan de strijd tegen IS in Irak en Syrië is in beginsel strafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Omtzigt, Remco Dijkstra en Van der Graaf over de verkeersveiligheid op de N36

MPs from CDA, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the minister why the N36 would not be widened along two sections during this year's maintenance, despite a motion adopted by parliament, and whether the government would guarantee full widening. The minister confirmed awareness of the motion and the coalition agreement, outlined interim safety measures, and said the remaining sections are being studied with results due in the second half of 2018, but gave no guarantee of full widening.
Following the adopted motion, I am examining the added value of widening on the sections where major maintenance is not currently taking place.
Naar aanleiding van de aangenomen motie onderzoek ik wat de meerwaarde is van verbreding op de delen waar groot onderhoud nu niet plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitgaven en de resultaten van de investeringsagenda en de gevolgen voor de plannen uit het regeerakkoord

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about spending and results of the Tax Authority's Investment Agenda, its funding after the redesign, expected extra revenue of 750 million euros per year, and whether coalition agreement measures and the fiscal policy agenda are at risk due to Tax Authority problems. The State Secretary answered with spending tables and remaining budget figures, said a direct link between investments and extra revenue cannot be established, and said implementation feasibility will be assessed through implementation tests without concrete reason to expect failures.

As my predecessor informed the House in his letter of 30 June 2016, and as I did in my letter of 23 February, it has proven impossible both ex ante and ex post to establish a direct link between specific investments and higher tax revenues.

Zoals mijn voorganger de Kamer in zijn brief van 30 juni 2016 heeft laten weten en ik in mijn brief van 23 februari jl., is gebleken dat het zowel ex ante als ex post niet mogelijk is een directe relatie te leggen tussen specifieke investeringen en meer belastingopbrengsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pieter Heerma en Van Toorenburg over de As Soennah moskee die onder de Nederlandse wet aangemerkt is als goed doel

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the As Soennah mosque holding ANBI charity status despite reportedly preaching against women's rights and advocating stoning, its missing mandatory publications, and whether foreign public bodies automatically qualify as ANBIs. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority cannot disclose individual cases, that foreign public bodies qualify automatically under current law and that the ANBI definition is under review together with other ministers, and that transparency proposals on funding from unfree countries are being explored.
The Tax Authority is bound by the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act and therefore does not provide information on individual cases.
De Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) en verstrekt derhalve geen informatie over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Omtzigt over het onderzoek naar paasvuren

MPs Von Martels and Omtzigt asked why RIVM is studying Easter bonfire emissions, who commissioned it, its cost, and whether Easter fires are intangible heritage. The government answered that RIVM is updating the national emissions register under international obligations, estimated Easter fire PM10 emissions at about 10% of stove emissions, and budgeted 6,800 euro for a sizing study before any decision on inclusion.
Therefore it was decided to further determine the size of the source in 2018.
Daarom is besloten om in 2018 de grootte van de bron nader te gaan bepalen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het niet delen van interne stukken (telefoonnoties van de belastingtelefoon) met de rechter en over het recht van de burger om de telefoonnotities van de belastingtelefoon te k

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance why Belastingdienst telephone notes are not shared with courts or parties, whether citizens can access them, and about compensation for parents affected by the childcare benefit (toeslagen) affair. The State Secretary answered that administrative bodies must send all case-relevant documents, that phone notes are usually personal working notes not requiring disclosure, that citizens' access rights are legally regulated, and declined to discuss individual cases still before the courts or involving individuals.
Telephone notes are usually no more than personal working notes used as a memory aid for the author.
Telefoonnotities zijn veelal niet meer dan persoonlijke werkaantekeningen die gebruikt worden als geheugensteuntje voor de opsteller.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins Slot en Van der Molen over de hoge OZB-rekeningen voor sportverenigingen en andere Sociaal Belang Behartigende Instellingen (SBBI)

CDA MPs asked whether municipalities charging sports clubs property tax (OZB) and then refunding it via subsidy is bureaucratic, whether non-residential OZB burdens on SBBI's are excessive, and whether the Municipalities Act should be amended to allow equal rates or an exemption. The minister answered that OZB rates and subsidies are a local democratic choice, declined to amend the law or grant a blanket exemption, and said no general judgement on burdens is possible.
An amendment of the Municipalities Act is not necessary in my view at this moment.
Een aanpassing van de Gemeentewet vind ik op dit moment niet nodig.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Dam en Omtzigt over de aangenomen resolutie van de parlementaire assemblee van de Raad van Europa “Prosecuting and punishing the crimes against humanity or even possible g

MPs Van Helvert, Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether the government will act on a Council of Europe resolution calling ISIS crimes genocide, including whether to appoint a specialised prosecutor and enable handover of evidence. The government confirmed its support for the resolution, described existing investigative cooperation, and promised to study the specialised prosecutor proposal and report back.
I will inform your House of the results of this study.
Over de resultaten van dit onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over de bizar hoge voorbeeldrendementen bij beleggingsverzekeringen en het risico op een nieuwe (pensioen)woekerpolisaffaire

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about unrealistically high example returns (up to 16%) in investment insurance products under the EU PRIIPs regulation and the risk of a new pension-insurance scandal. The minister answered that the returns follow a mandated EU calculation method based on the past five years, that the issue is being raised at EU level with the AFM, and that Dutch parliament had no role in the delegated regulation.
Parliament was not informed about the adoption of the delegated regulation.
Over de vaststelling van de gedelegeerde verordening is Uw Kamer niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Omtzigt en Lodders over het btw-nummer van zzp’ers dat het burgerservicenummer bevat

MPs Van der Molen, Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether the VAT number of sole traders contains the citizen service number (BSN) and whether this is lawful under privacy rules, and asked the government to stop including the BSN in new VAT numbers. The State Secretary of Finance answered that the BSN is part of the VAT number for natural persons for historical and EU-specification reasons, that a legal basis exists under the Wabb and Wet op de omzetbelasting, and that he is open to a different VAT number format, with information to the House before summer 2018 but declined to report on the Data Protection Authority's investigation.
I cannot make any statement about the status of the Data Protection Authority's investigation.
Over de stand van zaken van het onderzoek van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Omtzigt over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof inzake transparantie van de triloogonderhandelingen

MPs Leijten and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the General Court ruling in De Capitani v Parliament (T-540/15) requiring public disclosure of trilogue four-column documents, and how it will promote transparency. The minister welcomed the ruling, said the Limité marking should be applied as restrictively as possible and that Nederland will press the Council secretariat on this and on proactive publication, but declined to commit to standard publication of the documents.
The Netherlands is working to ensure that this assessment is carried out carefully.
Nederland zet er op in dat deze afweging zorgvuldig gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geluk-Poortvliet over het vervallen van de ANW-compensatieregeling bij het ABP

MPs Omtzigt and Geluk-Poortvliet asked about the abolition of the ANW compensation scheme at the ABP pension fund, including communication failures, the five-year limit on the hardship arrangement, and whether a duty of care applies to risk coverage. The minister acknowledged communication was unfortunate and insufficient, defended the five-year limit and the abolition as a joint social-partner decision, and declined to ask the AFM for an investigation.
I am also not willing to ask the ABP to remove this five-year term.
Ik ben ook niet bereid het ABP te verzoeken deze vijfjaarstermijn te schrappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over de adviesaanvraag over de sluiting van Siemens Hengelo

MPs Amhaouch and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Siemens' works council request to close the profitable Hengelo plant, including whether the government would seek to influence the supervisory board. The minister said he is in contact with Siemens Nederland's management and Siemens AG, which committed to preserving jobs, but that the supervisory board makes its own judgement and he will not intervene in a strategic corporate decision beyond offering help.
The management boards of Siemens Nederland and Siemens AG are responsible for taking a strategic decision such as the proposed closure of Hengelo.
De directies van Siemens Nederland en Siemens AG zijn verantwoordelijk voor het nemen van een strategisch besluit als de voorgenomen sluiting van Hengelo.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse steun aan het Vrije Syrische Leger

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether Dutch non-lethal support to Free Syrian Army groups had reached groups now fighting alongside Turkey in Afrin, and requested transfer documents and a fuller answer. The government declined to publish transfer documents or group names for security reasons, said support was stopped in northern Syria in March 2018, and referred the specific questions to a confidential letter.
For security reasons the cabinet does not make public information from which it can be inferred which groups Netherlands supports or supported or where they are located.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen maakt het kabinet geen informatie openbaar waaruit kan worden afgeleid welke groepen door Nederland worden of werden gesteund of waar ze zich precies bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de pretoetredingssteun van de Europese Unie aan Turkije

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about EU pre-accession aid to Turkey: the funding per year and sector for 2014–2020, spending on prisons, police, justice and press freedom, and whether funds reach the Turkish government directly. The minister answers most questions with figures and programme details, notes the aid was cut and redirected toward civil society and rule of law, and says no projects on police/justice were funded in 2017 while 2018 programming is still in progress.
The Commission is currently still working out the programming for 2018.
De Commissie werkt de programmering voor 2018 momenteel nog uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Omtzigt en Rudmer Heerema over de btw-vrijstelling voor denksporten

MPs Bruins Slot, Omtzigt and Rudmer Heerema asked about the VAT exemption for mind sports (bridge, chess, draughts) after the 2017 CJEU ruling that such activities are not 'sport'. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling removes the sports exemption, estimates about EUR 1 million extra VAT revenue, and says talks are underway on possibly listing mind sports under the cultural services exemption, with a letter to the House promised before the summer recess.
However, I aim to inform the House in more detail about this before the summer recess.
Ik streef er echter wel naar uw kamer voor het zomerreces hierover nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitspraak van het hof in Den Bosch in een tipgeverszaak van zwartspaarders

Mr Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Den Bosch appeal court ruling in the informant case involving Luxembourg tax evaders, questioning the timeline of contacts with the informant, whether the tax authority obstructed witness testimony, and the handling of the case. The State Secretary largely refused to go into the substance, citing ongoing litigation, withheld procedural documents and cost information, and rejected calls for an independent review.
The case is still before the courts. The discussion about the ruling of the Den Bosch Court of Appeal will be conducted by my Cassation team before the Supreme Court.
De zaak is nog onder de rechter. De discussie over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof ’s-Hertogenbosch zal door mijn team Cassatie bij de Hoge Raad worden gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over een brede open studie naar het zorgstelsel en de zorgkosten

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked whether the government and the WRR would carry out a broad open study of the healthcare system and rising healthcare costs, as promised in the budget debate. The minister replied that the government supports the request, is consulting the WRR, and that the WRR will decide on its work programme this spring.
Yes, we have discussed your request and wholeheartedly support it.
Ja, wij hebben uw verzoek besproken en steunen het verzoek van harte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het bericht 'PGGM wil samen met Apollo een bod doen op chemietak AkzoNobel'

MPs Van den Berg and Omtzigt asked the minister about reports of a PGGM and Apollo bid for AkzoNobel's chemicals division, its job and R&D impact, and whether the government would intervene. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that divestment is a company strategic decision outside government's role, noted the company's sustainability record, and said the ministry will monitor developments without committing to action.
However, the sale of the Specialty Chemicals division is a strategic decision of AkzoNobel.
Verkoop van de divisie Specialty Chemicals is echter een strategische beslissing van AkzoNobel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Van Rooijen over het transparantie initiatief, ondertekend door 26 delegaties van commissies voor Europese aangelegenheden uit de parlementen van de lidstaten van de Eu

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Van Rooijen asked whether the Dutch representative handed the COSAC transparency report to the Bulgarian presidency, whether all member states received it, what comments exist, when it will be on the agenda, and whether the government has actively pushed for its proposals. The minister confirmed the handover, said the initiators were responsible for distribution, stated no comments had been made and the Council's reaction will come later, and said the government has raised the topic and will seek a suitable moment to put it on the General Affairs Council agenda.
The cabinet will endeavour to put the subject of transparency on the General Affairs Council agenda at a suitable moment, in consultation with the presidency.
Het kabinet zal zich inspannen om het onderwerp van transparantie, in samenspraak met het voorzitterschap, op een geëigend moment te agenderen voor de Raad Algemene Zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pieter Heerma en Slootweg over het niet-opgevolgde advies van het Bureau ICT Toetsing (BIT) om het ICT project Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein gedeeltelijk uit te stellen

Members Omtzigt, Heerma and Slootweg (CDA) asked why the government did not follow the BIT advice to postpone part of the Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein ICT project, why the advice was not sent to parliament within the required four weeks, and about costs, readiness, privacy assessments, staffing and oversight. The minister acknowledged the late transmission, said the deviation was made deliberately after end-to-end testing, and gave detailed assurances on implementation progress, while declining to give a timeline for some cost and readiness details and deferring some answers.
I regret that I was unable to inform your House within the four-week response period.
Ik betreur het dat ik uw Kamer niet binnen de reactietermijn van vier weken heb kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het aanvullend pensioenfonds van Europarlementariërs

MP Omtzigt asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Social Affairs about the supplementary pension fund for MEPs, which has a coverage ratio of about 37% and may need large top-up payments. Minister Blok answered that the European Parliament itself must find a solution for its own pension scheme, that the Dutch recovery rules would likely force substantial cuts for a Dutch fund at that level, and declined to write to EIOPA or commit to a specific step, saying the answers would follow within the deadlines.
It is for the EP to find a solution to this problem.
Het is aan het EP een oplossing voor deze problematiek te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over dubbele belastingheffing over pensioenen van grensarbeiders uit België

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why Dutch taxing rights extend to whole pensions from Belgium-resident frontier workers, and about double taxation, indexation of the 25,000 euro threshold, Belgian taxation of Dutch AOW pensions, and treatment of business-owner pension buyouts. The government answered that it has source-state taxing rights under the treaty where Belgium cannot adequately tax, that a bilateral arrangement addresses double taxation, that indexation would need a treaty amendment, and that the buyout concession was implemented via a Belgian circular.
With recently agreed arrangements between Belgium and the Netherlands, a solution has been found for this.
Met recent gemaakte afspraken tussen België en Nederland is hier een oplossing voor gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert en Bruins over de balansen in Target2 en de daarmee verbonden risico’s

Three MPs (Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bruins) asked the Finance Minister about TARGET2 balances, financial fragmentation, possible capital flight, deposit discouragement, and whether TARGET2 should be an EU policy indicator. The minister replied that fragmentation persists but is declining, that the current balances stem from ECB asset purchases rather than capital flight, that discouraging deposits is undesirable, and that the government works on EU reforms to reduce the underlying imbalances.
As I also indicated in my answer to question 2, the current rise in TARGET2 balances differs fundamentally in origin from the rise during the crisis.
Zoals ik ook in de beantwoording van vraag 2 heb aangegeven, verschilt de huidige oploop van TARGET2-saldi wezenlijk in oorsprong van de oploop ten tijden van de crisis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of Brexit for the Netherlands, focusing on a customs impact memo, customs staffing needs (500-800 extra staff), IT readiness and the timing of recruitment. The government answered that the Douane and NVWA are recruiting within existing frameworks, that analyses for internal deliberation will not be shared, and that preparations continue ahead of March 2019.
The analyses requested by your House were, however, prepared for internal deliberation and it is undesirable that they become the subject of political debate.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde analyses zijn echter opgesteld voor intern beraad en het is onwenselijk dat zij onderwerp zijn van politiek debat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts, Omtzigt, Von Martels en Slootweg over transparantie regionaal BO van 18 december 2017 en Alderstafel Lelystad Airport

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about transparency of the regional administrative consultation of 18 December 2017, whether minutes and agenda would be public, the remaining steps before the environmental impact report, and the evaluation of the Schiphol advisory council. The Minister confirmed the importance of transparency but declined to publish the minutes of the 18 December consultation for now, citing confidential input from provincial officials, and promised further consultation and a letter to parliament in early February.
Therefore I will not yet make the minutes of the administrative consultation of 18 December 2017 public at this time.
Derhalve zal ik het verslag van het bestuurlijk overleg van 18 december 2017 op dit moment nog niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over dubbele belastingheffing over pensioenen van grensarbeiders uit België

Member Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about Dutch taxation of Belgian residents' Dutch pensions above EUR 25,000, the reasons for this decision, and possible double taxation, and whether consultation with Belgium was planned. The State Secretary answered that the treaty gives the residence state the right to tax such pensions, that Belgian court rulings made it unclear whether Belgium can tax them sufficiently, that about 1300 Belgian residents were notified their exemption ends in 2018, and that the competent authorities will consult shortly to find a solution.
Consultation between the Dutch and Belgian competent authorities will take place in the short term to reach an appropriate solution.
Er vindt op korte termijn een overleg plaats tussen de Nederlandse en de Belgische bevoegde autoriteiten om te komen tot een passende oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

Three CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of a hard Brexit for the Netherlands, including the KPMG report on non-tariff trade barriers, planned actions, customs and inspection capacity, and information provision to businesses. The government answered that it is intensifying business information, hiring extra customs and NVWA staff, and that the cost of a hard Brexit is estimated at about 1.2% of GDP, while stressing that the EU-UK arrangements are still under negotiation.
The precise effect on employment is difficult to estimate, because trade can also shift to other countries and new jobs can therefore also arise.
Het precieze effect op de werkgelegenheid is moeilijk in te schatten, omdat handel zich ook kan verplaatsten naar andere landen en er dus ook weer nieuwe banen kunnen ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bruins en Sneller over de rechtsgrondslag van het voorgestelde Europees Monetair Fonds (EMF)

MPs asked whether the Commission's proposal for a European Monetary Fund, based on the flexibility clause Article 352 TFEU, is legally sound, given a German Bundestag opinion that found the basis inadequate, and whether the government has legal advice. The minister acknowledged the Commission's choice and said the government finds it insufficiently clear why an EMF is needed, will request a Council legal service opinion, and favours keeping the ESM's intergovernmental character.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over de toekomst van de vestiging Siemens in Hengelo (Overijssel)

Two CDA MPs asked the economy minister whether Siemens' Hengelo site will stay open under the Siemens name, whether Siemens Germany has been persuaded to keep jobs, and what the government is doing to save the business. The minister confirmed ongoing talks with Siemens, said serious buyers are interested, but withheld details of the scenarios and buyers, citing the sensitivity of the process.
In the interest of this process, it is not possible to make further statements about this.
In het belang van dit proces is het niet mogelijk daar verdere mededelingen over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de publicatieplicht van moskeeën en kerken die de ANBI-status hebben en de transparantie van geldstromen uit onvrije landen

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the publication duty for ANBI-status churches and mosques, the 632 omissions found, whether published figures reveal money from unfree countries, and how the coalition agreement's transparency of foreign funding will be implemented. The government reported 970 omissions among 2,135 church institutions checked, 884 remedied, and deferred transparency measures on foreign funding to a Justice Minister exploration letter due by Q1 2018.
The publication duty applies to church bodies and their autonomous parts that have been designated as ANBI by group decision, from 1 January 2016.
Voor kerkgenootschappen alsmede hun zelfstandige onderdelen en lichamen waarin zij zijn verenigd die door middel van een groepsbeschikking als ANBI zijn aangemerkt, met ingang van 1 januari 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geluk-Poortvliet over de afschaffing van de ANW-compensatie door het ABP

MPs Omtzigt and Geluk-Poortvliet asked why the ABP pension fund abruptly ended ANW-compensation for survivors, whether members were informed in time, and whether the AFM should investigate the information provided. Minister Ollongren answered that the change was agreed by social partners, that members were notified and the coulance scheme was extended to 1 May 2018, but declined to commit to an AFM investigation, leaving that to the independent regulator.
This was also noted by the social partners. They asked the ABP to adjust this information.
Dit is ook geconstateerd door sociale partners. Zij hebben het ABP verzocht deze informatie aan te passen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over Nederlandse steun en internationale steun aan de Syrische oppositie

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about Dutch and international support for the Syrian opposition, including the AJACS police programme in Idlib, monitoring of aid, NLA to the SDF, the White Helmets, and arms origins. The ministers answered most questions on substance, defending the AJACS programme's resumption after investigations and declining to share detailed monitoring reports and recipient locations for security reasons.
For security reasons the cabinet does not share information showing at which locations and to which communities the AJACS programme provides support.
Het kabinet deelt om veiligheidsredenen geen informatie waaruit kan blijken op welke locaties en aan welke gemeenschappen het AJACS-programma ondersteuning verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Belastingwijziging benadeelt grensarbeiders uit België en Duitsland’

MP Omtzigt asked why Dutch employees living in Germany and cross-border workers cannot claim tax credits through provisional assessments, whether a treaty change is needed, and how affected workers will be informed about the 2019 change. The State Secretary replied that the measure is designed to prevent non-qualifying foreign taxpayers from receiving credits they are not entitled to, that qualifying taxpayers can claim credits via provisional assessments after the first year, that no treaty amendment is strictly necessary but a special provision would be needed to avoid precedent, and that the Tax Administration will write to affected groups in the last quarter of 2018.
During the Eerste Kamer treatment of the Belastingplan 2018 package on 12 December I committed to actively writing to this group about the consequences of this measure.

Antwoord 9, 10 Tijdens de behandeling van het pakket Belastingplan 2018 in de Eerste Kamer op 12 december 4 heb ik de toezegging gedaan deze groep actief aan te schrijven over de gevolgen van deze maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert en Bruins over de balansen in TARGET2 en de daarmee verbonden risico’s

MPs Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert and Bruins asked the Finance Minister about TARGET2 imbalances across euro countries, whether they are better balanced than in 2012, whether mitigation is desirable, and how the risks (including exit scenarios and accounting) are assessed. The minister answered with the country balances, explained the post-2015 rise as driven by QE, stated that the euro-exit scenario is speculative and that TARGET2 balances are not a government-debt indicator, and noted no EU plans to rebalance TARGET2.
There are no plans on the European agenda to rebalance the TARGET2 system.
Er zijn geen plannen op de Europese agenda om het TARGET2-systeem meer in balans te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de plotselinge versobering van het nabestaandenpensioen

An MP asked whether the 2017 pension decree quietly tightened survivors' pension rules by allowing a cut in risk-based partner pensions and combining it with a lower franchise, and asked about affected schemes, consent procedures and employee rights. The government answered that the rules were not materially changed, that the cut and lower franchise were already permitted in 2015 and remain allowed, that it lacks data on affected schemes, and that no reversal is needed.
However, the decree does not involve a reduction in survivors' pensions.
Het besluit houdt echter geen versobering van het nabestaandenpensioen in.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omzigt en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘UK foreign aid money 'diverted to extremists' in Syria’

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the government was aware of BBC allegations that AJACS-funded police in Syria paid extremists and worked with courts imposing executions, and asked about Dutch funding and whether it would suspend aid. The minister confirmed awareness, stated Dutch funding of EUR 2.2 million was held pending investigation, committed to joint inquiry with the UK, and listed conditions for resuming aid.
In response to these serious allegations, the financiers involved took immediate action.
Naar aanleiding van deze ernstige aantijgingen hebben de betrokken financiers direct actie ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het sluiten van Siemens Hengelo

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Siemens' announced closure of its Hengelo plant with 600 jobs at stake, including whether the ministry knew earlier and what action it would take to keep the plant. The minister answered that the ministry was surprised by the announcement, is in close contact with Siemens and has asked it to keep the site, and will take an active role with the province and municipality if a useful role for government emerges.
I am in close contact with Siemens and have asked for the site to be retained.
Ik sta in nauw contact met Siemens en heb gevraagd om behoud van de vestiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over ernstige verontreiniging door lekkages NAM in Rossum

MPs Mulder and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a serious soil and groundwater contamination from leaks at an NAM site in Rossum, including when it was discovered, why it went unnoticed, and remediation timing. The minister answered that the historic contamination, first found in 1985, cannot be traced to its cause or exact timing, that the province of Overijssel is the competent authority, and that remediation is not urgent while current use poses no unacceptable risk.
The production water comes from oil extraction in Schoonebeek.
Het productiewater is afkomstig van de oliewinning in Schoonebeek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over informatiebeveiliging

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about data security at the Broedkamer programme and its predecessors, including the forensic investigation into the tender, downloads of tax data, data-leak reporting and monitoring. The State Secretary answers that the investigation is still ongoing, that interim reports were not received, that some internal memos and the Oliver Wyman report cannot be published in full, and lists measures taken, though several questions are answered only partially.
Once I have received the report I will inform your House and send the report.
Zodra ik het rapport heb ontvangen zal ik uw Kamer informeren en het rapport toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het vastleggen van afspraken tussen het ministerie van Financiën en De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB)

An MP asks the Finance Minister to confirm in writing that agreements with the president of DNB are recorded and agreed by both parties, citing Court of Audit criticism of unrecorded ad-hoc contacts. The minister answers that such meetings are not decision-making, that agreements reached are put in writing and archived, that internal reporting will be improved, and that DNB is independent.
I share the Court of Audit's view that record-keeping can contribute to the reconstructability and continuity of decision-making.
Ik deel de mening van de Algemene Rekenkamer dat verslaglegging kan bijdragen aan reconstrueerbaarheid en continuïteit van besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Keijzer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht “Albanese maffia slaat hier zijn tentakels uit”

MPs Omtzigt, Keijzer and Van Toorenburg asked about reports of Albanian organised crime in the Netherlands, including whether a visa requirement should be reintroduced under EU rules and whether Albania should keep candidate status. The minister answered that Albanian-national suspects rose to about 700 in 2016, that the government will await the Commission's Western Balkans monitor before considering the EU emergency brake, and that the answers were delayed beyond the two-week target.
I will make this report available for confidential inspection by your House until the end of the year.
Deze rapportage leg ik tot het einde van het jaar ter vertrouwelijke inzage in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de opschorting en stopzetting van kinderopvangtoeslag aan een groep ouders in 2014

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the suspension and termination of childcare allowance for parents in 2014, including whether letters omitted objection rights, how many cases were affected, and whether instructions were lawful. The State Secretary acknowledged shortcomings, said objection rights were standard on decisions, reported partial reversals and long objection times, and declined to give exact counts for several questions.
This working method was applied in this specific case.
Deze werkwijze is in dit specifieke geval toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Visser, Jetten en Bruins over de vluchtroutes naar Lelystad

Five MPs from CDA, VVD, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about the Lelystad airport flight routes, including the Alderstafel advisory process, consultation records, airspace safety and feasibility, environmental costs and the Helios second opinion. The state secretary answered most questions on substance, stating that no minutes or attendance lists were kept, that routes were designed within existing airspace structure, and that the Helios opinion would be sent before the committee meeting.
No minutes are made of the meetings of the Alderstafel Lelystad, nor is an attendance list kept.
Van de vergaderingen van de Alderstafel Lelystad worden geen verslagen gemaakt, noch een presentielijst bijgehouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de informatie beschikbaar bij de Nederlandse overheid en regering over het onveilige luchtruim boven Oost Oekraïne in de eerste helft van 2014, dus vóór het nee

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked what information the Dutch government held about unsafe airspace over eastern Ukraine before MH17 was downed, including an April 2014 NCTV threat-analysis request, the Kiev memorandum, OVSE and ECAC warnings, NOTAMs, Eccairs reports and airline warning arrangements. The government answered that the April 2014 request was a routine terrorism-alert request on Dutch airports, that the relevant warnings concerned Crimea and the Black Sea rather than eastern Ukraine, and it offered some documents for confidential inspection by the House until the 2017 Christmas recess while withholding others from public disclosure.
To give your House a complete picture I will make all the requests mentioned above available for confidential inspection, only to members of your House, until the 2017 Christmas recess.
Om uw Kamer een compleet beeld te geven zal ik alle hierboven genoemde aanvragen ter vertrouwelijke inzage ter beschikking stellen, alleen aan de leden van uw Kamer, tot het kerstreces 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het MH17 archief

Rep. Omtzigt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the government's MH17 archive, including whether a public index or search function exists, whether sensitive materials such as interview reports, the JIT agreement and diplomatic memos will be preserved and made accessible, and whether the archiving meets the DUTO accessibility criteria. The minister answered that an information overview has been published on the National Archives website at dossier level, that a public item-level index or search function will not be provided for privacy, state interest and ongoing prosecution reasons, and that interview reports, the JIT agreement and diplomatic memos will not be disclosed.
I do not share your assessment of how applicable the information overview is.
Uw oordeel over de mate van toepasbaarheid van het informatieoverzicht deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het artikel “Nieuwe lekkage AkzoNobel in Hengelo: kalk en pekel gelekt”

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a new large leak at AkzoNobel in Hengelo, the timeliness of reporting to SodM, a list of leaks, the company's safety management and whether its permits will be reviewed. The minister answered that the leaks were reported to SodM in time (except one, put 335), that SodM supervises AkzoNobel's safety management and leak list, and that a new risk analysis and pipeline renovation are underway, with permit revision planned.
SodM has therefore asked AkzoNobel to carry out a new risk analysis following this recent leak.
SodM heeft daarom AkzoNobel gevraagd om naar aanleiding van deze recente lekkage een nieuwe risicoanalyse uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg over terugkerende jihadisten naar Zweden die een nieuwe identiteit krijgen

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked whether Sweden gives returning jihadists new identities without local authorities knowing where they live, and what risks this poses for the EU. The ministers answered that the reports are inaccurate according to Swedish authorities, that no EU state is known to pursue such a policy, and they described existing EU information-sharing and PNR arrangements.
Enquiries with the Swedish authorities show that this report is incorrect.
Uit navraag bij de Zweedse autoriteiten blijkt dat deze berichtgeving onjuist is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over de problemen bij Anbang en de gevolgen daarvan voor de polishouders van VIVAT

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the ministers about problems at Anbang and the risks to Vivat policyholders, including the regulator's handling and possible capital extraction. The ministers answered that DNB's supervisory information is confidential, that the regulator monitors compliance and that the EUR 1.35 billion capital injection strengthened Vivat, while declining to comment on Anbang's internal affairs or future licence applications.
Information about the supervisor's assessment of the holder of a declaration of no objection is supervisory-confidential and therefore not public.
Informatie over de beoordeling door de toezichthouder van de houder van een verklaring van geen bezwaar is toezichtvertrouwelijk en daarmee niet publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Nederlander vast na kritiek op Erdogan’

CDA MPs asked about a Dutch national detained after criticising Erdogan and about Dutch citizens barred from leaving Turkey, including travel advice and consular action. The minister said about ten people have reported exit bans, withheld their circumstances for privacy reasons, described existing travel warnings and consular efforts, and promised continued pressure on Turkish authorities.
For reasons of privacy protection, I cannot provide your House with information about the background to these cases in this public letter.
Vanwege privacybescherming kan ik uw Kamer via deze openbare brief geen informatie verstrekken over de achtergronden bij deze zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het onderzoek van Helios naar de vliegroutes van Lelystad

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the state secretary about the Helios second opinion on Lelystad airport flight routes, whether the B+ routeset is fixed, the London airspace comparison, military airspace in other countries, and LVNL's role. The state secretary maintained that the B+ routes and design principles are given, confirmed Helios would review the proposed routes within those principles, and provided the Helios assignment.

Helios is therefore, partly at my request, carrying out a second opinion next month on the currently proposed connecting routes and the consequences for the airspace, guided by the principles advised by the Alderstafel Lelystad and adopted by the cabinet.

Helios voert dan ook, mede op mijn verzoek, komende maand een second opinion uit op de nu voorliggende ontwerp aansluitroutes en de gevolgen voor het luchtruim, met als leidraad de door de Alderstafel Lelystad geadviseerde en door het kabinet overgenomen uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Heerma over de indeling van uitzendbureaus en andere organisaties bij de sectorcodes sociale zekerheid, waardoor sociale lasten fors kunnen toenemen

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked why a May 2017 ministerial regulation freezes the option for new temp-work agencies to be classed in a craft sector rather than the temp sector, raising social premiums, and questioned its justification, legal basis and why parliament was not informed. Minister Asscher answered that the freeze is a temporary measure pending a definitive rule by 2019, that sector premium differences of roughly 4 to 7 percentage points result, and that the change was made quickly without prior notice to parliament.
I considered rapid action necessary given the increasing speed with which temp work has shifted away from the temp-agency sector to other sectors.
Ik achtte een snelle actie noodzakelijk gezien de toenemende snelheid waarmee de verschuiving van uitzendarbeid vanuit de sector uitzendbedrijven naar andere sectoren is opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de over de rechtmatigheid van de afvloeiingsregeling bij de douane en de FIOD in de slotwet 2016

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the early-retirement scheme with bonuses used at Customs and the FIOD in 2016 was lawfully applied, given that these services were not reorganised and the replacement scheme (remplaçantenregeling) may not have been met. The State Secretary confirms the facts, admits only five VWNW candidates have been placed so far, and maintains the scheme was applied lawfully since the ARAR sets no deadline.
After review, approval and actual payment, there is therefore a lawful expenditure in accordance with the replacement scheme.
Na toetsing, toekenning en feitelijke betaling is dan ook sprake van een rechtmatige uitgave overeenkomstig de remplaçantenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de bankenredding in Italië, waarbij Italië de regels voor de bankenunie aan zijn laars gelapt heeft

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether Italy's rescue of two banks, Banca Popolare di Vicenza and Veneto Banca, breached the banking union rules, questioning the bail-in, state guarantees, the role of the ECB and SRB, and the lack of private investors. The minister answers that shareholders and subordinated creditors bore losses, the SRB found no public-interest resolution so national liquidation applied, the Commission approved the aid, and the full Commission decision is still awaited.
Although the rules were followed in this case, I consider it important that the European Commission explains its considerations for approving this substantial state aid.
Ondanks dat de regels in deze casus zijn gevolgd, vind ik het van belang dat de Europese Commissie uitleg geeft over haar overwegingen om goedkeuring te geven aan deze forse staatssteun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Vereniging Eigen Huis wil regeling restschuld behouden’

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the tax-deductible residual mortgage debt scheme (restschuldregeling), expiring end 2017, should be extended, given that many homeowners remain underwater. The government answered that the crisis measure has served its purpose, the housing market has recovered, and it sees no reason to extend the scheme with its associated tax loss.
I therefore see no reason to extend this scheme, which was introduced as a crisis measure, with the additional tax loss that would result.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om deze regeling, die geïntroduceerd is als crisismaatregel, te verlengen met bovendien een fiscale derving als gevolg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van den Berg, Omtzigt, Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Dik-Faber over lekkages bij AKZO-Nobel in Twente

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about new well leaks at AkzoNobel in Twente, the number and effects of leaks, SodM's enforcement and projects, and liability for leak damage. The minister answered that lists of leaks are published and checked by SodM, that the effects appear limited to the immediate vicinity of leaking wells, that enhanced supervision continues with a research programme due by end 2017, and that liability stays with the party responsible at the time of the leak.
SodM urged AkzoNobel to give appropriate urgency to the investigation and remediation of leaks and possible contamination in Twente.
SodM heeft bij AkzoNobel aangedrongen op gepaste urgentie bij het onderzoek en de sanering van lekkages en mogelijke verontreinigingen in Twente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de VN-Veiligheidsraad

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked whether the government would make prosecution of MH17 downers and ISIS fighters priorities of Dutch Security Council membership, and whether it would send the monthly programme of the presidency. The minister said priorities would be sent in a letter in autumn, that MH17 accountability remains top priority, that ISIS prosecution will be explored, and that the programme will be sent monthly.
To that end, the House will receive a letter in the autumn, after government-wide consultation.
Daartoe zal de Kamer in het najaar een brief toegaan, na rijksbrede afstemming.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de opmerkingen van de ARK over de rechtmatigheid van de totaal uit de hand gelopen kosten van de afvloeiingsregeling en over aan de Kamer beloofde onderzoeken

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Court of Audit's remarks on the early-retirement scheme, including whether applicants were advised to backdate requests to before 1 July 2016, the replacement of departed customs and FIOD staff, and the status of promised investigations. The State Secretary denied that such advice was given, stated that vacancy filling is ongoing with figures not yet available, and said the Broedkamer tender investigation is expected to finish at the end of summer with a report to parliament before the recess.
It has not been established that such advice was given.
Er is niet geconstateerd dat dergelijke adviezen zijn gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vraag of de wet iemand verplicht de hypotheekrenteaftrek te gebruiken of niet

Omtzigt (CDA) asks whether the law obliges taxpayers to claim mortgage interest deduction, whether a net tax increase can arise for small mortgages, and how the Hillen rule and the 2013 letter should be read. State Secretary Wiebes answers that the rules are unchanged, that claiming deductions is effectively mandatory for correct returns, and that the 2013 letter's passage was unclear, though the law will be applied as written.
It has come to my attention that the passage in the letter of 11 November 2013 is being read as a standalone choice to claim or not claim interest and costs as deductions.
Antwoord 5 Mij is gebleken dat de passage in de brief van 11 november 2013 5 wordt uitgelegd als een losstaande keuze om rente en kosten al dan niet in aftrek te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Ronnes, Omtzigt, Jetten en Van Weyenberg over het bericht in de Trouw van 4 mei 2017 “Staatsbedrijf NS ontwijkt fiscus weer”

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the government about reports that state-owned NS avoids Dutch tax via an Irish leasing subsidiary, including whether the 2015 agreements were honoured and how much tax is lost. The minister defended the arrangement as consistent with a 'level playing field' for foreign concessions, and refused to give tax figures citing secrecy rules and business confidentiality while promising phase-out of the Irish route on Dutch lines.

A more detailed specification of amounts I cannot give because under article 67 of the AWR I cannot make statements about the taxes of individual taxpayers, as business confidentiality precludes this.

Een nadere specificatie van bedragen kan ik niet geven omdat ik op grond van artikel 67 van de AWR geen uitspraken kan doen over de belastingen van individuele belastingplichtigen omdat bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid zich hiertegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de mogelijkheden tot het verbieden van campagnes van buitenlandse politici van niet-vrije landen in Nederland

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister whether the government could ban political campaigning in the Netherlands by foreign politicians from non-free countries, citing the European Convention on Human Rights and its Article 16. The government answered that questions 1 to 8 were addressed in a separate letter to parliament on the Turkish ministers' campaign visits of March 2017.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Campaign visits by Turkish ministers and the events that took place around 11 March 2017'
zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Campagnebezoeken van Turkse ministers en de gebeurtenissen die daaromtrent plaatsvonden rond om 11 maart 2017»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het achteraf melden aan de Kamer dat er 55 miljoen euro extra is uitgegeven aan de inhuur van externen bij de Belastingdienst in 2016

Omtzigt asked why an extra 55 million euro spent on hiring external staff at the Tax Administration in 2016 was only reported to parliament after the fact, and how many externals were employed and where. The State Secretary explained the increase as temporary hiring for appeals, collection and the Investment Agenda, attributed the late reporting to an administrative error in the supplementary budget, gave headcounts by unit, and declined to answer the request for same-week replies.
In 2016 the information on this was mistakenly not included in the 2nd supplementary budget IX (with the Autumn Memorandum).
In 2016 is de informatie hierover abusievelijk niet verwerkt in de 2 de suppletoire begroting IX (bij de Najaarsnota).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Van Klaveren en Voordewind over de vluchtelingendeal met Turkije

MPs from several parties asked whether PM Rutte and Chancellor Merkel made a gentlemen's agreement with Turkey to resettle 150,000-250,000 Syrian refugees a year, and whether the government asked Turkey to postpone a visit by Minister Cavusoglu. The government denied any side agreement, pointed to the EU-Turkey statement of 18 March 2016 and ongoing EU resettlement talks, denied any request to postpone the visit, and declined to answer the questions one by one before the requested deadline.
No. Agreements have only been made at European level on resettling Syrian refugees from Turkey.
Antwoord 4 Er zijn enkel in Europees verband afspraken gemaakt over het hervestigen van Syrische vluchtelingen vanuit Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het artikel “Vergeefse zoektocht naar stemmen per bureau”

MPs Amhaouch and Omtzigt asked the Interior Minister about reported counting errors in the 2017 election, the restricted inspection and non-copying of polling-station records, retention and publication of those records, and handmade counting. The minister answered that the procedures follow the Kieswet, that the credentials committee found no grounds for a recount, that an evaluation will be completed before summer recess, and that the records are retained for three months, though he could not publish or collect them himself.
The Kieswet does not allow the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to collect or publish the polling-station records.
De Kieswet staat niet toe dat de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties de processen-verbaal verzamelt of publiceert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het faillissement van het Zeeuwse bedrijf Thermphos

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked about the bankruptcy of Thermphos, the Kazakh dumping ruling, the EU's role, and state responsibility for the remediation of the site containing low-level radioactive waste. The minister answered that the Rijk helped the province find remediation experts, that the damages claim is a private matter, that the EU and national state bear no direct liability for dumping, and that the company is primarily responsible for remediation under the EU radioactive waste directive.
The national government has in recent months discussed with the province of Zeeland the request for experts.
Het Rijk heeft de afgelopen periode met provincie Zeeland gesproken over de vraag om deskundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Hoge NS bazen kregen half miljoen oprotpremie’

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether the government approved and knew the reasons for severance payments of about EUR 600,000 to two NS managers, and whether these were linked to the Limburg tender irregularities. The minister answered that NS restructured its top structure, that the board needs no approval for non-board severance, that the departures are unrelated to Limburg, and declined to share supervisory board minutes.
I do not have access to the minutes of the meetings of the supervisory board.
Ik heb geen beschikking over de verslagen van de vergaderingen van de raad van commissarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de voorgenomen zeer lage aanvliegroutes met veel geluidsoverlast in Overijssel naar vliegveld Lelystad

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked the State Secretary about very low approach routes over Overijssel to Lelystad airport causing noise nuisance, including route maps, the scope of the environmental impact assessment, and provincial representation at the Alderstafel. The State Secretary answered that the routes follow the agreed 6,000 ft and 3,000 ft heights, that low flying is limited to exceptional cases, that no new MER is needed, and that she will explore optimisations with LVNL and CLSK.
For the south-eastern approach route over Overijssel, this means traffic to Lelystad enters Dutch airspace well above 6,000 feet over Twente.
Voor de zuidoostelijke naderingsroute over Overijssel betekent dit, dat verkeer naar Lelystad boven Twente aanzienlijk hoger dan 6.000 voet het Nederlandse luchtruim binnenkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de financiële bijdragen van provincies aan het hoofdwegennet

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Infrastructure minister about provincial co-financing of national motorway projects, noting that Overijssel and Gelderland pay far more than other provinces. The minister answered that the figures are distorted by timing of payments, that provinces have varying motives and financial capacity, and provided a table of co-financing shares, but the answer largely explains the differences by project phase and does not commit to new action.
This reasoning cannot be linked to the cited figures; see my answer to question 3.
Deze redenering kunt u niet aan de aangehaalde cijfers verbinden, zie hiervoor mijn antwoord op vraag 3.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de problemen met de digitale belastingaangifte voor fiscale hulpverleners zoals het feit dat wijzigingen voor toeslagen dit jaar op papier gedaan zullen moeten worden, indien d

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about digital tax filing problems for volunteer tax helpers such as unions and seniors' organisations, including paper-only filing for partners of deceased persons and loss of commercial software support. The State Secretary answered that a pilot for a deceased-person authorisation is running, that paper remains necessary in some cases, and that interim arrangements and an eHerkenning-based route for intermediaries are being developed.
In the first quarter of 2017 the Tax Administration runs a small-scale pilot with a first version of that survivor authorisation.
In het eerste kwartaal van 2017 vindt bij de Belastingdienst een kleinschalige pilot plaats met een eerste versie van die nabestaandenmachtiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over arbeidsmigranten die wel of geen motorrijtuigenbelasting (MRB) betalen en het plotseling ontbreken van cijfers daarover

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the government can no longer state how many labour migrants pay motor vehicle tax (MRB) on Dutch-registered cars, as it could in 2013, and whether it can provide a time series. The Secretary answered that a comparable estimate is possible (about 105,000 of 362,000 registered residents in February 2017) but that it cannot be compared with 2013 because the share of migrants owning cars is unknown, and pointed to declining car ownership among newer migrants.

A comparison with the 2013 figures to support the degree of MRB compliance by migrants is not possible with these figures, because one would need to know what share of migrants registered in the BRP own a car in the Netherlands and how car ownership within that group has developed.

Een vergelijking met de cijfers uit 2013 ter onderbouwing van de mate van naleving van de MRB verplichtingen door migranten is met deze cijfers echter niet mogelijk, omdat daarvoor bekend moet zijn welk deel van de in de BRP ingeschreven migranten in Nederland een auto heeft en hoe het autobezit binnen die groep zich ontwikkelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ongevraagd opgelegde voorlopige aanslagen 2017

MP Omtzigt asked whether voorlopige aanslagen were again imposed in 2017 on taxpayers who did not file a provisional return, how many, and how communication would be improved. The State Secretary answered that 228,911 taxpayers received one (average EUR 2,374), mostly due to multiple employment or Box 3 income, and that the text on the notice will be clarified starting with the 2018 notice.

In addition, the text on the provisional assessment will be adjusted following the Omtzigt motion so that it becomes even clearer that authorising the Tax Authority for automatic collection, and thus payment in instalments, is the standard.

Daarnaast wordt de tekst op de voorlopige aanslag naar aanleiding van de motie Omtzigt aangepast zodat nog duidelijker wordt dat het machtigen van de Belastingdienst tot automatische incasso en daarmee betaling in termijnen de standaard is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de MH17

Dutch MPs Omtzigt asked the Justice, Foreign Affairs and Interior ministers about withheld MH17 documents (interview transcripts, the JIT agreement), the unfinished internal police evaluation, deleted emails under the Archiefwet, and Russian radar data. The minister refused disclosure of the interview records and JIT agreement on grounds of confidentiality and ongoing criminal investigation, and gave partial, procedural answers on the other points.
The JIT agreement is not suitable for disclosure because it records operational arrangements for an ongoing criminal investigation.
De JIT-overeenkomst leent zich niet voor openbaarmaking omdat hierin operationele afspraken over een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek zijn vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Groot over het bericht 'Cashen met valse scheiding populair'

MPs Omtzigt and Groot asked about reports that 'false divorces' to claim benefits are popular, and about the scale of address fraud and single-parent household trends. The State Secretary answered that address registration fraud combined with divorce is illegal and prosecutable, that married couples keep fiscal partner status unless formally divorced, gave income calculations, and described the Landelijke Aanpak Adreskwaliteit, which is continued until 2023.
If a couple does not actually separate but registers at two different addresses to obtain financial benefit, that is fraud and therefore punishable.
Als een stel niet daadwerkelijk uit elkaar gaat, maar zich op twee verschillende adressen inschrijft om financieel voordeel te genieten is dat fraude en dus strafbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de eerdere en herhaalde bewering dat er geen waarschuwingen voor een RVU-heffing gevonden waren bij de belastingdienst, terwijl er nu minstens drie aan het licht gekomen zijn

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance why earlier claims that no warnings about an RVU levy existed at the Tax Authority conflict with three documents now surfacing, and demanded those documents. The State Secretary admitted an earlier nuance was needed, but refused to release the emails and documents, invoking the state-interest exception under article 68 of the Constitution and the cabinet line on internal policy communication.
On the basis of this cabinet line, I am not providing the emails and the inventory list.
Op grond van deze kabinetslijn verstrek ik de e-mails en de inventarislijst niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Groot over een regeling waarbij leenbijstand, die voor 1 januari 2017 omgezet is in een gift, niet langer leidt tot terugvordering van toeslagen en het (nog) niet uitvoeren van

Members Omtzigt and Groot asked why self-employed people whose loan assistance was converted into a grant, creating a phantom income that forced repayment of benefit allowances, still lack relief, and whether a scheme for existing cases could be proposed as the motion requested. The state secretary replies that retroactive or case-by-case compensation is unworkable, costly and unequal, that only a payment-plan route is offered, and that no problems with municipalities have been reported.
Although I understand the wish of your House, in view of the above I see no possibilities to arrive at a legally defensible and affordable tailor-made solution and to implement your motion.

Hoewel ik de wens van uw Kamer begrijp, zie ik gelet op het vorenstaande, dan ook geen mogelijkheden om tot een juridisch goed verdedigbare en tevens betaalbare maatwerkoplossing te komen en uw motie uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vertrekregeling voor ambtenaren

MP Omtzigt asked about early-retirement schemes for civil servants, RVU levies owed by the Belastingdienst, emails on internal warnings, contracts of the Broedkamer and unauthorised spending of 38 million euro under the Investment Agenda. The government answered that the schemes follow general ARAR rules, that 24 million euro in RVU levy was paid, that the emails are withheld to protect internal advice under Article 68 of the Constitution, and that the contracts will be made available confidentially.
On the basis of this cabinet line I do not provide the emails.
Op grond van deze kabinetslijn verstrek ik de emails niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Ronnes over de rol die de Raad van Commissarissen van NS gespeeld heeft bij de fraude bij de aanbesteding in Limburg

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about the role of NS's supervisory board in the Limburg tender fraud, including when he learned of it, access to board minutes, discharge granted for 2014 and 2015, and damage claims. The minister answered that he was informed in April 2015 by the supervisory board, denied knowledge of board incitement to crimes, refused to release board and shareholder meeting minutes, and pointed to ongoing court and regulatory proceedings.
It is also not usual for such reports to be shared with the general meeting of shareholders.
Het is ook niet gebruikelijk dat dergelijke verslagen met de algemene vergadering van aandeelhouders worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Target2

MP Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about the size and drivers of DNB's Target2 position, private-sector exposures, the mitigation of Target2 risks and the state's maximum exposure. The minister answered that DNB's Target2 balance was EUR 99.6 billion, that it is a claim on the ECB rather than on other national central banks, that rising balances stem mainly from the ECB asset purchase programme, and that the state's risk is limited because the ECB has adequate buffers.
DNB's Target2 balance currently (as of end November 2016) amounts to EUR 99.6 billion.
Het Target2-saldo van DNB betreft momenteel (per eind november 2016) EUR 99,6 mrd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over toezicht arbitrage en andere mogelijke schadelijke gevolgen voor pensioenfondsen en gepensioneerden van de IORP-2 richtlijn

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs for a precise article-by-article list of Pension Act provisions that the IORP-II directive requires changing, and questions whether cross-border pension fund transfers to Belgium for supervisory arbitrage should be allowed.
