The State Secretary replies that an article-by-article implementation plan will follow within three months of the directive entering into force, that DNB can block a transfer on defined criteria, and that the government considers large-scale arbitrage-driven transfers undesirable but not prohibited.
The cabinet is now working this out in an implementation plan of which an article-by-article overview will be part.
Het kabinet is nu bezig om dit uit te werken in een implementatieplan waar een artikelsgewijs overzicht onderdeel van uit maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het associatieverdrag met Oekraïne en de agenda van de Europese Top

MP Omtzigt asked the government why the agenda for the December 2016 European Council was late, whether a European Council conclusion is legally binding, what plan B exists if the EU-Ukraine association agreement fails, and how the government acted on a motion about EU funds and torture. The answer refers the MP to letters on the European Council and the General Affairs Council, which were sent separately.
have been answered by means of the letters 'Response to requests for additional information regarding the European Council of 15 December 2016'
zijn beantwoord middels de brieven «Reactie op verzoeken om aanvullende informatie aangaande de Europese Raad van 15 december 2016»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Weyenberg over de voortdurende totale onzekerheid over het uitstel van handhaving van de wet deregulering beoordeling arbeidsrelaties

MPs Omtzigt and Van Weyenberg asked why the Belastingdienst website gave a broader definition of 'kwaadwillend' (bad-faith) in its enforcement-suspension notice than the state secretary's own definition on the Wet DBA, and who approved it. The state secretary answered that the website text was a communication error, withdrawn after three days, and that the official definition in the Handboek Loonheffingen applies, with roughly ten bad-faith cases expected.
On Friday 2 December the deviating text was replaced by a text that does match the texts exchanged with your House.
Op vrijdag 2 december jl. is die afwijkende tekst vervangen door een tekst die wel aansluit bij de met uw Kamer gewisselde teksten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Omtzigt over het VVD-filmpje over de Wet Deregulering Beoordeling Arbeidsrelaties

MPs Van Weyenberg and Omtzigt asked about a VVD video implying the DBA law was postponed, the legal status of enforcement suspension, and plans to change labour law and communicate with clients. Staatssecretaris Wiebes answered that enforcement was postponed (not the law itself), that a separate policy decision is not issued, that a labour-law review is underway with a timeline, and that enforcement will focus on about ten malicious cases.
What has been postponed is, of course, the enforcement.
Wat is uitgesteld is natuurlijk de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de verkeers (on)veiligheid op de N36

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the minister about road safety on the N36, including fatality figures over ten years and how it compares with other N-roads. The minister answered that the N36 has 18 fatalities in the period, lists completed and planned Meer Veilig measures, and says a behaviour-change approach is being prepared, but declined to commit to a plan matching the average N-road.
In addition, I constantly monitor the safety of the N36 and all other national roads and take measures where necessary to improve safety.
Daarnaast houd ik de veiligheid van de N36 en alle andere Rijkswegen constant in de gaten en neem ik waar nodig maatregelen om de veiligheid te verbeteren.
Antwoord op van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Duitse tolheffing

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the planned German road toll for passenger cars, its compatibility with EU law, its cross-border effects and possible Dutch complaints. The minister answered that the Commission and Germany are still negotiating, that the plan was already softened for border regions, and that no concrete figures or border-effect study exist yet.
I will study the outcome as soon as it is known, and will consider further steps.
Ik zal de uitkomst zodra deze bekend is bestuderen, en zal mij beraden op vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de vorstelijke vertrekregelingen bij de Belastingdienst en het gapend AOW-gat bij Defensie

Two CDA MPs asked the Defence and Finance ministers about the suspended defence pay talks, the AOW (state pension) gap for former defence staff, and the generous early-retirement scheme at the Tax Administration. The minister answered that talks have resumed, that a new AOW arrangement is being pursued in response to court rulings and that Finance is not her responsibility, while distinguishing the two schemes' purposes.
As employer, I have the responsibility to make a provision for the AOW gap of civilians and military personnel in (former) service at Defence.
Als werkgever heb ik de verantwoordelijkheid om een voorziening te treffen voor het AOW-gat van burgers en militairen in (voormalige) dienst bij Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de geofoons in Twente, die bevingen meten in Twente veroorzaakt door de afvalwaterinjectie door de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM)

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked why geophones near the Twente wastewater injection sites were not all live-readable and whether NAM promised such live access, and about responsibility for data collection and analysis. Minister Kamp answered that KNMI operates and analyses the stations, that connectivity issues explain the gaps, and committed to contacting KNMI to ensure live data, open storage and periodic analyses.
Ik heb contact opgenomen met het KNMI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het telefonisch intrekken van bezwaren

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Tax Authority work instruction allowing objections to be withdrawn by phone without written confirmation, which the questions argue conflicts with the Awb. The State Secretary admits the instruction was contra legem, says it has been ended and the instruction is being amended, and explains that the phone-withdrawal count cannot be fully aggregated and affected taxpayers may be reinstated on request.
This specific work instruction did not comply with laws and regulations and should never have been adopted at all.
Deze specifieke werkinstructie was niet conform wet – en regelgeving en had dus überhaupt niet mogen worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de financiële curatele van de Belastingdienst

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the early retirement scheme, the Tax Administration's continuity risks, the Auditdienst Rijk and Algemene Rekenkamer reports, and the procurement and hiring freeze during financial curatorship. State Secretary Wiebes answered that the scheme's premium cap and RVU levy were not discussed in negotiations or warned about in advance, that a temporary commitment stop applied from 13 to 26 October 2016, and that several figures would be provided later once final.

For the questions whose answers depend on the precise number of departing and Switch-transferring staff under the scheme, and where this outflow takes place, the answers will still be provided once this number is definitively established.

Voor de vragen waarop de antwoorden samenhangen met het precieze aantal vertrekkende en in Switch instromende medewerkers op basis van de regeling en waar deze uitstroom plaatsvindt, geldt nog steeds dat deze worden beantwoord zodra dit aantal definitief vaststaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over radardata m.b.t. MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russia holds raw primary radar data from the MH17 area, why it was not shared for over two years, and how the Dutch government assesses cooperation and prosecution strategy. The minister answered that Russia has promised to share the data with the JIT but has not yet handed it over, that the government has repeatedly urged full cooperation, and that prosecution options (an ad hoc tribunal or national prosecution) remain open.
For that reason we cannot inform your House in detail which information was requested or received from which party.
Om die reden kunnen wij uw Kamer niet in detail melden welke informatie van welke partij is gevraagd of gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uit de hand gelopen reorganisatie van de Belastingdienst

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance, in 18 numbered questions, about the Tax Authority reorganisation (Switch, the exit scheme of about 500 million euro, approval by the Investment Committee, budget transfers, deputy bailiffs and outflow pace). The State Secretary answers that procedures were not followed so internal checks could not operate, that budget releases were made in two tranches, and that a planned cost overrun was not reported to parliament in spring to protect negotiations.
In my letter of 4 October and during the General Financial Considerations on 5 October I indicated that the procedures were not followed, so internal checks and balances could not do their work.

In mijn brief van 4 oktober jl. en tijdens de Algemene Financiële Beschouwingen op woensdag 5 oktober jl. heb ik aangegeven dat de procedures niet zijn gevolgd, waardoor interne checks and balances hun werk niet hebben kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de erkenning van de genocide, die op dit moment door ISIS gepleegd wordt

An MP asked the government whether it recognises ISIS as committing genocide against minorities and what obligations follow under the 1948 Genocide Convention, citing European Parliament, Council of Europe and US positions. The minister answered that the government does not formally determine genocide absent a court ruling, outlined existing counter-ISIS and foreign-fighter measures, and declined to publish internal legal advice.

The Cabinet has been advised internally several times under international law on this issue. The Cabinet attaches importance to civil servants being able to advise their ministers freely and to present all views, and publishing that advice afterwards would undermine this.

Het Kabinet is intern meermalen volkenrechtelijk geadviseerd over deze kwestie. Het Kabinet hecht eraan dat ambtenaren hun ministers vrijelijk kunnen adviseren en daarin alle standpunten kunnen weergeven. Het achteraf openbaar maken van die adviezen staat daaraan in de weg.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Knops en Rog over de uitlatingen van de Turkse consul-generaal te Rotterdam over de Hizmet/Gülen-beweging en de invloed die Turkije uitoefent op burgers in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt, Knops and Rog asked the ministers about the Turkish consul-general in Rotterdam's remarks on the Gülen movement, pressure on Turkish-Dutch citizens, threats and the effects of the post-coup crackdown in the Netherlands. The government condemned intimidation, said Turkish authorities must not interfere with Dutch citizens' choices, noted about 175 reports and ongoing investigations, and answered the remaining questions largely by restating policy and citing ongoing proceedings.
It is unacceptable that foreign governments openly try to influence those choices.
Het is onacceptabel dat buitenlandse overheden die keuzes openlijk proberen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de leegloop bij de belastingdienst

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the departure wave at the Belastingdienst, including sign-up numbers for the voluntary exit scheme, costs, the agreement with unions and changes to its conditions. Wiebes reported that about 7,280 fte expressed interest and around 4,960 fte had chosen a variant, admitted the broad opening was a wrong choice, and gave cost figures and a timeline of changes, with the answer on continuity risks still open.
In hindsight, this broad opening was a wrong choice, and a more targeted definition of the target group and a time limit would have been preferable.
Achteraf bezien is deze brede openstelling een verkeerde keuze geweest en had een meer gerichte doelgroepbepaling en een afbakening in de tijd de voorkeur moeten hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Amhaouch over financiering van de referendum campagne in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt and Amhaouch asked the government about foreign and undisclosed funding of the 2016 Dutch referendum campaign, including donor disclosure rules, GRECO recommendations on foreign donations, and contacts with George Soros's organisations. Minister Plasterk answered that party donations above EUR 4,500 are disclosed, no rules exist on foreign donations or referendum-period disclosure, the government had no direct contact with Soros, and the referendum subsidy audit is still ongoing.
I do not have overviews of organisations or persons who spent more than EUR 4,500 on campaign activities for the referendum of 6 April.
Ik beschik niet over overzichten van instanties of personen die meer dan € 4.500 hebben uitgegeven aan campagneactiviteiten voor het referendum van 6 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de onzekerheid over de uitvoering van de Wet deregulering beoordeling arbeidsrelaties

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about uncertainty over the Wet DBA, including Belastingdienst positions on zzp'ers in construction, the meaning of 'langere duur dan gebruikelijk', and whether the law changes the employee/entrepreneur definitions. The State Secretary answers that the DBA does not change the legal definitions, that the Belastingdienst gives advance certainty via model agreements, and that a rule of thumb for 'langere duur' has been approved.
Nothing changes about those boundaries; what was allowed remains allowed and what was not allowed remains not allowed.
Er verandert niets aan die grenzen; dat wat toegestaan was, blijft toegestaan en dat wat niet toegestaan was, blijft niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over de huur van panden voor een azc in Maastricht

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked about the COA's lease of Parkweg 20 and Blekerij 52 in Maastricht for an asylum centre, including the rent, the transaction history, vetting of the owner, and links to an FIOD investigation. The State Secretary answered that rents are not disclosed for commercial reasons, that the COA checked the owner via a notary who found no links, and that the FIOD does not inform other bodies about its investigations.
The COA does not make lease contracts public. A lease contract contains information that affects the economic and financial interests of the COA.
Het COA maakt geen huurcontracten openbaar. Een huurcontract bevat informatie die de economische en financiële belangen van het COA raken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het archief van de MH17

An MP asks the government about the archiving of MH17 crisis documents, including whether emails were lost, why interview transcripts and evaluations were withheld, and the status of the JIT and prosecution strategy. The minister answers that no separate hotspot list exists, that archive transfers have not yet taken place, that interview transcripts remain confidential to protect research validity, and that some evaluations and prosecution strategy details are still in progress.
This promised confidentiality weighs very heavily for me in considering not sending the report to your House.
Deze toegezegde vertrouwelijkheid weegt voor mij zeer zwaar bij de afweging om het verslag niet aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de heropstart van de afvalwaterinjectie in Twente

MPs Mulder and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the permits, chemical content, liability, legal classification, seismic risk and timing of the restart of wastewater injection in Twente by NAM. The minister answered all 18 questions in substance, committing to send the permits and the evaluation reports, while declining to treat the injection as a waste-disposal matter under EU rules.
Yes, I will send these permits separately to your House in the short term.
Ja, deze vergunningen zal ik op korte termijn separaat naar uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over het mogelijk maken om een hypotheek met hoge rente stapsgewijs en boetevrij om te zetten in een hypotheek met een lager rentepercentage

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked whether existing mortgage holders could convert high-rate mortgages stepwise and penalty-free to lower rates, and whether banks may still charge early-repayment fees under the new EU Mortgage Credit Directive. The minister explained that fees must now reflect actual losses for new mortgages, that the AFM is still investigating compliance for existing contracts, and that no standardised stepwise conversion guide will be published.
There is currently no overview available showing how the various mortgage lenders in the Netherlands calculate the early repayment compensation.
Er is op dit moment geen overzicht voorhanden waarin wordt weergegeven op welke wijze de verschillende hypotheekverstrekkers in Nederland de vergoeding bij vervroegde aflossing berekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het feit dat het OM nu de MH17 radargegevens in Rusland opvraagt

Two MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service's request to Russia for raw primary radar data on MH17 reflected political pressure, whether an ICAO dispute should be launched, and why Russia, Ukraine and the UN had not fully complied with Security Council resolution 2166 and the victims' families' letters. The minister replied that the prosecution's independence must be protected, that the Netherlands is ready to assist on request, that no ICAO dispute will be started because the safety investigation did not need the data, and that the Russian authorities have said they are willing to cooperate.
The cabinet does not want political influence on this important criminal investigation.
Het kabinet wil geen politieke beïnvloeding van dit belangrijke strafrechtelijke onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de heropstart van de oliewinning in Schoonebeek en de hervatting van de injectie van productiewater in Twente

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked the minister whether NAM had informed him of its plan to resume wastewater injection and oil production at Schoonebeek, why parliament was not informed of the decision, and to release the evaluation and Deltares report. The minister confirmed NAM notified SodM and his ministry, said the decision was postponed to year-end, promised to send the evaluation and advice by early September, but declined to provide some documents and deferred the decision to consultation with the region.
I expect to send the Commission's advice and the Deltares second opinion to your House in early September 2016.
Ik verwacht het advies van de Commissie en de second opinion van Deltares begin september 2016 naar uw Kamer toe te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de elektronische berichtenbox

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the electronic mailbox (Berichtenbox): whether the Belastingdienst must accept and answer digital messages, usage figures for MijnOverheid and MijnToeslagen, the post-by-paper maatwerk policy and acceptgiro timing. The State Secretary answers that a second channel is not required in principle but personal help must remain available, gives usage figures, and states that the acceptgiro timing and bezwaar information are adequate.
I do not share the view that there must always be a second channel for sending messages to or receiving messages from the Belastingdienst.
Ik deel niet de mening dat er altijd een tweede kanaal moet zijn om berichten in te sturen naar of te ontvangen van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over het beeld Terrorismebestrijding Turkije: ISIS door draaideur, academici in de cel

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's handling of ISIS suspects, releases of suspects, MIT powers and the EU visa-liberalisation benchmark on terrorism law. The minister said the cabinet cannot judge Turkish proceedings without the case files, that Turkey's terrorism law is used against terrorist groups but also criticised on press freedom, and that visa liberalisation requires meeting all benchmarks, which has not yet happened.
Since the cabinet has no access to the investigation files, it is not possible to judge the Turkish legal process in these cases.
Aangezien het kabinet geen inzage heeft in de onderzoeksdossiers is het niet mogelijk een oordeel te vellen over de Turkse rechtsgang in deze zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Krol en Van Klaveren over "het behandelvoorbehoud op het EU-voorstel inzake bedrijfspensioenfondsen"

MPs Omtzigt, Krol and Van Klaveren asked whether the government would present the negotiated text on the EU occupational pensions (IORP) directive in time for Parliament to instruct its voting position, and by when. The State Secretary replied that the consolidated negotiation text was sent to Parliament on 24 June and made available via the Council extranet, that COREPER would discuss it on 30 June, and that Parliament could still state its view before the Council decision.
The consolidated text of the negotiation result will be submitted to COREPER
De geconsolideerde tekst van het onderhandelingsresultaat zal worden voorgelegd aan COREPER
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de nieuwe Europese richtlijn pensioenen, IORP-2

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the status of the IORP-2 pension directive, whether a deal was reached in the trilogue, whether publication was delayed until after the Brexit referendum, and whether the government kept its 2014 commitments to inform parliament quarterly and send draft Council positions in time. The State Secretary answered that the trilogue reached a provisional compromise, that the stilte procedure passed without objection, that Coreper vote is planned for 30 June, that the text will be shared with parliament, and that prior briefings were sent, while publication timing is a normal procedure.
No minutes were drawn up of these trilogue meetings.
Van deze triloogbijeenkomsten zijn geen notulen opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Fransen kapen KLM’ en ‘Stakingsdreiging Air France: wat zijn de consequenties voor KLM'

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked about reports that Air France might shift KLM flights from Amsterdam to Paris amid strike threats, and about the strain on the KLM-Air France relationship. The State Secretary replied that Air France KLM denies such a plan, that cost-cutting is needed at both airlines, that the government opposes shifting capacity at KLM's expense, and that it will keep defending the public interests tied to KLM and Schiphol, promising a letter to the House.
We continue to commit to safeguarding the public interests involved with KLM and the main-port function of Schiphol.
We blijven ons inzetten voor de borging van de publieke belangen die met KLM en de mainportfunctie van Schiphol zijn gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Toorenburg, Knops en Keijzer over de zaak Saban B. in Turkije

CDA MPs asked about the case of Saban B., convicted in the Netherlands to 7 years 9 months for trafficking and assault but still free in Turkey, and about Turkey's cooperation on enforcing Dutch sentences. The minister answered that Turkish proceedings are still pending, that Dutch requests since 2010 cover 23 persons with at least 6 granted, and that a memorandum of understanding is being negotiated, but did not provide a complete list or the requested one-week timeline.

In the context of protecting the privacy of the persons concerned, I can only inform you that since 2010 the Netherlands has, under the Wots, expressed to Turkey the wish to transfer enforcement of a Dutch sentence for 23 persons.

In het kader van bescherming van de privacy van de betrokken personen, kan ik u slechts mededelen dat Nederland vanaf 2010 op grond van de Wots ten aanzien van 23 personen aan Turkije de wens kenbaar heeft gemaakt de tenuitvoerlegging van een Nederlands vonnis aan Turkije over te dragen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek over de radargegevens van de OVV, de non-disclosure clausules in het JIT MH17 verdrag, het archief over de MH17 en de brieven van nabestaanden

An MP asks the government about radar data on MH17, JIT non-disclosure clauses, the MH17 archive, and letters from relatives to Ukraine, Russia and the US. The minister answers that the government took note of the OVV report, that JIT-related agreements are not public, that the archive is being indexed, and that the interview notes of the Twente evaluation cannot be disclosed.

The cabinet wants to avoid that starting a dispute procedure could be taken to mean that the Netherlands considers this data necessary to draw the conclusions of the OVV report and that the investigation must be reopened.

Het kabinet wil voorkomen dat uit het starten van een geschillenprocedure zou kunnen worden geconcludeerd dat Nederland van mening is dat deze gegevens nodig zijn voor het trekken van de conclusies van het OVV rapport en dat het onderzoek heropend moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over confisqueren van kerken en vernielen van cultureel erfgoed door Turkije

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about Turkey's expropriation of about 6,300 parcels in Diyarbakir's historic Sur district, including churches, damage to heritage sites, a police photo mocking Christians, and whether the Netherlands will protest or request independent investigation. The minister answered that expropriation is legal for restoration under Turkish law with compensation and appeal rights, damage stems from mutual fighting, church damage is limited, and the Netherlands urges an end to violence and monitors the situation.
Affected parties can further appeal against expropriation.
Betroffenen kunnen verder beroep aantekenen tegen onteigening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek van de Belastingdienst naar strafbare feiten aan de hand van de Panama Papers

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance when the Tax Authority would obtain the Panama Papers data, why journalists would not share it earlier, and how it could gain lawful access for enforcement. The State Secretary answered that the data would be available via an online database from 9 May, that the Tax Authority had contacted the newspaper and the JITSIC network, and that delay risks evidence loss, which the Tax Authority, FIOD and prosecutors confirmed.
I myself sought contact with the editorial board of Trouw with the request to make the underlying data available earlier.
Ik heb zelf contact gezocht met de hoofdredactie van Trouw met het verzoek om de achterliggende gegevens eerder beschikbaar te maken
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Omtzigt aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de bizarre nieuwe wereld van de zzp’er

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the uncertainty facing freelancers (zzp'ers) under the new DBA rules replacing the VAR, including vague model contracts, enforcement of contract compliance, and readiness before 1 May 2016. The State Secretary answers that the model contracts are workable, that compliance is judged reasonably, that the Belastingdienst will process pending contracts in 6-8 weeks, and that the transition is adequately supported.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over uitspraken over helikoptergeld van de hoofdeconoom van de Europese Centrale Bank (ECB)

MP Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about ECB chief economist Peter Praet's remarks on 'helicopter money', including whether it is legal under Article 123 TFEU and what risks it poses for the Dutch state. The minister replied that helicopter money is a theoretical concept, that the Eurosystem is independent within its mandate, that legality could be tested before the Court of Justice, and that no legal advice would be sought, while agreeing to answer before the plenary debate.
Whether the ECB acts within its mandate can be brought before the European Court of Justice by interested parties.
Of de ECB handelt binnen haar mandaat kan door belanghebbenden worden voorgelegd aan het Europese Hof van Justitie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Amhaouch over de voorlopige toepassing van het associatieverdrag tussen de EU en Oekraïne

MPs Omtzigt and Amhaouch asked how long the EU-Ukraine association agreement could stay provisionally applied if it never enters into force, which parts fall under exclusive EU competence, and whether a narrower EU-only agreement is being considered. Minister Koenders answered that non-ratification is uncharted territory, outlined the EU competence rules in general terms without a definitive list of articles, and said no such overlegs on an EU-only alternative had taken place while the agreement remains the best basis for cooperation.
The association agreement does not specify which provisions fall under the exclusive competences of the EU.
Het associatieakkoord specificeert niet welke bepalingen vallen onder de exclusieve bevoegdheden van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Keijzer over het onderzoek inzake de kunstroof in het Westfries Museum in Hoorn

Two Christian Democrat MPs asked why Ukraine appears not to take the Hoorn museum art theft investigation seriously, including questions about unheard suspects and the Ukrainian security service's role. The Ministers answered that Ukraine is conducting a criminal investigation, that the Netherlands cannot comment on an ongoing prosecution, and that cooperation is satisfactory, while declining to share case progress details with Parliament.
Since this concerns an ongoing criminal investigation, no statements about it will be made to the House.
Gezien het een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek betreft, worden hierover geen mededelingen aan de Kamer gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de onderzoeken naar de vliegramp bij Faro en de mogelijke heropening van dat onderzoek door de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV)

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked whether new facts justify asking the OVV to reopen the Faro air disaster investigation, and why the Netherlands seeks reopening of the Portuguese report, with questions on confidentiality, expert access to documents, and maintenance responsibility. The State Secretary answered that the OVV was asked to assess new relevant facts, that the Portuguese authority alone can reopen the investigation, that ICAO rules restrict disclosure of records, and that the aircraft was found airworthy and maintenance-deferral records remain unverified.
I have not asked the OVV to reopen the Portuguese investigation.
Ik heb de OVV niet gevraagd het Portugese onderzoek te heropenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de bijstand die verleend wordt aan Romano van der Dussen, die op 11 februari 2016 is vrijgelaten

Two CDA MPs asked how Romano van der Dussen, released from a Spanish prison in February 2016 after 12 years, will receive reintegration help, legal assistance, and progress on his case. The government replied that consular assistance, coordination with Spanish authorities and Dutch reclassering/municipal support are available, that further legal procedures are his own responsibility, and referred to earlier letters for the case history.
See my letter to your House of 17 February 2016 (TK 30 010, no. 26).
Zie mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 17 februari 2016 (TK 30 010, nr. 26 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de foutmelding op de website van de Belastingdienst op de eerste aangiftedag

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about website overload and login errors on the Tax Authority portal on the first filing day, and about the discontinuation of the downloadable filing program easytax. The State Secretary answered all 13 questions, explaining capacity expansion, that peak-time overload is occasional and that users are asked to file in spread-out fashion, and that easytax was phased out in favour of online filing.
Question 13: Can you answer these questions one by one and within two weeks? Answer 13: Yes
Vraag 13 Kunt u deze vragen één voor één en binnen twee weken beantwoorden? Antwoord 13 Ja

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Omtzigt, De Roon, Sjoerdsma en Bontes over het rondetafelgesprek van 22 januari 2016 over de beleidsreactie onderzoeksrapporten over MH17

MPs asked the government to reflect on the January 2016 round-table discussion on prosecution of the MH17 downing, including suggestions on a possible Dutch-Russian tribunal, the interpretation of article 552y of the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, and victims' relatives' rights in proceedings. The government answered that it keeps both national and international prosecution options open pending the criminal investigation, acknowledges that article 552y should be amended (a bill is with the Council of State), and will consider the concerns raised about relatives' participation.
Should there be a need to speed up the legislative process with a view to possible prosecution of offences related to the downing of MH17, the available options will be used.

Mocht er met het oog op de eventuele berechting van misdrijven gerelateerd aan het neerhalen van MH17 behoefte zijn om het wetgevingsproces te versnellen zullen de beschikbare mogelijkheden daartoe aangegrepen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over bericht Turkse journalisten bedreigd met levenslang vanwege 'Adana-gate'

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish prosecutors seeking life sentences against journalists Can Dündar and Erdem Gül over reports on alleged arms transports to Syria, including press freedom, prison access, EU action and the case for an international inquiry. Minister Koenders answered that the Netherlands raises press freedom with Turkey, views the charges as very serious, and sees no need for an independent international investigation, while leaving judicial matters to the courts.
The cabinet sees no need for an independent international investigation.
Het kabinet ziet geen noodzaak voor een onafhankelijk internationaal onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Financiën over de schikking met NS-fraudeurs

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked why NS settled employment contracts with executives involved in the Limburg concession tender irregularities despite the minister's earlier promise of no severance payments, and about the amounts, timeline and whether the state approved them. The minister answered that the NS board handled the settlements under employment law, that the state as shareholder has no role in ordinary employee dismissals, that he does not know the individual amounts, and that the settlements avoided costly litigation.
It is not for the shareholder to make this information public. That is for the company itself.
Het is niet aan de aandeelhouder om deze informatie publiek te maken. Dat is aan de onderneming zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over “de puinhoop bij het toekennen van subsidies voor het referendum op 6 april 2016”

CDA MPs Amhaouch and Omtzigt asked why only three subsidy applications for the 6 April 2016 advisory referendum had been granted despite a three-week decision deadline, and sought data on delays, form errors, costs and fairness. Minister Plasterk answered that 73 applications had been granted, that the independent Referendum Commission is responsible for the subsidy scheme and will evaluate it after the summer recess, and that he has full confidence in its decision-making.
The Referendum Act chose to entrust this task to an independent Referendum Commission.
In de Wet raadgevend referendum is er voor gekozen deze taak in handen te geven aan een onafhankelijke Referendumcommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over de rapporten van de Auditdienst Rijk

Two MPs (Ronnes and Omtzigt, CDA) asked the Finance, Justice and Security, and Defence ministers about the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) audit reports, including a list of 2015 reports, when each was sent to parliament, and the status of six announced audits. The government answered that it sent most reports promptly, gave dates for each, said some audits are unfinished or were commissioned by other ministers, and committed to publishing the reports on the ministries' websites.
The study referred to under b is being carried out on the instructions of the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and has not yet been completed.
Het onderzoek bedoeld onder b wordt uitgevoerd in opdracht van de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over de primaire radargegevens van de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked whether the Public Prosecution Service told the minister that primary radar data for the MH17 investigation was no longer needed, and how such oral communications are recorded. The minister confirmed the prosecution's oral statements of 14 and 19 January that no further radar requests were needed, said oral and written briefings have equal status, and declined to have them put in writing, citing rechtshulp requests already made.
Oral information is not registered as such in the administration.
Mondelinge inlichtingen worden niet als zodanig in de administratie geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de brief van commissievoorzitter Juncker aan de Turkse regering met beloftes over de toetredingsonderhandelingen van Turkije tot de EU

Omtzigt asked the government about a letter from Commission President Juncker to Turkey promising progress on EU accession talks, including whether the Commission committed to finishing preparatory work for chapters 15, 26, 23 and 24 by 1 April, and about Turkey's human rights and Copenhagen criteria. The minister answered that the Commission's commitment only concerns completing preparatory documents, that the Netherlands supports treating rule-of-law chapters 23 and 24 with Cypriot blockade in place, and referred back to earlier letters for the rest.
The content was first communicated to your House in the report of the EU-Turkey Summit of 29 November, sent to your House on 2 December.
Over de inhoud ervan is uw Kamer voor het eerst geïnformeerd in het verslag van de EU Turkije Top van 29 november, dat uw Kamer op 2 december is toegegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over ontbrekende primaire radargegevens, de ontbrekende satellietbeelden en het ontbrekende gesprek met de luchtverkeerleider in het onderzoek van de Onderzoeksraad vo

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked the government about missing primary radar data, missing satellite images and the absence of an interview with the Ukrainian air traffic controller in the OVV's MH17 investigation. The minister answered that the OVV is independent, that its conclusions are not affected by the missing data, and that the government facilitated the investigation while declining to detail which information was requested from partner states.
Disclosure would give insight into the course of the investigation and could put pressure on ongoing discussions with requested states.
Openbaarmaking zou inzicht geven in de loop van het onderzoek en lopende besprekingen met aangezochte staten onder druk kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven en Voordewind over de voorlopige inwerkingtreding van het associatieverdrag tussen de EU en Oekraïne

MPs Omtzigt, Verhoeven and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the provisional application of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, including which articles apply, whether unanimity and parliamentary consent were needed, and what happens if the Netherlands rejects it in the referendum. The minister answered that about 355 articles (roughly 70%) are provisionally applied under EU competence, that the Council decisions were adopted by unanimity with Dutch consent, and that the Netherlands will follow the referendum law without prejudging the outcome.
The cabinet does not have continuous insight into the timing and manner in which the national parliaments of the 27 member states are informed of the decision on provisional application.
Het kabinet heeft niet voortdurend zicht op het tijdstip en wijze van informeren van de nationale parlementen in 27 lidstaten over het besluit tot voorlopige toepassing.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het feit dat de OVV onderzoekers geen primaire radargegevens ontvangen hebben voor het onderzoek naar de MH17 van de Rusland, van Oekraïne of van andere landen, terwijl ze daar

An MP asked the ministers why the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) did not receive primary radar data on the MH17 downing from Russia, Ukraine or other countries despite requesting it and despite ICAO obligations to retain such data. The government answered that the OVV had sufficient information for its conclusions, that Russia stated no radar data was stored, that Ukraine's radars were not operational, and that the OVV's investigation was independent, with the government having no role in obtaining the data.

In view of this, the Netherlands will work within the EU and ICAO to remove this ambiguity by advocating a retention obligation that always applies when radar data may be relevant to aviation accident investigations.

Met oog hierop zal Nederland zich in EU-verband binnen ICAO inzetten om deze onduidelijkheid weg te nemen door een bewaarplicht te bepleiten die altijd aan de orde is als radargegevens relevant kunnen zijn voor onderzoek naar luchtvaartongevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de omvang en de in transparantie van het ANFA-programma waarmee Nationale Centrale Banken voor honderden miljarden staatsobligaties opgekocht hebben en over de totale hoeveelhe

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the opaque ANFA agreement limiting national central banks' net financial assets, the composition of national central bank bond holdings, and whether ECB bond purchases amount to monetary financing of sovereign debt. The minister largely deflected, citing the ECB's and national central banks' responsibility and confidentiality of ANFA, while providing aggregate PSPP purchase figures per country and committing only to discuss publishing ANFA with DNB.
It is therefore up to the NCBs themselves whether they use the room that ANFA offers them.
Het is dus aan de NCB's zelf of zij de ruimte die hun geboden wordt op basis van ANFA benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het feitenrelaas over professor Maat

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about missing documents in the Maat case, the drafting of the police chief's letter, why it went to the Director-General, and when the Wob appeal decision would come. The Minister answered that missing documents were added to the file, listed the notes received, explained the drafting changes, and said the Wob decision follows statutory deadlines with a hearing expected mid-February 2016.
The incomplete file that Professor Maat viewed on 23 November 2015 did not contain the internal memo from the Algemeen Commandanten.
Het onvolledige dossier dat professor Maat op 23 november 2015 heeft ingezien bevatte niet het interne memo van de Algemeen Commandanten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over onterechte kortingen op toeslagen en uitkeringen vanwege een afgekocht pensioen

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about unlawful reductions in benefits and allowances (rent allowance, AOW partner allowance, Anw and bridging benefit) after small pensions were bought out, and about SVB advice discouraging objections and the failure to fix the problem for two years. The State Secretary answered that the rules were changed from 1 December 2014, that an internal SVB investigation found no proof people were deterred from objecting though some may have felt objections were pointless, and that the SVB was asked to fully revise 2013–2014 decisions as a goodwill gesture.
Given the combination of circumstances, I have decided to ask the SVB to fully revise decisions on buy-outs of small pensions reduced between 1 January 2013 and 1 December 2014.

Ik heb besloten om, gezien de samenloop van omstandigheden, de SVB te verzoeken besluiten ten aanzien van de afkoop van klein pensioenen die gekort zijn in de periode van 1 januari 2013 tot 1 december 2014 volledig te herzien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het politieonderzoek naar professor Maat, dat de minister keer op keer op keer weigerde om openbaar te maken

MPs Omtzigt and others asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the police investigation into professor Maat's MH17 role was kept confidential and heavily redacted under the Wob, and whether the termination of his cooperation was justified. The minister answered that the file was made available to parliament confidentially under article 68 of the Constitution, that redactions protected officials' personal policy views and witness cooperation, and that he apologised to Maat for reacting too emotionally.
the file, including the witness statements, has been made available for confidential inspection by your House since 2 December 2015.
het dossier, waaronder de getuigenverklaringen, vanaf 2 december 2015 ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de brief, die Europarlementarier Schaake (D66/ALDE) samen met 33 Europarlementariers aan eurocommissaris Timmermans geschreven heeft op 10 december 2015

Omtzigt asks whether the government will disclose the Juncker letter to Turkey's prime minister, all deal elements, and details of the refugee redistribution proposal before the EU summit debate. Minister Koenders replies that the government cannot share the Commission letter as it is an official Commission document, points to earlier letters for the deal's contents, and says the redistribution proposal will be shared with parliament in the usual way.
The cabinet is not authorised to give access to this letter between the European Commission and a third party.
Het kabinet is niet gemachtigd inzage te geven in deze brief tussen de Europese Commissie en een derde partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over zijn uitspraak dat hij voortaan wel alle documenten aan de Kamer zal sturen, als daarom gevraagd wordt

Omtzigt asks Finance Minister Dijsselbloem whether he will send Parliament all documents requested by MPs, citing Article 68 of the Constitution, and asks which documents were withheld, including Eurowob, NS remuneration and Commission coco correspondence. The minister affirms the Article 68 framework, says all necessary information is provided unless state interests oppose it, declines to compile a list or reconsider past decisions, and points to earlier answers and the NS annual report.
For that reason I provide all information necessary to enable you to perform that function, unless the interest of the State opposes it.
Om die reden verstrek ik alle inlichtingen die nodig zijn om u die functie te kunnen laten vervullen, tenzij het belang van de Staat zich daartegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het onderzoek naar de professor die uit het MH17 team gezet werd en het onderzoek daarna, dat totaal onleesbaar aan de Kamer gestuurd is

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked why the police investigation into Professor Maat's removal from the MH17 team was largely blacked out when released under the Wob, and why the minister had not disclosed the witness statements and the conversation report. The minister defended the redactions on Wob grounds and personal policy views, but agreed to place the investigation documents for confidential inspection by parliament from 2 December 2015.

To respond further to your Chamber's request for information, the relevant documents from the police fact-finding investigation will be placed for confidential inspection by your Chamber from 2 December 2015.
Om nader op de informatievraag van uw Kamer in te gaan liggen per 2 december 2015 de betreffende stukken van het feitenonderzoek van de politie ter vertrouwelijke inzage in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over EU-Turkije top

MP Omtzigt asked the government for the EU-Turkey deal text, a report of the summit, a list of commitments for each party, Turkish funding and Dutch contributions, resettlement and refugee-convention commitments, returns of migrants, budget implications and whether a parliamentary reservation was made. The minister answered that the action plan is provided via a letter, that Dutch funding (up to EUR 117 million extra, EUR 3 billion EU-wide) will be decided in the Spring Memorandum, and that no general parliamentary reservation was made, while leaving detailed modalities and resettlement commitments largely open.
No concrete agreements have been made on resettlement of refugees from Turkey.
Over hervestiging van vluchtelingen vanuit Turkije zijn geen concrete afspraken gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees, Omtzigt en Bashir over de informatie over de bonus van de voorzitter van de Raad van Bestuur van NS

MPs Koolmees, Omtzigt and Bashir asked the Finance Minister whether NS had emailed the ministry in April 2015 that its board received a 17.5% bonus, and why the ministry only checked the status of the bonuses on 17 June. Minister Dijsselbloem confirmed the April email, said agreement on the CEO bonus existed but payment could not occur until the CFO salary compensation was agreed on 30 May, and pointed to previously public documents for the communication request.
It is correct that NS sent an email on 14 April about a possible communication line on the variable pay awarded to NS's statutory board.
Het klopt dat NS op 14 april een e-mail heeft gestuurd over een eventuele communicatielijn over de toegekende variabele beloning van de statutaire directie van NS.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert en Geurts over de decharge die de aandeelhouder van de NS verleende op 4 maart 2015 tijdens de ALV, ondanks het feit dat toen al duidelijk was dat NS in 2014 de Spoorw

MPs Omtzigt, Van Helvert and Geurts asked why the shareholder granted discharge to NS management on 4 March 2015 although an ACM finding of a Railway Act breach was already foreseeable, and about the handling of the Veolia tender case, remuneration reports and bonuses. The minister answers that ministries were informed step by step, that NS did not yet know the ACM decision date on 4 March, that discharge covers only facts known at that time, and that remuneration information is publicly available in the annual reports.

Moreover, the shareholder grants discharge to the directors only for what the shareholder knew at that moment, and it does not amount to approval of the conduct for which the legal entity remains responsible.

Overigens geeft de aandeelhouder alleen decharge aan de bestuurders voor wat de aandeelhouder op dat moment (moment decharge) bekend is en betreft het hier geen goedkeuring van de gedragingen waarvoor de rechtspersoon verantwoordelijk is en blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Schouten over het verdwijnen van de blauwe envelop, het gebruik van de berichtenbox en de ouderenservice van de ouderenbonden

MPs Omtzigt and Schouten asked about complaints over abolishing the paper blue envelope, digital-only delivery via the Berichtenbox, and the future of the elderly tax-help service run by senior unions. Secretary Wiebes answered that support for less digitally capable people will continue, that the elderly service receives a one-year 2016 contribution, and that the first digital-only letter is the 2016 allowance continuation notice with a 6-week objection period preserved.
To ensure the first fully digital delivery of allowance messages in the Berichtenbox takes place responsibly, the Tax Administration starts with the notice on continuation of allowances.

Om te zorgen dat de eerste volledig digitale bezorging van toeslagberichten in de Berichtenbox ook verantwoord plaatsvindt, begint de Belastingdienst met het bericht over de continuering van toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over veto op proef met gasolie in Twente

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked why a test of gasoil storage in Twente salt caverns by AkzoNobel was halted, whether the company acted properly without an approved safety report, who is liable for future cavern leaks, and whether storage is safe. Minister Kamp answered that the test was not stopped, only the above-ground part was tested, the underground filling awaited a complete safety report, the revised report is now considered complete by advisers, and liability lies with the permit holder under the Mining Act and Civil Code.
I will therefore declare the safety report complete in the short term.
Ik zal op korte termijn het veiligheidsrapport dan ook volledig verklaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt, Bashir, Tony van Dijck en Van Vliet over de afschaffing van de oldtimervrijstelling

MPs from CDA, SP, PVV and Van Vliet asked the Finance State Secretary about the revenue estimates for abolishing the classic-car tax exemption, the number of diesel and LPG cars affected, and the cost of extending transitional rules to them. The State Secretary defended revised revenue estimates of roughly 60 to 70 million euros, gave a table of affected vehicles, and rejected extending transitional rules to diesel and LPG cars because of budget and air-quality concerns.

In my letter on the classic car measure I only intended to indicate that, to reach the estimated revenue of 137 million euros, the second part of the revenue, the replacement cars, would need to yield 82 million euros in motor vehicle tax.

Ik heb in mijn brief over de oldtimermaatregel slechts willen aangegeven dat, om de geraamde opbrengst van € 137 miljoen te halen, het tweede deel van de opbrengst, de vervangende auto's, € 82 miljoen aan MRB zou moeten opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Omtzigt over het bericht van de Kiesraad “Groen licht voor referendum over Associatieovereenkomst Oekraïne”

MPs Verhoeven and Omtzigt asked about the Kiesraad's approval of a referendum on the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, whether partners were informed, how the public will be informed, and the agreement's provisional application and ratification status. The government answered that the referendum does not affect provisional application, that the ratification law's entry-into-force provision lapsed, and that it will follow the Advisory Referendum Act, with a further decision on any rejection to be made later.
The cabinet will follow the Advisory Referendum Act.
Het kabinet zal de Wet raadgevend referendum volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het bericht «Voormalig NS-topman Huges spant kort geding aan om vergoeding»

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that former NS chief Huges sued for a large severance payment, whether his 2014 variable pay was reclaimed, and how NS governance and disclosure of the settlement work. The minister answered that the matter was settled out of court, the variable pay was repaid as part of the settlement, the shareholder discharge was granted, and the settlement will appear in the 2015 annual report, with the settlement document made available for confidential inspection.
I have made the settlement agreement itself available for confidential inspection.
De vaststellingsovereenkomst zelf heb ik ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de onderhandelingen van stichting 'Qanitoen' om een pand in de Schilderswijk te kopen ten behoeve van de prediking van de radicaal salafistische imam

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the radical imam Fawaz, his prior convictions, the foundation Qanitoen's attempts to secure premises in The Hague, and what the government will do to prevent him gaining a fixed base. The minister answered that individual cases are not discussed, that municipalities and local partners decide intervention strategies case by case, and that a new counter-terrorism administrative measures law is pending before the Council of State.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen mededeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Omtzigt over dood van een Nederlandse activist in Oost-Timor

MPs Voordewind and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the article alleging state-sanctioned killing of Dutch activist Paulino Gama in East Timor, whether the government would press for an independent investigation and autopsy, and what consular support the family received. The minister confirmed the death, said the investigation is the responsibility of the East Timorese government, that the Netherlands has asked about an inquiry and is monitoring, and that consular contact with the family was maintained.
The investigation into Mr Gama's death is the responsibility of the East Timorese government.
Het onderzoek naar de dood van de heer Gama is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Oost-Timorese regering.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de business case om de rechtbank Almelo half te ontmantelen

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a business case exists for halving the Almelo court, whether local officials can receive it, and whether it will be made public. The minister answered that the judiciary prepared no business case for Almelo, only financial projections based on reference projects and existing contracts, and that the figures were shared with local administrators.
The judiciary, as the Council for the Judiciary has informed me, has not prepared a business case for the planned housing arrangements for Almelo.
De rechtspraak heeft, zo heeft de Raad voor de rechtspraak (hierna: Raad) mij meegedeeld, voor de voorgenomen huisvestingplannen met betrekking tot Almelo geen business case opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de zaak R. van der D.

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Romano van der Dussen, including when the government learned of a DNA match to another prisoner, whether consular assistance was adequate, and for release of the case file. The minister answered that consular help was adequate, provided a chronology of consular contacts, but declined to hand over the underlying documents citing their personal and sensitive nature.

Because of the strongly individual and personal character of the file and the many documents and views of third parties, I limit myself to providing the aforementioned information and not to submitting the documents themselves.

Vanwege dit sterke individuele persoonlijke karakter van het dossier en de vele stukken en opvattingen van derden beperk ik mij tot het verstrekken van voornoemde inlichtingen en niet tot het overleggen van de documenten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over woekerpolissen

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about the 2011 'best of class' commitment on follow-up policy for woekerpolissen, Kifid ombudsman appointment, loss estimates, TER cost disclosure, a 2014 bonus at Nationale Nederlanden, and insurers' out-of-court settlements. The minister answered that the AFM monitors activation of policyholders, that Parliament will be consulted on the ombudsman appointment, that total damages cannot be determined, that TER rules apply, and that the AFM will report on settlements at end October.
I will consult the House of Representatives beforehand.
Ik zal hieraan voorafgaand de Tweede Kamer raadplegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Neppérus en Koolmees over dubbele belasting voor Nederlanders met de Amerikaanse nationaliteit

MPs Omtzigt, Neppérus and Koolmees asked the State Secretary of Finance about double taxation of Dutch citizens who also hold US nationality, covering US taxation of foreign benefits, home sale gains, BV loans, investment restrictions and IRS penalties. The State Secretary answered that the US applies nationality-based taxation under the 1992 treaty, that no concrete cases of double taxation are known, that no treaty renegotiation or OECD agenda item is planned, and that the US sets its own penalty regime.
I have no concrete signals that there is suddenly double taxation.
Ik heb geen concrete signalen dat er nu opeens sprake zou zijn van dubbele belastingheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de rol van Turkije in de strijd tegen PKK en ISIS

Members Omtzigt and Knops (CDA) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about Turkey's airstrikes on Kurdish groups (PKK, YPG) and ISIS, including alleged civilian casualties, coordination with the US-led coalition, and a proposed buffer zone in northern Syria. The government said it lacks independent information on Turkish operations, that Turkey and the US have agreed deconfliction and joint operations against ISIS, that it will look into the Zergele allegations via Turkey's announced inquiry, and that it sees no need for an independent investigation into alleged Turkish support for ISIS.
The cabinet does not have independent information on the circumstances of the Turkish air operations and the associated risks to American military personnel.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie over de omstandigheden van de Turkse luchtoperaties en de daaraan verbonden risico's voor Amerikaanse militairen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het bericht dat de rechtbank in Almelo compleet wordt uitgekleed

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about plans to strip the Almelo court of its functions, citing the Teeven/Heerts motion, earlier commitments, the penitentiary link, travel times and unemployment. The minister answered that the 32 hearing locations are equivalent but may differ in case mix, that the plan is driven by building vacancy and budget cuts, and that the Masterplan has not yet been adopted by the judiciary, which will be sent to parliament after adoption.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht “EU Squeezed $7.8 Billion Greek Bridge Loan Via ESM Loophole”

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether a Bloomberg-reported EFSM bridge loan to Greece was in substance an ESM loan routed around ESM unanimity and information rules. The minister replied that the ESM lent to the European Commission as part of its investment policy, that Greece was not a party, that no loophole exists and the information protocol was followed.
The ESM provided a loan to the European Commission, thus had a claim on the Commission, and is otherwise not a party to the purpose the Commission chooses for the borrowed money.
Het ESM heeft een lening verstrekt aan de Europese Commissie, had dus een vordering op de Commissie en is verder geen partij bij de bestemming die de Europese Commissie kiest voor het geleende geld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over het plotselinge vertrek van de CEO van Vivat na de overname door Anbang

Christian Democrat MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about the sudden departure of VIVAT's CEO after the Anbang takeover, including DNB's conditions, debt repayment, capital injection, and shareholder obligations. The minister gave a largely evasive reply, citing supervisory confidentiality, while confirming Anbang's tax payment and committing only to continued contact and a new chair vetted by DNB.
Information about the content of a declaration of no objection is confidential supervisory information and therefore not public.
Informatie over de inhoud van een verklaring van geen bezwaar is toezichtvertrouwelijk en daarmee niet publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het onderzoek dat gedaan is naar de gang van zaken rond de presentatie van een professor m.b.t. de ramp met de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked the Minister of Security and Justice to publish the police investigation behind the 10 June letter on the presentations by Professor Maat about the MH17 victim identification, and to clarify who was interviewed, when statements were signed, what agreements existed, and how the photos were shared. The Minister answered that large parts of the internal fact-finding report will be made public in anonymised form once personal data is protected, gave Maat access without secrecy, acknowledged the handling of photos was not careful and that formal rules are being drawn up, and declined to answer the questions one by one within the regular deadline.
Following your questions and four requests under the Freedom of Information Act (Wob) that have since been received, the police have considered the possible publication of the investigation.

Mede naar aanleiding van uw vragen en vier verzoeken op grond van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob), die inmiddels zijn ontvangen, heeft de politie de mogelijke openbaarmaking van het onderzoek bezien.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Aukje de Vries over de verplichte roulatie van accountants en een mogelijke tegenstrijdigheid tussen de Europese Verordening EU/537/2014 en het wetsvoorstel Wijzigingswet financ

Omtzigt and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch Wijzigingswet financiële markten 2016 lacks transitional rules for audit firm rotation that the EU Regulation 537/2014 provides, and whether this creates a conflict with EU law and what consequences follow. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the EU Regulation applies directly, the Dutch rotation provision will not enter into force by royal decree, the AFM has a limited extension power in exceptional cases, and a separate letter will be sent to the House.

By royal decree it will be determined that article 23, part c, of the Wta, as well as the amendment to it in the Wijzigingswet Financiële Markten 2016, will not enter into force, so that for office rotation only the EU Regulation provisions apply.
Door middel van een koninklijk besluit zal worden bepaald dat artikel 23, onderdeel c, van de Wta, evenals de wijziging daarop in de Wijzigingswet Financiële Markten 2016, niet in werking zal treden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Omtzigt en Van Tongeren over meetgegevens op het Nederlandse olie- en gasportaal

MPs Mulder, Omtzigt and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reported monthly wastewater injection volumes above a 300,000-barrel threshold at Rossum-Weerselo-2, the relevance of a Science study on US injection and induced seismicity, and felt tremors near the injection well. The minister replied that monthly averages stay below that threshold, that the US study is not directly transferable to Dutch conditions, that TNO and SodM are assessing it with results expected in late September, and that the geophone network is being expanded.
I expect an answer from SodM and TNO at the end of September and will inform your House about it then.
Ik verwacht eind september een antwoord van SodM en TNO en zal uw Kamer hier dan over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de douane van Turkije

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked about Turkey's new additional import duties on goods from third countries, which affect Dutch exports, and whether this breaches the EU-Turkey customs union, and what steps the government would take. The minister confirms the customs union rules, lists the additional duties, says the Dutch embassy and the European Commission have raised the issue with Turkey, and that the parties will look at modernising the customs union.
The Dutch embassy in Ankara raised the increasing duties in a conversation on 10 July with the Turkish Ministry of Economic Affairs.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Ankara heeft de toenemende heffingen aangekaart in een gesprek op 10 juli bij het Turkse Ministerie van Economische Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat tientallen miljoenen in de zorg aan onnodig fiscaal advies verspild zijn

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether medical specialists' founding of new companies to keep entrepreneurial status was unnecessary after declaration rules changed, and about the role of tax advice and Article 3.5 Wet IB 2001. The State Secretary answered that the loss of direct declaration rights generally does not by itself establish entrepreneurship, that the Tax Service did not pressure parties, and that eligibility depends on all relevant risks, with the government open to contracts being submitted to the Tax Service.
I note that in practice some unclarity has arisen about the extent of the personnel risks to be borne.
Ik merk hierbij op dat in de praktijk enige onduidelijkheid is gerezen over de omvang van de te lopen personeelsrisico's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ulenbelt en Krol over de aanpassing in de Ultimate Forward Rate (UFR) voor pensioenfondsen

MPs Omtzigt, Ulenbelt and Krol asked the state secretary about the change to the Ultimate Forward Rate for pension funds, including its effects on contributions, wages, recovery plans and transfers of value. The state secretary answered that the UFR was set by DNB following the advice of an independent committee, and gave estimates of effects while stating that many outcomes remain uncertain.
I expect that I can inform you at the end of September about the outcomes of this study.
Ik verwacht dat ik u eind september over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek kan informeren.

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de Minister van Financiën over de vraag of fiduciair beheer door pensioenfondsen is toegestaan en over de openheid in beleg

An MP asks the State Secretary and Finance Minister about whether pension funds may outsource investments to fiduciary managers, the duty of care of such managers, participants' access to contracts, investment and derivatives information, and accountability for misleading cost reporting. The government answers that participants have no individual right to inspect management contracts, that the supervisor's information rights cannot be limited by confidentiality clauses, that the current law has no communication norm, and that internal and external supervision is relied upon, while declining to report current investment positions for strategic reasons.

However, the Pension Funds Code stipulates that the pension fund board annually and critically evaluates the quality of execution and costs of contracted service providers, including fiduciary managers.

Wel is in de Code Pensioenfondsen bepaald dat het pensioenfondsbestuur jaarlijks en op kritische wijze, de kwaliteit van de uitvoering en de gemaakte kosten van de gecontracteerde dienstverleners, inclusief de fiduciair beheerders, evalueert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Omtzigt inzake de verhuizing van SLO van Enschede naar Utrecht

MPs Rog and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why SLO is moving its seat from Enschede to Utrecht, citing regional employment dispersal policy and a board letter claiming the ministry strongly favoured Utrecht. The minister answered that the move is SLO's own strategic decision, denied having expressed a preference for Utrecht beyond noting its logic, declined to intervene or write to SLO, and said no statutory-change approval basis exists to refuse.
I have not expressed a preference for Utrecht because, as previously answered on this subject, I am not responsible for it.
Ik heb geen voorkeur voor Utrecht uitgesproken omdat zoals eerder geantwoord over dit onderwerp, ik daar niet over ga.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het aantal paspoorten dat vervallen verklaard wordt

Opposition MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the government to reconcile conflicting figures on passports declared void for suspected jihadist travel, whether Dutch citizens' passports are revoked alongside second-nationality passports, and whether cooperation with Turkey and Morocco exists on revoking passports. The Minister gave figures clarifying the difference between total signalled passports and active signals, acknowledged that identity cards can still enable travel, announced a bill on travel bans and identity card revocation, and stated there are no specific agreements with Turkey on mutual passport revocation.
I do not provide further statements about individual cases.
Over de individuele gevallen doe ik geen nadere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de zaak van R. van der D. (vervolgvragen)

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked why the minister withheld the confidential Grimbrere report on the case of R. van der D., when the government first learned of the DNA match, and what it has done to secure a Spanish DNA comparison and review. The minister answers that the report contains sensitive personal data so disclosure is the individual's choice, that Dutch policy is not to intervene in foreign judicial verdicts, and that the embassy is pressing Spanish authorities for a swift DNA verification.
The trust report contains special personal data (health and criminal data) within the meaning of the Dutch Data Protection Act, which stand in the way of sharing that information.

Het vertrouwensrapport bevat bijzondere persoonsgegevens (daar wordt onder verstaan: gezondheid en strafrechtelijke gegevens) zoals bedoeld in paragraaf 2, hoofdstuk 2 van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, die eraan in de weg staan om die informatie te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt naar aanleiding van het bericht “Verdere selectie van zakenbanken voor de voorgenomen beursintroductie van ABN AMRO”

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about the selection of underwriting banks for the planned ABN AMRO IPO, including fees, other remuneration, share allocation and whether banks can earn money from the deal. The minister answered that NLFI runs the selection, that a base fee is zero with capped expenses and a discretionary fee up to 4.5 million euro, and that share allocation follows set criteria with safeguards against improper practices.
The contract terms I will make available for confidential inspection.
De contractvoorwaarden zal ik vertrouwelijk ter inzage beschikbaar stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haersma Buma en Omtzigt over het aftreden van de Griekse premier

Two CDA MPs asked whether the cabinet knew in advance of the Greek prime minister's planned resignation and snap elections, what this means for implementing the Greek bailout, and whether an Eurogroup meeting would be convened. The government answered that it was not informed beforehand, that calling elections is a sovereign Greek decision not in conflict with the agreement, that an interim government cannot take binding decisions, and that the next Eurogroup meeting is on 12 September.
A decision to hold early elections is a sovereign decision of Greece.
Een besluit tot vervroegde verkiezingen is een soeverein besluit van Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over de verkoop van Vivat (Reaal) aan Anbang

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister why DNB blocked Anbang's takeover of Nationale Nederlanden, whether approvals elsewhere were delayed, how DNB views Anbang's European acquisitions, and how pension and customer data are protected after the Vivat sale. The minister declined to disclose DNB's assessment citing supervisory confidentiality, said Vivat Verzekeringen's sale was completed with DNB's no-objection statements, and pointed to existing supervision by DNB, AFM and CBP.
Information about the assessment of an application for a no-objection statement, if one had been submitted in that case, is supervisory-confidential.
Informatie over de beoordeling van een aanvraag van een verklaring van geen bezwaar, zo die in het genoemde geval zou zijn ingediend, is toezichtvertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de identificatie van de slachtoffers van de MH17

An MP asked the ministers whether the government would fully disclose who authorised Professor Maat's MH17 victim-identification presentations, what the internal police study found, and whether the study report would be shared. The minister answered that the presentations were not explicitly authorised by police leadership, that a colleague's presentation was, and that the internal study's report would not be published, with rules for presentations to be formalised later.
The investigation itself is an internal study that is known only within the police.
Het onderzoek zelf is een intern onderzoek dat alleen binnen de politie bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bashir over de extra aandeelhoudersvergadering van de NS

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Bashir) asked the Finance Minister about extra shareholder meetings of NS and whether the invitation and minutes would be shared, and whether any settlement agreement with CEO Huges would be made public. The minister confirmed the meetings, declined to share the minutes because of ongoing legal proceedings and possible harm to the state's legal position, and referred the settlement question to a prior answer.
Publication of the minutes could harm the legal position of the state.
Openbaarmaking van het verslag kan de juridische positie van de staat schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de uitbetaalde bonus van de voormalig topman van de NS en de uitspraken van de minister van Financien over deze zaak

CDA MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked the Finance Minister how NS top executive Huges's bonus was paid out before the supervisory board and shareholder had approved it, and about the minister's earlier statements on the matter. The minister confirmed the earlier statements, said the board and shareholder had not authorised the payment, and explained the timeline of the bonus and the executive's departure.
The supervisory board has informed me that the supervisory board did not authorise the payment.
De raad van commissarissen heeft mij gemeld dat de raad van commissarissen de uitbetaling niet heeft geautoriseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de zaak van R. van der D.

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Romano van der Dussen's Spanish conviction, consular visits, a commissioned defence-counsel report, and a DNA match on a victim. The government answered that consular visits continue, that the report is confidential and did not address guilt, and that the Spanish courts alone can decide on reopening, with Dutch consular assistance continuing.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not make confidential reports public.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken maakt vertrouwensrapporten niet openbaar.
