Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam over het niet vervolgen van Rabobankiers bij de Libor/Euribor-fraude

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked which Rabobank settlement transactions were agreed, whether the Dutch settlement shields staff from prosecution, and why the Libor/Euribor case led to no prosecution of current employees. The government answered that the non-prosecution decision was an independent OM decision confirmed in the settlement, refused to publish the Dutch settlement, and defended the approach as proportionate while acknowledging slow DNB action and FIOD evidence handling issues.
In the Dutch system a settlement agreement is not made public.
In het Nederlandse stelsel wordt een vaststellingsovereenkomst niet openbaar gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Weyenberg over welke mensen verplicht moeten deelnemen aan het pensioenfonds voor de uitzendbranche, StiPP, nu de ontslagregeling een andere definitie heeft van uitzendwerkg

MPs Omtzigt and Van Weyenberg asked whether payroll and secondment workers must remain covered by the StiPP pension fund, given that the 2015 dismissal rules define employment agencies differently by requiring an allocation function. The State Secretary answered that the dismissal definitions apply only to that regulation, that the StiPP scope is set by its parties (with a pending Supreme Court case), and promised a bill on equal pension treatment for payroll workers after the summer.
The relevant bill will be submitted to your House after the summer.
Het betreffende wetsvoorstel zal na de zomer bij uw Kamer worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de naheffing

An MP asks the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers why correspondence with the European Commission about the EU budget levy (naheffing) is withheld, and demands the emails and a breakdown of payments per country. The government refuses to send the correspondence, claims diplomatic confidentiality and parliamentary information rules, provides a country-by-country payment table, and dodges the question about when the Prime Minister was first informed.
Are you willing to finally send the parliament the correspondence about the levy relating to the sixth supplementary budget 2014, as has been requested several times?
Bent u bereid alsnog de correspondentie over de naheffing, die betrekking heeft op de zesde aanvullende begroting 2014 aan de Kamer te doen toekomen, zoals meerdere keren gevraagd?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het uitwisselen van de pensioengegevens van Nederlanders die in de Tweede Wereldoorlog in Duitse eenheden gediend hebben en daarvoor pensioenen ontvingen

Rep. Omtzigt asks why Dutch tax authorities did not receive data on German military pensions paid to Dutch volunteers in WWII, whether such pensions fall under the treaty exemption, and what has been agreed with Germany. The Secretary of State confirms German pensions are taxable in Germany, that Germany cannot provide a full overview, that Kriegsbeschadigtenrenten are exempt in Germany and only available via individual requests, and commits to re-assess the taxing of recent discoveries.
Germany is therefore not able to indicate in general which pensions are paid to which persons.
Duitsland is dus niet in staat om in het algemeen aan te geven welke pensioenen aan welke personen worden betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de buitenlandse financiering van islamitische instellingen

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked ministers about foreign funding of Islamic institutions, the AIVD's remit, and ANBI transparency obligations for mosques and churches. The government answered that the RAND study revealed nothing new, that it will apply ANBI publication rules from 2016 and revoke status where obligations are unmet, and that intelligence services investigate foreign influence only where serious suspicions arise.
No public statements can be made about how the AIVD concretely organises its investigations.
Over de wijze waarop de AIVD concreet onderzoeken inricht, kunnen in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het benutten van wettelijke mogelijkheden om uitreizen naar IS-gebieden te voorkomen

CDA MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the government why local authorities do not use passport measures to prevent jihadist departures to IS territory, and about information provision to mayors and the monitoring of departures. Minister Van der Steur answered that passport signalling is one useful tool within a broader package, that mayors and municipal councils have been adequately informed, that about seventy passports were flagged for invalidation, and that the government will not publish per-municipality departure figures, which remains the responsibility of each municipality.
As indicated, it is not for the cabinet to communicate about individual departing persons or the number of departures per municipality.
Zoals aangegeven is het niet aan het kabinet om over individuele uitreizigers of het aantal uitreizigers per gemeente te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat medisch specialisten volgens de Belastingdienst nog steeds zelfstandig ondernemers zijn

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether the Tax Authority's view that medical specialists remain self-employed contradicts government policy on integrated care funding and whether the costs of cooperative models were unnecessary. The minister answered that the government's position is unchanged, that self-employment depends on facts and circumstances, and that the transition subsidy aims to make employment a real option.
The cabinet has not changed its position on the self-employment of medical specialists.
Het kabinet heeft zijn standpunt ten aanzien van het ondernemerschap van medisch specialisten niet gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Omtzigt over de positie van christenen in Syrië

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the kidnapping of a Syrian-Christian cleric near Homs, the decline of Christian populations in Syria and Iraq under ISIS, Dutch contacts with the anti-ISIS coalition on Christian protection, and whether the international community will act. The minister confirmed the kidnapping, gave rough population estimates, said the Netherlands raises the issue through all channels and within the coalition, and described pluralism-oriented political work without committing to a new concrete step.
Precise figures for the current number of Christians in Syria and Iraq are not available.
Precieze cijfers van het huidige aantal christenen in Syrië en Irak zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aankondiging van de stresstest voor pensioenfondsen door EIOPA op 11 mei jongstleden

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary about the EIOPA pension fund stress test, its legal basis, its consistency with the IORP-II revision, DNB's role, the consequences of non-participation, and whether it adds regulation. Klijnsma answered that EIOPA has a mandate under its founding regulation, that participation is voluntary, that results will be published only in aggregate by country, and that the government remains critical and will coordinate with like-minded member states.
It is up to EIOPA to decide when a stress test will be carried out.
Het is aan EIOPA om te bepalen wanneer er een stresstest uitgevoerd zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over het dreigende gat in de begroting door de snel stijgende verkoop van o.a. de Volvo XC90

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked the State Secretary of Finance about the fiscal risk from rising sales of plug-in hybrids such as the Volvo XC90 T8, the low company-car tax base, the Algemene Rekenkamer's recommendations on tax incentives for efficient cars, and whether the bijtelling increase should be accelerated. The State Secretary answered most questions with figures on lost tax revenue and referred the test-method and actual-consumption questions to other sources, but declined to accelerate the measure, citing lack of support and practical objections, and deferred the rest to the Autobrief 2.0.
In autumn 2014 I informed the House of the need to include additional measures for 2016 in the car taxes.
Ik heb in het najaar van 2014 de Kamer geïnformeerd over de noodzaak om aanvullende maatregelen voor het jaar 2016 voor de autobelastingen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma, Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de nadelige gevolgen voor kloosterlingen, indien de kostendelersnorm ook voor AOW wordt ingevoerd

MPs Heerma, Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked whether the household-sharing norm for the AOW pension would harm monastic residents and when the study on its effects on informal care would be ready. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, noted the exemption for commercial arrangements, said implementation was postponed to 1 July 2016 and promised the decision-making would be sent to Parliament before summer 2015.
My aim is to send the decision-making on the household-sharing norm in the AOW, in relation to effects on informal care, to both Chambers of the States General before summer 2015.
Mijn inzet is om de besluitvorming over de kostendelersnorm in de AOW in relatie tot de effecten op mantelzorg voor de zomer van 2015 naar beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de bouw van een moskee in Gouda

MPs Oskam, Omtzigt and Knops (CDA) asked ministers how the sale of the PWA barracks in Gouda to a large mosque project was handled, including the origin of its funding, the Bibob review, and whether the state would follow the process. The ministers answered that the matter is a local responsibility, that a new local process is under way, and that financing was checked by a forensic accountant and Bibob advice, but that the results are not publicly disclosed and no independent state investigation will be launched.
No, this concerns a local matter.
Nee, dit betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pieter Heerma over de (tussen)uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep, waarin zij oordeelt dat een afgekocht pensioen niet in mindering gebracht wordt op de partnertoeslag AOW

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked the State Secretary about a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that a lump-sum pension buyout should not be fully offset against the AOW partner allowance, and about the SVB's notice and the costs of appeal. The State Secretary answered that the ruling leaves room for other ways of offsetting, that the Inkomensbesluit will be amended so buyout amounts are fully exempt from 1 December 2014, and that retroactive relief for final decisions is not granted because of legal certainty.
Requests to reconsider our decision will be rejected because you did not lodge an objection or appeal.
Verzoeken om alsnog terug te komen op onze beslissing wijzen wij af, omdat u niet in bezwaar of (hoger) beroep bent gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over Actieplan EU over mensenrechten

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked why freedom of religion or belief is absent from the EU Action Plan on Human Rights and Democracy, and how the Dutch parliament will be able to weigh in. The minister replied that Dutch efforts had pushed for concrete religious-freedom actions, that the plan refers to existing EU guidelines, and that parliament will receive an assessment fiche and can comment at a committee meeting before adoption.
This fiche will be shared with the House of Representatives in early June.
Dit fiche wordt begin juni met de Tweede Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt over de situatie in Burundi en de inzet van Nederland om escalatie (zoals massamoord en mogelijke genocide) te voorkomen

CDA MPs asked the ministers about the Burundi crisis over President Nkurunziza's third term, the court ruling, possible genocide risk, Dutch diplomatic and aid responses, and sanctions. The government answer refers the MPs to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163) answering these questions rather than answering them in this document.

The written questions from MPs Agnes Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt (all CDA), question number 2015Z08595, have been answered by the letter 'Response to committee request on the situation in Burundi and answer to questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes, Sjoerdsma and Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt' (Parliamentary paper 29 237, no. 163).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt (allen CDA), vraagnummer 2015Z08595 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op commissieverzoek inzake situatie in Burundi en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes, Sjoerdsma en Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt» (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163 ).

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het verzoek van de Nederlandse regering aan de Europese Commissie om alle documenten en briefwisselingen tussen Nederland en de Europese Commissie over de naheffing van 642 mil

An MP asks why the government asked the European Commission to keep correspondence about the 642 million euro levy secret, and demands the letter and emails be released. The government refuses to provide the Commission correspondence, citing diplomatic confidentiality and Wob exceptions, and says Article 68 of the Constitution rather than the Wob governs its duty to parliament.
Providing the correspondence with the European Commission itself is, in line with the cited cabinet position, considered undesirable.
Verstrekking van correspondentie met de Europese Commissie zelf achten wij, in lijn met genoemd kabinetsstandpunt, onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt over het artikel “Werkgevers klagen over ‘straf’ op sociaal plan

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked whether the RVU levy on voluntary early-retirement severance payments discourages employers from using voluntary schemes and pushes toward forced dismissals, and whether the rules should be relaxed. The state secretary answered that the levy applies only outside objective criteria, that a 10% efficiency margin applies to voluntary schemes, and that the government will not relax the levy because it has raised average retirement age, though it denied that the Tax Authority tightened its advance-ruling practice.
Within the package of labour market measures, the cabinet does not consider it desirable to relax the RVU levy.
Het kabinet vindt het binnen het pallet van arbeidsmarktmaatregelen niet wenselijk de RVU-heffing te versoepelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt (over het wetsvoorstel „Hervorming Kindregelingen” waarin het woord alimentatie in de memorie van toelichting slechts een keer voorkwam en wel in de artikelsgewijz

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked the government about the Hervorming Kindregelingen bill, its limited treatment of child maintenance (alimentatie), the promised standard calculation rule and advice from the judiciary, and the effects on divorced parents' incomes. The minister replied that the Raad voor de rechtspraak advice is attached, that existing alimentatienormen serve as the basis, that parents can seek advice from the Juridisch Loket, mediators or lawyers, and that a further analysis of the bill's consequences was being prepared, without providing a new calculation tool.
I asked the Council for the Judiciary to advise on the House's request to develop a standard calculation rule for child maintenance.
Ik heb de Raad voor de rechtspraak gevraagd advies uit te brengen over het verzoek van de Tweede Kamer om te komen tot een standaardrekenregel inzake de berekening van kinderalimentatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over de vervolgings- en berechtingsstrategie van verdachten van het neerhalen van vlucht MH17 op 17 juli 2014

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the prosecution and trial strategy for suspects in the downing of MH17, including promised notes, possible trials in absentia, extradition, and amnesty under Minsk-2. The government said no prosecution strategy can be disclosed yet to protect the criminal investigation, but it reaffirmed that prosecution is the goal and promised to inform parliament once the investigation allows.
Releasing prosecution strategies prematurely is not in the interest of the investigation.
Het voortijdig naar buiten brengen van vervolgingsstrategieën is niet in het belang van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over de onderzoeken naar de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked about the authenticity and sharing of a leaked July 2014 Kiev briefing memo, ICAO and airspace warnings over Crimea, information sharing with airlines, Dutch–Ukrainian and Minsk arrangements for the crash site, and the state secrecy of MCCb MH17 minutes. The government largely refused to release the briefing memo and MCCb minutes on confidentiality grounds, while describing remedial steps such as the ICAO website pilot and planned consultations with airlines.
For the same reason, the cabinet will also not share the document with which the essence of the briefing was shared with other departments.
Om diezelfde reden zal het kabinet ook het document waarmee de essentie van de briefing is gedeeld met andere departementen niet delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de gevolgen van in Nederland begane verkeersovertredingen met auto’s met een buitenlands kenteken

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about enforcement of traffic fines against foreign-plated vehicles, including data exchange under the Cross Border Enforcement directive, collection rates, and a 2013 Wob request by RTL. The minister answered that the new directive was adopted in March 2015, that enforcement of French plates began in December 2014 and Polish plates was still being prepared, that collection rates are partial, and that the RTL request was partly granted after court proceedings, with some information unavailable.
RTL did not receive data overviews because there were no overviews or other documents within my ministry containing such data.
RTL heeft geen data-overzichten ontvangen, omdat er zich geen overzichten of andere documenten binnen mijn ministerie bevonden waarin dergelijke data zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Knops over de komst van een megamoskee in Gouda

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government's position on the Gouda mega-mosque had changed after the Prime Minister's remarks on financing doubts, whether the municipality had withdrawn the original plan, and whether the sale of the former PWA barracks should be suspended. The Minister replied that the government takes no position on this local matter, described the PwC financial investigation and pending Bibob advice, noted the mosque board's offer of a smaller building, and refused to suspend the sale, stating that Muslims in Gouda have the right to build a mosque provided they obey the law.
In line with the constitutional structure of the Netherlands, the cabinet has taken no position on this local matter.
Het kabinet heeft conform de staatkundige inrichting van Nederland geen standpunt ingenomen over deze lokale kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het arrest van de Hoge Raad dat de Staatsloterij kopers van staatsloten in de periode 2000-2008 zou hebben misleid

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the government about a Supreme Court ruling that the State Lottery misled ticket buyers in 2000-2008, including revenue figures, possible misleading draw practices, the Kansspelautoriteit investigation, and liability. The government answered that the KSA found no reason to suspend draws, recommended measures the lottery will implement by Q2 2015, and that no assessment of damages can yet be made.
The KSA expects that the State Lottery will have implemented the final measures to carry out the recommendations by the end of the second quarter of 2015 at the latest.
De KSA verwacht dat de Staatsloterij uiterlijk aan het einde van het tweede kwartaal 2015 de laatste maatregelen ter uitvoering van de aanbevelingen heeft ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Armeense genocide

Omtzigt asked the foreign minister whether the Armenian genocide is recognised by scholars, whether ministry officials had cited only one professor disputing it, and why the government does not use the term 'genocide'. Minister Koenders replied that scholarly consensus is broad but that legal qualification is not for the cabinet, and that a cabinet judgement would not help reconciliation.
Whether there was legally speaking a genocide is not for the cabinet to determine.
De vaststelling of hier in juridische zin sprake is geweest van genocide, is evenwel niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt over kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked whether a working father whose wife is in a nursing home in a coma can receive childcare allowance for his three children, and whether divorce or municipal social-medical support could solve this. The minister confirmed no entitlement under current rules, pointed to municipal social-medical indication (SMI) support and contact already made with the municipality, and rejected amending the childcare act.
I understand that first contact between Mr K. and his municipality to find a solution has now been made.
Ik heb begrepen dat het eerste contact tussen de heer K. en zijn woongemeente om tot een oplossing te komen inmiddels is gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het Aeronautical Fixed Telecommunication Network (AFTN) van 3 maart 2015

An MP asked which Dutch parties connect to the AFTN network, whether ICAO and Dutch bodies received special alert messages about eastern Ukraine before the MH17 crash, and about the OVV investigation into route choice. The government answered that ICAO does not send messages over AFTN, that no such special alerts were known to the Dutch government, and that the OVV independently decides what it investigates.
The OVV is independent and itself determines which incidents it investigates.
De OVV is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelf welke voorvallen hij onderzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over het bericht over valse inschrijvingen in de Basisregistratie Personen

MPs Van Toorenburg and Omtzigt asked whether false registrations in the Basisregistratie Personen were used to obtain a citizen service number or Dutch driving licences, how many cases and municipalities were involved, and what measures would block this. Minister Plasterk answered that six municipalities suspect about 125 improper registrations, that no benefits were claimed in those cases, and that municipalities will now run address checks when foreign licences are exchanged for Dutch ones.

I will ask all municipalities to always carry out an address investigation if someone applies, within four weeks of registration in the BRP, to exchange a still-valid foreign driving licence for a Dutch one.

In aanvulling hierop zal ik alle gemeenten vragen om altijd alsnog een adresonderzoek in te stellen als iemand binnen vier weken na inschrijving in de BRP een aanvraag doet voor de omwisseling van een nog geldig buitenlands rijbewijs naar een Nederlands rijbewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over KLM en Air France

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether contracts and agreements between the state and Air France KLM and KLM since the merger should be sent to parliament, and whether a January 2015 press release showed that KLM's cash management had been centralised under the Air France KLM holding. The state secretary replied that no new agreements or contracts had been concluded since 2004 beyond a 2010 memorandum on state guarantees, and that the holding's president had confirmed KLM keeps autonomous financial management in Amstelveen.

Since the merger in 2004, no new agreements have been recorded or contracts concluded, apart from the memorandum of understanding of 25 May 2010 on extending part of the state guarantees, which was sent with the letter of 3 March.

Sinds de fusie in 2004 zijn er geen nieuwe afspraken vastgelegd of contracten gesloten, naast het met de genoemde brief van 3 maart jl. meegestuurde memorandum of understanding van 25 mei 2010 inzake verlenging van een deel van de staatsgaranties.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA) en Segers (ChristenUnie) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Megabenefiet-gala «Het is nu of nooit» in Utrecht (ingezonden 20 februari 2015).

MPs Omtzigt and Segers asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers whether they knew of a March 2015 Utrecht gala with a cleric who had endorsed jihad in Syria, and about visa screening for attendees. The ministers answered that the cleric was not known to have attended, that the cleric's 2013 message reflected a broader Sunni position on a legitimate jihad in Syria, and that no visas were known to have been requested for the gala.
No visa has been requested at the Kingdom's representations abroad in the name of the preacher (Sheikh) Assim Al-Hakeem named in the announcements.
Bij de vertegenwoordigingen van het Koninkrijk in het buitenland is geen visum aangevraagd op naam van de in de aankondigingen genoemde prediker (Sheikh) Assim Al-Hakeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de verkeersveiligheid op de N36

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about road safety on the N36 after a site visit and about the timing of planned improvement measures. The minister said some measures will be realised in 2015-2016 by folding them into existing contracts, while the rest will follow in 2017-2018 with no possibility of acceleration, and offered to discuss a grade-separated junction with the region if it takes the initiative and funds it.
Acceleration of these schedules is not among the possibilities.
Versnelling van deze planningen behoort niet tot de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “Schimmigheid krijgt trekjes van patroon”

Omtzigt asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands objected to disclosure of its correspondence with the European Commission about a surcharge, and what it had told the Commission. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the Netherlands invoked privacy and internal policy-opinion exceptions under the Wob and EU access rules, that the Commission accepted these grounds, and declined to commit to writing a letter urging disclosure.
The Netherlands informed the European Commission which information it would make public in the context of the Wob request.
Nederland heeft de Europese Commissie gemeld welke informatie Nederland in het kader van het Wob-verzoek openbaar zou maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam over het intrekken van de visa van predikers

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked why the NCTV letter on withdrawing visas for preachers bears a 23 February creation date and a 3 March date, and about its reference number, timing, inter-communication, Schengen coordination and a database of banned preachers. The government explained the letter was written and sent on 17 February, copied on 23 February with only the official's name removed, that the reference number reflects creation date, that other Schengen states can be asked to revoke visas, and that a usable alert list will be delivered by 1 April.
The NCTV letter to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs was written, signed and sent on 17 February.
De brief van de NCTV aan het Ministerie van BZ is op 17 februari geschreven, ondertekend en verstuurd naar het Ministerie van BZ.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de ingangsdatum van de subsidieregeling energiebelasting voor sportverenigingen

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked why the energy-tax refund for sports clubs is being abolished, whether clubs face higher costs in 2015 with no refund or subsidy available for that year, and how provinces and clubs are affected. The minister replied that the 2014 refund is still paid in 2015, the new energy-saving subsidy starts 1 January 2016 with no transitional compensation, and the change is designed to reward sustainability investment and is compatible with provincial schemes.
No compensation can be claimed for the calendar year 2015.
Over het kalenderjaar 2015 kan geen compensatie worden aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht “Geëiste premiedaling komt niet van de grond”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs and Employment and the Minister of Finance about reports that a promised fall in pension premiums was not materialising, and about the premium forecasts underlying the coalition agreement and the expected revenue from cutting pension accrual. The government answered that premiums fell between 2014 and 2015, that current CPB forecasts are below earlier projections, and that the expected revenue of 2.1 billion euro in 2017 is not at risk.

The CEP 2015 forecast shows that the realised premium development in 2014 and the expected development for 2015 and 2016 are so far more favourable than expected at the time of the pension agreements.
Uit de CEP-raming 2015 blijkt dat de gerealiseerde premieontwikkeling in 2014 en de verwachte ontwikkeling voor 2015 en 2016 vooralsnog gunstiger is dan verwacht ten tijde van de pensioenafspraken.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam (beiden CDA) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de Staatssecretaris van Financiën over een bijeenkomst in Rijswijk op 8 maart 2015

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked the ministers about a planned March 2015 event in Rijswijk featuring preachers linked to extremist views, including visa revocations, whether the organiser's ANBI status could be withdrawn, and the list of speakers. The government answered that visas for three speakers were revoked on public order grounds, that the event was scaled back, and that the tax authority could investigate ANBI status if signals warranted, but gave no commitment to a specific investigation.
Without going into individuals, it can be said that seven preachers had been invited to give lectures on 8 March.
Zonder in te gaan op individuen kan verteld worden dat zeven predikers waren uitgenodigd voor het geven van lezingen op 8 maart.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het reglement van het klachtenloket bij het Klachteninstituut Financiële Dienstverlening (KiFiD), dat zo is opgesteld dat veel gedupeerde ondernemers er nooit gebruik van zulle

Mr Omtzigt asks the Finance Minister whether the KiFiD interest-rate derivatives complaints rules, including exclusion of loan-margin complaints, the Dec 2016 deadline, the restrictive SME definition, and the appeal clause, unduly keep many injured entrepreneurs from the complaints desk. The Minister defends the rules as a low-threshold procedural arrangement, says the desk need not cover all loan-condition complaints, will press banks if the deadline proves too short, and describes the committee members' independence checks.
If that proves necessary, I will hold the banks to account on it.
Als dat nodig mocht blijken, zal ik de banken daarop aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het grote aantal ongevallen met dodelijke afloop op de rijksweg N36 tussen Almelo en Ommen

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the minister for an overview of fatal and serious accidents on the N36 between Almelo and Ommen, its casualty rates against comparable national roads, and the timing of promised safety measures. The minister supplied accident counts, fatality figures, a risk comparison showing the N36 slightly above average, and said the measures will be built between 2015 and 2018 with a further safety decision pending.
The number of seriously injured in this period is not yet known.
Het aantal zwaargewonden in deze periode is nog niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Gesthuizen en Schouw over de tot nu toe verstrekte informatie over de omvang en aard van (legale) identiteitswisselingen en mogelijke fraude met reisdocumenten

Three MPs (Omtzigt, Gesthuizen, Schouw) asked the Dutch State Secretary and Minister about the scope and nature of legal identity changes and possible passport/identity fraud, including why Parliament was not informed earlier of NVIK/police signals from 2011 and 2013 and of the April 2014 meetings. The government answered that the signals were operational, not quantified, that duplicate registrations were largely legal name changes or data-entry errors, and that several measures and studies are underway.
It is not customary to inform the Chamber while an investigation is ongoing.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om lopende een onderzoek de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de vestiging van een mega-moskee in Gouda

CDA MPs asked the government about the financing of a planned large mosque in Gouda, its links to salafist fundraising, and the sale of the former Prins Willem Alexander barracks with a nuclear bunker. The minister answered that the sale and onward sale are a local matter, that PWC found no obstacles and a Bibob advice is pending, that the bunker will be demolished, and that national security is not a criterion for such sales.
The proposed decision on the onward sale to El Wahda may be changed by the mayor and aldermen after receipt of the Landelijk Bureau Bibob advice.
Het voorgenomen besluit over de doorverkoop aan El Wahda kan door het college van burgemeester en wethouders eventueel worden gewijzigd na ontvangst van het advies van het Landelijk Bureau Bibob.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse informatiepositie in aanloop naar de MH-17 ramp

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the ministers of Security and Justice, Foreign Affairs and Defence about the Dutch government's information position before the MH-17 downing, including what was known about downed aircraft, Ukrainian airspace warnings, the July 2014 Ukraine briefing and the role of the OVV and CTIVD. The government answered most questions by pointing to the ongoing OVV and prosecution investigations, stating it had no validated list of downed aircraft and that Ukraine gave no warnings beyond NOTAMs, while committing to share the briefing report and correspondence with the OVV.
We consider it of the utmost importance that the Public Prosecution Service can continue its investigation unhindered.
Wij achten het van het grootste belang dat het OM het onderzoek ongehinderd kan blijven verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Bontes, De Roon, Thieme en Van Ojik over de tussenrapportages van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) onderzoeken

MPs asked whether the Safety Board (OVV) runs three MH17 investigations, whether interim reports were published, and under which ICAO Annex 13 reporting obligations. The minister confirmed three investigations, that only the cause investigation has a published preliminary report, and that the other two have no interim reports.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de zaak Spijkers

An MP asks ministers about the Spijkers settlement, including whether medical records were ordered destroyed without the claimant's explicit consent, who may access the archived file, and whether it was improperly kept secret. The government denies any destruction decision was taken, states the digital record was deleted by the former occupational health provider with a destruction statement, says the file was transferred to the National Archives under access rules, and refuses to open the full file to the Chamber or researchers on the grounds set out in earlier letters.
Otherwise a check of what was transferred would not have been possible.
Een controle van hetgeen werd overgedragen was anders niet mogelijk geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de invoering van het minimumloon en de eerstedagmelding in Duitsland en de gigantische administratieve lasten die dat oplevert voor Nederlandse werkgevers

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about Germany's minimum wage law and its first-day notification requirement, which he said burdens Dutch employers and workers with heavy administrative obligations, including German-language documents, high fines, and questions about EU law compliance. The State Secretary answered that the obligations exist, that the German customs authority is the competent body, that the Netherlands considers the administrative burden a restriction on free movement of services but leaves final judgement to the EU Court of Justice, and that no exemption or EU-level challenge is planned for now.
The answer to the question of whether there is an unjustified trade barrier is ultimately for the European Court of Justice.
Het antwoord op de vraag of sprake is van een ongerechtvaardigde handelsbelemmering is uiteindelijk aan het Europese Hof van Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de kaspositie van KLM

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether KLM's roughly 1 billion euro cash position will stay under KLM's own management, whether KLM keeps control of its financial management, and whether the SAK foundations and MoU remain in force. State Secretary Mansveld answered that Air France KLM reported no plans to transfer KLM's surplus cash to the holding, that KLM will retain autonomy over its cash, banking and hedging, and that the foundations and MoU are maintained, though no final decision on financial management had yet been taken.

This means that KLM as an independent airline can continue to invest (such as in fleet financing) and remains responsible for its own cash flows, bank relations, management of its financial cash position and execution of its own hedging.

Dit betekent namelijk dat KLM als zelfstandige luchtvaartmaatschappij kan blijven investeren (zoals ten aanzien van vlootfinanciering) en verantwoordelijk blijft voor haar eigen kasstromen, bankrelaties, beheer van de financiële kaspositie en uitvoering van haar eigen «hedging».

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Geurts, Van Meenen en Schouten over de uitspraak van het Hof Arnhem-Leeuwarden, die de Belastingdienst in het ongelijk stelde en bepaalde dat deelkwalificaties wel in aanmerking k

MPs Omtzigt, Geurts, Van Meenen and Schouten asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education about a Court of Appeal ruling that part-qualifications qualify for the education wage-tax reduction, including whether the Tax Service's corrections will be suspended, how firms are compensated, and whether bankruptcies or dropouts resulted. The government answered that it will file a cassation appeal before 29 January 2015, that corrections can be held pending the Supreme Court ruling on objection request, that refunds follow any Supreme Court outcome, and that it has no data on affected firms, students or bankruptcies.
I intend to file a cassation appeal against this ruling.
Ik ben voornemens om tegen deze uitspraak in cassatie te gaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de plannen om het financiële beheer van KLM van Nederland naar Frankrijk over te hevelen en daarmee KLM een groot deel van haar resterende autonomie te laten ve

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether Air France KLM plans to move KLM's financial management to Paris, whether the Memorandum of Understanding and other agreements are respected, and related questions on the state's shareholding and KLM's profits. The State Secretary answered that concrete plans are not yet known, that the state's influence as shareholder is limited, that the 2010 MoU safeguards KLM's Dutch base and hub network, and offered confidential inspection of the MoU.
I am willing to make this Memorandum of Understanding and the agreements with the State available for confidential inspection.
Ik ben bereid om dit Memorandum of Understanding en de afspraken met de Staat vertrouwelijk ter inzage te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Schouten, Siderius en Yücel over de medewerking van het kabinet aan het plan om de werkloosheid in Twente aan te pakken

MPs Omtzigt, Schouten, Siderius and Yücel asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether the cabinet will cooperate with the Twente 'Twente Werkt' action plan against high unemployment, and referred to earlier motions on regional economic renewal and border regions. Minister Kamp replied that the ministries already participate in the plan, pointed to earlier letters, acknowledged a skills mismatch in Twente and said no substantial changes to government jobs in the region are foreseen, while leaving the specific contribution per action line to a later letter.
The ministries of Social Affairs and Employment and Economic Affairs are already actively participating in the 'Twente Werkt!' action plan.
De ministeries van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en Economische Zaken werken al actief mee aan het Actieplan «Twente Werkt!.»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de vestiging van een moskee/islamitisch centrum in Gouda

MPs Oskam, Omtzigt and Knops asked ministers about a planned mega-mosque and Islamic centre in former Gouda barracks, including sale arrangements, financing from abroad, links of preachers to jihadism and counter-radicalisation measures. The government answered most questions, declining to comment on individual cases and noting that the municipality is responsible for land use and the financing investigation is ongoing.
I do not make public statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik in het openbaar geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Omtzigt over fraude door middel van legale naamwisselingen

MPs Gesthuizen and Omtzigt asked the ministers how the government responded to RTL reports on fraud through legal name changes, which signals from abroad and the police it received, whether the Matching Autoriteit was consulted, and whether databases should be cross-matched. The government answered that no overview of signals is kept, that operational services act on signals as needed, that no separate report was required on the police signal, and that after investigation no evidence of fraud through double registration was found, so no further cross-matching is planned.
No overview is kept of all signals exchanged in the course of regular operational work.
Er wordt geen overzicht bijgehouden van alle signalen die in het kader van de reguliere taakuitvoering worden uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Europese naheffing die op 30 december 2014 betaald gaat worden

An MP asked the Finance Minister why the Netherlands was surprised by the EU levy, why internal emails and the 17 October 2014 negotiation note (stuk 75) were withheld under the Wob, and when the Parliament was told about the 30 December payment date. The minister answered that the surprise concerned the size of the levy, that stuk 75 was withheld to protect confidentiality of negotiations and Dutch relations with other states, and that Parliament was informed of the payment date via the Najaarsnota and a supplementary budget.

I previously set out to your House, by letter of 13 November 2014, the reasons underlying the decision not to make public the report of the Permanent Representation in Brussels of 17 October 2014, document 75.

Ik heb eerder, per brief van 13 november 2014, aan uw Kamer de redenen uiteengezet die ten grondslag liggen aan het besluit het verslag van de Permanente Vertegenwoordiging in Brussel van 17 oktober 2014, stuk75, niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over onderhandelingen met rebellen inzake MH17

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch forensic team's project leader negotiated with separatist leader Borodai over MH17 victims' repatriation, whether this contradicted the cabinet's no-direct-negotiation principle, and whether there were other such talks. The government answered that contact was via the OSCE with the embassy informed, that there was no direct negotiation, and that all contact went through the OSCE.
No. There was no question of direct negotiations with the separatists.
Nee. Er was geen sprake van rechtstreekse onderhandelingen met de separatisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het aantal neergeschoten helikopters en vliegtuigen boven Oost-Oekraïne voorafgaand aan de ramp van 17 juli 2014

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the government how many aircraft and helicopters were shot down over eastern Ukraine before the MH17 disaster, what the cabinet knew on 17 July 2014, and related questions about Dutch monitoring, a 14 July briefing, and prosecution timing. The government answered that the numbers were unverified and no validated list could be provided, that no specific airspace consultations took place, and that prosecution options cannot yet be disclosed because the criminal investigation is ongoing.
Both the number and the causes are unclear and not validated.
Zowel het aantal als ook de oorzaken zijn onduidelijk en niet gevalideerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Segers, Dijkgraaf en Thieme over het wachtgeld voor de voorzitter van de Europese Raad

Five MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the EU transitional allowance (wachtgeld) for the outgoing President of the European Council, who had already reached pensionable age and could draw his Belgian pension alongside it, and about pension accrual rates and job-seeking obligations. The minister confirmed the facts, said the EU rules (Regulation 422/67/EEG) cap the allowance at three years with no job-seeking duty, and said the Netherlands is willing to examine modernising and reducing the scheme, though any change requires Council action.
The Netherlands is willing to examine whether modernising and reducing the current scheme for political office holders in the EU is possible
Nederland is bereid te bekijken of modernisering en versobering van de huidige regeling voor politieke ambtsdragers in de EU mogelijk is

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Verheijen over de massale arrestatie van journalisten, de afkeurende reactie van de Europese Commissie en de mogelijke gevolgen voor de steun vanuit de EU aan Turkije

MPs Omtzigt and Verheijen asked the Foreign Minister about the mass arrest of Turkish journalists, the Commission's condemnation, and whether EU pre-accession aid to Turkey should be frozen or cut. The minister agreed the arrests are incompatible with EU values, noted the IPA performance reward mechanism, and said Netherlands pushed for consequences for aid at the General Affairs Council, though no broader support existed and it is for the Commission to propose measures.

At the Council, the Netherlands also pointed to the performance reward anchored in the new IPA regulation and argued that current developments should have consequences for financial support to Turkey.

Nederland heeft tijdens de Raad eveneens gewezen op de prestatiebeloning die in de nieuwe IPA-verordering verankerd zit en ervoor gepleit dat de huidige ontwikkelingen consequenties zouden moeten hebben voor de financiële steun aan Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het onderzoek naar de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked about the composition of the Joint Investigation Team on MH17, Malaysia's role, Ukraine's veto and non-disclosure arrangements, and who is examining the flight route decisions. The government answered that Malaysia is already formally involved and will join as a member, that the JIT agreement is confidential because it contains operational arrangements for an ongoing criminal investigation, and that the Dutch Safety Board is examining route decisions without addressing liability.
We therefore cannot make the agreement regarding the JIT public.
De overeenkomst met betrekking tot het JIT kunnen wij daarom niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over “de goudclaim van Nederland op Zwitserland en het bericht dat DNB Nederlands goud uit het buitenland naar Nederland heeft gehaald”

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Swiss gold referendum and expert advice (Kalshoven) change the government's position on the Dutch wartime gold claim against Switzerland. The minister answered that the claim lacks legal grounds, that the Van Kemenade commission conclusions are adopted, and that no new legal opinion will be sought unless new stolen gold surfaces.
I see no reason to reconsider my position on the gold claim.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om mijn standpunt over de goudclaim te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over getuigenissen van belastingambtenaren in rechtbanken

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority's handling of testimony by tax officials in court, including the Brutra bankruptcy case, the non-appeal against disclosure of a tipster's name, and witness preparation. The State Secretary answers that tax officials may invoke confidentiality in court, that no specific guidance exists on preparing witnesses, and that the Tax Authority applies risk-based control regardless of lawsuits.
There are almost continuous legal proceedings between the Tax Authority and taxpayers, and it is customary that I do not inform the House case by case.
Er lopen vrijwel continu gerechtelijke procedures tussen de Belastingdienst en belastingplichtigen waarbij het de gewoonte is dat ik de Kamer niet per geval informeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Omtzigt en De Rouwe over het bericht ‘Overheid sluit deal voor behoud pinautomaten’

CDA MPs asked whether the government's intention agreement with SNS RegioBank on cash-machine provision in rural areas, and its relation to a Finance Ministry pilot on avoiding ATM 'white spots', was lawful and coordinated. The minister answered that the agreement concerns local liveability rather than ATM retention, that the ACM saw no reason for a competition assessment, and that the pilot's competition-law compatibility is still under discussion with the ACM.
For an assessment under the Competition Act by the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) there is therefore no reason.
Voor een beoordeling op grond van de Mededingingswet door de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) bestaat dan ook geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Van Bommel en Ten Broeke over de positie van Pakistaanse minderheden

Five MPs asked the government about the position of religious minorities in Pakistan, including reported lynchings of Christians, a judge's apparent embrace of a blasphemy-case killer, and whether Pakistani Christians should be treated as an asylum risk group. The minister acknowledges rising violence against minorities, notes Dutch and EU pressure on Pakistan over blasphemy laws and minority protection, and says the State Secretary will review the new country report for possible changes to asylum policy.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice will examine whether the information in the thematic country report gives cause for changes to the current asylum policy for Pakistani Christians.
De Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie zal bezien of de informatie in het thematisch ambtsbericht aanleiding geeft tot aanpassingen in het huidige asielbeleid voor Pakistaanse christenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het transport via coax- en glasvezelkabel door Caiway

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked whether Caiway, taking over the Twente cable network from Ziggo from 1 January 2015, would control both transport and services and thereby block competition, and raised questions on ADSL reach, pricing, alarm services, email retention and the EU push for cable opening. The minister answered that Cogas, as network owner, is not obliged to admit other providers but has opened its network, that competition is expected on the new fibre network, that Caiway prices were aligned with Ziggo's with some service differences, and that the ACM sees no reason for investigation.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de pensioenmaximering op € 100.000 en de verlaging van de opbouw, die bij heel veel werkgevers niet tijdig wordt doorgevoerd en de fiscale gevolgen die dat kan hebben

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Social Affairs about the EUR 100,000 pension accrual cap, the risk that employers fail to adapt schemes in time, and the tax and legal consequences including dual or part-time employment cases. The State Secretary answered each question, explaining the glijclausule option, the per-employment application of the cap, the limited legal risk for employers, and that no treaty changes are needed.
As far as can be seen, the risk of a claim is therefore very small.
Naar het zich laat aanzien is het risico op een claim daarom zeer gering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie tegen de plaatsing van het Armeens herdenkingsmonument

MPs asked the government about a demonstration against an Armenian genocide memorial in Almelo, alleged Turkish state involvement, verification of claims, and whether the government will take a clearer stance on the commemoration. The government answered that there was no direct Turkish state involvement in the demonstration, that it has raised the matter with Turkish authorities, that it does not keep lists of all contacts, and that it sees no need for special research, while declining to say when the prosecutor will decide on the complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed the Ministry of Security and Justice that it cannot currently give certainty about when the assessment of the complaint will be completed.
Het openbaar ministerie heeft het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie meegedeeld dat het nu geen uitsluitsel kan geven over het moment waarop de beoordeling van de aangifte zal zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het snel willen instemmen met de nieuwe richtlijn voor pensioenen in de EU zonder de Kamer daarover tijdig en adequaat te informeren

Omtzigt (CDA) asked why the government sent a 79-page compromis on the EU IORP pensions directive only days before the Coreper vote, without prior briefing as promised, and asked it to postpone agreement until January 2015. The Staatssecretaris replied that the government kept its promised information, sent a progress letter in October and an appreciation on 4 December, and that a deal needed to be reached before the Italian presidency ended, so postponement was not desirable.
We attach great importance to these agreements and are of the view that we have informed the House of Representatives as well as possible.
Wij hechten zeer aan deze afspraken en zijn van mening dat we de Tweede Kamer zo goed mogelijk geïnformeerd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over MH17 (opnieuw en nu met nagezonden bijlagen)

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers about evidence on the MH17 downing, access to satellite and radar data, OSCE safety assessments, NOTAMs, shelling of the crash site, and Ukrainian search logs. The government answered that it cannot pre-empt the independent OVV and criminal investigations, declined to detail information requests for investigative reasons, and gave brief factual replies on the NOTAMs, OSCE contacts and search documents.
The Cabinet cannot anticipate the conclusions of these independent, international investigations by making statements about indications and the manner of verification.
Het Kabinet kan niet vooruitlopen op de conclusies uit deze onafhankelijke, internationale onderzoeken door uitspraken te doen over aanwijzingen en de wijze van verificatie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt die mij gesteld zijn inzake het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer “Op weg naar correcte gegevens over het bruto nationaal inkomen (BNI): een meer gestructureerde en gerichte aanpak

An MP asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about European Court of Auditors criticism of EU GNI statistics that underpinned a 642 million euro extra payment by the Netherlands. The Finance Minister answered that the recommendations target the Commission and Eurostat, that the GNI committee found the data suitable for own resources, and that Eurostat's verification cycle is still pending, so the Netherlands must pay while other countries' revisions are being reviewed.
Based on the publicly released figures and Eurostat regulations, the Netherlands is obliged to pay the supplementary levy.
Op basis van de openbaar gemaakte cijfers en Eurostat regelgeving is Nederland gehouden de naheffing te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt over conflicten over kinderalimentatie als gevolg van de Wet hervorming kindregelingen

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked whether the abolition of the child-maintenance tax deduction (LOK) from 2015 would cause disputes over alimony and what parents should do. The minister says the reform may affect existing alimony, points parents to advice channels and to courts, and notes the Raad voor de Rechtspraak will advise on a calculation rule early next year.
The request in the motion to develop a standard calculation rule for changing child maintenance amounts due to the child benefits reform has been placed with the Council for the Judiciary.

Het verzoek in de motie om te komen tot een standaardrekenregel voor wijziging van het kinderalimentatiebedrag als gevolg van de Wet hervorming kindregelingen is neergelegd bij de Raad voor de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Bontes over Satellietbeelden/MH17

Five MPs asked the government about reports that the Netherlands holds satellite images showing who is responsible for the MH17 downing, including whether intelligence from the US and Germany has been verified and what political conclusion the cabinet draws. The government answered that it does not comment publicly on verification of foreign intelligence and will not give a political verdict on the cause while the Dutch-led investigations are ongoing, to protect their independence.
The Cabinet cannot draw conclusions without undermining the independence of these official investigations.
Het Kabinet kan geen conclusies trekken zonder de onafhankelijkheid van deze officiële onderzoeken aan te tasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Thieme en Van Klaveren over Beschuldiging van Turkse wapenleveranties aan terroristische organisaties

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about allegations that Turkey supplied arms to jihadist groups including IS, and about reports of recruitment centres and a prisoner swap. The minister said the government could not confirm the allegations, relied on Turkey's denials and its IS listing, and declined to seek clarification from Turkey or back an independent international inquiry.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, as is the House, but, as indicated in earlier answers to parliamentary questions, cannot confirm them.
Het kabinet is net als de Kamer op de hoogte van deze berichten, maar kan, zoals ook in eerdere antwoorden op Kamervragen aangegeven, deze niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over misbruik van de innovatiebox

Omtzigt (CDA) asked whether the innovation box allows Dutch firms to move innovation abroad and still pay only about 5% tax, and whether this loophole would be closed. Staatssecretaris Wiebes replied that in practice no such constructions are known, that the box is not a loophole, but he will propose a clarifying amendment in the Fiscale verzamelwet 2015.

To remove the unclarity and possible undesirable consequences of applying the innovation box in the situation described, I will make a proposal to adjust the innovation box in the Fiscale verzamelwet 2015 bill.

Om de onduidelijkheid en eventuele onwenselijke gevolgen van de toepassing van de innovatiebox in de beschreven situatie weg te nemen, zal ik in het wetsvoorstel Fiscale verzamelwet 2015 een voorstel tot aanpassing van de innovatiebox doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de naheffing

An MP asked the Finance Minister and Prime Minister about the 2014 EU budget surcharge (naheffing), including when Eurostat reservations were known, who in government knew and when, and the correspondence with the European Commission. The minister answered almost every question by referring to earlier letters and debates, while answering question 9 and 10 only in general terms and pointing to Ecofin reports.
I informed you about this on 3 November in answering the parliamentary questions on the consequences of the macroeconomic revisions for the EU contributions.
Ik heb u hierover op 3 november geïnformeerd bij de beantwoording van de Kamervragen over de gevolgen van de macro-economische revisies voor de EU-afdrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Voordewind, De Roon, Servaes, Ten Broeke en Van Bommel over het doodvonnis van Asia Bibi

Six MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the Pakistani appeal court's upholding of Asia Bibi's death sentence, what remaining appeal options exist, and what Dutch and international steps can prevent execution. The minister said the government deeply regrets the ruling, outlined the appeal path to the Pakistani Supreme Court, and listed bilateral and EU advocacy, embassy actions and planned follow-up without committing to a specific new step.

The Netherlands will continue to raise the case of Ms Asia Bibi, the blasphemy legislation and the death penalty with the Pakistani authorities at every opportunity, both bilaterally and within the EU.

Nederland zal bij iedere voorkomende gelegenheid bij de Pakistaanse autoriteiten aandacht blijven vragen voor mevrouw Asia Bibi, de blasfemiewetgeving en de doodstraf, zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over het bericht dat WVA wordt teruggevorderd bij transportbedrijven

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked why the Belastingdienst is reclaiming the education wage-tax discount (AV Onderwijs) from transport firms, and how education quality and eligibility are checked. The minister answered that about 36 firms face recovery for €3.5 million, that the Belastingdienst verifies WVA conditions while the Inspectie judges education quality, and that recovery cannot be repaired retroactively.
At 36 companies the AV onderwijs has been reclaimed, for a total amount of about €3.5 million.
Bij 36 bedrijven heeft terugvordering van de AV onderwijs plaatsgevonden, voor een totaalbedrag van circa € 3,5 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Omtzigt over de naheffing bij 5 miljoen Nederlanders

An MP asks why the government did not disclose earlier the estimated 800 million euro reclaimed from 5 to 6 million taxpayers caused by the incomplete implementation of the tax credit phase-outs, and when ministers knew of the problem. The State Secretary gives indicative amounts, explains the systems constraints, and states the issue was communicated and known since 2013, while rejecting the term 'errors' and announcing communication steps.
From the moment this measure was decided, it was therefore clear that the phase-out in 2014 would lead to additional payments or lower refunds on the final assessment in 2015 for 2014.
Vanaf het moment dat tot deze maatregel werd besloten was dus duidelijk dat de afbouw in 2014 zou leiden tot bijbetalingen of lagere teruggaven bij de definitieve aanslag in 2015 over 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Omtzigt over ‘Gaza met onmiddellijke ingang onder controle van Hamas en Fatah’

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hamas and Fatah would jointly govern Gaza, and about whether Dutch or EU funds could reach Hamas through Palestinian Authority salaries and prisoner payments. The minister answered that there is no joint budget, that Qatari one-off payments are not salaries, that EU-funded civil servant lists are unchanged, and that the prisoner payment rules remain duration-based, with the Netherlands continuing to press for reform.
The money concerns Qatar, not the EU or the Netherlands.
Het betreft geld van Qatar, niet van de EU of NL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een nevenfunctie bij het comité van aanbeveling van het Gergiev Festival

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he sits on the honorary committee of the Gergiev Festival, why this was not on his ministerial CV, and how he views the conductor's support for Russia's annexation of Crimea and anti-gay laws. The minister admitted the membership was an oversight that he has since ended, said he has held no active side functions as minister, and stated that Gergiev's views contradict government positions.
When I took office as a member of the government, I ended my side functions and side activities.
Bij mijn aantreden als bewindspersoon heb ik mijn nevenfuncties en nevenactiviteiten beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Omtzigt inzake naheffingen bij scholengemeenschappen

MPs Rog and Omtzigt asked about Tax Authority back-tax assessments on school communities for lunch-supervision volunteer allowances, including whether they reach back five years and whether they fit the participation policy. The state secretary defended the volunteer exemption rules, said the Tax Authority can correct up to five years and may impose fines, and declined to intervene or ask for reduced penalties.
I cannot make further statements about individual cases in the context of these questions.
Over individuele gevallen kan ik in het kader van deze vragen geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de onderzoeken naar de aanslag op de MH17

An MP asked when a progress report on the MH17 investigations would be sent, whether Ukraine would be asked to make the investigation agreement with the Dutch Safety Board public, and about the status, signing, and secrecy of the joint investigation team (JIT) agreement, including whether it contains vetoes or prosecution provisions. The ministers answered that the Safety Board's final report is expected in July 2015, that the JIT agreement is binding and signed with government knowledge but will not be published because it contains operational working arrangements, and that it is limited to the investigation phase with no prosecution arrangements.
This agreement is not public, as it concerns a document containing operational working arrangements in an ongoing criminal investigation.
Deze overeenkomst is niet openbaar, aangezien het hier een document betreft met operationele werkafspraken in een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam,Omtzigt en Segers over de radicale prediker ‘Tarik ibn Ali’ uit België die naar Gouda

Three MPs asked the ministers whether a Belgian imam with radical messages, invited by a Gouda mosque board, would be barred and whether criminal action was underway. The minister answered that no hateful content is currently expected, the local authority has agreed no incitement will occur, criminal action would follow if it did, and no Belgian investigation is known.
At this moment we have no indications that this person is coming to the Netherlands to proclaim a hateful or inciting message.
Op dit moment hebben wij geen aanwijzingen dat deze persoon naar Nederland komt om een haatzaaiende of opruiende boodschap te verkondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de tax gap en de weigering van de regering om een aangenomen motie niet uit te voeren

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about the Dutch tax gap, the Belastingdienst's enforcement capacity, and why the government did not carry out an adopted motion to halve the tax gap. The State Secretary answers that the macro VAT gap study was published, business cases will not be disclosed for enforcement reasons, the motion was removed from the open-motions list and will be reinstated, and a tax gap study for direct taxes is not yet available.
For this reason it is the firm policy that business cases are not made public.
Om deze reden is vaste lijn dat businesscases niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de voortvluchtige vrouwenhandelaar Saban B.

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked whether fugitive trafficker Saban B. is seen in Facebook photos in Turkey, the status of the investigation, and whether Turkey agreed to enforce his sentence. The minister confirmed authorities know he is in Turkey, that Turkey has been formally asked to take over enforcement since 2013, and that talks continue, but gave no further details citing the interest of the case.
I cannot make further statements at this time in the interest of the case.
Ik kan in het belang van de zaak op dit moment geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de onthulling over steun Turkije aan Al Qaeda

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey supported Al Qaeda-linked groups in Syria, restricted coalition operations against IS, and tolerated IS recruitment and oil smuggling. The minister replied that the government has no indications Turkey supports jihadist groups, rejected the need for an independent international inquiry, and largely denied or deflected the allegations.
The cabinet cannot in general make statements about intelligence information.
Het kabinet kan in het algemeen geen mededelingen doen over inlichtingeninformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over Repatriëringsmissie MH17

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked about the MH17 repatriation mission, the joint investigation agreements with Ukraine, Belgium, Australia and Malaysia, and the scope of the local search operation in the crash area. The ministers largely answered by citing operational agreements, confidentiality requests from partner states and the separation of investigative responsibilities, while providing limited detail on search areas and maps.
The nature of such information is not suitable for disclosure.
De aard van dergelijke informatie leent zich niet voor openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kredietverlening aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about ECB lending support for SMEs, the causes of weak SME credit, and whether family loans could be encouraged through a revived Tante Agaathregeling tax scheme. The ministers say the ECB's TLTRO effects are hard to estimate, attribute low SME lending mainly to falling demand and weaker borrower positions, and point to SME financing measures while staying cautious about new tax measures.
The cabinet has therefore decided to support market parties in setting up a subordinated loan fund (AGL) fund
Het kabinet heeft daarom besloten marktpartijen te gaan ondersteunen bij het oprichten van een achtergestelde leningenfonds (AGL)-fonds
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de CBS cijfers van de verkoop van diesel en LPG

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why CBS figures show sharp falls in diesel and LPG sales after the excise increase, and whether the excise hike still yields the expected revenue. The State Secretary said he takes the CBS data as objective, gave revised revenue forecasts by fuel type, declined to reverse the increase, and deferred some answers to a separate cover letter.
I have taken note of the CBS figures on fuel sales.
Ik heb kennis genomen van de CBS-cijfers over de verkoop van brandstof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het uitbreiden van de pilot voor zzp’ers in de zorg

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked the State Secretaries about the pilot allowing self-employed care workers (zzp'ers) to obtain VAR-wuo statements, including how many were contacted, how many enrolled, and whether the pilot would continue. The State Secretary answered that about 650 contracts were concluded, that all care offices participated, and that the pilot's future depends on the long-term care reform and a short-term review of alternative business models.
However, no registration is kept of the reasons why self-employed persons decline participation in the pilot.
Er wordt echter geen registratie bijgehouden van de motieven waarom zzp'ers afzien van deelname aan de pilot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Keijzer over het btw-tarief voor dirigenten

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance to clarify the VAT rate applicable to conductors leading rehearsals, for both permanent and substitute conductors, and how the Tax Authority assesses whether rehearsals are necessary for performances. The State Secretary answered that rehearsals closely linked to and necessary for public performances fall under the reduced rate for performing artists regardless of whether the conductor is permanent or substitute, that the Tax Authority accepts the Haarlem court ruling and will include this in a new decision, and that conductors can demonstrate necessity with a written statement from the choir or orchestra.
This position will be included in a new decision on goods and services subject to the reduced VAT rate, to be published soon in the Staatscourant.
Dit standpunt zal worden opgenomen in een nieuw besluit over goederen en diensten waarvoor het verlaagde btw-tarief geldt dat binnenkort in de Staatscourant zal worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de juridische verplichtingen die voortvloeien uit het mogelijk plegen van genocide en andere misdrijven door de zogenoemde Islamitische staat

Omtzigt asked whether internal legal advice on possible genocide by ISIS in Iraq and Syria would be shared, and when external international-law advice was sought and what it asked. Minister Timmermans declined to release internal advice to protect policy formation, shared the external advice (received 3 September) with the House on 5 September, and explained that the ICJ Bosnia obligation to prevent genocide applies only to states able to influence the perpetrators, which the government considers not to apply to the Netherlands while still committing to prevention and aid.
The internal legal advice on this must remain confidential to allow unhindered internal policy formation.
De interne juridische adviezen hierover dienen vertrouwelijk te blijven voor een onbelemmerde interne beleidsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de mogelijke wijziging van het Sportbesluit

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about possible changes to the VAT sports exemption after the Bridport judgment, including effects on municipalities and sports clubs. The government answered that the Bridport ruling requires reviewing the exemption, that no decision or cost estimate has been made yet, and that the review will weigh all financial and legal aspects.
As stated, a carefully considered decision on the design of the sports exemption will be taken after weighing all financial, organisational, legal, administrative and implementation aspects.

Zoals gemeld zal met afweging van alle financiële, organisatorische, juridische, administratieve en uitvoeringsaspecten een weloverwogen besluit worden genomen over de vormgeving van de sportvrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie op 1 juni tegen het Armeens herdenkingsmonument in Almelo

MPs from several parties asked the government about a June 2014 demonstration in Almelo against an Armenian genocide memorial, including alleged Turkish state involvement, slogans, and whether the Turkish consul or Diyanet mosques were involved. The government answered that the claims could not be verified in several cases, that demonstration rights were respected, that a criminal complaint was under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service, and that the issue would be considered in a separate parallel-communities study.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, but they could not be verified.
Deze berichtgeving is het kabinet bekend, maar deze was niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Parex-bank

Parliamentarian Omtzigt asks whether the Parex bank put option with the EBRD, and related Latvian transactions, were correctly recorded under ESA95 and whether Eurostat and the EBRD should be asked to revise or disclose them. The Minister answers that the transactions were correctly recorded, refuses further Eurostat or EBRD requests, and describes existing Commission verification powers.
The EBRD has indicated that it cannot disclose further specific information.
De EBRD heeft aangegeven geen verdere specifieke informatie openbaar te kunnen maken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de "mogelijke genocide in Irak en de maatregelen die Nederland verplicht is te nemen, zoals het onmiddellijk stoppen van alle jihad reizen van Nederlanders en het voornemen tot

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Security and Justice whether the government's suspicion of IS genocide in Iraq obliges the Netherlands under the Genocide Convention to stop Dutch jihadist travel and criminalise it, and sought legal advice. Minister Timmermans answered that the Convention binds the Netherlands regardless of the government's qualification, that efforts to block departures are ongoing, that a bill on losing dual nationality is coming, and that external legal advice has been requested.
The cabinet refers in this regard to the answers to parliamentary questions on IS and the situation in Iraq of 11 August 2014
Het kabinet verwijst in dat verband naar de beantwoording van de Kamervragen over IS(IS) en de situatie in Irak van 11 augustus 2014

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de tweet waarin een ambtenaar van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie stelt dat ‘Islamitische Staat (IS) een vooropgezet plan van zionisten is die bewust de Isl

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a civil servant's tweet claiming IS is a Zionist plot, and whether IS is monitored online and what policy applies to civil servants who support or excuse IS. The minister distanced the government from the tweet, explained that the NCSC monitors digital security rather than all online expressions, and set out the limits on civil servants' freedom of expression under the Ambtenarenwet, with disciplinary sanctions possible after advice from an advisory committee.
I completely distance myself from the content of the tweet.
Ik neem volledig afstand van de inhoud van de tweet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de nog steeds niet uitgevoerde motie over het uitwisselen van informatie over in het buitenland veroordeelde zedendelinquenten, zodat ze niet in Neder
