CDA MPs asked why a motion to exchange information on foreign-convicted sex offenders, so they cannot obtain a VOG and work in childcare, remains unimplemented, and whether Dutch children are adequately protected. The Minister confirmed the motion, said information exchange with non-EU countries happens only case by case, and promised an Interpol-related study and a progress report before the end of 2014, while acknowledging the VOG cannot fully exclude misuse.
in contrast to the arrangements within the EU, criminal information is not exchanged structurally with countries outside the EU
wordt in tegenstelling tot de afspraken die gelden binnen EU-verband, niet op structurele wijze strafrechtelijke informatie uitgewisseld met landen buiten de EU
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Omtzigt over zware aanklacht tegen Iraanse voorganger

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and possible death-penalty charge against Iranian pastor Matthias Haghnejad, and about the persecution of Iranian Christians and EU action on religious freedom. The minister replied that the facts of the charge are not yet known, that the government shares concern and monitors the case, and that Nederland and the EU raise religious freedom with Iran bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN Universal Periodic Review, while acknowledging that individual cases are better addressed at EU level.
Nothing has been made public about the background of the charge.
Over de achtergrond van de aanklacht is niets bekend gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van der Staaij en Omtzigt over de Gaza-demonstratie van 24 juli 2014 in Den Haag

Three MPs asked the ministers about the Gaza demonstration in The Hague on 24 July 2014, including whether it was properly notified, whether police and prosecutors acted on antisemitic chants, threats to journalists, and display of ISIS flags. The government answered that the demonstration was notified as required with 50 expected participants, referred to answers given to related questions, and stated the prosecution's position that displaying IS and Hamas flags is punishable under the Penal Code.

The position is that IS (formerly ISIS/ISIL) and Hamas, banned as terrorist organisations by the EU and UN aiming at violence against certain population groups, public display of their flags constitutes a criminal offence in the prosecution's view under Articles 137d and 137c of the Penal Code.

Het standpunt houdt in dat nu IS (voorheen ISIS/ISIL) en Hamas (door de EU en de VN) verboden, terroristische organisaties zijn die tot doel hebben geweld te plegen tegen bepaalde bevolkingsgroepen, het in het openbaar tonen van deze vlaggen van deze organisaties naar het oordeel van het Openbaar Ministerie strafbaarheid oplevert
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Omtzigt, Van Haersma Buma, Voordewind, Slob en Van der Staaij over IS(IS) en de situatie in Irak

Members of parliament from the CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the government about the humanitarian emergency facing Yazidis and Christians fleeing IS in Iraq, US airstrikes and genocide claims, and whether Dutch and EU action is adequate. The minister answered that the government supports US aid to Iraq, has given an extra 400,000 euro via the Red Cross, is examining airlift support through defence, and is pressing for a unity government in Baghdad.

In response to the current humanitarian crisis, the cabinet has decided to immediately provide an extra 400,000 euro via the Netherlands Red Cross to the International Red Cross for emergency aid in Iraq.

Naar aanleiding van de huidige humanitaire crisis heeft het kabinet besloten onverwijld een extra bijdrage van 400 000 Euro via het Nederlandse Rode Kruis te geven aan het Internationale Rode Kruis ten behoeve van noodhulp in Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het gebruik van artikel 7d van de Rijkswet goedkeuring en bekendmaking verdragen

MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked how often since WWII the cabinet has used article 7d of the treaty approval act to exempt confidential treaties from parliamentary approval, and asked for the titles and texts. Minister Timmermans answered that the provision dates from 1994, that confidential treaties were notified to parliament under confidentiality, and that a list of notification letters will be shared confidentially; titles for 1945-1994 are available online.
As usual, you will shortly be sent an overview of these notification letters for confidential inspection.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal u op korte termijn een overzicht van deze mededelingsbrieven ter vertrouwelijke kennisneming worden toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt over het bericht dat Frankrijk hulp en opvang gaat bieden aan christenen

Two CDA MPs asked whether France's offer of aid and shelter to Christians expelled by IS from Mosul would be matched by Dutch asylum options, and what support minorities and the EU provide. The minister answered that asylum cases from IS-controlled Iraqi areas are postponed until a new country report appears in early September, while the EU and Netherlands continue supporting minorities.

Once the new country report is available, the State Secretary for Security and Justice will consider whether the information in it should lead to an adjustment of the current asylum policy regarding Iraq.

Zodra het nieuwe ambtsbericht er is, zal de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie bezien of de informatie in het ambtsbericht tot een aanpassing moet leiden in het huidige asielbeleid ten aanzien van Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Omtzigt over de dramatisch zorgelijke situatie van christenen in Mosul

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about threats by ISIS against Christians in Mosul, how such groups can be protected, and whether a safe haven could be created and the issue raised at the UN General Assembly. The minister answered that minorities' rights are a priority, cited UN Security Council and UNAMI calls for accountability, ISIS UN sanctions, EU aid, and said a political solution in Iraq is needed, without committing to a specific new step.
Both the protection of minority rights and freedom of religion or belief are priority subjects of Dutch foreign policy.
Zowel bescherming van de rechten van minderheden als vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging zijn prioritaire onderwerpen van het Nederlands buitenlands beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Omtzigt en van Hijum over het Parex-schandaal in Letland

MPs Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the rescue of Latvian bank Parex, alleged Russian dirty money, EBRD stakes in its successor Citadele, and lessons for Lithuania's euro entry. The government answered most questions by pointing to Latvian authorities, the Commission and the EBRD, stated that no Dutch loans or guarantees were used beyond a roughly 5% share of EU balance-of-payments aid, and declined to disclose EBRD due diligence and transaction details.
Beyond the information under questions 13 and 14, the EBRD has indicated that it cannot make further specific information public.
Buiten de informatie bij vraag 13 en14 heeft de EBRD aangegeven dat het verdere specifieke informatie niet openbaar kan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en De Rouwe over de oldtimermaatregel

Members Omtzigt and De Rouwe (CDA) asked about the implementation of the oldtimer vehicle tax exemption, including information given to owners, the handling of bills and objections, and revenue estimates. The government answered that rushed implementation strained the Tax Authority's information and processing, that bills were sent in April and May 2014 with thousands of objections received, and that current data are insufficient to revise the EUR 137 million revenue estimate.
The very short implementation period of the oldtimer measure has put the implementation by the Tax Authority and the information provided to taxpayers under pressure.
De zeer korte implementatietijd van de oldtimermaatregel heeft er toe geleid dat de uitvoering door de Belastingdienst en de voorlichting aan de belastingplichtigen onder druk is komen te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het bericht dat ontbreken GSM dekking levens kan kosten

MPs from the CDA asked the government about a reported death in Lattrop where AED alerts did not arrive, whether mobile coverage gaps endanger lives, and whether providers meet licence coverage obligations. The Minister replied that the network functioned properly, that 100% coverage is not achievable, that alternative emergency routes are advised, and that no coverage requirements exist in current frequency licences, with a ministry study on mobile coverage and 112 announced.
I do not have such information available.
Dergelijke informatie heb ik niet beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de aangenomen motie Omtzigt (Kamerstuk 33 750 V, nr. 30) over informatie over veroordelingen van Nederlanders voor zedendelicten in het buitenland

MPs Omtzigt, Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked about information exchange on Dutch nationals convicted of sex offences abroad, which can allow them to obtain a VOG and work with children. The government explains that EU exchange works under treaties and ECRIS, while information exchange with non-EU countries occurs only case by case, with Thailand approached and an Interpol-based approach being explored.
It is not separately recorded in how many cases a VOG was refused to a person with a Dutch passport for a sex offence conviction abroad.
Er wordt niet apart geregistreerd in hoeveel gevallen de VOG is geweigerd aan iemand met een Nederlands paspoort voor een veroordeling voor een zedendelict in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, de Roon en van Bommel over de vrijlating en arrestatie van een zwangere vrouw in Sudan

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Merriam Ibrahim was re-arrested after a court acquitted her of a death sentence, on what grounds, and whether the Sudanese ambassador would be summoned. The minister confirmed she was held at the airport on suspicion of using false documents, released on 26 June and is now at the US embassy, and said international pressure is being raised through quiet diplomacy.
Ms Ibrahim was held on suspicion of using false documents, but she was not formally arrested.
Mevrouw Ibrahim werd vastgehouden op verdenking van het gebruik van valse documenten, maar zij is niet officieel gearresteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Baay-Timmerman over het stoppen met de paspoortuitgifte bij consulaten

MPs Omtzigt, Oskam and Baay-Timmerman ask why the government is phasing out passport issuance at consulates before informing parliament and before 2016, and demand a cost-benefit analysis and a halt to the process. The Minister replies that biometric passport services at honorary consulates are being phased out for cost and efficiency reasons, that the consulate-general plans are still in draft and parliament will be informed later, and that he will provide the cost-benefit analysis in that letter.
The cost-benefit analysis of phasing out consular services at the consulates-general will be made after the action plans are assessed and included in the letter promised to your House.

De kosten-baten analyse bij afbouw van de consulaire dienstverlening bij de consulaten generaal zal na beoordeling van de plannen van aanpak gemaakt worden en verwerkt in de aan uw Kamer toegezegde brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de vergoeding voor rietlandbeheer

MPs Geurts, Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked why subsidies paid by provinces to nature managers are exempt from VAT while payments from nature managers to reed cutters are subject to VAT, and asked about the basis for a possible exemption. The State Secretary explained the VAT treatment under EU case law, that the subsidy scheme is taxable only where the payment is consumed, and that stakeholders and government are exploring a restructured single-entity arrangement.

Representatives of private reed managers, Staatsbosbeheer, Natuurmonumenten, the province of Overijssel and the Ministry of Economic Affairs are examining whether the relationship between reed managers and land owners can be changed and formalised so that there is a single entity.

Vertegenwoordigers van de particuliere rietlandbeheerders, Staatsbosbeheer, Natuurmonumenten, de provincie Overijssel en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken onderzoeken of de relatie tussen rietlandbeheerders en terreineigenaren zodanig gewijzigd en geformaliseerd kan worden, dat sprake is van één entiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Servaes over de repressie die zou zijn ingezet tegen straatkinderen in Rio de Janeiro in de aanloop naar het WK voetbal en de Olympische Spelen

MPs Omtzigt and Servaes asked the government about alleged repression of street children in Rio de Janeiro ahead of the World Cup and Olympics, including reports of unlawful detention, child killings and disappearances, and whether Brazilian authorities withheld information. The Minister answered that the government does not see a systematic repression strategy or systematic child-rights violations, that the cited IBGE report could not be verified, that no Brazilian data was found to have been deleted, and that no international investigation is warranted, while committing to raise human rights bilaterally, supporting NGOs, and pursuing sport-federation human rights clauses.
The Cabinet currently sees no reason for an international investigation, because the Brazilian government recognises the problem
Het Kabinet ziet op dit moment geen aanleiding voor een internationaal onderzoek, omdat de Braziliaanse regering de problematiek onderkent
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vernietiging van 1500 fruitbomen door de Israëlische autoriteiten bij de “Tent of Nations” boerderij in de omgeving van Bethlehem

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the destruction of 1,500 fruit trees at the Tent of Nations farm near Bethlehem, whether Israeli courts had a pending appeal, and about Area C land use and Israeli policy. The minister said the conflicting claims on ownership and legality could not be resolved by the cabinet and that local authorities must decide, while describing the wider Area C situation and international law concerns about settlements and house demolitions.
Because of the conflicting information and accounts, it is not possible for the cabinet to determine which party is right regarding the property rights and the legality of uprooting the trees.

Door de conflicterende informatie en lezingen is het voor het kabinet niet mogelijk een afweging te maken welke partij in het gelijk staat wat betreft de eigendomsrechten en de wetmatigheid van de ontworteling van de bomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ISIS en Jabhat Al Nusra als terroristische organisaties

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's list of suspected jihadists, Turkey's position on Jabhat al-Nusra and ISIS as terrorist organisations, EU and Dutch implementation of UN sanctions, prosecution of Dutch fighters, and financing and arms flows. The minister answered largely on substance, confirming Turkey's asset freeze and sanctions implementation while declining to confirm the intelligence list and deferring prosecution matters to the public prosecutor.
No public statements can be made about which information is shared with which organisations.
Er kunnen geen mededelingen in het openbaar gedaan worden over de vraag met welke organisaties welke informatie gedeeld wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het nog steeds onbeantwoorde Wob- en grondwetsverzoek inzake het onderzoek naar de gevolgen van de accijnsverhogingen

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance to disclose all documents on the excise duty study, including all versions, and to list them with a disclosure decision per document under article 68 of the Constitution. The State Secretary answered that article 68 is not wider in practice than the Wob for this purpose, that no document list is required, and that he will not provide one, though he is accountable for the analysis and will discuss it in debate.

Drawing up the list of all internal documents you requested is unusual in exchanges between parliament and cabinet, and I see no special facts or circumstances that would warrant doing so in this case.

Het opstellen van de door u gevraagde lijst met allerlei interne documenten is in het verkeer tussen het parlement en het kabinet ongebruikelijk en ik zie geen bijzondere feiten of omstandigheden om in dit geval wel over te gaan tot het opstellen van zo'n lijst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Baay-Timmerman over de sluiting van het honorair-consulaat in de Spaanse provincie La Nuncia per 1 september 2014

MPs Omtzigt, Oskam and Baay-Timmerman asked why the honorary consulate in La Nucia (Spain) would lose its passport and visa functions from 1 September 2014, whether the minister had promised to wait until 2016, and whether a cost-benefit analysis was made. The minister replied that the change is part of budget cuts and the network modernisation, that the consulate remains available for emergencies, that the 2016 timeline still applies, and that the chosen cuts will not be reversed.
A cost-benefit analysis was made for the honorary consulates with biometric equipment.
Er is een kosten/baten analyse gemaakt voor de honoraire consulaten met biometrische apparatuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het faillissement van het bedrijf Thermphos en de rol van de Nederlandse en Europese overheid daarin

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the Thermphos bankruptcy, including the Dutch abstention on the EU anti-dumping decision on Kazakh white phosphorus, whether the government foresaw the costs, and whether compensation or EU budget funds were pursued. The minister answered that the Netherlands abstained, that no causal link between the lack of duties and the bankruptcy was demonstrated, that the government actively sought a buyer and a green restart, and that no compensation was pursued.
The Netherlands abstained from voting, as did Spain, France and Hungary.
Nederland heeft zich onthouden van stemming, evenals Spanje, Frankrijk en Hongarije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het WOB-verzoek dat het lid Omtzigt bij de regeling van werkzaamheden van de Tweede Kamer van 28 mei 2014 heeft gedaan

Omtzigt asked whether the minister's letter on the diesel and LPG excise evaluation amounts to a refusal of his WOB (public access) request for all documents, and when a decision would be taken. Minister Wiebes answered that the request was treated as a request under article 68 of the Constitution rather than the WOB, and that the non-aggregated oil company data is withheld for confidentiality reasons, which the WOB also requires.
I have made clear that I do not disclose information from the oil companies because it concerns commercially confidential and competitively sensitive information.
Ik heb kenbaar gemaakt dat ik informatie die afkomstig is van de oliemaatschappijen niet openbaar maak omdat het bedrijfsvertrouwelijke en concurrentiegevoelige informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Omtzigt, Van Bommel over de vernietiging van 64 kerken in de Chinese provincie Zhejiang

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that 64 churches in China's Zhejiang province were demolished or stripped of Christian elements under a demolition campaign, and whether central authorities back it. The minister confirmed the reports, said the campaign targets illegal buildings and anti-corruption, and said Dutch concerns on religious freedom are raised bilaterally and via the EU.
The Netherlands will continue to raise this worrying development both bilaterally and through the EU.
Nederland zal zowel bilateraal als via de EU aandacht blijven vragen voor deze zorgelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over het bombarderen van een ziekenhuis in het Nuba gebergte in Soedan

Two CDA MPs asked the government about an alleged bombing of the only hospital in the Nuba Mountains in Sudan, the EU/UN response, Dutch private-sector trade promotion in Sudan, and a visit by Sudanese officials to Europe, and whether the government would raise the bombing with them. The government answered by referring to an earlier letter on the political situation in Sudan, without substantive answers to the individual questions.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Agnes Mulder en Geurts over de olielekkage uit opslag in lege zoutmijnen in het natuurgebied Amtsvenn (bij Enschede) en de geplande extra opslag van diesel in lege zoutmijnen onde

MPs Omtzigt, Mulder and Geurts asked about an oil leak from strategic oil storage in salt caverns at Amtsvenn in Germany and about planned diesel storage in salt caverns under Enschede, including risks to the Netherlands and whether operations should wait. The minister replied that the leak likely lies in a borehole casing, that Dutch risks are considered low, that the Enschede design differs and is monitored, that the regulator SodM can intervene, and that AkzoNobel may proceed with preparatory work but has said it will not store diesel until the German cause is clear.
If at any point I see a need to intervene, I can, under article 50 of the Mining Act, prescribe measures in cases of serious harm to safety or the environment or ground movement.

Indien ik op enig moment noodzaak zie tot ingrijpen, kan ik op grond van artikel 50 van de Mijnbouwwet, in gevallen van ernstige aantasting van de bescherming van de veiligheid, het milieu of in gevallen van beweging van de aardbodem, maatregelen voorschrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de evaluatie van de accijnsverhoging op diesel en LPG

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the evaluation of the fuel excise increase, including which pump-owner organisations gave input, BOVAG's doubts about CBS data and the cross-border effects. The State Secretary answered that the evaluation was based on oil company, CBS and tax authority data, that BOVAG's 2 May letter was not answered directly but BOVAG was invited to talk, and that the first-quarter 2014 results gave no reason for further measures despite some cross-border effects.
A number of oil companies cooperated in the research. These companies provided data to Finance on a confidential basis.
Aan het onderzoek heeft een aantal oliemaatschappijen meegewerkt. Deze maatschappijen hebben op vertrouwelijke basis gegevens aan Financiën ter beschikking gesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de zorgen die leven bij de Vereniging Natuurmonumenten over de beheersvergoedingen in het kader van het rietlandbeheer in Nationaal Park de Weerribben-Wie

CDA MPs asked whether the subsidy levels for reed-land management in the Weerribben-Wieden park are adequate, and whether the 2014 income-tax changes and 6% VAT rate undermine the SNL standard-cost system. The State Secretary says provinces set compensation at 75% of norm costs under the Natuurpact, that VAT is due on paid management outsourcing, that no relevant tax changes occurred, and that a reduced VAT rate is not possible under EU rules, while committing to no concrete action.

On the basis of the information known to me, I cannot assess whether and to what extent the management compensation provided to reed cutters is insufficient to achieve the desired nature quality through the summer mowing regime.

Op basis van de mij bekende gegevens kan ik niet beoordelen of en in hoeverre de verstrekte beheersvergoedingen die in het kader van het rietlandbeheer aan riettelers verstrekt worden ontoereikend zijn om de gewenste natuurkwaliteit via het regime van zomermaaibeheer te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het afkopen van een klein pensioen

Mr Omtzigt asked the ministers about problems with buying out small pensions before retirement, including effects on rent allowance, AOW partner allowance and benefits, and whether the government would reverse or prevent buy-outs. The government answered that it sees no feasible way to reverse past buy-outs or compensate those affected, but will work with pension providers on better information and will inform parliament before the summer recess.
I deeply regret that people have suffered adverse financial consequences from the buy-out of a small pension.
Ik betreur het ten zeerste dat mensen nadelige financiële gevolgen hebben ondervonden van de afkoop van een klein pensioen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pieter Heerma over het feit dat België op dit moment akkoord gaat met het feit dat kranten 0% btw in rekening brengen op hun digitale abonnementen

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked why Belgium, Luxembourg and France apply reduced VAT to digital newspapers and e-books while the Netherlands does not, and what the government will do about it. The Secretary of State answered that from 1 January 2015 EU rules will tax electronic services at the buyer's country rate, and that a reduced rate for digital versus physical products requires new EU legislation, which Netherlands will push for during the Commission's coming VAT evaluation.

In that context the Netherlands will work to ensure that, when the European Commission proposes any amendment to the VAT Directive concerning digital products, Member States pursue priority treatment of it.

Nederland zal zich in dat kader er voor inzetten dat, wanneer de Europese Commissie een voorstel voor eventuele aanpassing van de btw-richtlijn met betrekking tot digitale producten doet, een prioritaire behandeling wordt nagestreefd door de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Segers en Dijkgraaf over het rapport “The European Union Integrity System” van Transparency International

MPs Omtzigt, Segers and Dijkgraaf asked whether the government would act on Transparency International's report on EU integrity gaps (openness and corruption) and its 12 recommendations, whether it would raise the report at the European Council, and who should check EU institutions on rule of law. The minister said the government supports follow-up on transparency and anti-corruption measures in Council and EU fora, but declined to put the report on the European Council agenda, and stated the EU's rule-of-law oversight is shared with member states.
The cabinet attaches importance to the greatest possible transparency regarding European legislative and decision-making processes.
Het kabinet hecht aan een zo groot mogelijke transparantie ten aanzien van Europese wetgevings- en besluitvormingsprocessen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt Justitie over gsm-ontvangst in Nederland

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about poor mobile coverage in border municipalities and whether 112 emergency calls could fail, including how many complaints and cases occurred and what action was taken. The minister answered that 100% mobile coverage is not achievable, that no registration of failed emergency calls exists, that EZ is studying coverage reach, and that citizens are advised to use a landline in emergencies.
It is not registered in how many cases an acute emergency call was not possible because no mobile coverage was available.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd in hoeveel gevallen een acute noodoproep niet mogelijk was, omdat er geen mobiele dekking voorhanden was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over garanties in het kader van het bid voor het Europees Kampioenschap voetbal in 2020

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Health about why government guarantees for the Euro 2020 football bid, including tax exemptions and a no-new-legislation commitment, were signed before parliament was informed, and requested documents and details of the tax guarantees. The minister replies that guarantees were kept within existing legal frameworks, that parliament was informed once the bid was finalized, that the tax guarantees do not create specific exemptions beyond existing law, and that some documents will be sent later or are publicly available.
I then informed the House that same day about the submission of the bid and the government guarantees I signed on behalf of the state, which form part of the bid.
Ik heb vervolgens de Kamer die dag terstond geïnformeerd over het uitbrengen van het bid en de overheidsgaranties die ik namens het Rijk heb ondertekend en onderdeel uitmaken van het bid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Na weken van desinteresse wil de wereld dat Nigeriaanse meisjes thuis komen'

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to the abduction of Nigerian schoolgirls, whether the Netherlands and the EU offer search support, whether the abduction counts as terrorism, and whether Boko Haram should be listed on the EU terrorism list. The minister answered that the government is concerned, offered help if Nigeria requests it, said the EU urged release and prosecution, and confirmed the Netherlands again pressed for listing Boko Haram.
At the Foreign Affairs Council of 12 May 2014, the Netherlands again argued for listing Boko Haram on the European terrorist list.
Nederland heeft tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken van 12 mei 2014 opnieuw gepleit voor het opnemen van Boko Haram op de Europese terreurlijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht “Diplomaat slaat er bij ruzie op los en gaat vrij uit”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the case of an Afghan diplomat who assaulted a Dutch citizen and damaged his car, and who was not prosecuted due to diplomatic immunity. The minister answered that the Afghan embassy was summoned and told the conduct was unacceptable and damages were owed, but declined to disclose the full report and said no tax-pass blocking had yet occurred.
To date, no fuel cards have yet been blocked.
Tot heden zijn er nog geen tankpassen geblokkeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over de aftrek weekenduitgaven voor gehandicapten

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Health about tax deductibility of weekend care costs for severely disabled institutional residents, including the 'moral obligation' criterion and a specific case where the child's own income may have excluded deduction. The government affirms that the moral-obligation test is marginal in practice, that the Belastingdienst applies it generously, and it will propose extending the deduction to curatele (curatorship) alongside mentorschap in a future law change.
I will submit a legislative amendment to this end when the opportunity arises.
Ik zal hiertoe bij gelegenheid een wetswijziging indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over de aftrekbaarheid van trapliften als specifieke zorgkosten

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance why a stairlift, previously deductible as a specific care cost, was made non-deductible from 2014 despite the Tax Authority's website having said otherwise, and whether the cost should be allowed under the legitimate expectations principle. The State Secretary answered that the 2014 exclusion of home adaptations was deliberate, that the website disclaimer warned rules could change, that cash-basis rules mean 2014 payments are not deductible, and that no legitimate-expectations exception applies to general public information.
Providing general information by the Tax Authority cannot lead to treatment deviating from the law by applying the legitimate expectations principle.
Het verstrekken van algemene voorlichting door de Belastingdienst kan niet leiden tot een van de wet afwijkende behandeling met toepassing van het vertrouwensbeginsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat Turkije betrokken is bij onder andere steun aan Syrische rebellen

An MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reports that Turkey supplies Syrian rebels, supports Al Nusra and was linked to the Ghouta sarin attack, and asked whether Turkey would be questioned and whether Dutch intelligence had information. The Minister answered that the government cannot independently assess the allegations, denied none of the claims could be verified, said talks with Turkey continue, and declined to share intelligence exchanges.
No public statement can be made about the sharing of information between intelligence services.
Over het delen van informatie tussen de inlichtingendiensten kan in het openbaar geen mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over oorlog Turkije tegen Syrië onder valse vlag

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about leaked recordings allegedly showing Turkish officials discussing a false-flag pretext for war with Syria, the downing of a Syrian jet, and jihadist attacks near Kessab, and asked whether NATO Patriot deployments should be withdrawn. The government said it cannot verify the recordings, that Turkey claims they were illegally recorded and manipulated, that Dutch Patriots were not designed to track such incidents, and that it will not speculate on Turkish intentions.
The cabinet cannot assess the authenticity of these audio recordings and therefore cannot form a judgement on their alleged content.
Het kabinet kan de echtheid van deze geluidsopnames niet beoordelen en kan zich dus geen oordeel vormen over de vermeende inhoud ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de problemen van zzp’ers in de zorg om een VAR-wuo te krijgen of te behouden

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked how the Tax Authority assesses VAR-wuo self-employment declarations for care workers, and whether withdrawals are leaving zzp'ers without clients. The government answers that the assessment follows uniform legal criteria, that care provision in kind generally implies employment with the institution, and that the policy is unchanged, while noting a pilot allowing direct contracting with care offices and some withdrawals were wrongly made.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de voorwaarden voor uitstel van betaling voor ondernemers

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the conditions for payment deferral for entrepreneurs, the discretion of tax collectors, supervision of individual arrangements, complaint handling and ministerial approval for enforcement against large firms. The State Secretary answered in detail, describing regular, special and short-term deferral rules, the internal guidelines and hierarchical supervision, and the ministry's approval procedure, while acknowledging that individual officials may reach different conclusions.
For that reason it is not entirely ruled out that different employees reach different conclusions; it remains human work.
Het is om die reden niet geheel uitgesloten dat verschillende medewerkers tot een verschillende conclusie komen; het blijft mensenwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over steun en onderdak aan terroristen door Turkije

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey harbours and supports terrorists, including Hamas figures and Al Qaeda financiers, and whether the government will press Turkey on this. The minister answered that the government has no independent information on the alleged activities, that Turkey denies supporting Al Qaeda and says it takes measures, and that counter-terrorism is discussed in NATO, EU and bilateral channels.
The cabinet has no independent information on the alleged activities and travel movements of the named persons, nor on the alleged money transactions.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie ten aanzien van de veronderstelde activiteiten en reisbewegingen van genoemde personen, noch over de veronderstelde geldtransacties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Keijzer over orgaanroof in China

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Dutch government about organ harvesting from prisoners of conscience in China, EU and UN concerns, Dutch patients travelling abroad for transplants, and Dutch hospital ties to Chinese hospitals. The government said it shares the concern, cannot independently verify the allegations, will keep raising the issue in EU and bilateral channels, and knows of no Dutch hospital ties to suspect Chinese hospitals.
The Netherlands will continue to make efforts to keep this issue on the EU agenda.
Nederland zal zich blijven inspannen om deze kwestie op de agenda van de EU te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de mogelijke rol van Turkije bij kidnapping van bisschoppen in Syrië

Mr Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about reports of Turkish involvement in the kidnapping of two bishops in Syria, including claims that Turkish authorities misrepresented the detention of the Abu Banat group and that the MIT intelligence service tracked the kidnappers. The minister answered that the government has no independent information confirming these claims, that Turkey says the group is detained and the law must take its course, and that the government will seek closer counter-terrorism cooperation with Turkey.
The cabinet has no independent information that confirms the claim in question.
Het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie die de genoemde bewering bevestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de Leden Van Ojik en Klaver en Omtzigt over Oekraïense vermogens die in Nederland gestald worden en de rol die de Nederlandse ambassade hierin speelt

MPs Van Ojik, Klaver and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch embassy in Kiev actively invited companies to a November 2013 seminar on investing in the Netherlands, whether attendees were linked to EU-sanctioned persons, and how trust offices and FIU reports relate to Ukrainian assets. The minister answered that the embassy did not actively approach companies, that the attendee list is not shared for privacy reasons, that no sanctioned person attended, and that embassy promotion events and trust office presentations are not centrally registered.
These reports of unusual transactions are then assessed by FIU, and based on the information available to FIU, FIU may decide to report the unusual transactions as suspicious to law enforcement.

Deze meldingen van ongebruikelijke transacties worden vervolgens door FIU beoordeeld en op basis van de bij FIU beschikbare informatie kan FIU besluiten de ongebruikelijke transacties als verdacht door te melden aan de opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over nucleaire ontwapening en non-proliferatie

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether the B61 nuclear bomb modernisation adds new military capabilities, citing claims of greater precision, yield reduction and F-35 compatibility. The government answered that the US-run life-extension programme adds no new military capabilities, that the Netherlands has no say in it, and that it will not speculate on Russian reactions.
The cabinet is not responsible for the content and implementation of the US life-extension programme and therefore makes no statements about the US Government Accountability Office's claims on this.

Het kabinet is niet verantwoordelijk voor inhoud en uitvoering van het Amerikaanse levensduurverlengingsprogramma en doet dan ook geen uitspraken over beweringen van de Amerikaanse Rekenkamer hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over mogelijke steun Turkije aan jihadisten Syrië

Rep. Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey supports jihadists in Syria, citing Israeli and press reports of Al Qaeda bases and weapons transfers, and whether the Patriot mission should be questioned. The minister answered that Turkey denies such support, that the government has no independent information confirming the bases or safehouses, that the border situation is opaque so support via Turkish territory cannot be excluded, and that the issues were raised in bilateral consultations and will not be pursued through an international investigation.
The cabinet has no independent information that Al Qaeda bases exist within Turkey.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie dat binnen Turkije bases van Al Qaeda bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver en Omtzigt over Oekraïense vermogens die in Nederland gestald worden en de rol die de Nederlandse ambassade hierin speelt

MPs Van Ojik, Klaver and Omtzigt asked about trust offices and the Dutch embassy in Kiev hosting a November seminar on the Dutch fiscal climate, including whether the presentations fit OECD substance rules, whether they would be shared, the guest list, and the number of anti-money-laundering reports on Ukrainian funds. The minister answered that the seminar was a public event within embassy tasks, that none of the 18 EU-sanctioned persons attended, that FIU-Nederland received 1475 linked transactions and two unusual trust-office reports, and that gatekeepers self-police under DNB supervision, while leaving several questions (presentations, guest list) unanswered.
The Cabinet is of the view that facilitating this meeting falls within the standing mandate of the embassies.
Het Kabinet is van mening dat het faciliteren van deze bijeenkomst past binnen de staande taakopdracht van de ambassades.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het “Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt” van de EU ten aanzien van Cuba

MP Omtzigt asked the government about the settlement of a Dutch export-credit insurance debt owed by Cuba's state bank, including the amount outstanding, the write-off, the 2% interest rate, the repayment schedule, and whether other Paris Club members were consulted. The minister answered in detail, explaining the debt was roughly budget-neutral, the 2% rate reflects OECD CIRR benchmarks, and bilateral settlements were permitted outside the Paris Club, though some sensitive figures (interest rate in original loan) were withheld as commercially confidential.
The interest rate in the original loan agreements between the insured party and the Cuban bank is commercially confidential information.
Het rentepercentage in de oorspronkelijke leningsovereenkomsten tussen de verzekerde partij en de Cubaanse bank betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, De Caluwé, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Servaes over het bericht dat President Museveni de omstreden anti-homowet heeft ondertekend

MPs from several parties asked the government how it would respond to President Museveni signing Uganda's anti-homosexuality law and what measures it would take. The minister answered that the Netherlands suspended justice-sector aid and human-rights-conditioned support, pressed Uganda diplomatically, and would push the EU to condemn the law and withhold budget support, while promising to review support for LGBT groups.
Immediately after the law was signed, the cabinet suspended aid to the Ugandan government in the justice sector.
Meteen na het ondertekenen van de wet heeft het kabinet de hulp aan de Ugandese overheid in de justitiële sector opgeschort.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Financiën over de hogere accijnzen (ingezonden 13 januari 2014).

Omtzigt asks the state secretary of Finance whether the government has monitored the sharp sales drops in border regions after the January 2014 fuel excise increase, whether it will reverse the increase, and why the revenue estimate ignores border effects. The state secretary says monitoring is underway with oil company data and a result is expected by mid-May 2014, declines to reverse the increase for now, explains that the revenue figure is a static estimate while behavioural effects are reflected in macro forecasts, and notes that UWV cannot provide data on dismissals at petrol stations.
I have meanwhile started my own investigation.
Ik heb inmiddels eigen onderzoek in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over fiscale tip- en toongelden, samenwerking door de fiscus met criminelen en het opvolgen van de aanbevelingen van de Commissie Van Traa

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the fiscal tip-money policy, cooperation between the tax authority and criminals, the 2010 policy framework and whether the Van Traa commission's recommendations were followed, including the 1994 internal memo, FIOD guidelines, a former FIOD official's later role, and how entrapment is prevented. Wiebes answered that the 2010 framework remains unchanged, the 1994 memo was internal and informative, the Van Traa recommendations concern criminal investigation and do not apply, no separate protocol exists, several documents could not be found, and details of payments are withheld.
It is not possible to state how many potential tipsters have reported since 2001, because this was not recorded.
Het is niet mogelijk aan te geven hoeveel potentiële tipgevers zich vanaf 2001 hebben gemeld, omdat dat niet is bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het «Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt» van de EU ten aanzien van Cuba

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked why Cuba was absent from the minister's travel schedule, whether the EU Common Position on Cuba would be changed, and why a Memorandum of Understanding with Cuba and a debt repayment deal were not sent to parliament earlier. The minister answered that the Cuba trip was not yet confirmed in early December, that the Common Position remains in force until a new mandate-based agreement exists, that MoUs are departmental and not routinely sent to parliament, and provided the main terms of the Cuban debt repayment agreement while withholding the full contract as commercially sensitive.
This agreement contains commercially sensitive information and therefore cannot be made fully public.
Dit akkoord bevat bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en kan derhalve niet volledig openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over "het veel te laat gepubliceerde en lang achtergehouden rapport over de doorsneepremie"

An MP from the CDA asked why the Ministry of Social Affairs delayed publishing the CPB study on the average-premium system for pensions until 20 December 2013, despite repeated promises of earlier delivery, and asked for drafts, comments and advisory group input. The State Secretary acknowledged the delays, explained the Landsadvocaat legal review and the contractual publication control, but declined to release drafts and advisory group comments.
Releasing the advisory committee's comments would breach the reasonable and customary agreement with them that their input would be used only for the study.
Het vrijgeven van opmerkingen van de begeleidingscommissie zou de zeer redelijke en gebruikelijke afspraak met hen schenden dat hun inbreng alleen ten behoeve van het onderzoek gebruikt zou worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de verklaring van het bedrijf Vitens over de beëindiging van zijn samenwerking met het Israëlische waterbedrijf Mekorot

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked the minister why she cancelled a visit to Mekorot, whether government policy discouraging trade with Israeli settlements played a role, and whether she consulted colleagues before cancelling. The minister answered that she refers to a letter of 16 January 2014, said the government sees no reason to apologise, and rejected the characterisation of chaos and diplomatic damage.
I would refer you to the letter to your House of 16 January 2014, reference 2014.35843, which addresses this matter.
Graag verwijs ik u naar de brief aan uw Kamer van 16 januari 2014, met kenmerk 2014.35843, waarin op deze kwestie wordt ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de resultaten van de aanpak van fraude bij toeslagen (o.a. de `Bulgarenfraude`)

MP Omtzigt asked about the Bulgarian benefit-fraud case, collection of fines, the fraud coordinator's work, household registration and the Kavelaars criticism of unimplemented advice. The State Secretary answered most questions with figures and described measures taken, but withheld the dates of benefit payments citing the investigation and did not commit to new steps beyond existing measures.
Because of the investigation's interests, no statements can be made about this.
Vanwege het onderzoeksbelang kunnen hierover geen mededelingen gedaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de situatie in Zuid-Sudan met grote aantallen slachtoffers van etnisch geweld

Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of the ethnic violence in South Sudan, how high the risk of genocide was, and what the UN Secretary-General and EU/Netherlands were asked to do. Minister Timmermans answered that the risk of escalation exists but genocide cannot be predicted, describes diplomatic efforts via IGAD and the UN Security Council reinforcement of UNMISS, and says the Netherlands keeps its UNMISS contribution.
Parties must also agree a ceasefire as soon as possible; in addition, the protection of civilians is of great importance.
Partijen moeten voorts zo spoedig mogelijk een staakt-het-vuren overeenkomen; daarnaast is de bescherming van burgers van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Bashir over bijstellingsregeling directe belasting

MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Bashir asked when the Secretary of State learned of the 2014 indexation raising the eigenwoningforfait from 0.6% to 0.7%, why earlier calculations assumed 0.6%, and how the rise affects taxpayers, provisional assessments and cost estimates. The government answered that the indexation follows the statutory mechanism, was signed on 18 December 2013 and published without notifying parliament, and that provisional assessments used 0.65% with later requests recalculated at 0.7%, with a commitment to adjust the trial calculation.
It is not customary to share the outcomes of statutory indexation mechanisms with members of the cabinet.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om de uitkomsten van wettelijke indexeringsmechanismes aan leden van het kabinet mede te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pieter Heerma over het gebruik van overheidsvorderingen

CDA MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority's use of government claims (overheidsvordering) to debit taxpayers' bank accounts, including the protection of the attachment-free minimum, usage and complaint figures, evaluations, and consultation with debt-relief and bailiff bodies. The government answered that the instrument is lawful and efficient, that a correction for the attachment-free minimum has been added since November 2013, that complaints have been rare, and that consultations and a bailiffs' register are underway.
As of 1 November 2013 the Collection Guidelines 2008 have been amended.
Met ingang van 1 november 2013 is de Leidraad Invordering 2008 gewijzigd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de beperkte en onduidelijke uitleg van het Sportbesluit

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Belastingdienst's handling of VAT on sports facilities, including a court ruling on artificial turf, long waiting times for advice, the treatment of walking and cycling routes, and a call for clearer rules. The State Secretary answered that the tax office has appealed the district court ruling and continues to challenge artificial constructions, that advice can take weeks to over a year, that reserved routes qualify under the reduced rate, and that an updated policy decision is expected in early 2014 after consultation with sports bodies.
I intend to update the aforementioned policy decision of 27 October 2011.
Ik heb het voornemen om het hiervoor genoemde beleidsbesluit van 27 oktober 2011 te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de toenemende vervolging van christenen op Sri Lanka

MPs Omtzigt, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about reported rising persecution of Christians in Sri Lanka, including church closures, an attack on a church in Hanwella, police inaction, and removal of Sri Lanka from the human rights fund country list. The minister acknowledged rising religious tensions, said no independent information was available on several specifics, explained the 2011 reduction of the fund's country list, and noted EU and UN expressions of concern without committing to new national measures.
There is no independent information available to make a statement about this.
Er is geen onafhankelijke informatie beschikbaar om hier een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Klein over de schenkingsvrijstelling en boeterente

MPs Omtzigt and Klein asked the government whether banks would waive early-repayment penalties when mortgages are repaid with gifts under the temporarily expanded gift-tax exemption, and whether ABN AMRO's conditions contradict earlier letters to parliament. The Minister replied that banks have implemented the call differently (ABN AMRO and ING for underwater mortgages, Rabobank and SNS for gifts up to 100,000 euro), that penalty waiver is a bank decision, and that he would answer the remaining questions before the vote on the Tax Plan.
Providers have therefore given different interpretations to the cabinet's call.
Aanbieders hebben derhalve op een verschillende manier invulling gegeven aan de oproep van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma, Thieme, Van Ojik en Omtzigt over het autorijverbod voor vrouwen in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and fines of women defying Saudi Arabia's driving ban and the detention of a journalist supporting women's right to drive, and whether the government would press Saudi counterparts. The minister confirmed short detentions that could not be independently verified, said the journalist was briefly held and has been released, described the situation as concerning while noting some reforms, and stated the issue is raised in EU and UPR dialogue.
However, it is not possible to independently confirm the number of women detained, nor whether they were fined.
Het is echter niet mogelijk om het aantal vrouwen dat is vastgezet onafhankelijk bevestigd te krijgen, noch of zij zijn beboet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Van Bommel over het ongekende geweld tegen christenen in Egypte, zoals gedocumenteerd door Amnesty International

MPs from seven parties asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's documentation of large-scale violence against Coptic Christians in Egypt, including trends, casualty figures, the interim government's protection efforts and possible international initiatives. The minister said the reports are troubling, that the government urges independent investigation bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, that no reliable casualty figures exist, and that Dutch initiatives include judicial training and interfaith contacts.
The cabinet advocates the need for such an impartial investigation with the Egyptian authorities, both bilaterally and within the EU and UN.
Het kabinet bepleit de noodzaak van een dergelijk onpartijdig onderzoek bij de Egyptische autoriteiten, zowel bilateraal als in EU- en in VN-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke financiering van Al-Shabaab via het consulaat van Eritrea

MPs from several parties asked whether money from the Eritrean consulate's diaspora tax in the Netherlands may fund Al-Shabaab, whether the OM investigated, and whether the consul should be expelled or the consulate closed. The government answered that the OM has received no complaints and started no investigation, that the tax is not per se contrary to Vienna Conventions or sanctions, that there are no concrete indications the funds financed terrorism, and that no measures are warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has not started an investigation into the so-called diaspora tax because it had received no reports on this matter.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie is geen onderzoek begonnen naar de zgn. diaspora taks omdat het Openbaar Ministerie dienaangaande geen aangiften had ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Nederlands/Turkse journaliste Fusün Erdogan

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Dutch-Turkish journalist Füsun Erdoğan, held in pretrial detention in Turkey since 2006, including when Dutch authorities were informed, whether her trial was fair, and whether the case was raised in human rights dialogue. The minister answers that the Netherlands follows the case but does not intervene in Turkish legal proceedings, while backing the European Commission's concerns about long pretrial detention and defence rights, and that consular staff visited her and attended her hearing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ondergedoken Papua activisten

MP Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would act on reports that Papuan activists linked to the Freedom Flotilla went into hiding after threats from Indonesian police and military, and whether it would press Indonesia and raise the issue in the EU and UN. The minister answered that Indonesia had stated it wanted to avoid force, that the ministry had no information supporting fears for local participants, and that human rights are discussed in the bilateral dialogue and EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has no information that could substantiate the concerns of the Freedom Flotilla spokesperson.
Het Ministerie van BZ beschikt niet over informatie die de zorgen van de woordvoerder van de Freedom Flotilla kunnen onderbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en van Hijum over het bericht “Leugens en bedrog bij burgerzaken”

MPs Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked about a report on tax nomads who deregister from the municipal population register (GBA) to evade the state, including how many emigrants filed final tax returns, whether data is exchanged with foreign tax authorities, and whether passports are denied. The government answered that the report was shared confidentially, outlined the Taskforce VOW and an FIOD investigation, gave deregistration and filing figures, and said about 40 persons were flagged for passport refusal, with a broader anti-fraud approach promised for December 2013.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations sent you this report by letter for confidential handling.
De minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties heeft u dit rapport bij brief ter vertrouwelijke behandeling toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Ontmoeting met een Cubaanse blogger

An MP asks the foreign minister why he praised Cuba's reforms and sought closer ties despite reported human rights abuses, and whether he will visit Cuba and inform parliament. The minister replies that reforms are seen as positive, that engagement is more effective than isolation, that human rights are closely monitored, and that he will inform parliament about Cuba policy before the budget debate and before a visit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over het akkoord tussen de koepelorganisatie voor de woningcorporaties Aedes en het kabinet, waarin onder meer is afgesproken dat de integratieheffing komt te vervallen

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked about the August 2013 agreement with Aedes that abolishes the integration levy, whether this applies to all sectors, the budgetary effect, and timing. The minister confirmed the levy is abolished entirely via the Belastingplan 2014 from 1 January 2014, with a total revenue loss of 95 million euros per year, of which about 35 million is attributed to housing associations.
The proposal that forms part of the Belastingplan 2014 aims to abolish the integration levy entirely and not only for the housing association sector.
Het voorstel dat onderdeel uitmaakt van het Belastingplan 2014 beoogt de integratieheffing in het geheel te laten vervallen en niet alleen voor de corporatiesector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het rapport “Turkey: Gezi Park protests: Brutal denial of the right to peaceful assembly in Turkey

MP Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about an Amnesty report on excessive police force against Gezi Park protesters in Turkey, including whether an independent Turkish investigation took place and whether the Netherlands would accept opening chapter 22 of accession talks without one. The minister said the government shares the report's concerns, notes revised police instructions on force and tear gas, and says an investigation took place, to be addressed in the Commission progress report.
The government shares the view that Turkey must respect the right to peaceful association and assembly and that the police must facilitate demonstrations responsibly.
Het kabinet deelt het oordeel dat Turkije het recht op vreedzame vereniging en vergadering moet respecteren en dat de politie demonstraties op verantwoorde wijze moet begeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de definitie van samenwonen in de AOW

An MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs about the criteria for cohabitation in the AOW state pension after a newspaper case of a married woman facing a pension reduction, and asked for the guidelines used. The state secretary explained that married and registered partners receive 50% of the minimum wage each, while unmarried cohabitants are treated as married only if they share a household (shared housing plus mutual financial or other care), judged case by case under case law, and sent an exploration of alternatives to the current cohabitation criterion.
The implementing agency determines, based on objective factual circumstances in the individual case, whether there is a shared household.
De uitvoeringsinstantie stelt op basis van objectieve feitelijke omstandigheden in het individuele geval vast of er sprake is van een gezamenlijke huishouding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over pensioenen

An MP asked how many Dutch residents are entitled to and receive Greek state pensions, how many have sought SVB help, and whether the government has contacted other countries or Greece. The State Secretary answered that the government lacks data on entitlements and payments, has received only a few signals, and sees no need for further action, while noting that collecting the pension is the pensioner's own responsibility.
I do not know how many people residing in the Netherlands are entitled to a pension from the Greek state.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel personen die woonachtig zijn in Nederland recht hebben op een pensioen van de Griekse staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot, Monasch en Omtzigt over het mislukken van het overleg over directe huurtoeslagbetaling aan woningbouwcorporaties

MPs Groot, Monasch and Omtzigt asked why the motion-based arrangement for direct payment of rent allowance (huurtoeslag) to housing associations failed. The State Secretary answered that housing association umbrella body Aedes judged the partnership arrangement commercially unviable, and that no alternative route for direct payment is available within the legal framework.
I see no possibilities, within the statutory scheme and the conditions attached to it, to give direct payment of rent allowance to housing corporations an alternative form.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om binnen de wettelijke regeling en de daarbij geldende randvoorwaarden een directe betaling van huurtoeslag aan woningcorporaties op alternatieve wijze vorm te geven.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de inning van Europese douanerechten in Nederland en de boetes die Brussel heeft opgelegd aan Nederland voor het niet, incorrect of onvolledig innen van Europese douanerechten

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Netherlands' performance in collecting EU customs duties (traditional own resources) and about EU liability claims against the Netherlands for uncollected or misallocated duties. The government disputed the comparability of an EU Parliament report, explained collection rates and fraud trends, and listed liability amounts paid or contested since 2006.
The Netherlands informed the European Commission that it cannot be held liable for errors of the customs authorities in question.
Nederland heeft de Europese Commissie medegedeeld dat Nederland niet aansprakelijk kan worden gehouden voor fouten van de douaneautoriteiten in kwestie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de exclusieve afnameverplichtingen tussen brouwers en horecaondernemers op de biermarkt en het effect van aangekondigde maatregelen in de grensregio

Two MPs (Mulder and Omtzigt, CDA) asked about exclusive beer purchase obligations between brewers and hospitality businesses, expected beer excise revenue, cross-border beer consumption, and the financial effects of planned excise measures in border regions. The state secretary answered that the market must function effectively, gave the 2012 excise revenue figures, said data on cross-border consumers is not recorded, declined to give a calculation rule for the excise effect, and promised to inventory relevant memos and send any found separately by end of October.
This request cannot be met in the short term. This will first have to be inventoried.
Aan dit verzoek is niet op korte termijn te tegemoet te komen. Dit zal eerst moeten worden geïnventariseerd.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en AgnesMulder (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Economische Zaken over arrest van het hof in Luxemburg 219/12(Finanzamt Freistadt Rohrbach Urfahr tegen Una

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance about the CJEU ruling C-219/12 (Fuchs), which treats solar panel operation for feed-in as VAT-relevant economic activity, including why the Netherlands did not intervene, retroactive VAT recovery, administrative burden, and whether it would push for a directive change. The state secretary answered that there is no retroactive effect, that the small business exemption and annual form apply, that the revenue loss will be covered, and that the Netherlands has raised the matter with the Commission and will seek a directive amendment.
I consider the outcome of the ruling undesirable, but see no legal room in the ruling to deny entrepreneurship when the conditions are met.
Ik acht de uitkomst van het arrest ongewenst, maar zie in het arrest geen juridische ruimte om het ondernemerschap te ontkennen

Vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat slechts ongeveer de helft van de diplomaten in Den Haag hun verkeersboete betaa

Two CDA MPs asked whether roughly half of diplomats in The Hague leave their traffic fines unpaid, how many fines Dutch diplomats abroad pay, which countries complained, which ten missions owe the most, and what action is taken. The government confirmed the non-payment, said no central figures exist for fines abroad, listed the ten missions with the largest arrears, and described quarterly reminders and occasional summons, noting it lacks enforcement tools. It also gave a limited answer on minister car fines, pointing to published overviews.
No central figures are available on fines and traffic fines imposed abroad on officials and family members sent out by the Netherlands.
Er zijn op centraal niveau geen cijfermatige gegevens beschikbaar van in het buitenland opgelegde boetes en verkeersboetes aan door Nederland uitgezonden ambtenaren en hun gezinsleden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de uitspraken van de Russische minister van Sport

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether Russia's anti-gay law would apply to athletes at the Sochi Winter Olympics, whether Russia would guarantee non-interference, and how the Dutch government would act under its human rights note and EU LGBTI guidelines. The government condemned the law as discriminatory, reported the IOC's written guarantee from Russia, and committed to raising the issue in the EU Foreign Affairs Council and in bilateral contacts.
The Netherlands will continue to press internationally that the anti-gay propaganda law not be applied to participants and visitors during the 2014 Winter Games.
Nederland zal in internationaal verband er op blijven aandringen dat de anti-homopropagandawet tijdens de Winterspelen in 2014 niet op deelnemers en bezoekers wordt toegepast.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, De Rouwe en AgnesMulder (allen CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken over de BPM, de wegenbelasting, de KIA, de MIA

Three CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance whether a Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV and a Tesla S Performance can be bought with near-zero tax burden via BPM exemption, KIA, MIA, Vamil, a 0% company-car addition and no road tax, and how this compares to conventional cars and CO2 emissions trading prices. The government confirmed the tax treatment, provided worked net-cost calculations, and said it would present measures on electric car incentives around Prinsjesdag.
In this context I inform you that around Prinsjesdag I will send your House a letter presenting a number of measures to arrive at a more balanced form of stimulating (semi-)electric cars.

In het kader van het bovenstaande deel ik u mede dat ik omstreeks Prinsjesdag een brief aan uw Kamer zal doen toekomen, waarin ik een aantal maatregelen aan u zal presenteren om te komen tot een meer evenwichtige vorm van stimulering van (semi) elektrische auto's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geurts over het bericht van de aangifte tegen Odfjell wegens het verzwijgen van een groot Methanol-incident

Opposition MPs Omtzigt and Geurts asked the government about reports that Odfjell concealed a major methanol incident in 2009, including whether it was reported, whether confidential dossiers can be made public, and whether management can be trusted. The state secretary said the incident should have been reported to the DCMR, that a criminal complaint has led to a prosecutor's assessment, that the dossier was released after a balancing test, and that Odfjell is under heightened supervision.

The public prosecution service informed the Minister of Security and Justice that it is currently considering whether, in view of this complaint, there is reason to launch a criminal investigation against Odfjell.

Het openbaar ministerie heeft de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie meegedeeld dat het momenteel beziet of er, gezien deze aangifte, aanleiding bestaat een daarop gericht strafrechtelijk onderzoek in te stellen tegen Odfjell.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het feit dat de regering, ondanks veel toezeggingen, nooit een plan gemaakt heeft om ingezetenen van Nederland met een buitenlands kenteken, belasting te laten betalen

Omtzigt (CDA) asks why the government, despite repeated promises, never produced a plan to make residents with foreign-registered cars pay Dutch motor vehicle tax, and when the promised letter and tax rules will arrive. State Secretary Weekers answers that residents must register cars in the Netherlands, that enforcement data is being collected, and that a letter with combined legislative and enforcement measures will follow, with legislation in the Belastingplan 2014.
The final touches are currently being put to it.
Daaraan wordt op dit moment de laatste hand gelegd.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over persvrijheid en demonstraties in Turkije

An MP asks the foreign minister about press freedom in Turkey, including journalist dismissals, arrests of demonstrators, use of anti-terrorism law and police violence. The minister confirms awareness, reports around 3,600 detentions (most released within 48 hours), no known anti-terrorism charges, five deaths, and that the outcome of investigations into excessive force is not yet clear.
There is not yet a clear picture of the progress and/or outcomes of such investigations, including that of the Turkish National Ombudsman.
Er is nog geen helder beeld van de voortgang en/of uitkomsten van dergelijke onderzoeken, waaronder dat van de Turkse Nationale Ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van de ledenr Omtzigt, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de EU-richtsnoeren over vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging

MPs Omtzigt, Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why the minister did not inform parliament in advance about the EU guidelines on freedom of religion or belief adopted in June 2013, and whether the Netherlands would discuss a ranking of persecuted religious minorities in EU fora. The minister answered that the guidelines were prepared in the Council working group, were not discussed substantively at the Foreign Affairs Council, will be communicated to parliament by letter, and that the freedom of religion topic will be raised in EU consultations after parliament debates the human rights note.
As promised to your House during the committee meeting on freedom of religion of 15 May, your House will be informed by letter about the adoption of these guidelines.
Zoals tijdens het AO godsdienstvrijheid van 15 mei jl. aan uw Kamer toegezegd, wordt uw Kamer per brief over de aanname van deze richtsnoeren geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Van Bommel over de nieuwe NGO-wet in Egypte

Six MPs asked the foreign minister whether Egypt's draft NGO law, despite amendments, still violates freedoms of expression and assembly, threatens human rights work and civil society, and whether the Netherlands has raised objections. The minister agreed the draft appears to conflict with Egypt's international obligations, said the Netherlands and the EU have raised concerns bilaterally and in multilateral fora, and noted the law is not yet adopted, with the EU to raise it if adopted.
Should a restrictive proposal nonetheless become law, I will raise it as soon as possible within the EU framework.
Mocht een restrictief voorstel toch wet worden dan zal ik dat zo spoedig mogelijk in EU-verband aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “Terugvorderen opbrengst belastingfraude moeilijk”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance and other ministers about reports that recovering proceeds of tax and benefit fraud is difficult, including fraud amounts and fines in a Deventer case, foreign childcare allowances, unregistered persons receiving allowances, Polish recipients, and EU residence and coordination rules. The government answered in detail, providing figures, explaining controls, and acknowledging some untraceable recipients and data limitations, while promising maatregelen to improve pre-payment checks and a later overview.
The correct amount cannot be given.
Het juiste bedrag is niet te geven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt betreffende de zorg aan militairen die niet onder de Zorgverzekeringswet valt

Two CDA MPs asked why active-duty soldiers, who are outside the Zorgverzekeringswet, end up with a higher taxable income and lower benefits than comparable employees, and whether this was deliberate. The State Secretary confirmed the difference, explained that soldiers' health costs run through the military insurer SZVK with a taxable employer share, called it a consequence of soldiers' special position and the Wet ULB, and described a one-off 2013 fix with a structural solution to follow for 2014.
For 2014 and onward, work is under way on a structural solution.
Voor 2014 en verder wordt gewerkt aan een structurele oplossing
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over een eventuele bijdrage van Nederland aan de EU trainingsmissie in Mali

Christian Democrat MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked why the Netherlands offered troops to the EU training mission in Mali without informing parliament, why the offer was not coordinated with Belgium, and whether defence cuts motivated participation. The government answered that the offer was made under political reservation during the force generation process, that the mission had no current need for it, and that participation decisions rest on substantive grounds, not budget considerations.
If the cabinet again considers a Dutch contribution in the future, the House will be informed about it.
Als het kabinet in de toekomst opnieuw een Nederlandse bijdrage overweegt, wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over geweld in Sudan en in Zuid-Sudan en de precaire situatie tussen beide landen

Two MPs from the CDA asked the government about violence in Sudan and South Sudan, human rights abuses, humanitarian access, the Abyei dispute, the suspension of oil transport, civil society space and the future of EU and AU mediation roles. The government answered at length, noting concern, backing AU-led mediation and cross-line humanitarian access, but declined to commit to new fact-finding missions and said the EU Special Representative's mandate would be transferred.
To verify the data in these reports, humanitarian access to these areas is needed, as well as an independent investigation into the human rights situation in South Kordofan and Blue Nile.

Om de gegevens in genoemde rapporten te kunnen verifiëren is humanitaire toegang tot deze gebieden nodig, alsmede een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de mensenrechtensituatie in South Kordofan en Blue Nile.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over witwaspraktijken op Cyprus

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether reports by Deloitte and Moneyval on money laundering in Cyprus were available, public, and linked to conditions for European aid tranches, and whether they gave a misleadingly incomplete picture. The minister answered that the reports were received and published on the Cypriot finance ministry website, that the problem lies in implementation rather than legislation, and that completing an action plan is a condition for the next aid tranche.

As also stated in the Eurogroup and Ecofin Council report of 13 and 14 May 2013, the research shows that the shortcomings lie not so much in the laws and regulations as in their implementation and compliance.

Zoals ook vermeld in het verslag van de Eurogroep en Ecofin Raad van 13 en 14 mei 2013 (met kenmerk BFB 2013-5174M) blijkt uit het onderzoek dat niet zozeer in de wet- en regelgeving tekortkomingen zijn, maar in de implementatie en naleving hiervan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Omtzigt over het gezag van het Internationaal Strafhof in Afrika

MPs Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel and Omtzigt asked the government how it responds to African Union accusations that the ICC targets Africans, to the AU call to refer the Kenyatta and Ruto cases to Kenyan courts, and to the effects on the ICC's standing, and what the Netherlands did at the AU summit.
