The minister rejects the AU claims, notes the ICC acts independently and that half of African situations were referred by states or the UN Security Council, says the Kenyan admissibility challenge was rejected, and describes bilateral and EU efforts to support the ICC in Africa without committing to a new report on the summit.
The cabinet disagrees with the statements of the African Union chairperson, Hailemariam Desalegn, which imply that the ICC is biased.
Het kabinet is het oneens met de uitspraken van de voorzitter van de Afrikaanse Unie, Hailemariam Desalegn, waarin wordt geïmpliceerd dat het ICC vooringenomen zou zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel 'Timmermans goede bedoelingen brengen Syrië dichter bij de hel'

MP Omtzigt asks the Foreign Minister whether arming Syrian rebels and recognising the Syrian National Coalition are compatible with international law, citing the non-intervention principle, Austria's position, and risks of weapons reaching extremists. Minister Timmermans answers that recognition is a political act, that arms supply is not currently under consideration, that non-intervention is a norm which may be set aside in exceptional cases, and refers to a letter of 4 June for legal analysis, declining to seek new advice or publish the legal opinions.
For the reasons stated in the above letter, the cabinet understands that the non-intervention principle is coming under pressure.
Vanwege de redenen aangegeven in bovengenoemde brief heeft het kabinet er begrip voor dat het non-interventiebeginsel onder druk komt te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Omtzigt over een werkbezoek aan het Internationaal Strafhof

MPs Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the ICC's staffing shortage, the consequences of closing the Scheveningen prison for detainees, and whether witnesses are admitted to the Netherlands long enough. The minister said the Netherlands is in dialogue with the ICC and supports strengthening its investigative capacity, referred the prison question to the Justice State Secretary's earlier answer stating detention for international tribunals continues in Scheveningen, and said he was unaware of witness admission problems, pointing to the host-state agreement.
The Netherlands is aware of the ICC's concerns about limited staffing capacity and is in dialogue with the ICC about it.
Nederland is bekend met de zorgen van het ICC over de beperkte personele capaciteit en is hierover met het ICC in gesprek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het arrest van het Europees Hof van Justitie in zaak C-398/11

An MP asks the state secretary and foreign minister about the CJEU ruling in case C-398/11 (Hogan), which held that member states may be liable if insolvency wipes out half or more of occupational pension rights, and about its consequences for the Netherlands, European liability schemes and the government's position. The government confirms awareness, says the ruling is still being analysed with results promised before the summer recess, states no European guarantee proposal exists, and describes the Dutch position in the hearing.
The CJEU judgment in the Hogan case (C-398/11) is currently being analysed.
Het arrest van het Hof van Justitie in de zaak Hogan (C-398/11) wordt op dit moment geanalyseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Voordewind over de mensenrechtennota

MPs asked when the human rights note would reach parliament, whether the old note still guides policy, and how much was spent from the human rights fund since the new cabinet took office. The minister replied that the letter will be sent after cabinet approval, that it will state continuity and new emphases, and that ongoing commitments from the fund have been honoured.
The human rights letter will be sent to the House immediately after the Council of Ministers has approved it.
De mensenrechtenbrief wordt direct nadat de Ministerraad deze heeft goedgekeurd aan de Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis en Ten Broeke over de detentie van Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi-Arabië

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister whether the four-month detention of human rights activist Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi Arabia was justified, whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that he is a prisoner of conscience, and whether it will urge Saudi Arabia to release him. The minister answered that the EU is investigating the background of the arrest with Saudi bodies, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands generally raises human rights defender issues with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de btw-heffing bij zelfstandigen in de zorg

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked whether self-employed nurses in hospitals, who are exempt from VAT under the BIG-registration logic, should charge 21% VAT, and how this squares with Article 10 of the VAT Directive and a Breda court ruling. The state secretary answers that such nurses are treated like temporary-staffing agencies, that the work is taxable labour provision, that the Tax Authority has appealed the Breda ruling, and that payment arrangements exist for back-tax assessments.
The Tax Authority has therefore lodged an appeal against the Breda district court ruling.
De Belastingdienst heeft daarom hoger beroep ingesteld tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank Breda.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Wet uniformering loonbegrip

MP Omtzigt asked whether the Wet uniformering loonbegrip (article 11d Wet LB), which excludes the Zvw income-dependent contribution from taxable wages, unfairly disadvantages cross-border workers insured abroad, including Belgian and German employees working in the Netherlands and Dutch residents working in Belgium. The state secretary answered that the rule does not apply to workers insured under foreign schemes, so the Uitvoeringsregeling is not unlawful, but that a comparable provision will be added for foreign situations and the 2009 decree will be updated.

To remove the distinction between employees under the Dutch Zorgverzekeringswet and employees under a comparable foreign scheme, I will include in a bill for foreign situations a provision comparable to article 11d of the Wet op de loonbelasting 1964.

Om het onderscheid tussen werknemers die onder de Nederlandse Zorgverzekeringswet vallen en werknemers die onder een vergelijkbaar buitenlands stelsel vallen, weg te nemen, zal ik in een wetsvoorstel voor de buitenlandse situaties een aan artikel 11d van de Wet op de loonbelasting 1964 vergelijkbare bepaling opnemen.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, Omtzigt en Voordewind over Islamitisch-extremistisch geweld tegen christenen in Nigeria

MPs Van der Staaij, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the foreign minister about Islamist violence against Christians in northern Nigeria, including whether the Nigerian state is failing to protect its citizens and what the Netherlands and the EU will do. The minister acknowledged the violence, said Nigeria bears national responsibility and that the Netherlands will raise it bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, but gave no concrete commitments beyond ongoing dialogue and EU follow-up.
The Netherlands will, through the usual multilateral channels and mainly in the bilateral relationship with Nigeria, point to Nigeria's national responsibility for protecting its citizens.

Nederland zal via de gebruikelijke multilaterale kanalen en vooral in de bilaterale relatie met Nigeria wijzen op de nationale verantwoordelijkheid van Nigeria ten aanzien van de bescherming van haar burgers.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Bonis, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over de ontvoering van twee Syrische bisschoppen

MPs from eight parties asked the foreign minister whether the government knew of the abduction of two Syrian bishops, whether their driver was killed, and whether the Netherlands would seek mediation with the parties to the conflict. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to give details on the circumstances or the bishops' status, and said the Netherlands is working with EU partners and the Syrian opposition to secure their release and promised to inform the House.

Regarding the precise circumstances of the abduction of Bishop Boulos Yazigi and Bishop Yohanna Ibrahim and the specific question of whether their driver was killed, it is not possible to provide further information.

Over de precieze omstandigheden van de ontvoering van bisschop Boulos Yazigi en bisschop Yohanna Ibrahim en de concrete vraag of hun chauffeur hierbij is gedood is het niet mogelijk nadere inlichtingen te verschaffen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over "harde eisen van de arbeidsinspectie aan Odfjell na ernstige overtredingen" (De bijlage is ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd, alleen voor de leden, bij het Centraal I

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked whether the Labour Inspectorate's 2007 letter with eleven hard demands to Odfjell was complied with, and asked for the full file and all inspectorate letters to Odfjell over ten years to be made public. Minister Asscher confirmed the letter, listed the inspection visits and which violations were resolved, noted that the ATEX violation led to a criminal report and court ruling, and made the file and letters available only for confidential inspection by MPs due to the company's commercial interests.
Given Odfjell's commercial interests, I make this data available to your House only for confidential inspection.
Gelet op het bedrijfsbelang van Odfjell stel ik u deze gegevens vertrouwelijk, alleen ter inzage aan uw Kamer, ter beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over toenemend geweld tegen en onderdrukking van christenen in Indonesië

An MP asks the foreign minister about rising violence against and suppression of Christians in Indonesia, including attacks on churchgoers, impunity, church closures and permit problems, and asks what the government will do. The minister acknowledges increased attacks on religious minorities, weak local protection and insufficient prosecution, says Indonesia's decentralisation complicates matters, and commits to raising the issue bilaterally, at the UN and in an upcoming debate.
I take the Archbishop of Jakarta's remarks seriously and agree that a more effective approach to violence against persons belonging to religious minorities is needed.
Ik neem de uitlatingen van de aartsbisschop van Jakarta hierover serieus en ben het met hem eens dat een effectievere aanpak van geweld tegen personen behorend tot religieuze minderheden nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Birma/Myanmar

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Myanmar meets the EU's four criteria for keeping sanctions suspended, including release of political prisoners, humanitarian access and Rohingya status, and whether the EU should postpone lifting sanctions. The minister acknowledged the remaining problems but said reforms were welcomed, sanctions were lifted with the arms embargo kept, and the EU should keep raising concerns.
The foreign ministers welcomed these reforms at the Council of 22 April and decided to lift the sanctions suspended in 2012 to support reform-minded forces in the country.

De ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken verwelkomden deze hervormingen in de Raad van 22 april jl. en besloten de in 2012 opgeschorte sancties op te heffen om de hervormingsgezinde krachten in het land te ondersteunen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de publicatie “Medezeggenschap bij PPI is juridische gatenkaas”

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary whether works council consent rights extend to the implementation agreement when a pension scheme is placed with a premium pension institution (PPI), following a critical article in Pensioen en Praktijk. The State Secretary answered that consent rights cover the pension agreement, not the implementation agreement, acknowledged this departs from earlier parliamentary statements, and declined to legislate for clarity, saying the answers suffice.
I do not believe that the way participation rights at the PPI have been regulated and explained gives rise to unclarity.
Ik ben niet van mening dat de wijze waarop de medezeggenschap bij de PPI is geregeld en toegelicht, aanleiding geeft tot onduidelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de salarissen en arbeidsvoorwaarden van EU-ambtenaren

MP Omtzigt asked the foreign minister why the promised information on EU civil servants' pay and allowances, relative to the Dutch prime minister's salary, had not been delivered in time for the February 2013 debate, and whether the government had consulted the European Commission. The minister replied that he had discussed the requested comparison with the responsible Commissioner and would continue contact in May, promising to inform parliament afterwards.
I have explained the requested comparison to the responsible Commissioner and discussed it with him. I will continue this contact in May.
Ik heb de gevraagde vergelijking aan de verantwoordelijke commissaris toegelicht en met hem besproken. Dit contact zal ik in mei voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Heerma over de kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked whether working lone parents living with a parent lost childcare allowance after the 2012 partner rules change, whether they were warned, whether allowance remains for shared households, and whether they will compensate affected parents. The minister confirmed the partner rule can strip allowance, that notification was given via general communication and personal letters, and that compensation is not proposed without a parliamentary decision because of budgetary consequences.
Het gaat dan om ca. 4,6 miljoen belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het aanvragen van de voorlopige aanslag

An MP asked why the tax authority no longer automatically imposes provisional income tax assessments for 2013 and whether taxpayers can be exposed to unexpected large bills. The state secretary answered that about 3.9 million provisional assessments were issued, roughly 0.1 million could not be issued due to the Wet uniformering loonbegrip, affected people were asked to reapply, and the government denied a structural increase in administrative burden.

Therefore it was decided not to impose a first provisional assessment in these cases, but to ask these citizens by letter – if they believe they are nevertheless entitled to a first provisional assessment – to submit a new application.

Daarom is besloten in deze gevallen geen eerste voorlopige aanslag op te leggen, maar deze burgers per brief te vragen – als zij menen toch recht te hebben op een eerste voorlopige aanslag – een nieuwe aanvraag in te dienen.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over Duitse pensioenen

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about German pensions paid to Dutch residents, including whether war-victims' and military pensions reach Dutch tax authorities, whether SS-related pensions are withdrawn, and whether AOW is stopped for prisoners. The State Secretary replies that the tax service now receives automatic data on German statutory pensions but not military pensions, that German pension matters are largely a German internal affair, and that the answers to several questions are not available in the Netherlands.
There is no data available in the Netherlands showing how many Dutch nationals were entitled to a German pension due to German military service.
Er zijn in Nederland geen gegevens beschikbaar waaruit blijkt hoeveel Nederlanders recht hadden op een pensioen uit Duitsland vanwege Duitse krijgsdienst.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over nieuwe stappen gezet ten aanzien van de buitenlandse financiering van Russische niet-gouvernementele organisaties

Mr. Omtzigt (CDA) asked whether the government knows of and assesses new Russian steps on foreign funding of NGOs, whether Russia's human rights situation has worsened under Putin, and what the EU and the Netherlands will do about it. Minister Timmermans answers that the government has repeatedly voiced concern about Russian NGO legislation, will raise human rights with Putin, and that the EU has discussed Russia's internal situation, without committing to a concrete new step.
Since the legislation on NGOs (foreign funding and labelling as 'foreign agent') came up in Russia last summer, my EU colleagues and I have repeatedly expressed our concerns to Russia.

Vanaf het moment dat wetgeving inzake NGO's (buitenlandse financiering en betiteling als «buitenlands agent») vorige zomer in Rusland aan de orde is, hebben mijn EU-collega's en ikzelf hier herhaaldelijk tegenover Rusland onze zorgen kenbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over recentelijke aanval op de christelijke gemeenschap in Lahore

MP Omtzigt asked the foreign minister about the March 2013 attack on Christians in Lahore, alleged involvement of ruling-party politicians, misuse of blasphemy law, education curricula and GSP+ human rights benchmarks. The minister answered that the ambassador expressed sympathy, that confirmation of MPs' involvement is unavailable while Dutch and EU efforts urge prosecution, and that Pakistan's GSP+ assessment will be tested against 27 international conventions.
Confirmed information on this is not available.
Geconfirmeerde informatie hierover is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt betreffende derivaten

Deputy Omtzigt asked the Interior and Finance ministers about derivative positions of the central government, local authorities and their participations, including whether regional and municipal participations hold derivatives and what rules apply, and asked about specific cases such as Slibverwerkingsbedrijf Noord-Brabant and PWN. Minister Plasterk answered that participations are privately organised and fall outside the Fido and Ruddo regimes, that accountability for them lies with the local councils and shareholder governance, and promised a separate letter on Groningen Seaports and a later inventory of central government derivative positions.
I am not responsible for supervising these private-law organisations.
Ik ben niet belast met het toezicht op deze privaatrechtelijke organisaties.

Antwoord vragen Knops en Omtzigt over de problemen als gevolg van de huidige regelgeving met betrekking tot  hypotheekrenteaftrek die kunnen optreden voor mensen met een eigen woning die in scheiding liggen

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the government about problems for divorcing homeowners with negative equity under current mortgage interest deduction rules, including sale times, tax treatment at divorce, and bank conditions. The minister replied that existing measures (restschuld financing, temporary tax deduction on residual debt, divorce exceptions, extended move-out periods) are sufficient within budget limits, declined to extend the divorce term or relax the amortisation requirement, and said banks reassess the finances of the remaining partner.

Within the tight budgetary margins caused by the current economic crisis, this is currently the maximum that can be done about the problem of homes being underwater and its consequences for taxpayers going through divorce.

Binnen de – door de huidige economische crisis – krappe budgettaire marges is dit op dit moment het maximale dat gedaan kan worden aan het probleem van het «onder water staan» van woningen en de gevolgen daarvan voor belastingplichtigen die aan het scheiden zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de kwaliteit van de cijfers van de Spaanse overheidsfinanciën

MPs Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about the reliability of Spanish deficit figures, the accounting of bank capital injections, and retroactive ESM bank recapitalisation. The minister answered that Spanish and Commission deficit figures are broadly consistent once financial-sector interventions are included, that Eurostat applies rules consistently case by case, and that the Netherlands is very reluctant about retroactive ESM recapitalisation.
There is no reason to assume that the rules are being bargained over.
Er is geen reden aan te nemen dat er gemarchandeerd wordt met de regels.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over Turkse pleegkinderen in Europa

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked about a Turkish parliamentary committee chair's claim that Turkey might reclaim Turkish children placed with Christian or gay foster families in Europe, the Hague Convention, and foster-care numbers. The government rejected any idea of Turkish reclaiming of children under the 1961 Convention, said it does not hold the data on Turkish-passport children in care, and offered only to explain Dutch foster-care decision-making if Turkey asks.
I do not have this information.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de Iraanse gevangene Nasrin Sotoudeh

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the imprisonment of Iranian human rights lawyer Nasrin Sotoudeh, the outcome of an Iranian parliamentary inquiry, the conviction of lawyer Mohammad Ali Dadkhah, and EU action. The minister described her sentence, said the Iranian delegation's findings may not be published, confirmed Dadkhah's sentence and Dutch concern, and reported new EU sanctions and repeated EU calls for release.
If the results of their inquiry are made public, which is not certain, I will share them with your House.
Als de resultaten van hun onderzoek publiek worden gemaakt, wat niet zeker is, zal ik deze aan uw Kamer mededelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitspraak van het Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens van 3 juli 2012 in de zaak Loetsenko versus Oekraine

MP Omtzigt asks the Foreign Minister about the European Court of Human Rights ruling in Lutsenko v. Ukraine, which found Lutsenko was detained for non-legal reasons in breach of Article 18, and whether Ukraine has implemented it, whether the appeal delay was raised, and what conditions the EU set for an association agreement and public pressure on political prisoners. The minister answers that Ukraine must implement the ruling under Article 46, that the Committee of Ministers is supervising, that the EU and bilateral channels have raised the case, and that signing depends on rule-of-law conditions.
Once information on further implementation by Ukraine is made available, I will form a judgement on it.
Zodra informatie over verdere tenuitvoerlegging door Oekraïne beschikbaar wordt gesteld zal ik mij daarover een oordeel vormen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat de Palestijnse Autoriteit overweegt om Israël aan te klagen bij het Internationaal Strafhof voor de detentie van kinderen

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that the Palestinian Authority may bring Israel before the ICC over child detention, the reported rise in Palestinian child detentions, and Dutch responses. The minister said the ICC decides on cases, no concrete Palestinian steps are indicated, child detention numbers rose in 2012 though exact figures are unavailable, and Israel has announced a law reducing pre-trial detention of minors.
The Israel Prison Service and the Israel Defense Force (IDF) do not publish data on the number of children arrested and questioned who were then not detained.
De Israel Prison Service en de Israel Defense Force (IDF) geen gegevens openbaar maken van het aantal kinderen dat is gearresteerd, ondervraagd en vervolgens niet in hechtenis is genomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het programma van de conferentie in Oslo over de Humanitarian Impact of Nuclear Weapons

MP Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the programme of the Oslo conference on the humanitarian impact of nuclear weapons, whether the Netherlands has assessed such impacts and its emergency services' preparedness, and about the delegation and briefing. The minister confirmed the conference's relevance, pointed to existing crisis preparedness and a delegation with crisis-response expertise, and promised to inform parliament later about the discussion.
At an appropriate time, the House will be informed about the discussion that took place.
Bij gelegenheid zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de gevoerde discussie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de premieovereenkomst voor pensioenen (DC-regeling)

An MP asks the state secretary whether employers switch from DB to DC pensions for cost reasons, whether DC members can build an adequate pension given fiscal staffels based on 4% (or 3%) assumed returns versus lower market rates and a 2.4% illustrative rate, and why annuity purchase and mortality tables are outdated. The government answers that adequacy is possible within the legal framework, that the 4% assumption is reasonable, that a new premium staffel with updated mortality tables was issued end 2012, and that DC and DB fiscal room are equal overall.
Yes, that is possible within the legal framework.
Ja, dat is mogelijk binnen het wettelijke kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de arbeidsvoorwaarden van de EU-ambtenaren

An MP asked the ministers about EU civil servant pay and pensions, including the lapse of the 5.5% solidarity levy, salary comparisons with US and Dutch officials, and the Council's role in the salary dispute. The government answered that the levy lapsed, gave salary figures, and blamed the impasse on the Commission's salary method and the need for an MFK administrative ceiling.
The salary tables you received with Parliamentary Paper 32 833, no. 9 are current. The adjustments for 2012 and 2013 are not yet available.
De salaristabellen die u ontving bij Kamerstuk 32 833, nr. 9 zijn actueel. De aanpassingen voor 2012 en 2013 zijn nog niet beschikbaar
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat de minister geen lijst kan presenteren van artsen waarmee de IGZ een deal heeft gesloten om te stoppen met werken

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked why the minister cannot provide a complete list of IGZ restrictive agreements with doctors since 2000, and whether such agreements are lawful, including the case of Jansen Steur before the 2014 limitation date. The minister answered that the IGZ never systematically recorded these agreements, estimated 10-20 per year, said legality is for the courts, and explained tuchtrecht options against Jansen Steur while promising stronger registration and ICT investment.
Because restrictive agreements were not systematically recorded by the IGZ in the past, including by its regional offices, it is not possible to provide a detailed overview.

Omdat de beroepsbeperkende afspraken in het verleden door de IGZ niet structureel zijn bijgehouden – ook niet door haar regiokantoren – is het niet mogelijk om hiervan een (gedetailleerd) overzicht te geven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over het bericht "Duitse Patriot-militairen belaagd in zuiden Turkije"

Omtzigt and Knops (CDA) asked the Foreign and Defence ministers about reports that German Patriot soldiers were harassed in southern Turkey, and whether further unrest and host-nation funding for the Patriot deployment are expected. Minister Timmermans answered that the soldiers were unharmed, that demonstrations are small and the Patriots enjoy broad Turkish support, and that the NATO-Turkey funding agreement was completed on 12 January 2013 without being hindered by the anti-Western sentiment.
De militairen zijn niet gewond geraakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Van Hijum over de Nationale Hypotheekgarantie

CDA MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked the ministers about the Nationale Hypotheekgarantie (NHG): claim numbers, debt write-offs, sale methods, approval of forced sales, controls on lenders and the maximum state risk. Minister Blok answered with WEW data, noting forced-sale approval rules were tightened from 1 January 2013 and that the maximum exposure is well below the guaranteed EUR 149 billion.
The WEW states it has no data on this.
Het WEW geeft aan hierover geen gegevens te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Van Hijum over executieveilingen en onderhandse executies

Three CDA MPs asked ministers about foreclosure auctions and private sales of homes, citing lower prices, falling auction numbers, bank conduct, notaries' role and NMa cartel fines. Minister Blok answered that auction prices are lower for structural reasons, that data on private foreclosure sales are incomplete, that the pending bill on foreclosure auctions and existing NHG and AFM measures are the response, and that no new legislation or research is planned.
There is no publicly available data on the number of private foreclosure sales for the entire Dutch housing market.
Er zijn geen openbaar beschikbare gegevens over de aantallen onderhandse verkopen voor de gehele Nederlandse woningmarkt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over het bericht van 4 januari jl. in het Financieel Dagblad “Toezichthouder negeerde risico Vestia”,

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the minister whether the Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw (WSW) lawfully guaranteed loans for housing corporation Vestia despite its large equity and its derivative exposure, and who is accountable. The minister answered that the WSW followed its own rules, declined to disclose individual loan and derivative details citing commercial sensitivity, and said the CFV and WSW each had a limited supervisory role.
Information at the WSW on individual loans and derivatives is commercially sensitive, so the WSW cannot provide it without prior written consent from the participant.

De informatie bij het WSW met betrekking tot (individuele) leningen en derivaten is bedrijfsgevoelig en kan het WSW derhalve niet verstrekken zonder voorafgaande schriftelijke toestemming van de deelnemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Bonis, Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over sluiting van maatschappelijke organisaties door de regering van Sudan

MPs from PvdA, CDA and D66 asked the Dutch government whether it shares EU concerns about Sudan's closure of civil society organisations, whether it will press Khartoum to reverse this, and how it supports the closed groups and threatened rights defenders. The government answered yes to each point, said the EU and member states will raise the closures with Sudanese authorities, and described ongoing contact and programme support for civil society and rights defenders.
The closure of the civil society organisation will be raised with the Sudanese authorities shortly, jointly by the EU and a number of EU member states present in Sudan, including the Netherlands.

De sluiting van de maatschappelijke organisatie zal op korte termijn gezamenlijk door de EU en een aantal in Sudan aanwezige EU-lidstaten, waaronder Nederland, bij de Sudanese autoriteiten worden aangekaart.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het rapport van Human Rights Watch waaruit blijkt dat Syrische oppositiegroepen kerken plunderen

Members Omtzigt, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister about a Human Rights Watch report on Syrian opposition groups looting churches, including who was responsible, whether sectarian violence is increasing, and whether attacks on religious buildings are war crimes for the ICC. The minister answered that responsibility cannot be established, acknowledged the sectarian trend and the crime, but said the ICC cannot act without a Security Council referral, which the Netherlands supports, and that the letter to the Council did not specifically mention church attacks.
No. Is it possible to establish which groups were responsible for these lootings?
Vraag 2 Is vast te stellen welke groepen verantwoordelijk zijn geweest voor deze plunderingen?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pechtold, Van Bommel, Madlener, Van der Staaij, Ouwehand en Segers over het rapport “Seventeenth Bi-annual Report: Developments in European Union Procedures  en Practices Relevant

MPs asked the foreign minister about the COSAC report on parliamentary scrutiny of EU documents, including why the Dutch parliament lacks access to Council documents marked EU Restricted and Limité that Austrian MPs can see. The minister answered that both chambers will receive direct access to all Limité documents, that Limité is a distribution code rather than a classification, and that the Dutch parliament is already as well informed as the Austrian and European Parliaments.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “PvdA niet tevreden met regeling AOW-gat"

The MP Omtzigt asked the state secretary about press reports that most early-retirement and pre-pension recipients would not qualify for the new AOW bridging allowance, and about the feasibility, legal form, EU coordination and cross-border health cover of the scheme. The government answered that roughly 80-90% of early-retirees fall outside the means test, that the scheme is a ministerial regulation under the Kaderwet SZW-subsidies with a commitment to brief parliament, and that a legal fix to Zvw article 69 will close the health-cover gap retroactively.
Given the importance of the subject, however, I attach great value to closely involving the House of Representatives in the drafting of the scheme.
Gelet echter op het belang van het onderwerp hecht ik er zeer aan om de Tweede Kamer nauw bij het tot stand komen van de regeling te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over de rapporten over de BRZO-rapportage van Odfjell van oktober 2012

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked the state secretary about the October 2012 BRZO inspection reports on Odfjell, fines imposed on Seveso firms, incident reports, safety after the reorganisation, pipe-thickness checks and whistleblower channels. The secretary released the inspection report, which found violations enforced against but not dangerous enough to stop operations, and described the monitoring, enforcement and whistleblower arrangements, promising a monitoring report by mid-2013.
The inspection report for inspection days 1, 9, 10, 11, 16 and 17 October 2012 was released on 8 February 2013.
Het inspectierapport van inspectiedagen 1, 9, 10, 11, 16 en 17 oktober 2012 is op 8 februari 2013 vrijgegeven.
Antwoord vragen Keijzer en Omtzigt over casussen van verontruste burgers

CDA MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked the state secretary of Health about anonymised citizen cases showing sharply higher care contributions from the asset-income surcharge (VIB) and about treatment of homes, letselschade, landgoederen and the pocket-money threshold. The secretary answered most questions in substance, admitted some cases did not reconcile with available data, pointed to CAK follow-up, and said the revenue estimate was still too early to confirm.
I am consulting with the CAK to determine how this limited group of clients should be handled.
Ik ben in overleg met het CAK om te bezien hoe met deze beperkte groep cliënten om kan worden gegaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over het wetsvoorstel dat de pensioenen voor politieke ambtsdragers moderniseert

MPs Van Toorenburg and Omtzigt asked why the bill modernising pensions for political office holders, announced for 1 January 2013, had not yet been submitted, and when it went to the Council of State. The minister explains that adjusting the Appa pension to a flexible retirement age is complex and that the bill will be sent to Parliament around 1 March 2013.
Yes, the bill will be sent to you around 1 March 2013.
Ja, het wetsvoorstel ontvangt u omstreeks 1 maart 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt en Van Bommel over de verplaatsing van de inwoners van Kamp New Iraq (voormalig Kamp Ashraf) naar Kamp Hurriya

MPs Omtzigt and Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about reports that conditions in Kamp Hurriya are very poor, UNHCR's position, the progress of the transfer from Kamp New Iraq and the asylum status of residents. The minister answered that conditions meet UN standards, denied the UNHCR claim, and gave figures on interviews and resettlement options while stating Dutch concern is channelled through the Iraqi government.
Living conditions in Camp Hurriya regarding water, food and electricity meet the conditions of the United Nations (UN).
De leefomstandigheden in Kamp Hurriya op het gebied van water, voedsel en elektriciteit voldoen aan de voorwaarden van de Verenigde Naties (VN).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vermeende aangifte wegens ambtelijke corruptie tegen dhr J. van Rey

The MP Omtzigt asked whether a Belastingdienst official filed a corruption complaint against sitting Senator J. van Rey, how suspects are notified, what rules apply to complaints against parliamentarians, and who in government was informed. Minister Opstelten answered that the procedure was followed without deviation, that no specific rules exist for complaints against MPs, and that a criminal investigation is ongoing so further details cannot be given.
Given the interests of this criminal investigation, which is still ongoing, I cannot go into further detail.
Gelet op de belangen van dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat nog gaande is, kan ik niet verder in detail treden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat dhr. Jansen Steur zich in 2006 geregistreerd heeft in Duitsland als arts?

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether Jansen Steur registered as a doctor in Germany in 2006, which bodies knew, how the IGZ and prosecutors handled the matter, and why he was allowed to work abroad. The minister confirmed the German registration, explained the IGZ's 2006 decisions and the ongoing criminal case, and said he cannot work in the Netherlands because he is not BIG-registered.
The Public Prosecution Service sent several requests for legal assistance to the German authorities in the investigation that led to the case now pending before the Almelo court.

Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft in het kader van het onderzoek dat heeft geleid tot de rechtszaak die nu aanhangig is bij de rechtbank Almelo, meerdere rechtshulpverzoeken doen uitgaan naar de Duitse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Omtzigt en Rog over het onderzoek in de affaire Jansen Steur

Three CDA MPs asked the health and education ministers whether the scientific work of neurologist Jansen Steur should be examined, why no body had reviewed it earlier, and about his publications and drug-trial involvement. The minister agreed the reasoning on unreliable research is sound, explained that the IGZ halted its probe after the criminal investigation was dropped, and promised to consult Medisch Spectrum Twente and the KNAW on reviewing the publications.
I will first consult with the former employer of Mr Jansen Steur, Medisch Spectrum Twente, on the design and results of the study into publications set up by that institution.

Er zal door mij eerst met de voormalige werkgever van de heer Jansen Steur, Medisch Spectrum Twente, overlegd worden over opzet en resultaten van het door deze instelling opgezette onderzoek naar publicaties
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de beroepsbeperkende afspraken door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about the legal basis and enforceability of informal professional restriction agreements the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) made with doctors, notably the Jansen Steur case, and about limitation periods and transparency. The minister replied that since 2010 the IGZ uses only public-law measures, that past agreements were not centrally registered, and that IGZ can request expedited tuchtrecht handling but will not reopen past agreements, while promising to refer one question to the CBG.
Since September 2010 the policy is that the IGZ may no longer make private-law professional restriction agreements, but uses its statutory powers to take public-law measures.

Sinds september 2010 geldt het beleid dat de IGZ geen privaatrechtelijke, beroepsbeperkende afspraken meer mag maken, maar gebruik maakt van haar wettelijke bevoegdheden om publiekrechtelijke maatregelen te treffen.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de multiplier in de Geefwet

Parliamentarian Omtzigt asked for an overview of all laws, schemes and projects for which the Dutch government sought European Commission approval but had not yet received an answer, with dates of formal requests. Minister Timmermans replied that EU law generally does not require prior Commission approval of national legislation, with exceptions such as state aid notifications, and that no central overview of Dutch state aid notifications is kept.
No central overview is kept of Dutch state aid notifications from the various ministries.
Voor wat betreft Nederlandse staatssteunmeldingen van de verschillende ministeries wordt geen centraal overzicht bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het bericht dat premier David Cameron van het Verenigd Koninkrijk op vrijdag 18 januari 2013 een speech zal geven in Nederland met als onderwerp Europa

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he would attend David Cameron's planned Europe speech in the Netherlands, whether they remain political friends, and whether he shares Cameron's views on the EU. The Prime Minister said the speech was postponed due to the Algeria hostage crisis, no government member had been planned to attend, and he could not comment on its content.
On 17 January, Prime Minister Cameron decided to postpone the speech on Europe that was to be given in the Netherlands on 18 January, due to the hostage situation in Algeria.
Op 17 januari heeft premier Cameron besloten de toespraak over Europa die op 18 januari in Nederland gehouden zou worden, uit te stellen vanwege de gijzeling in Algerije.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het artikel “Griechen und Spanier kaufen massenhaft deutsche Immobilien“

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether tax data on suspicious cash property purchases abroad are exchanged across the EU, and whether Greece and other states should ratify the mutual assistance protocol. The government answered that automatic exchange under Directive 2011/16/EU applies from tax year 2014, that it supports ratification, and that it will ask Greek authorities about follow-up on a list of Dutch yacht owners after a few months.
This does not seem necessary for now, because the aforementioned Directive 2011/16/EU
Dit lijkt mij vooralsnog niet nodig, omdat genoemde Richtlijn 2011/16/EU
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat door een computerfout duizenden burgers een foutieve brief van de Belastingdienst gekregen hebben

An MP asked whether thousands of citizens received an erroneous Belastingdienst letter due to a computer error, how many were affected, and whether recipients must re-submit data. The state secretary answered that 35,000 households were wrongly told of upcoming policy changes, about 16,000 were confirmed in error and will receive a correction letter, and 4,700 remain under investigation, with the cause traced to a legacy system and no effect on allowance amounts.
These 16,000 households will receive a letter in December stating that they wrongly received a letter and that Belastingdienst/Toeslagen will correct the error made.
Deze 16.000 huishouden krijgen in december een brief waarin staat dat ze ten onrechte een brief hebben gekregen en dat Belastingdienst/Toeslagen de gemaakte fout hersteld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Hijum over het bericht “EU Aid for Cyprus A Political Minefield for Merkel”

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports of Russian deposits and oligarch passports in Cyprus, Cypriot anti-money-laundering efforts, and the lack of investigation into the Magnitsky fraud case, and whether they would condition EU aid on these issues. The minister replied that information on Russian deposits is limited, that Moneyval rates Cyprus positively, that Cypriot authorities have now opened an investigation without seeking Russian permission, and that he would support conditionality on tax information exchange and anti-money-laundering systems if aid is needed.
At this moment not enough information is known to make a precise estimate of the amounts of deposits by persons with Russian nationality at Cypriot banks.
Op dit moment is niet genoeg informatie bekend om een precieze inschatting te kunnen maken van de bedragen aan deposito’s van personen met een Russische nationaliteit bij Cypriotische banken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de voorgenomen bouw van 3000 woningen op de E1 locatie

MP Omtzigt asked the foreign minister about his talks with the Israeli ambassador on E1 settlement construction, the US position, EU coordination and Dutch efforts within the Quartet. The minister answered that he raised concerns with the ambassador, shares the US view that unilateral action is harmful, and that Nederland supports a unified EU message calling for resumed negotiations.
I indicated that implementation of the construction plans would make the two-state solution nearly impossible.
Ik heb aangegeven dat uitvoering van de bouwplannen de twee-statenoplossing vrijwel onmogelijk zal maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw c.s. over de zaak Van Rey - Weekers

Opposition and coalition MPs ask the State Secretary for Finance about the Van Rey–Weekers affair: a billboard donation, the sale of a tax office and a tax request involving real estate. They press on the nature and financing of the donation, contacts about closing tax offices, and handling of a personal tax request. The item is a bundle of written questions; the answers are not included in the text provided.
Have you verified that the donation was indeed made only by Mr Van Rey and, as agreed, processed via the regional campaign fund? Can you make the accounts public?

Heeft u zich ervan vergewist dat de donatie inderdaad alleen door de heer Van Rey is gedaan en, zoals afgesproken, via de regionale campagnekas is afgehandeld? Kunt u de rekeningen hiervan openbaar maken?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over nieuwe aanwijzingen over activiteit rond de plekken waar Syrische chemische wapens zijn opgeslagen

MP Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about reports of new activity around Syrian chemical weapons sites, including whether the weapons were being moved and where they are located. The government declined to comment publicly on the operational questions, said NATO discussed the issue without conclusions, and noted the issue was not on the agenda of the OPCW Conference of States Parties because Syria is not a party to the Chemical Weapons Convention.
No public statements can be made on this matter.
Hierover kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de ontvoering van de Nederlandse fotojournalist Jeroen Oerlemans

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two British nationals linked to the kidnapping of Dutch photojournalist Jeroen Oerlemans, Turkish intelligence's role in his release, and whether the government evaluated the case. The minister confirmed cooperation with British police, declined to discuss the arrestees' involvement because the British investigation is ongoing, denied receiving any Turkish confidentiality request, and said the case was reviewed without any policy change.
Since the arrests took place at the request of the British authorities and the investigation there is still ongoing, I cannot give any information on this.
Aangezien de aanhoudingen hebben plaatsgevonden op verzoek van de Britse autoriteiten en het onderzoek aldaar nog loopt kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Hijum en Knops over de hypotheekrenteaftrek

Three CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance about the planned phased reduction of the mortgage interest deduction top rate (fourth bracket) from 52% to 38% and its effect on marginal tax rates. The government confirmed the plan, said details on the marginal tax effects and the mechanism (no tax credit route) would follow in a bill, and stated that the phasing-down timetable runs over 28 years to give housing market certainty.
It is premature to make statements now about the tax rate that will then apply in the third bracket or the combined tax and premium rate in the second bracket.
Het is voorbarig om nu uitspraken te doen over het dan geldende belastingpercentage in de derde schijf of het gecombineerde belasting- en premiepercentage in de tweede schijf.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat Zuid-Sudan een VN-medewerker heeft uitgezet

An MP asked the foreign minister about South Sudan expelling a UN human rights officer after alleged army abuses, the UN mission's role in improving security institutions, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The minister said the expulsion breaches the UN Charter and the status of forces agreement, that pressure has been applied to reverse it, and that the Netherlands will keep raising human rights with Juba.
The government is concerned about the signal the South Sudanese government sent with the expulsion of the UNMISS human rights officer.
De regering is bezorgd over het signaal dat de Zuid-Sudanese regering heeft afgegeven met de uitzetting van de UNMISS mensenrechtenmedewerker.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Omtzigt over executies in Iran

MPs Van Bommel and Omtzigt asked about imminent executions in Iran, the number carried out this year, whether official figures understate them, whether drug offences and political motives play a role, the execution of minors, and whether the government will protest bilaterally and in the EU. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares the concerns, cites 344 executions by its own count against 262 officially announced, notes no minors executed this year, and says protests have been lodged in Tehran and within the EU.
The Netherlands is fundamentally opposed to the death penalty and states this unequivocally.
Nederland is principieel tegen de doodstraf en draagt dit ondubbelzinnig uit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rog en Omtzigt over derivaten in het onderwijs

MPs Rog and Omtzigt asked the education minister about the value of derivatives used by education institutions, whether a 270 million euro loss was taken from education funds, and whether such use should be banned, as well as sanctions for open positions and a ROC West-Brabant criticism. The minister answered that swaps hedge interest risk at lower cost given Basel III, that the negative value is not a realised loss, that she will not ban derivatives but will tighten rules, and that the inspectorate's report was accurate though nuanced by ROC West-Brabant.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het bericht dat de Franse president Hollande heeft gesproken over steun aan een mogelijke Afrikaanse missie in Noord-Mali

The MP Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about French support for a possible African mission in northern Mali, the security situation there, US and NATO involvement, and whether ransom payments to terrorists should be stopped. The minister answered that the Netherlands does not pay ransom or negotiate with terrorists, supports an EU training mission and a possible ECOWAS/AU mission, and will raise the issue at the Global Counter Terrorism Forum.
The Dutch policy in kidnappings of Dutch nationals abroad is that the Dutch government does not pay ransom, does not negotiate, and does not otherwise meet terrorist demands.

Het Nederlandse beleid bij ontvoeringen van Nederlandse onderdanen in het buitenland is dat de Nederlandse overheid geen losgeld betaalt, niet onderhandelt en ook anderszins niet tegemoet komt aan terroristische eisen.
Antwoord vragen Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over de tegenstrijdige berichtgeving over het schrappen van de buitenlandtak van de AIVD

MPs Van Toorenburg and Omtzigt asked the Interior Minister about conflicting reports on scrapping the AIVD's foreign intelligence branch, what the government would do to prevent its abolition, and whether the cut would be fully reversed. The minister replied that the coalition agreement footnote was read as a suggestion, the full AIVD task set was kept intact including foreign intelligence, but the budget cut still requires reprioritisation, with a concrete proposal promised in the first half of 2013.

The constituent meeting then decided, on the proposal of the Minister of the Interior, to keep the AIVD's full set of tasks, A through E, intact as the service's field of work, thus including the foreign intelligence task.

Vervolgens heeft het constituerend beraad op voorstel van de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties besloten het volledige takenpakket van de AIVD, van taken A tot en met E, intact te laten als het werkterrein van de dienst, dus inclusief de buitenlandtaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse regering de Syrian National Council niet langer ziet als belangrijkste representant van de Syrische oppositie

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares US Secretary Clinton's view that the Syrian National Council no longer represents the Syrian people, whether the EU and US should align, how representative the opposition is, and whether Syria is a humanitarian emergency. Minister Timmermans answered that a new, more inclusive Syrian National Coalition was formed in Doha, welcomed it, noted Dutch support for representativeness, and confirmed a humanitarian emergency with over 23.5 million euro already committed.
I welcome the establishment of this structure as an important step on the path to transition in Syria.
Ik verwelkom de oprichting van deze structuur als een belangrijke stap op de weg naar transitie in Syrië.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam over het onderzoek ‘Erven zonder financiële zorgen’

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked the government about a study proposing three routes to protect heirs from unintended acceptance of an estate's debts, about the number of households with negative home equity, and about delays in CAK and Toeslagen decisions affecting inheritances. The government said it has no exact count of negative-equity households (estimated around 700,000), announced mortgage-debt measures and a temporary tax deduction for residual debt, and promised a reply on the study's preferred route by year-end.
The cabinet does not have information that gives insight into the exact number of households with negative home equity.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die inzicht geeft in het exacte aantal huishoudens met een negatieve overwaarde.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat leden van Al Shabaab terugkeren uit Somalië naar onder andere Kenia

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder asked about reports that Al Shabaab fighters are returning from Somalia to Kenya and elsewhere, including whether Dutch nationals are involved and whether Kenyan police corruption hampers counter-terrorism. The minister answered that exact numbers are unknown, cooperation is opportunistic rather than structural, Dutch nationals cannot be excluded, and Dutch support for police training and reform continues.
I do not have exact figures or detailed information on the spread.
Ik beschik niet over exacte aantallen of gedetailleerde informatie over de verspreiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt inzake derivatenposities van publieke en semi-publieke instellingen

An MP asks the government for an overview of derivative positions across public and semi-public institutions and for details on municipal, provincial and Groningen Seaports exposures. The minister answers that the central government lacks data on local authorities' derivatives, that horizontal supervision applies, that Groningen Seaports is still being assessed, and that an overview is being prepared.
Insight into derivative positions of decentralised governments is not available at national government level.
Inzicht in derivatenposities van decentrale overheden is op Rijksniveau niet voorhanden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat Turkije het hoogste aantal journalisten opgesloten heeft

The MP Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows that Turkey holds the most journalists in prison, how he assesses the Committee to Protect Journalists' findings, whether the EU Commission will be asked to explicitly judge press freedom, whether Article 301 is used to convict them, and whether the topic is raised bilaterally. The minister confirmed awareness, said the EU progress report already expresses concern about press freedom, reported that no journalist is currently jailed under Article 301, and said the issue was raised at bilateral meetings in March and April 2012.
This topic deserves and receives my continued attention.
Dit onderwerp verdient en krijgt mijn voortdurende aandacht.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en Knops over het bericht “het weigeren van de toegang tot India van twee begeleiders van het Dendron college uit Horst”

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister whether he was aware that two supervisors of a Horst school were refused entry to India despite valid visas, and whether he would ask the Indian ambassador to explain and correct this. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Indian embassy was willing to explain the refusal to the supervisors, and noted that under international law states have sovereign authority over entry to their territory.
Under international law, states have the sovereign right to grant or deny foreigners access to their territory.
Volgens internationaal recht hebben landen het soevereine recht vreemdelingen al dan niet toegang tot hun grondgebied te verschaffen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Koppejan over het bericht ‘stortvloed van klachten over het bedrijf zakelijke telefonie voortduurt’

MPs Omtzigt and Koppejan asked the minister whether complaints about the business telephony firm Zakelijke Telefonie continue, how many complaints were filed, and what action would be taken against spam, misleading switching, and inadequate switching procedures. The minister replied that OPTA received 148 complaints and the fraud reporting point 110, that OPTA independently decides on investigations, and that the government will explore legal measures and possible expanded OPTA powers.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het feit dat de heer Wishnudath Datadin met de Nederlandse nationaliteit in Dubai door twee agenten uit het vliegtuig is meegenomen en dat zijn familie sindsdien niets meer van he

MP Omtzigt asked the foreign minister whether the government knew that a Dutch national was taken off a flight in Dubai by police and whether the consulate would seek information about his whereabouts and condition. The minister answered that the consulate contacted local authorities, that the man was not arrested, and that his whereabouts were known and communicated to the family.
Mr Datadin has not been arrested.
De heer Datadin is niet gearresteerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “Pensioenpremie gaat voor 17% op aan kosten” en het onderliggende rapport van adviesbureau LCP

MP Omtzigt asked the state secretary about a press report that pension premiums go 17% to costs, and how far pension funds and insurers have gone in making costs transparent to participants. The state secretary answered that participants can see costs in annual reports and websites, that the second-pillar sector has taken big steps on transparency, and that no further steps are needed for pension funds, while third-pillar insurers have become more transparent.
I see no reason to take further steps.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om verdere stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over "het septemberpakket pensioenen"

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the state secretary to clarify the legal basis of the September pension package, including whether article 142 of the Pensioenwet allows raising the minimum required equity and whether the amendments to general measures and DNB rules will be published. The state secretary corrected the record, said article 142 provides no basis for raising minimum equity, explained the 110% indexation condition, and promised the Regeling would be amended and published before 1 January 2013.
During that consultation I indicated that the possibility of attaching conditions to spreading the reductions rests on the power to extend the statutory recovery periods.
Tijdens bedoeld overleg heb ik aangegeven dat de mogelijkheid om voorwaarden te verbinden aan het spreiden van de kortingen, stoelt op de bevoegdheid om de wettelijke hersteltermijnen te verlengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitgestelde visie over toezicht en verantwoording van goede doelen van SBF en regering

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the long-delayed vision on supervision and accountability of charities (goede doelen) had not appeared, how often consultations had taken place, when the mandatory publication bill for foundations and the ANBI disclosure motion would be implemented, and whether a bill had been scheduled for the Council of Ministers. The State Secretary answered that the vision was sent to parliament on 20 September 2012, the publication bill is nearing completion, ANBI data disclosure will be required from 2014 via a tax amendment, and declined to disclose Council of Ministers agenda matters while denying a leak.
Since the signing of the covenant 'Ruimte voor geven' on 21 June 2011, two regular administrative consultations have taken place in which the progress of the Vision was discussed among other things.
Sinds de ondertekening van het convenant «Ruimte voor geven» op 21 juni 2011 heeft tweemaal een regulier bestuurlijk overleg plaatsgevonden
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg over problemen bij het zuiver aanvaarden van een nalatenschap

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked about heirs who unknowingly accepted an inheritance purely (zuiver) and so became liable for debts, including whether bank forms, emptying the estate and court fees trap heirs, and why minors are protected but not uninformed adults. The state secretary answered that heirs can get free public information and notary advice, that certain acts count as pure acceptance, that protecting minors reflects their inability to judge, and that beneficiary acceptance mostly causes unnecessary burdens, while promising only to consult the profession if a law change is considered.
I maintain my position that beneficiary acceptance will in most cases lead to unnecessary administrative burdens for citizens.
Ik blijf bij mijn standpunt dat beneficiaire aanvaarding in de meeste gevallen zal leiden tot onnodige administratieve lasten voor de burger.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de derivatenpositie en de risicobeheersing van pensioenfondsen en andere instellingen

An MP asks the minister whether pension fund derivative counterparty risk is adequately managed and requests a breakdown of derivative positions in public and semi-public institutions by sector and institution. The government answers that the risk is adequately controlled, that no per-institution overview exists at ministry level, and that several ministries are reviewing whether to tighten rules and supervision.
Currently the ministries do not have overviews of derivative positions per institution.
Momenteel beschikken de ministeries niet over overzichten van derivatenposities per instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “Gebrekkige voorlichting strop voor mantelzorgers” en de uitzending over mantelzorgers en erfbelasting

MP Omtzigt asked whether the SVB and Tax Authority information on the higher inheritance tax exemption for informal carers (mantelzorgers) was adequate, why the carers' allowance is limited to extramural care, and whether those who cared intensively for parents with a nursing-home indication and applications without a form can be helped. The State Secretary said the SVB website was improved and a letter will mention the inheritance tax link, will look at clarifying Tax Authority wording, explained that the extramural-only criterion reflects budget and administrative limits, and said the SVB will be asked to add information on applications without a form.
I will ask the SVB to adapt the site on this point.
Ik zal de SVB verzoeken de site op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht “Europa moet van onze pensioenen afblijven”

An MP asked the minister whether his Elsevier interview saying Europe must stay off Dutch pensions was authorised, how it squares with the Chamber's position on the Pension White Paper, which plans he distances himself from, and whether he will write to the Commission and has a blocking minority. The minister answered that the government supports the White Paper's general aims but has serious concerns about the IORP directive revision, which would raise buffer costs for pension funds; he says he is pursuing this via Commission contacts and cooperation with Germany, the UK and Ireland, but these four do not form a blocking minority.
However, the four countries do not form a blocking minority.
De vier landen vormen echter geen blokkerende minderheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over transparantie en publicatieplicht

MP Omtzigt asked whether a transparency bill for charities (ANBI register and publication duty) was pending before cabinet, whether consultation partners saw it, and when a joint transparency vision and bill would be ready. The state secretary refused to disclose cabinet deliberations, said consultation is standard and more time is needed for sector support, and confirmed the bill and full implementation of the motion will proceed.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de Goederenroutering Oost-Nederland van het PHS

MPs Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked why the studies on east Netherlands freight routing in the PHS progress report were late, why the Zutphen-Hengelo description was not updated as a standalone note, how ERTMS affects freight routing, and whether the freight routing component should be reconsidered. The minister answers that the studies were delivered in mid-2012, the Zutphen-Hengelo description is a technical overview pending the MER due spring 2013, ERTMS will be covered in a roadmap, and reconsideration is not on the table because the Chamber declared the component controversial.
According to the current planning the MER will be ready in spring 2013, so that on that basis, and after public consultation and advice, substantiated choices can be made.
Het MER zal volgens de huidige planning in het voorjaar van 2013 gereed zijn, zodat op basis daarvan, en na inspraak en advisering, onderbouwde keuzes kunnen worden gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en van Bochove over het bericht dat het aantal mensen met een betalingsachterstand op de hypotheek de afgelopen vier jaar verdubbeld is

Two CDA MPs asked the government about the doubling of mortgage payment arrears, whether homeowners can rent out part of their home given bank consent and tenancy protection, whether students will face delays finding rooms, and whether a quick short-lease option could be introduced. The minister confirmed the arrears figure, explained that banks must be asked for consent and that the hospitality rule and the tax room-rental exemption already apply, and pointed to the national student housing action plan, without proposing new legislation.
In view of the above, I am of the opinion that measures are already in place, both on tenancy protection and tax legislation, that facilitate the renting of rooms.
Gezien het bovenstaande ben ik van mening dat al voorzien is in maatregelen zowel qua huurbescherming als qua belastingwetgeving die het verhuren van kamers faciliteren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling in de Successiewet 1956

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance about a Breda court ruling that the business-succession exemption in the Successiewet 1956 breaches the equality principle, its scope, its budget impact (around 1 billion euros), and whether the law will be amended. The secretary says the Tax Authority disagrees, will appeal, relies on a 2011 Supreme Court ruling, does not plan an amendment now, and expects the ruling not to stand.
In view of the Supreme Court ruling of 9 December 2011, I will not take the Breda District Court ruling as a guideline.
Gelet op het arrest van de Hoge Raad van 9 december 2011 zal ik de uitspraak van Rechtbank Breda niet als richtsnoer nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Holtackers en Omtzigt over het bericht “Problemen Odfjell zijn er na 30 jaar kennelijk nog steeds”,

MPs Holtackers and Omtzigt asked about news reports on safety problems at Odfjell's Rotterdam tank storage site, including the changing deadline for emptying tanks, past fire-line testing and enforcement, and whether DCMR's oversight will be investigated. The state secretary explained the deadline extension for safety reasons, noted that the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) is investigating, and gave limited information on past live testing, saying the rest should be left to that investigation.
I do not want to obstruct the OVV in gathering information, so I limit my answers to information that is directly available and sufficiently valid.
Ik wil de OVV niet in de weg zitten met het vergaren van informatie, zodat ik de beantwoording van de vragen beperk tot die informatie die direct voor handen is en voldoende valide is.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het toegezegde maar nog steeds niet gerealiseerde ANBI-register

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance why the promised ANBI register, requested by a motion to publish organisation details, pay and accounts of charities, is still not realised, and why the SBF representativeness plan and joint oversight document have not been delivered. The state secretary answers that the SBF is responsible for its representativeness plan, that consultations with the Justice ministry on a joint vision on oversight and transparency are ongoing, and that the government does not intend to abandon openness, with results expected shortly after the summer.
Once the consultation is concluded, you will be informed further.
Zodra het overleg is afgerond, wordt u nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het toezicht op pensioenen

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about liability of pension insurers when an employer failed to register an employee with the pension provider, and whether insurers should be liable for unknown risks. The minister answers that employees can claim pension rights directly from the provider via a third-party clause, that providers bear the risk and must manage it, and refuses to amend the Pension Act on this point.
With regard to the interest of the individual participant, as explained in the answers to questions 9 and 10, I am not inclined to amend the Pension Act on this point.
Met het oog op het belang van de individuele deelnemer, zoals toegelicht in het antwoord op de vragen 9 en 10, voel ik niets voor een wijziging van de Pw op dit punt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over rechtszaken tegen het klooster Mor Gabriël

An MP asked the foreign minister about lawsuits against the Mor Gabriel monastery, including frequent postponements and whether EU embassies attend hearings. The minister confirmed the cases are ongoing, said procedural postponements are common in Turkey, and explained that embassies attend substantive hearings on a rotating basis.
Yes, I am aware of the postponement of the court case.
Ja, ik heb kennis van genomen de verdaging van de rechtszaak.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers en Omtzigt over mogelijke illegale asbestopslag

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about reports of possibly illegal asbestos storage at an Enschede demolition firm, including whether the inspectorate had acted and whether abolishing the landfill tax and planned asbestos landfill ban could encourage illegal storage. The state secretary answered that the province of Overijssel is the competent authority, that the inspectorate has no enforcement role here, that no signals link the tax change to illegal storage, and that illegal asbestos storage is not considered a structural problem.
The ILT has no supervisory and enforcement role in this case.
De ILT heeft in deze zaak geen controlerende en handhavende rol.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Bochove over de erfbelasting over een niet verkochte woning

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance about inheritance tax problems for heirs who cannot sell an inherited house and lack liquid funds to pay. The government answered that about 528 deferral requests were received in early 2012, that deferrals are granted case by case under existing policy, that no new rules are planned, and it referred heirs to notaries for advice on accepting an inheritance with benefit of inventory.
It is therefore not necessary to take further measures and make it possible, as the questioners propose, to grant up to two years of deferral (on top of the standard year).
Het is derhalve niet nodig om nadere maatregelen te treffen en het mogelijk te maken, zoals vraagstellers voorstellen, om maximaal twee jaar uitstel (bovenop het standaard jaar) voor te schrijven.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het bericht “Achterstand bij verwerking rekeningnummers”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a backlog in processing changed bank account numbers for allowances, affecting about 24,000 applicants, and about how affected people are informed, how to stop payments, liability for misdirected childcare allowance, and overdue objections. The State Secretary confirmed the notice was published with his approval, explained the backlog was a partly manual processing error, and said letters were sent and processing was underway, while giving figures on overdue objections but declining to inform the House fully within a week.
I would like to receive the case so that I can have it investigated.
Graag ontvang ik de casus zodat ik die kan laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over weekenduitgaven voor gehandicapten

MP Omtzigt asked the state secretary of Finance why the tax deduction for weekend care costs of disabled people is conditional on the disabled person's own income and assets, and what legal basis and thresholds apply. The state secretary cited the legal basis in the income tax act, explained the two requirements (costs borne by the taxpayer and a reasonable sense of obligation), said no fixed income or asset threshold applies, and promised to amend the Belastingdienst website text.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over toezicht op de pensioenen

An MP asks the minister whether a previous minister's parliamentary statements, and an amendment later withdrawn, imply that pension insurers can be liable without fault when an employer fails to register an employee. The minister answers yes to the quotations, but maintains that civil liability of the pension provider toward the employee does not arise; liability runs between employer and provider.
In this case, however, there is no civil liability of the pension provider towards the participant.
Er is in dit geval echter geen sprake van civielrechtelijke aansprakelijkheid van de pensioenuitvoerder ten opzichte van de deelnemer.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over de vrijwilligersvergoeding

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether tax objections against volunteer-allowance deductions rejected for lack of liquidity should be granted ex officio after a court ruling favouring deductibility, and how affected taxpayers would be informed of further options. The State Secretary answered that he disagrees with the court ruling, will not grant the objections ex officio, and maintains that deductibility depends on the ANBI's ability to pay.
I expressly maintain my policy pursued until now.
Ik houd uitdrukkelijk vast aan mijn tot op heden gevoerde beleid.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over de publicatie ‘Ondernemingsraad en Pensioen’

Parliamentarian Omtzigt asked the minister about an academic publication on works councils and pensions, covering works council consent rights, the binding effect of consent on individual employees, and whether tax changes flow into pension agreements. The minister answered that works councils have consent rights over both the pension and implementation agreements, that consent does not bind individual employees in principle, that tax rules do not automatically change pension agreements, and that compensation claims are possible.
Works councils have, under Article 27, consent rights over both the pension agreement and the benefits agreement for arrangements placed with a pension insurer.

Ondernemingsraden hebben conform artikel 27 ten aanzien van regelingen die ondergebracht zijn bij een pensioenverzekeraar instemmingsrecht over zowel de pensioenovereenkomst als de uitkeringsovereenkomst.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en Koppejan over het bericht ‘OPTA waarschuwt ondernemers voor ongewilde telefonie overstap’

MPs Koppejan and Omtzigt asked the minister about OPTA complaints over unwanted telephony switches by business customers, and about the sector's practices and remedies. The minister answered that a tightened switching procedure with fines now exists, that complaints have not fallen, and that KPN has started summary proceedings against ZakelijkeTelefonie.nl while a structural approach may follow if problems persist.
I will monitor developments and if the problems have not substantially diminished in the short term, a more structural approach is desirable.
Ik zal de ontwikkelingen volgen en mochten de problemen op korte termijn niet substantieel zijn verminderd dan is een meer structurele aanpak wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt over de Magnitsky zaak

MPs Çörüz and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the Magnitsky case, including whether Russian documents are authentic, whether a US-style visa ban exists, and when the Netherlands will impose a visa ban as the House requested. The minister answered that the Russian criminal case is ongoing, that there is no categorical US visa ban but visas can be refused for human rights abuses, that the list of persons refused entry is confidential, and that further EU steps will be considered after the Russian proceedings.
Information on who is or is not registered in the Schengen Information System for refusal is confidential.
De informatie met betrekking tot wie al dan niet in het Schengen Informatie Systeem ter weigering staan geregistreerd, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum, Ormel, Omtzigt, Smilde en De Rouwe over de wens van gemeenten om het Nedersaksisch als streektaal te erkennen

CDA MPs asked whether the government still supports recognising Low Saxon under Part III of the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages, given the long delay since the 2010 application.
