The minister confirmed the delay, said the government will not recognise Low Saxon under Part III because the inventory showed it would bring extra administrative and financial burdens, and that it stays under Part II.

In light of this, I consider it inopportune for the Netherlands to notify the Council of Europe that protection of Low Saxon will henceforth take place in accordance with at least 35 provisions of Part III of the European Charter.

Naar aanleiding hiervan acht ik het daarom niet opportuun dat Nederland bij de Raad van Europa kenbaar maakt dat bescherming van het Nedersaksisch voortaan plaatsvindt conform ten minste 35 bepalingen van Deel III van het Europees Handvest.

Antwoord vragen Haverkamp, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de inloopavond in Bathmen over plannen tot intensivering van het goederenvervoer per spoor, in het kader van het Programma Hoogfrequent Spoorvervoer (PHS)

CDA MPs asked the minister about reports that a January 2012 information evening in Bathmen on rail freight plans (PHS) descended into chaos, with ministry staff unable to answer residents' questions. The minister acknowledged the disorder, regretted that not all questions could be answered, and pointed to a follow-up evening, websites, written questions and the formal MER objection channel.
I regret that as a result not everyone's questions could be answered.
Ik betreur het dat daardoor niet ieders vragen beantwoord konden worden.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het bericht “Toezicht op pensioenen”

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about DNB's website claim that pension providers are responsible for employees not registered by employers, and whether the employee can still claim pension rights. The minister agreed with DNB that pension providers are not exempt from liability for employer omissions, that employees can still claim rights even if not registered, and that no change to the law is planned.
I endorse DNB's view as indicated under question 3. Even if the employee was not registered by the employer, he can invoke his pension rights and entitlements.
Ik onderschrijf zoals onder vraag 3 is aangegeven de visie van DNB. Ook als de werknemer niet is aangemeld door de werkgever kan hij een beroep doen op zijn pensioenrechten en aanspraken.
Antwoord vragen Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Menzis doet aangifte tegen Jansen Steur’

Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked the minister about Menzis filing a criminal complaint against a former neurologist and whether insurers should recover costs of improperly prescribed treatment. The minister said insurers may pursue claims but the decision is theirs, that IGZ is responsible for investigating improper prescribing, and that she lacks data on past recoveries.
When the IGZ becomes aware that a medicine has been prescribed on incorrect grounds, it is up to the IGZ to investigate this and, where necessary, to take action.
Wanneer de IGZ op de hoogte raakt van het voorschrijven van een geneesmiddel op onjuiste gronden dan ligt het op de weg van de IGZ om daar onderzoek naar te doen en zo nodig op te treden.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over de verwoesting door de overheid van de provincie Punjab (Pakistan) van gebouwen van de Lahore Charitable Organization

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about the Pakistani Lahore authorities' demolition of four Lahore Charitable Organization buildings, including housing and a chapel, and about the situation of minorities. Minister Rosenthal confirmed the demolition, said it likely had financial motives, raised the matter bilaterally, and said the Netherlands will press Pakistan with EU partners for change, without committing to report back on the specific reasons.
The Netherlands has requested an explanation from the Pakistani authorities about this incident at the bilateral level.
Nederland heeft op bilateraal niveau uitleg gevraagd aan de Pakistaanse autoriteiten over dit incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt over de Magnitsky-zaak

MPs Çörüz and Omtzigt asked the foreign minister about the Magnitsky case, including what was raised with Lavrov, the posthumous prosecution, a visa ban on 60 officials, and further pressure on Russia. The minister answered that he pressed for a swift, objective investigation, questioned the posthumous proceedings, and noted the US and UK had no visa ban, deferring any EU steps until the Russian investigation concludes.
I pressed for the swift completion of an objective and comprehensive investigation into the death of Sergei Magnitsky.
Ik heb aangedrongen op een spoedige afronding van een objectief en alomvattend onderzoek naar de dood van Sergei Magnitsky.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het betalen van toon- en tipgeld

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the policy on paying tip money (toon- en tipgeld), including a court ruling requiring disclosure of a tipster agreement, payments since 2010, and instructions to staff. The State Secretary answered that a court ruling allowed a summary instead of full disclosure, that no new tip payments have been made, that the Tax Administration takes a restrictive approach, and that the Justice ministry was willing to publish the Bijzondere Opsporingsgelden regulation.
The Tax Administration chose this option when executing the ruling.
De Belastingdienst heeft bij het uitvoeren van de uitspraak voor deze mogelijkheid gekozen.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers en Omtzigt over het benzeenconcentratie op het meetpunt A15 Botlek

Two MPs from the CDA asked why a brief benzene peak of 75 µg/m³ at the A15 Botlek measuring point on 4 February 2012 was not reported more promptly, whether a company caused it, and what follow-up supervision applies. The state secretary answered that the annual EU limit does not apply to short peaks, that DCMR investigated and linked the peak to a frost-related gas release at an NAM installation, and that SodM as mining supervisor is examining the causes.

Following the benzene peak and the concern it caused, the procedure has been extended: for certain high benzene peaks, such as that of Saturday 4 February, the DCMR publishes a notice on its website as quickly as possible with information about the investigation.

Naar aanleiding van de benzeenpiek en de onrust die dat gaf, is de procedure uitgebreid: bij bepaalde hoge benzeenpieken, zoals die van zaterdag 4 februari, publiceert de DCMR zo snel mogelijk een melding op de website met informatie over het onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers en Omtzigt over het bedrijf Odfjell

MPs Holtackers and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the state secretary about chemical storage firm Odfjell: the 64 inspection violations, details of leaks, why the firm was left out of a quickscan, inspection frequency, whether inspectors avoided the site, and cost recovery. The state secretary answered in detail, giving violation and leak tables and inspection history, declined to publish reports (left to the competent authority), said cost recovery needs a law change, and gave no guarantee of safety.
It is up to the competent authority concerned to make the reports public, observing the rules that apply to publication.
Het is aan het betrokken bevoegd gezag om de rapporten openbaar te maken met in achtneming van de voor openbaarmaking geldende regels.

Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en Smilde over het artikel “Floortje Mols, Melissa S.Y. Thong, Pauline Vissers, Tamar Nijsten, Lonneke V. van de Poll-Franse: ‘Socio-economic implications of cancer survivorship: results from the

MPs Omtzigt and Smilde asked the health minister about a study showing former cancer patients, especially younger ones, struggled to obtain life insurance or mortgages, and whether standard acceptance protocols could be pushed for or the Wet op de medische keuringen tightened. The minister said life insurance has no statutory acceptance duty, saw no reason to change the law now, left responsibility largely with insurers, and noted the NFK is in talks with the insurers' association.
For now I see no reason to amend the law.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen reden om de wet aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het pensioenakkoord

Omtzigt (CDA) asks the minister of Social Affairs how youth and elderly organisations have been involved in the pension agreement commissions and whether their involvement is full, and asks for a reply within a week. Minister Kamp answers that both groups have had meetings and receive the same information, that they do not take part in negotiations but their views are heard, and that he will answer as soon as possible.
These organisations do not take part in the negotiations.
Deze organisaties nemen niet deel aan de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de intrekking van de btw-vrijstelling voor steunstichtingen van sportverenigingen en van wereldwinkels

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked the state secretary of Finance about withdrawing the VAT exemption for fundraising by support foundations of sports clubs and by fair-trade shops, and about its consequences and EU compliance. The state secretary confirmed the withdrawal as required by the EU VAT Directive, with a transitional arrangement until 1 July 2012, and said the existing exemption for certain associations was preserved through a statutory change.
By withdrawing the contested policy decision, Dutch regulations have been brought into line with the VAT Directive.
Door middel van intrekking van het gewraakte beleidsbesluit is de Nederlandse regelgeving in overeenstemming gebracht met de btw-richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Ministeriele regeling bij de Geefwet

An MP asks the State Secretary for Finance about the pending ministerial regulation implementing the Geefwet, including the conditions for support foundations (steunstichtingen SBBI), the timing of publication, the ANBI status of Haagse venues such as Nieuwspoort and De Witte, and the forthcoming Uitvoeringsregeling on commercial activities. The State Secretary answers that consultations are ongoing, the draft will be submitted to both chambers at least four weeks before adoption, publication will follow as soon as possible, and no foundation can yet use the tax deduction.
The draft of the ministerial regulation will also be submitted to several representatives of tax advisers.
Het concept van de ministeriële regeling zal ook worden voorgelegd aan enkele vertegenwoordigers van belastingadviseurs

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ferrier (CDA) en Dikkers en Vermeij (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het feit dat het ABP betrokken is bij land

MPs from CDA and PvdA asked why the ABP pension fund's EUR 47 million investment in the Global Solidarity Forest Fund in Mozambique was linked to alleged land grabbing, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary said the ABP is a privatised fund at arm's length from the cabinet, that the relevant ministries would raise the matter in the employers' council and accountability body, and that pension transparency rules are planned.
ABP is a privatised fund and, like other pension funds in the Netherlands, is therefore at arm's length from the cabinet.
ABP is een geprivatiseerd fonds en staat daarmee net als andere pensioenfondsen in Nederland op afstand van het kabinet.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de erfbelasting over een niet verkochte woning (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Van Bochove asked whether heirs struggle to pay inheritance tax when an unsold house is the main asset, and whether payment deferral should be temporarily extended. The state secretary replied that the Tax Administration reports no such problems, points to its generous deferral practice, and sees no reason to widen the deferral rule.

In response to your question whether I am aware of signals from practice that many taxpayers have problems paying inheritance tax when the estate consists of a house that cannot be sold quickly enough, I can inform you, based on information from the Tax Administration, that such problems do not exist at all.

1 Antwoord 1 Naar aanleiding van uw vraag of mij uit de praktijk signalen bekend zijn dat veel belastingplichtigen problemen hebben om de erfbelasting te betalen als de nalatenschap uit een woning bestaat en deze woning niet snel genoeg verkocht kan worden, nu de verkooptijd is opgelopen tot 23 maanden, kan ik u op grond van informatie van de Belastingdienst meedelen dat bedoelde problemen hoegenaamd niet bestaan.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en De Rouwe over het incident met de sluis bij Eefde

MPs Omtzigt and De Rouwe asked the minister about the economic damage, traffic impact, duration of the repair and prevention measures after a broken lock gate at Eefde closed the Twente canal. The minister said damage cannot yet be quantified, gave the traffic figure of about 40 vessel movements per day, and promised research and a planned second lock chamber but no firm prevention measures yet.
At this moment an investigation is underway into the cause of the incident at Eefde and possible solutions.
Op dit moment vindt er een onderzoek plaats naar de oorzaak van het voorval bij Eefde en mogelijke oplossingen.

Vragen van de leden Ormel en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het artikel «Kopten zetten Marinab in brand en schuiven het in de schoenen van Moslims» (ingezond

MPs Ormel, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the foreign minister about a Dutch NOS report attributing the burning of a Coptic church in Egypt to Muslims, and whether the report was one-sided and should be rectified. The minister replied that media choose their own sources and content, that the NOS must decide on any rectification, and that the Egyptian investigation results were not yet known.

The results of the investigation led by the Egyptian Minister of Justice into the background of the Maspero incident on 9 October, including the events around the Al Marinab church, are not yet known.

De resultaten van het onderzoek onder leiding van de Egyptische minister van Justitie naar de achtergrond van het Maspero-incident op 9 oktober jl., waaronder de gebeurtenissen rondom de Al Marinab kerk, zijn nog niet bekend.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Groot (PvdA) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de vermogenstoets in de huurtoeslag voor 2012 (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Omtzigt, Groot and Braakhuis asked whether households with children who exceed the wealth test on 1 January 2012 could lose all their 2012 rent allowance, and why the lowered wealth test was not announced clearly. The state secretary answered that the lowered test applies by law, that the tax authority informed beneficiaries via a press release, a website notice and intermediaries, and that this was considered sufficient outreach.

Furthermore, intermediaries (e.g. housing corporations, social counsellors and municipalities) have been informed about the abolition of the child allowance in the box 3 tax-free allowance, so they can inform their clients.

Verder zijn de intermediairs (o.a. woningbouwcorporaties, sociale raadslieden en gemeenten) geïnformeerd over de afschaffen van de kindertoeslag van het heffingsvrije vermogen in box 3, zodat zij hun klanten hierover kunnen informeren.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het rapport «The Torture and Murder of Sergei Magnitsky and The Cover Up by The Russian Government» (ingezonden 7 december 201

MPs Çörüz and Omtzigt asked the foreign minister about the Magnitsky case, including repeated postponements of the Russian investigation, the lack of follow-up to a Russian human rights council report, and EU steps. The minister answered that the case has been raised with Russian authorities and EU officials, noting the investigation is ongoing and that the EU Parliament has condemned Russia's handling.

As long as the criminal investigation into Magnitsky's death is ongoing, it is too early to indicate the extent to which the Russian authorities have followed up on the findings of the Russian president's human rights council.

Zolang het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de dood van Magnitsky loopt is het te vroeg om aan te geven in welke mate de Russische autoriteiten gevolg hebben gegeven aan de bevindingen van de mensenrechtencommissie van de Russische president

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de problemen van dwangarbeiders met de Duitse Belastingdienst en geëmigreerde gepensioneerde

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance and the minister of Social Affairs about German tax claims on pensions earned by former forced labourers and the double taxation of emigrated Dutch ABP pensioners, including Belgian assessments and whether Germany would exempt forced labourers. The state secretary answered that German law now exempts pensions of persecuted forced labourers, that the Dutch government monitors its application, and that a structural bilateral solution on ABP pensions has been reached.
Moreover, it has been made clear that the exemption is applied pragmatically.
Bovendien is duidelijk gemaakt dat met de vrijstelling pragmatisch wordt omgegaan.

Vragen van de leden Verhoeven (D66) en Hachchi (D66) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over lastenverhogingen voor ondernemers als gevolg van Digin

MPs Verhoeven and Hachchi asked whether the Tax Authority's switch to a new certificate supplier after the DigiNotar breach raised costs for businesses and whether SMS authentication would be scrapped. The government answered that the new KPN/Getronics certificates cost the same as the old DigiNotar price, so there is no increase in costs, and that the SMS authentication question rests on a misunderstanding.
So there is no increase in costs or administrative burden.
Er is dus geen sprake van verhoging van kosten en administratieve lasten.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Mor Gabrielklooster (ingezonden 17 oktober 2011).

MP Omtzigt asks the Foreign Minister when and how the government has pressed Turkey and Greece, within the Council of Europe and bilaterally, to implement PACE resolution 1704 on Mor Gabriel monastery and minority rights, and whether the Netherlands will act jointly with other states and seek an end to the monastery cases. The minister replies that the Permanent Representation was instructed to raise the resolution with Turkey, that the issue has been raised in EU and bilateral contacts, that the Netherlands will keep raising it, and that it does not intervene in individual cases before Turkish courts.
I will continue to raise the Mor Gabriel issue in contacts with the Turkish government.
Ik zal in contacten met de Turkse overheid aandacht blijven vragen voor de Mor Gabriël-kwestie.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de erfbelasting (ingezonden 25 oktober 2011).

Deputy Omtzigt (CDA) asked the state secretary of Finance about how article 10 of the Successiewet 1956 applies when parents transfer a home to a child subject to a usufruct or rental arrangement, including buy-outs, rent levels and transitional rules. The state secretary answered in detail, confirming that article 10 applies where enjoyment continues until death within 180 days, that the 6% rent benchmark applies, and that transitional arrangement will cover situations arising from transfers before 1 January 2010, with a study of the percentage planned for 2012.
I do not intend to take an incidental measure regarding rent-lease situations in advance of this integral study.
Ik heb niet het voornemen om vooruitlopend op deze integrale studie een incidentele maatregel te treffen met betrekking tot huur-verhuursituaties.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Neppérus (VVD), Van Vliet (PVV), Koolmees (D66), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het rechtstreeks overmaken van kinderopvang

Six MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance whether childcare allowance should be paid directly to childcare providers to prevent parental arrears, and whether a system with certified payee parties would be designed with stakeholders. The State Secretary said government should in principle not intervene, that a single bank account per taxpayer is planned with an exception for childcare centres under strict conditions, and that the Minister of Social Affairs will consult the sector and report to parliament.

As I indicated at the legislative consultation of 7 November regarding the Tax Package 2012, I will include an exception for childcare centres to the mandatory use of a single bank account via an amendment.

Zoals ik in het wetgevingsoverleg van 7 november jl. over het Belastingpakket 2012 heb aangegeven, zal ik bij nota van wijziging voor kindercentra een uitzondering op het verplicht gebruik van één rekeningnummer opnemen.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt (beiden CDA), Timmermans (PvdA), De Roon (PVV), Van Bommel (SP), Schouw (D66), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het a

MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that the UK had secretly banned Russian officials linked to the death of lawyer Magnitsky from entering, whether Russian investigations could still be trusted, and whether the Netherlands would ban the same officials. The minister replied that no visa ban was introduced by the UK or US, that Russia has continued prosecuting doctors, and that the Netherlands would raise the matter as it has before, without committing to a new measure.
The government has repeatedly expressed its concern about the death of Mr Magnitsky and the circumstances under which he died.
De regering heeft herhaaldelijk haar zorg uitgesproken over de dood van de heer Magnitsky en over de omstandigheden waaronder hij is overleden
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht «Bemiddelaars in dubieuze leningen» (ingezonden 27 september 2011).

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether banks report mortgage interest, whether income data is monthly in the polisadministratie, whether fraud with provisional tax refunds is a priority, whether fake income can still obtain refunds without prior checks, whether FIOD investigates intermediaries, and whether charging fees for filing on others' behalf is punishable. Weekers answered that data is annual and not current for new buyers, that checks have been tightened with risk selection, that FIOD investigates on behalf of the Public Prosecution Service, and that no new rules for intermediaries are needed.
For that reason, oversight of this process has been considerably tightened.
Om die reden is het toezicht op dit proces aanzienlijk aangescherpt.

Vragen van de leden Uitslag en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «ZZP’ers genegeerd door zorgkantoren» (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary for health whether self-employed care workers (ZZP'ers) should be able to deliver AWBZ care in kind from 1 January 2012, and how many extramural AWBZ capacity places are needed to absorb the personal budget (pgb) change. The state secretary replied that zorgkantoren are not obliged to contract, that the legal obstacle has been removed, that extra funds and criteria are being prepared for contracting self-employed providers in the May 2012 round, and that EUR 100 million is available for the group losing pgb access.
I share your view that self-employed care providers should also be able to deliver AWBZ home care in kind, but this was not legally possible.
Ik deel uw mening dat ook zelfstandige zorgverleners AWBZ-thuiszorg via zorg in natura zouden moeten kunnen leveren, maar dit was wettelijk niet mogelijk.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het artikel «De levensgenieter krijgt «levenslang» oftewel eens genoten altijd genoten» (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Ormel asked the State Secretary of Finance about a published critique of article 10 of the Successiewet 1956 (inheritance tax), including the lack of transitional law after withdrawal of the 1964 resolution, the 6% rent benchmark, and the consistency of Belastingdienst positions. The State Secretary defended the article's application, but agreed to introduce transitional rules for pre-2010 transfers and promised a review of the 6% percentage in 2012.
I will nonetheless introduce transitional rules for the withdrawal of the decision.
Zal ik alsnog overgangsrecht treffen voor de intrekking van het besluit.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het feit dat de vader van de ontvoerde minderjarige I.A. hoogstwaar

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked why the father of abducted child I.A., convicted in absentia of murdering the mother and likely still in Libya, cannot be extradited, whether the government will press the new Libyan government, and why he was not put on the national wanted list. The Minister replied that the government will raise the case with the new Libyan authorities when an opportunity arises, that Libyan law bars extradition of nationals, that the Public Prosecution Service sees no reason to revisit the decision, and that only national and international alerts have been issued.
The Public Prosecution Service has hardly any means of tracing the person in Libya, because it has no investigative powers there.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft nauwelijks mogelijkheden betrokkene in Libië op te sporen, omdat het aldaar geen opsporingsbevoegdheden heeft.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een nieuwe Turkse wet waarin wordt bepaald dat alle onteigende bezittingen van Christelijke Kerken en de Joodse gemeenschap wo

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about a new Turkish law returning expropriated property of Christian churches and the Jewish community to original owners, its scope, implementation, and Turkey's compliance with Council of Europe obligations toward the Syriac Mor Gabriel monastery. The minister called the law a step in the right direction, said implementation of the 2008 foundations law had lagged, said the Mor Gabriel case is for Turkish courts to decide, and said the Netherlands will keep raising the issue in the Council of Europe.
The answer was that it is for the Turkish judge to reach a final verdict on these ongoing court cases.
Hierop was het antwoord dat het aan de Turkse rechter is om over deze lopende rechtszaken een definitief oordeel te vellen.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over een onjuiste waardebepaling van verhuurde panden in box 3 en de Successiewet, waardoor mensen extreem hoge belasting dien

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the 2010 switch to WOZ-based valuation of rented homes for box 3 and inheritance tax is causing extreme tax burdens, and proposed remedies such as a counter-evidence rule and municipal consultation. The State Secretary largely rejected the proposals, defending the WOZ valuation and existing appeal routes, while pointing to rent-cap and valuation adjustments and a few narrow changes for leased homes and service flats.
A counter-evidence arrangement was, when the mandatory use of the WOZ value was introduced and several times since, rejected with reasons.
Een tegenbewijsregeling is bij invoering van het verplicht gebruik van de WOZ-waarde en ook al enkele keren daarna, beargumenteerd afgewezen.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), Ulenbelt (SP), Klaver (Groenlinks), Koolmees (D66), Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP), Van den Besselaar (PVV) en Thieme (Partij

Ten MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about a reported 450 million euro fee paid by pension funds (PME and another fund) to Mn Services for asset management, and about transparency and remedies for members. The minister said the fee passage in the court ruling contained a typo, that supervisors alone may request such information and are bound by confidentiality, that members can raise concerns with the accountability body and as a last resort the Ondernemingskamer, and that a cost-reporting guideline is due in November 2011.
The Pension Act provides that only the supervisors, DNB and AFM, have the authority to request information from pension funds.
In de Pensioenwet is bepaald dat alleen de toezichthouders, DNB en AFM, de bevoegdheid hebben om informatie op te vragen bij pensioenfondsen.

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de problemen die grensarbeiders ondervinden bij de Nederlandse en Duitse belastingdienst en

Omtzigt (CDA) asks the state secretary of Finance about problems cross-border workers face with Dutch and German tax authorities, including German taxation of ABP pensions and German tax on pensions paid to Netherlands residents from 2005, asking about consultation, withholding, help, and a new treaty. The state secretary answers that the Dutch Supreme Court ruling stands, the German authorities are negotiating under Article 25, the German Rente taxation is the German legal consequence and not reversible by Dutch authorities, help is limited to GWO, and a new treaty negotiation is in its final phase with no details disclosed.
At this stage I obviously cannot go into the content of the new treaty, which hopefully can be signed within a reasonable time, as that would disrupt the negotiation process.
In dit stadium kan ik op de inhoud van het (hopelijk binnen afzienbare tijd te ondertekenen) nieuwe verdrag vanzelfsprekend niet ingaan.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over massale fraude (ingezonden 20 september 2011).

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about massive identity fraud in childcare and tax allowance payments, including how many files were coded for suspected identity fraud, how much money was lost, what warning signals existed, when bank account changes would be legally restricted, and what apology and victim support would be given. The State Secretary answered at length, giving approximate case numbers and amounts, describing new anti-fraud measures and a planned single-account rule in the Overige Fiscale Maatregelen 2012 bill, while leaving the exact timing of a name-number check open.
Concrete numerical information on this is not available, since fraud cases handled administratively are not broken down by type of fraud.
Concrete cijfermatige informatie daarover is niet beschikbaar, aangezien fraudegevallen die bestuurlijk worden afgehandeld niet worden onderverdeeld naar fraudesoort.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het college bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP) en patiëntendossiers (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a CBP opinion holding that exchange of patient data by a care providers' association requires explicit patient consent, and whether current local and national patient record exchanges are lawful. The minister answered that consent depends on the concrete setup, that existing WGBO and Wbp rules apply, that supervision lies with the CBP and IGZ, and that legal analysis and possible law changes are being pursued.
It is therefore for the College to halt violations of the Wbp by applying administrative enforcement or imposing an order subject to penalty.
Het is derhalve aan het College om een halt toe te roepen aan schendingen van de Wbp door de toepassing van bestuursdwang of het opleggen van een last onder dwangsom.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de exploitatie van buitensportaccommodaties door gemeenten en sportstichtingen (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked the State Secretary of Finance about VAT treatment of municipal and sports-foundation sports facilities, including a planned Sportbesluit with percentage-based rental rules and the Supreme Court's case law. The State Secretary denied that only symbolic fees allow VAT deduction refusal, explained abuse-of-law structures, and said draft guidelines would be revised, with final guidelines expected in October without the percentage link.
In this context, on 11 July 2011, draft guideline texts prepared at official level were sent for comment to various interest organisations, in line with the normal procedure for policy decisions.

In dit kader zijn op 11 juli 2011 conform de normale procedure voor de totstandkoming van beleidsbesluiten op ambtelijk niveau opgestelde conceptrichtlijnteksten voor commentaar naar verschillende belangenorganisaties gestuurd.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van de Werf (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over muziekverenigingen, die massaal hun ANBI-status kwijtraken (ingezonden 14 juli 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the mass loss of ANBI status by music associations after the Tax Office re-tested them under the stricter 90% public-benefit criterion, and whether symphony orchestras receive different treatment. The State Secretary answered that the policy is statutory interpretation, that roughly 10% of music associations still qualify, that individual reviewable decisions will follow, and that a horizontal supervision role for music federations is not feasible because ANBI status will be an exception.

Music associations that, after assessing the responses, the ANBI team considers no longer qualify will receive a reasoned written pre-notice, followed by a withdrawal decision open to objection and appeal.

De muziekverenigingen die na de beoordeling van de ontvangen reacties naar de mening van het ANBI-team niet meer kwalificeren, ontvangen schriftelijk een gemotiveerde vooraankondiging, gevolgd door een voor bezwaar en beroep vatbare intrekkingsbeschikking.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Koppejan (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over vertraging verliesverrekening bedrijven (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Koppejan asked the State Secretary of Finance about delays in corporate loss offset caused by a Belastingdienst system failure, and whether a 2009 relief decision should be revived. The State Secretary explained the processing delay was technical, said applications would be honoured once conditions are met, and declined to revive the relief scheme citing fiscal costs.
I am of the view that the Tax Authority must respond as quickly as possible to applications for loss offset.
Ik ben van oordeel dat de Belastingdienst zo snel mogelijk moet reageren op aanvragen van verrekening van verliezen.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over arbeidsongeschikt melden voor enkele procenten (ingezonden 15 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about a court ruling that employees who fully resume work cannot be reported sick for a few percent to keep WIA waiting periods running, and about data, information and rules to prevent this practice. The minister agrees such administrative reporting is inconsistent with reality, says no national data exists, rejects written quarterly updates as unnecessary given existing plans of action, and sees no need for legislative change since a UWV second opinion mechanism exists.
No national registration is kept of sickness absence.
Er wordt geen landelijke registratie bijgehouden over het ziekteverzuim.

Vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de vereniging Martijn (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

Christian Democrat MPs Van Toorenburg and Omtzigt asked the Justice Minister whether the Netherlands complies with the Lanzarote Convention on child sexual exploitation, given the Martijn association's aims and its board members' sex-offence convictions, and whether prosecution or dissolution of the association should be pursued. The minister answered that the Netherlands complies with the Convention, that no concrete offence justifies prosecution, that further examination of dissolution under existing law is ongoing, and that the Convention committee is procedural rather than a forum for case review.
At present there is no suspicion of a concrete criminal offence that could justify criminal prosecution.
Op dit moment is geen sprake van een verdenking van een concreet strafbaar feit die een strafrechtelijke vervolging kan rechtvaardigen.

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris en de minister van Financiën en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Amerikaanse Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

Deputy Omtzigt asked the state secretary of Finance about the US FATCA law, including whether it conflicts with the US-Netherlands tax treaty, whether it breaches Dutch privacy law, whether banks must ask every client about US status, and on what Dutch legal basis a 30% withholding could be imposed. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands supports an EU approach, that the privacy question awaits the Commission's review, that banks must adapt systems, and that no Dutch legal basis is needed because the withholding is a US tax.
Since the European Commission is already examining this point, I first want to await the outcome of that examination.
Aangezien de Europese Commissie dit punt al aan het onderzoeken is, wil ik eerst de uitkomst van dat onderzoek afwachten.
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp (CDA), Slob (ChristenUnie) en Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de vertraging ombouw station Enschede (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

MPs Haverkamp, Slob and Omtzigt asked why the reconstruction of Enschede station was delayed and whether a parliamentary motion on cross-border through-connection had been taken into account. The minister answered that the delay stems from new timetable insights requiring 60 km/h switches, and that the motion is separate and will be decided after a study expected to report in October.
I expect to be able to inform the House of the outcomes and the decision to be taken in October.
Ik verwacht de Kamer over de uitkomsten en het te nemen besluit in oktober te kunnen berichten.
Vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Nieuwe poging tot verbod pedoclub» (ingezonden 19 juli 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a deputy chief prosecutor in Rotterdam had urged complainant Drost to quickly file an Article 12 Sv complaint against the prosecution's decision not to prosecute the association Martijn. The state secretary answered that Drost himself announced the complaint, the deputy chief prosecutor only discussed it with him and said a quick filing would be good given public debate, and that the College of Procurators-General was informed.

The deputy chief prosecutor then stated that the public prosecution service maintains its earlier conclusion that prosecution, dissolution and/or banning of the association Martijn is not possible on the basis of what is currently known.

De plaatsvervangend hoofdofficier van justitie heeft vervolgens aangegeven dat het openbaar ministerie blijft bij de eerdere conclusie dat vervolging, ontbinding en/of verbodenverklaring van de vereniging Martijn op basis van hetgeen thans bekend is niet mogelijk is.

Vragen van de leden Sterk , Koopmans en Omtzigt (allen CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economie, Landbouw en Innovatie over voedselbanken (ingezonden 28 juni 2011).

CDA MPs asked the state secretaries whether the Netherlands should join the EU food aid programme that food banks request, given that most other member states use it and the Foundation for Dutch Food Banks wants access. The government declined to participate, arguing that food support is a matter for member states rather than the EU, and refused to convene talks with the foundation.
No, the cabinet does not intend to take part in the programme.
Nee, het kabinet is niet voornemens deel te nemen aan het programma.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over bijbetalingsverplichting van werkgevers bij waardeoverdracht van een pensioen (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether the pension-transfer top-up obligation for employers is consistent with the rule that pension entitlements must be fully funded, and what happens when a former employer no longer exists. The minister answered that the two rules are separate, that outgoing transfers are not exempt from full funding, that top-up costs are handled case by case, and that a broader temporary solution is being discussed with pension providers and social partners.
From that letter it follows that there is no discrepancy between full funding and top-up payments.
Uit die brief vloeit voort dat er geen discrepantie is tussen affinanciering en bijbetaling.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Ten Broeke (VVD) en Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over gevangenschap van de broer van een Armeense oppositiepolitica (ingezonden 19 mei 2011).

Three MPs asked the foreign minister whether the detention of Tigran Postanjyan, brother of an Armenian opposition MP, was meant to pressure his sister, and about his cell conditions and the 2008 violence investigation. The minister answered that he was released on 3 June 2011 under an amnesty, that the government denied any political link (citing alleged corruption), and that the Dutch ambassador monitored the case via contacts and the OSCE.

The Armenian government denied any link between Mr Postanjyan's arrest and his sister's political activities; according to the Armenian government it concerned a criminal investigation into alleged corruption.

De Armeense regering ontkende enig verband tussen de arrestatie van de heer Postanjyan en de politieke activiteiten van zijn zuster; volgens de Armeense regering betrof het een strafrechtelijk onderzoek vanwege vermeende corruptie.
Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitkeringen in Turkije (ingezonden 30 mei 2011).

MPs Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked the minister about the export of Toeslagenwet supplements to Turkey and other countries following the Akdas ruling (C-485/07), including effects on past recipients, export to EU states and treaty countries, and legal options. The minister answered that the Centrale Raad van Beroep must first rule on the Akdas case before the exact consequences are clear, and described existing export rules and treaty renegotiations.
As soon as I have more clarity on this, I will inform your House further.
Zodra ik daar meer duidelijkheid over heb, zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt , Sterk en Van Hijum (allen CDA) aan de staatssecretaris en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een concurrentiebeding bij een detacheringsbedrijf (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Social Affairs about a non-compete clause in a staffing agency's contracts, including whether UWV refers jobseekers to such employers and whether refusing such a contract affects unemployment benefit. The minister answered that such clauses are legally permitted and courts can moderate them, that refusing a job with a non-compete is generally not a valid ground to deny benefits except in unusual cases, and that UWV cannot force a jobseeker to sign a contract breaching an earlier non-compete.
The mere fact that an employer has included a non-compete clause in the employment contract is not a reason to regard a job offer as unsuitable.
Het enkele feit dat een werkgever in het arbeidscontract een concurrentiebeding heeft opgenomen, is geen reden om een arbeidsaanbod als niet passend te beschouwen.

Vragen aan de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het feit dat de vader van een ontvoerde minderjarige I.A. niet op de opsporingslijst staat (ingezonden 27

Two CDA MPs asked why the father of an abducted child, convicted of murdering her mother and believed to be in Libya, is not on the national wanted list, and whether it would be placed there. The state secretary answered that the Public Prosecution Service judged listing ineffective because he is unlikely to return to the Netherlands, though he is signalled nationally and internationally, and that the case would be revisited if Libya's situation changes.
Since it is known that the person is staying in Libya, the Public Prosecution Service did not consider involving the public through listing on the National Wanted List to be effective.
Aangezien bekend is dat betrokkene in Libië verblijft werd het inschakelen van het publiek door een vermelding op de Nationale Opsporingslijst door het OM niet effectief geacht.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Hijum (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over kinderopvangtoeslag (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Van Hijum ask the State Secretary of Finance about blocked childcare allowance payments, parents who cannot resolve delays, wrongful full suspension after partial changes, and whether the tax service will restore regular consultation with help desks. The State Secretary answers that about 9,800 applications were halted pending registry numbers and 3,225 suspended for non-response, that wrongful suspensions would be corrected on objection, and that consultation runs through trade associations and umbrella bodies while help desks can send feedback by mail or phone.
If the applicant has responded but the Tax and Customs Administration has unfortunately not received the documents, we advise the applicant to send the documents again.
Als de aanvrager heeft gereageerd maar de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen onverhoopt de stukken niet heeft ontvangen, dan raden wij de aanvrager aan de stukken nogmaals op te sturen.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitkering van havenspenioenen door Aegon (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the pension buffer held by Aegon for port-worker pensions can be withheld from pensioners, whether it consists of contributions, and whether the minister would mediate. The minister referred to earlier answers, stated that the Supreme Court confirmed Aegon owns the buffer with no legal obligation to use it, and declined further mediation as a private dispute with no reason to intervene.
There is no legal obligation to use or spend the restrained capital for the benefit of third parties.
Er bestaat geen juridische verplichting tot aanwending of besteding van het beklemde vermogen ten behoeve van derden.

Vragen van de leden Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over een nabetaling voor honderden (voormalig) Griekse parlementariërs (ingezonden 12 mei 2011)

CDA MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether they would ask the European Commission to object to Greek former MPs suing for retroactive pay supplements of about 250,000 euro each while Greek pay and pensions were being cut under EU-backed aid. The government answered that it shared the concern, had raised it with the Commission via the State Secretary, and would report on steps taken through regular channels.
I will inform your House about this through the regular information channels.
Ik zal u hierover via de reguliere informatievoorziening naar uw Kamer informeren.
Vragen van de leden Verburg en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over telefooncontracten overzetten zonder toestemming (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

MPs Verburg and Omtzigt asked the minister about businesses being switched to another telephone provider without consent, and what remedies exist and what OPTA can do. The minister confirmed complaints, explained the self-regulated COIN reversal procedure, said OPTA lacks powers because contract law falls under the Civil Code, and called for strengthened procedures without committing to legislation.
I have therefore called on the parties involved to strengthen the existing procedures to prevent transfers without adequate expression of intent.
Ik heb de betrokken partijen daarom opgeroepen om de bestaande procedures te versterken om overzettingen zonder adequate wilsuiting te voorkomen

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Smilde (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de stroomstoring en de veiligheid in de ziekenhuizen van Ziekenhuisgroep Twente (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about a power outage at a Twente hospital group that disabled emergency power, Dutch hospital emergency-power standards, fire-safety enforcement and dwangsommen imposed by two municipalities, and follow-up to a 2006 fatal operating-room fire. The minister answered that standards were addressed in an earlier reply, that municipalities are enforcing fire rules with a year-end deadline, and that the IGZ judged the hospital's post-fire measures adequate in 2009, while declining to commit to a further check beyond a ministry meeting with the board.
At the time the IGZ concluded that the measures were sufficient and continued its inspection work in the usual national manner.
De IGZ heeft destijds geconcludeerd dat de maatregelen voldoende waren en haar inspectie werkzaamheden op de gebruikelijke landelijke wijze voortgezet.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEA’s) en belastingverdragen (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance for a list of all Dutch tax information exchange agreements and tax treaties, showing whether information was exchanged with each country in 2009 and 2010, and the same for the other Kingdom countries. The state secretary provided a list of 15 TIEAs in force (most applicable from 2011 or 2012), explained that Aruba and the former Netherlands Antilles had treaties available in those years, and said that actual use falls under the other countries' finance ministers, pointing to online sources.
Whether and how these treaties have been used falls under the responsibility of the Ministers of Finance of the other countries of the Kingdom.
Of en hoe deze verdragen zijn gebruikt valt onder de bevoegdheid van de Ministers van Financiën van de andere landen van het Koninkrijk.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uitspraken van de bestuursvoorzitter van de ziekenhuisgroep Twente (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Uitslag asked the health minister whether the government can require a hospital to keep a maternity department open, and whether a hospital concentrating obstetric care breaches earlier parliamentary motions. The minister answered that the WTZi allows binding hospital admission conditions and, as a last resort, enforcement, but that no closure decision has been taken and the government will not impose keeping the department open where the 45-minute access norm is not at risk.
However, I will not impose on a hospital the obligation to keep a department open if the 45-minute access norm for acute care in the region is not at risk.
Ik zal een ziekenhuis echter niet opleggen om een afdeling open te houden als de bereikbaarheidsnorm voor acute zorg van 45 minuten voor de regio niet in het gedrang komt.

Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over exploitatie van buitensportaccommodaties door gemeenten en sportstic

CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance whether the reduced VAT rate for providing sports facilities is applied consistently, why tax offices refuse to rule on some cases, and whether municipalities and sports foundations can rely on the reduced rate. The state secretary said the rate applies under stated cumulative conditions, that a sale-and-leaseback structure is rejected as abusive, and promised simplified implementation guidance after consulting the VNG/VSG and NOC*NSF.
I will ensure that the implementing guidance is published as soon as possible, so that the various units can quickly settle pending cases.
Ik zal er voor zorgen dat de aanwijzingen in de uitvoeringssfeer zo spoedig mogelijk worden gepubliceerd, zodat de diverse eenheden snel lopende zaken kunnen afdoen.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de vrijstelling van energiebelasting voor de mineralogische industrie (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance why the Netherlands has no energy tax exemption for mineralogical processes, unlike many other member states, which harms the competitiveness of the domestic mineralogical industry. The state secretary explains that the EU directive excludes these processes, that the earlier ceramics exemption was found to be unlawful state aid, and that a broader exemption would be possible but would need budgetary cover, without committing to introduce one.
Looking at the European Commission's judgment, exempting all mineralogical processes would probably be possible, because there would then be no state aid.
Kijkend naar het oordeel van de Europese Commissie zou vrijstelling van alle mineralogische procedés waarschijnlijk mogelijk zijn, omdat er dan geen sprake is van staatssteun.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Mor Gabriël klooster (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Ormel, CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about the court proceedings over expropriation of land belonging to the Mor Gabriël monastery in Turkey, including the EU representative's findings and whether the Netherlands would press Turkey to reverse the expropriation and honour Council of Europe resolution 1704. The minister replied that the EU representative was not present at that hearing, gave the next hearing date, said the EU delegation had already made a démarche and Nederland had raised concerns in Council of Europe and bilateral channels, and promised continued engagement with the Turkish ambassador.

At Netherlands' urging, the EU delegation in Turkey made a démarche to the Turkish government on 15 February on behalf of all EU member states to express concern about the course of the Mor Gabriël court case.

Mede op aandringen van Nederland, heeft de EU-vertegenwoordiging in Turkije op 15 februari jl. bij de Turkse regering gedémarcheerd, om namens alle EU-lidstaten haar zorg uit te spreken over het verloop van de Mor Gabriël-rechtszaak.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over bescherming van fiscale informatie van burgers (ingezonden 1 maart 2011).

MP Omtzigt asked whether the Belastingdienst fails to verify consent and record who requests citizens' tax data via help and information points (HIPs), as the CBP found, and what measures will follow. The state secretary acknowledged the CBP findings, said HIP contracts require consent checks, and announced steps including phoning sampled taxpayers, updating contact registers and revising processor agreements.
By signing those agreements these HIPs are obliged, among other things, to handle all data carefully.
Met het ondertekenen van die overeenkomsten verplichten deze HIPs onder meer om zorgvuldig met alle gegevens om te gaan.
Vragen de leden Omtzigt en De Rouwe (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de verhoging van het liggeld voor woonboten (ingezonden 29 maart 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and De Rouwe asked the State Secretary of Finance about sharp increases in mooring fees for houseboat residents, including claims of a 300% rise at Zijkanaal B in Velsen and allegations that state mooring permits were auctioned at high prices. The State Secretary answered that the average increase at Zijkanaal B is 91.7% after accounting for the VAT exemption, denied any auction took place, and said the policy was softened by lengthening the adjustment period and notice period.
No, there has been no auction.
Neen, er is geen sprake geweest van een veiling.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Huizing (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), De Jong (PVV), Ulenbelt (SP) en Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Financiën over het oproep

MPs asked the state secretary about employers, including Connexxion as self-insurer, summoning former employees with WGA 35-80% disability for medical reassessments, and about the rights, procedures and re-integration duties involved. The state secretary answered that assessment of incapacity is reserved to the UWV, that self-insuring employers may request reassessment but cannot set the percentage themselves, and that he sees no reason for new rules or talks with Connexxion.
The UWV or the self-insuring employer have the possibility to summon a WGA beneficiary.
Het UWV of de eigenrisicodrager hebben de mogelijkheid om een WGA-gerechtigde op te roepen.

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de traumahelikopters in Enschede die door de nieuwbouw niet meer vlak bij het traumacentrum kunnen landen (ingezonden 29 maart 2

An MP asked the health minister whether the new hospital building in Enschede prevents trauma helicopters from landing close to the trauma centre, forcing patients to be wheeled longer distances, and whether the minister would help find a better solution. The minister replied that the hospital has assessed landing options with helicopter operators, decided not to move the helipad, and is working on two solutions to shorten internal transport, while stating that hospital construction is primarily the hospital's own responsibility.
Incidentally, the (new/re)construction of a hospital is primarily the responsibility of the hospital itself.
Overigens is (nieuw/ver)bouw van een ziekenhuis primair de verantwoordelijkheid van een ziekenhuis zelf.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het tegengaan van fraude met Voorlopige Teruggaaf (VT) (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance about fraud with preliminary tax refunds (VT), including signals investigated, amounts withheld, a criminal case, stolen identity data and bank account controls. The state secretary confirmed the priority and measures, declined to discuss the pending criminal case, and promised to consolidate action in the Fiscal Agenda.
This case is still before the court. For that reason I cannot go into it.
Deze zaak is nog onder de rechter. Om die reden kan ik er niet op ingaan.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de Wet op de Omzetbelasting (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

Deputy Omtzigt asked the state secretary of Finance about the implementation of EU VAT directives, business consultation and information channels, B2B reverse-charge and exemption differences across member states, VAT recovery for number acquisitions, and permanent establishment issues. The state secretary answered that consultation with business was held, information is available via the Belastingdienst, and that the Netherlands applies reverse charge to all B2B services; he acknowledged differences among member states and indicated he would assess simplifying the ABC-scheme refund procedure.
I will assess to what extent it is possible to achieve a statutory simplification of this refund procedure for these cases.
Ik zal beoordelen in hoeverre het mogelijk is om voor deze gevallen te komen tot een wettelijke vereenvoudiging van deze teruggaafprocedure.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Biskop (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de btw-vrijstelling voor het beroepsonderwijs (ingezonden 4 maart 2011)

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the 2010 change to the VAT exemption for vocational education created uncertainty for guest teachers, and whether the exemption should be drawn as broadly as EU rules allow. The State Secretary replied that the change only concerns non-statutory vocational education, that guest teachers can be exempt via the RKBO register under a lighter audit, and that the available EU room is already used.

Because the change in VAT rules from 1 July 2010 relates only to non-statutory vocational education, I am not aware that the change has caused uncertainty about the VAT obligations of self-employed teachers and guest teachers in statutory vocational education.

Omdat de wijziging in de BTW-regelgeving per 1 juli 2010 uitsluitend betrekking heeft op het niet wettelijk erkende beroepsonderwijs is mij niet bekend dat die wijziging aanleiding is geweest voor onduidelijkheid

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) Neppérus en Van der Burg (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over informatie over Nederlandse charitatieve instellingen (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

MPs asked the state secretary of Finance about public disclosure of Dutch charitable institutions (ANBIs) compared with the UK Charity Commission, including why only name and town are published and whether the English model should inform the new Geefwet. The state secretary said only name and seat are published by design, that ANBIs face the same disclosure duties as other foundations, and that he is willing to discuss broader data and transparency of ANBI assessments with the sector and ministries.
I am willing to reconsider, in consultation with the umbrella organisations, whether extending the published data with other information is possible.
Ik ben bereid om in overleg met de koepelorganisaties opnieuw te bezien of uitbreiding met andere gegevens mogelijk is.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Hijum (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het Landelijk Register Kindero

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance and two ministers about the national childcare register (LRK), including unmatched parents, the welcome text on the website, multi-child households, and the lack of a real-time link to tax systems. The government answered that most parents responded, that the website text was accurate, that a study of a link will be done, and that multi-provider reporting only becomes possible from 2012.
I can commit to having a study carried out this year into the possibility of such a link.
Ik kan u toezeggen dit jaar een onderzoek te laten doen naar de mogelijkheid van een dergelijke koppeling.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Mor Gabriel klooster in Turkije (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Turkish state's court win over the Mor Gabriel monastery should concern the Netherlands, asking which EU embassies attended hearings, whether Turkey guarantees minority rights, and whether the minister would press Turkey and the Council of Europe on the case. The minister confirmed awareness, said the embassy and EU delegation monitor hearings, shared the Commission's concern on minority rights, and reported an EU démarche and continued bilateral raising of the issue.
At the urging of the Netherlands, the EU representation in Turkey made a démarche to the Turkish government on 15 February to voice concern over the Mor Gabriel case.
Mede op aandringen van Nederland, heeft de EU-vertegenwoordiging in Turkije op 15 februari jl. bij de Turkse regering gedémarcheerd
Vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Financiën en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over kunstbeurzen (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MPs Van der Werf and Omtzigt asked about the customs guarantee for art fairs such as TEFAF, including whether the guarantee had tripled and whether it had ever been called upon. The government denied any increase in import guarantees, explained the VAT change and customs presence at the fair, and offered consultation with the fair organisers.
Customs is willing to consult with the fair organisation and the forwarders involved to jointly seek a comprehensive solution to this issue for coming years.
De Douane is graag bereid met de beursorganisatie en betrokken expediteurs in overleg te treden, om in gezamenlijkheid een integrale oplossing voor dit vraagstuk voor volgende jaren te zoeken.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Eigenrisicodragen voor WGA» (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

MP Omtzigt asked the state secretary about a UWV web text describing WGA employer self-insurance (eigenrisicodrager), reintegration duties, the absence of sanctions and of a process regulation, and the remedies available to beneficiaries. The state secretary answered that employers bear legal reintegration duties regardless of private insurance, that no sanction was chosen but UWV can extend sick pay, and that beneficiaries can object and appeal to the administrative court.
The legislator did not choose a statutory sanction for the self-insuring employer.
De wetgever heeft niet gekozen voor een wettelijke sanctie voor de eigenrisicodrager.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over fraude met voorlopige teruggaaf (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

MP Omtzigt asked the state secretary of Finance about fraud with provisional tax refunds (voorlopige teruggaaf), including identity fraud and vulnerable groups, and the scale of losses, pre-checks, and protective measures. The state secretary confirmed the priority, reported about 29,000 investigated and 45,000 total signals worth about EUR 135 million with roughly EUR 45 million paid out wrongly, said pre-checks are partly possible but not automated, and promised a detailed letter with further measures.
Because I want to know how successful the approach to this fraud is, I have instructed the Tax Administration to monitor the recovery of these fraud cases separately.
Omdat ik wil weten in hoeverre de aanpak van deze fraude succesvol is heb ik de Belastingdienst opgedragen de invordering van deze fraudeposten apart te monitoren.

Vragen van de leden Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink, Van der Burg (beiden VVD) en Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over problemen omtrent het aanvragen van een DigiD (ingezonden 26 ja

Three MPs asked the Interior Minister about Dutch citizens abroad being unable to obtain a DigiD, which blocks access to services such as the pension overview site, and about progress on counter-desk issuance, the Register Niet Ingezetenen and postal or digital issuance. The minister acknowledged the problem, said counter issuance at Schiphol and abroad is being explored with a technical build expected in early 2012, and ruled out postal or digital issuance as too vulnerable to fraud.
I am currently investigating several options to meet the wishes of non-residents for using DigiD.
Momenteel onderzoek ik meerdere mogelijkheden om aan de wensen tot het gebruik van DigiD van niet-ingezetenen tegemoet te komen.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de kinderopvangtoeslag (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked why childcare-allowance applicants had to re-enter whole forms after failing to match the national childcare register, and about digital copies, confirmation timelines, reminder letters and real-time register checks. The state secretary defended the matching process, admitted the application program is not user-friendly but cannot be fixed with current software, and committed to a reminder deadline of 28 February 2011 while rejecting a real-time register check as infeasible.
The application program is unfortunately not user-friendly in this respect.
Het aanvraagprogramma is hierin helaas niet gebruikersvriendelijk.

Vragen van de leden Uitslag, Omtzigt en Smilde (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over voornemens tot overheveling van de kraamafdeling van het ziekenhuis in Almelo naar Hengelo (ingezonde

CDA MPs asked the health minister about ZGT's plan to move the obstetric ward from Almelo to Hengelo, covering access, safety, capacity, home-birth rates, and the insurers' view. The minister answered that no final decision has been taken, that concentration is possible for quality reasons, that Hengelo's current capacity is insufficient, and that the IGZ can intervene if care quality is at risk.
Through the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) I am authorised and willing to intervene if the quality of care is at stake.
Via de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) ben ik bevoegd en bereid in te grijpen als de kwaliteit van zorg in het geding is.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zelfstandigen zonder persone

MPs Omtzigt and Uitslag asked the health, finance and VWS ministers whether the government still intends to allow self-employed care workers (zzp'ers) to be contracted, what concrete steps were taken, what the administrative and inspection consequences are, whether the 2012 promise will be kept, how four care-worker cases should be classified, and whether consultation with the sector will occur. The government answered that the aim remains, that preparatory activities are underway with a target of 1 January 2012 at the earliest, that employment classification is a matter for law and jurisprudence rather than politics, and that the Besluit zorgaanspraken AWBZ amendment will report on implementation.
It is not for politics to assess the facts and circumstances of an employment relationship.
Het is niet aan de politiek om de feiten en omstandigheden van een arbeidsrelatie te beoordelen.
Vragen van de leden Ormel en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de terroristische moordaanslag op Koptische Christenen in Egypte (ingezonden 5 januari 2011).

CDA MPs Ormel and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the New Year's Eve attack on a Coptic church in Alexandria, links to Iraqi attacks, delays in trying suspects in the January 2010 Naga Hammadi killings, Coptic Christmas security, Arab League reaction and EU/international efforts to ease Christian-Muslim tensions. The minister expressed condolences, reported that Egyptian authorities attribute the attack to a splinter group without releasing full findings, noted a death sentence against the main suspect in the Naga Hammadi case, and described EU and UN steps including raising the issue at the Foreign Affairs Council.
Further information on the outcome of the Egyptian authorities' investigation has not been made public.
Verdere informatie over het resultaat van het onderzoek van de Egyptische autoriteiten is niet openbaar gemaakt.

Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het ontbreken van christelijke feestdagen op een kalender van de Europese Commissie (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs why all Christian holidays were missing from a European Commission school calendar. The State Secretary answered that the omission was an unintended error, that the Commission would issue a rectification with official national holidays, and that he regretted the omission.
To correct this error, the Commission will send a rectification to all schools that received the agenda.
Om deze fout te herstellen zal de Commissie een rectificatie sturen aan alle scholen die de agenda hebben ontvangen.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over doorgifte van het registratienummer van de kinderopvang (ingezonden 18

Two CDA MPs asked why the Tax Administration sent about 114,000 childcare allowance applicants letters requiring them to provide the Dutch childcare register number by 28 January, under threat of losing the allowance, and questioned the short deadline, the burden on parents, and why Parliament was not informed earlier. The State Secretary answered that the letters were a planned step to link the register to the Tax Administration's system, that registration is a legal condition for the allowance, that the 14-day deadline is reasonable, and that the matter had been discussed with the ministry.
This is therefore not a response to an acute, unforeseen problem.
Het gaat hier dus niet om een reactie op een acuut, niet voorzien probleem.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Verburg (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over hoge regeldruk bij de innovatiebox (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the innovation box's regulatory burden is too high for SMEs and how many firms use it, and whether he would ask Actal to reduce administrative costs. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the burden is too high, cited strong SME interest and helpful tax office support, reported about 500 users through 2009, and saw no reason for further steps while monitoring the scheme and planning a 2013 evaluation.
In view of the above, I see no reason to take further steps.
Gezien het bovenstaande zie ik geen aanleiding nadere stappen te ondernemen.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de vrijwilligersvergoeding voor vrijwilligerswerk (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

Member Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance why some tax inspectors accept volunteer compensation waivers as deductible gifts while others reject identical declarations, and whether past returns are being revised. The State Secretary answers that deductibility depends on factual tax conditions, not on an ANBI declaration alone, that the assessment framework was circulated to inspectors in March 2009, and that earlier years may be reassessed within the statute of limitations.
The assessment framework outlined in the answer to questions 4 and 5 was widely circulated to the inspectors in March 2009.
Het beoordelingskader zoals geschetst in het antwoord op de vragen 4 en 5 is in maart 2009 breed bekend gemaakt aan de inspecteurs.

Vragen van de leden Ormel en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de ontvangst van een Wit-Russische minister door de EU Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Lady Ashton (ingezonden 10 j

MPs Ormel and Omtzigt asked the minister whether the EU High Representative Ashton should meet Belarusian Foreign Minister Martynov given EU-US sanctions efforts, the European Parliament debate and Dutch policy against the Belarusian regime. The minister answered that current EU policy does not prevent such a meeting, that the Netherlands will press for condemnation of the crackdown and release of detainees during the meeting, and that the meeting will take place Wednesday.
The Netherlands will propose in the EU that the High Representative also receive the Belarusian opposition.
Nederland zal in de EU voorstellen dat de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger ook de Belarussische oppositie ontvangt.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het toeslagensysteem van de Belastingdienst (ingezonden 31 december 2010).

The MP asks the state secretary of Finance about delays in the Tax Administration's VAT refund system, including how many requests were forwarded, which problems were known by 1 May 2010, whether other countries had similar issues, and how much late-payment interest is paid. The state secretary answers that 96 requests were sent in January 2010, 10 were rejected abroad, about 5,000 entrepreneurs will receive late-payment interest with procedures set in January 2011, and the disruption has been resolved.
Preparations are currently underway for the payment of late-payment interest.
Voor betaling van de coulancerente zijn thans de voorbereidingen gaande.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Tony van Dijck (PVV) en Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het pensioenfonds van Smit Internationale (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

MPs Omtzigt, Van Dijck and Vermeij asked the minister whether Boskalis's former Smit management put shareholders ahead of the Smit pension fund, and whether the employer bears a moral duty and should be called to account. The minister refused to engage directly, calling it a matter between Boskalis, the pension fund board and its bodies, though Boskalis offered a one-off EUR 30 million payment conditional on withdrawal of a lawsuit.
This is a matter between Boskalis, the board of the Smit pension fund, the accountability body and the participants' council. There is no role for the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment.
Dit is een zaak tussen Boskalis, het bestuur van het pensioenfonds Smit, het verantwoordingsorgaan en de deelnemersraad. Er ligt geen rol voor de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het aanhoudend en systematisch geweld tegen christenen in Bagdad (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

MPs Omtzigt and Ormel asked the Foreign Minister about ongoing violence against Christians in Baghdad, including attacks on relatives of hostage victims, and whether this is a systematic campaign to drive Christians out of Iraq. The minister condemned the violence and said the Iraqi government must restore security and protect minorities, denying a systematic campaign and declining a separate EU-Arab League meeting.
I strongly condemn the violent incidents that have taken place in Iraq in recent weeks and that have affected the Iraqi population, including Iraqi Christians.
Ik veroordeel ten zeerste de gewelddadige incidenten die de afgelopen weken in Irak hebben plaatsgevonden en die de Irakese bevolking, waaronder de Irakese christenen, hebben getroffen.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Spies (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer, van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Financiën over E85 (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

MPs Omtzigt and Spies asked the ministers about E85 and other high-blend biofuels, including tax correction, traceability, the Platform Duurzame Mobiliteit, and comparison with other European countries.
