The government answered that tax compensation for sustainable E85 applies since April 2010, that a temporary tax arrangement may be considered for new blends, and that traceability and infrastructure subsidies are being pursued, while leaving some matters to future reports.

If a company has concrete plans to introduce a new higher blend to the market and wants to test the product first, it will be examined whether a temporary excise compensation can be granted for a limited test period under strict conditions, analogous to the E85 arrangement.

Als een bedrijf concrete plannen heeft voor de marktintroductie van een nieuwe hogere blend en dit nieuwe product eerst wil testen, zal worden bezien of voor een gelimiteerde testperiode onder strikte voorwaarden een tijdelijke accijnscompensatie kan worden verleend analoog aan de regeling voor E85.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ferrier (beiden CDA), Timmer en Kraneveldt-van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een cluster 3 school

MPs asked whether a school in Losser for children with an IQ of 35 or lower lacks structural care funding after the AWBZ package measures and why it has no education recognition from the municipality. The minister said the school needs municipal agreement, denied a confirmed funding gap, pointed to adjusted care classes and a EUR 10 million subsidy, and promised continued consultation with the health ministry.
It is not known whether there are no or fewer structural funds as a result of the AWBZ 2009 package measure for the care activities at the school.
Het is niet bekend of er geen of minder structurele middelen zijn als gevolg van de pakketmaatregel AWBZ 2009 voor de zorgactiviteiten op de school.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financiën over de deal tussen de vereniging SBPVH en de stichting OPTAS (ingezonden 21 mei 2010).

Omtzigt asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Finance whether the €500 million settlement between SBPVH and OPTAS implies OPTAS had no right to the harbour workers' pension money, and whether a similar deal could be reached with Aegon. Minister Donner welcomed the settlement, said the parties have always acted within the law, declined to comment on OPTAS publicly, and said he would facilitate an Aegon-SBPVH agreement if useful.
I therefore have no judgement on the changed position of the OPTAS foundation and also see no reason for a public response to the OPTAS foundation.
Ik heb derhalve geen oordeel over de gewijzigde opstelling van de stichting Optas en zie ook geen reden voor een publiekelijke reactie aan de stichting Optas.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Spies (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over mogelijke windfall profits in de energie-intensieve industrie al

MPs Omtzigt and Spies asked whether a CE Delft study showing windfall profits in energy-intensive industry from free ETS allowances warrants policy changes, and what it means for the EU carbon leakage list and emissions trading design. The minister acknowledged the study, said pass-through of allowance value is plausible, noted allocation to 2012 is fixed, reaffirmed a preference for auctioning and strict carbon leakage criteria, and promised further research while stating the NEa does not monitor windfall profits.
I am of the view that it is good to conduct further research into carbon leakage, so that we are better able to determine which sectors are affected by it.
Ik ben van mening dat het goed is om verder onderzoek te doen naar carbon leakage, opdat we beter in staat zijn vast te stellen welke sectoren hiermee te maken hebben.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Haverkamp (beiden CDA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bomaanslagen in Mosul op bussen met christelijke studenten (ingezonden

MPs asked the foreign minister about bomb attacks on buses of Christian students in Mosul and how to increase international protection of minorities, including a round-table conference and UN action. The minister confirmed the attack, said protection of minorities is the Iraqi government's responsibility, pointed to existing EU/Dutch human rights and aid efforts, and reported that the UN mission discussed minority protection, without committing to a new conference or UN initiative.
Guaranteeing the safety and human rights of minorities is a matter for the Iraqi government.
De waarborging van de veiligheid en mensenrechten van minderheden is een zaak voor de Irakese regering.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het artikel «Lek woekerpensioen gedicht» (ingezonden 13 april 2010).

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the proposed compensation for 'woekerpensioen' collective defined-contribution pension schemes, questioning the use of the Wabek norm, cost transparency, and workers' remedies. Minister Donner defended the agreed norm as set by the parties themselves, said transparency has improved under the Pensioenwet, and declined to change the norm.
The norm was set by the parties involved themselves, and it is not for me to change this norm.
De norm is vastgesteld door de betrokken partijen zelf en het is niet aan mij om deze norm te wijzigen.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatsecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over blanco stemformulieren voor kiezers in het buitenland

MPs Haverkamp and Omtzigt asked about blank ballot papers sent to overseas voters due to a printing error and whether a third of registered voters had not yet received ballots in time. The state secretary explained replacement options, including embassy briefstembureaus, and said the mistake did not invalidate ballots missing a signature, while noting late-arriving ballots would be addressed by setting up embassy polling points.
Some voters received a blank ballot as a result of a production error by a supplier of the municipality of The Hague.
Een aantal kiezers heeft als gevolg van een productiefout van een leverancier van de gemeente Den Haag een blanco stembiljet ontvangen.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Spies (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Financiën over duurzame bio-ethanol (E85) (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked whether government fleet cars can run on E85 bio-ethanol, whether M85 biomethanol producers can get excise compensation for lower energy content, and which other sustainable fuels could qualify. The government answered that only 17 state fleet cars can use E85, that suppliers mainly blend biofuels, that an E85 excise refund was introduced from 1 April 2010 for demonstrably sustainable ethanol, and that M85 compensation is not currently relevant, while noting possible EU-level changes to excise tariffs.
Furthermore, M85 is more corrosive than E85, so the car industry withdraws the warranty when M85 is used.
Voorts is M85 meer corrosief dan E85, waardoor de auto-industrie bij gebruik van M85 de garantie laat vervallen.
Vragen van de leden Smilde en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het kwijtraken van collectieve zorgverzekering na ontslag (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

MPs Smilde and Omtzigt asked the health minister whether insurers may withdraw the 10% collective discount when employees lose their jobs, and whether a regulation should guarantee the discount until year-end. The minister confirmed awareness, said insurers and collectives may agree arrangements, and declined to legislate, leaving it to insurers.
Since the law provides sufficient scope to make such agreements, I do not intend to legally require insurers to give a dismissed employee a discount until the end of the year.

Aangezien de wet voldoende ruimte biedt om dit soort afspraken te maken, ben ik niet voornemens het wettelijk voor te schrijven aan verzekeraars dat zij een ontslagen werknemer tot het eind van het jaar een korting moeten geven.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over carrouselfraude (ingezonden 8 april 2010).

Mr Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister whether linking VAT payment to the right to deduct it, as proposed in a dissertation by Mr Wolf, could prevent carousel fraud and whether it is technically feasible. The minister answered that the idea is attractive but would impose large administrative burdens on all businesses, requires an EU Directive change, and raises technical and proof issues, while the Commission is studying it and the tax authority has launched a fraud information line.
We look forward with interest to the Commission's findings and will assess proposals in this area against the general principle Netherlands applies.
Wij wachten de bevindingen van de Commissie met belangstelling af en zullen voorstellen op dit gebied beoordelen
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een computerstoring bij KPN (ingezonden 6 april 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about a KPN network outage that briefly blocked access to GP and medication records, the maximum allowed downtime for EPD systems, whether single-point-of-failure storage is lawful, and liability for medical errors caused by inaccessible records. The minister said he had no direct access to the site, that national EPD outages may occur at most twice a year and must be resolved within a day with sanctions only after the law takes effect, that KPN had backups and a KPN evaluation was underway, that NEN 7510 covers backup requirements so extra measures are unnecessary, and that liability follows the professional standard of care.
As long as the EPD bill has not yet entered into force, there is no sanction possibility.
Zolang het EPD-wetsvoorstel nog niet inwerking is getreden is er geen sanctiemogelijkheid.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de vogelgriep

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about avian flu: the high poultry density, possible structural measures such as bans on new or expanded poultry farms in water-rich and dense areas, risks to wild birds and humans, and pandemic risk. I am currently having an impact analysis carried out on these structural measures.
Ik laat momenteel een impactanalyse uitvoeren naar deze structuurmaatregelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Podt, Bromet, Eerdmans, Grinwis, Beckerman, Graus en Dassen over ‘het door de Kamer geëiste verbod op stroomstootapparatuur in de veehouderij, dat de minister nog altijd niet hee

MPs from eight parties asked the minister why the ban on electric shock equipment in livestock farming, which parliament demanded, is still unsigned and may not take effect on 1 January 2026. The minister replied that the final decision steps are ready, that an exception to the standard two-month entry-into-force period may allow 1 January 2026, and that the aim remains entry into force on that date.
Within the cabinet policy on fixed change moments, I see room to use an exception to the standard two-month entry-into-force period, so that entry into force on 1 January 2026 remains possible.

Binnen het kabinetsbeleid over de vaste verandermomenten zie ik ruimte om gebruik te maken van een uitzonderingsgrond op de vaste invoeringstermijn van twee maanden, waardoor inwerkingtreding op 1 januari 2026 een mogelijkheid blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Slagt-Tichelman en Gabriëls over het bericht dat gemeenten een landelijke aanpak voor bestrijdingsmiddelen willen

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the minister about municipalities' calls for a national approach to pesticides in bulb cultivation, including a statutory spray-free zone and national rules, and about the government's health-in-all-policies approach. The minister answered that a legal framework already exists for municipalities to act locally, that a study on spray-zone width is under way, that the sector is reducing pesticide use voluntarily, and that no national statutory spray-free zone will be introduced.
I agree with the municipality of Midden-Drenthe that this issue is complex, and I endorse the importance of mutual trust and open communication between farmers and residents.
Ik ben het eens met de gemeente Midden-Drenthe dat dit vraagstuk complex is, en onderschrijf het belang van onderling vertrouwen en open communicatie tussen agrariërs en omwonenden.

MP Bromet asks the minister about a Danish study showing the PFAS compound TFA leaches easily into groundwater, Denmark's withdrawal of 23 pesticides, the Ctgb's delay in reviewing them, the continued use of fluopyram products, and extended sell-off periods for Luna Sensation. Once the Ctgb has taken a decision, I will inform your House of it.
Zodra er een besluit is genomen door het Ctgb zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.

The minister answered that no package was presented, that four knowledge institutes are analysing the measures and results will be shared only after cabinet decision-making, and that the questions were answered within three weeks.
As usual, the underlying documents from external parties containing relevant analyses, facts, risks and explanations will be shared with the House and made public after cabinet decision-making.

Zoals gebruikelijk worden de onderliggende documenten van externe partijen die relevante analyses, feiten, risico's en toelichtingen bevatten na besluitvorming in het kabinet gedeeld met Uw Kamer en openbaar gemaakt.

During the visit I conveyed my concerns about the human rights situation in discussions with my counterpart.

The state secretary answered that tender rules apply, selection criteria are the municipality's own competence, and that revised lease rules and talks with provinces and municipalities are planned, while declining to intervene in private lease decisions.
That is why I am working on revising the lease regulations, so that concluding long-term lease agreements becomes more attractive.
Daarom werk ik aan de herziening van de pachtregelgeving, waardoor het sluiten van langlopende pachtovereenkomsten aantrekkelijker wordt gemaakt.

The minister answered that the German scheme is similar to the planned Dutch balance, that Dutch data sources exist, that lessons will be drawn, and that the minister is willing to talk with Germany and inform parliament if this yields insights.
I am willing to discuss this with the German government. If this leads to additional insights, I will inform you about it.
Ik ben bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met de Duitse overheid. Indien dit tot aanvullende inzichten leidt, zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Bromet over de berichten dat Zeeuwse buffels te veel PFAS binnenkrijgen

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked why the NVWA knew for two years that Zeeland water buffalo contained too much PFAS without informing the province or nature organisation, and what risks and remedies exist. The State Secretary answered that the owner was informed, no food safety risk existed since the meat was no longer sold, communication improvements and RIVM research are underway, but no direct action on the province's request was committed.

Because the buffalo were no longer slaughtered for human consumption and there was no food safety risk, there was no need to inform other parties such as the province of Zeeland and the nature organisation Het Zeeuwse Landschap.

Omdat de buffels hierna niet meer werden afgevoerd voor humane consumptie en er geen sprake was van een voedselveiligheidsrisico, bestond geen noodzaak andere partijen zoals de provincie Zeeland en natuurorganisatie Het Zeeuwse Landschap op de hoogte te stellen.

The state secretary confirmed it, said it was meant to reduce dog bites among children aged 6-10 and cost about EUR 45,000, but that after consultation with the education ministry the mailing was cancelled and an alternative destination is being considered.
In consultation with the State Secretary of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (OCW), it has now been decided not to send the books to primary schools anymore.
Inmiddels is in overleg met de Staatssecretaris van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW) besloten de boeken niet meer te versturen aan basisscholen.

I expect the results of these analyses in the second quarter of 2025.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van deze analyses in het tweede kwartaal van 2025.

No, that is not the case. I want to emphasise that no exception was made when issuing the definitive nature permit for Schiphol.
Nee, dat is niet het geval. Ik wil benadrukken geen enkele uitzondering te hebben gemaakt bij afgifte van de definitieve natuurvergunning voor Schiphol.

The State Secretary answered that GGD advice is available, that a RIVM study on pesticides and residents is underway, that a motion on spray-free zones is being considered, and that the Omgevingswet allows municipalities to apply the precautionary principle.
Since a lot of crop protection agents are used in lily cultivation, the Minister of LNV will start an investigation into how the expansion of the lily acreage can be limited.
Aangezien in de lelieteelt veel gewasbeschermingsmiddelen worden gebruikt, gaat de Minister van LNV een onderzoek starten naar hoe de uitbreiding van het areaal in de lelieteelt beperkt kan worden.

The minister replied that LIFE and EFRO funding are possible in principle but no concrete study was done, provinces are responsible, and she will raise the options with the provinces and set up a long-term coexistence vision.
I will bring these options to the attention of the provinces.
Ik zaldeze mogelijkheden onder de aandacht brengen bij de provincies.

MPs Bromet and De Hoop asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about three court rulings that found the refusal of enforcement requests against Schiphol, Eindhoven Airport and Rotterdam The Hague Airport inadequately reasoned, and about external nitrogen offsetting, the PAS legalisation programme and general national nitrogen measures. The Minister answered that she will reconsider the objection decisions taking the court's reasoning into account, will not appeal, is tightening external offsetting rules and broadening PAS-melder options, but declined to give a full list of affected projects and did not commit to new enforcement against other permits.
The court ruled that my decision not to impose appropriate measures was insufficiently reasoned.
De rechtbank heeft geoordeeld dat ik mijn besluit om geen passende maatregelen op te leggen onvoldoende heb gemotiveerd.

State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that the government stays within Paris-aligned targets, that accelerated extraction only shifts production forward in time, and that the 2023 trawling closure target was missed but will be pursued via an EU procedure with a proposal by end 2024.
I have told the NZO that our aim is to submit the joint recommendation (to reach 13.7%) to the European Commission by the end of 2024.
Ik heb aan het NZO aangegeven dat onze inzet is om de gezamenlijke aanbeveling (om te komen tot 13,7%) uiterlijk eind 2024 bij de Europese Commissie in te dienen.

Two MPs asked the agriculture minister about a letter from a Zeeland water storage partnership requesting an extension because a 20-month wait between application and grant cut the project's runtime by about half, partly linked to ELFPO funding. The minister acknowledged the delay, attributed it to an overspent crisis-era EHF scheme and budget reshuffling, said the funding is not from ELFPO, pointed to the 2025 deadlines and the new CAP period, and declined to comment on the pending objection procedure.
The project in question is the subject of an objection procedure, so no statement can be made on it now.
Het voorliggende project is onderwerp van een bezwaarprocedure, daarom kan daar nu geen uitspraak over gedaan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Bromet over de aanwezigheid van hoge concentraties van het verboden gewasbeschermingsmiddel dinoterb in oppervlaktewater in het Natura 2000-gebied het Zwanenwater

MPs Gabriëls and Bromet asked about dinoterb, a banned pesticide, found in surface water in the Natura 2000 area Zwanenwater, including its origin, enforcement capacity, sanctions and whether enforcement should be tightened. The minister said a HHNK investigation into sources is underway, that residues may leach from soil or illegal use is possible, that NVWA found no dinoterb in inspections, and that enforcement was adequate while the ministries explore improving oversight.
I am waiting for the results of the investigation before deciding whether further action is necessary.
Ik wacht de resultaten van het onderzoek af om te kunnen bepalen of verdere actie noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor, Bromet en Bushoff over het rapport ‘De Europees- en Internationaalrechtelijke status van de Waddenzee’

Opposition MPs Chakor, Bromet and Bushoff asked the government about the Waddenacademie report on the European and international legal status of the Wadden Sea, including whether the Ternaard gas extraction permit was tested against World Heritage obligations and the fragmentation of Wadden Sea governance. The Minister replied that the report is still being studied, that the permit is assessed under the Nature Conservation Act with only indirect World Heritage considerations, and that the landsadvocaat's advice cannot be shared because it could harm the state's litigation position.
I cannot share this advice with you now, because it could harm the position of the state in any future legal proceedings.
Dit advies kan ik nu niet met u delen, omdat dit de positie van de staat in een eventueel proces zou kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Tjeerd de Groot, Kostić en Koekkoek over de controle op visfraude door de NVWA

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, D66, PvdD and Volt asked the minister about the court ruling on NVWA fish-fraud controls, overfishing, the adequacy of staffing and EU compliance of the inspection system. The minister acknowledged ongoing EU infringement procedures and announced capacity expansion and a revised steekproefplan, while largely defending current staffing levels and declining to share confidential Commission advice.
These advice and remarks are confidential.
Deze adviezen en opmerkingen zijn vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Nieuwe klap voor boeren: grond onder hun voeten vandaan’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about Staatsbosbeheer's letters telling nature-managing farmers their leases may not be renewed after the Didam ruling forced an open tender procedure. The minister confirmed the letters, said the criteria are objective and the process does not favour intensive dairy, and acknowledged the farmers would have preferred earlier notice.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Thijssen en Van der Lee over de Rabobank en de ontbossers

MPs asked the government about Rabobank financing deforestation actors, whether financial services should be regulated like deforestation-free products, and whether Dutch and EU policy on livestock reduction and financing is consistent with the Paris goals. The ministers answered that banks are responsible for due diligence under OECD guidelines, that the Commission will assess regulating financial institutions by mid-2025, and that the Finance Minister will report on financial-sector measures by year end.
The cabinet expects financial institutions to act in line with international standards for responsible business conduct.
Het kabinet verwacht van financiële instellingen dat zij handelen conform de internationale standaarden voor internationaal verantwoord ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over het artikel 'Gelekte documenten bewijzen tot nu toe onbekende connecties tussen Rusland en de PVV'

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the Minister of Interior whether foreign donations, including from Russia, could still reach Dutch parties via intermediaries, and about follow-up to a motion and advisory report on investigating Russian financing. The minister said the ban on non-Dutch donations applies since 2023, that a penetration test of the party financing law is underway, and that the motion on investigating Russian financing is a matter for the House Presidium, not his ministry.
I expect to receive the results of this test this year.
Naar verwachting zal ik nog dit jaar de beschikking krijgen over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over openbare pachtveilingen van het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf

An MP asked the ministers why public tenders by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (government property agency) of farmland, including an organically farmed plot in Almere, did not state organic use and allowed bulb cultivation, and how this fits the 15% organic farming target. The minister answered that a binding crop plan applied, organic use was not known to the agency because the outgoing tenant did not provide it, the agency rewards organic bids, and that a joint study will examine stimulating organic farming on regular leases, while the buffer-zone question falls outside any binding rule.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het artikel 'US agency refuses to examine toxicity of 'inactive' pesticide chemicals to crops'

An MP asked the Agriculture and Health ministers whether EU/Dutch pesticide approval covers inactive co-formulants, whether PFAS or POEA are used, and whether other very high concern substances are approved or used as co-formulants. The minister answered that co-formulants are assessed alongside the active substance, that the EU now bans unacceptable co-formulants, that POE-tallowamines were removed and are being phased out, and that several RIVM-identified substances have been or will be removed from use.
When assessing plant protection products in the EU, the co-formulants in the formulation are also examined alongside the active substance.
Bij de beoordeling van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in de EU wordt naast de actieve stof ook gekeken naar de hulpstoffen in de formulering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Sneller, Wassenberg en Bromet over het bericht dat prins Bernhard lid was van de NSDAP

Four MPs asked the Prime Minister how he views reports that Prince Bernhard had an NSDAP membership card, and whether he would support a CIDI call for research into the prince's Nazi-era past. The Prime Minister acknowledged the reports and said the information was already publicly known from accessible archives, and that further research will become possible at the Royal House Archive from early 2024 by extending access to 1948.
From the beginning of 2024, further research can be carried out in the Royal House Archive by extending access to the year 1948.
Met ingang van begin 2024 kan verder onderzoek worden verricht in het Koninklijk Huisarchief door verruiming van de toegang tot in het jaar 1948.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over antwoorden op eerdere schriftelijke vragen inzake het artikel ‘Nederlandse gemeenten overtreden massaal de wet door achterkamertjes in te duiken’

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the Minister of Interior about press reports that municipalities hold informal closed meetings bypassing public council rules, and whether such meetings should be regulated under open-government principles. The Minister replied that council and committee meetings are public by law and closed sessions are an exception requiring justification and a majority vote, that informal gatherings outside the Municipal Act are not prohibited but must not replace formal meetings, and that he will issue a circular on committee types and consult the VNG and council associations rather than seek Raad van State advice.

This starting point emerges, among other things, in the college's duty to inform that applies towards the council as a whole, even when the information is requested by one or more individual council members.

Dit uitgangspunt komt onder meer naar voren in de inlichtingenplicht van het college die jegens de raad als geheel geldt, ook als de inlichtingen door een of meer individuele raadsleden worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Verguisde stalvloer tegen stikstofuitstoot kan stoppende boer in de weg zitten’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister about reports that emission-reducing cattle-barn floors do not work as calculated, meaning some farmers who appear below the peak-load threshold may not qualify for the buy-out scheme and that permits were granted on the basis of inflated emission factors. The Minister answered that the emission factors have not yet been adjusted, that the government is examining options for a short-term clarification before the scheme closes, and that liability for manufacturers is a matter for buyers to pursue.
I am currently examining whether there are options to provide clarity to the entrepreneurs concerned in the short term.
Ik onderzoek momenteel of er mogelijkheden zijn om op korte termijn duidelijkheid te bieden aan de ondernemers die het betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over de aanpak van piekbelasting

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about the peak-load nitrogen approach, including the Gelderland interbestuurlijke aanpak, buyout scheme terms, land use after buyouts, industrial peak emitters, and advisory desks. The minister answered each sub-question, largely describing the existing voluntary framework and promising further analysis, while deferring some matters to provinces and declining to name a list of peak emitters.
The Ministry of LNV does not have a list of possible peak emitters.
Het Ministerie van LNV beschikt niet over een lijst met mogelijke «piekbelasters».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Dekker-Abdulaziz en Bromet over het artikel 'Nederlandse gemeenten overtreden massaal de wet door achterkamertjes in te duiken'

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch municipalities unlawfully hold informal closed meetings to avoid public scrutiny, and how the Municipalities Act and the Open Government Act apply. The Minister replied that the law sets openness as the rule, that informal technical or information meetings without decision-making are not regulated by the Municipalities Act, that no unlawful closed meetings were established, and that a circular on committees is being prepared.
I do not have figures on the number of municipalities that use closed meetings within the meaning of the Municipalities Act and other types of meetings.
Ik beschik niet over cijfermateriaal over het aantal gemeenten dat gebruik maakt van besloten vergaderingen in de zin van de Gemeentewet en andere type bijeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht 'Ede bedenkt eigen regeling om boerenbedrijven uit te laten breiden: 'Boeren perspectief bieden''

An MP asks whether Ede's interim policy allowing farm expansions via planning changes, relying on housing-style emission reductions, is lawful, risky, and appropriate given provincial and national programmes. The minister answers that the municipality is the competent authority for land-use planning, the province decides nature permits case by case, and the policy is interim and aligned with national and provincial goals.
The municipality of Ede's policy does not concern granting nature permits.
Het beleid van de gemeente Ede gaat niet over het verlenen van natuurvergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en De Hoop over de inperking van veerdiensten naar Ameland

MPs Bromet and De Hoop asked about the restriction of ferry services to Ameland, the broken road bridge at Holwert, and compensation for affected residents and businesses. The state secretary defended allowing a temporary force-majeure timetable for six weeks pending MARIN research, said no compensation is currently provided, and said the bridge renovation was not delayed and a second spare bridge section is already in use.
I have decided not to agree to a structural adjustment of the timetable between Holwert and Ameland.
Ik heb besloten niet in te stemmen met een structurele aanpassing van de dienstregeling tussen Holwert en Ameland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over zoönoserisico’s en vogelgriep bij mensen

MPs Westerveld and Bromet asked about bird flu transmission risks to humans, testing of exposed workers, mixed pig-poultry farms, and the adequacy of voluntary spatial measures under the NPLG. The minister answered that no human infections have been found in the Netherlands, that proactive surveillance of exposed workers starts in summer 2023, and that further research and a plan on mixed farms are under way, with spatial rules being explored rather than binding now.
Surveillance in this group is expected to be operational from summer 2023.
Naar verwachting is deze surveillance vanaf de zomer van 2023 operationeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de rol van het Didam-arrest op eerlijke pachtovereenkomsten tussen pachters en Staatsbosbeheer en het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Agriculture how the Didam ruling, which requires public tendering of leases, affects tenant security, sustainability, and the conduct of Staatsbosbeheer and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, and how the government will protect farmers. The Minister acknowledges the ruling weakens existing tenants' security, points to lease reform and sustainability criteria in tenders, and rejects the claim that public landlords prioritise short-term profit.
My objective is to encourage long-term lease contracts through amendment of the lease legislation; this will partly solve the problem.
Mijn doelstelling is om door wijziging van de pachtwetgeving langlopende pachtcontracten te stimuleren, dit zal het probleem deels verhelpen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Natuur- en actieclubs maken zich zorgen om hernieuwde interesse in zandwinning op het IJsselmeer en laten het Rijk opnieuw weten: 'Wy wiene, binne en bliuwe tsjin s

MP Bromet asked the ministers about reports of renewed interest in sand extraction in the IJsselmeer, why only the IJsselmeer area gets an environmental impact assessment, whether extraction outside shipping channels is possible under Natura 2000 and Ramsar status, how it fits with water and soil policy, and whether the province of Fryslân has been consulted. The government answered that the sand extraction policy is being renewed with regional involvement, that a planMER will assess ecological effects, that extraction outside shipping channels is possible only if the research shows natural features are not harmed, and that there has been contact with the province.
No environmental impact assessment (planMER) has been drawn up yet. This is expected to happen next year.
Er is nog geen milieueffectrapportage (planMER) opgesteld. Dit gebeurt naar verwachting volgend jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Microsoft bouwt al een jaar aan een datacentrum zonder bouw- en stikstofvergunningen’

MP Bromet asked the ministers whether Microsoft may continue building a data centre and high-voltage substation without permits, why construction was not halted after a Council of State ruling, which nature areas suffer nitrogen overload, whether the central government can halt the works, and how the confusion over permitting between Hollands Kroon and the province arose. The ministers answered that tolerance decisions were issued before the ruling, the environmental permit was granted on 19 April, the central government can intervene only in extreme cases under the Provinciewet, and the permitting confusion arose from new IPPC interpretations.
The central government, through inter-governmental supervision, is the supervisor of the provincial administrative bodies.
Het Rijk is vanuit het interbestuurlijk toezicht toezichthouder op de bestuursorganen van de provincies
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Boswijk en Grinwis over het bericht in Trouw met als titel: “onenigheid Rijk en provincie fnuikt redding van de grutto”

MPs Bromet, Boswijk and Grinwis asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about a Trouw report that Rijk-provincie disagreement stalls grutto protection and that funds remain unspent. The minister disputes that little money has been paid out (EUR 2.5 million of EUR 3 million allocated), says long-term contracts are legally possible and that provinces are responsible for the decision on long-term commitments, while promising shared intent to resolve the matter by next summer.
It is a competence of the provinces themselves whether or not to conclude long-term contracts at their own risk, without a financial guarantee for the period after 2027–2028.
Het is een bevoegdheid van de provincies zelf om al dan niet op eigen risico langjarige contracten af te sluiten zonder de financiële garantie voor de periode na 2027–2028.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over enkele berichten over de voorkeurslocatie van een militaire kazerne in Zeewolde

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports on the preferred location of a military barracks in Zeewolde, including nitrogen space, PAS-melders, farmland, flood risk and nature impacts. The government answered that the Zeewolde site is only a provisional preferred location, no permit has been filed, nitrogen needs are not yet calculated, and the final choice will be communicated to parliament later.
Once a final location choice is made, Defence will inform your House of Representatives about it.
Zodra er een definitieve locatiekeuze is, wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd door Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het alleen voor Chinees riet aanvragen van subsidie

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked why the ISDE insulation subsidy's product listing covered Chinese reed but not Dutch reed, raising level-playing-field, sustainability and EU state-aid concerns. The minister answered that a registration code was granted only because Chinese reed met the insulation threshold, that Dutch reed can apply once its performance declaration is ready, and that sustainability criteria for bio-based inputs are being developed.
It is correct that a registration code was requested and granted for Chinese reed and not yet for Dutch reed.
Het klopt dat er een meldcode is aangevraagd en verleend voor Chinees riet en nog niet voor Nederlands riet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Thijssen over ‘procedures door de overheid’

MPs Bromet and Thijssen asked how many administrative objection, appeal and enforcement procedures on nitrogen (stikstof) had been run since the Council of State ruling on the PAS, who was party to them, what they cost, whether the government commonly takes external legal advice, and why government often fails to respond to enforcement requests. The minister answered that such figures are not registered centrally, gave a partial overview of cases per competent authority, said costs are unknown, and argued that enforcement is an obligation in principle but may be set aside in exceptional cases, with reasons to be given.
No, this is not possible because this information is not registered.
Nee, dit is niet mogelijk omdat deze informatie niet wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over de bijdrage van de sector aan verduurzaming van de landbouw

MPs Thijssen and Bromet ask the Minister of Agriculture whether the government will make banks, suppliers, processors and retailers contribute to the agricultural sustainability transition, and whether the polluter-pays principle applies. The Minister answers that binding but non-voluntary contributions from supply-chain parties will be agreed in the Landbouwakkoord, and that the government is studying policy options such as this, without committing to a specific measure yet.
The coalition agreement announced that the government will make binding agreements with supply-chain parties to strengthen the position of the farmer in the chain.
In het coalitieakkoord is aangekondigd dat de overheid bindende afspraken met ketenpartijen maakt om de positie van de boer in de keten te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het position paper Omgevingswet-DSO van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about the Council of State's position paper warning that the Omgevingswet digital system (DSO) may not yet let citizens and courts trace environmental plans and amendments reliably. The Minister answered that the viewers and time-travel functions are adequate, that a dedicated mechanism for processing court rulings will follow after entry into force, and that testing with courts and users continues.
Following the Division's letter, I have invited them to keep testing the system this year and to keep practising with it.
Naar aanleiding van de brief van de Afdeling heb ik hen uitgenodigd om dit jaar het stelsel te blijven beproeven en hiermee te blijven oefenen.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Westerveld over het bericht ‘Slechtzienden blijven thuis door ov-staking: zorgen over actie op verkiezingsdag’

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers how far blind and partially sighted voters must travel to vote, how many polling stations are accessible to them, how many voters would be affected by a public transport strike on election day, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that accessibility varies by municipality, that the government urged unions not to strike on election day and asked VNG municipalities to arrange alternative transport, while stating the Kieswet offers no basis for home voting or early voting.
I have urged the VNG municipalities to try to offer alternative transport to voters who need it because of a possible strike.
Ik heb met de VNG gemeenten opgeroepen om te proberen alternatief vervoer aan te bieden voor de kiezers die dat vanwege een mogelijke staking nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het bericht 'Schiphol gaf al ruim 16 miljoen euro uit in jacht op stikstofrechten'

GroenLinks MPs asked whether Schiphol's purchases of farms for nitrogen rights (over EUR 16 million) were known to ministries, whether more purchases are planned, and how this relates to parliamentary motions and state-aid rules. The minister confirms awareness, says ministries were not involved, says Schiphol's external netting is allowed under current rules, and promises new policy to gain more regie over nitrogen space.
Private transactions have been concluded. I cannot comment on those.
Er zijn private transacties gesloten. Ik kan daar niet in treden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over stalbezettingen

Bromet (GroenLinks) asked how many stable occupations by animal activists took place in 2021 and 2022. The minister answered that none are known to have occurred in those years, noting police cannot retrieve such figures because a stable occupation is not a separate offence, though one occupation of a calf farm in Apeldoorn in September 2021 led to 84 arrests.
A stable occupation is not a separate criminal offence and is therefore not registered in a uniform way.
Een stalbezetting is geen apart strafbaar feit en wordt dus niet op een eenduidige wijze geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het artikel ‘Provincies bleven op grote schaal vergunningen verlenen voor controversiële ‘stikstofarme’ stallen'

An MP from GroenLinks asks whether provinces should suspend permits for low-emission barn systems whose emission reduction courts and researchers have questioned, and what follows for subsidies, permits and the nitrogen policy. The minister answers that provinces are the competent authority, that a further letter on permit-granting will follow in November, that subsidy recovery is not warranted merely because innovative systems underperform, and that the Council of State's rulings do not change total emission figures.
Provinces are the competent authority under the Nature Conservation Act to assess whether permits can be granted in that context and to decide whether permit-granting is suspended.
Provincies zijn op grond van de Wnb het bevoegde gezag om te beoordelen of er in dat kader vergunningen verleend kunnen worden en te bepalen of de vergunningverlening wordt opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over een lijst van 500–600 piekbelasters

An MP asked how the claimed list of 500–600 peak nitrogen polluters arose, what earlier studies say about targeting such emitters, and how the government will handle buyouts, PAS-notifier priority and zoning. The minister replied that the analysis was based on anonymised data rather than a list of companies, that a gradual approach with provinces is being developed, and that no zone classification or list of PAS-notifiers in zones exists yet.
At this moment there is no list of peak polluters, compiled for the approach to apply to.
Op dit moment is er geen lijst met piekbelasters waar de aanpak op zal zien, samengesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Werkvloer wil nieuw uitstel Omgevingswet’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister about a survey showing many local authority staff want to postpone the Environment and Planning Act, including concerns about testing, support and the 1 January 2023 date. The minister acknowledges the signals, points to the implementation progress letter and existing support programmes, and argues the Act is already law and a clear start date is needed.
I take all signals about the entry into force of the Environment and Planning Act seriously.
Ik neem alle signalen over de inwerkingtreding van de Omgevingswet serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Ellemeet over het PFAS-schandaal

MPs Bouchallikh, Bromet and Ellemeet asked the government about the PFAS contamination scandal, including breast milk levels near Dordrecht, the export of PFAS waste to Antwerp, Rijkswaterstaat permits for PFOA and GenX discharges, and the EU-wide PFAS ban. The state secretary answered all twelve questions in substance, defending existing health norms, the permitting framework and the planned EU restriction, while promising further study of exposure routes.
For a number of pending export permit applications, the ILT has requested additional information from the notifiers and the Flemish authorities.
Voor een aantal lopende aanvragen voor exportvergunningen heeft de ILT aanvullende informatie opgevraagd bij de kennisgevers en de Vlaamse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het bericht 'lucratieve bijverdiensten voor fulltime topbestuurders'

MPs Westerveld and Bromet asked whether top executives in the (semi-)public sector who earn above the WNT pay cap through side functions as supervisors should be restricted, and about their workload and transparency. The minister answered that the anti-cumulation rule was deliberately limited to executive posts, that no data on cumulative earnings exist, that a public side-function register would add administrative burden, and that the government will examine tightening the rule within a planned WNT amendment.
As part of the planned WNT amendment that the cabinet recently announced, I am willing to examine the pros and cons of further tightening the anti-cumulation provision.

In het kader van de wetswijziging Wnt die ik namens het kabinet onlangs heb aangekondigd, ben ik wel bereid om nader uit te laten zoeken wat de voor- en tegens zijn van het verder aanscherpen van de anticumulatiebepaling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Bromet en Van der Lee over door de Nederlandse regering erkende MTCS-certificaten voor Maleisisch hout

Greens MPs asked the state secretary about a lawsuit by timber firm Samling against the NGO SAVE Rivers over MTCS-certified timber, whether MTCS should be suspended, and related Tropical Timber Organisation funding. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the lawsuit and said TPAC would be asked to discuss the complaints with PEFC International, while stating TPAC has no independent power to act beyond the minister's request.
I will ask TPAC to discuss with PEFC International, following the signals I have received about MTCS, the signals and how they were handled.
Ik zal TPAC verzoeken om, naar aanleiding van de door mij ontvangen signalen over MTCS, in gesprek te gaan met PEFC International 3 over de signalen en de wijze waarop deze zijn opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en De Hoop over het bericht Acht boerderijen (deels) dicht voor extra stikstof door verbreding A27 en A12 bij Utrecht

MPs Thijssen, De Hoop, Bromet and Kröger asked why nitrogen capacity is being allocated to widening the A27 and A12 near Utrecht while an alternative is being developed, which other projects could use that capacity, and whether road widening really reduces congestion. Minister Harbers answered that the Raad van State appeal cannot be paused, that other projects such as the A28/A1 junction may need the capacity, that a 2020 traffic study shows congestion more than halved, and that the government is committed to sustainable mobility alongside road investment.
When the region has an alternative ready, I will enter into discussion with them.
Als de regio een alternatief gereed heeft, ga ik met hen in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over de schuldbekentenis van de Rabobank

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the ministers about the Rabobank's opposition to the nitrogen policy and whether banks and other supply-chain parties should contribute financially to the agricultural transition. The minister answered that all chain parties, including banks, have a shared responsibility, that a non-voluntary contribution is expected, that existing funds of 24 billion euro suffice, and that questions were answered separately but not before the debate.
The cabinet expects a non-voluntary contribution from supply-chain parties (banks, suppliers, processing industry and retail), as included in the coalition agreement.
Het kabinet verwacht een niet-vrijblijvende bijdrage van ketenpartijen (banken, toeleveranciers, de verwerkende industrie en de retail), zoals is opgenomen in het coalitiekakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het informeren van de Kamer

MPs Westerveld and Bromet asked the Prime Minister why earlier written answers on informing parliament were summary, and whether the government takes parliament's concerns about timely information seriously. The Prime Minister answered that the cabinet stresses timely information, reminded ministries of the rule that documents reach the Tweede Kamer at least a quarter hour before media release, and said each minister must weigh circumstances case by case.

Since 2013 the working agreement for sending documents to the House of Representatives has been that documents must be delivered to the clerks at least a quarter hour before news is released to the media.

Sinds 2013 geldt hiervoor als werkafspraak voor verzending van stukken aan de Tweede Kamer dat stukken minimaal een kwartier voordat door media nieuws naar buiten wordt gebracht dienen te worden aangeleverd bij de griffies
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Bromet over de analyse van het ministerie over de aanpak van de stikstofcrisis

MPs Maatoug and Bromet (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Finance about the ministry's analysis of the nitrogen crisis approach, including its methodology compared with Erisman and Strootman, the 39 kton ammonia reduction target, budgetary costs, farmers' debts and financial-sector risks. The government answered at length, stating the analysis is a tentative, non-binding working result shared with the RIVM, that an integral approach is preferred over nitrogen-only optimisation, and that forced write-offs of farmers' loans are legally and prudentially unacceptable.
The Cabinet will inform the House about the follow-up with the RIVM.
Over het vervolg met het RIVM zal het Kabinet uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over een reis per vliegtuig m.b.t. het staatsbezoek van de Koning en Koningin aan Oostenrijk

GroenLinks MPs asked why the royal state visit to Austria used a plane rather than a train, whether the royal carriage could be used for international rail travel, and how this fits sustainable transport policy. The minister replied that a train took over 12 hours versus about 1.5 hours by plane, that trains are considered but not always suitable, and that the royal carriage is already internationally approved and was last used abroad years ago.
For the route from the Netherlands to Austria, the train unfortunately was not (yet) a full alternative.
Voor het traject van Nederland naar Oostenrijk bleek de trein helaas (nog) geen volwaardig alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over de Afrikaanse varkenspest naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Zorgen over uitbraak varkenspest pal over de grens in Duitsland'

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the minister about African swine fever near the German border, including risk assessment, transport restrictions, prevention measures, preventive culling, a breeding ban, a 1 km farm distance rule and NVWA capacity. The minister said the risk is real, that the expert group reassessed the risk, that transport risk is small but measures are in place, and that a breeding ban is disproportionate for now, while answering most questions substantively and committing to updates.
I expect to provide an update in the short term on the results of the actions carried out over the past two years within this framework, and I will inform the House of Representatives about this.
Ik verwacht op korte termijn een update te geven van de resultaten van de acties die de afgelopen twee jaar in het kader hiervan zijn uitgevoerd en ik zal de Tweede Kamer hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Kröger over het bericht dat Nederland geen gezonde leefomgeving biedt aan kinderen

MPs Bouchallikh, Bromet and Kröger asked the government about a UNICEF report finding that the Netherlands does not offer children a healthy living environment, covering air pollution, energy poverty, breakfast, noise, lead, pesticides and damp/mould. The government replied that the situation is not 'very worrying' but that there are attention points, pointed to the forthcoming National Environmental Programme, the Clean Air Agreement, energy allowances, lead-pipe measures and a broad mould-prevention approach, and promised to answer each question individually.
For that reason I would not call the situation in the Netherlands very worrying, although there are certainly points of attention that the Netherlands wants to address.
Om die reden zou ik de situatie in Nederland niet zeer zorgelijk willen noemen, al zijn er zeker aandachtspunten waar Nederland een been bij wil trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en van der Staaij over het bericht 'Te weinig rechters in Gelderland, 1500 rechtszaken geschrapt'

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Public Prosecution Service dropping about 1,500 cases in Gelderland due to a shortage of judges, and its effects on victims, trust in justice, other districts and the appeal route. The minister regrets the situation, explains the capacity shortage and recruitment measures, and says victims can object to a dismissal only via article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure while cases are being reviewed.
Where victims relied on a judge making an independent ruling on the case they were involved in, this is now not happening.
Daar waar slachtoffers erop vertrouwden dat een rechter een onafhankelijk oordeel zou vellen over de zaak waar ze bij betrokken waren, gebeurt dit nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over fijnstof en stankoverlast

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked about odour and particulate nuisance from livestock farms, including enforcement gaps, combi-scrubber performance, permit practice and recovery of subsidies. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the problem and pointed to area-based approaches, WUR research on chemical odour measurement and an e-learning module, but largely deferred permit and enforcement questions to municipalities and provinces and declined to give farm-level data citing GDPR.
Due to the General Data Protection Regulation, the data on agricultural businesses from the top 100 ammonia sources were supplied anonymised by the RIVM.
In verband met de Algemene verordening persoonsgegevens zijn de gegevens van de agrarische bedrijven uit de top100 ammoniakbronnen geanonimiseerd aangeleverd door het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over de beloning van topinkomens

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about top-income rules under the WNT: how many executives and supervisors fall under it, whether they exceed the cap, how enforcement works, and whether accountants' fees and supervisory pay are adequately controlled. The government answered that the WNT is broadly effective, that some overruns persist and are enforced through reclaim and penalties, and that a limited amendment to simplify the act is being prepared.
Following the evaluation, a limited amendment of the WNT is being prepared, and the House of Representatives will receive a letter on it shortly.
Naar aanleiding van de evaluatie wordt een beperkte wetswijziging van de WNT voorbereid, op korte termijn ontvangt de Tweede Kamer daarover een brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bromet over het bericht 'Is de vezelhennepteelt ten dode opgeschreven?'

MPs Boswijk and Bromet asked whether the greening subsidy of 150 euro per hectare would end in 2023, what this means for farmers, and what the new nitrate rules mean for hemp and sustainable crops. The minister answers that the greening payment lapses at EU level and is replaced by the eco-scheme, with hemp cultivation counting as one of 21 eco-activities, and that the ecoregeling and the autumn cover-crop rules are still being developed.
The greening premium will lapse at European level in the new CAP period from January 2023.
De vergroeningspremie komt op Europees niveau te vervallen in de nieuwe GLB-periode vanaf januari 2023
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het informeren van de Kamer

Westerveld and Bromet (GroenLinks) asked the Prime Minister whether the cabinet still holds that Parliament must be informed before the media when cabinet plans are released, and how often ministers were reminded of this. Rutte answered only by reaffirming the principle of timely information to both Houses under article 68 of the Constitution, saying it still guides cabinet members, without giving any concrete figures or new commitment.
This includes that the government informs both Houses as quickly as reasonably possible about relevant matters.
Daarbij hoort dat de regering de Kamers zo snel als redelijkerwijs mogelijk informeert over relevante zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over besmettelijke dierziekten naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Varkens in Nood slaat alarm: Nederland niet klaar voor Afrikaanse varkenspest’

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the Minister of Agriculture about Dutch preparedness for African swine fever, including animal transports, the contingency plan dating from 2013, the NVWA's capacity, minimum distances and areas between pig farms, and vaccine funding. The minister acknowledged the risk, pointed to existing preventive measures, the roadmap and EU rules, and rejected a breeding ban and a 1 km minimum distance as disproportionate for now, promising further action within the area-based approach.
I share the author's concern that an outbreak of African swine fever (ASF) could occur in the Netherlands.
Ik deel de zorgen van de auteur dat zich een uitbraak van Afrikaanse varkenspest (AVP) kan voordoen in Nederland.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het onafhankelijk worden van Russisch gas

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Housing about the EU's independence from Russian gas, including energy-saving scenarios, the Nationaal Isolatieprogramma, enforcement of existing energy-saving duties, SDE++ subsidies, and Gazprom's activities and contracts in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports ambitious EU energy-saving targets, announced a campagne and insulation programme, gave limited commitments on new duties while rejecting some proposals, and explained the sanctions framework that limits action against Gazprom entities.
It is undesirable that we as European countries contribute in this way to the Russian state coffers.
Het is onwenselijk dat we als Europese landen op deze manier bijdragen aan de Russische staatskas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de top 100 stikstof bronnen

An MP asked the minister for a list of the top 100 nitrogen sources (companies/permits) sorted by sector and region, plus permitted versus actual emissions, affected Natura 2000 areas, BAT review dates and employment. The minister provided top-100 lists for NOx and ammonia from the 2019 emissions register without farm names, but said permitted headroom is not tracked centrally, deposition-by-area analysis is still in progress with area plans due in 2023, and BAT updates are carried out by competent authorities without figures on emission reductions or jobs.
The Emissions Register does not include names of agricultural businesses due to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
In de Emissieregistratie zijn – in verband met de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) – geen namen opgenomen van agrarische bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Bouchallikh over PFAS in de Westerschelde

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about PFAS contamination of fish and shellfish in the Westerschelde, public warnings, the Hedwigepolder managed-realignment project, and coordination with Flanders. The ministers answered that GGD Zeeland issued consumption advice, that EU restriction and Flemish emission measures are underway, that the Hedwigepolder project may proceed because PFAS levels are within legal limits, and that a senior-official coordinator will be appointed.

In response to the letter from the Zeeland provincial executive, the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management has indicated that he wants to appoint a coordinator at senior official level in both central government and the province of Zeeland.

In reactie op de brief van gedeputeerde staten van Zeeland heeft de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat aangegeven bij zowel de rijksoverheid als de provincie Zeeland op hoogambtelijk niveau een coördinator te willen aanwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de voorgenomen kap van/in het Sterrebos in Born ten behoeve van de geplande uitbreiding van een autofabriek

An MP asked about the planned felling of the centuries-old Sterrebos in Born for a car factory expansion, its protected species, permits, and fit with the national forest strategy. The minister replied that the province is the competent authority and holds all permits, that about 55 large trees will be relocated and 30 hectares of new forest created, and that the forest strategy allows compensated conversion.
As far as I can tell, the province of Limburg, as competent authority, has granted all the required permits and exemptions.
Voor zover ik dat kan overzien, heeft de provincie Limburg als bevoegd gezag alle benodigde vergunningen en ontheffingen verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Teunissen, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Simons en Dassen over het lot van de Afghaanse ambassadebewakers

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Afghan guards employed by an external contractor at the Dutch embassy in Kabul were not evacuated, when the Belhaj motion called for evacuating those who assisted the Dutch government, and whether the contractor was informed of the decision. The minister answered that the guards were not embassy employees and guarded other states' diplomatic missions, so they fell outside the evacuation criteria; he acknowledged the contractor received no timely written reply and that the lists and correspondence are shared only confidentially.
The request of 15 August and both reminders are shared with you on a confidential basis.
Het verzoek van 15 augustus en beide rappels worden op vertrouwelijke basis met u gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het Predicaat Koninklijk

MP Bromet asked the Prime Minister about the criteria for the Royal Predicate, whether Shell loses it by moving its head office abroad, and when it can be withdrawn after an unblemished-conduct breach such as a criminal conviction. The minister answered that the predicate is an honorary tradition governed by royal decrees, that a headquarters move risks loss of Dutch identity, and that withdrawal is a proportionate, case-by-case decision after a company is asked to explain itself.
The Royal Predicate is a long-standing tradition.
Het predicaat Koninklijk is een reeds lang bestaande traditie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over de uitzending van de Keuringsdienst van Waarde over 'Bij-vriendelijke planten'

MPs Bromet and Kröger asked whether the Keuringsdienst van Waarde broadcast showing pesticide residues on plants sold as bee-friendly was true, whether this misleads consumers and harms insects, and whether labelling warnings should be required. The minister answered that pesticides are approved only after risk assessment including insects, that misleading claims are for the ACM and Reclame Code Commissie to judge, and that warning labels are not needed.

Pesticides are only authorised in the Netherlands if a scientific risk assessment by the College for the Authorisation of Plant Protection Products and Biocides shows that they are safe for humans, animals and the environment when used according to the rules.

Gewasbeschermingsmiddelen worden in Nederland alleen toegelaten als uit een wetenschappelijke risicobeoordeling van het College voor de Toelating van Gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en Biociden blijkt dat ze volgens de voorschriften veilig zijn voor mens, dier en milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Bromet over het bericht 'Treinverkeer in Nederland heeft last van slappe bodem'

MPs Bouchallikh and Bromet asked the government about rail track stability on soft peat soils and whether it can keep up with frequency and climate ambitions. The state secretary replied that ProRail is studying baanstabiliteit and climate adaptation, with results expected in 2022, but gave no commitment to new funding.
Maintenance of the railway is of great importance.
Het onderhoud van het spoor is van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Oost-Brabant m.b.t. de kolencentrale Geertruidenberg en MOB

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about a district court ruling on the Geertruidenberg coal plant and MOB, questioning whether nitrogen rights and offsetting are still valid and what the ruling means for other projects and for Schiphol. The Minister declined to comment on the specific ruling under appeal, said the provinces and government are examining the consequences of latent permit space, and promised to share that exploration after the summer.
I do not consider it opportune to comment on the ruling in this specific case, against which the province of Noord-Brabant has lodged an appeal.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om commentaar te leveren op de uitspraak in deze specifieke zaak, waartegen de provincie Noord-Brabant hoger beroep heeft ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over het bericht 'Stop op boorvergunningen moet einde tijdperk olie en gas inluiden'

MPs Bromet and Kröger asked whether the government will coordinate with Germany and Denmark on Wadden Sea World Heritage management, the UNESCO letter, and a joint halt to fossil extraction there. The minister said the trilateral conference is planned for late 2022, the UNESCO reply was coordinated with partners, and she is willing to explore extending the coalition's no-new-licences ambition to the trilateral Wadden Sea.

I am willing to explore together with Germany and Denmark whether the coalition agreement's ambition to issue no new gas extraction licences under the Wadden Sea after the Ternaard procedure is completed can also apply to the trilateral Wadden Sea.

Ik ben bereid om samen met Duitsland en Denemarken te verkennen of de ambitie uit het coalitieakkoord 2 om na afronding van de procedure voor Ternaard geen nieuwe vergunningen voor gaswinning onder de Waddenzee af te geven ook kan gelden voor de trilaterale Waddenzee.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu, Teunissen, Simons, Van der Plas en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken weigert Afghaanse bewakers ambassade Kabul te evacueren’

MPs asked why Dutch embassy security guards employed via a subcontractor in Kabul were not evacuated while Hungarian guards were, and whether a new direct-employment criterion was introduced without informing parliament. The government answered that the criteria for evacuation (Belhaj motion) were unchanged, that embassy guards fall under host-state responsibility and their employer is responsible, and gave figures on remaining interpreters and Afghans awaiting transfer.
There is no question of a new criterion.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuw criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over de brief van UNESCO inzake de voorgenomen gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

Three MPs asked whether UNESCO had sent a letter on protecting the Wadden Sea and possible gas extraction beneath it, and whether it could be shared with a cabinet appraisal. The State Secretary confirmed UNESCO letters of 7 May and 30 November 2021, said the Ternaard gas production is assessed under UNESCO principles with a decision expected in March 2022, and that the cabinet plans to reply to UNESCO in January 2022.
The cabinet intends to send a letter to UNESCO with a response in January 2022.
Het kabinet is voornemens om in januari 2022 een brief te sturen aan UNESCO met een reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de bevindingen van Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) over zoutcavernes

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about SodM's findings on salt caverns operated by Nobian Salt in Twente, including unreported deviations from mining plans, merged caverns, and liability after ownership changes. The Minister answered that no general reporting duty applied, that SodM already supervises the stability risks and has agreed to stabilise risky caverns and check others, and that the current operator is liable.
There is no general reporting obligation for companies when they deviate from a mining plan.
Er bestaat geen algemene meldingsplicht voor bedrijven bij afwijking van een winningsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘NAM wil alle olie- en gasproductie in Nederland verkopen’

MP Bromet asks how much influence the government has over the sale of NAM's oil and gas fields, whether buyers with poor reputations could be blocked, the consequences for Groningen compensation and remediation, and whether the state could be left with unpaid decommissioning costs. The minister answers that ministerial consent is required for licence transfers, that buyers are vetted on technical and financial capacity, that the Groningen field stays with NAM, and that financial security under the Decommissioning Security Agreement covers the state's risk, while avoiding a firm commitment on some points.
Under the Mining Act, my consent is required for this transfer.
Op grond van de Mijnbouwwet is mijn toestemming vereist voor deze overdracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Nederlandse overheid moet doen wat ze belooft’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the Netherlands did not vote for an IUCN motion on Amazon deforestation and whether it supports 80% Amazon protection by 2025. The minister says the motion was not known in advance, that the Netherlands would have supported it had it been, and that it supports Indigenous peoples and the 2030 zero-deforestation goal.
This partly led to the Dutch delegation not voting for this motion.
Dit heeft er mede toe geleid dat de Nederlandse delegatie niet heeft gestemd voor deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over 'de uitspraak van de rechtbank Midden-Nederland d.d. 22 september 2021 met betrekking tot 17 agrarische bedrijven en één slachterij’

MP Bromet asks the Minister of Agriculture about a court ruling that annulled nitrogen-related decisions on 17 farms and a slaughterhouse, including criticism of technical stable measures and of the lack of a structural solution. The Minister acknowledges the ruling, says a legalisation programme is being prepared and that appeal is pending, defends the Rav emission factors as the best available science with a study due in 2022, and points to the Wsn as the structural approach.
I can at least guarantee that work continues unabated on legalising the reporting farms
Ik kan in ieder geval garanderen dat onverminderd hard wordt gewerkt aan het legaliseren van de melders
Antwoord vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het bericht ‘Hoe gelijk zijn man en vrouw voor gemeenten?’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why women often lack digital access to tax records for property they co-own with men, since municipalities and water boards usually issue tax assessments in one person's name. The minister explained the legal basis and municipal discretion, said there is no legal barrier to addressing all co-owners, and committed to discussing alternatives with municipalities and water boards.
I am willing to discuss with the other tiers of government what the options are for giving all owners of a property insight into the tax records.
Ik ben bereid om met de medeoverheden te bespreken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om alle eigenaren van een eigendom inzicht te geven in de belastinggegevens.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Bromet over de gecombineerde 22ste/23ste/24ste periodieke rapport van het Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination over het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden

MPs Wuite and Bromet asked the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations about the UN CERD committee's criticism of conditions on COVID-19 liquidity aid to Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, discrimination against Caribbean Dutch, Kingdom-wide climate funding, Statute reform and decolonisation. The State Secretary defended the conditions as customary, rejected a Kingdom climate fund citing the autonomy of the countries, said no immediate Statute reform is needed, and disagreed that decolonisation is incomplete.
When allocating subsequent tranches, that will always be the starting point.
Bij het toekennen van volgende tranches zal dat steeds het uitgangspunt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Van der Lee en Ellemeet over de voortgang van evacuaties uit Afghanistan

MPs Bromet, Van der Lee and Ellemeet asked the government how people covered by the Belhaj motion can still contact the Dutch state after the evacuation mailbox closed, what further evacuation efforts are planned, and how the Taliban treat those groups. The government answered that it continues limited evacuations, a special scheme for two groups is planned, about 20,000 unique emails were received, and it cannot yet confirm the Taliban's conduct clearly.
It is difficult to obtain a clear picture of the situation in Afghanistan and the conduct of the Taliban.
Het is moeilijk een eenduidig beeld te krijgen van de situatie in Afghanistan en het handelen van de Taliban.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Bromet over de verlenging van het Europees Diploma voor de Oostvaardersplassen en Nationaal Park Weerribben-Wieden

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government welcomes the renewed Council of Europe Diploma for the Oostvaardersplassen and Weerribben-Wieden, and whether Lelystad Airport's development endangers these Natura 2000 areas. The minister answered that the diploma is welcome, that the airport's routes avoid the areas (with minimum flight heights of 3,000 and 6,000 feet), and that the government will not commit to further action beyond the existing legal duty to protect Natura 2000 areas.

It concludes that the temporary connecting routes take place at a height of 6,000 feet and above, and that the earlier 2014 MER conclusion that there will be no damage to the natural characteristics of the Natura 2000 areas therefore does not change.

Hierin wordt geconcludeerd dat de tijdelijke aansluitroutes plaatsvinden op een hoogte van 6.000 voet en hoger, en dat de conclusie (uit het eerdere MER 2014) dat er geen sprake zal zijn van de aantasting van de natuurlijke kenmerken van de Natura 2000-gebieden daarom niet verandert.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Nijboer en Bromet over het oplopende tekort aan studentenwoningen

MPs Nijboer and Bromet asked the Minister why the student housing shortage of about 22,000 units is growing, whether the 50 million euro allocation is enough, and why a solution is only in sight by 2028.
