The minister acknowledges more is needed, promises to update the national action plan with stakeholders, but says structural solutions and any separate funding scheme for student housing must await a new cabinet.
As I indicated in the committee debate of 16 September, I am going to talk with the parties to update the National Student Housing Action Plan and increase the ambition.
Zoals ik in het Commissiedebat van 16 september jl. heb aangegeven ga ik met de partijen in gesprek om het Landelijk Actieplan Studentenhuisvesting te actualiseren en de ambitie te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over studentenhuisvesting

GroenLinks MPs asked about unhoused international students sleeping in bus shelters, emergency housing, cost of emergency shelter in Groningen, the housing-benefit and cost-sharing rules for hosts, and information given to international students. The minister answers that housing is primarily a local responsibility, lists local emergency measures, explains the rules for taking in students, says the national action plan will be updated with stakeholders while structural solutions await a new cabinet, and admits the answers were not delivered within the requested five days.
It is a local responsibility to ensure there is sufficient housing.
Het is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid om te zorgen voor voldoende huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over het bericht 'De bedreiging van de natuur door stikstofhandel’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that industry and farms hold unused nitrogen emission room that could be traded or used, potentially harming nature, and about the adequacy of the 30% deduction rate and the legal basis of the nitrogen policy. The minister answered that permitted emissions exceed actual emissions, that external netting only uses realised capacity with a 30% deduction, that the government is consulting provinces on preventing emission increases, and that the legal framework remains defensible.
I have no insight into the size of the latent space in the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de omvang van de latente ruimte in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Onmacht Almere met paspoorten wekt irritatie bij Marechaussee’

An MP asked the State Secretary about Almere's inability to issue passports and BRP extracts during summer peak demand, and the Marechaussee being overloaded with emergency document requests. The State Secretary answered all 14 questions in substance, attributing the backlog to capacity and COVID-related factors, noting BZK and the KMar can only help to a limited extent, and committing to clarify communication and guidance on emergency documents.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for their service provision.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun dienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht 'Weggemaaide zeldzame orchidee laat waterschap koud'

An MP asks the ministers how a water board could mow a protected orchid, whether enforcement of the Nature Protection Act in public space is adequate, and how ecological verge management can be encouraged and staff trained. The minister says the matter falls to the province of Zeeland as competent authority, sees no structural enforcement problem, declines to mandate Kleurkeur or the national flora database, and promises to discuss training and report yearly on verge management.
It is up to the province of Zeeland to hold the water board to account on this and enforce if necessary.
Het is aan de provincie Zeeland om het Waterschap hierop aan te spreken en te handhaven indien dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about gas extraction under the Wadden Sea, including subsidence, the role of regional authorities, climate consistency with the Paris Agreement, and financial benefits. The Minister answered that subsidence is managed under a 'hand on the tap' principle with monitoring and independent audit, that regional advice is weighed within legal limits, that extraction is climate-neutral compared to imports, and that no additional study is needed.
On the basis of an integral weighing of the advice and the studies carried out, I conclude that there are no grounds to refuse (partially) the approval of the extraction plan.

Op basis van een integrale afweging van de adviezen en de onderzoeken die zijn gedaan, kom ik tot de conclusie dat er geen gronden zijn om de instemming met het winningsplan (gedeeltelijk) te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Thijssen over het webartikel 'Grenswaarden stikstof ter discussie'

MPs Bromet and Thijssen asked the minister about a web article claiming nitrogen critical-load ranges are unreliable and that habitat quality declines below the threshold, and why the official report reads differently. The minister answers that the article's conclusions are not in the report, that only the empirical part is reliable while the statistical part is only plausible, and that no policy change is needed now, while the results are being fed into a European review of critical loads.
The conclusions from the report do not for now give reason to tighten the emission reduction targets.
De conclusies uit het rapport geven vooralsnog geen aanleiding om de emissiereductiedoelstellingen aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het rapport 'Bescherming drinkwater bij het boren naar aardwarmte; Stille wateren in diepe gronden'

Two Green Left MPs asked the ministers about an Algemene Rekenkamer report finding drinking water sources inadequately protected against geothermal drilling, and whether rules, regional consultation, monitoring and subsidies should be strengthened. The state secretary answered that the Tijdelijk Beleidskader and the forthcoming Mijnbouwwet amendment already strengthen oversight, consultation of provinces and water boards is adequate, extra monitoring will be explored with SodM, and subsidy adjustments are being studied.
The advisory right of the decentralised governments is laid down in the Mining Act.
Het adviesrecht van de decentrale overheden is vastgelegd in de Mijnbouwwet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) en de afvalwaterinjecties

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about NAM's wastewater injection in Twente, including RTV-Oost reports that NAM helps draft ministerial answers, the integrity of wells ROW-2, ROW-5, ROW-7 and SCH-447, and protection of the Natura 2000 area Voltherbroek. The minister rejected the call for more own information gathering, stated that SodM already imposed enhanced supervision and ordered injection in ROW-7 stopped pending investigation, and committed to further monitoring and an assessment of NAM's SCH-447 investigation.
That is why my answers to parliamentary questions about specific situations are regularly submitted to the parties the questions concern.
Daarom worden mijn antwoorden op Kamervragen over specifieke situaties regelmatig voorgelegd aan de partijen waarover de Kamervragen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Bromet, Ceder, Kuzu en Dassen over Afghaanse tolken

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how the government would support Afghan interpreters and their families to evacuate as security collapsed, including whether passport requirements would be waived and a charter flight arranged. The government said it is doing everything possible to bring the group to safety, explained that Afghan authorities and airlines required passports and that airport access depends on verifiable identity, and promised a further letter on the consequences of recent developments.
The cabinet will shortly send a further letter to address the consequences of the recent developments.
Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een nadere brief sturen om in te gaan op de consequenties van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Bromet, Ceder en Kuzu over het beschermen van Afghanen die werkzaam waren voor Nederland tijdens de Afghanistanmissies

MPs from six parties asked the cabinet why it is not doing more to quickly bring Afghan interpreters and other former local staff who worked for Dutch missions to safety, including questions on the asylum process, document problems, non-interpreter staff, and a deportation moratorium. The ministers answered that additional staff were deployed, interpreters' remaining requirements were dropped, about 43 interpreters had arrived since June, non-interpreters are assessed individually and generously, and the moratorium's extension will be decided later.
The cabinet is taking all steps within its own power to bring the interpreters and their families to the Netherlands as quickly as possible.
Het kabinet onderneemt alle stappen die binnen het eigen vermogen liggen om de tolken en hun gezinnen op een zo kort mogelijke termijn naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het bericht 'Nog slag te slaan: helft Nederlandse kantoren voldoet niet aan juiste energielabel'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about a report finding half of Dutch offices fail the required energy label and about enforcement of the label C obligation for offices by 2023. The minister replied that RVO monitoring matches the Colliers figures, that owners were informed via letters and intermediaries, that government buildings are to be upgraded through portfolio routemaps, and that municipalities, as the competent authority, decide on sanctions.
The competent authority is the municipality. The municipality ultimately determines which sanction is appropriate.
Het bevoegd gezag is de gemeente. De gemeente bepaalt uiteindelijk welke sanctie passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch, Ellemeet en Bromet over de wateroverlast in Limburg

MPs asked the government about the flooding in Limburg: the adequacy of responders, damage estimates, applying the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen to victims, flood buffers and climate adaptation funding, and the long-term aid. The minister answered that the government will apply the compensation law, outlined eligible damage categories, said a damage quick scan is being prepared, and described responder support, climate-adaptation programmes and a planned evaluation table.
Given the nature and scale of the disaster, the cabinet has decided to apply the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts).
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, gelet op de aard en de omvang van de ramp, de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) toe te gaan passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de ophokplicht voor vrije-uitloopkippen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why a nationwide bird-flu housing order for free-range hens remained when neighbouring countries had lifted theirs, and posed questions on regional differentiation, compensation, vaccination and flock size. The minister explained that the order was lifted in regions and then nationwide on 6 July based on expert risk assessments, that compensation is not given for consequential damage, that vaccination is not yet opportune, and that the broader flock-reduction question is left to a new cabinet.
Based partly on the assessment of the expert group on animal diseases, I examined per region whether I could lift the housing order.
Ik heb, mede op basis van de beoordeling van de deskundigengroep dierziekten, per regio bekeken of ik de ophokplicht kon opheffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de aanpak van waterwaaier en ongelijkbladig vederkruid

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister how invasive waterweed and Cabomba are managed, their ecological and recreational effects, and whether national rules, funding and provincial scaling-up are needed. The minister answered substantively on effects and EU rules, said a strategic approach and evaluation are underway, and gave no cost estimate or commitment to new national rules.
Therefore LNV is working with the relevant sub-national governments and other parties on a strategic approach, in which choices are made and priorities set.
Daarom werkt LNV samen met betrokken medeoverheden en andere partijen aan een strategische aanpak, waarbij keuzes worden gemaakt en prioriteiten worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Kuzu en Ceder over de noodsituatie van de Afghaanse tolken

MPs from five parties asked the Defence Minister how many Afghan interpreters and their families had arrived in the Netherlands in June 2021, how many remain in Afghanistan, and what is being done to speed up their transfer and protect them. The government answered with case counts (90 families arrived since 2014, 84 active applications in Afghanistan, 113 rejected), listed measures to accelerate processing, and said the embassy in Kabul will remain open if security allows.
For security reasons I cannot go into these measures.
Omwille van veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik niet ingaan op deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Smeulders over de funderingsproblematiek in Friesland en over het artikel 'Provincie Fryslân gaat huiseigenaren betrekken bij oplossen funderingsschade'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about foundation damage in Friesland caused by lowered water tables in peat meadow areas, and about the responsibility, legal framework and lack of data on affected homes. The minister explained that water boards and municipalities bear care duties, that compensation depends on whether a water-level change is lawful and natural subsidence, that no research on the specific problem exists, and that the cabinet's response to the advisory report was sent to the House.
No research is currently being carried out to map this specific problem.
Er wordt op dit moment geen onderzoek uitgevoerd om deze specifieke problematiek in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Laan, Bromet en Kathmann over het bericht ‘raadsleden pleiten voor modernisering verlofregeling’

Four MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether leave arrangements for councillors should be modernised, following a letter from three municipal councils. The Minister said the current leave rules for elected representatives were a deliberate choice, that broader leave is not warranted, and that she will consult professional associations and administrative bodies on possible flexibilisation, leaving any legislative change to her successor.

I want to see whether the Dutch Association of Councillors, the Dutch Association of Provincial Members and the Association of Water Board Members support the call for a more flexible arrangement set out in the letter.

Ik wil bezien of de Nederlandse Vereniging van Raadsleden, de Nederlandse Vereniging van Statenleden en de Vereniging van algemeen bestuursleden van de Waterschappen het pleidooi voor een flexibeler regeling uit de brief ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite, Ceder, Bromet, Wassenberg en Simons over het bericht “heeft premier Jacobs een punt als zij zegt dat Nederland vals speelt”

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister about the Rijksministerraad decision of 23 April 2021 to release the fifth tranche of liquidity support to Sint Maarten and why the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations did not implement it. The Prime Minister answered that concerns about corporate governance at the airport led the State Secretary to resubmit the matter, which the council reversed on 28 May, and that no change to the council's rules of procedure is planned.
I see no reason to amend the rules of procedure of the council of ministers.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om het reglement van orde van de ministerraad te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht 'NAM pompt Vries-0 leeg voor afronding goedkeuringsprocedure'

MP Bromet asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether NAM extracted gas from the Vries-10 well before approval of its mining plan, whether SodM should have enforced, and whether NAM and the ministry were open with residents and municipalities. The minister denied that gas was extracted without approval, said extraction fell within the 2011 plan's remaining production capacity, that SodM rejected the enforcement request, and that residents and regional authorities were consulted and informed in the later procedure.
I have no indications that NAM or staff of my ministry were not open or honest in communications about the Vries-10 well.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat NAM of medewerkers van mijn ministerie niet open of eerlijk zouden zijn geweest in de communicatie rondom de put Vries-10.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Hoe stikstofhandel de BV Brabant opnieuw in gevaar brengt: ‘Er is iets gruwelijk mis’’

An MP asked the Minister whether the province of Noord-Brabant is using bought-out farms' nitrogen rights for purposes other than nature restoration, including sales by auction, and whether the province can oversee the trade. The Minister said the province sold nitrogen space in one case by public sale, that proceeds flow to the nature budget, that she disapproves of provinces trading nitrogen space themselves, and that she cannot verify fraud claims or comment on individual cases.
However, I do not think it is right for provinces themselves to act as traders on such a platform, offering and purchasing nitrogen space.
Ik vind het echter niet goed als provincies zelf als handelaren op zo’n platform stikstofruimte gaan aanbieden en inkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Grinwis over het bericht 'Actiegroep: ministerie zwichtte voor vrees claim gaswinner'

MPs Bromet and Grinwis asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the ministry extended Vermilion's expired gas exploration licence out of fear of damage claims, and why relevant documents were redacted under the Wob. The minister denied this, citing the Mijnbouwwet's grounds, said extension differs legally from a new licence, and that existing licences are extended while new oil and gas licences are not issued per the coalition agreement.
The Mijnbouwwet has specific grounds for assessing (an extension of) an exploration licence.
De Mijnbouwwet kent specifieke afwegingsgronden voor de beoordeling van (een verlenging van) een opsporingsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het NRC-bericht ‘Nieuwe bouwcrisis dreigt door ‘onwerkbare’ megawet’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of the Interior about press reports that the Digital Environment Act system (DSO) and the Omgevingswet risk not functioning in time for 1 January 2022, and about related municipal concerns and testing problems. The minister answered that testing found improvements needed but overall progress is positive, moved the entry-into-force date to 1 July 2022, and committed to further steps such as an Auditdienst Rijk review and a later letter, while withholding internal documents for the time being.
I will inform the House of an answer to this question as soon as possible.
Ik zal Uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk van een antwoord op deze vraag voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het afsluiten van gasboorputten op LUT-5 in Losser

An MP asked the minister about permanently sealing gas wells in Losser, whether cement plugs fit the well integrity system, the cracked ROW-2 injection well in Rossum, and whether independent reviews of other wells are needed. The minister said SodM supervises sealing and post-closure monitoring, the ROW-2 investigation is still ongoing with a result expected by end of June 2021, and no independent investigation of other wells is currently deemed necessary.
No, there are currently no indications that this is necessary.
Nee, er zijn op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Bromet over het bericht dat algoritmes van de gemeente Rotterdam kunnen leiden tot vooringenomen uitkomsten

MPs Bouchallikh and Bromet (GroenLinks) asked about reports that Rotterdam's algorithms may produce biased outcomes, including the Rekenkamer Rotterdam report, use of possibly discriminatory variables, transparency toward benefit recipients, the SyRI ruling, and the need for an algorithm register. State Secretary Knops answered that municipalities are responsible, that the government is developing guidance, an impact assessment and a national inventory of unlawful use of nationality/ethnicity in risk models, and that a register is being studied.
Ultimately, municipalities are themselves responsible for complying with the law.
Uiteindelijk zijn gemeenten zelf verantwoordelijk voor naleving van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Bromet, Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland een grote aanjager is van wereldwijde ontbossing

MPs asked the ministers whether the Netherlands is a major driver of global deforestation per a WNF report, and about its links to nitrogen, climate, EU trade deals (Mercosur) and import tariffs. The ministers largely contest the report's attribution to the Netherlands, cite certification schemes and EU-level measures, and promise continued EU engagement on deforestation-free supply chains.
The Netherlands faces a major task in reducing nitrogen deposition.
Nederland heeft een stevige opgave om de neerslag van stikstof terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het artikel 'Toezichthouder NVWA stond kwekers gebruik van een verboden middel toe'

MP Bromet asked the minister whether the NVWA had tolerated the illegal use of the agent V10 for about 14 years, why no investigation was launched, and how enforcement will be improved. The minister answered that the regulator's 2014 decision not to actively enforce the restricted use was a choice, that an external expert will examine the case as required by a motion, and that NVWA capacity constraints are being addressed.
I will ask an external expert to answer the questions of how this could have happened and what we can learn from it.
Ik zal een externe deskundige vragen antwoord te geven op de vragen hoe dit heeft kunnen gebeuren en wat we hiervan kunnen leren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Bromet over de schuldbekentenis van de Rabobank

GroenLinks MPs Snels and Bromet asked ministers how banks financing intensive agriculture share responsibility for unsustainable farming, for insufficient disclosure of transition risks, and for blocking farmers' green transition, following a Zembla broadcast. The ministers answered that all agricultural chain parties share responsibility, that banks must consider foreseeable risks, that they call on financiers to act, and that new public instruments such as an investment fund and working-capital scheme are being developed.
I call on Rabobank, and also on the other financial institutions active in the agri-sector, to explicitly take on their role in financing the transition to more sustainable agriculture.

Ik roep de Rabobank, en ook de andere financiële instellingen die actief zijn in de agrosector, op om hun rol in de financiering van de omschakeling naar een duurzamere landbouw nadrukkelijk op zich te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het bericht 'Bospaden worden verhard met plastic bouwafval'

Green Left MPs Kröger and Bromet asked about reports that Staatsbosbeheer surfaces forest paths with plastic-contaminated construction waste, and whether the 1% contamination limit is respected and what harms result. The State Secretary answered that certified suppliers are used, that the limit applies by weight and volume, that the impact on nature is not yet fully known (RIVM research expected early 2022), and that the government will study tighter regulation of recycled granulate and engage stakeholders.
However, I will investigate whether there are possibilities to better regulate the use of recycled granulate.
Ik ga echter onderzoeken of er mogelijkheden zijn om de toepassing van recyclinggranulaat beter te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Studenten in de stress door tijdelijk huurcontract’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Interior about temporary student rental contracts, the rarity of multi-year campus contracts, data on temporary rentals, student housing shortages and prices, and Huurcommissie backlogs. The minister answered that the Wet doorstroming huurmarkt 2015 is under evaluation, that data on student-specific temporary contracts is not separately collected, reported a shortage of 22,000 units per Kences, and promised the evaluation results by end of next month.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Bromet, Kröger en Buitenweg over misstanden in de transportsector

MPs asked whether TLN and PostNL tried to influence a study into criminal abuse and labour exploitation in the transport sector, and what the government will do with its findings. The minister answered that TLN commissioned the study, that the ministry only co-sat on the steering group and held a subsidy, that the methodology was judged sound, and that a cabinet response will follow in spring.
I will study the outcomes and discuss them with TLN and the Minister of SZW, among others.
Ik ga de uitkomsten bestuderen en onder meer met TLN en de Minister van SZW bespreken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over de artikelen ‘Nieuw onderzoek 'probleemkanaal' Almelo-De Haandrik:’Provincie was grip van begin af aan kwijt’ en ‘Provincie: rapport naar probleemkanaal Almelo-De Haa

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Deltares and Van Baars reports on damage to homes caused by deepening the Almelo-De Haandrik canal, about who is responsible for compensation and whether the Rijk has a role. The Minister answered that the canal is a provincial waterway, that the Rijk has no role in the project or its compensation, and that the province is responsible for the necessary steps.
The Almelo-De Haandrik canal is a provincial waterway for which the province carries out waterway management.
Het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik is een provinciale vaarweg waar de provincie het vaarwegbeheer uitvoert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het rapport ‘de onzichtbare vervuilers van de vlees- en zuivelindustrie’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Agriculture about a Milieudefensie report on the global greenhouse gas emissions of Vion, FrieslandCampina and VanDrie Group, and whether the Climate Agreement should cover supply-chain and foreign emissions. The minister disputed the report's figures and comparisons, said the Climate Agreement correctly targets national emissions, and declined to adopt new supply-chain rules or independent monitoring, while noting the sectors' responsibilities.
Monitoring of greenhouse gas emissions is already carried out by independent and expert bodies such as PBL, CBS and RIVM.
Monitoring van broeikasgasemissies wordt nu al uitgevoerd door onafhankelijke en deskundige instanties zoals PBL, CBS en het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht “Milieuramp in de Berkel: Friesland Campina vervuilde, het Waterschap betaalde”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister whether Waterschap Rijn en IJssel should have borne less of the costs of a pipeline breach polluting the Berkel, given that FrieslandCampina was the polluter, and questioned possible favouritism linked to agricultural seats on the water board. The minister answered that the water board, as owner of the pipeline, carries primary responsibility, that TNO found several causes all partly attributable to the parties so no single polluter can be named, and that no agricultural influence is evident.
The water board has the autonomous authority to weigh the cost allocation itself.
Het waterschap heeft de autonome bevoegdheid om zelf een afweging te maken over de kostenverdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over het stopzetten van huurtoeslag wegens geboorte kind

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked the ministers why a Belastingdienst benefit (huurtoeslag) was stopped because a newborn lacked legal residence status, and sought details on frequency, legal basis, and planned changes. The government answered that a birth alone is not grounds to stop the allowance, that stoppage occurs only after four months without a residence application, that the case was resolved, and that it is exploring rule changes such as raising the age threshold to 18.
I cannot go into the specific circumstances of an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het artikel 'Zonne-eilanden in IJsselmeer als mogelijke energiebron'

MPs Bromet and Van der Lee asked the ministers about a proposal for solar islands on the IJsselmeer, the route map for solar on water, the Agenda IJsselmeergebied 2050, and the Wieringerhoek MIRT project that excluded energy generation. The minister answered that a route map was sent to parliament, a pilot pre-study is ordered, the Wieringerhoek scope will be assessed at the planuitwerkingsfase, and more clarity is expected in 2021 and autumn 2021.
In addition, Rijkswaterstaat has been commissioned to carry out a pre-study for a pilot with floating solar panels on the IJsselmeer.
Daarnaast is opdracht gegeven aan Rijkswaterstaat tot een pre-verkenning voor een pilot met drijvende zonnepanelen op het IJsselmeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over transparantie en duidelijkheid bij nieuwe kleine gasvelden

An MP asked the minister about transparency and participation for five new small gas fields near the Drenthe, Friesland and Overijssel border, the cumulative subsidence effects, and binding energy-transition conditions. The minister says participation sessions are being organised, explains why the fields are treated separately while cumulative effects are assessed by TNO and SodM, and says a Ternaard-style benefit agreement is being considered but decisions will outlast this cabinet.
I share your view that improvements in the reasoning of the decision on the Westerveld extraction plan, where applicable, should also be taken into account in future decisions.
Ik deel uw mening dat verbeteringen in de motivering van het besluit op het winningsplan Westerveld, indien van toepassing, ook betrokken moeten worden bij toekomstige besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Agnes Mulder, Sienot, Bromet, Nijboer en Dik-Faber over het rekenmodel waardedalingsregeling dat gedupeerden benadeelt

MPs asked whether the IMG's depreciation model disadvantages the hardest-hit Groningen homes and whether the minister would intervene to apply an individual-level alternative proposed by De Kam and Blanken. The minister replied that the IMG independently sets its own method under the Tijdelijke wet Groningen, that it chose the variant giving the highest average outcomes, and that intervening would undermine its independence, though objections and appeals remain available.
It is not for me but for the IMG to determine, within the legal framework, which method it uses to handle all types of damage, including depreciation damage.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan het IMG om binnen de wettelijke kaders te bepalen welke werkwijze zij hanteert voor de afhandeling van alle schadevormen, waaronder schade door waardedaling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, De Groot, Graus, Bromet, Futselaar en Moorlag over het opnemen van de haas en het konijn op de lijst bedreigde zoogdieren, terwijl beide nog steeds bejaagd worden

MPs from six parties asked the minister why the hare and rabbit, newly listed as threatened on the Red List of mammals, may still be hunted, and whether they will be removed from the huntable species list. The minister answered that both are listed as 'sensitive' rather than threatened, that the hunting season for hares has ended and for rabbits ends in January, and that research on population decline and hunting effects will be commissioned, with possible further protection measures to follow.
Next year I will have further research carried out into the decline of these species.
Het komende jaar zal ik verder onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de afname van deze soorten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en De Groot over de artikelen ‘Waar kalkoenen klokken zwijgen de hijskranen’ en ‘Helaas het stikstofprobleem is niet opgelost met het uitkopen van 25 piekbelasters al helpt het wel’

MPs Bromet and De Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about nitrogen 'peak emitters' near Natura 2000 areas, the targeted buy-out scheme, a Gelderland study and provincial roles. The minister answered that provinces control targeting and timing, that the evaluation of the first tranche will guide future steps, and declined to give some data (such as the number of applicants) until spring 2021; she also failed to complete answers to questions 16 and 17 on time.
I am not aware whether these companies are aware of this.
Het is mij niet bekend of deze bedrijven hier van op de hoogte zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen, Van Ojik en Bromet over het verzwakken van Europese standaarden voor landbouwgif onder Canadese druk via CETA

MPs from GroenLinks asked the trade and development minister whether CETA weakens EU pesticide safety standards, including reports of a shift to case-by-case risk assessment and Canadian pressure via CETA committees. The minister denied any abandonment of the precautionary principle, said the Netherlands opposed refusing import tolerances, and stated that CETA committees cannot change EU law and no concessions were made.
CETA does not affect the precautionary principle, which is anchored in EU law.
CETA tast het voorzorgsprincipe, dat is verankerd in EU-recht, niet aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Bromet over het artikel 'NAM wil productiewater Schoonebeek injecteren in Drentse gasvelden'

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers about NAM's plan to inject produced water from Schoonebeek into Drenthe gas fields, including cross-border risks and the lack of direct information to the German municipality of Emlichheim. The minister answered that no cross-border risks are currently expected, that the municipality was informed via documents but not actively involved under the bilateral framework, and that risks will be examined in an MER and permit process overseen by SodM.
For the planned injection in the Schoonebeek region there are currently no cross-border environmental effects.
Bij de voorgenomen injectie in de regio Schoonebeek is er op dit moment geen sprake van grensoverschrijdende milieugevolgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de artikelen 'Milieuwetten Brazilië versoepeld: bescherming kustbossen opgeheven» en «Import sojabonen uit Brazilië 40 procent hoger'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about Brazil loosening environmental laws, including protection of coastal forests, and about a 40 percent rise in Dutch soy imports from Brazil. The government acknowledged the reports, said Brazil's changes are being discussed through bilateral and EU dialogue, and argued the soy rise mainly serves other European markets while committing to EU-level deforestation-free import measures.

The Netherlands conducts, bilaterally and with European partners, an active dialogue with the Brazilian government on the importance of climate and environmental protection and combating deforestation.
Nederland voert, bilateraal en met Europese partners, een actieve dialoog met de Braziliaanse regering over het belang van klimaat- en milieubescherming en de bestrijding van ontbossing.
Antwoord op vragen vanhet lid Bromet over het artikel 'Ten koste van mens en milieu'

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister about a press article alleging that RIVM nitrogen models rest on limited measurements, that herd and manure-rights registers are not cross-checked, and that fraud is lucrative. The minister largely defends existing models and inspection arrangements, acknowledges uncertainties, and points to ongoing reviews and a planned sensor pilot without committing to a specific new check.
The Advisory Committee on Measuring and Calculating Nitrogen chaired by Mr Hordijk made recommendations in its final advice to reduce uncertainties.
Het Adviescollege Meten en Berekenen Stikstof onder voorzitterschap van de heer Hordijk heeft in hun eindadvies aanbevelingen gedaan om te komen tot een vermindering van de onzekerheden.
Antwoord op vragen vande leden Smeulders en Bromet over het bericht ‘Coronaregels overtreden maar Van Rooi Meat krijgt geen straf: gemeenteraad wil opheldering’

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked why the safety region did not sanction Van Rooi Meat for exceeding COVID-19 staffing limits, whether the Labour Inspectorate was involved, and whether slaughterhouses are treated leniently. The minister answered that the company received a warning rather than a sanction because it had not reported the actual number of workers, that the Labour Inspectorate made an unannounced visit and found no irregularities in Helmond, and that a national cooperation platform was set up in September 2020.

The chair of the safety region weighed the matter and decided to give the company a warning and impose no sanction for failing to report in advance the actual number of persons present at the inspection.

De voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio heeft een afweging gemaakt en besloten het bedrijf een waarschuwing te geven en geen sanctie op te leggen voor het feit dat er vooraf geen melding is gemaakt van het daadwerkelijk bij de controle aanwezige aantal personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het bericht ‘Black turbine blade ‘can cut bird deaths’’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about a report that painting turbine blades black could cut bird deaths, and whether the government would test this in the Netherlands. The minister replied that no black-blade test is currently running in the Netherlands, that the sector has shown interest in one at Eemshaven, and that bird-protection measures are being pursued through a joint programme with provinces and the sector.
In principle I am open to this kind of testing by the sector, provided that safety for air traffic is well assured.
Ik sta in principe open voor dit soort testen door de sector, mits de veiligheid voor het luchtverkeer goed geborgd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Jaar van de Wilde eend, toch worden ze afgeschoten’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister why around 90,000 wild ducks are shot yearly despite the species declining about 30% since 1990, and whether hunting-list status and the wildlife list system are adequate. The minister answers that the culling is acceptable given reproduction, that Sovon finds no evidence hunting causes the decline, that the species' conservation status is not at stake, and that no revision of the wildlife list is planned.
There is no reason to revise the wildlife list now or to examine another system.
Er is geen aanleiding om de wildlijst nu te herzien of een andere systematiek te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over loslopende nertsen en covid-19

An MP asked the minister whether loose mink in the Netherlands pose a public health risk and could infect mink farms. The minister answered that loose mink are not a meaningful health risk, that two loose mink tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 near culled farms, and that the role of loose mink is being examined in an ongoing tracing study.
In the tracing study that the research consortium is carrying out for us, all possible routes of infection are being examined.
In het traceringsonderzoek dat het onderzoeksconsortium voor ons uitvoert worden alle mogelijke besmettingsroutes onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over het bericht ‘Provincie Noord-Brabant: wie een weg wil aanleggen, mag nu de stikstof van een boer kopen’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about provinces allowing external netting of nitrogen rights from livestock farms, concerns about wealthy buyers, the 30% nature share, leasing of nitrogen space, and the SRM2 road-modelling method criticised by the Hordijk advisory committee. The minister answered that the provincial opening follows agreed policy, that monitoring and evaluation control the risks, that AERIUS remains the basis for permits, and that a reaction to the advisory committee is forthcoming.
The cabinet takes the advice of all advisory committees extremely seriously, and therefore also that of the Advisory Committee on Measuring and Calculating Nitrogen.
Het kabinet neemt de adviezen van alle Adviescolleges uiterst serieus, en dus ook die van het Adviescollege Meten en Berekenen Stikstof.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg , Futselaar, Bromet, De Groot, Moorlag en Graus over de onderbouwing voor de Nederlandse inzet voor de bescherming van honingbijen, hommels en wilde bijen in het bijenrichtsnoer

MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality for the scientific basis behind the Dutch position on protecting honeybees, bumblebees and wild bees in the EU bee guidance, including the BEEHAVE model, percentile choice, EFSA test runs and consultation of independent experts. The minister answered that the chosen option keeps colony size within natural variability, that the protection goal is still to be set, that a technical meeting is expected in late October, and that documents will be made public beforehand.
I will inform your House about this in advance of the meeting.
Ik zal uw Kamer voorafgaand aan deze bijeenkomst daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Bromet en Ellemeet over G4 EA H1N1-virus en het bericht ‘RIVM houdt ontwikkeling van Chinees varkensvirus goed in de gaten’

MPs Klaver, Bromet and Ellemeet asked the ministers why RIVM is not preparing for the G4 EA H1N1 swine flu virus despite its pandemic potential, how vaccines could be produced, and what sources RIVM monitors. The ministers answered that human-to-human transmission has not been observed, vaccine production takes 4-6 months via WHO-coordinated surveillance, and that no link exists with African swine fever.
It is currently not known how Chinese employees and pig farmers were infected. That is a Chinese matter and we have no information about it.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend op welke manier Chinese medewerkers en varkensboeren zijn besmet. Dat is een Chinese aangelegenheid en we hebben daarover geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het verband tussen luchtvervuiling en het infectierisico van COVID-19

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether air pollution raises COVID-19 infection risk and what research and measures would follow, citing World Bank and Harvard studies. The state secretary answered that the studies are only ecological signals without proof of causation, that human-to-human transmission drives spread, and that research on air quality and COVID-19 is being scoped with RIVM before decisions are taken.
RIVM has been asked to carry out an exploration of research options on the relationship between air quality, livestock farming and COVID-19.
Het RIVM gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de onderzoeksmogelijkheden aangaande de relatie luchtkwaliteit, veehouderijen en COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de verruiming van de sluis bij Kornwerderzand

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about excessive dredging of the Boontjes channel near Kornwerderzand, a possible further deepening requested by Harlingen, and whether a study and cost-benefit analysis would be done. The minister confirmed the dredging volumes exceeded forecasts, said further deepening is not currently planned, and committed to extend the agreement to 2022 with additional economic, morphological and ecological research.
I am therefore having research carried out into the causes of this and its longer-term effects.
Ik laat daarom onderzoek doen naar de oorzaken hiervan en effecten op langere termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Bromet, Futselaar, Moorlag en Madlener over de Nederlandse inzet voor het bijenrichtsnoer

MPs asked the minister whether the Netherlands would back a proposed bee guidance option based on natural colony variability, which the Ctgb and minister favour over the 2013 fixed 7% mortality threshold, and asked for postponement of the July 2020 SCoPAFF discussion. The minister answered that the discussion is non-binding, that she follows the Ctgb advice on the scientific basis for protection goals, and that she has pushed for rapid implementation of the bee guidance while refusing to postpone the meeting.
I consider it important that the way in which the protection goal is set is scientifically justified.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de wijze waarop het beschermdoel wordt vastgesteld wetenschappelijk verantwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over de berichten 'Coronabesmettingen bij VION in Boxtel nog altijd aan de orde van de dag'

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked whether the ongoing COVID-19 infections at the Vion slaughterhouse in Boxtel, and the company's claim that its workplace is safe, warrant closure in light of a parliamentary motion. The Staatssecretaris replied that closure decisions lie with the regional safety board chair on GGD advice, that the plant resumed production on 2 June with extensive measures, and that a national coordination platform is being set up, while stating no signals currently show the measures are ineffective.
The chairs of the safety regions are, under the Public Health Act, the Safety Regions Act and emergency ordinances, the competent authority to take measures at regional level.

De voorzitters van de veiligheidsregio's zijn op basis van de Wet publieke gezondheid, de Wet op de Veiligheidsregio's en Noodverordeningen het bevoegd gezag in deze om op regionaal niveau maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht 'Ctgb trekt proefontheffing Vertimec in'

An MP asked why the Ctgb withdrew a trial permit for Vertimec against oak processionary caterpillar after initially granting it, and whether environmental and ecosystem effects will be assessed more broadly in all pesticide authorisations. The minister explained the Ctgb applied a narrower test to trial permits, then widened its environmental assessment and found unacceptable risks to other insects and birds, and stated that environmental and health effects are already assessed broadly in every authorisation without committing to a new instruction.

After an internal evaluation, the Ctgb decided that for outdoor application of this agent in an oak tree, it would also weigh knowledge of the environmental aspects of Vertimec as a plant protection product.
Na een interne evaluatie heeft het Ctgb besloten voor het buiten toedienen van dit middel in een eik, ook de kennis van milieuaspecten van Vertimec als gewasbeschermingsmiddel mee te wegen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Bromet over het rapport ‘Uitgesproken’

MP Bromet asked the ministers about the 'Uitgesproken' report on pesticide use near residents in Westerveld, including the lack of citizen participation in the local convenant, the planned LNV pilot and the timing of the Health Council advice. Minister Schouten answered that local parties should find their own balance, that the pilot is being prepared under provincial leadership, and that the Health Council advice was published on 29 June 2020 with a reply sent separately.
My preference is that residents and growers enter into dialogue with each other to reach satisfactory agreements at the local level.
Het heeft mijn voorkeur dat omwonenden en telers met elkaar in gesprek komen om op lokaal niveau bevredigende afspraken te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Özütok over het bericht van EenVandaag ‘Verbod streekmarkten drijft boeren tot wanhoop: Onbegrijpelijk, omdat weekmarkten wél open mogen'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why regional farmers' markets were banned under COVID-19 emergency rules while weekly markets stayed open, and whether municipalities could re-permit them. The minister explained that markets are excluded from the event ban only when they are ordinary markets, that whether a regional market counts as an event is decided case by case by the safety region chair, and that organising markets remains a municipal matter, while stating sympathy for short supply chains.
Whether a regional market falls within this definition depends on the concrete circumstances and organisation of that market and is for the chair of the safety region to assess.
Of een streekmarkt binnen deze definitie valt, zal afhankelijk zijn van de concrete omstandigheden en inrichting van die markt en is ter beoordeling van de voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de toezegging om het Natura 2000-gebied 'Broekvelden, Vettenbroek & Polder Stein' ook onder de Habitatrichtlijn te beschermen

An MP asked why the designation decision bringing the Broekvelden, Vettenbroek & Polder Stein Natura 2000 area under the Habitats Directive is taking so long, and how nitrogen-sensitive habitats there will be protected. The minister explains the designation is linked to a Commission infringement procedure that was suspended on Dutch assurances, that the process is being reviewed alongside wider studies on land Natura 2000 areas, and that no nitrogen measures change is needed because the area is not overloaded.
Designation as a Habitats Directive area will therefore be considered in light of the outcomes of the announced studies expected this summer.
Het aanwijzen als Habitatrichtlijngebied zal dus bezien worden in het licht van de deze zomer verwachte uitkomsten van de aangekondigde onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht 'Het is onduidelijk en onzeker welke natuurgebieden baat hebben bij de stikstofaanpak'

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister why RIVM used average critical deposition values per 64-hectare hexagon, which may mask nitrogen-sensitive habitat types, and whether a habitat-type-based method and recalculation will be provided. The minister defends the averaged approach as a global overview, says precise habitat-level figures will follow with the measures, and promises answers before the next debate.
The number of hectares of nitrogen-sensitive nature that falls below the KDW can only be determined with more precision once the source measures are further elaborated and the effects occur.
Het aantal hectares met stikstofgevoelige natuur dat onder de KDW komt, kan pas met meer precisie vastgesteld worden wanneer de bronmaatregelen verder uitgewerkt zijn en de effecten optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over aanhoudende droogte en natuurbranden

An MP asked the ministers whether they know of reports on the drought and large forest fires in the Deurnese Peel, what additional measures are planned, how water boards and the monitoring of vulnerable nature areas have responded, and for a timeline of drought and fire-prevention actions. The minister answered substantively, pointing to existing drought recommendations, Deltaprogramma funding, priority water supply for category 1 nature areas, and the coordinating role of the regional and national bodies, while stating that fire ignition is hard to prevent.
The Netherlands is becoming more resilient to drought through implementation of the 46 recommendations of the Drought Policy Table.
Nederland wordt beter weerbaar tegen droogte met de realisatie van de 46 aanbevelingen van de Beleidstafel droogte
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Bromet en Futselaar over de gevaren van de coronabesmettingen bij nertsenfokkerijen

Three MPs asked the ministers about COVID-19 infections at mink farms, including culling, protective equipment, enforcement of the reporting duty and inspections, and the future of mink farming. The ministers answered that infections were confirmed on nine locations at six farms, that culling was decided on 3 June with a possible voluntary exit scheme still under study, that the NVWA carried out no mink-farm inspections in 2020 so far, and that the questions were answered later than planned.
Not all animals are tested, so we cannot give the precise number of infected animals.
Niet alle dieren worden onderzocht en daarom kunnen wij het precieze aantal besmette dieren niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘CBb ruimte voor positieve uitspraak knelgevallen klein’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that the CBb (College of Appeal for Business) rarely ruled in favour of dairy farmers claiming individual disproportionate burden under the phosphate rights system, and about whether organic and sustainable farmers are affected. The Minister answered that 7 of the 92 partly or fully upheld cases concerned individual disproportionate burden, that organic dairy farmers are not overrepresented among rejected cases, and that the law applies to all dairy farmers, so no exemption is planned.
Of the 283 cases the CBb found unfounded, 7 dairy farmers were SKAL-certified in the reference year 2015.
Van de 283 zaken die door het CBb ongegrond zijn bevonden, waren 7 veehouders in het peiljaar 2015 SKAL-gecertificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Bromet, Moorlag en Futselaar over het uitgelekte plan voor de aanpak van de stikstofproblematiek

MPs Ouwehand, Bromet, Moorlag and Futselaar asked the minister how leaks about the nitrogen plan reached the media before parliament was informed, and when parliament would receive the plan. The minister regrets the media coverage, says parliament will be informed once cabinet decides, and states the cabinet has now concluded its decision and sent the structural approach letter to parliament.
I attach importance to informing your House once the discussions with the parties involved have taken place and cabinet decision-making is complete.
Ik hecht eraan uw Kamer te informeren zodra de besprekingen met betrokken partijen hebben plaatsgevonden en de besluitvorming in het kabinet is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de geplande wildexcursies van Staatsbosbeheer op de Veluwe zoals op hun website vermeld

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister whether Staatsbosbeheer's guided wildlife excursions on the Veluwe, including night walks and Land Rover trips, disturb rest areas and biodiversity. The minister replied that excursions are guided, limited in frequency, and that Staatsbosbeheer will act if negative effects are observed, while Land Rovers are being phased out.
If Staatsbosbeheer observes negative consequences from this type of excursion, it will always take immediate action.
Wanneer Staatsbosbeheer negatieve gevolgen waarneemt van dit soort excursies, zal zij altijd direct actie ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over de vertraging van duurzame energieprojecten vanwege de stikstofproblematiek

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why sustainable energy projects, including hydrogen projects in Groningen, are delayed by the nitrogen problem, and what measures are being taken to complete them on time. The minister answered that stricter permitting after the PAS ruling delays some large energy projects, that no complete overview exists, and listed measures such as netting schemes, lease of nitrogen space, and a planned bundling programme, with a further letter promised in spring.

There is no complete overview of projects affected, because the competent authority lies with different governments (municipalities, provinces and central government) and initiators can be both public and private parties.

Er is geen compleet overzicht van projecten die hiermee te maken hebben, omdat het bevoegd gezag hiervoor bij verschillende overheden (gemeenten, provincies en Rijk) ligt en initiatiefnemers zowel overheden als private partijen kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het artikel ‘Ik heb rapporten herschreven. En daarna dwong je onderzoekers een handtekening eronder te zetten’

Bromet (GroenLinks) asks whether the agriculture ministry pressured ecologists to alter Natura 2000 recovery conclusions during the PAS, whether the PAS was legally doomed as a result, and how future reports and monitoring will be made trustworthy. Minister Schouten denies that any pressure was exerted, says the PAS process used a uniform, reviewed methodology, and promises to raise report reliability with the Rijksheren and strengthen monitoring.
As far as is now known, the ministry has not exerted any pressure to adjust research results.
Er is vanuit het ministerie voor zover nu bekend geen druk uitgeoefend om onderzoeksresultaten aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht “Het gaat niet goed met de natuur in Nederland. Als het zo doorgaat 'is het tegen de klippen op werken'" en natuurgebied ’t Twiske

An MP asked the minister about a newspaper report on poor nature conditions in the Netherlands and about growing commercial events, catering and overnight stays at the Natura 2000 area 't Twiske, asking how nature protection and nitrogen rules can be guaranteed. The minister answered that the Wet natuurbescherming applies, that the province of Noord-Holland is responsible for the management plan and permits, and that case-by-case assessment will determine whether large events or horeca are acceptable.
Permit granting for these kinds of activities is a responsibility of the province of Noord-Holland.
Vergunningverlening voor dit soort activiteiten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het bericht dat de overheid tuinders hielp om het ETS te ontwijken

MPs Bromet and Van der Lee asked whether the government helped greenhouse growers avoid the EU ETS by splitting companies and treating gas boilers as back-up, and why this was not debated with parliament. Minister Schouten answered that the affected firms left the ETS for legitimate reasons, that the NEa supervises to prevent misuse, that the rules were not put to parliament as they implement EU-based provisions, and that removing the back-up rule would be undesirable and contrary to EU law.
The NEa checks permit applications from companies that thereby cease to fall under the ETS against the legal framework so that the rules cannot be abused.
De NEa toetst de vergunningaanvragen van bedrijven waardoor ze niet langer onder ETS vallen aan het wettelijk kader zodat geen misbruik gemaakt kan worden van de regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over de veiligheid van het 5G netwerk

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about the security of 5G networks, including vendor screening, classification of high-risk network parts, human-rights principles and EU industrial capacity. The minister answered that vendors are assessed on intent and foreign legal obligations to share data, that the list of critical components is classified and cannot be shared, and that EU industrial policy is still under discussion.
The list of critical components has been classified as confidential and I therefore cannot share it with you.
De lijst met kritieke onderdelen is als vertrouwelijk geclassificeerd en kan ik daarom niet met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het gedogen van overtredingen naar aanleiding van de PAS-uitspraak

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government's plan to legalise nitrogen-permit-exempt activities after the PAS ruling means existing Nature Conservation Act violations will be tolerated indefinitely, and how this fits enforcement policy and the duty to enforce. Minister Schouten answered that enforcement is paused pending legalisation through regional approaches and assessments, that this counts as a special circumstance with concrete prospect of legalisation, and that grazing and manuring are handled separately.
Until then, the national government and provinces, in their role as competent authority, will not actively enforce against these notifications.
Tot die tijd zullen Rijk en provincies in haar rol als bevoegd gezag niet actief handhaven op deze meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over compensatie voor de gaswinning in het Waddengebied

MPs Van der Lee and Bromet asked whether the 448 million euro investment agenda for compensating gas extraction under the Wadden Sea is justified, whether the Waddenfonds has been used for natural restoration, and whether it should be used for nature and farmers' transition. The minister answered that the proposed projects were narrowed to a 6 million euro per year contribution over ten years conditional on extraction, that the Waddenfonds has spent roughly 46% on ecology since 2012, and that the fund's allocation will reach a 50/50 split by 2026.
I do not intend to spend 448 million euros and will also not charge the taxpayer.
Ik ben niet van plan 448 miljoen euro uit te geven en zal ook geen rekening bij de belastingbetaler neerleggen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het beperken van ammoniak in de veehouderij via technieken

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about subsidies for ammonia-reducing techniques in livestock farming, their effectiveness and cost-efficiency, and how further reduction affects climate, animal welfare, nature and small farmers. The Minister answered that spending data is incomplete, that emissions fell substantially, and that a source-oriented approach and financial support are planned, but gave no full evaluation of effectiveness or cost-efficiency.
The required information is not available. Not all schemes have (recently) been evaluated yet.
De benodigde informatie is niet voorhanden. Nog niet alle regelingen zijn (recent) geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Taking Stock of App Stores’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about app store operators' dominance, commission fees and possible self-preferencing by Apple, and about ongoing competition investigations. The State Secretary answered that the open internet regulation does not cover app stores, that the ACM is conducting a follow-up investigation into Apple, that the European Commission is investigating a Spotify complaint, and that ex ante powers for gatekeeper platforms could be considered.
It is not for me to assess whether an undertaking abuses its dominant position.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of een onderneming haar machtspositie misbruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over de rol van pensioenfondsen bij dierenwelzijn

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked whether pension funds such as ABP, which invests in food companies allegedly failing animal welfare standards, should change their investment policy and how the government would respond. The minister replied that ABP invests about 1.7 billion euro in 17 such companies, found no known law violations, and that the government relies on the voluntary but monitored IMVB covenant and exploring greater member control over investments.
The IMVB covenant focuses on embedding the OECD guidelines and UN Guiding Principles in pension funds' policy.
Het IMVB-convenant richt zich op de inbedding van de OESO-richtlijnen en United Nations Guiding Principles (UNGP's) in het beleid van pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over het bericht 'Concrete aanpak stikstof kan maanden duren’

MPs Bromet and Kröger asked the government about a report that a concrete nitrogen (stikstof) plan could take months, and about speed limits, livestock farms near Natura 2000 areas, natural restoration measures, the AERIUS calculator and missing permits for airports. The ministers answered that a area-based approach and a threshold for small projects will be prepared, with a package by year-end, but gave few numbers and deferred several points (speed-limit effects, farm counts, airport permits, AERIUS scope) to later dates.
The cabinet will come by the end of the year with a worked-out package on the basis of which decision-making can take place at the start of the new year.
Het kabinet komt voor het einde van het jaar met een uitgewerkt pakket op basis waarvan in het begin van het nieuwe jaar besluitvorming kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de geplande kap van gezonde bomen langs de A9

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked why thousands of healthy trees must be felled along the A9 for widening and a relocated fuel station, whether this fits climate and nitrogen rules, and about fuel station lease terms. The minister confirms awareness, explains the tree removal is tied to widening and the rest-stop relocation with one-for-one compensation planned, says the fuel station is a relocation not an addition, cites a 15-year lease, and states the nitrogen (PAS) rules do not apply because no Natura 2000 area lies along the route.
It has been demonstrated that widening the A9 has no effect on nitrogen deposition in Botshol.
Aangetoond is dat de verbreding van de A9 geen invloed heeft op de stikstofdepositie in Botshol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over het advies van de AIVD over de nationale veiligheid en veiling 5G

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the AIVD advice on 5G and national security of 4 February 2019 was not sent to parliament earlier or attached to the 1 July letter, and whether the government will adopt the AIVD recommendations on phasing out high-risk suppliers and on open source software. The government answered that the advice was weighed in the Taskforce risk analysis and shared confidentially with parliament, that its 5G approach is country-neutral, that it adopts the AIVD advice for C2000 with a verification study, and that open source software is a long-term option to be pursued at European level.
Because the AIVD and MIVD letter is one part of the Taskforce's analytical process, it was decided not to send the letter separately and outside the context of the report to the House.
Omdat de brief van de AIVD en de MIVD één onderdeel is van het analyseproces van de Taskforce is er voor gekozen de brief niet los en buiten de context van de rapportage aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht “Nieuwe inzichten in effect van neonicotinoïden op nuttige insecten”

MP Bromet asked the minister whether the WUR study on neonicotinoid exposure of beneficial insects via honeydew would affect Ctgb and EFSA risk assessments, and whether the Ctgb would reassess neonicotinoids. The minister answered that honeydew exposure is not yet included in current frameworks, that the Ctgb will urge EFSA to add this route, and that a reassessment is not needed given the 2018 restriction to greenhouse use.
The Ctgb has meanwhile committed to me that, based on this publication, it will urge EFSA to include the honeydew exposure route in both assessment frameworks.
Het Ctgb heeft mij inmiddels toegezegd om op basis van deze publicatie er bij EFSA op aan te dringen om de blootstellingsroute via honingdauw op te nemen in beide beoordelingskaders
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bromet over het bericht “Zware kritiek van oud-directeur Staatsbosbeheer op houtkap”

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about clear-felling by Staatsbosbeheer, the Forest Stewardship Council criteria, and the lapsed forest management code under the Nature Conservation Act. Minister Schouten denies that clear-felling is standard practice, says felling is limited to small areas except in calamities, and announces a forest strategy to be sent to parliament by year end.
I aim to send it to your House before the end of the year.
Ik streef ernaar deze voor het einde van het jaar naar uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Er zit mogelijk veel meer ‘bijengif’ in de vrije natuur dan gedacht, maar die ontdekking komt te laat’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a study showing the pesticide thiacloprid is far more harmful to aquatic life in simulated field conditions than in lab tests, and why the regulator did not act sooner. The minister acknowledged the findings as worrying, said the regulator considered the study too late for the reassessment, and promised to push for swift EU decision-making and inform parliament before its position vote.
Safety for humans, animals and the environment is leading for me and I will push for swift decision-making.
Veiligheid voor mens, dier en milieu zijn voor mij leidend en ik zal aandringen op snelle besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het bericht ‘35 vissers willen lading MSC Zoe uit zee halen, maar ze mogen niet’

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked why fishing vessels were reportedly barred from helping recover containers lost from the MSC Zoe and how quickly the recovery of the remaining containers would proceed. The minister replied that fishers may assist under conditions set by the ILT for safety and that the shipping company MSC is legally responsible for recovery, with Rijkswaterstaat monitoring progress.
However, this may not be a reason for shipowner MSC to not take its own responsibilities but to shift them onto others.
Het mag echter geen reden zijn dat reder MSC haar eigen verantwoordelijkheden niet op zich neemt maar afwentelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Bromet over het bericht 'Mest barst van chemicaliën en dat is slecht nieuws voor de weidevogels'

MPs De Groot and Bromet asked the Minister of Agriculture about a report linking pesticide residues in manure to declining meadow bird populations, and about whether permitting rules and organic standards are strict enough. The minister confirmed the reported findings, said a causal link to meadow bird decline has not been shown, and pointed to pending EFSA-based permit reassessments and a forthcoming pesticide vision and implementation programme.
Once EFSA's risk assessment of cumulative exposure to substances via residues is ready, it will be implemented and applied by the Ctgb in the permitting policy for plant protection products.

Zodra de risicobeoordeling van EFSA van cumulatieve blootstelling van stoffen via residuen gereed is, zal deze worden geïmplementeerd en toegepast door het Ctgb in het toelatingsbeleid van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over de berichten ‘Microplastics bewust in diervoeding gestopt’ en ‘ECHA proposes to restrict intentionally added microplastics’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about reports on intentionally added microplastics in animal feed and an ECHA proposal to restrict them. The minister answered that microplastics are not used in animal feed, that effects on soil and water are possible, and that restriction proposals are underway at EU level with a process of about one year.
The Netherlands considers it important that a broad look is taken at how the spread of microplastics in the environment can be curbed.
Nederland vindt het belangrijk dat breed wordt gekeken hoe de verspreiding van microplastics in het milieu kan worden teruggedrongen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de stikstofdepositie bij luchthaven Lelystad

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked about nitrogen deposition from Lelystad Airport on Natura 2000 areas, why the AERIUS study was not published, whether construction and traffic emissions were included, and whether sufficient PAS deposition space is available. The ministers answered that the detailed calculations are available on request and a reader's guide was added, that construction and road traffic were assessed with negligible or no effect on sensitive areas, and that the project fits within reserved priority-project capacity via a notification.
This approach was chosen because the information is very extensive and technical in nature.
Er is gekozen voor deze werkwijze omdat de informatie zeer omvangrijk en technisch van aard is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Zware kritiek van oud-directeur Staatsbosbeheer op houtkap’

An MP asked the minister about reports that logging by Staatsbosbeheer is increasing, how this fits its policy, the Nature Conservation Act, the Gedragscode bosbeheer and FSC standards, and the costs and revenues of its forest management. The minister denied a general increase in logging, stated Staatsbosbeheer remains bound by the Nature Conservation Act and FSC, and provided financial figures while affirming that logging must not harm biodiversity.
No, it is not correct across the board that logging is increasing in the forests of Staatsbosbeheer.
Nee, over de gehele linie klopt het niet dat er toenemend wordt gekapt in de bossen van Staatsbosbeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over de concrete aanpak van bedreigingen van boeren

MPs Buitenweg and Bromet asked the Justice, Interior and Agriculture ministers how threats against farmers by violent animal activists are being tackled, including the scale, reporting and prosecution figures and the AIVD's assessment. The minister condemned the intimidation, said such threats are not separately registered, stressed reporting and existing police and prosecution responses, and did not commit to new measures.
Threats against farmers or vandalism of barns motivated by animal activism are not as such registered by the Public Prosecution Service and the police.
Bedreiging van boeren of vernieling van stallen vanuit dieren-activistische motieven, wordt niet als zodanig door het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de berichten ‘Bewegingsjacht om dierziekte te voorkomen ‘veel gedoe voor weinig opbrengst’’ en ‘Omstreden jacht met bijna 80 man levert op: één dood zwijn’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a large drive hunt of wild boar in Zuid-Oost Twente and a related drive hunt in Brabant, questioning whether they fit the limited drive-hunt definition and whether the rules are proportionate. The minister answered that the Twente hunt, a count combined with four kills, fell within the definition, that the ministerial regulation would be evaluated after two years, and that the Chamber would be informed of the hunts.
I intend to evaluate the Ministerial Regulation on preventive measures against African swine fever two years after entry into force for effectiveness and proportionality.
Ik ben voornemens de Regeling preventieve maatregelen Afrikaanse varkenspest twee jaar na inwerkingtreding te evalueren op effectiviteit en proportionaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de plannen voor grootschalige zandwinning in het IJsselmeer voor de kust van Friesland

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked the ministers about the large-scale sand extraction plans in the IJsselmeer off Friesland, covering alternative sites, drinking water effects, cumulative impacts on Natura 2000, the Habitats Directive ADC test, the Commission m.e.r. advice, and consistency with provincial plans. The minister answered that the chosen Gaasterland site was the most suitable after alternatives were considered, that drinking water effects are negligible, that no significant effects on Natura 2000 are expected so no ADC test is required, and that the municipality makes the final zoning decision.
This means that an important (final) assessment is left to the municipality De Fryske Marren.
Daarmee wordt een belangrijke (finale) afweging gelaten aan de gemeente De Fryske Marren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de berichten ‘Baas Hoge Veluwe wil wolven afschieten: 'Slechts ruimte voor handjevol'’ en ‘Directeur De Hoge Veluwe wil dat afschieten van wolf mogelijk wordt’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about news reports that the Hoge Veluwe director wants wolves shot, whether Dutch landowners lobby via the European Landowners Organisation to delist the wolf, whether released wolves are realistic, and how other European countries handle wolf expansion. The minister confirmed awareness, said Dutch landowners' lobbying was not known to her (the Dutch membership is run by the Federatie Particulier Grondbezit), found no evidence of released animals, and described varied national wolf plans and compensation schemes.
I am not aware that Dutch landowners are lobbying via the European Landowners Organisation (ELO) to remove the wolf from the list of protected species.
Het is mij niet bekend dat Nederlandse landeigenaren via de European Landowners Organisation (ELO) lobbyen om de wolf van de lijst van beschermde diersoorten af te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Schonis, Bromet en Kröger over het bericht dat er 277 containers overboord zijn geslagen bij de Waddeneilanden, waarvan drie met benzoylperoxide

MPs asked how the government will protect nature and environment in the Wadden Sea after 277 containers, three holding benzoylperoxide, were lost overboard, and about responsibility, liability, tracing, monitoring, cleanup coordination and a future Wadden authority. The minister replied that retrieval is the priority, that Rijkswaterstaat and the Wadden Academy are studying the effects, that the shipping company is liable and has accepted cleanup costs, that the Veiligheidsregio Fryslân coordinates cleanup, and that the role of a future Wadden authority is still being decided.
The shipping company has been held directly liable on behalf of the State and obliged by Rijkswaterstaat to clean up under the Maritime Accidents Combating Act.
De reder is namens de Staat direct aansprakelijk gesteld en door Rijkswaterstaat tot opruiming verplicht op basis van de Wet bestrijding maritieme ongevallen.
