Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de plannen voor grootschalige zandwinning in het IJsselmeer voor de kust van Friesland

Two GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a large-scale sand extraction plan in the IJsselmeer off Friesland, its effects on Natura 2000 nature, landscape, drinking water, restoration and whether less harmful locations were considered. The government answered that responsibilities are spread across Rijk, province, municipality and water boards, that environmental and appropriate assessments were carried out, and that no further talks with the province are planned.
In my view a careful weighing has taken place.
Naar mijn mening heeft een zorgvuldige afweging plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar natuurinclusieve landbouw’

An MP asked the minister about a PBL survey on nature-inclusive farming, questioning whether restricting distribution to LTO members makes the sample unrepresentative and whether non-members will be approached. The minister confirmed the study, said the questionnaire was opened to all farmers via agricultural media, but deferred on representativeness to the professionalism of researchers and the steering group.
I trust in the professionalism of the researchers and the steering group that they have designed a sound research setup.
Ik vertrouw op de professionaliteit van de onderzoekers en de klankbordgroep dat zij een goede onderzoeksopzet hebben ontworpen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de berichten 'De wolf: nuttig dier of overbodige killer?', 'En de grootste schapendoder is ... misschien wel uw eigen hond' en 'Schapenhouders willen dat wolf beschermde status

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about wolves migrating from Germany, their ecological role, and whether sheep farmers' calls to remove wolves' protected status should be heeded. The minister answered that wolves remain strictly protected, that derogations are possible under provincial policy, and that the Operational Wolf Plan phase 2 decision is still pending.
Since 2014 the wolf has been designated as a protected native species.
Sinds 2014 is de wolf aangewezen als beschermde inheemse diersoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het stimuleren van economische sectoren rond de Waddenzee

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a national tourism summit, the Wadden islands' plea against new gas extraction under the Wadden Sea, and whether tourism rather than mining should be promoted there. The minister said the summit was a provincial initiative, that the Mijnbouwwet already restricts mining in the Wadden area, that the budget has no specific funds for Wadden tourism or mining, and that a one-dimensional focus is rarely possible in a densely populated country.

Partly on that basis, article 7a of the Mining Act, amended on 1 January 2017, was included, which in addition to the restrictions already in the Structuurvisie Waddenzee sets further limits on mining activities in the Wadden area.

Mede op basis daarvan is in de per 1 januari 2017 gewijzigde Mijnbouwwet artikel 7a opgenomen, waarin aanvullend op de beperkingen die reeds waren opgenomen in de Structuurvisie Waddenzee, nog nadere beperkingen zijn gesteld aan mijnbouwactiviteiten in het Waddengebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het gebruik van ruimtevaart voor het verkrijgen van data over onder andere ammoniak

An MP asked the government about the role of space-based data in refining the nitrogen and ammonia measurement network and whether this should be included in a forthcoming ammonia policy letter. The minister replied that satellite data is not yet suitable for near-surface concentration measurement and referred the technical detail to a RIVM briefing.

Satellite observations are currently not yet suitable for measuring concentrations close to the earth's surface (in a distinguishing way), so they cannot contribute to refining the current measurement networks.

Satellietwaarnemingen zijn momenteel echter nog niet geschikt om concentraties dicht bij het aardoppervlak (onderscheidend) te meten, om zo een bijdrage te kunnen leveren aan verfijning van de huidige meetnetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het onderzoek ‘Europe's renewable energy directive poised to harm global forests’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about a Princeton study warning that the revised EU renewable energy directive could harm global forests by counting wood as a low-carbon renewable fuel. The minister rejected the claims of mass deforestation and rising emissions, citing sustainability criteria and stricter Dutch rules, and promised to send a reaction before the European Parliament vote.
Your House will receive my reaction before the final vote on the revision of the renewable energy directive by the European Parliament.
Uw Kamer ontvangt mijn reactie voordat er definitief gestemd wordt over de herziening van de richtlijn hernieuwbare energie door het Europees Parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Zorgen bij Brabantse varkensboeren over uitbraak Afrikaanse varkenspest in België’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the risk of African swine fever spreading from Belgium to the Netherlands, including the measures taken, whether hunting of wild boar should be opened or halted, and whether human activity in hunting and farming spreads the virus. The Minister answers that the introduction risk is small to medium, that a Plan van Aanpak and buffer-zone population reduction are planned, and that she does not support a general hunting ban, which she considers not in line with expert advice.
I am already in consultation with the provinces about this.
Ik ben hierover reeds in overleg met de provincies.

Requests the government, as system authority, to actively report to the Chamber when an education institution is not free, safe or accessible for students.

requests the government to investigate whether the side-entry track can be completed with a hbo diploma, and to inform the House by autumn 2024
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of het zijinstroomtraject met een hbo-diploma afgerond kan worden, en de Kamer uiterlijk najaar 2024 te informeren
Motie van het lid Martens-America c.s. over studenten die een bestuursjaar doen en daardoor collegegeldvrij studeren niet volledig uitsluiten van het volgen van onderwijs
Asks the government to consult education institutions so that students doing a board year, who study tuition-free, are not fully excluded from taking courses.

introducing a capacity limit on tracks within a bachelor or associate degree programme.

Asks the government to create a transparency register in which broadcasters report the costs of every TV and radio programme, to strengthen public accountability of public money.
requests the government to establish a transparency register in which broadcasters list the costs of every TV and radio programme

wordt voor de looptijd van het Bestuursakkoord Friese Taal en Cultuur (vijf jaren) een jaarlijks bedrag ter beschikking gesteld

requests the government to draw up within eight weeks a plan with higher education institutions containing concrete measures that each institution will individually take to sharply reduce the share of English-taught programmes

Proposes shifting 340,000 euros within the university education budget to fund a Frisian bachelor programme.
by earmarking 340,000 euros annually from the general lump sum specifically for a Frisian bachelor programme
door jaarlijks € 340.000,– van de algemene lumpsum specifiek te oormerken voor een bachelor fries

Enables numerus fixus (capacity limits) on tracks within a programme in higher education, amending the WHW and related rules on admission and enrolment.
With this amendment the submitter aims to make a capacity limit possible on tracks within a programme.
Met dit amendement beoogt indiener een capaciteitsfixus mogelijk te maken op trajecten binnen een opleiding.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Van Eijk over het bericht 'Door angst voor schijnzelfstandigheid worden wachtlijsten bij UWV nog langer'

VVD MPs asked why UWV is ending contracts with self-employed occupational physicians over fear of sham self-employment, whether this reflects tax enforcement, and how it fits motions to avoid categorical exclusion of freelancers. The government answers that UWV no longer hires physicians as freelancers due to sham-self-employment risk, that the Tax Authority enforces risk-based and has lifted its moratorium with a soft landing, and that freelancers still work at UWV in some domains.
The Tax Authority cannot, under its duty of confidentiality, answer whether enforcement has taken place against occupational physicians working on UWV assignments.
De Belastingdienst kan op grond van zijn geheimhoudingsplicht niet beantwoorden of van handhaving sprake is bij verzekeringsartsen die in opdracht van UWV werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over de brief houdende het advies van de procesregisseur over clustering omroepen in omroephuizen

Member Martens-America (VVD) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the process adviser's advice on clustering public broadcasters into broadcast houses and on the implementation of parliamentary motions for public media reform. The Minister answered that reform is necessary and that the government will keep steering the process, maintaining the earlier frameworks while the broader reform bill is prepared for 2026.
I consider it important that politics takes more control now that it has become clear that broadcasters cannot reach agreement among themselves.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de politiek meer regie pakt nu duidelijk is gebleken dat omroepen er onderling niet uitkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over de beantwoording van Kamervragen op 21 augustus 2025 over de artikelen «Picnic en Flink vallen onder supermarkt-cao, zegt rechter» van RTL-nieuws en «Online-supermarkte

Martens-America (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government will act on weak business climate caused by rigid rules, clarify the AVV and dispensation procedure for the Picnic/online supermarket collective agreement, disclose the decision and planned reforms. The minister answered that the AVV decision was taken on 22 September, granting dispensation to the e-commerce employers' association, with publication expected 25 September, while withholding the dispensation text and promising a report to parliament in autumn.
I cannot give access to the text of the dispensation decision.
Ik kan geen inzage geven in de tekst van het dispensatiebesluit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Bikkers over de artikelen ‘Picnic en Flink vallen onder supermarkt-cao, zegt rechter’ van RTL-nieuws en ‘Online-supermarkten krijgen bijval van ACM in discussie rond cao

MPs Martens-America and Bikkers asked whether the government will act on court and ACM signals that online supermarkets Picnic and Flink fall under the supermarket collective labour agreement, and whether the AVV and dispensation framework needs updating for innovative firms. The minister says he is reviewing the cao and AVV system, will not comment on the pending dispensation request, and points to existing dispensation criteria while promising a fuller update after the summer.
The dispensation request is currently being handled by me.
Momenteel is het dispensatieverzoek bij mij in behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'UvA verhaalt schade bezettingen mei 2024 niet op demonstranten'

MPs Martens-America and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked why the University of Amsterdam did not recover about 1.5 million euros of damage from the May 2024 occupations from the protesters, and what legal and practical obstacles exist to recovering such damage from rioters. The Minister answers that identifying perpetrators in chaotic group situations is often practically impossible, that group liability has conditions, that most damage was covered by insurance, and that institutions decide themselves whether to claim as injured parties, without providing case counts.
Furthermore, as Minister I do not collect data on whether group liability is applicable in riots in higher education.
Voorts verzamel ik als Minister geen gegevens over het wel of niet toepasbaar zijn van groepsaansprakelijkheid bij rellen in het hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Radicalen vrijuit op universiteiten: gedragscodes blijken vooral papieren tijgers’

MPs Ceder and Martens-America asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how he views reports that university codes of conduct are toothless against intimidating radical behaviour, and what he will do about recurring intimidation and disruption on campuses. The Minister says institutions are responsible for enforcing their own rules and safety, that he is strengthening supervision through a planned statutory duty of care for safety and a review of complaint procedures, but gives no concrete new enforcement sanctions beyond existing instruments.
I expect institutions to take their responsibility for a safe learning and working environment for students and staff and to use the regular instruments available to them for this purpose.

Ik verwacht dat instellingen hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen in de zorg voor een veilige leer- en werkomgeving voor studenten en medewerkers en hierbij het reguliere instrumentarium inzetten dat zij hiervoor beschikbaar hebben
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Boskalis ziet geen toekomst meer in Nederland: “We moeten niet verzwakt worden door doorgeschoten milieueisen”

Two VVD MPs asked the government how it views Boskalis considering leaving the Netherlands over strict environmental rules, and about the effects of CSRD, CSDDD, WAMCA, EU procurement and export credit policy on Dutch competitiveness. The government answered that it regrets any departure, is working on a business climate pact, supports raising the CSRD threshold but not abolishing it, is awaiting the WAMCA evaluation, and defends Dutch export credit policy as broadly in line with peers.
I aim to have this Pact ready for signing by mid-June.
Ik streef ernaar dit Pact medio juni gereed te hebben voor ondertekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over Pro-Palestijnse rellen op universiteiten en de Raden van Toezicht van Nederlandse onderwijsinstellingen

An MP asked the Minister of Education about pro-Palestinian disruptions at Dutch universities and whether the minister appoints Supervisory Board members, and how those members are selected and held to account for safety. The minister answered that he contacted institutions, that boards bear primary responsibility for safety, that he appoints members of public universities' supervisory boards via a profile-based procedure, and that a safety duty bill and an inspectorate study are underway.
I do not report on or evaluate this.
Ik rapporteer of evalueer dit niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over de verplichte rekentoets in het mbo

An MP asked the Minister of Education about concerns that mbo students with diagnosed arithmetic problems such as dyscalculia may fail to obtain their diploma because of the compulsory maths test, and about options for schools to apply tailored support and flexibility. The Minister acknowledged the concerns, said schools have a responsibility to offer support such as extra time or oral examination, but rejected giving schools more room to award diplomas without a passed maths test and saw no need for further differentiation yet.
I do not consider it desirable that students without the correct result in arithmetic be eligible for a diploma.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk dat studenten zonder het juiste resultaat op rekenen in aanmerking komen voor een diploma.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Lezing pro-Israëlische activiste op Radboud Universiteit ruw verstoord, aangifte tegen gemaskerde docent: ’Hij leidde de bende’’

MPs Stoffer and Martens-America asked the government about disruptions of pro-Israel lectures at Radboud University and Maastricht University, the role of a masked lecturer, risk assessments, and whether institutions take action against staff and students. The minister condemns illegal disruption, describes the universities' risk measures and says institutions should report suspected crimes, while refusing to share confidential information on staff measures and noting that such measures against students are not centrally recorded.
However, I have asked these institutions about this.
Antwoord 4 Ik heb dit nagevraagd bij deze instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het bericht 'Omroepen gebruiken gratis peperdure zendtijd in strijd tegen bezuiniging op NPO: 'Niet correct''

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why public broadcasters used their identification slots to campaign against planned cuts to the NPO, and whether this compromised their independence. The minister answered that the slots were a fixed, non-commercial segment, staff acted outside working hours, and that the government would not comment on media content given broadcaster independence.
I do not decide on the content of the media offering.
Ik ga niet over de inhoud van het media-aanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het artikel 'EO-directeur Arjan Lock kan dankzij nieuw statuut onbeperkt aanblijven voor jaarsalaris van ruim 200.000 euro'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a recent EO statute change, reported to let the EO director stay indefinitely, was timed and framed appropriately given planned public broadcasting reforms and term limits. The minister answered that statutes are the broadcasters' own matter, that the change followed a 2021 Media Authority request on the mission wording and did not concern terms, and that term limits will be set in the reform law while broadcasters are already aligning their statutes to two five-year terms.
I have no role in assessing the statutes of broadcasting associations.
Ik heb geen rol ten aanzien van de beoordeling van de statuten van omroepverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het bericht ‘Het bindend studieadvies verdwijnt langzaam van de hogeschool’

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the government still supports the binding study advice (bsa) in higher education, given that several universities of applied sciences are loosening it. The minister replied that the government has no plans to change the rules, that institutions keep the legal power to decide on the bsa in consultation with their works councils, and that it will not intervene with individual institutions.
Since it is the institutions' own competence, which bsa norms are applied is not centrally registered.
Aangezien het de bevoegdheid van de instellingen zelf is, wordt niet centraal geregistreerd welke bsa-normen er worden gehanteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Aukje de Vries over het bericht «Minister scheldt FINEB-schulden Bonaire kwijt»

MPs Martens-America and Aukje de Vries asked why the minister forgave outstanding FINEB student debts owed by Bonaire students, why this was not in the recent letter on student finance, and about the loan terms and total amounts. The minister answered fully: he forgave 373 remaining debts totaling $4.378 million from 1 January 2025, citing outdated loan terms, and acknowledged the forgiveness was decided separately from the pending review of the WSF BES and WSF 2000 student finance schemes.
I have decided to forgive the still outstanding FINEB student debts as of 1 January 2025, because the way FINEB student loans were provided is outdated and no longer fits the current era.

Ik heb het besluit genomen om de nog openstaande FINEB-studieschulden per 1 januari 2025 kwijt te schelden, omdat de wijze waarop FINEB-studieleningen zijn verstrekt verouderd is en niet meer bij deze tijd past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het ledencriterium voor omroepen

MP Martens-America asks the minister about uncertainty over the membership criterion for broadcasters, a peildatum of 28 February 2026, and whether broadcasters should recruit members before reforms are clear. The minister confirms the earlier statements, sets out that a bill extending the current concession period by two years is pending, and says that without it a new membership count would be needed and the peildatum would be adjusted once the law passes.
Once the bill extending the period becomes law, I will adjust the peildatum and the other applicable deadlines, depending on whether the membership criterion is maintained at all.

Zodra het wetsvoorstel tot verlenging tot wet is verheven, zal ik de peildatum en de overige termijnen die van toepassing zijn aanpassen, afhankelijk van de vraag of het ledencriterium überhaupt gehandhaafd blijft.
Antwoord op van de leden Martens-America en Kisteman over het bericht ’Kleding SHEIN vol hormoonverstorende stoffen, slippers 325 keer giftiger dan toegestaan’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that SHEIN clothing contained hormone-disrupting substances, how many non-conforming products are sold, what legal basis Dutch and EU authorities have to act, and why enforcement was not intensified before the holidays. The Minister answered that EU market surveillance studies find 85-95% of sampled third-country platform products non-conforming, that the European Commission has exclusive competence over VLOPs like SHEIN under the DSA, and that the government will push for EU-level action and a customs reform, but could not yet provide Productenmeldwijzer report figures and declined to comment on enforcement timing.
As Minister I do not make decisions on the (temporary) intensification of supervision. That is for the supervisory authorities.
Als Minister neem ik geen besluit over de (tijdelijke) intensivering van het toezicht. Dat is aan de toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Martens-America over de artikelen `Energieminister Qatar dreigt gaslevering EU te stoppen` en `Topman Boskalis `verketterd` om kritiek op vestigingsklimaat

MPs Kamminga and Martens-America (VVD) asked the ministers about newspaper reports on Qatar threatening EU gas supply and on criticism of the investment climate, and about the impact of the CSDDD on competitiveness, compliance costs and implementation. The minister answered at length, largely defending the CSDDD and its Dutch implementation, promising ongoing dialogue and business support, and arguing that the Dutch law adds no extra requirements.
The cabinet endorses the goal of reducing regulatory burden, as also included in the coalition programme.
Het kabinet onderschrijft het doel van regeldrukvermindering, zoals ook opgenomen in het regeerprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Martens-America over het rapport 'Effect van Amerikaanse invoertarieven op de Nederlandse en Europese economie’ van het Centraal Planbureau

MPs Kamminga and Martens-America asked the ministers about the CPB report on the effects of US import tariffs on the Dutch and European economy, covering sectoral impacts, EU countermeasures, trade diversion, investment relocation, financing, ports and employment. The government answered that the report shows limited but real effects, pointed to existing EU trade instruments and business-support tools, and said it is too early to commit to specific measures on financing or employment.
It is too early to take measures on business financing.
Het is te vroeg om maatregelen te nemen rondom bedrijfsfinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het bericht ‘MBO Westland zet in op minder schoolverlaters: oriëntatieperiode van zes maanden’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about MBO Westland's plan for a six-month orientation period to reduce early school leaving and about loopbaanoriëntatie funding. The minister said the orientation programmes will be piloted and monitored, that investments in career guidance are being tracked with reports due in 2026 and 2028, and that a Pact Opleiden is planned, without a decision on steering study choices nationally.
I am enthusiastic about the potential of orientation programmes to guide students who at entry to MBO cannot yet make a targeted study choice towards a suitable choice.
Ik ben enthousiast over de potentie van oriëntatieprogramma's, om studenten die bij instroom in het mbo nog geen gerichte studiekeuze kunnen maken te begeleiden naar een passende keuze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over Sociale veiligheid NPO

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why EUR 3.6 million in one-off funds was allocated to the NPO for social safety, given that the NPO had not made sufficient progress after the OGCO report. The minister answered that the NPO is responsible for structural costs, that the funds were withdrawn following a parliamentary motion, and that the NPO had been asked to cover costs from its regular funding.
Your House adopted a motion on 5 December requesting the government to withdraw the allocation of one-off funds for social safety at the NPO.
Uw Kamer heeft op 5 december een motie aangenomen die de regering verzoekt om de toekenning van incidentele middelen ten behoeve van sociale veiligheid bij de NPO in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Van der Burg over het bericht ‘China intimideert Nederlandse media en correspondenten’

MPs Martens-America and Van der Burg asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Foreign Affairs about reports of Chinese intimidation of Dutch media and correspondents, and what the government will do about it. The minister answers that the government will evaluate its intensified foreign interference approach in 2025, supports PersVeilig, raises concerns with Chinese authorities, and will study the China Knowledge Network report's recommendations, without committing to specific new measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Martens-America over het bericht 'Experts waarschuwen: Chinese spionage escaleert en Westen krijgt er geen grip op'

MPs Martens-America and Hertzberger asked the Minister of Education about reports that Chinese espionage in Dutch knowledge institutions is escalating, including CSC scholarship PhD students, study-switching by Chinese students, and a Wageningen collaboration with Tencent. The Minister responded that knowledge security is a priority, pointed to a planned screening obligation and an expanded espionage offence bill, said study-switching is very limited, and that partnership decisions lie with institutions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over de capaciteitsfixus op trajecten binnen een opleiding

MP Martens-America asked the minister whether the amendment allowing a capacity-based numerus fixus at track level is in force for 2025–2026 and how implementation is progressing. The minister answered that the legal possibility took effect on 1 September, that Studielink will implement track-level fixus for 2026–2027 (enrolment opens 1 October 2025), and that institutions are responsible for implementation and for deciding on any fixus.
The amendment has indeed entered into force as of 1 September.
Het amendement is inderdaad in werking getreden per 1 september jongstleden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America, Becker, Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht 'Omstreden Samidoun-kopstuk Mohammed Khatib komt naar Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen: ’Extremistische haatprediker’'

MPs from the VVD asked ministers whether they would refuse or flag a visa for Mohammed Khatib of Samidoun, whether universities should host such speakers, and what the government will do about foreign influence and the organisation's banning. The ministers answered that Khatib has been flagged in the national alert system and refused entry, that the Radboud University cancelled the lecture, that the government is supporting an EU listing of Samidoun and talking with Germany and the public prosecutor, and that a national antisemitism strategy will follow in autumn.
These conclusions led the Minister for Asylum and Migration, in consultation with the Minister of Justice and Security, to flag the person in E&S.
Deze conclusies hebben ertoe geleid dat de Minister van Asiel en Migratie, in samenspraak met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, betrokkene heeft gesignaleerd in E&S.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Van der Burg over het bericht "Doodsbedreigingen en anonieme berichten: hoe Chinese studenten in Nederland worden geïntimideerd"

Two VVD MPs asked the Education minister and Foreign Affairs minister about reports that Chinese students in the Netherlands are threatened and intimidated, and what is being done. The minister agreed such intimidation is unacceptable, pointed to a broad approach against unwanted foreign interference, university responsibility for safety, a raised issue with the Chinese embassy, and ongoing work on academic freedom and self-censorship.
The cabinet considers every form of unwanted foreign interference completely unacceptable.
Het kabinet vindt elke vorm van ongewenste buitenlandse inmenging volstrekt onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Nederland wil export ASML naar China verder beperken’

MPs Kamminga and Martens-America asked whether the government plans to further restrict ASML's exports of chip-making machines to China, which tools and risks are involved, and how businesses are consulted. The minister denies a plan to restrict exports, describes a country-neutral export-control measure that requires licences rather than banning exports, and gives largely general answers, declining to give licence numbers and deferring to ASML on its own impact.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual licences to specific destinations.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele vergunningen naar specifieke bestemmingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het bericht 'Mediawaakhond bekijkt zorgelijk vertrek minister Klever bij Ongehoord Nederland'

An MP asked the Minister about reports that the media watchdog is reviewing the departure of Ongehoord Nederland's commercial director Klever, covering integrity, social safety, journalistic quality, handover of duties, transparency of public spending and possible conflicts of interest. The Minister says the Commissariaat voor de Media, which has been given full attention on the case, is the competent supervisor and that the Raad van Toezicht must assess the governance questions, while declining to judge journalistic quality itself.
The commissariat has informed me that this case has its full attention.
Het commissariaat heeft mij laten weten dat deze casus de volle aandacht heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over de hervorming van de NPO

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reforming the NPO public broadcaster, including extending its recognition period, governance and transparency, and a timeline. The minister confirmed the parliamentary request and committed to a governance and oversight review and to a transparency letter, but gave no firm timeline and deferred the reform's content and timing.
Several advisory reports show that the governance of the national public broadcaster and the media supervision tasks need to be revised.
Uit meerdere adviezen en rapporten blijkt dat de governance van de landelijke publieke omroep en de taken in het mediatoezicht herzien moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Brekelmans over het optreden van de Russische propagandisten Vladimir Pozner en Ivan Urgant in Theater Amsterdam op 28 mei 2024

MPs Martens-America and Brekelmans asked the government about a Dutch theatre performance by Russian propagandists Pozner and Urgant, including its risk of spreading Russian disinformation and how it fits EU and Dutch sanctions and anti-interference policy. The government answered that free expression weighs heavily, that theatres decide their own programming, and that no coercion by a state actor was identified, while promising no specific new step beyond restating existing policy.
In a democratic constitutional state freedom of expression is a great good and must weigh heavily alongside protection of the democratic constitutional state.
In een democratische rechtstaat is vrijheid van meningsuiting een groot goed en deze dient zwaar te wegen naast de bescherming van de democratische rechtsstaat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en De Kort over het artikel 'Havo-leerlingen stappen vaker over naar het mbo'

MPs Martens-America and De Kort asked about rising numbers of havo students leaving secondary school without a diploma for mbo vocational training, and whether basic skills and startkwalificatie are secured. The minister answers that numbers have risen, that the trend is largely positive, that basic skills plans and a planned study on the beroepshavo are underway, and that a tracking study shows 85% of such transfers obtained an mbo diploma.
In the autumn I will commission a study to gain insight into this.
Ik zal in het najaar een onderzoek uitzetten om hier zicht op te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Ellian over het artikel 'Politie beëindigt demonstratie pro-Palestijnse betogers op campus UvA’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a police-ended pro-Palestinian protest camp at the University of Amsterdam, including intimidation of Jewish students, journalists being hindered, and UvA publishing links with Israeli institutions. The Minister condemned intimidation and antisemitism, said he is in ongoing contact with universities and the local security triangle, pointed to a joint protest guideline and a forthcoming letter on safety and international cooperation criteria, and noted PersVeilig support for journalists.
Question 1: Are you aware of the article 'Police end demonstration by pro-Palestinian protesters on UvA campus'?
Vraag 1 Bent u bekend met het artikel «Politie beëindigt demonstratie pro-Palestijnse betogers op campus UvA»?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Martens-America over het hoofdstuk 'Zo krijg je geld terug van DUO' in het boek DRUKS 2

MPs Van Eijk and Martens-America asked whether DUO's prestatiebeurs (performance grant) facilities are widely misunderstood, whether a generic 'structural functional limitation' note suffices, whether late claims are allowed, and whether a book promoting ways to get money back from DUO is undesirable. The minister answered that DUO staff know the rules, that medical claims require a signed medical form and a causal link, that late claims are possible with justification and a five-year coulance term, and that free public information is not objectionable.
However, I see the task of ensuring that (former) students are informed through our own channels so well that no external explanation or help is needed.
Wel zie ik de taak om ervoor te zorgen dat (oud-) studenten via onze eigen kanalen zo geïnformeerd worden dat er verder geen externe toelichting of hulp nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Geen straf voor milieuactivisten die Meisje met de parel besmeurden: te ingrijpend, zegt hof'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Culture ministers about a court ruling that convicted climate activists for defacing the Girl with a Pearl Earring without imposing punishment, and about related questions on sentencing statistics, compensation for pre-trial detention, the chilling effect on free expression, cassation, museum damage costs, heritage protection, sentencing guidelines and demonstration law. The minister answered that the court found the act punishable, gave statistics on verdicts without sentence, said compensation is for the court to decide, that the prosecution did not appeal, and that existing safety protocols and sector talks are sufficient, promising only a forthcoming letter on demonstrations.
The Public Prosecution Service has not lodged an appeal in cassation.
Het OM heeft geen cassatie ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Ellian over Kamervragen over het artikel “Cultuursector wil veiligheidsprotocol na verstoring concert Lenny Kuhr”

MPs Martens-America and Ellian asked the State Secretary for Culture about the disruption of a Lenny Kuhr concert, the sector's call for a security protocol, and steps against antisemitism in culture. The State Secretary condemned antisemitism, agreed with the sector on a general guideline and specific protocols, and promised a letter to parliament soon, but gave no concrete security measures yet.
It has been agreed that parties in the cultural sector will, in consultation with me, arrive at a general guideline and specific protocols with a uniform directive.
Afgesproken is dat partijen in de cultuursector in overleg met mij komen tot een algemene handreiking en specifieke protocollen met een eenduidige richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het CPB-onderzoek ‘de relatie tussen de arbeidsmarkt en studie-inschrijvingen'

An MP asks the Minister of Education about a CPB report showing weaker labour-market prospects for some graduates and whether students should be steered via numerus fixus, funding or better career information. The minister agrees that study choice should consider labour-market prospects, points to existing and planned measures, and says numerus fixus raises accessibility concerns and is still being studied.

Furthermore, I am currently having research carried out into whether and what effects steering measures in vocational, higher vocational and university education have in encouraging students to pursue programmes leading to occupations with sustainable labour-market prospects.

Daarnaast laat ik momenteel een onderzoek uitvoeren of en welke effecten sturende maatregelen in het mbo, hbo en wo hebben om studenten te interesseren voor opleidingen die opleiden voor beroepen met een duurzaam arbeidsmarktperspectief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Ellian over woede over het besluit van de Hogeschool Utrecht om Holocaust-lezingen te schrappen

MPs Martens-America and Ellian (VVD) asked the Minister of Education about the Hogeschool Utrecht's reported cancellation of Holocaust lectures and about combating antisemitism in education. The Minister said the lecture series was postponed for security reasons, not cancelled, that Holocaust education is a curriculum requirement, and pointed to planned national antisemitism strategy and reporting channels.
The Utrecht University of Applied Sciences has stated that it does not let the content, form and implementation of its education be guided by interest groups or activists.
De Hogeschool Utrecht heeft aangegeven dat zij zich bij de inhoud, vorm en uitvoering van het onderwijs niet laat leiden door belangengroeperingen of activisten.

m: Motie van de leden Bouali en Weverling over rekening houden met bedrijfsgrootte en administratieve draagkracht
Asks the government to take applicant size and administrative capacity into account when Invest International applies additional criteria such as IMVO requirements.
account is taken of the size of the company and the administrative capacity of the applicant
er rekening gehouden wordt met de bedrijfsgrootte en de administratieve draagkracht van de aanvrager
Motie van de leden Amhaouch en Weverling over met de regionale ontwikkelingsmaatschappijen een samenwerkingsvorm onderzoeken
Asks the government to explore with regional development companies a form of cooperation to make it easier for firms to reach Invest International.
requests the government, in consultation with the regional development companies, to investigate what is needed to reach a form of cooperation
verzoekt de regering, in samenspraak met de regionale ontwikkelingsmaatschappijen te onderzoeken wat er nodig is om te komen tot een samenwerkingsvorm
Motie van de leden Weverling en Alkaya over het door de Europese Unie overnemen van aanbevelingen van de Europese Rekenkamer

Asks the government to press the EU to adopt the European Court of Auditors' recommendations on linking aid to anti-corruption, focusing spending and strengthening controllability and checks and balances.

requests the government to firmly urge the European Union to adopt the consistent recommendations of the European Court of Auditors on linking aid to anti-corruption, focusing policy and improving controllability and transparency
verzoekt de regering, er nadrukkelijk op aan te dringen dat de Europese Unie de consequente aanbevelingen van de Europese Rekenkamer ... over te nemen
Amendement van het lid Bouali c.s. over middelen voor opvang en bescherming van vluchtelingen in de regio
Amendment shifts 10 million euro within the budget from security and rule-of-law development to funding for refugee protection and aid in the region.
Coverage for this amendment is found in the non-legally mandatory expenditure in article 4.3 security and rule-of-law development.
Dekking voor dit amendement wordt gevonden in de niet-juridisch verplichte uitgaven in artikel 4.3 veiligheid en rechtsstaatontwikkeling.
Motie van het lid Weverling over nederlandse bedrijven een centralere rol geven in het OS-beleid
Asks the government to give Dutch companies a more central role in development cooperation policy, based on experience in other OECD countries.
requests the government, based on experiences of other OECD countries, to better deploy the knowledge of Dutch companies by giving them a more central role in development policy.
verzoekt de regering, om op basis van de ervaringen van andere OESO-landen de kennis en kunde van Nederlandse bedrijven beter in te zetten
Motie van het lid Weverling over het afbouwen van de OS-status van China in diverse internationale verbanden
Asks the government to explore ways to phase out China's developing-country status in international organisations such as the WTO.
requests the government to explore possibilities to phase out China's developing-country status through economic market power
verzoekt de regering, om te verkennen welke mogelijkheden er zijn om door middel van het inzetten van economische marktmacht
Motie van de leden Weverling en Amhaouch over in uitvoering brengen van het 15/15 actieplan
Asks the Minister to engage NABC and the Africa Taskforce to implement the 15/15 action plan and provide support for its first phase.
requests the Minister to contact NABC and the Africa Taskforce to implement the 15/15 action plan
verzoekt de Minister, in contact te treden met NABC en de Afrika Taskforce om het 15/15 actieplan in uitvoering te brengen
Motie van het lid Weverling over verplichtende migratieafspraken opnemen in het post-Cotonouverdrag
Motion asking the government to seek binding migration and return commitments in the post-Cotonou agreement and to make support for it conditional on their inclusion.
requests the government to make maximum efforts to include these binding migration agreements
verzoekt de regering, zich maximaal in te spannen om deze verplichtende migratieafspraken
Motie van de leden Alkaya en Weverling over onderzoek naar strategische afhankelijkheden en kwetsbaarheden in Nederland, en hoe die in nationaal of Europees verband gemitigeerd kunnen worden
Motion asking the government to investigate strategic dependencies and vulnerabilities in the Netherlands and how they can be mitigated, and to inform the House.
requests the government to conduct research into strategic dependencies and vulnerabilities in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering, een onderzoek in te stellen naar strategische afhankelijkheden en kwetsbaarheden in Nederland
Amendement van het lid Weverling over een voorhang van de krachtens artikel 11.7, negende lid, van de Telecommunicatiewet vast te stellen amvb

Amendment requiring that the general administrative order on the period for contacting existing customers under Telecommunications Act art. 11.7(9) be submitted to both chambers for four weeks before it is proposed.
The proposal for a general administrative order to be established under the ninth paragraph is not made until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het negende lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over de berichten '5G knokt om bandbreedte met levensreddend satellietstation voor schepen' en 'Reders bezorgd over ontmantelen Burum'

MPs Weverling, Remco Dijkstra and Aukje de Vries asked about reports on 5G interference with Inmarsat's Burum satellite station used for maritime emergency communications and on the station's possible dismantling, asking about consultations, alternatives, and timelines. The minister answered that an October 2023 agreement with Inmarsat to migrate emergency-traffic services to Greece secures maritime safety, while noting delays in answering and that no consultation with the province or municipality occurred.

Due to the agreement with Inmarsat, emergency, urgency and safety traffic is secured and there are no longer doubts about whether the Netherlands can sufficiently fulfil its obligations for maritime safety under international treaties.

Door de overeenstemming met Inmarsat is het nood-, spoed- en veiligheidsverkeer geborgd en zijn er geen twijfels meer over de vraag of Nederland de verplichtingen voor de veiligheid op zee onder de internationale verdragen voldoende kan uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Weverling over het bericht 'Politiehonden in opleiding nog steeds mishandeld'

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Weverling asked about media reports of mistreatment of police dogs in training at a private KNPV club, including contracts, sanctions and reporting duties. The minister said police are examining whether criminal investigation is warranted, that the problem does not appear structural, and promised tighter contract penalties and no further purchases from trainers convicted of animal cruelty, but said a ban on keeping animals cannot apply to the KNPV as an umbrella body.
Based on this broadcast, the police, on the instruction of the Public Prosecution Service, are examining whether there are grounds for a criminal investigation.
Op grond van deze uitzending wordt door de politie, in opdracht van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM), onderzocht of er aanknopingspunten zijn voor een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over het bericht 'Besluitvorming genetische gemodificeerde gewassen in impasse door gebrek aan politieke daadkracht'

VVD MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Infrastructure about a dissertation claiming EU GMO authorisation is deadlocked, and about import versus cultivation rules, CRISPR-Cas9, and their motion on biotechnology regulation. The ministers largely agreed EU procedures are slow and costly, said Dutch policy pushes for modernised rules, and pointed to an ongoing European Commission study due by 30 April 2021 without committing to a concrete new step.

The Netherlands is working to put the application and authorisation of new breeding techniques, such as CRISPR-Cas9, on the European agenda, provided species boundaries are not crossed and safety for humans, animals and the environment is guaranteed.

Nederland zet zich in op het Europees agenderen van de toepassing en toelating van nieuwe veredelingstechnieken, zoals CRISPR-Cas9, mits daarbij geen soortengrenzen worden overschreden en veiligheid voor mens, dier en milieu gewaarborgd blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Weverling over het bericht 'Beschermenswaardige partijen: bescherming van het daderdier'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about dangerous fighting dogs, including unrestricted ownership, medical and police costs, shelters rehoming such dogs, breeding restrictions and the Amsterdam appeal court ruling on liability. Minister Schouten answered that existing criminal and municipal powers are sufficient, that breeding restrictions and a risk test exist or are being developed, and that rehoming is possible depending on behavioural testing.
Criminal law provisions apply that impose restrictions on keepers of dangerous dogs.
Er gelden strafrechtelijke voorschriften die beperkingen opleggen aan houders van gevaarlijke honden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Vries, Weverling en Lodders over de berichten ‘Onrust bij pachters van buitendijks land achter Waddenzeedijk’ en ‘Rijkscommissie: Waddengebied moet Nationaal Landschapspark worden’

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about unrest among tenant farmers over the Wadden Sea dike plans and a national committee's proposal to make the Wadden region a National Landscape Park, including consultation with stakeholders and the absence of an impact analysis. The minister answered that dike reinforcement is being planned with stakeholders in phases, that the committee's advice is still being discussed with the parties concerned, and that a broad impact analysis will be started in parallel with the Wadden implementation programme.
In parallel with drafting the implementation programme, a broad impact analysis will be started, in line with the Dijkstra and Geurts motion, to weigh the effects on economy and ecology in balance.

Antwoord 14 Parallel aan het opstellen van het Uitvoeringsprogramma zal, in lijn met de motie Dijkstra en Geurts 8 , worden gestart met een brede impactanalyse om zo de effecten op economie en ecologie in balans met elkaar te kunnen afwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Becker over subsidie aan de organisatie Islamic Relief

MPs Weverling and Becker asked the ministers why Islamic Relief was selected for Power of Voices subsidy despite alleged links to the Muslim Brotherhood and German funding being stopped, and what the government would do about subsidies to organisations opposing integration. The minister answered that no subsidy will be granted to Islamic Relief Worldwide, that the Dutch intelligence services assess the Muslim Brotherhood's presence in the Netherlands as limited, and that municipalities decide their own subsidies, with the Rijk informing them of problematic conduct.
Based on the information available to me, however, I have decided not to grant Islamic Relief Worldwide a subsidy.
Op basis van de mij beschikbare informatie heb ik evenwel besloten om Islamic Relief Worldwide geen subsidie te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Overheid raadt kastomaat van eigen bodem af’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether a Milieu Centraal seasonal fruit and vegetable calendar, partly government-funded, wrongly rated Dutch winter tomatoes as less sustainable than Spanish or Moroccan ones, and how this fits the government's support for short supply chains. The minister confirmed the calendar was taken offline, said no LNV subsidy went to it, stated no current calculation allows a reliable country comparison, and declined to direct an independent organisation's advice.
At present no current calculation is available that would allow a careful statement on how the current production of Dutch tomatoes compares to tomato production in other countries.

Op dit moment is er geen actuele berekening beschikbaar waarmee een zorgvuldige uitspraak gedaan kan worden over hoe de huidige productie van Nederlandse tomaten zich tot de productie van tomaten in andere landen verhoudt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Brits Parlement overtuigd van samenwerking tussen Huawei en China'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Justice about a British parliamentary report on Huawei, China-state ties, subsidies and 5G security. The government said it makes its own assessment of 5G security, outlined existing telecom security measures and EU-level action, and acknowledged close state involvement in Chinese firms without commenting on the report's conclusions.
I closely follow developments in policy on the security and integrity of 5G networks in other countries, including the United Kingdom.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen in het beleid ten aanzien van de veiligheid en integriteit van 5G-netwerken in andere landen, waaronder het Verenigd Koninkrijk, op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Weverling over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse universiteiten werken samen met omstreden techgigant Huawei’

MPs Wiersma and Weverling asked the ministers why Amsterdam universities are collaborating with Huawei on AI-related research despite security risks, and whether the government had warned the UvA about risks. The government answered that universities are autonomous and responsible for their own risk assessments, that the ministries gave advice on risks without formal approval, and that it is studying additional knowledge-security measures to report on this autumn.
Entering into a collaboration is therefore the responsibility of the institution itself.
Het aangaan van een samenwerking is dan ook de verantwoordelijkheid van een instelling zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over DDoS-aanvallen op internetproviders

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate, on behalf of the Minister of Justice and Security, about DDoS attacks on internet providers, their statistics, economic impact, the role of the Digital Trust Center and NCSC in helping SMEs, public-private cooperation, exercises, and user awareness. The answers give 2019 attack figures from NBIP's NaWas, state that economic damage cannot be estimated, describe existing public-private coalitions and advisory roles, and state that providers must take mitigation measures under the Telecommunications Act, with commitments limited to continuing existing exercises and sharing lessons learned.
An estimate of the economic damage caused by an internet disruption from a DDoS attack cannot be made because it depends on a large number of factors
Een inschatting van de economische schade als gevolg van een verstoring van het internet als gevolg van een DDoS-aanval is niet te maken omdat het afhangt van een groot aantal factoren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Weverling over het artikel ‘Behind China’s Decade of European Deals, State Investors Evade Notice’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about reports that Chinese state investors evade notice in European deals, including in the Netherlands. The ministers acknowledge close Chinese state involvement and state risks to national security, outlining a planned investment screening law (Toetsing Economie en Veiligheid) and EU FDI screening regulation, but give no concrete findings on specific Chinese investments.
The cabinet is currently working on establishing a system of investment screening.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment aan de totstandkoming van een stelsel van investeringstoetsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de  leden Remco Dijkstra en Weverling over berichten rond de actie van Greenpeace om de Doggersbank te beschermen door het storten van stenen

MPs Dijkstra and Weverling asked the ministers about Greenpeace dumping rocks on the Dogger Bank in the North Sea, its legal status, possible sanctions, and effects on fishers and the North Sea Agreement talks. The minister says the action is rejected, the stones were dumped in British waters so Dutch law does not apply, the Dutch prosecutor is considering an investigation, and Greenpeace has pledged to stay in the talks.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that it is considering whether there is reason to conduct a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft laten weten te bekijken of er aanleiding is om strafrechtelijk onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Natuurorganisaties moeten mogelijk honderden miljoenen aan subsidie terugbetalen'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a European Court of Justice ruling that state aid to nature organisations (TBOs) for land purchases may have been wrongly approved, and about possible repayment obligations. The minister answered that the ruling does not judge the legality of past subsidies, that no formal Commission investigation has yet been opened, and that concrete consequences and amounts cannot yet be determined.
The judgment of the European Court does not constitute a substantive ruling on the legality of the subsidies granted to TBOs in the past.
Het arrest van het Europese Hof betreft geen materieel oordeel over de legaliteit van de in het verleden verleende subsidies aan TBO's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Van der Molen, Weverling en El Yassini ten behoeve van het VAO Telecommunicatie

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and Climate about the commercial radio advertising market during COVID-19, including revenue shares, job losses, support measures, litigation over frequency licences, the 2003 auction, and DAB+ penetration and FM switch-off timing. The State Secretary answered on substance in most points, citing SEO, ACM and Dialogic studies, and declined to disclose some figures as commercially confidential.

An exact breakdown between large and smaller commercial stations on the one hand, and between commercial and public broadcasters on the other, is difficult to provide because this concerns commercially confidential information.

Een exacte verdeling tussen grote en kleinere commerciële stations enerzijds en tussen commerciële en publieke omroepen anderzijds is lastig te geven omdat het hier om bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur over illegale hondenhandel

An MP asked the minister, after a Nieuwsuur broadcast on illegal dog trade, how the earlier Weverling motion was implemented, the state of the identification and registration system, import numbers, NVWA reports and inspections, and capacity. The minister answered in detail: international cooperation and a dog chain analysis are underway, the improved I&R system is due mid-2021, NVWA handled 849 dog/cat reports in 2019 with 118 inspections, and some reports lacked leads to act on.
It is not possible to state how many dogs imported from abroad were placed in animal shelters.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel honden in dierenasiels geïmporteerd zijn vanuit het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘China weert Nederlands varkensvlees om coronavirus’

An MP asked the minister whether China's suspension of four Dutch pork exporters over COVID-19 was justified, given WHO/FAO findings that food does not transmit the virus, and whether the government would act on it. The minister confirmed awareness, said two of the four plants had been reinstated, that the affected export value is still unclear, and that the government has raised the issue with China and, via the European Commission, with a joint EU response.
This subject has been discussed with the European Commission at various levels. Pressure has been applied for a joint response towards China.
Dit onderwerp is op verschillende niveaus besproken met de Europese Commissie. Er is aangedrongen op een gezamenlijke reactie richting China.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de handelsbetrekkingen met Suriname

MP Weverling (VVD) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about trade and investment ties with Suriname, including trade volumes, Dutch support for business climate and diaspora involvement. Minister Kaag answered that trade could get a new impulse, reported 2019 imports of 29 million euro and exports of 223 million euro, and largely deferred responsibility for Suriname's business climate and resource development to the Surinamese government.
It is up to the Surinamese government to decide whether and which foreign expertise and foreign companies it involves in developing the natural resources and the associated value chains.

Het is aan de Surinaamse overheid om te besluiten of en zo ja, welke buitenlandse deskundigheid en buitenlandse ondernemingen het bij de ontwikkeling van de natuurlijke hulpbronnen en de daarbij behorende waardeketens betrekt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Weverling, Van der Staaij en De Roon over het bericht dat twee terreurverdachten indirect salaris hebben ontvangen met behulp van Nederlandse financiële steun aan de Palestijns

Four MPs asked why the government kept funding the Palestinian NGO UAWC after learning that two suspected terror-linked employees received salary via Dutch-funded overhead, and whether this shows inadequate vetting and BDS-related risks. The minister admitted the earlier conclusion was wrong, suspended payments, commissioned an external investigation, but largely defended the vetting process, rejected reconsidering funding for BDS-adjacent organisations, and answered each question.
Because careful action on this point is extremely important, I have decided to commission an external investigation into possible links between PFLP and UAWC.
Omdat zorgvuldig handelen op dit punt uiterst belangrijk is heb ik besloten om een extern onderzoek te laten verrichten naar eventuele banden tussen PFLP en UAWC
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over regelgeving en handhaving van garnalenvisserij in Natura 2000-gebieden

MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the minister how the fishing-hour limits for shrimp trawlers in Natura 2000 areas were set, why the permit figures differ from NVWA figures, and how monitoring and enforcement work. The minister explained that the permits were based on 2015 data, were partly corrected after objections, that WMR now monitors fishing hours while enforcement stays with the ministry, and that a new black-box monitoring system is being certified.
From the end of 2019 this monitoring was taken over by WMR.
Vanaf eind 2019 is deze monitoring overgenomen door WMR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Dierenasiels verzwijgen verleden van gevaarlijke vechthonden'

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether dog shelters conceal the past bite incidents of fighting dogs they rehome, how many such incidents occurred, and whether shelters should disclose a dog's history. The minister says rehoming of bite-history dogs via RVO is excluded, aggregate data is unavailable, shelters bear responsibility for disclosure, and a multidisciplinary study and a bill are pending.
It is not known how many dogs involved in a bite incident had previously been in an animal shelter.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel honden die betrokken zijn geweest bij een bijtincident daarvoor in een dierenasiel zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Kabinet gebruikt drukmiddelen niet om asielzoekers terug te sturen’

MP Weverling asked the minister whether the Netherlands uses leverage to secure return cooperation with countries of origin, and asked for effectiveness assessments and trade and aid overviews for fourteen countries. The government replied that Dutch return performance is relatively good, that it assesses each country individually, and referred to a letter to parliament of 10 July 2020 for details.
For each country the cabinet considers what the most effective approach is and weighs its options.
Per land bekijkt het kabinet wat de meest effectieve aanpak is en maakt het een afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aartsen over de berichten ‘VS van plan uit WTO-onderdeel te stappen‘ en ‘Chinese bussen kunnen bij aanbesteding niet worden geweerd‘

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Dutch and provincial authorities can exclude bidders from non-GPA countries such as China from public tenders, and about reports the US may leave the WTO procurement agreement. The government replied that exclusion of non-GPA bidders is legally possible under EU and WTO rules, that the Noord-Holland and Overijssel bus cases involved private purchases rather than tenders, and that it is pursuing an International Procurement Instrument while supporting the GPA.
It is possible for Dutch and other European contracting authorities to reject bids from third countries that are not party to the WTO Government Procurement Agreement.
Het is voor Nederlandse en andere Europese aanbestedende diensten mogelijk om inschrijvingen te weigeren uit derde landen die geen partij zijn bij de Overeenkomst inzake overheidsopdrachten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Aukje de Vries en Moorlag over het bericht over watercrassula op Terschelling en de bestrijding van invasieve exoten

MPs Weverling, Aukje de Vries and Moorlag asked the minister about the spread of water crassula on Terschelling, its financial and legal responsibilities, control methods, and coordination among authorities. The minister confirmed the threat to protected dune habitat, described provincial spending of about 4.3 million euros, noted the difficulty of control, and rejected a central knowledge platform while promising an evaluation and a meeting on this case.
For this specific problem I will organise a consultation.
Ik zal voor deze specifieke problematiek een overleg organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Becker en Koopmans over de Europese Afrikastrategie

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the new EU-Africa strategy, its migration section, conditionality linking migration cooperation to returns, the EIB president's remarks on open procurement, Chinese contractors in African infrastructure, and untied aid. The minister's answers largely defend the Commission's approach as balanced and consistent with Dutch policy, while declining to press for the specific linkages the MPs proposed and rejecting a shift away from untied aid.
The cabinet assesses the migration section of the Commission communication on the EU-Africa Strategy as balanced
Het kabinet beoordeelt de paragraaf over migratie in de Commissiemededeling over de EU-Afrika Strategie als gebalanceerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'PostNL verhoogt pakketprijs in kerstpiek'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about PostNL raising parcel prices in the Christmas peak, its link to the postage increase and the Sandd takeover, and whether cross-subsidisation between the universal postal service and parcels is prohibited and supervised. The State Secretary answered that the commercial parcel market is unregulated and the peak surcharge reflects extra costs, that the Sandd link is absent, that the Postal Act's maximum return on the universal service is respected, and that the ACM supervises cost allocation and an external study on strengthening cross-subsidy oversight is underway.
I have since commissioned an external study that also examines whether there is reason to strengthen the oversight of cross-subsidisation.
In dat verband heb ik inmiddels onderzoek extern uitbesteed waarin ook wordt gekeken of er aanleiding bestaat om het toezicht op kruissubsidiëring te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Koopmans over de gezondheidszorg in Afrikaanse landen om een uitbraak van het coronavirus het hoofd te bieden

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign trade/development and foreign affairs ministers about the capacity of African health systems to handle COVID-19, the economic and political risks, the scope for development budgets, and whether European aid should be coordinated. The ministers answered that health systems are weak and the crisis is severe, that Netherlands has allocated EUR 100 million largely via multilateral organisations, and that a Team Europe coordinated approach is pursued.
The cabinet does not yet have a complete picture of the funds available from other EU member states; the European Commission is working on an overview.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment nog geen compleet beeld van beschikbare middelen van andere EU-lidstaten; de Europese Commissie werkt aan een overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Chipsector onderuit na uitlekken Amerikaanse plannen‘

Two MPs asked whether the government would raise with the US a planned licensing requirement on exports to China of chip-making equipment containing US components, and how it fits international law and EU policy. The minister said the US De Minimis Rule already applies, that the government will await the formal US position before commenting, and that it aims to secure good international arrangements for the semiconductor value chain.
The cabinet does not want to anticipate unconfirmed reports and for now awaits the formal position of the US government and any changes to US legislation.
Het kabinet wil niet vooruitlopen op onbevestigde berichtgeving en wacht vooralsnog het formele standpunt van de Amerikaanse regering en eventuele wijzigingen in de Amerikaanse wetgeving af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de berichten ‘Royal Floraholland: sierteeltsector ongekend hard geraakt’ en ‘Coronavirus treft vooral logistiek en sierteelt hard

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether she was aware of reports that the flower sector was hit hard by the coronavirus, what steps were being taken on trade impact, credit guarantees, support for affected firms, and sector-specific measures. The minister answered that ongoing contact with sector representatives continues, that expanded guarantee schemes and tax payment deferrals are available to all firms including flower growers, and that she will ask the European Commission for market-support measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Provincie wil steenmarter breed bestrijden’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the Fryslân pilot on controlling stone martens, which coincided with more hatched lapwing and black-tailed godwit chicks, is successful, and whether the province's request to list the stone marten on the national exemption list will be granted. The minister finds the pilot promising but insists the province already has sufficient powers, declines the national listing, promises a broader national study and a discussion with Fryslân, and says no national damage data exists.
Control of damage and nuisance caused by the stone marten is a competence of the provinces.
Bestrijding van schade en overlast van de steenmarter is een bevoegdheid van de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Strop webshops: buitenlandse brief mag van PostNL alleen nog papier bevatten'

An MP asks the state secretary for Economic Affairs about PostNL's price increase for international letter-post parcels from 1 January 2020, linked to Universal Postal Union barcode rules, its effects on businesses, comparisons with other countries, China, compensation for stamps, notification and EU free movement. The answers explain the UPU barcode obligation, PostNL's commercial reasons, that Deutsche Post made similar changes, that no distinction is made between business and private users, and that EU free movement is unaffected.
It is up to each national postal operator how these new requirements are implemented.
Het is aan elke nationale postvervoerder op welke wijze deze nieuwe eisen worden doorgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Wiersma en Aartsen over de berichten ‘Alibaba zwemt in het geld na beursgang in Hongkong’ en ‘Tarieven voor pakjes uit China verhogen’

Three VVD MPs asked about Alibaba's Hong Kong listing and higher postal tariffs for China parcels, raising unfair competition, product safety and CE-marking enforcement. The state secretary replied that tariff harmonisation applies from 2020 with a phased self-declared rate system to 2021, that the EU should use its market power and possibly stricter oversight of platforms, and that the government is consulting the SER and the Commission on platform liability.
The cabinet believes the EU should better use its market power to enforce a level playing field in trade with third countries through new and existing instruments.
Het kabinet vindt dat de EU haar marktmacht beter moet inzetten om met nieuwe en bestaande instrumenten een gelijk speelveld in de handel met derde landen af te dwingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Weverling over de berichten 'Nederlandse bedrijven geraakt door VS-sancties tegen Nord Stream 2' en 'Allseas trekt zich terug uit Oostzee, Russen bouwen omstreden gaspijpleidin

MPs Koopmans and Weverling asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that US sanctions targeting Nord Stream 2 hit Dutch firms such as Allseas, and what the government would do to protect them. The minister said the cabinet considers the US sanctions undesirable, has raised this with US counterparts and will keep doing so, and is in close contact with the EU and business, but is not considering countermeasures such as a Special Purpose Vehicle.
The cabinet considers these sanctions undesirable, given the consequences for business in the Netherlands and other EU member states.
Het kabinet acht deze sancties onwenselijk, vanwege de gevolgen voor het bedrijfsleven in Nederland en andere EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Weverling over het bericht 'KPN loopt voor de troepen uit en bouwt ondanks politieke strijd alvast Huawei-zendmasten in de Randstad'

MPs Van den Berg and Weverling asked whether KPN is installing Huawei antennas in its 4G and 5G network despite the parliamentary motions on 5G integrity, and whether this counts as an irreversible step. The State Secretary confirmed KPN began modernising its radio network with Huawei equipment, said several Dutch and EU operators use Huawei gear, and stated the critical components list is confidential while a structural approach with providers is being set up.
The list of critical components is confidential.
De lijst met kritieke onderdelen is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Miljoenen aan EU-steun voor Marokko hebben weinig effect’

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that EU budget support to Morocco had little effect, and whether EU development spending should be halted, including Morocco's obstruction of EU visibility and the migration/return clauses in the NDICI and post-Cotonou negotiations. The Minister acknowledges the European Court of Auditors findings, says the Netherlands will push for implementation of recommendations and keep a constructive-critical stance, and points to ongoing negotiations on migration and return clauses.
The cabinet does not have a complete overview of all cases of fraud within EU budget support programmes.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een volledig overzicht van volledige malversaties binnen begrotingssteunprogramma's van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de Europese investeringstoets en Chinees investeringsgedrag op de EU-markt

MP Weverling asked the minister about the EU investment screening framework, whether the Commission has capacity to probe Chinese investments, and coordination against market-distorting Chinese investment. The minister replied that screening is limited to national security by design, that the EU regulation mainly provides information sharing, and that further steps will be considered at evaluation and in the level-playing-field work.
The regulation will be evaluated no later than three years after it becomes fully applicable.
De verordening wordt geëvalueerd uiterlijk drie jaar na het volledig van toepassing worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over hondenhandel

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether imported dogs from Eastern EU states are sick, illegally vaccinated or sold under fraudulent health certificates, and whether NVWA enforcement is adequate. The minister denies evidence of systematic non-compliance, reports 89 checks in 2018 without shortcomings, and promises a dog identification and registration reform plus 3 extra enforcement FTE in 2020.
At the NVWA, supervision and enforcement of companion animal welfare will be intensified in 2020 with 3 FTE, part of which will be deployed on dog trade.
Bij de NVWA vindt voor toezicht en handhaving op welzijn van gezelschapsdieren in 2020 een intensivering plaats met 3 fte, waarvan een deel ingezet wordt op hondenhandel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aartsen over de berichten ‘Hoe T-Mobile zichzelf in de voet schoot met omweg dataverkeer’ en ‘Klachten bij toezichthouder over traag internet bij T-Mobile‘

MPs Weverling and Aartsen asked the State Secretary about reports that T-Mobile routed Dutch data traffic via Germany, lowering response speed, and about net neutrality and the role of the ACM. The State Secretary answered that the rerouting was largely reversed, that the ACM is independent and may examine interconnection under net neutrality rules, and that no further investigation of other providers is planned.
The ACM is an independent regulator. For the sake of that independence, I do not consider it appropriate to comment on the desirability of any investigation.
De ACM is een onafhankelijk toezichthouder. Ten behoeve van die onafhankelijkheid acht ik het niet verstandig om mij uit te laten over de eventuele wenselijkheid van enig onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Onafhankelijk kennisplatform invasieve exoten in de maak'

An MP asked the minister whether she supports a single independent knowledge platform on invasive alien species, given the many scattered studies and pilots.
