The minister agreed invasive species are undesirable and that initiatives are valuable, but argued one broad platform is not necessarily optimal and that she will assess support requests on merit.
I consider it important that, in consultation with the various organisations, it is examined whether and how that cooperation can be further improved.
Ik vind het van belang dat er in overleg met de verschillende organisaties gekeken wordt of en hoe die samenwerking verder verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aartsen over het bericht dat een Chinees bedrijf een aanbesteding voor het aanleggen van een metrolijn in Stockholm heeft gewonnen

MPs Weverling and Aartsen asked whether Chinese state-owned firms bidding below cost on European public tenders, such as a Stockholm metro contract, distort competition and whether the government will act on reciprocity. The government answered that existing EU procurement rules allow abnormally low bids to be rejected, that it supports the EU International Procurement Instrument and a level playing field instrument, but gave only general commitments and referred to earlier letters.
The cabinet is currently pursuing a non-discriminatory instrument aimed at promoting a level playing field to address this problem.
Het kabinet zet momenteel in op een non-discriminatoir instrument gericht op het bevorderen van een gelijk speelveld om dit probleem wel te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Weverling over de artikelen ‘Asielzoekers uit veilige landen terroriseren Harderwijk’ en ‘Harderwijk is diefstallen door asielzoekers beu’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Weverling asked about press reports of crime by asylum seekers from safe countries in Harderwijk, their nationalities, unknown-destination departures, and returns. The State Secretary declined to address Harderwijk specifically, gave national figures showing nearly half of suspects were from Algeria and Morocco, and described efforts to improve returns, including conditional cooperation with origin countries.
Each year I inform the House about incidents through the incident overview in the Aliens Chain Report (RVK).
Jaarlijks informeer ik uw Kamer over incidenten door middel van het incidentenoverzicht in de Rapportage Vreemdelingenketen (RVK).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de situatie van vissers in Zeeland

An MP asked the minister about the situation of Zeeland fishers: delays in using an oyster-farming permit pending monitoring-plan approval, the eel fishing closure and its lack of compensation, oyster borer pests, and oxygen-depleted water in the Grevelingenmeer. The minister defended the permit timeline as constructive and expected approval in time for April 2020, rejected extending the permit or compensating lost months, outlined the oyster pest plan, the EU eel regulation rationale, and planned a sluice and dam measures to address stratification.
The consultation with the oyster sector on the monitoring plan is proceeding constructively.
Het overleg met de oestersector over het monitoringsplan verloopt constructief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Veldman en Weverling over de berichten ‘Iedereen wil internet, niemand wil datacenters’ en 'Hoe Nederland zichzelf economisch in de voet schiet'

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary how the temporary building freeze on new data centres in Amsterdam and Haarlemmermeer fits with national digitalisation and spatial strategies, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary acknowledges the freeze is driven by energy demand and land shortages, points to a national data centre table and regional alternatives, and says the government is willing to play a facilitating role.
Yes, I am willing to play a facilitating role in this.
Ja ik ben bereid een faciliterende rol hierin te spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Ziengs over het bericht 'Massale muizen- en rattenplaag op komst in Nederland'

MPs Weverling and Ziengs asked the ministers about reports of a looming mouse and rat plague, criticism from the KAD that government is complacent, the planned restriction of anticoagulant rodenticides from 2023, and whether adequate alternatives and ongoing research exist. The state secretary answers that integrated pest management and prevention are central, that a RIVM exploratory study is underway with its report expected end 2019, and that alternatives remain available, while the Ctgb is planning to limit anticoagulants to certified professionals.
The cabinet wants to reduce the number of barn fires in line with the reaction agreement.
Het kabinet wil conform het reageerakkoord het aantal stalbranden verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over dode dieren die gedumpt zijn in het buitengebied van Haaren

MPs Weverling and Laan-Geselschap asked the ministers about dead hares and a wild boar dumped in the Haaren countryside, possible use as prey in illegal dog betting, and rising illegal activity and enforcement gaps in rural areas. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police received no report, no examination has taken place so cause of death is unknown, dog-prey betting is not legal, and the rural enforcement action plan is still being implemented with a progress report promised for early 2020.
I have promised the House to report on the progress of the elaboration of the action plan in early 2020.
Ik heb de Kamer toegezegd begin 2020 te rapporteren over de voortgang van de uitwerking van het plan van aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Nieuwbouwhuis? Grote kans dat 5G je geen sneller internet oplevert'

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about RTL Z reporting that 5G may not improve indoor mobile connectivity in new-build homes, and about who should ensure indoor coverage. The State Secretary answered that absolute indoor coverage guarantees are not feasible, that the 5G coverage requirement applies outdoors only, and that residents can use Wi-Fi and Voice over Wi-Fi, while the ministry's facilitating role applies only to business settings.
Absolute guarantees for mobile network coverage cannot be given.
Absolute garanties voor mobiele netwerkdekking zijn niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over aanrijdingen met wild

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about wildlife road collisions, including under-reporting, registration gaps across provinces, and whether provinces can improve reporting. The minister replied that estimates suggest about 10,000 collisions a year, that registration is fragmented and decentralised to provinces, and that she will consult provinces on improving reporting and include collisions in the wildlife management evaluation.
I will consult with the provinces to examine how reporting of wildlife collisions can be improved.
Ik zal mij met de provincies verstaan om te bezien hoe de aanmeldingen met aangereden wild kunnen worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van Haga over het aanstaande Buitengewone Congres van de Wereldpostunie

MPs Weverling and Van Haga asked the state secretary about the extraordinary UPU congress, US threats to withdraw over postal terminal dues, Dutch and EU positions, and consequences of a US exit. The government confirmed attendance, said the Netherlands supports reform of the terminal dues system with gradual change, and answered most questions substantively while declining to endorse US proposals and disputing the Economic Report's characterization of Dutch positions.
I refer you for the answer to my extensive response of 20 September on questions 11 and 12 of the questions on the same subject of 27 June.
Ik verwijs u voor het antwoord naar mijn uitgebreide reactie van 20 september jl. op de vragen 11 en 12 van de vragen over hetzelfde onderwerp van 27 juni jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Stichting AAP vindt 53 exoten in Nederlandse huisdierenhandel’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a report by Stichting AAP finding 53 exotic mammal species offered in the Dutch pet trade, including whether the government tracks offer trends, how it enforces online sales, and what it does against illegal import of protected species. The minister said no data on offer is collected, pointed to agreements with Bol.com and Marktplaats and risk-based NVWA enforcement, described CITES and EU enforcement cooperation, and promised a draft positive list for consultation by year end.
No information is collected on the supply of animals, so this information is not known.
Er wordt geen informatie verzameld over het aanbod van dieren, dus deze informatie is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Bosman en van Gent over het bericht ‘Afschieten honderden damherten op Haringvreter had voorkomen kunnen worden’

MPs from the VVD asked the minister whether an overpopulation of fallow deer on the Haringvreter, which has reduced breeding birds and orchids, could have been prevented by earlier culling permits and why population recovery needs several winters. The minister confirmed the permit history and damage, said several winters of culling are needed, and committed to including such cases in the review of wildlife management.
Yes, it is my intention to include practical situations such as those on the Haringvreter in the evaluation of wildlife management, as requested in the Von Martels motion.
Antwoord 9 Ja, het is mijn voornemen bij de evaluatie van het faunabeheer, zoals gevraagd in de motie-Von Martels 2 , praktijksituaties als die op de Haringvreter, mede te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van Haga over de verkoop en distributie van pakketjes door Alibaba in Nederland

VVD MPs Weverling and Van Haga asked the government about Alibaba/AliExpress parcel distribution, unfair competition from China, Universal Postal Union tariffs and US proposals. The State Secretary answered at length, largely defending the 2016 tariff reform and EU/WTO tools, while withholding PostNL commercial figures as confidential.
Information about commercial agreements between parties is confidential, and making it public would harm PostNL's international competitive position.
Informatie over commerciële afspraken tussen partijen zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en het publiek maken daarvan zou de internationale concurrentiepositie van PostNL schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Laan-Geselschap en Worfsdorfer over het bericht ‘Deze nieuwe en gevaarlijke cyberaanval wordt gewoon met de post bezorgd’

Four VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about 'warshipping', a reported cyberattack using parcels to plant devices that breach local wifi networks, and how it could be detected, handled and countered. The government answered that it knows the technique but has no known cases in the Netherlands or abroad, that organisations can screen parcels, and that the NCTV and NCSC are aware of the risk and would advise if needed.
I am not aware of any cases in which warshipping has been detected in the Netherlands.
Er zijn mij geen gevallen bekend waarin «warshipping» is geconstateerd in Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “onverwoestbaar stofje gaat bouwprojecten lamleggen” en over de gevolgen van de industriële stof PFOS voor de bouwwereld

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary whether new PFAS rules for soil and dredged material would further delay road and housing projects, and how the government would address the concerns of municipalities and industry. The state secretary replied that the temporary framework adds clarity rather than new obligations, that the duty of care applies where PFAS is found, that she is consulting with regional authorities and will inform the House in early 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Ondernemers dupe van kwijtgeraakte pakketjes’

VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about entrepreneurs bearing costs of lost parcels and about data on lost-parcel volumes and complaints. The State Secretary answered that the government leaves the parcel market to competing carriers, does not hold the requested data, and that carriers are not legally required to record complaints.
I am addressing these questions together because the government does not have this information.
Ik behandel deze vragen tezamen omdat de overheid niet over deze informatie beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Weverling over de ‘bewapening van boswachters’

MPs Weverling and Laan-Geselschap asked why green BOA rangers at Recreatie Noord-Holland lost their baton and pepper spray, and whether the procedure is clear enough. Minister Grapperhaus explained that the extension was granted with handcuffs only after negative advice from police and prosecutors, that the weapons decision still needs careful review, and that the procedures are clear enough, with the issue to be raised with the BOA unions.
Because the procedure regarding a possible award of these weapons is still ongoing, I refrain from further explanation of this case.
Omdat de procedure ten aanzien van een eventuele toekenning van deze geweldsmiddelen nog loopt, onthoud ik mij van een nadere toelichting op deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘De mobiele lokdoos werkt niet met 5G’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that IMSI-catchers (mobile 'lokdoos' interception devices) do not work with 5G, and about Europol's concerns over identifying and locating suspects on 5G networks. The government answered that a working group is adapting investigative procedures and rules for 5G, that it is in contact with telecom providers and foreign counterparts, and that private possession of IMSI-catchers remains prohibited.

At present, the interdepartmental working group '5G and investigation', chaired by the police and including the Public Prosecution Service, Agentschap Telecom and the Ministries of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Justice and Security, is working out which changes in procedure are needed to enable identification and localisation of persons on the 5G network.

Op dit moment wordt in de ambtelijke werkgroep «5G en opsporing» onder voorzitterschap van de politie met daarin het Openbaar Ministerie, Agentschap Telecom en de Ministeries van Economische Zaken en Klimaat en van Justitie en Veiligheid uitgewerkt welke aanpassingen in werkwijze noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de berichten ‘Deurne krijgt echt twee keer glasvezel’, ‘Aanleg glasvezel vertraagd’ en ‘E-Fiber en KPN samen in één sleuf’

An MP asks the State Secretary about reports on fibre roll-out delays and dual fibre networks in rural Brabant, and whether the government backs the goal of broadband for all. The State Secretary says the market leads, the government sets conditions, the ambition of 100 Mbps by 2023 stands, and the ACM market study is expected after the summer.
I will therefore send the outcomes to your House.
Ik zal de uitkomsten dan ook aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Lodders en Rutte Arno over het bericht ‘Bijkleuren van tonijn brengt risico voor de volksgezondheid met zich mee’ en de uitzending van het televisieprogramma Kassa

Two VVD MPs asked whether coloring of yellowfin tuna is banned, how it can be detected, and whether histamine risks are being controlled. The Minister of Medical Care confirmed that tuna coloring is prohibited under EU additive and food safety law, described NVWA inspections and sampling plans, and reported low histamine incident numbers.
The NVWA carries out checks on compliance with additives legislation through inspections.
De NVWA voert controles uit op de naleving van de additievenwetgeving door middel van inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘De weerman wordt gestoord door 5G’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that 5G rollout in the 26 GHz band could disrupt weather and climate measurements, including whether meteorological bodies had raised concerns and whether the rollout risks degrading forecast quality. The State Secretary answered that European protections are adequate, that technical limits do not hinder 5G rollout, and that the Netherlands will push for equivalent protections at the ITU World Radiocommunication Conference, while acknowledging that international negotiations are expected to be intensive.
For weather measurements in Europe, I therefore currently have no concerns.
Voor de weermetingen in Europa heb ik dan ook op dit moment geen zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht dat de Aziatische hoornaar plotseling overal in Nederland opduikt

An MP asked the agriculture minister about reports of the Asian hornet appearing across the Netherlands, its dangers, sightings, nest eradication responsibilities, and planned action. The minister answered that the hornet poses little danger to humans but harms insect pollinators, that only one verified sighting occurred this year with many false reports of the European hornet, and that eradication is likely not feasible so provinces will decide on management measures in autumn.
I have asked the NVWA and the provinces to continue combating the Asian hornet this summer.
Ik heb de NVWA en provincies gevraagd deze zomer de bestrijding van de Aziatische hoornaar voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Huawei kan bij vertrouwelijke klantdata KPN’

An MP asked whether the interdepartmental Taskforce assessing risks from Huawei access to KPN customer data covers software supply and IT development by tech vendors, and whether government reviews telecom suppliers' access arrangements and security policy. The government answered yes on scope, pointed to the Telecommunications Act duty and Agentschap Telecom oversight, and said the Taskforce has delivered its findings with the cabinet still deliberating and the Chamber to be informed.
The Taskforce has now delivered its findings. The cabinet is currently deliberating on these findings. The Chamber will be informed about this.
De Taskforce heeft inmiddels haar uitkomsten opgeleverd. Op dit moment beraadt het kabinet zich op deze uitkomsten. De Kamer wordt hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Steenmarters teisteren auto’s bij Tjongerschans’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about stone marten damage to cars and other harms, and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that no national damage data exist, that particulars are responsible for prevention, that provinces can act, and that the species will not be placed on the national hunting exemption list for now.
As a result, there is no national overview of the damage and nuisance caused by stone martens.
Daardoor is er geen landelijk overzicht van de schade en de overlast die steenmarters veroorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van Haga over de verkoop en distributie van pakketjes door Alibaba in Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister for Foreign Trade about cheap Alibaba parcels shipped to the Netherlands, counterfeit goods, postal delivery fee rules under the Universal Postal Union, and the risk of unfair competition from China. The government answered at length, stating that many details are commercially confidential, that the postal fee system is being phased toward parity, that the US threat to leave the UPU is being addressed multilaterally, and that China trade issues will be pursued via the WTO and the new China strategy.
This concerns commercially sensitive and confidential business information.
Dit betreft commercieel gevoelige en bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht in de Telegraaf “kleine visser zit klem”

MPs asked the government about reports that small fishers are squeezed by offshore wind farms, including access rules, fines for approaching turbines, and the progress of a Noordzee future perspective. The minister answered that the ministries share responsibility, that no record was kept of a meeting with fishers, that wind farms were opened to vessels up to 24 metres from May 2018 under conditions, and that a Noordzee agreement process and a fishing-sector perspective are underway, with evaluation in 2020.
No report was made of the meeting referred to.
Van het gesprek waarnaar wordt verwezen is geen verslag gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Onze veiligheid in eigen hand houden’

MPs Weverling and Laan-Geselschap asked the government about a proposed national secure communications network (NVC) and whether it is needed for critical infrastructure, emergency services and C2000 back-up, and about security audits of C2000 technology. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government does not see the need for an NVC, that vital providers bear primary responsibility, and that a study into a C2000 solution independent of states with offensive cyber programmes will be reported after the summer.
In this letter I committed to carry out an exploration of a solution that does not depend on countries that have been established to run offensive cyber programmes against Dutch interests.

In deze brief heb ik toegezegd een verkenning uit te voeren naar een oplossing die niet afhankelijk is van landen waarvan is vastgesteld dat ze een offensief cyberprogramma voeren tegen Nederlandse belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de Daglichtkas

MPs Weverling and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked why the award-winning Daglichtkas solar-thermal greenhouse technology was excluded from SDE+ support, what consultation with the horticulture sector preceded this, and what the consequences are for innovation and the energy transition. The minister explains that the technology was removed from the solar-thermal category since 2018 because of overstimulation risk, that the sector was consulted on the definition, and that the effects are limited but he will consider it when designing SDE++ 2020.
In my preparations for designing SDE++ 2020, I will take the application of solar thermal in greenhouses as a specific point of attention.
In mijn voorbereidingen voor de vormgeving van de SDE++ 2020 zal ik de toepassing van zonthermie in kassen als specifiek aandachtspunt meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Biodiversiteit is groter dan gedacht’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a claim that biodiversity is greater than thought and about PBL's methods, including its use of 1700 as a baseline, its exclusion of wet nature, and its treatment of farmers' conservation efforts. The minister rejected several premises (PBL does not treat 1700 as a qualitative baseline) and referred to PBL's independence, while acknowledging some points and offering no concrete new action.

The substantive independence of the PBL is guaranteed in the Guidelines for the Planning Bureaus, which state that ministers must refrain from giving instructions on research methods and the content of the agency's reports.
De inhoudelijke onafhankelijkheid van het PBL is gewaarborgd in de Aanwijzingen voor de Planbureaus
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Weyenberg over de advertentie in Arts en Auto: ‘Schenking eigen woning’

MPs Lodders and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary of Finance about a newspaper advertisement promoting 'cross gifts' that let parents give a second tax-free gift to their children via reciprocal arrangements, and whether this is legitimate and how it is enforced. The State Secretary answered that such cross gifts are unwanted and contrary to the letter and spirit of the Successiewet, that the Tax Authority will treat them as gifts from the parent and enforce against misuse, and that no amendment is planned.

I consider the use of cross gifts to obtain the increased gift tax exemption for the owner-occupied home a second time undesirable, and applying the exemption in such a case contrary to the letter and spirit of the Successiewet 1956.

Ik acht het gebruik van kruislingse schenkingen ten einde de verhoogde vrijstelling schenkbelasting voor de eigen woning voor een tweede maal te verkrijgen ongewenst en de toepassing van de vrijstelling in een dergelijk geval in strijd met de letter en geest van de Successiewet 1956.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Pulsmissie van Veerman strandt in Frankrijk'

An MP asks the minister about the stalled mission of the special envoy for Dutch pulse fishers, who was unable to get France to appoint a counterpart, and what steps follow. The minister says the envoy tried to engage France without success, that the reasons are unknown, and refers to a separate letter for next steps and the trilogue outcome.
From the French side, despite repeated urging, no counterpart was ever appointed.
Vanuit Franse kant is ondanks herhaaldelijk aandringen nooit een counterpart aangewezen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over een werkbezoek aan de vissers Lauwersoog d.d. 6 januari 2019 en diverse berichten in de media over de overboord geslagen zeecontainers van

MPs from the VVD asked about the MSC Zoe container loss off the Wadden islands, its risks for fisheries and shipping, liability, recovery timelines, and container securing rules. The minister answered that the shipowner is held liable and must recover containers within a two-month expected timeframe, that investigations by the OM and OvV are underway, and that securing rules were tightened in 2016, but gave no exact compliance percentage.
At present no exact percentage is known of ships where cargo has been properly secured.
Op dit moment is geen exact percentage bekend van schepen waar op de juiste wijze lading vastgezet is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Weverling en Von Martels over het bericht dat patenten toch mogelijk zijn op veredelde groenten en planten

MPs De Groot, Weverling and Von Martels asked whether the European Patent Office appeals board allowing patents on natural plant traits and classically bred plants undermines Dutch law, and what the government will do. The minister says the written ruling is not yet available, that the government opposes such patents and will push for a lasting EU-level solution, but has not yet decided whether treaty amendment is the right route.
I am in favour of a swift and lasting solution to this matter.
Ik ben voor een snelle en duurzame oplossing van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Weverling over de voorbereiding op de brexit door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

MPs Lodders and Weverling asked the minister about the NVWA's Brexit preparations, including external reviews, inspection locations, staffing, IT readiness and coordination with other inspection bodies. The minister answered that preparations are on schedule, with a worst-case plan requiring 143 FTE, ongoing recruitment and training, and some locations and IT readiness still being addressed.
The NVWA saw no reason to commission such an external study.
De NVWA zag geen aanleiding om een dergelijk extern onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Weverling over het bericht ‘112 onbereikbaar door accudieven’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that battery theft from telecom masts threatens 112 availability, and whether it is being tackled. The minister answered that emergency calls are largely protected by roaming and call priority, that police registered 136 theft reports in 2018 with few arrests, that no data exists on outages caused by theft, and that police prioritise theft by seriousness and indicators, with regional consultations possible.
Theft of emergency power batteries therefore does not directly lead to reduced availability.
Diefstal van noodstroomaccu’s leidt dan ook niet direct tot een verminderde bereikbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Het rode gevaar komt uit het westen’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that the American crayfish harms Dutch waters, including its effects on biodiversity, extra dredging, EU water quality targets, and whether the Fisheries Act blocks effective control. The minister answered that species-specific risks are known, that fishing exemptions and water board contacts exist, that further research is with regional partners, and that recreational use of professional gear is not desirable.
It is up to the regional parties to determine whether further research is worthwhile.
Het is aan de regionale partijen om te bepalen of verder onderzoek zinvol is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Weverling over het bericht ‘Ecologen: zonneparken zijn funest voor de natuur’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether they share experts' concern that large solar parks harm nature and soil life, and about rooftop priority, land competition, the number of solar parks under construction, the government's role, and innovative placement such as noise barriers. The ministers answered that ecological effects depend on site and design, that spatial planning is primarily a responsibility of municipalities and provinces, that rooftops should be prioritised per the draft NOVI, and that they will inform parliament in early 2019 on a national assessment framework.
I will inform you early in 2019 about the implementation of this motion and also involve it in drafting the draft NOVI.
Ik zal u begin 2019 informeren over de uitvoering van deze motie en deze ook betrekken bij het opstellen van de ontwerpNOVI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Von Martels en Moorlag over “designer dogs and cats”

MPs Weverling, Von Martels and Moorlag asked the minister about breeding of 'designer dogs and cats' with hereditary health problems, citing a petition, a European conference, and the adequacy of existing rules and enforcement. The minister agreed such breeding is unacceptable, pointed to Article 3.4 of the Besluit houders van dieren and ten NVWA inspections (four with enforcement), announced a review of enforcement due by year end, and said the issue is being raised in an EU subworking group.
I have commissioned research to make this more enforceable.
Ik heb onderzoek uitgezet om dit beter handhaafbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Weverling over de uitzending ‘De bijenredders’

MPs Lodders and Weverling asked the minister about a Brandpunt+ broadcast on varroa mite control and a project to introduce varroa-resistant bees, and whether the National Bee Strategy and Bee Health Action Programme address it. The minister answered that the varroa mite is an important cause of winter bee mortality, welcomed the Arista Bee Research initiative, said it has joined the National Bee Strategy, and described existing knowledge-development and monitoring measures.
I will continue the policy aimed at reducing bee mortality among honeybees, developing more resilient (varroa-resistant) honeybees and optimising beekeeping practice.

Ik zal het beleid gericht op het verminderen van bijensterfte onder honingbijen, het ontwikkelen van meer weerbare (varroa-resistente) honingbijen en het optimaliseren van de imkerpraktijk voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Vis kan eindelijk door Haringvlietdam, maar daarachter wachten netten en fuiken’

MPs Weverling and Remco Dijkstra asked about the opening of the Haringvliet dam sluices (Kierbesluit), concerns over saltwater intrusion into freshwater supplies during drought, monitoring, and evaluation. The ministers answered that freshwater intakes were relocated, saltwater intrusion is avoided in low-Rhine-flow periods, monitoring and telemetry will follow the effects, and no evaluation conclusions can yet be drawn.
Work is done on a risk-controlled basis, starting with smaller openings and situations with relatively high Rhine discharge.
Er wordt risico-gestuurd gewerkt, waarbij gestart wordt met kleinere openingen en situaties met relatief veel Rijnafvoer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over de berichten ‘EU blijft streng op nieuwe veredelingstechnieken’ en ‘Europees Hof remt kwekers vanwege genetische modificatie’

MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the minister how the EU Court ruling on new plant breeding techniques such as CRISPR-Cas9 (subject to GMO rules) affects policy, import controls, and the coalition goal of promoting these techniques in Europe. The minister answered that the ruling keeps such products under GMO authorisation, that detection is difficult, and that the government will address the policy consequences in a separate letter to parliament.
We will shortly inform the House by letter about the Dutch position on applying new plant breeding techniques and the policy consequences of the European Court of Justice ruling.

Wij zullen uw Kamer spoedig per brief informeren over de Nederlandse inzet voor de toepassing van nieuwe plantenveredelingstechnieken en de beleidsconsequenties van de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Kostenbesparende operatie 'brievenbus weghalen' is in volle gang’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about PostNL's plan to remove nearly half of Dutch letter boxes, its legal basis, consultation with the ACM and vulnerable groups, and whether removals should be reversed. The State Secretary answered that the 2016 loosened spreading rules allow about 8,700 boxes, that the legal consultation process with consumer organisations is in place, that the ACM sees no current breaches, and that the government will keep the minimum number without reversing removals.
I have understood from the ACM that there are currently no indications that PostNL is not complying with the rules on the availability of letter boxes.
Ik heb van de ACM begrepen dat er op dit moment geen indicaties zijn dat PostNL zich niet houdt aan de regels ten aanzien van de beschikbaarheid van brievenbussen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over de berichten ‘Twaalf schapen afgeslacht in Overijssels weiland: was het een wolf?’, ‘Dit wil je niet nog een keer meemaken’ en ‘Wolf maakt mogelijk slachtoffers b

VVD MPs asked the minister about wolf attacks on sheep, whether farmers can be better protected, compensation and whether lethal control should be possible. The minister answered that wolves are a protected species, that livestock protection is the owners' responsibility, that provinces handle damage compensation and that the operational wolf plan is being revised, with a commitment to consult stakeholders.
It seems desirable to me that foreign examples, such as those in Germany, are taken into account in this revision.
Het lijkt mij wenselijk dat buitenlandse voorbeelden, zoals die in Duitsland, bij deze aanpassing worden meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Weverling over het bericht ‘Multibandveiling zou ook 2021 kunnen worden’

MPs Paternotte and Weverling asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the multiband spectrum auction might slip to 2021, and about the timing dependence on the European Commission's decision on the T-Mobile/Tele2 merger. The State Secretary answered that the auction still aims for late 2019 but may slip a few months, depending mainly on the Commission's merger decision and the ACM advice, and declined to speculate on scenarios.
In this matter I must be cautious and restrained toward the European Commission, given its independent position as regulator.
Ik dien me in deze zaak overigens behoedzaam en terughoudend op te stellen richting de Europese Commissie gegeven diens onafhankelijke positie als toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'West-Brabantse aardbeientelers luiden noodklok over 'oneerlijke' Belgische concurrentie'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about claims by Dutch strawberry growers that Belgian competitors receive more EU subsidies, and whether the Dutch government had engaged with them. The Minister denied that Belgian growers simply get more subsidy, explained that national strategies differ by member state, said the Dutch focus shifted away from operating-cost subsidies, and pledged to keep working for a level playing field.
No. Under the European regulation, each member state must adopt a national strategy for sustainable operational programmes in the fruit and vegetable sector.
Nee. Op grond van de Europese verordening dient elke lidstaat een nationale strategie voor duurzame operationele programma's in de sector groenten en fruit vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Arno Rutte, Middendorp en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Agentschap Telecom slaat alarm over hackbare apparaten’

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government shares the Agentschap Telecom's call to hurry a security mark for 'smart' connected devices, how it is progressing, and related questions on consumer visibility, ISP involvement, company-led certification and innovation. The government answers that it supports a European CE-type mark with mandatory minimum digital security requirements under the Radio Equipment Directive, that it has proposed this in Europe, and that it is working with ISPs and on EU cybersecurity certification.

Together with the European Commission, the cabinet is examining how to give effect to the aforementioned possibility of extending the current CE mark of the RED with minimum digital security requirements for wireless devices.

Met de Europese Commissie onderzoekt het kabinet hoe invulling te gegeven aan voornoemde mogelijkheid om het huidige CE-keurmerk van de RED uit te breiden met minimale eisen aan de digitale veiligheid van draadloze apparaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Zorgen Staatsbosbeheer om veiligheid boswachters’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about reported safety concerns for forest rangers (boswachters) and green enforcement officers, including incident numbers, whether rangers should receive handcuffs, batons and pepper spray, C2000 radio access, and a joint action plan with the police. The minister answered that no total incident figures exist because of a changed registration system, reported about 70 incidents at Staatsbosbeheer in 2017, said the equipment request is under advisory review, and promised an action plan to be shared around the budget debate.
No figures are available on the total number of incidents involving forest rangers and enforcement officers.
Over het totaal aantal incidenten van boswachters en boa’s zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Dierenarts waarschuwt: dodelijke hondenziekte bij Duitse grens geconstateerd’

An MP asked the minister about reports of canine distemper near the German border, its prevalence, vaccination rates, fake vaccination passports on imported dogs, and fox transmission. The minister answered that there is no notification duty or registration system, that vaccination protects well, and that EU discussions on animal transport continue, without committing to new measures.
For canine distemper, also called Carré's disease, there is no notification obligation.
Voor hondenziekte, ook wel ziekte van Carré genoemd, is geen meldplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over het bericht ‘NVWA bevestigt besmetting bruinrot in snijroos’

VVD MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture about Ralstonia (brown rot) infections in cut roses, compensation for affected growers, a 2018 College van Beroep ruling denying compensation under the Plantenziektenwet, use of EU regulation 702/2014, and the unknown source of the outbreak. The minister said no compensation negotiations have taken place, the Netherlands chose not to pay compensation under EU rules judging the losses a normal business risk, and the source remains unidentified despite NVWA investigation.

I want to support the sector by jointly examining, together with the sector, what room exists within cabinet policy and European and national laws and regulations to achieve risk coverage by the sector itself.

Ik wil de sector ondersteunen door samen met de sector te onderzoeken welke ruimte er binnen het kabinetsbeleid en Europese en nationale wet- en regelgeving gevonden kan worden om tot realisatie van een risicoafdekking door de sector zelf te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Weverling over het bericht 'Gegevens huisdieren en hun baasjes op straat'

MPs Koopmans and Weverling asked whether pet owners' data from pet chip databases was exposed online, whether breaches were reported to the Data Protection Authority, and how the ministry prepared affiliated bodies for GDPR. The minister replied that no sensitive data reportedly leaked, databases blocked bulk queries, one database filed a breach report, and a DPIA and processing agreements were in place.
Following the NOS finding, the databases took measures so that querying multiple chip numbers from a single IP address is now impossible.
Naar aanleiding van de constatering door de Nederlandse Omroep Stichting (NOS) hebben databanken maatregelen genomen, waardoor opvraag van meerdere chipnummers vanaf één IP adres nu onmogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Wörsdörfer en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Kabinet zet koppositie ICT op het spel, waarschuwt Eelco Blok’

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether they agreed with Eelco Blok's claim that the cabinet lacks a long-term ICT vision and risks Dutch digital leadership, and asked about spectrum auction timing and the national digitalisation strategy. The government disputed the claim, pointed to Dutch strengths and the coming Digitaliseringsstrategie, and confirmed that auction dates and the 3.5 GHz options would be sent to parliament before the relevant recesses.
To be able to lead in the coming years, the coalition agreement contains the necessary ambitions and actions regarding digitalisation.
Om de komende jaren voorop te kunnen lopen, bevat het regeerakkoord de nodige ambities en acties bevat als het gaat om digitalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over de aanvraag voor de status van referentielaboratorium voor Nederlandse instellingen

MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the Netherlands applying to host an EU reference laboratory for plant pest and disease identification, and what would happen if no Dutch institution were designated. The minister replied that the NVWA's NRC-fytosanitair is suitable, that hosting a reference laboratory would strengthen Dutch influence, that funding options are being examined, and that she intends to build support at EU level.
At present I am examining, in good faith, the possibilities for responding to this.
Op dit moment onderzoek ik welwillend de mogelijkheden om hierop te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Verbod op spieringvisserij in IJsselmeer’

MP Weverling asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why fishers have been barred from catching smelt in the IJsselmeer, on what legal basis, whether a 2013 report was acted upon, and about stock levels, affected fishers, buy-out compensation and timing of alternatives. The minister answers that the ban dates from 2009, cites the legal grounds, confirms the 2013 advice was shared with fishers, reports declining smelt stocks and Natura 2000 targets not being met, and says a new assessment framework will follow this year.
Furthermore, WMR advises, from the precautionary principle, not to permit fishing on spawning smelt any longer.
Daarnaast adviseert WMR om vanuit het «voorzorgsbeginsel» de visserij op de paaiende spiering niet meer toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over diverse berichten over dierenleed in de Oostvaardersplassen

An MP asked the minister about reports of animal suffering in the Oostvaardersplassen and whether the 2016 agreement with Flevoland adequately implements a parliamentary motion. The minister declined to judge the reports, said Flevoland's provincial executive is responsible for animal welfare policy, rejected an evaluation or new agreement for now, and pointed to an independent review by the Commissie-Van Geel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Belhaj en Weverling over de berichten 'Spionnenjacht blokt 5G' en 'Arena geen proeftuin voor nieuwste generatie mobiel internet'

MPs Paternotte, Belhaj and Weverling asked about press reports that intelligence services are blocking 5G rollout in the 3.5 GHz band and that the Amsterdam Arena cannot serve as a 5G testbed. The State Secretary says the rollout is important, that talks with intelligence services and neighbouring countries are ongoing, and that a solution and options will be sent to parliament around mid-2018.

Both the ministers of Defence and of the Interior and the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and Climate are working to find, on the basis of technical research, solution options for making the 3.5 GHz band available.

Zowel de ministers van Defensie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijkrelaties als de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en Klimaat zetten zich in om op basis van technisch onderzoek tot oplossingsmogelijkheden te komen voor de beschikbaarstelling van de 3,5 GHz-band.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Veldman en Weverling over het bericht ‘Maakbedrijven trekken naar India wegens groeiend gebrek aan Nederlandse ingenieurs’

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Education about a newspaper report that manufacturing firms are moving to India due to a shortage of Dutch engineers, including expected shortages, number of firms leaving, and how other countries respond. The state secretary and minister answered that a shortage of technical talent is a growing constraint, that no integrated data exist on firms leaving or on the number of jobs lost, and that the government's Techniekpact is a model cited by other countries.
Statistics Netherlands does not keep data on the number of firms leaving the Netherlands.
Er worden (door het CBS) geen gegevens bijgehouden over aantallen bedrijven die uit Nederland vertrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Paternotte over het bericht ‘PostNL nog steeds bezig met bezorgen kerstpost’

MPs Weverling and Paternotte asked the State Secretary about reports that PostNL was still delivering Christmas mail in January 2018, including delivery standards, oversight of peak periods, causes of the delays, and whether additional requirements would be set. The State Secretary answered that the existing delivery norms and ACM oversight are adequate, attributed the delays to weather, staffing shortages and a new sorting code rule, declined to impose extra requirements for now, and said ACM is investigating.
Imposing additional requirements now therefore seems premature to me.
Het nu stellen van aanvullende eisen vind ik daarom prematuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Weverling over reorganisatie en bezuinigingen bij DowDuPont

MPs Dijkstra and Weverling asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the reported 500 job cuts at DuPont, the Dutch employment and investment picture of DowDuPont, and how to keep the Netherlands attractive for such firms. The minister confirmed the 500 figure applies only to DuPont, gave location-by-location employment and investment figures, and framed the chemical sector's role in decarbonisation.
Possible investments or divestments in the Netherlands resulting from these plans are not yet known.
Mogelijke investeringen of desinvesteringen in Nederland als gevolg van deze plannen zijn nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Ouderen dupe van opdoeken brievenbussen'

MPs Weverling and Van den Berg asked about reports that letterboxes were removed in Leidschendam-Voorburg, harming elderly residents, and how accessibility rules protect vulnerable users. The State Secretary answered that complaints are few, that PostNL's consultation process with advocacy groups and local representatives governs changes, that legal rules require considering vulnerable groups, and that PostNL already agreed not to remove letterboxes at care institutions.
Before a planned change in the number of letterboxes, this is announced in writing and meetings are organised for interest groups about the relocation plans.

Voorafgaand aan een voorgenomen wijziging van het aantal brievenbussen wordt dit schriftelijk aangekondigd en worden bijeenkomsten georganiseerd voor belangenorganisaties over de herplaatsingsplannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Remco Dijkstra en Weverling over het bericht ‘Tuinbouw in de knel door raffinaderijbrand Pernis’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the greenhouse sector's CO2 supply disruption after the Pernis refinery fire needs an emergency fix and talks with industry to prevent recurrence. The minister replied that CO2 supply is a private arrangement with no government role, but that EZ is exploring additional CO2 sources and buffering within existing green deal and smart grid frameworks, with timing unpredictable and supply restored from 21 August.
This is a collaboration between private parties, in which the government plays no role.
Dit is een samenwerking tussen private partijen, waarbij de overheid geen rol speelt.

m: Motie van de leden Kwint en De Neef over de bescherming van hulpverleners tegen intimidatie en bedreigingen
Asks the government, together with healthcare workers, to develop concrete measures to better protect care workers against intimidation and threats.
requests the government to work with people in care to reach concrete measures that better protect care workers against intimidation and threats
verzoekt de regering om samen met mensen die in de zorg werken tot concrete maatregelen te komen die hulpverleners beter beschermen tegen intimidatie en bedreigingen
Motie van het lid Sahla c.s. over het informeren van mensen over het verantwoord publiek maken van misstanden
Asks the government to proactively inform patients and clients at the Landelijk Meldpunt Zorg about how to publicly disclose misconduct responsibly without breaching privacy rules.
requests the government, at the Landelijk Meldpunt Zorg, to proactively inform people about responsibly making misconduct public
verzoekt de regering bij het Landelijk Meldpunt Zorg mensen proactief te informeren over het verantwoord publiek maken van misstanden
Motie van het lid De Neef c.s. over meer ervaringsdeskundigheid aantrekken voor de jeugdzorgarbeidsmarkt
Asks the government to investigate how to attract and secure more experience experts for the youth care workforce.
requests the government to investigate how more experience expertise can be attracted and secured for the near and future youth care labour market
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe meer ervaringsdeskundigheid aangetrokken en geborgd kan worden voor de nabije en toekomstige jeugdzorgarbeidsmarkt
Motie van het lid De Neef over inventariseren hoe gemeenten nauwkeuriger en gerichter jeugdzorg kunnen inkopen
Motion asking the government to inventory supplementary tools so municipalities can procure youth care more precisely and control costs.
requests the government, together with the municipalities, to inventory which additional products or activities are needed
verzoekt de regering om samen met de gemeenten te inventariseren welke aanvullende producten of activiteiten nodig zijn
Motie van de leden De Neef en Ceder over betere verankering van de richtlijn in de aan- en toewijzing van behandelingen
Asks the government to examine how shared decision-making with parents and youths can be better anchored in the allocation of youth care treatments.
to examine, in the reform agenda process, how such consultation and guideline can be better anchored in the allocation of treatments
om in het proces van de hervormingsagenda te onderzoeken hoe zo'n overleg en richtlijn beter verankerd kunnen worden in de aan- en toewijzing van behandelingen
Motie van de leden De Neef en Ceder over de maatschappelijke weerslag van behandelingen inventariseren
Asks the government to inventory the societal outcomes of youth care treatments within the reform agenda, analogous to a learning network.
requests the government to inventory, in the reform agenda process, the societal impact of treatments
verzoekt de regering om in het proces van de hervormingsagenda te inventariseren wat de maatschappelijke weerslag is van behandelingen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Neef over het advies van de Gezondheidsraad inzake eetstoornissen

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Health about the Health Council's advice on eating disorders, including the reported four-year average wait for help, the need for a national early-detection approach, and what the K-EET chain approach has achieved. The State Secretary answered that delays are partly inherent to the illness, pointed to capacity expansion, regional coordination, the K-EET hotline and website, and a letter with the policy response, but gave no firm new wait-time targets.
I support municipalities and providers in their regional responsibility for tackling waiting times.
Ik ondersteun gemeenten en aanbieders in hun regionale verantwoordelijkheid voor de aanpak van wachttijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verkuijlen en De Neef over het artikel ‘Noodkreet kinderrechters: veroordeelde jongeren krijgen niet de hulp die ze nodig hebben’

MPs Verkuijlen and De Neef asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health about reports that convicted youths do not receive timely specialised youth care ordered by juvenile judges, including waiting lists, municipal budget constraints, lighter treatment advice from the Child Protection Council, and priority for these youths. The minister acknowledged the urgency, said regional procurement obligations and a support programme are being pursued, but gave no national figures on waiting lists and stated there is no plan to give these youths priority.
Municipalities are responsible for organising youth care, including youth care for young people in the criminal law context.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren van jeugdhulp, waaronder jeugdhulp voor jongeren in het strafrechtelijk kader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en De Neef over het bericht 'Weer meer incidenten met verwarde personen'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and De Neef asked about rising police registrations of incidents involving people with confused behaviour (over 100,000 in 2020, 130,184 in 2021) and whether most are care matters rather than police matters, plus what measures and national teams have done, how municipal approaches differ, and whether the Veldhoven model and suggested joint police-care consultations should be adopted. The minister answered that the registration rise is not a clear indicator of growth, outlined ongoing triage pilots and national programmes, and promised to consider the suggestions and inform parliament before summer.

Although I share the concerns about the number of registrations, based on the registration of E33 reports it is not possible to state in general terms what share of these cases actually required care or support.

Hoewel ik de zorgen over het aantal registraties deel, is het op basis van de registratie van E33-meldingen niet mogelijk om in algemene zin aan te geven in welk aandeel van deze gevallen eigenlijk zorg of ondersteuning nodig was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Werner, De Neef en Tellegen over het toezicht van de gemeenten op de zorg

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the state secretary about municipal supervision of care after reports that municipal oversight under the Wmo 2015 is failing, including staffing, coordination with national inspectorates, handling of reports, staff qualifications and fraud. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, said municipalities have wide discretion and that a study on Wmo supervision is underway with a follow-up letter promised before 1 June 2022, while several answers referred to existing cooperation arrangements and noted that national data was unavailable.
That is why my predecessor decided to commission a study into the functioning of Wmo supervision.
Daarom heeft mijn ambtsvoorganger besloten een onderzoek in te stellen naar het functioneren van het Wmo-toezicht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Neef en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Juvent kan niet wegblijven uit Zeeuws-Vlaanderen’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about Juvent's relocation of youth care from Zeeuws-Vlaanderen to Middelburg due to staffing shortages. The State Secretary said three youths stay at the Anker location, four moved to Middelburg with about 35 minutes' travel, and listed eleven contracted youth care providers in the region while pointing to municipalities' responsibility and broader reforms.
When children and parents need help, it is important that good help is available in a timely manner.
Wanneer kinderen en ouders hulp nodig hebben, is het van belang dat goede hulp tijdig beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, De Neef en Valstar over de mishandeling en het dumpen van huisdieren

MPs Ellian, De Neef and Valstar asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about rising animal abuse and dumping of pets during the coronavirus crisis and what the government would do. The minister answered that reports rose in 2020 but shelters saw no national increase in intake, outlined existing reporting and expertise arrangements, and said the animal-abuse ownership ban bill had been submitted to parliament.
The bill was submitted to your House on 15 July.
Het wetsvoorstel is op 15 juli jl. bij uw Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Neef en Ouwehand over het manifest toegankelijke festivals dat op 8 juni jl. is gelanceerd

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, VVD and PvdD asked ministers whether festivals should be more accessible for people with disabilities under the UN convention, why many are not, and whether the government will engage with the sector and international examples. The minister answered that the Onbeperkt Meedoen programme addresses accessibility, that gemeenten can set accessibility conditions in event permits, and that the government will raise the manifesto with VNG and VNO-NCW but gave no concrete new measures.
I will put this manifesto and the accessibility of festivals and events on the agenda in the talks I hold with the VNG and VNO-NCW.
Ik zal dit manifest en de toegankelijkheid van festivals en evenementen agenderen tijdens de gesprekken die ik voer met de VNG en VNO-NCW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en De Neef over de Zembla-uitzending dat spoorwerkers al ruim 10 jaar worden blootgesteld aan gevaarlijk kwartsstof

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about a Zembla broadcast reporting that rail workers have been exposed to carcinogenic quartz dust for over ten years, asking about legal duties, inspection history, ProRail reports and station safety. The ministers answered in detail on the legal framework and past inspections, acknowledging ProRail's reports and ongoing investigations, but largely pointed to employer responsibility and did not commit to new measures beyond referring to existing inspection work.
ProRail had not shared these studies with the Inspectorate SZW until recently, but did so following the Zembla broadcast.
ProRail had deze onderzoeken tot voor kort niet met de Inspectie SZW gedeeld, maar heeft dit naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Zembla wel gedaan.

m: Amendement van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het regelen dat iedere gemeente, provincie en elk waterschap en openbaar lichaam voorwaarden bepaalt waaronder inwoners en maats
Requires every municipality, province, water board and public body to set conditions under which residents and civil society may carry out tasks of the administrative body (right to challenge).

This amendment provides that every municipality, province, water board and public body sets conditions under which residents and civil society organisations may carry out tasks of the administrative body.

Dit amendement regelt dat iedere gemeente, provincie en elk waterschap en openbaar lichaam voorwaarden bepaalt waaronder inwoners en maatschappelijke partijen taken van het bestuursorgaan kunnen uitvoeren.
Motie van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over uitwerken hoe flankerend beleid kan worden vormgegeven zodat het uitdaagrecht ook in de praktijk goed uit de verf komt
Asks the government, with local government and citizen bodies, to work out supporting policy so that citizens' right to challenge (uitdaagrecht) local government works in practice.

verzoekt de regering om in samenspraak met VNG, IPO, de Unie van Waterschappen, de openbare lichamen, het LSA, het Landelijk Samenwerkingsverband Actieve bewoners, de LVKK, de Landelijke Vereniging voor Kleine Kernen, en de vertegenwoordigers van de jongerenraden uit te werken hoe flankerend beleid kan worden vormgegeven
Motie van het lid Hans Teunissen c.s. over het recht op begrijpelijke taal en duidelijke uitleg van besluiten vastleggen in de wet

het recht op begrijpelijke taal en duidelijke uitleg van besluiten wettelijk vast te leggen
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over uitwerken hoe in continuering van de Jettengelden voor politieke partijen kan worden voorzien
Asks the government to work out how to continue the incidental Jettengelden funding for political parties after 2024.
to work out how the continuation of the Jettengelden for political parties can still be provided for
uit te werken hoe alsnog in continuering van de Jettengelden voor politieke partijen kan worden voorzien

the submitters make funds available to ProDemos with this amendment
stellen indieners met dit amendement middelen beschikbaar voor ProDemos
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hans Teunissen over het bericht 'Gemeenten worstelen met desinformatie'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities are adequately supported in tackling misleading information and conspiracy theories that undermine local democracy ahead of elections. The minister answered that the government works with the VNG on support measures, points to existing handbooks, webinars and a national strategy, and promises a further letter to parliament at year-end.
At the end of this year, your House will be further informed about the progress of these discussions and the further actions from the national strategy for an effective approach to disinformation.
Eind dit jaar wordt uw Kamer verder geïnformeerd over de voortgang van deze gesprekken en de verdere acties uit de Rijksbrede strategie effectieve aanpak van desinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hans Teunissen over het bericht ‘Grote zorgen bij DUO: studiebeurs een raadsel voor bijna 90 procent ouders van mbo’ers

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a survey showing most parents of vocational students do not understand the student grant and some do not know about helpful tools such as the OV-jaarkaart, and asked about uptake, monitoring, information efforts and planned actions. The minister confirmed the survey, reported high uptake of the basic and supplementary grants, said the effect of the DUO campaign is hard to isolate, and listed information measures and a promise to send the full answers before the committee debate.
I will investigate how we can better inform parents of prospective students about all administrative matters relating to studying, including applying for student finance.
Ik ga onderzoeken hoe we ouders van aankomend studenten in aanvulling hierop beter kunnen informeren over alle regelzaken rondom studeren, dus ook het aanvragen van studiefinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hans Teunissen en Sneller over het artikel ‘VNG waarschuwt voor tekort aan stembureauvrijwilligers bij volgende verkiezingen’

MPs Teunissen and Sneller asked the Interior Minister about a shortage of polling-station volunteers, the planned recruitment campaign, the tax treatment of allowances, small-ballot experiments and the location of polling stations. The minister answered that recruitment is mainly a municipal task supported by a national campaign, that allowance talks with municipalities are ongoing with a report due by year-end, and that experiments and a letter on preparations will follow.
I intend to call on people via regional media (radio and newspapers) and social media to register with a municipality as a polling-station member or teller.
Ik ben voornemens om via de regionale media (radio en dagbladen) en via social media mensen op te roepen om zich bij een gemeente aan te melden als stembureaulid of als teller.

m: Motie van het lid Olger van Dijk c.s. over de NS-Jongerendagkaart behouden

Asks the government to provide door-to-door information on emergencies and to explore municipal information points, with a report to the House in Q3 2025.
requests the government to provide door-to-door information on emergencies

Motie van het lid Olger van Dijk c.s. over voor de zomer van 2025 met een strategie komen voor de gewenste taakinvulling en inzet van de marine

requests the government to come up with a strategy by summer 2025 for the desired tasks and deployment of the navy

requests the government together with European partners to map the main obstacles to scaling up European defence cooperation and production capacity

requests the government to survey with European countries which steps are needed to be able to deliver these critical defence capabilities
verzoekt de regering met Europese landen te inventariseren welke stappen nodig zijn om deze cruciale defensiecapaciteiten te kunnen leveren

Asks the government to draw up a masterplan for the Lelylijn railway and anchor it in the Nota Ruimte, and to keep seeking funding.
requests the government to draw up a masterplan Lelylijn and anchor it in the Nota Ruimte

Motie van het lid Olger van Dijk c.s. over het project Kornwerderzand blijven behandelen als een integraal project

requests the government to continue treating the Kornwerderzand project as an integrated project
verzoekt de regering om het project Kornwerderzand te blijven behandelen als een integraal project
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over berekenen wanneer de aanleg van tijdelijke fietsbruggen als alternatief voor de huidige fietsbussen op de Afsluitdijk aantrekkelijk is

Asks the government to inform parliament with a transparent calculation of when temporary bicycle bridges become a better alternative to the bike buses on the Afsluitdijk, and what consequences it attaches.
Motie van het lid De Hoop c.s. over spoedig in gesprek gaan met de Duitse vervoersautoriteiten over voortzetting van de treinverbinding Venlo-Düsseldorf
Asks the government to talk promptly with German transport authorities about continuing the Venlo-Düsseldorf cross-border train and inform the House of the outcome.
requests the government to promptly talk with the German transport authorities about continuing this cross-border train connection and to inform the House of the outcomes

Motie van het lid Vedder c.s. over het MIRT-onderzoek naar de haven van Werkendam actualiseren en aanvullen op basis van de Sectoragenda Maritieme Maakindustrie

requests the government to take measures promptly, by 2026 at the latest, so that Schiphol's noise burden is reduced by 20%

Motie van de leden Pierik en Olger van Dijk over bezien wat er nodig is om een MIRT-verkenning naar de Nedersaksenlijn op te starten

requests the government to examine what is needed to start an MIRT exploration of the Nedersaksenlijn
verzoekt de regering te bezien wat er nodig is om een MIRT-verkenning naar de Nedersaksenlijn op te starten
Motie van het lid Olger van Dijk over de effecten van de kortingen op IenW-subsidies onderzoeken en betrekken bij een mogelijke herschikking van subsidiebudgetten bij de Voorjaarsnota 2025

Asks the government to study the effects of cuts to transport and water ministry subsidies and to inform the Chamber, including in a possible reallocation of subsidy budgets in the 2025 Spring Memorandum.
requests the government to examine the effects of the cuts to IenW subsidies, include this in a possible reallocation of subsidy budgets in the 2025 Spring Memorandum, and inform the Chamber about it

verzoekt de regering de effecten van de kortingen op IenW-subsidies te onderzoeken, dit te betrekken bij een mogelijke herschikking van subsidiebudgetten bij de voorjaarsnota 2025, en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Motie van het lid Heutink c.s. over de algehele drooglegging van het Julianakanaal uitstellen tot in ieder geval stuw Borgharen weer volledig functioneel is

requests the government to postpone the full draining of the Julianakanaal until at least the Borgharen weir is fully functional again
verzoekt de regering om de algehele drooglegging van het Julianakanaal uit te stellen tot in ieder geval stuw Borgharen weer volledig functioneel is
Motie van de leden Olger van Dijk en Pierik over onderzoeken hoe de zuiverings- en verontreinigingsheffing meer op basis van de omvang van huishoudens geheven kan worden
Asks the government to study how the wastewater pollution levy can be based more on household size.
requests the government to study how the purification and pollution levy can be levied more on the basis of household size
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe de zuiverings- en verontreinigingsheffing meer op basis van de omvang van huishoudens geheven kan worden
Amendement van de leden Olger van Dijk en Grinwis over lichte voorhang voor de amvb, bedoeld in artikel 120, zevende lid, onder b
Adds a light pre-consultation (voorhang) of four weeks before parliament for the AMvB setting the water board tolerance band in the water system charge bill.
The proposal for the general administrative order under paragraph 7(b) may not be submitted until four weeks after the draft has been laid before both Chambers.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het zevende lid, onderdeel b, vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Motie van de leden Olger van Dijk en Vedder over de aanbevelingen van het PBL over grensoverschrijdende effecten integraal overnemen in de Werkwijzer MKBA bij MIRT-verkenningen
Asks the government to fully adopt the PBL's three recommendations on including cross-border effects in the MKBA guidance for MIRT explorations.
requests the government to fully adopt the three PBL recommendations on including cross-border effects in the Werkwijzer MKBA for MIRT explorations
verzoekt de regering om de drie aanbevelingen van het PBL over het meenemen van grensoverschrijdende effecten integraal over te nemen in de Werkwijzer MKBA bij MIRT-verkenningen
Amendement van het lid Olger van Dijk over wetsevaluatie van artikel 122, vijfde lid
Requires the minister to send parliament an evaluation of the effects of the draagvlak requirement for water board plus-facilities within five years.
This amendment therefore provides for an evaluation provision on article 122, fifth paragraph, no later than five years after the bill takes effect.
Dit amendement voorziet daarom in een evaluatiebepaling van artikel 122, vijfde lid, uiterlijk vijf jaar na inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel.
Motie van het lid Olger van Dijk c.s. over onderzoek naar een revolverend fonds voor verduurzaming en toegankelijkheid van sportaccommodaties
Asks the government to explore a revolving fund for sports clubs to finance sustainability and accessibility investments in sports facilities.
requests the government, with Stichting Waarborgfonds Sport and BNG, to explore how a revolving fund for sports clubs can be created
verzoekt de regering met Stichting Waarborgfonds Sport en BNG te onderzoeken hoe er een revolverend fonds voor sportclubs kan worden gecreëerd
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over de drinkwaterbedrijven dit jaar zo snel mogelijk duidelijkheid geven over de financieringsruimte met ingang van 2025
Asks the government to give drinking water companies clarity this year on financing room from 2025 so they can fund required investments, and report to the House.
requests the government to give the drinking water companies clarity as soon as possible this year about financing room from 2025
verzoekt de regering de drinkwaterbedrijven dit jaar zo snel mogelijk duidelijkheid te geven over de financieringsruimte met ingang van 2025
Motie van het lid Kostić c.s. over de kansen van nature-based solutions in waterprojecten maximaal benutten
Asks the government to ensure nature-based solutions are fully used in water projects.
requests the government to ensure that the opportunities of nature-based solutions in water projects are fully exploited
verzoekt de regering om ervoor te zorgen dat de kansen van nature-based solutions in waterprojecten maximaal worden benut
Motie van de leden Olger van Dijk en Grinwis over vervolgonderzoek naar pfas in zeeschuim aan de Nederlandse kust
Asks the government to commission follow-up research into PFAS in sea foam on the Dutch coast and inform the House before summer.
requests the government to commission follow-up research into PFAS in sea foam on the Dutch coast
verzoekt de regering opdracht te geven voor vervolgonderzoek naar pfas in zeeschuim aan de Nederlandse kust
Motie van het lid Olger van Dijk c.s. over bevorderen dat concessie verlenende provincies en gemeenten tekorten aan vrijwilligers bij buurtbussen kunnen tegengaan
Asks the government to help concession-granting provinces and municipalities counter volunteer shortages at community buses.
requests the government to promote that concession-granting provinces and municipalities can counter volunteer shortages at community buses
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat concessie verlenende provincies en gemeenten tekorten aan vrijwilligers bij buurtbussen kunnen tegengaan
Motie van het lid Heutink c.s. over onderzoek naar invoering van een gepersonaliseerd kenteken
Asks the government to study introducing personalised number plates and report costs and benefits before summer recess.
requests the government to investigate whether a personalised number plate can be introduced
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of een gepersonaliseerd kenteken ingevoerd kan worden
Motie van het lid Veltman c.s. over een concreet voorstel om de rapportageplicht voor woon-werkverkeer te versimpelen
Asks the government to propose within three months a simpler reporting obligation for commuter travel of employers with over 100 staff.
requests the government to come within three months with a concrete proposal on how the reporting obligation can be simplified
verzoekt de regering om binnen drie maanden met een concreet voorstel te komen hoe de rapportageplicht kan worden versimpeld
Motie van het lid Olger van Dijk c.s. over een landelijke aanpak om woon-werkverkeer beter te spreiden over de dag en de week
Motion asking the government to work with employers and schools on a nationwide approach to spreading commuter travel over the day and week.
requests the government to work with employers, employees and educational institutions towards a nationwide approach to better spread commuter traffic over the day and week
verzoekt de regering om samen met werkgevers, werknemers en onderwijsinstellingen tot een landelijke aanpak te komen om woon-werkverkeer beter te spreiden over de dag en de week
Motie van het lid Veltman c.s. over een aanvalsplan om de veiligheid in het openbaar vervoer en op stations te verbeteren
Asks the state secretary for Infrastructure to draw up, with the Justice ministry and carriers, an action plan to improve safety on public transport and at stations.
requests the state secretary of IenW to draw up, in consultation with the Justice ministry and carriers, an action plan to improve safety on public transport and at stations

verzoekt de staatsecretaris van IenW om in samenspraak met het Ministerie van JenV en de vervoerders een aanvalsplan op te stellen om de veiligheid in het openbaar vervoer en op stations te verbeteren
Motie van het lid Veltman c.s. over met voorrang kijken naar een oplossing voor Mariënheem
Asks the government to prioritise a solution for Mariënheem on the N35, starting with a ring road once nitrogen rules allow, and to inform the Chamber before summer.
requests the government to look with priority at a solution for Mariënheem
verzoekt de regering met voorrang te kijken naar een oplossing voor Mariënheem
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over een evaluatie van de prijsbijstellingssystematiek voor investeringen uit het Mobiliteitsfonds en Deltafonds
Motion asks the government to evaluate the price-adjustment system for infrastructure investments from the Mobility and Delta funds and inform the House before the 2025 budget debate.
requests the government to carry out an evaluation of the price-adjustment system
verzoekt de regering een evaluatie uit te voeren naar de prijsbijstellingssystematiek
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 28 over middelen voor het spoorknooppunt bij Meppel
Adds 40 million euro to the rail budget for the Zwolle-Meppel junction, funded from a windfall in the public transport availability fee.
This amendment makes the required 40 million euros extra available to fully address the Zwolle-Meppel rail junction.
Dit amendement stelt de benodigde € 40 mln. extra beschikbaar om het spoorknooppunt Zwolle-Meppel goed en volledig aan te pakken.
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 29 over middelen voor de OV-hub bij station Ede-Wageningen
Shifts EUR 6.6 million to the Ede-Wageningen OV-hub from a surplus in the transport availability payment, a budget amendment with no bearing on executive checks.
This amendment aims to fund completion of the OV-hub at Ede-Wageningen station.
Dit amendement strekt ertoe om te voorzien in afronding van de OV-hub bij station Ede-Wageningen.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over dekking voor middelen voor het spoorknooppunt bij Meppel

Shifts funds from the rail and public transport article to the Investment Funds contribution article, covering a 40 million euro amendment for the Meppel rail hub from a surplus on the 2022 availability fee.
The necessary funds are made available via article 26 Contribution to Investment Funds for the budget of the Mobility Fund.
De benodigde middelen worden via artikel 26 «Bijdrage Investeringsfondsen» ter beschikking gesteld voor de begroting van het Mobiliteitsfonds.
