Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van dat gedrukt onder nr. 24 over dekking voor middelen voor de OV-hub bij station Ede-Wageningen

Amendment moves 6.6 million euro within the departmental budget from public transport and rail to the investment funds article, funded by expected repayments from the 2022 public transport availability payment, to finance the Ede-Wageningen transport hub.
Funding is found in the receipts from the 2022 public transport availability payment.
Dekking wordt gevonden in de ontvangsten uit de Beschikbaarheidsvergoeding OV 2022.
Motie van de leden Grinwis en Olger van Dijk over bepalen of de A2 Deil-Den Bosch-Vught in aanmerking komt voor alternatieve aanwending van de gereserveerde middelen
Asks the government to map measures on the local road network for safety near the A2 and to decide whether the reserved A2 Deil-Den Bosch-Vught funds can be used elsewhere.
requests the government to map as soon as possible, together with the region, measures on the underlying road network to guarantee traffic safety
verzoekt de regering zo spoedig mogelijk samen met de regio maatregelen op het onderliggend wegennet in kaart te brengen om de verkeersveiligheid te waarborgen
Motie van het lid Olger van Dijk c.s. over aspecten van brede welvaart meewegen bij het afwegingskader van infrastructuurbeslissingen voor MIRT-investeringen
Asks the government to change the infrastructure decision framework for MIRT investments from 2025 so that broad-welfare aspects are weighed, beyond the cost-benefit analysis.
requests the government to adjust the decision framework for MIRT infrastructure investments from 2025 so that aspects of broad welfare are taken into account
verzoekt de regering het afwegingskader van infrastructuurbeslissingen voor MIRT-investeringen vanaf 2025 zodanig aan te passen dat aspecten van brede welvaart worden meegewogen
Amendement van het lid Heutink c.s. over extra middelen voor de N35
Amendment shifts €94 million from the national highways budget to the exploration reserve so the N35 project regains funding under earlier administrative agreements.
Therefore the submitters propose through this amendment to reverse the reprioritisation insofar as it comes at the expense of the N35
Daarom stellen indieners voor om middels dit amendement het herprioriteren voor zover dat ten koste gaat van de N35 terug te draaien
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over demonstraties op het spoor

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, together with the Justice Minister, about Extinction Rebellion activists occupying railway tracks at Amsterdam Centraal, how the government prepared for and responded to the announced action, and how it will prevent future disruption of transport hubs. The government answered that it condemns track occupation, describes contacts with police, municipal authorities, NS and ProRail, notes that pre-emptive arrest requires a suspicion of a criminal offence, and points to a handling framework and a pending research study on the legal basis for restricting demonstrations.
Completely preventing demonstrators from entering the track proves extremely complex in practice.
Het volledig voorkomen dat demonstranten het spoor betreden blijkt in de praktijk uiterst complex.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger van Dijk en Wingelaar over het artikel ‘geen noodbrug blijkt op infoavond over renovatie brug Urmond’

MPs Van Dijk and Wingelaar asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Urmond bridge renovation: the delay since around 2017-2018, the lack of a social impact analysis, the shift in project scope without informing residents, and the budget discrepancy (EUR 8.8m vs 15-20m, only EUR 350,000 for nuisance measures). The minister acknowledged communication shortcomings and that the bridge will be fully closed, but attributed the delay and scope change to deteriorating technical condition and defended the budget as phase-specific, while leaving alternatives like a temporary bridge to the municipality of Stein.
No official social impact analysis (MIA) was prepared for the closure of the Urmond bridge.
Er is geen officiële maatschappelijke impactanalyse (MIA) opgesteld voor de afsluiting van brug Urmond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over het fatbikeverbod in Enschede

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Enschede fatbike ban, accident statistics, municipal legal options, other municipalities, and implementation of a parliamentary motion on helmet rules and a separate vehicle category. The minister answered that municipalities can regulate local nuisance via the APV, that the ministry will not intervene, that separate weight/torque rules are not feasible, and that a leeftijdsgebonden helmplicht and other measures will be pursued.
The ministry currently sees no (other) effective measures that could support municipalities in introducing the fatbike ban referred to in your question.
Het ministerie ziet op dit moment geen (andere) effectieve maatregelen die gemeenten kunnen ondersteunen bij de invoering van het in uw vraag aangehaalde fatbikeverbod.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger van Dijk en Wingelaar over Rijkswaterstaat sluit brug Urmond anderhalf jaar volledig af, maar gemeente Stein verzet zich: Niet akkoord met samenloop verbreding A2

MPs Olger van Dijk and Wingelaar ask why Rijkswaterstaat fully closes the Urmond bridge for 18 months despite objections from Stein and residents, and how local participation and the A2 timing were handled. The minister answers that worsened inspection results make a partial closure unsafe, that residents were consulted in earlier phases, that a klankbordgroep and alternatives like bus and bike options are being explored, but that no formal impact analysis was made and no reconsideration meeting with the municipality will be held.
No official societal impact analysis (MIA) has been prepared for the closure of the Urmond bridge.
Er is geen officiële maatschappelijke impactanalyse (MIA) opgesteld voor de afsluiting van brug Urmond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heite en Olger van Dijk over de bezuiniging op rampenbestrijding en de conclusies van het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer ‘De derde hoofdtaak van de krijgsmacht’

MPs Heite and Olger van Dijk asked the ministers of Defence and Justice and Security about the Court of Audit report on the armed forces' third main task (disaster relief), the cuts, coordination with civil services, and civilian resilience. The ministers answered that Defence met all 447 civil assistance requests, that the Court's concerns mainly concern wartime capacity, that civil-military coordination will be strengthened, and that a resilience campaign is planned, but gave no firm guarantees on future capacity shortfalls.
Defence stated in its administrative response that it will adopt the recommendations made by the Court of Audit.
Defensie heeft in haar bestuurlijke reactie gemeld de door de Algemene Rekenkamer gedane aanbevelingen over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over het bericht ‘Koning klaagt erop los: vaak file na loos alarm’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about frequent tunnel closures at the Schiphol tunnel caused by height-detection alarms for trucks, including false positives, traffic impact, and planned improvements. The minister answered in detail, stating the system produces no false positives, giving 2024 alarm counts per tunnel, and outlining signage, technical, and enforcement measures with a report to parliament promised before summer.
The system does not give false-positive alarms.
Het systeem geeft geen fout-positieve meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Wal, Van der Werf, Nordkamp, Dassen en Olger Van Dijk over de (dreigende) afhankelijkheid van de Nederlandse krijgsmacht van Starlink

MPs asked whether the Dutch armed forces risk dependence on Starlink, whether alternative European satellite systems exist for command, communication, positioning and ISR, and whether the Netherlands will invest in autonomous capacity. The minister replied that Defence is not dependent on Starlink, that it spreads suppliers and is building sovereign ISR and PNT capacity over time, but withheld details of specific systems and command systems on operational and national security grounds.
No statements are made about specific alternatives for Defence in connection with operational interests and national security.
Over specifieke alternatieven voor Defensie worden geen uitspraken gedaan in verband met operationele belangen en de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over Europese financiering voor de Nedersaksenlijn en de Lelylijn

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about possible EU funding (CEF, EIB, military mobility programmes) for the Nedersaksenlijn and Lelylijn rail projects and about a meeting with the EU transport commissioner. The State Secretary answered that EU funds cannot be pre-committed and are only an additional source, that CEF budgets are largely exhausted, that the post-2027 budget is uncertain, and that EIB loans do not solve the national budget problem.
The Commission has confirmed that the European Union cannot make advance commitments on possible funding prospects for specific infrastructure projects, including the Lelylijn and Nedersaksenlijn.

De Commissie heeft bevestigd dat vanuit de Europese Unie geen toezeggingen vooraf gedaan kunnen worden over mogelijke financieringskansen van concrete infrastructuurprojecten, ook niet voor de Lelylijn en Nedersaksenlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Olger van Dijk over verdachte Russische schepen in onze wateren

MPs Kahraman and Olger van Dijk asked the ministers about suspicious Russian ships in Dutch waters, the shadow fleet, espionage around North Sea infrastructure and European sales of tankers to Russia. The government describes sanctions listings, IMO and port-state measures, NATO and regional cooperation, and promises a confidential briefing on the legal analysis of additional powers while declining to detail planned measures.

As promised in the NATO Defence Ministerial committee debate of 5 February 2025, you will be informed through a confidential technical briefing about the outcomes of the legal analysis into additional options to intervene in maritime espionage and sabotage activities.

Zoals toegezegd in het commissiedebat NAVO Defensie Ministeriële op 5 februari 2025, zal u middels een vertrouwelijke technische briefing worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van de juridische analyse
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger Van Dijk over het bericht ‘Voertuigen weginspecteurs vaker aangereden'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the tripling of collisions with road inspector vehicles in 2024, the causes, distraction-related measures and safety of inspectors. The minister answered that causes appear largely random and linked to inattention, cited enforcement and camera measures, and committed to reconsidering lane closures if safety measures prove insufficient.
Incidentally, this question has immediately been added to the guidelines for producing the incident report.
Per direct is deze vraag overigens toegevoegd aan de aanwijzingen om te komen tot het feitenrelaas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over het bericht ’Onbekend clubje van NAVO-landen richt zich op tegen de Russen’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the relationship between the Joint Expeditionary Force and NATO, Dutch tasks and contribution, and protection of undersea infrastructure. The minister answered that the JEF is complementary to NATO, participation is voluntary (opt-in), and the Dutch focus is maritime protection of vital infrastructure, without committing to expansion or new capacity steps.
Participation in JEF activities only takes place when it does not conflict with Dutch NATO obligations.
Deelname aan JEF-activiteiten vindt alleen plaats wanneer dit niet strijdig is met de Nederlandse NAVO-verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over het bericht ‘Geen zwaar vrachtverkeer meer over viaduct A12 bij Velperbroek’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the weight restriction on heavy freight over the A12 viaducts at Velperbroek, including support structures, enforcement, detour effects, renovation timing and defence transport needs. The minister answered all ten questions in substance, noting Rijkswaterstaat does not enforce itself (police and ILT do), that renovation timing is not yet known, and that the military transport network is being re-evaluated with the Ministry of Defence.
Specific information on military transport routes and corridors cannot be shared publicly due to the confidential nature of this information.
Specifieke informatie over militaire transportroutes en corridors kan i.v.m. het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie niet publiekelijk gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger van Dijk en Pierik over het bericht 'Rijksadviseur Wouter Veldhuis is om: Lelylijn zonder Duitse connectie wél van belang.'

MPs Olger van Dijk and Pierik asked the State Secretary about a news report on the Lelylijn and Nedersaksenlijn rail projects, including whether further study should be done and how the projects can be financed. The State Secretary answered that both lines are priorities, that MIRT start conditions require about 75% financing not yet secured (roughly 7 billion euro for Lelylijn and 1.3 billion for Nedersaksenlijn), that financing options are still being studied, and that a final decision on next steps will be taken by the spring memorandum.
By the spring memorandum (April 2025) at the latest, the cabinet will take the definitive decision on the next steps for the Lelylijn.
Uiterlijk bij voorjaarsnota (april 2025) zal door het kabinet het definitieve besluit over de vervolgstappen voor de Lelylijn worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger Van Dijk en Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Minister van Defensie: Nederlandse wetten ongeschikt voor ‘grijze zone’ tussen oorlog en vrede’

MPs Van Dijk and Six-Dijkstra asked the government about Russian vessels mapping North Sea infrastructure, military transport routes, conscription and reservists, a single cyber contact point, and cybersecurity governance. The government answered that it does not pre-announce responses, outlines Defence's North Sea tasks and the Action Plan, says military route specifics are confidential, notes a voluntary enquiry and more reservists, and describes the NLCS and the planned Cyberweerbaarheidsnetwerk.
Specific information on military transport routes and corridors cannot be shared publicly due to the confidential nature of this information.
Specifieke informatie over militaire transportroutes en corridors kan i.v.m. het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie niet publiekelijk gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Olger van Dijk over het persbericht «Rusland bespioneert systematisch onze wateren»

MPs Kahraman and Olger van Dijk asked the government about a broadcast report that Russia systematically spies on Dutch waters, and how the North Sea is monitored, whether responses are proportionate, joint NATO measures, intensification, and tougher measures in coastal areas and ports. The minister answered that a range of agencies monitor the North Sea, that Navy escorts Russian vessels, that an action plan on North Sea infrastructure is being expanded with sensors and satellite capacity, and that a bill on espionage offences is pending, while declining to pre-announce specific responses.
The cabinet does not make public statements in advance about how the Dutch government will act in specific incidents, to prevent malicious parties from anticipating Dutch conduct.

Het kabinet doet publiekelijk op voorhand geen uitspraken over hoe de Nederlandse overheid handelt bij specifieke voorvallen, om te voorkomen dat kwaadwillende partijen in hun handelen kunnen anticiperen op Nederlandse handelwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over het bericht ‘Zwaarbeveiligd Defensie-netwerk wist even niet meer hoe laat het was’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a multi-hour outage of the NAFIN defence network, including the cause, vulnerability to sabotage, the 15-hour restoration time, preventive measures and scenarios. The state secretary attributed the outage to a software fault in a standard vendor component, said no sign of malicious involvement was found, and gave partial answers, citing security reasons, promising a fuller evaluation only by year-end.
For security reasons, however, Defence does not provide further substantive information on whether vulnerabilities are present.
Vanwege veiligheidsredenen verstrekt Defensie echter geen nadere inhoudelijke informatie over het al dan niet aanwezig zijn van kwetsbaarheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldkamp, Olger van Dijk en Van Hijum over de toegenomen onveiligheid op de treindienst Zwolle-Emmen

Three NSC MPs asked why incidents of fare evasion and violence against rail staff on the Zwolle-Emmen line rose in early 2024, and what measures, cameras, travel bans and COA-related steps are being taken. The government answered that the rise largely reflects more systematic checks by the service team, that Arriva is reinstating two stewards per train, that camera discussions will continue, and that a national travel ban was ruled out on proportionality grounds while operators explore faster temporary bans.
No figures are available on the nationalities of the persons causing the incidents.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de nationaliteiten van de personen die de incidenten veroorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger van Dijk en Zeedijk over de Nationale Circulaire Plastic

MPs Olger van Dijk and Zeedijk asked the government about the planned recyclate blending norm for plastics, its EU alignment, competitive effects, recyclate supply and certification. The minister answered that the norm bill is still under review after consultation, that the EU is advancing product-specific recyclate requirements, and that EUR 267 million in subsidies is available, while many questions were deferred to a new cabinet or later regulations.
The decision to be based on this is for the new cabinet.
Het hierop te baseren besluit is aan het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over statiegeld

An MP asked the state secretary about ILT's enforcement against Verpact for missing the 90% bottle-collection target, including a possible increase of deposit to €0.50, impact analysis, and extension to juice and dairy bottles. The state secretary answered that the enforcement is ongoing with proposed penalties, that the deposit level is one lever to be reviewed in an evaluation in 2024, and that the extension to juice and dairy is not current policy but will be examined.
It is important to note that the process is ongoing and currently concerns an intention to impose an order subject to penalty.
Hierbij is het van belang om te benoemen dat het traject in uitvoering is en dat het momenteel een voornemen tot last onder dwangsom betreft.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Olger van Dijk, Tuinman, De Roon en Stoffer over meldingen in het veiligheidssysteem ECCAIRS over het luchtruim boven Oekraïne voor 17 juli 2014, de datum waarop vlucht MH17/KL410

MPs asked the minister for details of three Eccairs safety reports on Ukrainian airspace filed in 2014 before MH17 was shot down, and for the reports to be shared with parliament. The minister declined, citing a pending Council of State case and EU Regulation 376/2014 confidentiality rules, and promised to inform parliament after the ruling expected in Q3 2024.
Because this procedure is still ongoing, no further information can be provided.
Omdat deze procedure nog loopt, kan verder geen informatie worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Olger van Dijk over het bericht ‘Kabinet versoepelde exclusief voor Schiphol de bestaande stikstofregels’

MPs Hertzberger and Olger van Dijk asked the government why Schiphol's nitrogen permit allowed external netting without an additionality requirement, why 500,000 flights were permitted despite advice pointing to 440,000, and about nearby habitat overload. The Minister of Nature and Nitrogen answered that the permit followed a technical assessment and that the reference situations and external netting were applied as before, with limited nitrogen increases, while partly deferring to other responsibilities and procedures.
I was advised by officials to make the decision, as I did in September 2023.
Mij is ambtelijk geadviseerd om het besluit te nemen, zoals ik dat in september 2023 genomen heb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over het artikel ‘Schiphol hield explosief rapport over krimp luchthaven onder de pet, na dreigement KLM’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a newspaper report that Schiphol withheld a cost-benefit study on shrinking the airport after a KLM threat, and about the study's findings on flight taxes, leakage and emissions. The minister said the report's commissioners must agree on publication, that the study offers no detailed evidence on network effects, and that further research on flight taxes is a matter for a new cabinet.
It is up to the commissioners of the report, namely Schiphol, BARIN and KLM, to make mutual agreements about its publication.
Het is aan de opdrachtgevers van het rapport, te weten Schiphol, BARIN en KLM, om onderling afspraken te maken over de openbaarmaking hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Olger van Dijk over het bericht 'Geweld tegen NS-medewerkers weer toegenomen, 'schokkend en onacceptabel''

MPs Veltman and Olger van Dijk asked the infrastructure state secretary about reports of rising violence against NS staff, whether the 'Aanvalsplan veilig met de trein' is needed, how other countries handle this, the status of the related motion, progress with the Justice ministry and carriers, NS's extra measures, and bodycams. The state secretary attributes the rise to wider social hardening and to homeless, confused and intoxicated people, condemns the violence, describes an action programme with carriers, police and the Justice ministry and existing measures, and says bodycam pilots have positive experiences.
In doing so, I share your sense that the parties involved need to step up their efforts to halt these developments.
Ik onderschrijf daarbij uw gevoel dat vanuit de betrokken partijen extra inzet nodig is om de ontwikkelingen een halt toe te roepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Olger van Dijk over het activistisch aandeelhouderschap van Schiphol door de gemeente Amsterdam en de inzet op krimp tot maximaal 440.000 vluchten

Two NSC MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers how the state views Amsterdam's activist shareholding in Schiphol and its push to cap flights at 440,000, and how the state's shareholder strategy and public-interest criteria apply. The minister welcomed Amsterdam's focus on the living environment, explained that the state's strategy review and MVO criteria cover sustainability and environmental quality, and said a new strategy process would start this year while shareholders act independently.
For that I refer you to the shareholding policy of the respective shareholders.
Ik verwijs u daarvoor graag door naar (het deelnemingenbeleid van) de desbetreffende aandeelhouders.

qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Omtzigt over de lobby van grote familiebedrijven om de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling (BOR) te verruimen

MPs Idsinga and Omtzigt asked why the requested lobby letters from large family firms seeking to widen the business succession scheme (BOR) had not yet been sent to Parliament, and asked for their timely delivery along with all related correspondence. The State Secretary answered that the request could not be met in the short term, supplied a search of correspondence from the Finance, Economic Affairs and General Affairs ministries as an annex, and said the letters would be attached to the tax bill Wet aanpassing fiscale bedrijfsopvolgingsfaciliteiten 2025.
A copy of the lobby letters has been included as an annex to that bill.
Een afschrift van de lobbybrieven is opgenomen als bijlage bij dat wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Groningers die door immateriële schadevergoeding buitengesloten worden voor kwijtschelding van waterschaps- en gemeentebelasting

An SP MP asked whether Groningen residents receiving immaterial damages from the IMG are excluded from waterschap and municipal tax relief because the payment counts as wealth, and what is being done about it. The government confirms the payment counts as wealth, says municipalities and water boards can waive collection and are cooperative in practice, points residents to the Noordelijk Belastingkantoor, and says the energy allowance system cannot be copied.

Although this touches on the autonomy of municipalities and water boards, which I cannot intervene in, contacts with the municipalities and water board concerned have shown that they apply this option benevolently in the case of damages paid by the IMG and NCG.

Hoewel dit raakt aan de autonomie van gemeenten en waterschappen waar ik niet in kan treden, is uit contacten met de desbetreffende gemeenten en het desbetreffende waterschap gebleken dat ze deze mogelijkheid in het geval van schadevergoeding door het IMG en de NCG welwillend toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens over ontwijking van de vennootschapsbelasting

MPs Maatoug and Stultiens asked the State Secretary of Finance about corporate tax avoidance, including the participation exemption, interest deduction on non-arm's-length loans, and depreciation of goodwill and intangibles. The State Secretary largely defended existing anti-avoidance rules, announced a Belastingplan 2025 measure on the earnings-stripping threshold and further research on dividend stripping, and rejected proposals to raise the participation threshold, restrict interest deductions or ban depreciation of goodwill.
The cabinet will continue this research.
Het kabinet zal dit onderzoek voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Eijk over het bericht 'Onderzoek naar klachten over evangelist Tom de Wal, hij geeft intussen Mercedes CLA en Audi A6 weg'

MPs asked whether faith healer Tom de Wal, who reportedly gives away luxury cars, falls under the Wkkgz, whether his title misleads patients, and whether his foundation's ANBI status fits the public-benefit requirement. The minister said the IGJ has no signals of structurally harmful practices, sees no reason to re-evaluate the rules, considers religious healing protected, and explained that ANBI status is neutrally assessed and the tax authority cannot act on such conduct.
However, I have no concrete signals that this is the case in practice.
Ik heb echter geen concrete signalen dat hiervan sprake is in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst, Vlottes, Boon en Markuszower over de 'Stichting Plant een Olijfboom'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the Stichting Plant een Olijfboom, whose staff allegedly praised the 7 October attack, questioning its ANBI charity status, missing financial reporting, possible funding of Hamas, and calls for an FIOD investigation or a ban. The minister condemned such statements but said the ANBI public-benefit test is neutral and non-prosecutable conduct is no ground for revocation, that financial publication gaps are usually remedied, that tax secrecy prevents comment on the individual organisation, and that dissolution/banning under Article 2:20 BW is for the Public Prosecution Service and the court.
The Tax Authority is bound by the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act and therefore cannot provide further information about individual institutions.
De Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen en kan daarom geen nadere informatie verstrekken over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Idsinga over het bericht ‘Britse belegger sluist uitpondwinst Nederlandse woningen weg naar Bermuda’

Two MPs asked whether Dutch rental homes bought by a British investor and sold off to owner-occupiers via Luxembourg and Bermuda vehicles constitute tax avoidance, and what the government will do. The minister says Dutch treaties allocate tax on Dutch property income to the Netherlands, sees no reason for intervention or new rules, and declines to discuss individual tax files.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oostenbruggen over het aantal toegenomen schijnzelfstandigen bij het Ministerie van Financiën

An MP asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the rise in suspected false self-employed (schijnzelfstandigen) working at the Ministry of Finance and its services, after an Algemene Rekenkamer finding and a taskforce meant to reduce them. The government answered that about 1,000 potential false self-employed are hired via intermediaries, mainly at Toeslagen/UHT for the childcare benefits recovery operation, that the taskforce aims to phase them out by 1 January 2025, and that no central overview exists across other departments.
There is currently, however, no central overview of the specific numbers of potential false self-employed at the departments.
Er is momenteel echter geen centraal overzicht van specifiek de aantallen potentiële schijnzelfstandigen bij de departementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over BTW-teruggave aan internationale reizigers

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about VAT refunds for non-EU travellers (tax-free shopping), including spending levels, use of the scheme, the effect on growth, digitalisation and competitiveness. The State Secretary answered that digital export validation is being prepared as mandatory, with a consultation to follow, while noting that refunds depend on retailer participation and other factors and that the State will refund more VAT if tax-free purchases rise.
I intend to make the export validation of goods bought in the Netherlands and exported from the Netherlands to the EU mandatory via digital means.
ben ik voornemens om de uitvoervalidatie van goederen die in Nederland zijn gekocht en vanuit Nederland de EU worden uitgevoerd, verplicht langs digitale weg te laten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het moratorium om te handhaven op schijnzelfstandigheid

The MP asks how the state secretary's statement that amending labour law is a condition for lifting the enforcement moratorium on sham self-employment fits with earlier government positions on a three-track approach, and what delaying the labour-law amendment would mean for lifting the moratorium. The state secretary answers that enforcement proceeds in parallel tracks, that a clearer legal framework supports compliance, and that the government still intends to lift the moratorium on 1 January 2025 after impact assessments.
The cabinet has the ambition to fully lift the enforcement moratorium on 1 January 2025.
Het kabinet heeft de ambitie om het handhavingsmoratorium op 1 januari 2025 volledig op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het onderzoeken van de grenseffecten van de accijnsverhogingen op tabak

MP Vermeer asks the State Secretary of Finance whether border-effect studies promised for excise increases on tobacco and alcohol are underway, and questions whether the methods are comparable and whether stacked excise increases harm border-region businesses. The State Secretary confirms the commitment, reports the tobacco study is completed and alcohol analysis is pending, defends different methods per product, and rejects the claims of severe harm, citing health goals and budgetary considerations.
The study on border effects of the 2023 tobacco excise increase has been completed and sent to the House of Representatives.
Het onderzoek met betrekking tot grenseffecten van de accijnsverhoging op tabak in 2023 is inmiddels afgerond en naar de Tweede Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht “Spaarders in box 3 mogen oordeel Hoge Raad niet afwachten”

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether savers in box 3 who did not object to their 2023 tax assessments will benefit from a forthcoming Supreme Court ruling, given that their assessments may already be final, and what communication and objection procedures will apply. The State Secretary confirms that assessments for savers are being held back, that the Supreme Court rulings of 6 June apply to 2023 assessments dated early May, refuses to estimate the workload of individual objections, and says a return to the pre-2016 mass-objection procedure is rejected in favour of a new 'direct aanpassen' system.
Almost all 2023 income tax assessments of box 3 savers are dated early May 2024, so on 6 June, the date the Supreme Court rulings were issued, the assessments were not yet final.

Nagenoeg alle aanslagen inkomstenbelasting 2023 van de spaarders box 3 hebben een dagtekening van begin mei 2024, waardoor aanslagen op 6 juni, de datum dat de arresten van de Hoge Raad zijn gewezen, nog niet onherroepelijk vaststonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over ‘schijnzelfstandigheid bij YoungOnes’

The MP asks how the planned permit regime for temporary labour will prevent false self-employment at YoungOnes, and what the Tax Authority has done after a letter flagging possible employer status. The minister answers that the Labour Inspectorate will focus on exposing such constructions and enforce against them, while the Tax Authority cannot comment on individual taxpayers and describes its general enforcement options, including a moratorium-based warning procedure.
The Labour Inspectorate will therefore, in its supervision and enforcement activities under the Temporary Agency Work Permit Act, pay attention to recognising and exposing sham constructions.

De Arbeidsinspectie zal daarom in haar toezichts- en handhavingsactiviteiten in het kader van de Wet toelating terbeschikkingstelling van arbeidskrachten aandacht hebben voor het onderkennen en blootleggen van schijnconstructies.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk en Aartsen over het bericht van de Hoge Raad: ‘Gratis verstrekking gezonde lunchmaaltijden aan werknemers valt voor de loonbelasting onder de gerichte vrijstelling voor Arbovoorzie

MPs Van Eijk and Aartsen asked whether the Supreme Court ruling that free healthy lunches fall under the tax exemption for occupational health provisions should be read broadly, and what the government will do to stimulate such lunches. The State Secretary answered that the ruling concerns pre-2022 rules, that since 2022 the exemption covers only mandatory occupational health provisions, that employers can provide healthy lunches using the WKR free space, and that the government sees no need or plan to change tax law, though an Arbo-regulation simplification plan is underway.
The cabinet considers it a good initiative that employers invest in keeping their staff healthy by providing healthy lunch meals.
Het kabinet vindt het een goed initiatief dat werkgevers zich door gezonde lunchmaaltijden te verstrekken inzetten om hun personeel gezond te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht 'Belastingstelsel kost eenverdienersgezin straks ook deel AOW'

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the abolition of transferability of the general tax credit leaves old-age pensioner couples worse off by about 1,000 euro a year, and whether this was foreseen and should be reversed. The State Secretary denies the claim for typical pensioner couples, acknowledges losses in specific cases such as negative business income or non-transferable credits for lower-earning partners, and declines to revise the decision.
The claim that AOW recipients lose around 1,000 euro per year is factually incorrect.
De stelling dat AOW'ers zo'n € 1.000 per jaar mislopen is feitelijk onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht 'Duitsland verhoogt vliegtaks: nu 70 euro belasting op verre vlucht'

MP Bamenga asked the government about Germany's distance-based aviation tax increase and whether the Netherlands should differentiate its flat flight tax by distance and include transfer passengers, as well as the effects on emissions, noise and state revenue. The State Secretary answered that the Dutch tax is kept flat for simplicity, that further changes are for a new cabinet, and that the government will not act on the alternatives in the February report.
The caretaker cabinet therefore did not follow up on the report.
Het demissionaire kabinet heeft zodoende geen vervolg gegeven aan het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over een VPB-vrijstelling voor kinderopvang naar voorbeeld van de zorg

An MP asked the ministers whether a corporate tax exemption for childcare organisations without profit motive, modelled on the healthcare exemption, could be created, and about its rationale, budget impact and needed amendments. The government answered that such an exemption is not justified because non-profit childcare providers compete with commercial firms, that introducing one would be very restrained and raises state aid concerns, and estimated a revenue loss of at least 10 million euros.
Given that non-profit childcare organisations compete with regular market parties, a subjective exemption for these organisations cannot be sufficiently justified.

Gegeven het feit dat kinderopvangorganisaties zonder winstoogmerk in concurrentie treden met reguliere marktpartijen laat een subjectieve vrijstelling voor deze organisaties zich niet voldoende rechtvaardigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Flach over de toepassing van de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling (BOR) in de agrarische sector

Two MPs from the SGP asked the Minister of Agriculture about how the business succession scheme (BOR) applies to crop-lease arrangements in agriculture, including whether the Grondkamer's rules on necessary crop rotation and the exclusion of grass and maize are fair to landowners. The Minister confirmed the rules, explained the rationale for excluding grass and maize, and declined to extend BOR treatment to one-sided crop leases before a planned revision of the Pachtwet.
When the crop lease regime was created, the legislature determined that it was not intended for maize and grass.
Bij de totstandkoming van de teeltpacht is door de wetgever bepaald dat het regime niet bedoeld is voor mais en gras
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Werf over een fiscaal neutraal pensioenkader in de tweede en derde pijler

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why pension saving in the second and third pillars is treated differently for the earned income tax credit and other rules, and whether this should be removed for a work-form-neutral pension framework. The State Secretary confirms the differences (e.g. the earned income definition, the company car, high-low pensions and bridging payments), acknowledges that harmonising the earned income definition would cost about 110 million euros per year and require major system changes, and leaves the decision on any change to a future Cabinet.
I leave it to a future Cabinet whether such a legislative amendment should take place and how it should be funded.
Ik laat het aan een volgend Kabinet of een dergelijke wetswijziging plaats dient te vinden en hoe deze gedekt dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens over partiële buitenlandse belastingplicht en de lucratiefbelangregeling

MPs Maatoug and Stultiens asked the State Secretary of Finance about a press report on expat managers at Action avoiding Dutch tax through the lucrative-interest rules and partial foreign tax liability, and about related schemes such as swapping gross pay for allowances and the box system. The State Secretary confirmed that combining partial foreign tax liability with the lucrative-interest pass-through obligation is not possible, that the Grinwis amendment abolishes partial liability from 2025, and that the tax authority has appealed contrary rulings, while stating that data on lucrative-interest application is unavailable and that the box system and tax equalisation will be reviewed by a future cabinet.
It is not possible to determine from Tax Authority data in how many cases the lucrative-interest rule applies.
Het is niet mogelijk om op basis van Belastingdienstgegevens in beeld te brengen in hoeveel gevallen de lucratief belangregeling van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach, Vedder, Postma, Grinwis en Pierik over de visserij en ETS-2

Five MPs asked whether fisheries should be brought under the EU ETS-2 carbon market and what the consequences would be for the sector. The minister answers that the cabinet has decided not to opt fisheries in, citing lack of a viable path for the sector, EU state-aid limits and unequal competition, and that a WECR impact study will be sent to Parliament.
The cabinet has now decided not to bring fisheries under ETS2 through the opt-in.
Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om visserij niet onder het ETS2 te brengen middels de opt-in
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat landen van de Europese Unie (EU) 33 miljoen euro per uur mislopen door de fiscale behandeling van superrijken

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister and State Secretary about reports that EU states lose 33 million euro per hour to the tax treatment of super-rich individuals, including wealth distribution, effective tax burdens, revenue losses and wealth registers. The government answered that it upholds that the strongest shoulders bear the heaviest burden, cited Dutch wealth concentration data, said tax avoidance cannot be precisely measured, and committed to exploring a stepwise EU/OECD approach and improved wealth statistics without committing to a wealth register.
It is therefore currently not possible to estimate how much tax revenue is missed due to a lower tax burden than intended, or to break down which combination of schemes causes this.

Het is daarom nu niet mogelijk een schatting te maken van hoeveel belastinginkomsten er gemist worden door een lagere belastingdruk dan is beoogd en een decompositie te maken door welke (combinatie van) regelingen dit veroorzaakt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over het Besluit met voorwaarden voor algemeen nut investeringen en het toezicht op algemeen nut beogende instellingen (ANBI’s)

The MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the new decree setting conditions for general-interest investments by ANBI charities, and whether it raises risks of misuse, definitional disputes, increased investment, or the need for stricter enforcement and oversight. The State Secretary replies that the conditions are carefully formulated, that no inherent misuse risk is seen, that enforcement intensification is not currently needed, and that the ANBI evaluation and digitalisation of oversight are underway.
This decree currently gives no reason to intensify enforcement of compliance by ANBIs.
Dit besluit geeft voor nu geen aanleiding voor intensivering van de handhaving op naleving door ANBI’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Maatoug en Dijk over belastingontwijking door de rijkste vrouw van Nederland

MPs Stultiens, Maatoug and Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by the richest woman in the Netherlands, including dividend-free capital repayments, the 5% participation exemption, and micro-company reporting rules. The government condemned tax avoidance but said capital repayments are lawful, declined to quantify or stop the routes, and promised only further study and EU-level work.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het artikel 'Hoe chemiebedrijf OCI zijn aandeelhoudersmiljarden uitkeert en de fiscus met lege handen achterblijft'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a press report that chemicals company OCI returned capital to shareholders, avoiding dividend tax, and whether this constitutes tax avoidance and should be curbed. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual tax files, said returning recognised capital is not dividend and not avoidance by itself, and saw no reason for new measures, while noting work on taxing high net worth individuals at OECD level.
Due to article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege artikel 67 AWR kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Teunissen over exportkredietverzekeringen voor de baggersector

MPs Hirsch and Teunissen asked the government about export credit insurance for dredging projects in Brazil, Egypt, the Philippines, the Maldives, Mozambique and Indonesia, including harms to fishers and farmers, the Mozambique LNG reassessment, human rights risks, withdrawal of cover, compliance with a 2018 motion, and transparency of ESAPs. The government answered that it does not recognise the report's picture, that a reassessment of Mozambique LNG is underway with results to be communicated, that it will not withdraw the policies, and that OECD and ADSB transparency rules limit publication of contract documents.
The cabinet is not considering withdrawing the export credit insurance for these projects.
Het kabinet overweegt niet om de exportkredietverzekeringen in te trekken voor deze projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht ‘Noodkreet gemeenten in Toeslagenaffaire’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that municipalities are overwhelmed by non-victims of the childcare benefits scandal claiming broad municipal support, and about how to speed up individual assessments and set limits on support. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, explained that non-victims should be referred to regular help, and pointed to ongoing assessment acceleration, data-sharing improvements and a forthcoming administrative consultation with the VNG, promising a progress report.
A administrative consultation with the VNG and the Ministry of SZW will soon take place to discuss these problems.
Binnenkort vindt er een bestuurlijk overleg plaats met de VNG en het Ministerie van SZW om deze problemen te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over de lokale lastendruk

A VVD MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and Minister De Jonge about local tax burdens, the split between waste, sewage and parking levies, and rules on parking charges. The minister answered with COELO figures on rising local levies from 2020 to 2024, the tariff systems used for waste charges, and stated that parking charge decisions lie with municipal councils.
It is for the municipal councils concerned to decide whether and where parking charges are levied.
Het is aan de betreffende gemeenteraden zelf om te beslissen of en waar parkeerbelastingen worden geheven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Welzijn over de Atlas van de lokale lasten, die is opgesteld door het instituut COELO van Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs Van Hijum and Welzijn asked the Minister of Interior about rising local taxes and charges per the COELO Atlas, including whether increases reflect autonomous choices or statutory obligations, their effect on rents, the large municipal surpluses, and the share of specific grants versus the municipal fund. The minister answered that local councils and water boards set their own charges democratically, that the data on the cause of increases is not known, and provided tables on grants and tax shares.
It is not known to what extent the increase in charges is related to autonomous choices by municipalities or results from statutory obligations.
Het is niet bekend in hoeverre de lastenstijging samenhangt met autonome keuzes van gemeenten dan wel het gevolg zijn van wettelijke verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over dat Appelsientje de frisdrankentaks ontwijkt door koemelk aan een product toe te voegen

An MP asked why fruit juice producer Appelsientje can avoid the soft drinks excise by adding a small amount of milk fat, and whether the government will close this loophole and reconsider the dairy exemption. The state secretary answered that the dairy exemption has existed since 1993 and is currently lawful, that a contour letter sets out options for a differentiated sugar-based levy and for changing the dairy exemption, and that any change would need 12 to 24 months of preparation by Customs.
The attached contour letter sets out the options for a differentiated consumption tax.
In bijgaande contourenbrief zijn de opties voor een gedifferentieerde verbruiksbelasting uiteengezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht ‘Appelsientje ontwijkt suikertaks met truc: vleugje zuivel maakt sap belastingvrij’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that adding a little dairy lets juice escape the sugar-related beverage excise, and whether a sugar-based tax should be introduced by 2026. The government says dairy and soy drinks remain exempt, that a sugar-differentiated excise is being put to parliament via a contour letter given its caretaker status, and that removing the dairy exemption is a structural change needing 12 to 24 months for Customs.
In the attached contour letter, I and the State Secretary for Health have explained the design of the current exemption for dairy and soy drinks.
In bijgaande contourenbrief heb ik samen met de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport de vormgeving van de huidige uitzondering voor zuivel- en sojadranken toegelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Marktplaats-melding aan fiscus blijkt ook risico voor uitkering; 'Overheid heeft geen goed track record in zulke zaken''.

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about risks that DAC7 platform data sharing with the tax authority could lead to benefit clawbacks and extra checks on welfare recipients selling goods online. The government answered that DAC7 creates no new obligations, that the tax authority only gives yes/no income signals to municipalities via the Inlichtingenbureau, that municipalities initiate checks, and that the effects will be monitored and reported in December 2024.

The Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions will inform the House in the Stand van de Uitvoering sociale zaken in December 2024 about the effects of platform data sharing on municipalities' enforcement activities.

De Minister voor Armoedebeleid, Participatie en Pensioenen informeert uw Kamer via de Stand van de Uitvoering sociale zaken in december 2024 over de effecten van de gegevensdeling van platformbedrijven op de handhavingsactiviteiten van gemeenten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de berichten ‘Chronisch zieke Anneke uit Buitenpost moet 16.000 euro terugbetalen aan Belastingdienst: “Het vreet me op”’ en ‘Excuses Belastingdienst voor chronisch zieke Bruinsma

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports of a chronically ill woman ordered to repay about 16,000 euros to the Tax Authority over disallowed specific care costs, and asked whether the treatment reflects distrust and harshness. The State Secretary acknowledged the regulation is being reviewed, said the Tax Authority aims to prevent such corrections, explained that refunds follow from statutory rules, declined to comment on the individual case still under objection, and provided figures on corrections and penalties from 2010 to 2022.
I cannot go into individual case details.
Ik kan niet op individuele casuïstiek ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de uitspraak van de rechter over belastingconstructies gericht op belastingontwijking

The MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling rejecting a PwC-designed tax avoidance structure, whether it falls under the DAC6/MDR reporting duty, how enforcement works, and how many reports have been received. The State Secretary says the structure falls outside MDR because it was a domestic merger, describes the enforcement and anti-avoidance measures taken, notes 7,666 Dutch reports received through 2023, and declines to discuss individual files citing tax secrecy.
Because of the tax confidentiality duty in Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot go into individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Van Eijk over de kamerbrief van 11 maart 2024 inzake het rapport ‘VAT Gap in the EU, report 2023’

MPs Idsinga and Van Eijk-Nagel asked the State Secretary of Finance about the VAT gap report, including the size of the gap, its main causes, fraud versus other causes, and Commission follow-up. The State Secretary answered that the 2022 gap is €3.6bn (4.9%), that causes include fraud, optimisation and administrative errors, and pointed to VIDA package measures, evaluation of the reduced VAT rate and questions about the Ecofin discussion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Idsinga over het bericht 'A historic step’: G20 discusses plans for global minimum tax on billionaires'

MPs Van Eijk and Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about a proposed global minimum tax on billionaires discussed at the G20, about how billionaires avoid tax, the revenue lost in the Netherlands, and national enforcement options, with 10 questions in total. The government answered that it is prioritising taxation of high net worth individuals in the OECD, will explore the issue step by step, and listed existing and planned anti-avoidance measures, while providing no revenue estimate and declining to commit to joining the initiative.
There is no estimate of the revenue of a minimum tax for billionaires in the Netherlands.
Er is geen raming van de opbrengst van een minimumbelasting voor miljardairs in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht 'Vermalen door het systeem'

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the rules for deducting homeopathic and other medical costs from income tax, and about how the Tax Authority handles errors and fraud among chronically ill taxpayers. The answer explains the legal conditions for deduction, reports that about 28% of returns claiming specific care costs contain correctable errors, and says the scheme is being evaluated for simplification and better targeting.
In working out solution directions, the cabinet will continue to involve the experiences of people with a disability and/or chronic illness and their representative organisations.

Het kabinet zal bij het in kaart brengen en uitwerken van de oplossingsrichtingen de ervaringen van mensen met een beperking en/of een chronische ziekte en diens vertegenwoordigende organisaties blijven betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Frauderisico bij brievenbus-bv’s: ‘In Muiden 403 bedrijven op één adres’’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report that 403 companies are registered at one address in Muiden, and whether Dutch shell-company red flags and mass registration enable concealment of illegal activity and tax avoidance. The State Secretary disputed that Dutch red-flag counts are high relative to other countries, acknowledged mass registration can hide money flows, and pointed to an AML package with a registration duty for domicile providers, FIU reporting, and EU-level Unshell measures, while stating that Tax Authority data analysis of risky addresses is not yet available.
I am curious about the outcomes of this research and will consider what is needed based on the FEC's conclusions.
Ik ben benieuwd naar de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en zal bezien wat nodig is, aan de hand van de conclusies van het FEC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Teunissen en Beckerman over belastingontwijking door bedrijven zoals Chemours

Three MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by Chemours, including whether its low corporate tax payments reflect transfer pricing and whether the Tax Authority supervises it. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual tax files under confidentiality rules, explained loss offset and arm's-length transfer pricing in general terms, and set out measures against tax avoidance and conduit companies.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de AWR kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga, Palmen-Schlangen en Omtzigt over een advies van de landsadvocaat

MPs Idsinga, Palmen-Schlangen and Omtzigt asked why the landsadvocaat's advice on the childcare benefits affair was released late, what changed between two versions of the letter, and how the 'Heidi' logging system worked, when it breached GDPR and how it linked to the Fraud Signalling Facility. The State Secretaries answered that the version was not final, explained Heidi's purpose and its suspension in 2017 and December 2023, and promised a further letter within three weeks on wider Tax Authority use of Heidi.
Your House will be informed within 3 weeks at the latest about how other parts of the Tax and Customs Administration used Heidi, for what purposes and which data were processed.
Uw Kamer wordt uiterlijk over 3 weken geïnformeerd over hoe andere onderdelen van de Belastingdienst gebruik hebben gemaakt van Heidi, voor welke doeleinde en welke gegevens hierbij verwerkt werden.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Sneller over belastingvoordelen voor bedrijven

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax benefits for business families under the business succession scheme (BOR), including whether relatives holding under 0.5% of shares should qualify and whether the scheme is needed in most cases. The State Secretary answered that the scheme aims to prevent inheritance and gift tax from endangering business continuity, disagreed that 75% of cases are unnecessary, and declined to estimate how much of the budgetary cost is truly necessary.
No, it is not possible to estimate which part of the budgetary cost of the BOR is truly necessary from the scheme's objective.
Nee, het is niet mogelijk om een inschatting te geven van welk deel van het budgettaire beslag van de BOR echt noodzakelijk is vanuit de doelstelling van de BOR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de gang van zaken met betrekking tot de Wet herwaardering proceskostenvergoedingen WOZ en bpm

An MP asks why the Wet herwaardering proceskostenvergoedingen WOZ en bpm applies transitional rules to reduced fees but not to direct payment of compensation into accounts in the claimant's name, and whether this is inconsistent and unreliable toward citizens. The Secretary of State defends the design: transitional rules protect pending claims, direct payment strengthens claimants' information position, and no retroactive extension is planned.
Not providing transitional law for direct payment does not infringe claimants' rights but in fact strengthens their information position and increases their involvement.

Het niet voorzien in overgangsrecht op het punt van rechtstreeks uitbetalen maakt geen inbreuk op de rechten van belanghebbenden, maar versterkt juist hun informatiepositie en vergroot hun betrokkenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat Pfizersgigawinsten in Nederland nog verder zijn gestegen naar 20 miljard euro

An MP from the SP asked the health and finance ministers how they would respond to reports that Pfizer's profits in the Netherlands rose to 20 billion euros, and what steps would prevent large pharmaceutical firms from making excessive profits from care funds and avoiding tax via the Netherlands. The minister said that profit is not something government can steer, that the government will pursue a demand-led medicines policy and wider societal debate on prices, declined to give Pfizer's hypothetical tax figures citing confidentiality, and pointed to existing and planned anti-avoidance measures.
I cannot make statements about the tax position of an individual taxpayer on the basis of the tax confidentiality obligation of art. 67 of the General State Taxes Act.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over de fiscale positie van een individueel belastingplichtige op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van art. 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het WEF en de belasting voor miljonairs en miljardairs

An SP MP asked the government whether it endorses the WEF participation and why taxpayers fund it, what the costs are, whether ministers account for outcomes, and what has been done about taxing millionaires and billionaires after motions on that topic. The minister replied that attendance offers networking and Dutch interests, listed accommodation costs of about 6,000 euros in total and that the government is transparent about its delegation, and referred to earlier studies (Bouwstenen 2020 and 2022, a 2023 letter and an IBO fiche on wealth tax) as the follow-up to the millionaire tax motions.
Besides six cabinet members, ten civil servants from the Netherlands travelled to Davos.
Naast zes kabinetsleden, zijn tien ambtenaren uit Nederland afgereisd naar Davos.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het artikel ‘Hoge Raad oordeelt in nadeel van de fiscus, boetes dividendstrippen onzeker’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a Supreme Court ruling that narrows the 'ultimate beneficiary' exception against dividend stripping, the number and value of pending cases, and whether the law or enforcement should be tightened. The State Secretary says the ruling clarifies the rules, the case is remitted to the Hague Court of Appeal, further anti-stripping research is underway with results expected in spring 2025, and no new measures are committed yet.
The House is expected to be informed of the outcomes of this research in spring 2025.
Naar verwachting zal de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2025 geïnformeerd worden over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga, Postma en Six Dijkstra over de berichten 'Verkopen op Vinted of Marktplaats? De Belastingdienst kijkt mee', 'Fiscus kijkt mee met verkoop op Vinted en Marktplaats: dit betekent he

MPs Idsinga, Postma and Six Dijkstra asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports that the Tax Authority will receive data on private online sellers on Vinted, Marktplaats and Bol under DAC7, raising concerns about tax burdens, unclear entrepreneur status, and privacy risks from collecting citizen service numbers. The State Secretary replied that DAC7 creates no new tax obligations, that the 30-transaction/2,000-euro threshold balances enforcement with feasibility, that personal data collection is necessary for proper taxation and protected under GDPR, and that the Tax Authority will expand public information rather than new rules, though several questions were answered only in part.
In addition, the Tax Authority is intensifying information provision to private individuals who sell, rent out or offer their services via online platforms.
Daarnaast intensiveert de Belastingdienst de voorlichting aan particulieren die verkopen, verhuren of hun diensten aanbieden via online platformen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel 'Verkopen op Vinted of Marktplaats? "De Belastingdienst kijkt mee"'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the DAC7 thresholds (30 transactions or EUR 2,000 per year) for platform reporting on private online sellers, and whether these create burdens for citizens and platforms. The State Secretary defended the thresholds as a balance between tax enforcement and workability, denied a central database of online income, and argued that DAC7 adds no new tax rules, though some questions were answered only in combined form.
There is no separate central database at the Tax Authority that stores online income of private individuals.
Er is bij de Belastingdienst geen aparte centrale database die online inkomsten van particulieren opslaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over zzp’ers in de schoonmaakbranche die hun werk verrichten in onveilige omstandigheden en een verhoogd risico lopen op armoede

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and the Minister's colleague at Finance about self-employed cleaners working in unsafe conditions, facing poverty risk and lacking social insurance protection. The government acknowledged the rise in one-person cleaning firms and the lack of protection for self-employed workers, pointed to planned measures (mandatory disability insurance for self-employed, enforcement against sham self-employment, arbovisie), but said it has no specific data on poverty or health risks in the cleaning sector.
I consider it undesirable that (vulnerable) self-employed persons are insufficiently protected against risks such as loss of income due to incapacity for work.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat (kwetsbare) zelfstandigen onvoldoende beschermd zijn tegen risico's zoals inkomensterugval door arbeidsongeschiktheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Voordeel familiehypotheek groter dan jubelton’

Van der Lee (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked whether family mortgages at market rates, where interest is effectively refunded, allow an unfair mortgage interest deduction that entrenches wealth inequality, and how large the budget impact is. The State Secretary answered that such constructions are not an undesirable tax construction, that the budgetary effect is estimated at around 150-200 million euros but possibly overstated, and that no plans exist to restrict the deduction.
Because the caretaker cabinet does not consider this an undesirable tax construction, it has no plans to restrict the mortgage interest deduction.
Omdat er naar de mening van het demissionaire kabinet geen sprake is van een «onwenselijke fiscale constructie» heeft het demissionaire kabinet geen plannen om de hypotheekrenteaftrek te beperken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de artikelen ‘Fiscus belast betaaltegoed oneerlijk, bedrag loopt op naar 130 miljoen euro’ en ‘Spaarders betalen hogere box 3-heffing na definitieve belastingaanslag’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports that the tax authority taxes current-account balances unfairly under the box 3 flat-rate system and about higher box 3 charges for savers after final assessments. The State Secretary defended taxing current accounts as bank deposits, refused a carve-out and a finer subcategory for bank balances, and promised a future actual-return box 3 system.
I am not willing to make an exception for current accounts.
Ik ben niet bereid om voor betaalrekeningen een uitzondering te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Amerikaanse multinationals ontwijken Nederlandse bijheffing minimumbelasting’

MP Van Eijk asked whether the temporary safe-harbour for the undertaxed profits rule, which delays the Dutch top-up tax on parent-subsidiary structures, creates an escape route for US multinationals, and what steps the government will take against avoidance. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, defended the temporary safe-harbour as an OECD/Inclusive Framework compromise limited to 2025-2026 that cannot be extended, said no further anti-avoidance measures are planned for now, and expected no lower tax revenue in 2024-2025.
The cabinet will address the effects of the Minimum Tax Act 2024 measures in future versions of the monitoring letter on the tackling of tax avoidance, once the tax return data are available.

Het kabinet zal in de volgende versies van de monitoringsbrief effecten aanpak belastingontwijking ingaan op de gevolgen van de maatregelen uit de Wet minimumbelasting 2024 wanneer de aangiftegegevens voorhanden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de artikelen ‘Amerikaanse multinationals ontwijken Nederlandse bijheffing minimumbelasting' en ‘OECD Pillar Two Impleme Dilemma'

Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports that US multinationals restructured to avoid Dutch and European top-up taxes under Pillar Two, and whether this reflects a prisoner's dilemma and an unwanted transitional safe harbour. The State Secretary said the number of firms is unknown, the impact is not expected to be large, the safe harbour is temporary and EU-agreed, and the Netherlands is bound by EU and OECD rules with built-in leverage.
I am not aware of how many companies this concerns.
Het is mij niet bekend om hoeveel bedrijven dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over het oprichten van een brievenbusfirma in Nederland door het grootse vleesbedrijf ter wereld

MPs Van Raan and Akerboom asked the government about JBS's plan to set up a Dutch holding company as part of a US listing, and about the environmental, animal welfare, corruption, labour and tax allegations against the firm. The government said it does not comment on individual companies, expects Dutch-based firms to follow OECD and UN due diligence standards, and said that tax-driven conduit companies are undesirable and that an EU-wide approach ('Unshell') is preferred.
However, the cabinet does not make statements about claims and possible violations of law by individual companies.
Het kabinet doet echter geen uitspraken over claims en mogelijke wetsovertredingen van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de antwoorden op eerdere schriftelijke vragen over fossiele subsidiesen de beprijzing van CO2-uitstoot

The MP asks the government to justify fossil fuel subsidies to major polluters, the choice of EUR 130/ton CO2 as a damage-cost reference versus German figures, and progress on phase-out paths. The minister defends the preventive-cost approach, lists recent carbon pricing measures, and says phase-out scenarios will be delivered around February 2024.
The cabinet has asked the independent chair of the Building Blocks report for a better and simpler tax system to develop the requested phase-out scenarios for fossil subsidies.

Het kabinet heeft aan de onafhankelijk voorzitter van het ambtelijk rapport Bouwstenen voor een beter en eenvoudiger belastingstelsel verzocht om de gevraagde afbouwscenario's voor «fossiele subsidies» uit te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over het bericht 'Rendement particuliere verhuurders onder druk'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vedder (CDA) asked about a study showing that the net return for private landlords falls sharply due to rising interest rates, the Wet betaalbare huur and tax measures, and whether this threatens rental supply. Minister De Jonge answered that the dataset is not representative, that the bill keeps investment in middle-rent attractive, and that the WWS will be made binding with stronger enforcement against overpriced rentals.
I will send the Wet betaalbare huur bill to your House shortly, so that it can take effect on 1 July 2024.
Het wetsvoorstel betaalbare huur zal ik op korte termijn aan uw Kamer sturen, zodat de inwerkingtreding per 1 juli 2024 kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de ANBI-status van Extinction Rebellion

An MP from JA21 asked whether Extinction Rebellion's ANBI tax status, and the disclosure of tax benefits, should be revoked after unlawful protest actions and whether the group should be banned under the Civil Code. The Secretary of State answered that tax confidentiality prevents disclosure about individual organisations, that ANBI status is tested neutrally and can be revoked only through the integrity test or a court ban, and that the Public Prosecution Service decides on any court ban.
The Tax Administration is bound by the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act and therefore cannot provide further information about individual organisations.

De Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) en kan daarom geen nadere informatie verstrekken over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over de extra belasting van woningcorporaties met betrekking tot schadevergoedingen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked why compensation paid to housing corporations for Groningen mining damage is taxed as corporate profit, and whether it should be exempted or compensated. The government replied that the compensation is fiscally neutral over time because associated repair costs offset it, that it sees no reason to defiscalise or compensate, and that the EUR 135 million subsidy, including EUR 750 per tenant, benefits tenants.
However, a compensation payment is fiscally neutral for housing corporations.
Een schadevergoeding pakt voor woningcorporaties echter fiscaal neutraal uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Vedder en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Ruim 200 boeren met bos krijgen onverwacht megaclaims van fiscus’

MPs Inge van Dijk, Vedder and Van der Plas asked whether farmers who joined the set-aside scheme and planted fast-growing forest were wrongly denied the agricultural exemption and faced tax assessments after decades. The State Secretary of Finance answers that the Tax Authority's position is consistent, that no assurances were given about the agricultural exemption, and that the pending Supreme Court ruling will be awaited.
As with our answers of 5 September 2023 to the previous questions from your House on this subject, we note at the outset that the case is still before the courts.
Net als bij onze antwoorden van 5 september 2023 op de vorige vragen van uw Kamer over dit onderwerp stellen wij voorop dat de zaak nog onder de rechter is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Plotseling tekort van 126 miljoen voor tolvrije tunnel: ‘We kunnen in 2030 toch niet weer poortjes neerzetten?'

MPs Grinwis and Van der Graaf asked about a reported 126 million euro shortfall for making the Westerscheldetunnel toll-free, linked to the controversial status of Betalen naar Gebruik. The minister said a toll-free tunnel from 2025 is agreed with Zeeland, that the Rijk has committed to funding 2030–2033, but declined to give firm guarantees about future tolling and deferred the matter to a new cabinet.
Declaring Betalen naar Gebruik controversial does not yet mean that BNG will not go ahead.
Het controversieel verklaren van Betalen naar Gebruik (BNG) betekent nog niet dat BNG niet doorgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het 'eindrapport onderzoek regeldruk bij vrijwilligersorganisaties en filantropische instellingen'

An MP from the CDA asks the government why its acknowledgement that red tape for volunteer organisations is a serious problem has not led to concrete measures, how the Beleidskompas ensures volunteer organisations are consulted, whether the AVG obligations and the volunteer allowance should be changed, and what a further volunteer allowance increase would cost. The government replies that it is working on a plan of action with the sector, that the Beleidskompas will be evaluated before any changes, that banks have adopted a new sector standard reducing checks on non-profits, that AVG obligations will not be reduced, and that raising the volunteer allowance by 500 euro would cost about 3 million euro a year, while promising a further policy response in December 2023.
We are therefore holding talks with various departments, the sector and other relevant stakeholders to arrive at concrete and serious measures to counter the red tape.
Wij zijn daarom met verschillende departementen, de sector en andere relevante betrokkenen gesprekken aan het voeren om tot concrete en serieuze maatregelen te komen om de regeldruk tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het onderzoek naar het (risico)profiel UT001

An MP asks why the Tax Authority withheld documents on the UT001 risk profile during the investigation, whether all related files can be produced, how records were stored and deleted, and whether nationality or birthplace indicators were used. The State Secretary answers that six informal drafts were supplied late, a targeted search found further documents which are being provided, retention rules and information management gaps are acknowledged, and the 2022 decision to reject the profile is referenced.
The exception is six documents without formal status that were only provided during the adversarial hearing procedure.
Uitzondering hierop zijn een zestal documenten zonder formele status die pas tijdens de procedure van wederhoor zijn verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Inge van Dijk, Temmink, Van der Plas en Dekker-Abdulaziz over de RAM database bij de Belastingdienst

Five MPs asked the government about the RAM database at the Belastingdienst, including whether privacy impact assessments were done, whether parliament was misinformed, and why an external investigation is needed. The State Secretary answered that an external investigation and an investigation by the Dutch Data Protection Authority are pending, so definitive answers and the legality question cannot yet be given, and that memos and documents will be sent later.
I wish to emphasise that definitive answers can only be given after the external investigation and the investigation by the AP.
Ik wil daarbij benadrukken dat pas na het externe onderzoek en het onderzoek door de AP definitieve antwoorden gegeven kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de social media politie

MP Van Haga asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Authority (Belastingdienst) collected large amounts of sensitive personal data, including from social media, through the RAM system, and whether RAM was set up to monitor disfavoured people and opinions. The State Secretary answered that conclusions must await the ongoing investigations by the Tax Authority and the Dutch Data Protection Authority, that RAM was not created to monitor disfavoured opinions but for supervision, and that an external investigation into RAM will be instituted.
Only after these investigations are completed can conclusions be drawn about RAM and any actions be taken.
