Pas na afronding van deze onderzoeken kunnen conclusies worden getrokken over RAM en eventuele acties ondernomen worden.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over armoede onder middeninkomens

An MP asked the government about very low net incomes and extreme marginal tax rates faced by middle-income households through combined benefit and tax schemes, and whether these effects were foreseen. The government acknowledges these outcomes are undesirable, explains methodological differences, notes a planned temporary bridging measure and a structural fiscal fix for single-earner couples from 2028, but says no simple solutions exist for the extreme marginal rates.
The cabinet commits to a structural solution through the tax system.
Het kabinet committeert zich aan een structurele oplossing via de fiscaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Herstel van Toeslagenaffaire groeit uit tot peperdure, ambtelijke moloch'

Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the government knowingly made unachievable promises to victims of the childcare benefits scandal, whether the recovery operation's delays can be solved by shortening rather than extending deadlines, and what is being done about slow processing, professional objection agencies, administrative costs and urgent cases. The State Secretary answered that the statutory deadlines proved unachievable due to larger-than-expected inflow, that the focus is on shortening processing times with the integrated assessment expected by 2025, and that urgency routes and other measures are being introduced.
At the start of the recovery operation, the cabinet, anticipating the inflow of affected parents, chose a relatively generous statutory period of 6 months, extendable by another 6 months.

Bij de start van de hersteloperatie heeft het kabinet, met het oog op de verwachte toestroom van gedupeerde ouders, voor een relatief ruime wettelijke termijn gekozen van 6 maanden, met mogelijkheid tot verlenging met nogmaals 6 maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over mogelijke discriminatie van de As-Soennah-moskee

An MP from DENK asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority discriminated against the As-Soennah mosque, why mosques were treated as a fraud risk, and why selection criteria were withheld in court. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual taxpayer citing tax confidentiality, said a pro forma appeal and a KPMG review of the CAF unit are pending, and explained that giftenaftrek fraud had been concentrated partly within the Islamic community.
Because of the tax confidentiality obligation (art. 67 AWR), I cannot address an individual taxpayer or the questions asked about them.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht (art. 67 AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op een individuele belastingplichtige en de gestelde vragen daarover.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het stelselmatig achterhouden van stukken door de Belastingdienst en discriminatie van de islamitische instellingen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority allegedly withholding case documents from a court, targeting Islamic institutions through risk selection based on nationality, and revoking a mosque's ANBI status retroactively. The State Secretary answers that much cannot be disclosed due to tax confidentiality and pending appeal, denies a structural problem, and promises a KPMG report and an IBTD inspection.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Palland en Amhaouch over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag inzake het onterecht intrekken van de ANBI-status van de As-Soennah-moskee

MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Hague district court ruling that the tax authority wrongly revoked the ANBI status of the As-Soennah mosque, and whether selection of ANBI institutions was based on nationality or religion. The State Secretary declined to address individual taxpayers citing fiscal secrecy, noted pro forma appeal, explained the selection practice in general terms and said the mosque-related CAF investigation continues.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation, I cannot address an individual taxpayer.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik niet ingaan op een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de verwachte grenseffecten van de stijgingen van de accijnzen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the expected cross-border effects of excise increases on petrol and diesel, including how much revenue is lost and what the acceptable excise gap with neighbouring countries is. The government answered that a study estimates lower excise revenue of roughly EUR 122-207 million per year for petrol and EUR 32-136 million for diesel, but declined to give a reasonable maximum excise gap or to answer the hypothetical half-increase scenario, pointing to forthcoming study updates.
On the basis of the current cross-border effects study, that is not possible.
Op basis van het huidige grenseffectenonderzoek is dat niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Romke de Jong (D66) over het bericht 'Afschaffing btw op groente en fruit dreigt te sneuvelen'

MPs Grinwis and Romke de Jong asked why the government doubts introducing a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables despite coalition support and the Prime Minister's remark that the tax service can implement it. The state secretaries answer that no decision has been taken, that the zero rate would invite endless legal challenges under the neutrality principle and cost 550-950 million euros, and that implementation on 1 January 2024 is not advisable.
No decision has yet been taken on whether to introduce a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables and/or alternative health measures.
Er heeft nog geen besluitvorming plaatsgevonden over het al dan niet invoeren van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit en/of alternatieve gezondheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van het lid Van Haga over de problemen bij het afschaffen van btw op groente en fruiover het btw-nultarief op leveringen van groente en fruit

An MP asked the Finance and Health ministers about the problems with abolishing VAT on fruit and vegetables, including costs, legal definition issues, and the Tax Administration's enforceability concerns. The government answered that no decision has been taken, that budgetary impact ranges from 500 to 950 million euros depending on the variant, and that a legally defensible demarcation is difficult, leaving the choice to a future cabinet.
No decision has yet been taken on whether to introduce a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables and/or alternative health measures.
Er heeft nog geen besluitvorming plaatsgevonden over het al dan niet invoeren van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit en/of alternatieve gezondheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Beleidsmakers en wetenschappers: afschaffen btw op groente en fruit is ‘effectief en uitvoerbaar’’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Health why the government did not follow a group of experts calling for abolishing VAT on fruit and vegetables, given SEO's finding of only a small sales effect and its claim of legal complications. The government, in a caretaker position, said it shares the goal of healthy eating, that the decision on a zero VAT rate is left to the next cabinet, and that it will weigh the measure against alternative health measures without disputing the SEO findings.
Decision-making on whether or not to introduce a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables, and on any introduction date, is left by the cabinet, given its caretaker status, to a next cabinet.

Besluitvorming over het al dan niet invoeren van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit, alsmede over de eventuele invoeringsdatum daarvan, laat het kabinet gezien haar demissionaire status aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de effectiviteit van het afschaffen van de btw op groente en fruit in landen waar dit al is toegepast

An MP asked the government about the effectiveness of abolishing VAT on fruit and vegetables in countries where this was done, including health and purchasing-power effects, and whether the OECD should study it. The government answered that no decision has been taken, that information on other countries' measures is limited, and that the decision is for a next cabinet.
No decision has yet been taken on whether to introduce a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables and/or alternative health measures.
Er heeft nog geen besluitvorming plaatsgevonden over het al dan niet invoeren van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit en/of alternatieve gezondheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op ragen van Inge van Dijk, Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht Koester familiebedrijven, ze dragen de economie

MPs Inge van Dijk, Palland and Amhaouch asked whether family businesses deserve protection and whether the planned tightening of the business succession exemption (BOR) risks harming them, citing commentary by Maarten de Groot. The State Secretary agreed family firms add substantial economic value and should be supported, but rejected claims that the BOR changes would threaten them, citing a CPB evaluation, and promised to report after a pending study requested by a motion.
The cabinet does not expect that the announced adjustments to the BOR will lead to this.
Het kabinet verwacht niet dat de aangekondigde aanpassingen in de BOR hier toe zullen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het 'eindrapport onderzoek regeldruk bij vrijwilligersorganisaties en filantropische instellingen'

An MP from the CDA asks the government to respond to the final report on administrative burden for volunteer organisations and philanthropic institutions, including whether the AVG and Wwft obligations should be relaxed for small organisations and how departments coordinate. The State Secretary answers that burden is a serious problem, points to ongoing talks with the sector, and declines to exempt small organisations from the AVG while promising a fuller response in December.

The cabinet considers it very important to reduce the administrative burden on volunteer organisations and philanthropic institutions given the important social value of these organisations in our society.

Het kabinet vindt het erg belangrijk om de regeldruklasten bij vrijwilligersorganisaties en filantropische instellingen te verminderen gezien de belangrijke maatschappelijke waarde in onze samenleving van deze organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker  en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Keer op keer werd de minister gewaarschuwd, en nu heeft Nederland 450.000 nieuwe gokkers'

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether the government was warned about online gambling advertising increasing youth gambling after the 2021 Kansspelen op afstand law, and about the Finance Ministry's dealings with Nederlandse Loterij and the gambling sector. The minister declined to answer the historical questions substantively, promising a Kamerbrief after a document search, and summarised later advertising restrictions and the Finance Ministry's shareholder pressure on Nederlandse Loterij.
Answering these questions is only possible after a thorough search of information and communication systems and archives within my ministry.
Beantwoording van deze vragen acht ik alleen mogelijk na een grondige zoekslag in informatie- en communicatiesystemen en archieven binnen mijn ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Boswijk en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Ruim 200 boeren met bos krijgen onverwachts megaclaims van fiscus’

MPs from CDA and BBB asked whether the Ministry of Agriculture gave farmers who converted land to fast-growing forest under the set-aside scheme a promise that the land would remain agricultural, and why the Tax Authority now taxes capital gains on that land. The minister answers that the ministry only commented on the planning designation, which stayed agricultural, while the tax authority applies the agricultural exemption only to periods when land was used within a farm business, so the case is pending before the Supreme Court and no concrete remedy is offered.
Because the case is still before the courts, we follow the line of recent court rulings in this answer and await the Supreme Court's judgment.
Omdat de zaak nog onder de rechter is volgen we de lijn van de recente rechterlijke uitspraken in deze beantwoording en wachten we het oordeel van de Hoge Raad af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de accijnzen per 1 januari 2024

MP Omtzigt asked about the scheduled 2024 excise duty increases on petrol and diesel, indexation, EU comparisons, cross-border price differences, and the tax-free mileage allowance. The state secretary confirmed the scheduled increases under unchanged policy, noted the government would not anticipate the August budget decision, and said a higher allowance would be considered in that decision.
During the treatment of the Tax Plan 2023 I promised to consider raising the tax-free mileage allowance from 2024 to €0.23 per kilometre.
Tijdens de behandeling van het Belastingplan 2023 heb ik toegezegd om een verhoging van de onbelaste reiskostenvergoeding per 2024 naar € 0,23 per kilometer te bezien.

Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘de negatieve impact op het midden- en kleinbedrijf (mkb) van earningsstrippingmaatregel (wijziging artikel 15b Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting per 1 januari 2025)’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the impact on SMEs of removing the EUR 1 million threshold from the earnings-stripping rule for real estate entities renting out property from 1 January 2025, and about the rationale, transition period and alternatives. The government answered that the measure targets artificial splitting of property investments across companies, that the details are still being worked out, and that it sees no reason for a transition period.
The design of the measure will be further elaborated in the coming period. The impact of the measure depends on its final design.
De vormgeving van de maatregel zal in de komende periode nader worden uitgewerkt. De impact van de maatregel is afhankelijk van de uiteindelijke vormgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over de stichting de Vrienden van XR

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Idsinga asked about the Stichting Vrienden van XR, its alleged role funnelling money to Extinction Rebellion, government subsidies to related organisations, its ANBI status, and civil liability for disruptive actions. The Minister answered that the government has no subsidy relationship with XR or the foundation, that ANBI status is assessed neutrally by the tax authority, and that civil liability for unlawful acts is for courts to decide.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to assess such statements.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om hier in de beoordeling te treden van dergelijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Grevink over de uitspraak van Gerechtshof ’s-Hertogenbosch over forse verhoging van de forensenbelasting in 2020

MPs Idsinga and Grevink (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior whether the government shares concern about a court ruling on a sharp municipal forensenbelasting increase and whether municipalities are overstepping their powers. The minister replied that municipal taxation is an autonomous competence, that the courts and municipal politics provide sufficient safeguards, and declined to assess the case or propose new limits.

The tax levy concerned is an autonomous competence of the municipality and, given the role of the independent judge, it is not for me to give a judgment on the assessment and/or the court ruling on it.

De betreffende belastingheffing is een autonome bevoegdheid van de gemeente en gegeven de rol van de onafhankelijke rechter, is het niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de aanslag en/of de rechtelijke uitspraak daarover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boutkan en Inge van Dijk over de ongelijke fiscale behandeling grenswerkers

MPs Boutkan and Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about unequal tax treatment of cross-border workers who work from home, and about negotiations with Germany and Belgium and a possible temporary arrangement like the COVID-era one. The government says it will pursue a bilateral home-working measure with Germany and Belgium, form an EU-level taskforce, and rejects a temporary COVID-style agreement as unsuitable for a permanent solution.
The Netherlands wants to include a home-working measure aimed at cross-border workers in the bilateral tax treaties with Germany and Belgium.
Nederland wil in de bilaterale belastingverdragen met Duitsland en België een thuiswerkmaatregel gericht op grenswerkers opnemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Belasting betalen over geld dat je nooit hebt verdiend: box 3 'desastreus' voor start-ups'

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance how the planned box 3 reform, taxing actual returns through an unrealised-gains (vermogensaanwas) tax, would affect startup employees and angel investors, and how this squares with the stock-option rules. The State Secretary acknowledges the concerns, notes the liquidity problem and that the final design, including a possible realisation-based alternative, is not yet decided, and promises to take the signals into account and consider mitigating measures.
Measures to mitigate the identified liquidity problem are currently being examined.
Momenteel wordt onderzocht welke maatregelen getroffen kunnen worden om het gesignaleerde liquiditeitsprobleem te mitigeren.
Antwoord opvragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht ‘Monaco: belastingparadijs voor topsporters’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Monaco is a tax haven for top athletes, including how many Dutch residents live there, the revenue lost, and options to counter tax avoidance by high-income Dutch citizens abroad. The government answered that 12 of 75 examined Monaco cases yielded over 31 million euro in corrections, that residence is taxed on the basis of habitual residence rather than nationality, and that it would explore international measures for high net worth individuals while tempering expectations.
The Tax Administration has no current overall picture of this; this information is not systematically recorded.
De Belastingdienst heeft geen actueel totaalbeeld hiervan; deze informatie wordt niet systematisch bijgehouden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over rechtvaardige compensaties voor SBF-ers die door privatiseringen onder andere ministeries werkten dan het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (J&V) en nog geen uitzicht he

An SP MP asked why former SBF employees of privatised TBS clinics and youth institutions have not been compensated like Justice and Security civil servants, and whether the clinics should be held to earlier agreements. The Minister replied that compensation is the responsibility of the privatised clinics and institutions as employers, not the state, and declined to direct them.
It is the responsibility of the privatised clinic or institution to determine whether compensation is due to the SBF leave employee of that clinic or institution.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de verzelfstandigde kliniek of inrichting om na te gaan of een compensatie aan de orde is voor de SBF-verlofmedewerker van die kliniek of inrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het recht op de arbeidskorting van mensen met een arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering

An MP asks whether the government will follow a court ruling that the labour tax credit (arbeidskorting) should apply to disability benefits paid via employers, questions the size and justification of the difference, and asks for worked examples and historical figures. The Secretary of State answers that the government has appealed the ruling to the Supreme Court, provides calculations showing the net income gap, defends the policy aims in general terms, and says a cabinet response will follow in summer.
I have appealed against this ruling to the Supreme Court.
Tegen deze uitspraak ben ik in cassatie gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Van Weyenberg over het verbod op FATCA-doorgiftes op basis van de General Data Protection Legislation (GDPR) in België

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Belgian data protection authority's ban on passing tax data of Belgian accidental Americans to the US under the GDPR, and whether the Dutch FATCA arrangement complies with the GDPR and what the Dutch privacy authority has assessed. The State Secretary answered that the Belgian ruling does not affect the bilateral and EU efforts, that the Dutch privacy authority's earlier advice found no GDPR-conflict and that pending individual procedures will be awaited rather than reopening the advice, and that the Belgian ruling has no direct consequences for Dutch data exchange.
I think it is important that the AP is given time to form its judgment and I do not want to interfere with ongoing procedures.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de AP de tijd krijgt voor oordeelsvorming en ik wil lopende procedures niet doorkruisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het onderzoek van de Algemene Rekenkamer 'Betalingsregelingen bij uitvoeringsorganisaties van het Rijk

MP Ceder asks how the government views the Court of Audit finding that people with tailored payment arrangements may still fall into hardship because the subsistence minimum is insufficiently protected, and what will be done about it, including common norms, automatic insight into debts, and ways to reduce the effort required. The minister commits to working with agencies on protecting the subsistence minimum, exploring legal changes for shared debt visibility, and developing a government debt overview, while the Tax Authority says it cannot yet guarantee the minimum due to limited information on private debts.
I want to investigate whether it is possible to amend the laws and regulations on this point.
Ik wil onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om de wet- en regelgeving op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de fiscale maatregelen voor de glastuinbouw

CDA MPs asked the government about the impact of planned energy tax changes on greenhouse growers, the feasibility of transition timelines, the treatment of combined heat and power plants, and fairness between small and large growers. The government acknowledges the strong impact, points to a combined package of measures and a possible phase-in path decided in August 2023, and says it will consider a revised proposal pending EU state aid approval.
The cabinet will decide in August 2023, based on an impact analysis yet to be published, whether to possibly adopt a phase-in path with substantial steps from 2025.
Het kabinet besluit in augustus 2023 op basis van een nog te verschijnen impactanalyse eventueel tot een ingroeipad met substantiële stappen vanaf 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over het belasten van de eigen woning in box 3

An MP from FvD asked the Finance ministers whether they were aware of DNB and IMF analyses recommending moving the owner-occupied home into box 3, and whether they intended to do so. The Staatssecretaris answered that a vision on the owner-occupied home scheme will be presented in 2024, but no move to box 3 is planned because the box 3 reform is not yet settled and takes effect only in 2027.
I aim to send my vision to your House in 2024.
Ik streef ernaar om mijn visie in 2024 aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de wijze van verstrekken van informatie uit Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV) door de Belastingdienst aan gemeenten en andere samenwerkende instanties

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance how the Belastingdienst shares FSV fraud-signalling information with municipalities and cooperating bodies, including data deletion, legal bases, LSI intervention-team practices and the IVT system. The government answers that organisations were asked to delete FSV-related data, that many questions cannot be reconstructed or will be answered later, and that it will inform parliament in a progress letter before the next debate.
I cannot answer the question on sharing of incidental data within the set deadline. I will inform the House further through the progress letter sent before the next Belastingdienst committee debate.
Voor de deling van incidentele gegevens kan ik binnen de gestelde termijn de vraag niet beantwoorden. Ik zal uw Kamer nader informeren via de stand van zaken brief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder het niveau van een bijstandsuitkering omdat de regelingen niet op elkaar aansluiten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the government about thousands of households living below the social assistance level because income schemes do not align, asking for structural fixes, the effects of the double general tax credit reduction, and compensation options. The ministers answered that a structural solution is urgently needed, that options are being explored with a report due before June 2023, and that the answers include detailed budget and income calculations for example households.
As promised in the letter of 29 March, we will inform the House before June 2023 about progress in searching for solution directions.
Zoals toegezegd in de brief van 29 maart 1 zullen wij de Kamer vóór juni 2023 informeren over de vorderingen van het zoeken naar oplossingsrichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Gewiekst vindt graanhandelaar Cargill toch weer een route om belasting te ontwijken, via Nederland

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary of Finance whether multinationals such as Cargill still avoid tax via the Netherlands and Luxembourg, and how such structures work. The government says it cannot discuss individual firms due to tax secrecy, points to anti-avoidance measures and the coming Pillar 2 minimum tax, and sees no need for additional measures yet.
I cannot discuss the tax situation of an individual company because of the tax secrecy obligation under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR).
Ik kan niet ingaan op de fiscale situatie van een individueel bedrijf vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het artikel 'Belastingmedewerkers gedumpt op de drempel: 'Toeslagenaffaire verbaast me niks, ze liegen tot het bittere einde''

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Telegraaf article alleging the Tax Administration wrongly accused staff of misuse, corruption and integrity breaches, and whether this reflects a poor working climate at the Tax Administration and FIOD. The State Secretary declined to comment on individual cases, described the existing integrity procedures and oversight bodies (OIF, CIF, confidential advisers), said the working climate is healthy, and did not recognise the described picture.
As State Secretary I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Als Staatssecretaris kan ik geen uitspraken doen over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het artikel ''Huiseigenaren geschokt door hoge WOZ-taxaties: 'Makkelijk scoren door schuld bij bezwaarbureaus te leggen"

MP Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about a news report claiming four in ten homeowners who object to WOZ valuations win their case, and asked whether oversight of municipalities and the Waarderingskamer should be tightened. The State Secretary confirmed the figures, acknowledged the rate is high, said informal pre-objection contact may be made legally mandatory and the Waarderingskamer's oversight is being examined, but rejected the claim that homeowners are structurally overtaxed and said no direct link exists between the Waarderingskamer's ratings and successful objections.
As indicated in answering the previous questions, I do not share the conclusion that homeowners are structurally overtaxed.
Zoals bij de beantwoording van voorgaande vragen is aangegeven, deel ik de conclusie dat huiseigenaren structureel veel te hoog worden aangeslagen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht 'Medewerkers op Schiphol krijgen deze zomer 840 euro per maand extra'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland (CDA) asked about reports that Schiphol staff would receive extra pay via a summer bonus and an allowance rather than a raised collective wage, and about how these payments affect net income, benefit entitlements and repayment risk. The government gave a detailed answer with example calculations showing high marginal tax burdens for some groups, and said it was in contact with Schiphol and the unions, with no new binding commitment beyond existing ones.
I have asked Schiphol whether it is aware of this.
Ik heb Schiphol gevraagd of hier oog voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over eenverdieners en middeninkomens

An MP asks the Social Affairs and Finance ministers about single-earner households with middle incomes ending up with less net income than benefit recipients, and about the tax burden and purchasing-power support for them. The government acknowledges the problem, points to ongoing reviews of tax reliefs and the childcare and benefit reforms, and says it will return with a fuller letter on the single-earner benefit-interaction issue and results of its evaluations.
It is not good that in the seven years this problem has been known, no solution has been reached.
Het is niet goed dat er in de zeven jaar dat deze problematiek bekend is, niet tot een oplossing is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Idsinga over de door de fiscus gestuurde aanmaning naar ondernemers

MPs Aartsen and Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about the tax authority's letters warning entrepreneurs of payment arrears on corona tax debts, asking how many were sent, why the arrears amount was not stated, and how to avoid unnecessary warnings. The State Secretary answered that about 80,000 entrepreneurs received a letter, that the arrears amount was omitted because the system cannot compute it in mass mailings, and described a phased process including debt overviews, a helpline, and eventual withdrawal of payment arrangements.
The exact amount of the payment arrears was not included, because it is not possible for the Tax Authority to process this amount in mass messages.
Daarbij is niet het exacte bedrag van de betalingsachterstand opgenomen, omdat het voor de Belastingdienst niet mogelijk is dit bedrag in massale berichten te verwerken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van der Lee over de verhuizing van Ferrovial

MPs Nijboer and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary of Finance about Ferrovial's planned move of its top holding company to the Netherlands, including contacts with Dutch bodies, possible tax arrangements, and revenue effects. The State Secretary answered that the company gave no tax motives, that the Tax Authority cannot disclose a taxpayer's fiscal position, that no recent Tax Authority contact occurred, and that revenue effects cannot be reliably estimated.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act, however, it is not permitted to make information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer publicly known.
Op basis van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen is het echter niet toegestaan informatie over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige voor iedereen kenbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de ‘uitwringpraktijk’

MP Nijboer asks whether private equity buyouts load target companies with excessive debt, whether the Dutch ban on financial assistance should be reinstated for BVs, and whether this risks collapses and harm to workers and creditors. The minister answers that excesses are rare, that earnings-stripping and interest-deduction limits and director liability already apply, and that there is no need to reinstate the ban, promising no new measures.
I do not think companies should be separated from acquisition financing, other than what is already regulated in book 2 of the Civil Code.
Ik vind niet dat ondernemingen gescheiden zouden moeten worden van de aankoopfinanciering, anders dan nu al geregeld in boek 2 van het BW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het opiniestuk 'Arbeidskorting werkt averechts, waarom grijpt politiek niet in?'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the degressive phase-out of the earned income tax credit above €37,691 harms work incentives and whether a tax-free allowance would be considered. The government answered that the phase-out raises marginal tax rates but that removing it is costly and only modestly effective, and that a tax-free allowance is possible but complex, with income effects to be weighed, without committing to a specific study timeline.
Not phasing out the earned income tax credit would also have considerable budgetary consequences.
Het niet afbouwen van de arbeidskorting heeft daarnaast forse budgettaire consequenties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over de Nederlandse steun voor het project van Boskalis in Manila

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked the government about Dutch support (export credit insurance) for Boskalis's New Manila International Airport project, including alleged rights and environmental harms, information-sharing, compensation of fishers and the Global Witness allegations. The government answered that ADSB and Boskalis meet OECD/UN standards, that compensation is being carried out under monitoring by independent consultants, and that it sees no need for additional measures or an independent investigation, while commissioning a monitoring review by Steward Redqueen.
This picture is confirmed by ADSB, which had an independent consultant investigate this aspect.
Dit beeld wordt bevestigd door ADSB die een onafhankelijke consultant onderzoek heeft laten doen naar dit aspect.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Romke de Jong over btw op menselijke geslachtscellen

Two D66 MPs asked why human sperm and egg cells used for reproductive donation are taxed at the 21% general VAT rate, higher than the 9% rate for animal sperm, and why they are not exempt like human organs, blood and breast milk, and whether costs for people with a fertility wish should be reduced. The government answered that the EU VAT Directive offers no room for a reduced or exempt rate for human germ cells, that exemptions must be interpreted strictly, that the Embryowet already caps fees charged by sperm and egg banks, and that an EU amendment is not foreseen.
However, the VAT Directive offers no scope to apply the reduced rate to germ cells supplied to humans for reproductive purposes, so the standard rate of 21% applies to them.

De Btw-richtlijn biedt echter geen ruimte om het verlaagde tarief toe te passen op geslachtscellen die voor reproductieve doeleinden bij mensen worden geleverd, waardoor hierop het algemene tarief van 21% van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch, Vestering en Van Raan over het bericht 'Havermelk duurder door 'limonadebelasting''

Three PvdD MPs asked whether the planned increase in the beverage consumption tax, which exempts dairy drinks but taxes most plant-based milk drinks, is consistent with health and protein policy, and whether the exemption for sugary dairy drinks will be removed. The government confirmed the budget-driven increase, defended the dairy exemption on nutritional grounds, and said a study on sugar taxation is ongoing with results due in 2023, without committing to specific changes.
It is correct that the consumption tax on non-alcoholic drinks (hereinafter: consumption tax) is being increased.
Het klopt dat de verbruiksbelasting van alcoholvrije dranken (hierna: verbruiksbelasting) wordt verhoogd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht dat geld voor ontwikkelingshulp in belastingparadijzen belandt

MPs Alkaya and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch development aid routed through PIDG, its Mauritius-based trust and the Guernsey-managed EAIF fund, could end up in tax havens, and how that fits Dutch anti-avoidance policy. Minister Schreinemacher answered that PIDG's trust is fiscally resident in the UK, that the fund manager was selected in 2016 under older tax rules, that PIDG now applies EDFI responsible tax principles, and that the ministry will explore a tax guideline and discuss a structure analysis with donors.
I am examining the possibilities for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Finance to draw up a guideline for this.
Ik ben aan het bezien wat de mogelijkheden zijn om vanuit het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en het Ministerie van Financiën een richtlijn hiervoor op te stellen

Antwoord op vragenvan het lid Omtzigt over de LSI-verslagen, de uitspraak van het Europese Hof d.d. 12 januari 2023 over informatie over het verstrekken van data over persoonsgegevens, alsmede de uitspraak van de Raad va

An MP asks the government about GDPR access rights to recipients of personal data (CJEU ruling), whether a 'code 88' fraud-list marking is personal data, and whether individuals may access the reasons for fraud investigations (Council of State ruling), plus questions on LSI intervention-team records, risk lists, home-entry consent and related documents. The government largely answers that access rights are subject to limits and that code 88 becomes personal data only within a dataset, gives limited information where records no longer exist, and commits to a FSV letter and an LSI evaluation.
For that reason, the information provided to the data subject must be as precise as possible.
Daarom dient de verstrekte informatie aan de betrokkene zo nauwkeurig mogelijk te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gündoğan over het bericht ‘Kabinet biedt alternatief voor aangekondigde vermogensbelasting’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about the government's alternative to the planned real-return wealth tax, including the Tax Authority's IT burden, information gaps, complexity and precedent in other OECD countries. The State Secretary answered that a real-return system is still being prepared, that a refined flat-rate alternative is less complex to implement but shifts workload to service and oversight, and that a detailed implementation assessment and a letter on box 3 are still pending.
An implementation assessment quantifying the effects has not yet taken place and is planned for when the draft bill is published for internet consultation.

Een uitvoeringstoets, waarin de effecten ook worden gekwantificeerd, heeft nog niet plaatsgevonden en staat gepland om uitgevoerd te worden op het moment dat het conceptwetsvoorstel ten behoeve van de internetconsultatie wordt gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Van der Lee over de uitzending van Tegenlicht van donderdag 26 januari en het initiatief Collectief Kapitaal

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the Collectief Kapitaal initiative, which gives cash payments to participants and holds ANBI status as a knowledge institution, is treated as income, and about related policy. The government answered that tax treatment depends on the facts, that it cannot disclose details of an individual ANBI under secrecy rules, and that it will follow such small private initiatives and consult municipalities.
Because the Tax Administration is bound by the secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), no further information can be provided about individual institutions.

Omdat de Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan geen nadere informatie worden verstrekt over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over "Reactie op brief LOSR over samenloop regelingen en effect op toeslagen"

An MP asks why resolving the overlap between social assistance and tax-based allowances (toeslagen) for households at the social minimum has taken so long, since the Ombudsman raised it in 2016 and the Central Council of Appeal ruled on it. The minister answers that several options were examined without a solution free of serious drawbacks, that a compensation route is under study, that municipalities are advised to compensate in the meantime via special assistance, and that Parliament will be informed before summer 2023.
The exact number of households is not known.
Het exacte aantal huishoudens is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Overheidsfinanciën in gevaar door verouderde ict van Belastingdienst’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg (CDA) asked whether the outdated Cool:Gen ICT systems behind income and wage tax could be replaced in time, and whether the risks to tax collection were real. The State Secretary answered that the continuity risk is unfounded, the systems are stable but costly to change, a multi-year modernisation portfolio and mitigation measures are in place, and the planning to finish by end 2026 is still feasible.
The fear that the continuity of tax collection is at stake is unfounded.
De vrees dat de continuïteit van de belastingheffing op het spel staat is ongegrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het afbouwpad van fossiele subsidies

GreenLeft MPs asked why a 2018 motion to phase out fiscal incentives undermining climate goals has not been fully implemented, why many fossil-energy exemptions remain, and for details on the largest emitters' benefits, the refinery exemption, free ETS allowances and related schemes. The government answered that it is phasing out some exemptions and plans a transparency action plan, cited treaty and double-taxation constraints, but declined to disclose company-level benefits citing confidentiality.
Regarding individual companies' entitlement to exemptions, subsidies and other benefits, as far as known, I cannot go into it due to confidentiality.
Op de aanspraak van individuele bedrijven op vrijstellingen, subsidies en andere voordelen, voor zover bekend, kan ik uit hoofde van vertrouwelijkheid niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over fossiele subsidies

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk asked whether the fossil subsidy debate should focus on the carbon pricing gap identified by PBL, whether energy tax on electricity is too untargeted and should be revised, and how the Energy Tax Directive and non-energy use of fossil fuels should be handled. The government answered that carbon pricing analysis is useful, agreed to ask PBL for an update, acknowledged the electricity tax issue and EU negotiations, and said further study of non-energy fossil use is needed.
I will ask PBL to update the 2021 analysis.
Ik zal het PBL vragen om een actualisatie van de analyse uit 2021.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de toepassing van de alleenstaande ouderenkorting bij belastingplichtigen met een partner in een verzorgingstehuis naar aanleiding van een bericht in de Geldgids van de Consume

An MP asked why the tax authority rejects claims for the single elderly person's tax reduction when a partner lives in a care home, even though entitled people should receive it, and how many are affected. The Staatssecretaris explains the Belastingdienst depends on the SVB indication, may grant the reduction if it was granted the prior year, otherwise sends a pre-announcement of adjustment, and gives figures for 2021 while committing to examine improved communication.
The Belastingdienst does not know in how many cases this involves a partner admitted to a care home.
Het is bij de Belastingdienst niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen hierbij sprake is van een partner die is opgenomen in een verzorgingstehuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over het bericht 'Financieel gepuzzel toch weer terug bij Belastingdienst door verstoringen'

MPs Van Weyenberg and Romke de Jong asked why the automatic income-distribution calculator between fiscal partners was removed from the 2022 tax return despite an earlier promise, and when it would return. The State Secretary explained it was disabled due to incorrect values, that the 2021 promise could not be met due to other priorities, and that it will return in the next campaign after fixing existing returns.
The Tax Administration aims to correct the return based on the optimal distribution, without requiring citizens to submit a new return.
De Belastingdienst streeft ernaar de aangifte te herstellen op basis van de optimale verdeling, zonder dat de burger gevraagd wordt om een nieuwe aangifte in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht "Vrijwilligers in de knel door regels fiscus voor vergoeding: "Gedwongen om te stoppen""

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Landelijke Cliëntenraad report showing that rules on volunteer expense allowances are unclear and can harm people on benefits, asking whether the rules should be simplified and the hardships addressed in the Tax Plan 2024. The government acknowledged the concerns but declined to change the scheme now, stating the flat-rate allowance is a cost-reimbursement rule meant to reduce administrative burden, pointing to better communication, and promising the Minister of Social Affairs will consider simplification of the WW and WIA and the Minister for Poverty Policy will alert municipalities to incorrect implementation under the Participatiewet.
On the other hand, it is also important not to lose sight of the character of the scheme, a cost-reimbursement scheme.
Aan de andere kant is het ook van belang om het karakter van de regeling, een kostenvergoedingsregeling, niet uit het oog te verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over bezwaren box 3-heffing

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Finance why the Tax Register urges all box 3 taxpayers to object to their assessments, whether a substantial number of objections will be upheld, whether the Tax Authority has capacity to process them, and how the government will address the mass-objection problem and the transition to actual-return taxation. The State Secretary answered that the box 3 restitution is reasonable, that unfounded objections will be rejected, that capacity is under strain with a review planned in 2023, and that the mass-objection procedure is under study with a letter promised before spring, while giving a timetable for the transition to actual-return taxation from 2026.

I consider it undesirable that taxpayers feel compelled to object to every tax assessment because otherwise there is a risk of paying too much tax without compensation possibly being offered afterwards.

Ik acht het onwenselijk dat belastingplichtigen zich genoodzaakt voelen om tegen iedere belastingaanslag bezwaar te maken omdat anders de kans bestaat dat er te veel belasting betaald wordt zonder dat achteraf nog compensatie geboden kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Rahimi over het bericht ‘Oude ict kost fiscus miljoenen’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that outdated ICT costs the tax authority millions, requesting yearly ICT spending, modernisation ratios, timelines, tender plans, and the link to tax morale. The State Secretary gave detailed budget and portfolio figures, a 2026 modernisation target, and declined to reveal the timing of upcoming tenders for commercial and legal reasons while promising to answer each question.
For tenders that are in preparation or will be brought to the market in the near future, the Tax Authority gives no advance insight.
In aanbestedingen die in voorbereiding zijn of in de nabije toekomst op de markt zullen worden gebracht, wordt door de Belastingdienst geen inzage vooraf gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de renseigneringsverplichting

Green Left MP Ellemeet asked why healthcare providers must report payments to third parties (UBD) despite VAT exemptions, why the deadline is 1 February 2023, and whether they should be exempted or consulted on regulatory burden. The State Secretary answered that the obligation is generic and necessary for income-tax pre-filling and checks, that healthcare providers will not be exempted, that the rules are not retroactive, and that case-by-case deadline extensions are available.
No, I do not want to exempt healthcare providers from this obligation.
Nee, ik wil zorgaanbieders niet uitzonderen van deze verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer, Klink en Inge van Dijk over exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs Stoffer, Klink and Inge van Dijk asked how the government accepts higher risks in green export credit insurance, what room Atradius DSB has, and how green export can be stimulated alongside phasing out fossil-related insurance. The government answered by listing measures such as lower financial requirements for small green transactions, longer loan terms, a green cover product, and OECD negotiations to modernise the Arrangement, noting 48 green transactions were insured in 2022.
The cabinet provides the maximum room within the set national and international frameworks, such as the EU state aid frameworks and the OECD Arrangement.
Het kabinet biedt de maximale ruimte binnen de vastgestelde nationale en internationale kaders zoals de EU-staatssteunkaders en de OESO Arrangement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitwerking van de COP26-verklaring over het beëindigen van overheidssteun voor fossiele projecten in het buitenland

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development how the COP26 pledge to end export credit support for overseas fossil projects is being implemented, including the transition period, the pipeline of fossil deals, exemptions and transparency. The government answers that new applications for fossil-related export credit insurance were stopped from 1 January 2023, with a transition for applications filed earlier, lists ten pipeline cases and six pledges with limited detail, explains the exemptions, and commits to reporting in an annual monitor.
Information on company names and the country has been omitted from the overview so that it cannot be traced to specific projects and companies, given commercial sensitivity.
Informatie over bedrijfsnamen en het land zijn in het overzicht achterwege gelaten zodat de informatie niet herleidbaar is tot specifieke projecten en bedrijven, gelet op de bedrijfsgevoeligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het achterhouden van fiscale informatie voor de rechter

An MP asked whether the tax authority's withholding of fiscal documents from courts, reported by RTL, is regular and what the consequences are for taxpayers. The State Secretary answered that such cases are rare among over 23,000 procedures, that secrecy claims are reviewed by an independent court chamber, and that the tax authority has internal consultation rules and ongoing attention to the issue.
In my letter of 8 February 2023, responding to the request from the Finance Committee, I did, however, deny the picture that this would be commonplace.
In mijn brief van 8 februari 2023 in reactie op het verzoek van de Vaste Kamercommissie voor Financiën heb ik echter het beeld tegengesproken dat dit schering en inslag zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het ontwijken van de heffing in box 3 over vastgoed

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether holding real estate through a STAK (administration foundation) lets investors reduce box 3 tax compared with direct ownership, and whether that is fair. The State Secretary confirms the lower outcome stems from netting property against debts inside the STAK, says the structure is not intended for tax avoidance, and states the government is examining whether to counter it, possibly through legislation.
For that reason we are examining whether this construction is becoming more common and how it can best be combated, possibly with a legislative amendment.
Om die reden onderzoeken wij of deze constructie meer voorkomt en hoe deze het beste kan worden bestreden, al dan niet met behulp van een wetswijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het WODC-rapport ‘Bestuursorganen in hoger beroep’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance about a WODC report showing how often the Tax Authority loses on appeal, the reasons for appeals, mediation and other dispute-resolution options. The State Secretary answered at length, arguing the report's figures are limited to published rulings and not fully representative, providing appeal outcome tables and mediation numbers, and describing the Tax Authority's appeal and cassation criteria.
The Tax Authority's systems only record the number of appeal cases, without distinguishing whether the taxpayer or the inspector lodged the appeal.
In de systemen van de Belastingdienst wordt alleen informatie over de aantallen zaken in hoger beroep bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de onafhankelijke review naar de veiligheidssituatie LNG project Mozambique

An MP asked why the government has not yet sent Parliament the promised independent review of the security situation at the Mozambique LNG project, and whether it will arrive before year end. The State Secretary says the review was extended with an additional assignment, the final report is expected in February 2023 with a policy response before the 23 February debate, and gives a brief security update.

The expectation is that the final report will be delivered in February, so that it, accompanied by a policy response, can be sent to your House before the committee debate on export credit insurance of 23 February 2023.

De verwachting is dat het eindrapport in februari zal worden opgeleverd, zodat het, vergezeld van een beleidsreactie, voorafgaand aan het commissiedebat exportkredietverzekeringen van 23 februari 2023 aan uw Kamer kan worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over eHerkenning

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about problems with eHerkenning as the mandatory login for tax filing by businesses, including costs, security and privacy, and whether the old portal could be reopened. The government answered that existing compensation schemes and a planned free public login address the costs, that eHerkenning meets EU and national standards under supervision, and that the old portal cannot be reinstated.
A free public login means at the substantial assurance level is being developed by the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations for logging in to the MijnBelastingdienst Zakelijk portal.

Door het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties wordt een kosteloos publiek inlogmiddel op betrouwbaarheidsniveau substantieel ontwikkeld voor het inloggen op het portaal MijnBelastingdienst Zakelijk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over Operation Admiral en de handhaving op btw-carrouselfraude

The MP asked about the EPPO's Operation Admiral on VAT carousel fraud, the size of the VAT gap, enforcement capacity, and whether digital reporting obligations like those in Italy and Spain should be adopted. The State Secretary answered that Dutch VAT gap is relatively low (2.8%), that enforcement capacity is about 70 FTE plus FIOD, and declined to adopt digital reporting for now, citing costs and a low gap, while committing to continue current enforcement and a pending bill on payment data.
The Netherlands has a relatively small gap between expected and collected VAT revenue of 2.8% (1.7 billion euros).
Nederland heeft een relatief klein verschil tussen verwachte en geïnde btw-inkomsten van 2,8% (1,7 miljard euro).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek naar Uber, waarbij de Belastingdienst zelf de eigen vragen formuleerde

Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Authority investigated its own handling of Uber without external independence, whether the internal report could be published, whether confidentiality and interstate secrecy rules were breached, and how the external validation was scoped. The State Secretary answered that the internal report cannot be published under the tax secrecy rule but was placed confidentially before Parliament, that external experts validated it and found no breach of secrecy, and that a technical briefing would follow on 18 January 2023.
Given the purpose and design of these articles, the investigation report cannot be made public because of the secrecy obligation.
Gegeven de doelstelling en de vormgeving van deze artikelen, kan het onderzoeksrapport vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht niet openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht ‘BelastingTelefoon blijkt onbereikbaar; burgers konden er 900.000 keer hun vragen niet kwijt’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Phone was unreachable for 900,000 callers, and about waiting times, staffing, a contingency plan, and coulance for taxpayers harmed by poor reachability. The State Secretary gives reachability figures (71.7% through November, a two-day technical outage), describes recruitment and efficiency initiatives, agrees to consider redeploying staff and to act coulantly toward affected taxpayers, but gives no firm timeline for recovery.
Yes, I am willing to do that.
Ja, daar ben ik toe bereid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de LSI (Landelijke Stuurgroep Interventieteams) en vele tot nu toe onuitgevoerde toezeggingen over privacy, risicoscores van heel veel burgers, onuitgevoerd onderzoek, niet opg

MP Omtzigt asks about the LSI joint intervention-team data sharing, including DPIAs, promised but unpublished documents, a planned external review of risk scores, an advisory analytics committee that is still not set up, and possible GDPR violations. The government answers that DPIAs and a privacy protocol are being prepared, that LSI risk scores were stopped in July 2020, that the advisory committee is still being recruited, and that the requested documents are attached or promised later.
Once the DPIA of the LSI cooperation has been completed, it will be sent to the House.
Zodra de DPIA van de LSI-samenwerking is opgeleverd zal deze aan de Kamer worden toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over Lucratief Belang

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary of Finance about the carried-interest 'lucratief belang' rules, including whether the doorstootverplichting in article 3.95b(5) lets private equity managers pay only 26.9% tax, whether it conflicts with the legislative intent, and whether combining it with the 30%-regeling creates zero-tax outcomes for expats. The State Secretary largely defends the regime as clarifying the law, says no data exist on structure counts, sees no unintended avoidance and no need for action, and states that fund managers and expats are taxed on the same basis as other earners.
I currently see no need to take action.
Ik zie vooralsnog geen noodzaak om actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de fiscale miljonairsvrijstelling

MP Nijboer asks the State Secretary of Finance about the wealth exemption (miljonairsvrijstelling) in article 3.95b of the income tax act, which lets holders of a lucrative interest move carried-interest-type gains from box 1 to the lower box 2 rate if at least 95% is distributed, and questions its rationale, the lack of data, the tax paid by holding companies, the time it costs the tax authority, and whether it should be abolished. The State Secretary defends the option as providing legal certainty and balanced tax burden, says no data are available on the revenue or claimed exemption, and states that the approach to opaque tax constructions will be communicated to parliament later.
No data are available on the tax levied on income from lucrative interests, as these are not separately recorded in income tax returns.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over de heffing over inkomsten uit lucratief belang, aangezien deze niet apart geregistreerd worden in de aangiften inkomstenbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht ‘Corruptie is bij de Belastingdienst lastig te traceren’

MPs Idsinga and Michon-Derkzen asked about reports that corruption at the Tax Authority is hard to trace, since systems do not log which data staff access. The State Secretary admits systems do not log data queries, outlines integrity measures, and says the Minister will raise corruption in the MCAO and inform parliament in later letters.
It is correct that the Tax Authority's computer systems do not record (log) which information employees query, because these systems were not designed to capture such information.
Het klopt dat computersystemen van de Belastingdienst niet registreren (loggen) welke informatie medewerkers opvragen omdat deze systemen niet zijn opgezet om dit soort informatie vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over een onbedoeld generaal pardon voor zwartspaarders

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a perceived unintended amnesty for undeclared 'black savers' after the Supreme Court's Christmas ruling on box 3 wealth tax, including lost revenue, navigation of assessment periods, fines and possible reform. The State Secretary answers that the ruling applies to open assessments, that the 12-year limitation period for foreign assets is justified, that fines and prosecution remain possible, that retroactive fine increases are legally impossible, and that the government will examine the limitation periods and fine basis and continues its anti-concealment programme.
It is not known how many black savers there are, how much or what kind of wealth they hold, or where it comes from.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel zwartspaarders er zijn en over hoeveel dan wel welk soort vermogen zij beschikken en wat de herkomst daarvan is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Zwartspaarder spint garen bij schrappen vermogenstaks’

An MP asks whether the Supreme Court's Kerstarrest ruling prevents the tax authority from re-assessing or fining undeclared box 3 wealth from 2017 onward, and whether this is fair to those who objected; the State Secretary replies that re-assessment and fines remain possible for pre-2017 years (12-year period, plus other routes), that post-2017 amounts will be limited by the lower rates under the rechtsherstel legislation, and that a review of fine law is being started, without data on past re-assessments.
The Kerstarrest explicitly does not mean that the Tax Authority can no longer re-assess or fine tax evaders.
Het Kerstarrest brengt nadrukkelijk niet met zich dat de Belastingdienst bij zwartspaarders niet meer kan navorderen of beboeten.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Zwartspaarder spint garen bij schrappen vermogenstaks'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that abolishing the wealth tax lets tax evaders gain, asking for figures on black savers, penalty floors for hidden savings, and the treatment of cash. The State Secretary said the Tax Authority does not systematically track such cases, will examine alternatives to tying fines to the tax owed, and confirmed that cash currently falls under the low-yield bank-balance category.
The Tax Authority does not systematically record how often and how much is recovered from black savers.
De Belastingdienst houdt niet systematisch bij hoe vaak en hoeveel nagevorderd wordt bij zwartspaarders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de motie-Omtzigt inzake vergoedingen voor energiebedrijven (Kamerstuk 36200, nr. 118)

MP Omtzigt asks the government how it implements two motions on the energy price cap: margin-based compensation for energy suppliers and handling of shared connections (blokaansluitingen), plus questions on tax changes and the timing of the cap. The minister answers that talks on margin testing are ongoing, a solution for shared connections has top priority under coordination by the Tax Authority, the 2023 cap is intended to start on 1 January 2023, and no further change to energy tax rates is currently planned.
Talks are currently being held with energy suppliers on how to arrive at some form of margin testing in implementing the 2023 price cap scheme.
Op dit moment worden gesprekken gevoerd met de energieleveranciers over hoe te komen tot een vorm van margetoetsing bij de uitvoering van de prijsplafondregeling voor 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht “Forse verhoging prijzen bus, trein- en metrokaartjes dreigt volgend jaar”

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries about reported fare rises for buses, trains and metro in 2023, the end of a transition safety net, and whether fares should be frozen or VAT removed. The State Secretary answered that fares are a decentralised responsibility under a fixed indexation system, that NS fares rise 4.3% on average, that a 150 million euro transition safety net was agreed, and that KiM research on fare incentives will be discussed with the NOVB, with a report expected by summer 2023.
I am not responsible for the fares; fare authority lies with decentralised governments and NS.
Ik ga echter niet over de tarieven, de tariefbevoegdheid ligt bij decentrale overheden en NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over mogelijke fossiele exportsteun Santos Basin Pre-Salt Pole

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a pending export credit insurance application for the Santos Basin Pre-Salt Pole fossil project in Brazil, questioning its compatibility with the COP26 commitment to end fossil export support by end-2022 and its emissions impact. The government answered that the application is in due diligence, that it falls under a transition period allowing policies for applications submitted before 1 January 2023 to lead to a policy until end-2023, and that emissions data is not yet available.
At the ex-ante publication stage no information is given about the exporters, financial institutions or insured value involved, because this is commercially sensitive at this stage.
Bij de ex-ante publicatie wordt geen informatie gegeven over de betrokken exporteurs, financiële instellingen of te de verzekeren waarde, omdat dit in deze fase concurrentiegevoelig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het stoppen van fossiele subsidies in 2023

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the Netherlands' signing of the Glasgow declaration commits it to ending direct state support for the international fossil energy sector by end-2022, whether phasing out is compatible with that commitment, and whether other countries' non-signature should affect Dutch implementation. The government confirms it will end new support for fossil energy activities by end-2022 with narrow exceptions aligned with 1.5°C and EU energy security, referring to a letter of 3 November 2022 and an assessment framework.
The cabinet is not opting for gradual phase-out but for ending new support that is not in line with the declaration by the end of 2022.
Het kabinet kiest niet voor stapsgewijze uitfasering, maar voor beëindiging van nieuwe steun, die niet in lijn is met de verklaring, per eind 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over naheffingen bij schijnzelfstandigheid

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary for Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs whether bogus self-employed workers face back-payment claims for social contributions and tax, whether these are used as a threat to deter claims, and whether employers may pass such costs on to workers. The government answers that enforcement against employers is under a moratorium, that individuals may still face income-tax assessments, that it cannot give general assurances, and that it will reinforce enforcement and send a progress letter this year.
In the cabinet response to the ARK and ADR reports, it was promised that enforcement on the classification of employment relationships for payroll taxes will be recalibrated and strengthened.
In de kabinetsreactie op de rapporten van ARK en ADR 3 is toegezegd de handhaving op de kwalificatie van de arbeidsrelatie voor de loonheffingen te herijken en versterken.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Van der Plas over door de Belastingdienst ontvangen (fraude)signalen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the estimated number of unprocessed fraud signals at the Tax Administration, whether signals forwarded via Meld Misdaad Anoniem, regional tax offices and the FIOD information desk are being handled, and whether fraud policy is still 'in control'. The State Secretary gave detailed estimates (around 30,000 signals in total, about 2,000 forwarded signals not processed), acknowledged that part of the signals cannot currently be followed up, and described ongoing enforcement and a programme to restart the signal process.
That is why I do not think it is good that part of the signals about possible fraud cannot currently be followed up.
Daarom vind ik het niet goed dat een deel van de signalen over mogelijke fraude op dit moment niet kan worden opgevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de voorgenomen afschaffing van de BPM-vrijstelling voor bestelauto's

Sen. Stoffer (SGP) asked the government about the planned abolition of the BPM exemption for business delivery vans, its CO2 effect, the basis for the 0.7 Mton figure, the switch of the tax base to CO2, the legal basis, alternatives and talks with industry. The state secretary answered every question on substance, explaining the climate and budget rationale, the CO2-based tax base, and that the industry alternative was rejected while the MRB increases for business vans were partly withdrawn.
The 0.7 Mton is the reduction target that the coalition agreement set for this measure for this target group.
De 0,7 Mton is het reductiedoel dat bij deze maatregel voor deze doelgroep in het coalitieakkoord is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Heinen over de uitspraken over mogelijk loslaten unanimiteitsbeginsel en de ontwikkelingen rondom 'Pijler 2' van de OESO

MPs Idsinga and Heinen asked the State Secretary of Finance about statements on possibly dropping unanimity for tax decisions and developments around OECD Pillar 2, and why the joint declaration with four other states was signed by only five countries. The State Secretary answered that the cabinet position is unchanged, that Pillar 2 should ideally be agreed by all 27 member states, and that alternatives such as enhanced cooperation or coordinated implementation are being explored while unanimity remains required.
The cabinet's position on this point has not changed.
Het kabinetsstandpunt is op dit punt niet gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rechtsbescherming van gedupeerden van het kinderopvangtoeslagenschandaal

The SP MP Van Nispen asked why childcare benefit scandal victims must go to court to enforce statutory decision deadlines and obtain access to their files, and what the government will do about it. The government acknowledges that many decisions are overdue (41,335 applications past the one-year deadline as of 30 September 2022), points to capacity constraints, prioritisation and ongoing improvement measures, and says it will report in the 12th progress report.
Unfortunately, it is not succeeding in giving parents a decision within the statutory deadlines for the integral assessment and objections.
Het lukt helaas niet om ouders binnen de wettelijke termijnen uitsluitsel te geven bij de integrale beoordeling en bezwaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over dat de Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen pas in actie komt na een rechterlijke uitspraak

An SP MP asks why the Dutch tax authority's Herstel Toeslagen unit only acts on childcare-benefit victims' files after court rulings, and how this squares with the law and costs. The government answers that files are handled in order of registration with priority for urgent cases, that late-decision appeals are a consequence of the system rather than deliberate policy, and that it will report further in the next progress report.
As a result, late-decision appeals cut across the processing order based on date of registration.
Hierdoor doorkruisen de beroepen niet tijdig de behandelvolgorde op basis van volgorde van aanmelding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over het artikel 'Hoe een Ierse rundvleeskoning via de Zuidas voor miljoenen aan belastingen ontwijkt'

An MP (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by a company via interest-free loans and informal capital structures, and about dividend withholding rates to Luxembourg, among other things. The State Secretary answered that the 2022 anti-mismatch law applies to existing arrangements without grandfathering, that the Netherlands cannot comment on individual taxpayers under the AWR, and that the Pillar 2 minimum tax bill will be released for consultation.
Under Article 67 AWR I cannot comment on the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 AWR kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het niet publiceren van kennisgroepstandpunten

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why tax authority expert-group (kennisgroep) positions are not published and made accessible, and whether this gives large firms an informational advantage over ordinary citizens. The State Secretary explained that these positions have the same status as formal policy, are generally published via policy decisions in the Staatscourant with some delay, and that a more accessible website for all positions will be published by 1 April 2023.
Once this website is shown to meet all conditions, all expert-group positions will be published via this website and thereby be accessible.
Zodra blijkt dat deze website voldoet aan alle randvoorwaarden, zullen alle kennisgroepstandpunten via deze website worden gepubliceerd en daarmee op een toegankelijke wijze raadpleegbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gündoğan en Grinwis over de 10-jaarstermijn in de erf- en schenkbelasting

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Dutch inheritance tax is avoided for Dutch nationals who have lived abroad for over ten years, including those with a pied-à-terre in the Netherlands, how other countries handle such limits, and whether the ten-year rule should be extended or abolished. The State Secretary answered that the ten-year fictional rule prevents tax flight, that a second home does not avoid liability, that the government sees no reason or plan to change the ten-year period, and that a rough estimate of revenue impact cannot be given.
The cabinet sees no reason to change the ten-year period. There is no intention to do so.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om de tienjaarstermijn aan te passen. Er is geen voornemen hiertoe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Omtzigt over een laag tarief op verse groente en fruit, dat al in een aantal EU-lidstaten wordt toegepast en dus ook in Nederland mogelijk zou moeten zijn.

MPs Van Esch and Omtzigt asked why the Netherlands cannot apply a reduced VAT rate on fresh fruit and vegetables as Italy, Latvia and Spain do. The government answered that it is studying the legal and practical delimitation with SEO, expects results in early 2023, and that a zero rate could take effect on 1 January 2024 at the earliest.
The cabinet emphasises that it is wise to await the conclusions of this study before proceeding to any introduction of a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables.
Het kabinet benadrukt dat het verstandig is om de conclusies van dit onderzoek af te wachten voordat tot eventuele invoering van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit wordt overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de opinie "Henk Bluemink: Alimentatie toont aan dat belastingstelsel anders moet"

An MP asked the state secretaries of Finance about an opinion arguing that partner alimony under the tax and benefits system can leave both ex-partners worse off, and whether the system should be reformed. The government acknowledged the very high marginal burden as a known unintended effect of the tax and benefits system, said it is not easy to solve, and pointed to planned adjustments such as independent childcare contributions and gradual abolition of benefits.
The cabinet is taking a number of measures to counter this.
Het kabinet neemt een aantal maatregelen om dit tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Vermogenden gebruiken eigen goede doelen als belastingconstructie'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that wealthy people create their own ANBI charities to reduce income tax, including by donating bare ownership of shares or artworks while keeping the income or use, and asked for data on scale, oversight and fixes. The State Secretary confirmed the IBO findings and the risk of abuse, said data on the number of cases is not available, and announced a EUR 250,000 cap on periodic gift deductions from 1 January 2023 plus a broader anti-tax-construction push.

That is why the cabinet intends, as announced in the cover letter to the Tax Plan 2023, to cap the deduction of periodic gifts at EUR 250,000 per taxpayer and any partner together from 1 January 2023.

Daarom is het kabinet voornemens om, zoals aangekondigd in de aanbiedingsbrief bij het Belastingplan 2023, de aftrek van periodieke giften per 1 januari 2023 te begrenzen tot € 250.000 per belastingplichtige en eventuele partner samen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Paul over het bericht 'Ook personeelstekorten bij uitvoeringsorganisaties als UWV, fiscus en IND'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance about reported staff shortages at the Tax Authority and Customs, including long Belastingtelefoon waiting times, staffing for the box 3 ruling and childcare benefits aftermath, sick leave and pension outflow. The government answered that waiting times averaged about 17-20 minutes, listed measures to keep access, explained recruitment difficulties and prioritisation trade-offs that reduce supervision capacity, and projected extra staffing needs, promising further information in the autumn.
