In the stand-of-affairs letter 2 I, State Secretary of Finance – Fiscal Affairs & Tax Authority, stated that I will inform you further in the autumn about the level of supervision.
In de stand-van-zakenbrief 2 heb ik, Staatssecretaris van Financiën – Fiscaliteit & Belastingdienst, opgenomen dat ik u in het najaar nader zal informeren over het niveau van toezicht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de berichten 'Meeste toeslagenouders hebben migratieachtergrond, vaak met schulden', nieuwe data van het CBS: 'Kenmerken van gedupeerde gezinnen toeslagenaffaire' en 'Belasting

An MP (Azarkan, DENK) asked the State Secretaries of Finance about CBS data showing that most families harmed by the childcare benefits scandal have a migration background and often debts, and about reports that the Tax Service knew of ethnic profiling already in 2019. The government acknowledged the findings as painful, denied that Toeslagen collected ethnicity data or actively selected on nationality, admitted that the risk model disadvantaged certain groups without a valid basis, and pointed to reforms, a screening team clarification, and ongoing restitution efforts, but did not concede the 2019 knowledge claim.
It is not the case, and the DPA has not established either, that the handlers selected on the basis of second nationality.
Het is niet zo, en ook niet door de AP vastgesteld, dat de behandelaren in dit verband geselecteerd hebben op tweede nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'hoge prijzen leiden tot miljardenwinst voor olie- en gasbedrijf Shell'

An MP from the CDA asked the government how it views Shell's large profits and share buybacks during the energy price crisis, whether a solidarity levy should be introduced, and how state participation EBN could be expanded. The minister answered that a levy on fossil producers is being examined with a decision due on Prinsjesdag, that the state already receives about 70% of domestic oil and gas profits, and that Shell has committed to investing in the energy transition in the Netherlands.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de gelekte maatregelen naar aanleiding van het bereikte begrotingsakkoord in aanloop naar Prinsjesdag

MP Omtzigt asks the Prime Minister and Finance ministers whether leaked pre-Budget Day measures (air ticket tax, corporate tax, box 3, student grants and others) are accurate, who leaked them, and why a leak by an opposition MP was punished while government leaks are not. The Prime Minister declines to confirm or deny specific leaked measures because the Prinsjesdag proposals are still under Council of State advice and CPB calculation, confirms the coalition agreement's rise in air passenger tax, says he regrets the breach of the confidentiality rule, but does not say who leaked or what the ministerial discussion concluded.
The decision-making process on the Prinsjesdag documents has not yet been completed.
Het besluitvormingsproces over de Prinsjesdagstukken is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over baby-bv

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about 'baby-bv' constructions, where shares in a company are transferred to minors to shift future value, including whether such structures are undesirable, how common minority shareholdings are, and how to counter them. The government answered that the policy stance follows with the Prinsjesdag cabinet response to the IBO on wealth distribution, gave registry counts of minors as shareholders, explained gift tax and parental control rules, and pointed to the pending Wet excessief lenen bij eigen vennootschap for loans.
The desirability of the mentioned tax constructions will be addressed in the cabinet position on the IBO Wealth Distribution, which follows on Prinsjesdag.
Op de wenselijkheid van de genoemde belastingconstructies wordt ingegaan in het kabinetsstandpunt op het IBO Vermogensverdeling dat volgt met Prinsjesdag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de Fiscale Monitor

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretaries of Finance about questions and statements in the Fiscale Monitor, including statements on childcare benefit fraud and whether the survey asks about the Tax Authority's harshness and courtesy. The government answered that the survey measures tax and benefit morale, that it is not designed to question people's honesty, that wording will be reviewed, and that an external review is planned.
The wording of the statements used to measure morale will be evaluated and adjusted where necessary.
De bewoordingen van de gebruikte stellingen waarmee moraal wordt gemeten, zullen worden geëvalueerd en waar nodig worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst de regels schond om Uber te helpen

MP Alkaya (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Belastingdienst officials broke rules to favour Uber, including withholding foreign information requests and leaking confidential information. The State Secretary declined most substantive detail citing the tax secrecy duty (art. 67 AWR), said an internal investigation with external expert review is underway with results expected in September, and offered a confidential briefing to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over het artikel 'Hoge ambtenaren Belastingdienst schonden regels om Uber te bevoordelen'

MP Romke de Jong asked the State Secretary of Finance about a newspaper report that senior Tax Administration officials broke rules to favour Uber, and about how the tax authority handles foreign investors, information requests from other countries, and communication with multinationals. The State Secretary answered that an internal investigation is underway, that tax secrecy under article 67 AWR prevents disclosing individual case files and the investigation results, and offered a confidential briefing to parliament.
Because of the tax secrecy obligation in article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I have not been able to answer all questions and cannot make the results of the investigation public either.

Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) heb ik niet alle vragen kunnen beantwoorden en kan ik ook de resultaten van het onderzoek niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de fiscale behandeling van Uber

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the tax treatment of Uber, alleged favouritism by the Tax Authority, delayed foreign information requests, the role of other agencies and former Commissioner Neelie Kroes's StartupDelta post. The State Secretary declines to discuss individual tax files under confidentiality rules, offers a confidential briefing to Parliament, and gives procedural explanations and references to past enforcement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Nijboer, Grinwis, Maatoug, Stoffer, Dassen en Inge van Dijk over de Uber-files en aanverwante zaken

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Uber Files, including Tax Authority conduct toward Uber, exchange-of-information handling, multilateral audits, the NFIA and APBI roles and the withheld Unilever bidbook. The Secretary answered largely by citing tax secrecy, promising an internal investigation with results expected in September, offering a confidential briefing, and declining to change rules or reveal individual cases.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), I have not been able to answer all questions and cannot make the results of the investigation public.

Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) heb ik niet alle vragen kunnen beantwoorden en kan ik ook de resultaten van het onderzoek niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht 'Advocaat-generaal: verplichte eHerkenning bij belastingaangifte mag'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of an Advocate-General's opinion that mandatory eHerkenning for tax filing is lawful, including support for businesses, transition measures, and free login options. The State Secretary says the government keeps its eHerkenning policy, offers a limited annual compensation of 24.20 euro, and that a public login alternative is being studied, without committing to a timetable beyond a progress report.
The cabinet therefore for now continues to adhere to the government-wide line of using eHerkenning as the authentication means.
Het kabinet houdt daarom vooralsnog vast aan de overheidsbrede lijn van het gebruik van eHerkenning als authenticatiemiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over de hoogte van de thuiswerkvergoeding

Romke de Jong (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the tax-free home-working allowance is still adequate given the Nibud's higher 2022 cost estimate and rising energy prices. The State Secretary answered that the allowance will be indexed by the tax table correction factor from 2023, that the Nibud figure will be reviewed in the WKR evaluation, and that hybrid working brings societal benefits.
The cabinet will include the evaluation of the home-working exemption in the evaluation of the WKR planned for 2023/2024.
Het kabinet zal de evaluatie van de thuiswerkvrijstelling meenemen in de evaluatie van de WKR die gepland staat voor 2023/2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de positie die de belastingdienst inneemt in rechtszaken over vrijwillige verbetering van de aanslag

Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority's position in court cases on voluntary correction of tax assessments, including a Hague District Court ruling and whether the Tax Authority's stance was 'fiscale grensverkenning' and properly published. The State Secretary defends the Tax Authority's position as a legal disagreement over the reallocation of joint tax items, notes that the cited memo quote matches the explanatory memorandum in substance, declines to publish judicial rulings or a separate standpoint, and promises a late reply.
It is not customary for me to publish judicial rulings.
Het is niet gebruikelijk dat ik gerechtelijke oordelen publiceer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Van Strien over het bericht 'Vertrek DSM is signaal voor politiek'

MPs Idsinga and Van Strien asked the ministers about reports that the DSM headquarters move signals a wider political problem for large multinationals, including their contribution to society, job numbers and what the government will do about the investment climate. The minister defends the contribution of multinationals, admits concern about the investment climate and promises a second investment-climate letter before the EZK budget debate, while saying the DSM-Firmenich dual headquarters decision was taken by the companies without government involvement.
DSM is a listed company and legally may not share this information before it is made public.
DSM is een beursgenoteerde onderneming en mag wettelijk gezien deze informatie niet voorbeurs delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Belastingdienst, die leerstoelen en hoogleraren financiert

MP Omtzigt asks the Finance and Education ministers about Tax Authority funding of university chairs, including whether the Leiden sponsorship was disclosed, which chairs are funded, the transparency of related publications, and whether funding should go through the education budget. The minister answers that seven chairs are financed by the Finance ministry, declines to provide individual publication or PhD overviews, promises to ask UNL and the code authors for an evaluation of the integrity code, and says a full overview of other funded chairs will follow later.
No statements are made about individual employees.
Er worden over individuele medewerkers geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Romke de Jong over een suikertaks

MPs Van der Laan and Romke de Jong asked whether the coalition's sugar tax, which raises the existing beverage excise, would also make bottled water more expensive and whether this fits prevention goals. The government confirmed that mineral water is temporarily included, plans to exempt it from 1 January 2024, and will study tariff differentiation by sugar content.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over compensatie voor stijgende energieprijzen voor de consumenten van LPG

MP Van Haga asked why a temporary reduced VAT rate on LPG (propane) is not possible under the EU VAT Directive, why LPG consumers are treated differently from natural gas users, and whether LPG-heating households can be compensated for rising energy prices, including via the one-off energy allowance. The State Secretary answered that propane is not listed in Annex III of the Directive, that LPG consumers benefit from the excise cut and can apply for the one-off allowance via municipalities, and that no extra compensation or EU initiative is planned.
Propane, an LPG, is not natural gas and propane/LPG is also not mentioned elsewhere in Annex III.
Propaan, een LPG, is geen aardgas en propaan/LPG wordt ook niet elders in Bijlage III genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de excessieve winsten van energiebedrijven

An MP asked whether windfall taxes on energy companies' excess profits, as used in Italy, Spain and other countries, could be adopted in the Netherlands, and why the government says profits cannot be mapped. The minister answered that profits depend on world markets, that a sector-specific windfall tax faces investment-climate, implementation and EU-law obstacles, and that an increase of existing mining levies on Dutch oil and gas production is an option.
Introducing a specific new windfall tax for energy companies is complex and involves several bottlenecks.
Het introduceren van een specifieke nieuwe windfall tax voor energiebedrijven is complex en kent verschillende knelpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over de winsten van oliebedrijven

CDA MPs asked the government whether it considers oil company profits from high energy prices morally acceptable, whether share buybacks and higher dividends are acceptable, what a reasonable profit is, and whether companies invest enough in the energy transition and should contribute more. The minister answers that the government has no moral judgement on lawful profits, that companies may use profits as they see fit, that it will steer investment through carbon pricing, subsidies and tailored agreements, and gives no view on a reasonable profit level.
In general, the cabinet has no moral judgement on profits that profit-seeking companies make, as long as this happens within the rules and they pay fair tax on them.
In algemene zin heeft het kabinet geen moreel oordeel over winsten die bedrijven met een winstoogmerk boeken, zolang dit binnen de regels gebeurt en zij hierover een eerlijke belasting afdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: zzp’ers en de fiscale oudedagsreserve’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report showing many self-employed workers claim the fiscal retirement reserve (FOR) without actually setting the money aside for retirement, and about the complexity, efficiency and consequences of the FOR. The State Secretary answered that the FOR is largely a tax deferral tool, that he finds this undesirable, and that the cabinet will propose abolishing the FOR from 1 January 2023 in the Belastingplan 2023.
As part of the Tax Plan 2023, it will be proposed to abolish the FOR.
Als onderdeel van het Belastingplan 2023 zal worden voorgesteld de FOR af te schaffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht 'Belastingadviseurs kritisch: veel zoekgeraakte post bij de fiscus; e-mailen niet mogelijk'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that post sent to the Tax Authority goes missing, that e-mail communication is not formally available, and about rising fines, the relationship with tax advisers, and the future of Horizontal Supervision. The State Secretary acknowledged that lost post is undesirable but that its extent cannot be measured, explained that e-mail is only formally allowed in some situations, and promised a letter on the fines policy and continued dialogue with tax advisers.
It is indeed an undesirable situation that post goes missing or is processed with delay.
Het is inderdaad een onwenselijke situatie dat post zoekraakt of met vertraging wordt behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het breder toepassen van het discriminerende risico-selectiemodel door Toeslagen

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance how the discriminatory risk-selection model used by Toeslagen (childcare and housing benefits) was applied more widely, which teams used it, when it was used, and when an external investigation would start. The government answered that the model's risk scores were used beyond manual-review selection, that nationality and other indicators were part of the model, and that an external investigation would start in summer 2022 with a report expected early the following year.
Therefore an external investigation will be carried out.
Daarom zal een extern onderzoek worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Azarkan en Omtzigt over recente nihilstellingen in de kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Leijten, Azarkan and Omtzigt asked about recent nihilstellingen (zeroing-out of childcare allowance) for 2020/2021, including how the process, notification, reasons, objection and repayment are handled after the Ongekend Onrecht report. The State Secretary answered that about 4,500 2020 cases were zeroed out, described new procedural safeguards, admitted decisions do not yet state reasons in the formal beschikking, and promised improvements without firm dates.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over het verweer van de Staat in de artikel 12-procedure omtrent de vervolging van de Belastingdienst

MPs Leijten and Omtzigt asked why the State's written defence in the Article 12 complaint procedure about prosecution of the Tax Authority omitted the Tax Authority's repeated breaches of law, and about the handling of the Biemond advice, the notice of complaint, and the information shared with the Public Prosecution Service. The State secretaries answered that breaches occurred for varied reasons, that the Chamber will continue to be informed of new cases, and that the Ministry deliberately withheld documents from the Public Prosecution Service to protect its independence.
Not acting in accordance with the law can have various reasons, with different underlying causes.
Het niet handelen in overeenstemming met de wet kan diverse redenen hebben, met verschillende grondoorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van Jasper van Dijk over het vervallen recht op toeslagen vanwege gegevens in de basisregistratie personen (BRP)

An MP asks why childcare and housing allowances are withdrawn and recovered when the IND registers code 98 (no lawful residence) in the BRP, even when people may not be definitively rejected, and whether affected people can contest this before recovery. The State Secretary replies that code 98 reflects current status not final rejection, that Toeslagen relies on IND's code and only checks doubtful cases, that the code is not a contestable decision but the underlying IND decision is, and that the government will report on hardship options in the summer.
Code 98 means that at the time of determination a citizen does not (or no longer) lawfully reside in the Netherlands; it does not mean the person has been finally rejected.
Code 98 betekent dat een burger op het moment van vaststelling niet (meer) rechtmatig in Nederland verblijft, dit betekent niet dat iemand uitgeprocedeerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de grenseffecten van het tabaksbeleid

MP Van Houwelingen asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that a growing share of tobacco smoked in the Netherlands comes from abroad, the effect of excise differences on border-region businesses, and the RIVM study on price sensitivity of smokers. The government answered that the industry-funded figures are unreliable, that Empty Pack Surveys show foreign-bought cigarettes at about 15% without a clear trend, and that the RIVM and other evidence do not justify changing tobacco policy, while promising to keep monitoring cross-border effects and to report on fuel-excise support on Prinsjesdag.
The Cabinet considers it important to monitor whether cross-border effects undermine tobacco excise policy.
Het Kabinet vindt het belangrijk om te monitoren of grenseffecten het beleid rondom tabaksaccijns ondermijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht "Grensarbeider kan thuiswerken vergeten: ‘Dit is pure discriminatie’'

MP Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that cross-border workers cannot telework without tax consequences, and whether the temporary telework arrangements with Germany and Belgium will be extended. The government answered that the arrangements expire on 1 July 2022, that renewal is not suitable, and that talks on a possible permanent telework rule with both neighbours are ongoing without a guaranteed outcome.

Before the summer recess, the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, on my behalf too, will send a letter to your House to inform it about the progress of our talks with neighbouring countries and within the EU.

Voor het zomerreces zal de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid mede namens mij een brief aan uw Kamer sturen om uw Kamer te informeren over de voortgang van onze gesprekken met buurlanden en binnen de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over verplichte winstdeling door bedrijven in de strijd tegen inflatie

The SP MP Alkaya asked the State Secretary of Finance about mandatory profit-sharing by companies as a response to inflation, citing a CNV proposal, and asked why the Netherlands has fewer such schemes, whether tax rules discourage them, and what could be learned from the UK, France and Germany. The State Secretary answered that wages and profit-sharing are primarily matters for employers and employees, noted risks of profit-sharing, stated the government is not currently planning tax incentives, and pointed to a pending bill on stock option tax rules.
The offer and use of employee participation is, as said, primarily a matter between employers and employees.
Het aanbod en gebruik van werknemersparticipaties is, zoals gezegd, primair een zaak tussen werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de tax governance code van VNO-NCW

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the new Tax Governance Code by VNO-NCW, its appreciation, international reach, and whether transparency duties extend to tax advisers, academics and government. The State Secretary welcomes the code, promises a roundtable and an evaluation later, and commits to further attention on advisers' conduct and independence in advisory committees.
I therefore want to let this code do its good work first, and at a later point I want to evaluate whether more is needed.
Ik wil deze code dan ook eerst zijn goede werk laten doen, en wil op een later moment evalueren of meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Inge van Dijk over de gevolgen van een recent gewezen arrest over letselschadevergoedingen

MPs Idsinga and Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of a 25 March 2022 Supreme Court ruling on wage tax treatment of injury compensation from workplace accidents, including refund rights and possible financial impact. The State Secretary answered all ten questions, arguing the ruling is new case law that adds a new condition to the 1983 Smeerkuil doctrine, so no ex officio reduction of past assessments and no compensation or specific policy change is required.
I am of the opinion that this is new case law.
Ik ben van mening dat sprake is van nieuwe jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht 'FIOD schorst speciale eenheid ‘onaanvaardbaar lang'

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance ministry about the suspension of the FIOD's Team Specialistische Operaties and a court's finding that the suspension was unacceptably long. The state secretary answered that mediation is ongoing, the suspension was justified by serious circumstances, the FIOD does not intend to dissolve the team, and investigations were not hindered.
In its ruling, the court pointed to an unacceptably long suspension.
In zijn uitspraak heeft de rechter gewezen op een onaanvaardbare lange schorsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Recordboete voor Belastingdienst vanwege zwarte lijst’

An MP asks whether the record fine imposed by the Data Protection Authority on the Tax Authority over the blacklist can be earmarked to strengthen taxpayers' legal protection, and how the fine flows through the budget. The State Secretary confirms the fine is paid from the Tax Authority budget, reaches the Justice budget via the CJIB, and that the cabinet may propose uses for these funds, but declines to commit to earmarking them for taxpayer legal aid.
I am therefore, ahead of final decision-making, exploring what possible situations a compensation would be appropriate in and what that compensation could be.
Ik ben daarom, vooruitlopend op definitieve besluitvorming, aan het verkennen wat mogelijke opties van situaties zijn waarin een tegemoetkoming passend is en wat dit voor tegemoetkoming kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over zeer forse onregelmatigheden bij de uitkering van de zorgbonus in 2020 en 2021

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister of Long-term Care and Sport and the State Secretary of Finance about serious irregularities in the 2020 and 2021 care bonus, including whether bonuses were paid net as promised and whether a sample finding of tax errors in 35% of cases showed fraud or a subsidy windfall. The minister answered that the errors mainly concern incorrect reporting of tax paid rather than deliberate fraud, that overpaid subsidy will be recovered, that a sample was kept rather than extended to full checks, and that four fraud reports have been filed.
Audited subsidies that contain errors will be set at a lower amount. The excess subsidy paid out will be recovered within the applicable laws and regulations.
Gecontroleerde subsidies die fouten bevatten worden lager vastgesteld. Het teveel uitgekeerde subsidiebedrag wordt binnen de hiervoor geldende wet- en regelgeving teruggevorderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Sylvana Simons  en Arib over de uitkomsten van PwC-onderzoeken naar de Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV)

MPs Koekkoek, Simons and Arib asked the government about PwC findings on the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), including use of ethnicity-based risk profiles and whether this amounts to institutional racism. The State Secretary largely declined to characterise the practice as racism, stated that nationality will only be used in supervision with a clear legal basis, promised a compensation scheme and reforms, but deferred many substantive questions on racism and definitions.
I cannot make a general statement about that.
Ik kan daar geen algemene uitspraak over doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Van der Lee  en Arib over de berichten dat de Belastingdienst discriminerende criteria in de fraudesignalering voorziening (FSV) verzweeg en dat de Belastingdienst op onrechtmati

Three MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Authority concealed discriminatory criteria in the fraud signalling facility (FSV) and unlawfully blocked access to blacklists. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, admitted the ministry knew of the discriminatory handbook since 2020, acknowledged the FSV processing was unlawful and will pay the fines, and said that FSV access requests are being handled and letters sent, while formal refusals of some access requests remain subject to a balancing of interests.
Yes, the manner in which personal data was processed in FSV was unlawful.
Ja, de wijze van verwerking van persoonsgegevens in FSV was onrechtmatig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de Belastingdienst die discriminerende criteria verzweeg

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Authority used discriminatory selection criteria (nationality, age, religion) for fraud investigations and whether ministry and agency knew of it earlier. The State Secretary confirms the Tax Authority's internal handbooks contained such references, says the 2020 handbook was declared invalid and the process halted, and states the criteria were not formally approved at political level, while refusing to give a definitive judgement on discrimination or racism and promising to return later.
These handbooks were not formally adopted within the Tax Authority, for example by management or by the corporate service Vaktechniek.
Deze handleidingen zijn niet formeel binnen de Belastingdienst vastgesteld, bijvoorbeeld door het management of door de corporate dienst Vaktechniek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het BTW-tarief op openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Infrastructure whether VAT on public transport should be abolished to attract passengers, compensate consumers and fight transport poverty, and what this would cost. The government declined to commit to abolition for now, pointing to pending analyses (KIM study, evaluation of the reduced VAT rate, the EU proposal), gave cost estimates of 300-400 million euros for full abolition and 100-133 million for a return to 6%, and noted that a 6% rate is technically impossible before 2026.
The cabinet wants to help people who find it difficult to absorb short-term cost increases with its package of purchasing power measures.
Het kabinet wil met het pakket aan koopkrachtmaatregelen mensen tegemoetkomen die kostenstijgingen op korte termijn moeilijk kunnen opvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Westerveld over het zo snel mogelijk naar het nultarief brengen van de btw op groente en fruit vanwege steeds duurdere boodschappen

MPs Van Esch and Westerveld asked why the VAT on fruit and vegetables cannot be cut to zero sooner, given rising grocery prices, and whether this could happen by 1 July 2022. The government answers that defining unprocessed produce raises complexity and fiscal-neutrality issues, so it cannot be done by 1 July 2022, and promises a plan of action with a study to the House by summer.
It is therefore not possible to arrange this by 1 July 2022.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om dit voor 1 juli 2022 te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over juridische adviezen over box 3

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary for Finance for a full list of legal advice on box 3 since 2010, including internal notes and advice from the Landsadvocaat, and questioned why no advice appears for 2015-2017 despite the Belastingplan 2016. The State Secretary confirmed the earlier list covered only 2015 onward and EVRM-related advice, said the 2015-2017 search scope explains the gap, and promised to send the notes on the Belastingplan 2016 before the summer recess, while stating that a full list of all advice could not be provided before the debate.
The notes prepared for the change to box 3 in the Belastingplan 2016 I will send to you before the summer recess.
De notities die zijn gemaakt ter voorbereiding op de wijziging in box 3 in het Belastingplan 2016 zal ik u voor het zomerreces toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Nijboer over "achterblijvende reiskostenvergoeding voor werknemers"

MPs Kathmann and Nijboer asked the government about rising commuting costs, the non-indexed tax-free travel allowance, and low employer reimbursement in low-wage sectors. The minister answered that the cost effects vary by worker, data on employer practices is incomplete, a study on modernising the allowance is due in 2022, and temporary fuel excise cuts and a planned future increase of the allowance are pointed to.
The Ministry of Finance is conducting research into modernising the travel allowance, and this research will be delivered in 2022.
Het Ministerie van Financiën doet onderzoek naar een modernisering van de reiskostenvergoeding, dat onderzoek zal in 2022 worden opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de aanwezigheid van Gazprom in Nederland

MPs from the SP asked the government about Gazprom's presence in the Netherlands, including its asset holdings via shell companies, Dutch investment ties with Russia, tax avoidance, tax rulings for state-owned firms, and frozen Russian assets. The State Secretary answered that sanctions freezes apply, the cabinet opposes facilitating Russian-linked shells and is banning certain trust services, tax secrecy limits detailed answers on individual taxpayers, and a rulings termination clause exists for sanctioned entities.
Under the tax secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), the cabinet cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Toezichthouder heeft dubbel gevoel bij reclames WOZ-aanslag’

An MP asked the government about rising WOZ property-valuation objections, the profits and public fees of no-cure-no-pay firms, their success rates versus citizens filing themselves, and the Waarderingskamer's advice. The government confirmed the trends, defended low-threshold legal protection including via no-cure-no-pay firms, and promised its reaction to the report before summer.
Yes, it is important that citizens' legal protection against the determination of the WOZ value is low-threshold.
Ja, het is belangrijk dat de rechtsbescherming van de burger tegen de vaststelling van de WOZ-waarde laagdrempelig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de mogelijkheid tot BTW aangifte na overlijden en verlopen DIGID

An MP asked how a sole trader's VAT return can be filed after death when DigiD access lapses, and whether DigiD can be transferred to a relative. The State Secretary replied that heirs can authorise a person through the Tax Authority counter to file digitally, that DigiD sharing is not allowed, and listed support measures and planned simplifications.
The Tax Authority is currently investigating whether the authorisation can also be issued without a visit to the counter.
De Belastingdienst onderzoekt momenteel of het mogelijk is om de machtiging ook zonder bezoek aan de balie afgegeven kan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Belastingexpert: 'Compensatie spaartaks kost maar € 3 miljard en kan rap worden opgelost'' en het artikel 'Een voorstel voor een goed uitvoerbaar

Two MPs (Idsinga, VVD and Inge van Dijk, CDA) asked the State Secretary for Finance about press reports proposing a quick, flat-rate compensation scheme for taxpayers wrongly taxed under box 3 (the savings tax). The State Secretary answered questions 2 to 12 by referring to a separate preparatory letter for a technical briefing, providing no substantive answer in this document.
Questions 2 to 12 are answered, as proposed in question 13, in the 'preparatory letter' sent to the House simultaneously with this reply.
De vragen 2 tot en met 12 worden, zoals voorgesteld in vraag 13, beantwoord in de «voorbereidingsbrief» die gelijktijdig met deze beantwoording aan uw Kamer is gestuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over correspondentie van de Belastingdienst in reactie op verzoeken van betrokkenen met betrekking tot inzage in hun persoonsgegevens vanwege registratie in de Fraudesignaleri

MP Inge van Dijk asked whether the Tax Authority's formal refusals of access requests about FSV fraud-register data, citing GDPR exceptions in general terms without explanation or contact, are acceptable and whether communication should change. State Secretary Van Rij answered that refusals are needed where oversight or third-party safety is at stake, cannot always be explained, and that the letters will be reviewed for a more human tone while remaining legally sound.
I will have the manner of communication in the context of FSV registration examined further.
Ik laat de wijze van communicatie in het kader van de FSV-registratie nader bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Boswijk over het bericht 'Accijnzen op voorraad diesel en propaan terugvragen tot en met 8 april'

CDA MPs asked why the deadline to claim excise refunds on stocks of diesel and propane was only one week, whether firms without the required EH3 eHerkenning level could still apply, and whether the deadline would be extended. The Secretary of State said the five-working-day term follows from the Excise Act, that applications can also be filed in writing or via DigiD, and agreed to extend the deadline to 13 April.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Smals over het bericht ‘Meerderheid scholen weigert inzet zzp’ers ondanks lerarentekort’

MPs Paul and Smals asked the government about a report that most schools refuse to deploy freelancers (zzp'ers) despite teacher shortages, and about enforcement moratorium, the DBA web module and legal uncertainty over flexible contracts. The minister answered that there are no signs refusals worsen teacher shortages, that enforcement moratorium remains in force with exceptions for malicious cases and unfollowed instructions, that the web module is only indicative and a broader policy letter will follow before summer 2022.
Before the summer we will inform you further about the elaboration of this ambition in the coalition agreement.
Voor de zomer zullen wij u nader informeren over de uitwerking van deze in het coalitieakkoord opgenomen ambitie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aangenomen motie om binnen 48 uur de fiscale gegevens van de personen op de sanctielijst te beschikking te stellen aan de autoriteiten die de sancties moeten opleggen

MP Omtzigt asked the government about the adopted motion requiring tax data, including APA and ATR rulings, of persons on the sanctions list to be shared within 48 hours with sanctions enforcement authorities, and about the Tax Authority's data sharing, asset freezing and contacts with listed persons. The State Secretary answered that a tax secrecy exemption was granted and a legal basis is being pursued, that the ruling inventory of 3,400 requests is ongoing, and that contacts with listed persons are not tracked.
No overview is kept of contacts that ministers and officials have with persons on sanctions lists.
Er wordt geen overzicht bijgehouden van contacten die bewindspersonen en ambtenaren hebben met personen die op sanctielijsten staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Romke de Jong over pensioenopbouw door zzp’ers

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Romke de Jong asked about pension accrual by self-employed workers (zzp'ers) during and after the coronavirus crisis, including the role of home equity as a pension provision, administrative burdens and withdrawal flexibility. Minister Schouten answered that the proposed Wetsvoorstel toekomst pensioenen raises the tax-facilitated savings room for the self-employed, that home equity is not designed as a pension provision and will not be promoted specifically, and that an experiment will ease access to second-pillar schemes.
The cabinet is of the view that pension accrual for self-employed workers will thereby be better facilitated.
Het kabinet is van mening dat pensioenopbouw voor zelfstandigen hierdoor beter wordt gefaciliteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Boulakjar over de kamerverhuurvrijstelling

MPs Romke de Jong and Boulakjar asked whether the room-rental tax exemption (kamerverhuurvrijstelling) should be raised to better use the housing stock, and about its rationale, budget and tax effects. The government answered that better use of existing housing can help, referred to the National Housing and Construction Agenda, explained the exemption's conditions and rationale, and argued that raising it would have negligible effects on the housing shortage and could push up rents.
Because the exempt amount per month is already higher than the average cost of a room with shared facilities, I consider the chosen level of the room-rental exemption defensible
Omdat het vrijgestelde bedrag per maand reeds hoger is dan de gemiddelde kostprijs voor een kamer met gedeelde voorzieningen vind ik de gekozen hoogte van de kamerverhuurvrijstelling verdedigbaar
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over dubbele belasting op energie en brandstof

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance why VAT is charged on excise and energy tax, arguing this double taxation is unfair, and asked for an analysis of abolishing it. The government replied that VAT on these taxes follows from the EU VAT Directive, that abolishing it is not possible, and that it is only temporarily lowering fuel excise and energy VAT rates to cushion price rises.
The cabinet does not intend to consider such a policy change and will therefore not investigate it.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens een dergelijke beleidswijziging te overwegen, en zal dit daarom ook niet onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over oplossingen voor de stijgende brandstofprijzen

Member Stoffer (SGP) asked whether rising fuel prices burden households and firms, whether excise on fuel should be temporarily cut, whether VAT revenue from higher prices should be frozen, and whether the proposed higher untaxed travel allowance can be brought forward. The State Secretary answered that the government will cut fuel excise by 21% for nine months from 1 April, denied automatic extra VAT windfalls, refused to freeze VAT revenue citing budget rules, and said the travel allowance cannot be raised mid-year for technical reasons.
To cushion the effects, the cabinet announced last Friday, 11 March, that it intends, among other things, to temporarily lower the excise duty on petrol and diesel by 21% from 1 April.
Om de gevolgen te dempen heeft het kabinet afgelopen vrijdag 11 maart aangekondigd dat het onder andere voornemens is om per 1 april de accijns voor benzine en diesel tijdelijk te verlagen met 21%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Grinwis en Ceder over het gebruik van eHerkenning

MPs Omtzigt, Grinwis and Ceder asked why the government keeps requiring eHerkenning for tax filing despite a Gelderland court ruling questioning its legal basis, and about refunds, penalties and a free public alternative. The State Secretary defends the legal basis, says the ruling does not affect other tax assessments, offers a limited compensation scheme, and refuses to provide a free public login or restore paper filing for now.
To clarify this, I will have an addendum published on the Tax Administration's website.
Om dit toe te lichten zal ik een naschrift laten publiceren op de website van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Van Strien over het artikel van Constantijn van Oranje in het Financieel Dagblad met als titel ‘We hadden de ster van Europa kunnen zijn’

MPs Idsinga and Van Strien asked the minister about a newspaper article claiming the Netherlands missed chances to become Europe's startup star, and about startup policy, venture capital, the Growth Fund and the tax bill on stock option rules. The minister rejected the claim that the Netherlands is lagging, described existing policy instruments and knowledge gaps, and gave a status update on the delayed stock option bill with no firm new timeline.
I agree with the envoy that we must remain alert to new opportunities and keep working to solve bottlenecks in our startup climate.
Ik ben het eens met de envoy dat we alert moeten zijn op nieuwe kansen en ons moeten blijven inzetten voor het oplossen van knelpunten in ons startup klimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de gewijzigde definitief van royalty’s, waardoor het voor multinationals makkelijk is om onder de Wet bronbelasting uit te komen

MPs Alkaya asked whether AmCham lobbied to change the definition of royalties in the Dutch withholding tax act and why the definition was chosen, including its relation to the OECD model treaty and transfer pricing guidelines. The State Secretary replied that a consultation with AmCham touched on the royalty definition but did not shape the law, that the definition follows OECD Model Treaty Article 12 to target passive income flows, and that the Tax Authority assesses mixed contracts case by case.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ambassadeurs op de fraudelijst van de Belastingdienst

An MP asked why two ambassadors were on the Tax Authority's fraud list (FSV) and why they were not informed, under which GDPR exemption, and who they are and why they are listed. The State Secretary answered that the ambassadors will be informed like others unless an exemption applies, that the Tax Authority consulted the Foreign Ministry, and that the tax secrecy duty prevents him from identifying individuals or their tax position.
The ambassadors will, like other people registered in FSV, be informed, unless an exemption ground applies.
De ambassadeurs zullen net als andere mensen die in FSV stonden geregistreerd, worden geïnformeerd, tenzij er sprake is van een uitzonderingsgrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht 'FIOD-speurders thuis na vergoedingenruzie'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Idsinga asked about reports that the FIOD suspended its Team Specialistische Operaties over an allowance dispute, and about the team's role, the cause, and the atmosphere within the FIOD. The Secretary of State declined to give details, citing an ongoing labour and court dispute and the employer's duty of care, while saying investigations continue with partner agencies and that the directorate seeks a swift resolution.
No statement is made on the specific content. The matter is before the court.
Over de specifieke inhoud wordt geen mededeling gedaan. De zaak is onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Knops over het bericht 'FIOD-speurders thuis na vergoedingenruzie'

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports that a FIOD special operations team was sent home for months over an allowance dispute and alleged fear-based management culture. The State Secretary declined to discuss specifics because of the labour and court proceedings, denied knowledge of such a culture without signals, and said efforts were underway to find a quick solution.
This is a labour-law dispute between employees and their employer. I cannot make any public statements about it.
Er is hier sprake van een arbeidsrechtelijk geschil tussen werknemers en hun werkgever. Ik kan hierover in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over het eerder afschaffen van de Jubelton

MP Maatoug asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the tax-free gift for a home (Jubelton) could be set to zero before 2024 via a parameter change, arguing this would reduce housing inequality, and why abolition was not earlier. The State Secretary answered that setting it to zero requires structural system changes, that a floor of 27,231 euro is preferred, that abolition is planned for 1 January 2024, and that the timing was constrained by ICT portfolio capacity.
It is technically possible to automate lowering the gift exemption for the owner-occupied home for parental gifts to children to one euro or another amount, but not to 0 euro.
Het is automatiseringstechnisch mogelijk om de schenkingsvrijstelling voor de eigen woning voor schenkingen van ouders aan kinderen te verlagen tot één euro of een ander bedrag, maar niet tot 0 euro.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Rutte gaat in gesprek met bedrijfsleven over toenemende 'ellende''

CDA MPs asked the government about reports that Prime Minister Rutte would talk with business about rising hardship, debt built up during COVID, the hardship-fund and TVL/NOW subsidy gaps, bank refinancing costs, retail support and Bbz/TONK uptake. The ministers answered that talks with business continue, that a broad set of debt-relief tools exists, that subsidy rules cannot easily cover edge cases without slowing payments, and that some follow-up letters and reviews will come.
The cabinet realises that the current support package does not fit every individual situation, and that feels uncomfortable.
Het kabinet beseft dat het huidige steunpakket niet op iedere individuele situatie aansluit, en dat voelt ongemakkelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over risicoselectie op basis van uiterlijk voorkomen

An MP asked the government whether the Tax Authority used risk profiles based on appearance, nationality and other personal traits, following PwC findings on its FSV blacklist. The State Secretary acknowledged examples referring to nationality and migration background, said no explicit appearance-based criteria were found beyond one 2016 email, stated that discrimination in risk selection is not permitted except in exceptional cases, and announced further investigations and safeguards while not answering all questions fully.
Unfortunately it has not proven possible to answer the questions within the deadline set by the member.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken de vragen binnen de door het lid gestelde termijn te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een voor de belastingdienst beschamende uitspraak bij het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden over o.a. zwarte lijsten

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling criticising the Tax Authority over blacklist (FSV) registration, dossier access, appeal conduct and trust in the tax service. The State Secretary answered most questions on substance, but declined to discuss individual cases citing tax secrecy, and committed to further investigations, an external review of CAF, and a compensation regime.
Based on the tax secrecy obligation in Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot address the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht uit artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over de afwijzing van inzageverzoek in FSV

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance about the rejection of a data access request concerning registration in the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), including why citizens are denied the specific grounds for refusal. The government answered that exceptions such as investigation interests and tips apply, that numbers of requests and timeliness are reported, that the grounds for refusal are assessed case by case without disclosing details, and that a compensation scheme is being developed for early 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over het artikel 'Opeens is de machine of de fabriek veel minder waard'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Climate and Energy how fiscal depreciation and write-down rules work and whether the energy transition will force large write-downs of machines and factories. The government explained the depreciation and write-down rules in detail, said the impact of the energy transition varies case by case and cannot be quantified, and concluded that tax rules will not significantly affect the pace of the transition.
That cannot be said in general terms.
Dat is niet in algemene zin te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over Nederland als belastingparadijs

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Netherlands is a tax haven given that many large multinationals route profits through Dutch entities, and about dividend withholding tax, shell companies and the Secretary's own past involvement in tax structures. The government denied the Netherlands is a tax haven, cited secrecy rules that prevent discussing individual firms, and described recent anti-avoidance measures (conditional withholding taxes, the principal purpose test) with monitoring promised, though it declined to say how much tax has yet been collected and did not answer whether the Secretary had been involved in avoidance structures beyond general statements.
Based on the fiscal secrecy obligation laid down in article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), the cabinet cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.

Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht die is neergelegd in artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad met betrekking tot box 3

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Supreme Court's box 3 ruling, the handling of individual objections within the mass-objection procedure, and whether the uncertainty over who validly objected will be resolved, plus a legislative fix. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling creates urgency to amend the law, said the full scope of those eligible for redress is not yet determined, and promised to inform parliament and hold a debate.

The full scope of the group of citizens eligible for redress has not yet been determined, but we will very seriously consider whether the group that did not file an objection will also fall under the redress.

De volledige reikwijdte van de groep burgers die in aanmerking komen voor rechtsherstel is op dit moment nog niet bepaald, maar wij zullen zeer serieus meewegen of de groep die geen bezwaar heeft gemaakt ook onder het rechtsherstel zal vallen.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel ‘Wat hebben Nederlandse landbouwbedrijven op een beurs in Rusland te zoeken?’1

Members of D66 asked the government about Dutch agricultural firms exhibiting at a fair in Krasnodar and continuing to operate in Russia, including whether agricultural machinery exports strengthen Russia and whether export bans and company conduct should be addressed. The minister answered that the government balances sanctions against food security, pursues a ban on specific high-tech agricultural machinery exports, notes that Dutch-linked export figures cannot be solely attributed to machinery, and will inform parliament further on a motion.
The cabinet continues to work towards banning exports of specific high-grade agricultural machinery to Russia.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen voor het verbieden van de export van specifieke, hoogwaardige landbouwmachines naar Rusland.
